1.niv: In the beginning was the Word, and the Word was with God, and the Word was God.
1.cmn: 太初有道，道與上帝同在，道就是上帝。
1.sry: Tu naunamu akumeya ta Su, ka ayakwa ki Alid ta Su, ka Alid ta Su [ka ana].

2.niv: He was with God in the beginning.
2.cmn: 這道太初與上帝同在。
2.sry: Ta ata ayakwa ki Alid tu naunamu.

3.niv: Through him all things were made; without him nothing was made that has been made.
3.cmn: 萬物是藉着他造的；凡被造的，沒有一樣不是藉着他造的。
3.sry: Nipeyimiden ta mamang ki ana, ka tu ausi ki ana, asi nipeyringey ta sasasat ka mamang, ka nipeyringey ra.

4.niv: In him was life, and that life was the light of all mankind.
4.cmn: 生命在他裏頭，這生命就是人的光。
4.sry: Ayakwa tu ana ta kawagan, ka kawagan [ka ana] ta ramag ki kagulung.

5.niv: The light shines in the darkness, and the darkness has not overcome it.
5.cmn: 光照在黑暗裏，黑暗卻不接受光。
5.sry: Ka maramag ta ramag tu karumduman, ka asi nimibaley ta karumduman ki ana.

6.niv: There was a man sent from God whose name was John.
6.cmn: 有一個人，是從上帝那裏差來的，名叫約翰。
6.sry: Niakumeya ta tau ka na padadingey ki Alid, ka nanang tin ta ti Yoanes.

7.niv: He came as a witness to testify concerning that light, so that through him all might believe.
7.cmn: 這人來，為要作見證，就是為光作見證，叫眾人因他可以信。
7.sry: Teni ka ata ta niirua tu patagihailan, ka patagihailey tin ta ramag, aley ka tnaimida tnamising aley tenian.

8.niv: He himself was not the light; he came only as a witness to the light.
8.cmn: 他不是那光，乃是要為光作見證。
8.sry: Asi ramag ta teni, ra dik aley ki patagihailey tin ki ramag da.

9.niv: The true light that gives light to everyone was coming into the world.
9.cmn: 那光是真光，照亮一切生在世上的人。
9.sry: [Teni ka ana] ta ramag ka dilig, ka maramag imid ki kagulung ka irua tu Nay.

10.niv: He was in the world, and though the world was made through him, the world did not recognize him.
10.cmn: 他在世界，世界也是藉着他造的，世界卻不認識他。
10.sry: Ayakwa tu Nay ta teni, ka nipeyringey tin ta Nay: ka asi nikmalang tenian ta Nay ra.

11.niv: He came to that which was his own, but his own did not receive him.
11.cmn: 他到自己的地方來，自己的人倒不接待他。
11.sry: Nimukwa ki a'teni, ka asi niabaley [matararig] tenian ta a'teni.

12.niv: Yet to all who did receive him, to those who believed in his name, he gave the right to become children of God—
12.cmn: 凡接待他的，就是信他名的人，他就賜他們權柄作上帝的兒女。
12.sry: Papinapina ta niabaley [matararig] tenian, nipigaen tin ta kailgan kawalalak ki Alid, nenian ka tnamising ki nanang tin da.

13.niv: children born not of natural descent, nor of human decision or a husbandʼs will, but born of God.
13.cmn: 這等人不是從血氣生的，不是從情慾生的，也不是從人意生的，乃是從上帝生的。
13.sry: Ka asi nipualaken na gamag, asi na kamuyen ki vaat, asi na kamuyen ki parag, ra na Alid apa.

14.niv: The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth.
14.cmn: 道成了肉身，住在我們中間，充充滿滿地有恩典有真理。我們也見過他的榮光，正是父獨生子的榮光。
14.sry: Ka nikawvaat ta Su, Ka niitukakwa imitaan, (ka nikitaen yan ta kairangan tin, ta kairangan ki kidi mama ki Paisaten ki Rama ra) matmuy ki kanadapan, ka mamisingan apa.

15.niv: (John testified concerning him. He cried out, saying, “This is the one I spoke about when I said, ‘He who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’ ”)
15.cmn: 約翰為他作見證，喊着說：「這就是我曾說：『那在我以後來的，反成了在我以前的，因他本來在我以前。』」
15.sry: Matagihail ta ti Yoanes tenian ka nipakulangagen tin, kuma, “Teni ta ti ata ka nikwaaw, Teni ka siawug yawan, ta nikawhauro yawan, aley ka tu uru yawan akumeya ta teni.”

16.niv: Out of his fullness we have all received grace in place of grace already given.
16.cmn: 從他豐滿的恩典裏，我們都領受了，而且恩上加恩。
16.sry: Ka tu katmuyan tin nipeyimiden eta mara ta kanadapan, ka kuma tunutunun ki kanadapan da.

17.niv: For the law was given through Moses; grace and truth came through Jesus Christ.
17.cmn: 律法本是藉着摩西傳的；恩典和真理都是由耶穌基督來的。
17.sry: Aley ka na papiga ti Moses ta Tatuko, ra kanadapan ta kamamisingan apa na pavafutaw [ta ana] ti Yesus Kristus.

18.niv: No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is himself God and is in closest relationship with the Father, has made him known.
18.cmn: 從來沒有人看見上帝，只有在父懷裏的獨生子將他表明出來。 施洗約翰的見證 （太3‧1－12；可1‧1－8；路3‧1－18）
18.sry: Mikakwa asi nikmita ta timamang ki Alid ra: Alak ka peysaten ka itukwa tu ayva ki Rama, teni ta nitmawug pupanag [imitaan].

19.niv: Now this was Johnʼs testimony when the Jewish leaders in Jerusalem sent priests and Levites to ask him who he was.
19.cmn: 約翰所作的見證記在下面：猶太人從耶路撒冷差祭司和利未人到約翰那裏，問他說：「你是誰？」
19.sry: Ka ata ta patagihailen ti Yoanes, ru padingien ki Yoden maka Yerusalem ta Tamapigik ki Leviten apa patalig tenian; “Timang kaw?”

20.niv: He did not fail to confess, but confessed freely, “I am not the Messiah.”
20.cmn: 他就明說，並不隱瞞，明說：「我不是基督。」
20.sry: Ka nimatagidungdung ta teni, ka asi nirmaw; ka nidmungdung matagikumahina, “Asi ti yaw ta ti Kristus.

21.niv: They asked him, “Then who are you? Are you Elijah?” He said, “I am not.” “Are you the Prophet?” He answered, “No.”
21.cmn: 他們又問他說：「這樣，你是誰呢？是以利亞嗎？」他說：「我不是。」「是那先知嗎？」他回答說：「不是。」
21.sry: Ka nitagitalig [ta neni] nein tenian, “na mang lava? Ti Eliyas kaw kawa?” Ka nikuma ta teni, “Asi ko [ti ana]”. “Tamamatagitan kaw kawa?” ka nimatagivli ta teni, “Asi.”

22.niv: Finally they said, “Who are you? Give us an answer to take back to those who sent us. What do you say about yourself?”
22.cmn: 於是他們說：「你到底是誰，叫我們好回覆差我們來的人。你自己說，你是誰？」
22.sry: Anata nikuma ta neni tenian: “Timang kaw ra? Aley ka patagivlianey yan ki su nenian ka nimadingi imianan, mang kuma kaw imhuan mamado?”

23.niv: John replied in the words of Isaiah the prophet, “I am the voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Make straight the way for the Lord.’ ”
23.cmn: 他說：「我就是那在曠野有人聲喊着說：『修直主的道路』，正如先知以賽亞所說的。」
23.sry: Nikuma: “Ti yaw ta ingaw ki Makulangag tu pawlapawlag da: peytiktikaw pakahapuhap ta darang ki Meyrang, mama ki nipasusuen ti Esayas ka na Matagitan.

24.niv: Now the Pharisees who had been sent
24.cmn: 那些人是法利賽人差來的；
24.sry: Ka nipadingien na Farizeen ta neni.

25.niv: questioned him, “Why then do you baptize if you are not the Messiah, nor Elijah, nor the Prophet?”
25.cmn: 他們就問他說：「你既不是基督，不是以利亞，也不是那先知，為甚麼施洗呢？」
25.sry: Ka nitmalig tenian, ka nikuma tenian ta neni: “Kaumang ka maawlug kaw, ru asi kaw ti Kristus, asi ti Eliyas, asi ki Tamamatagitan da?”

26.niv: “I baptize with water,” John replied, “but among you stands one you do not know.
26.cmn: 約翰回答說：「我是用水施洗，但有一位站在你們中間，是你們不認識的，
26.sry: Nimatagivli nenian ta ti Yoanes, kuma: “Ti yaw ta maawlug ki ralum, ra muripat mituko imumian, ka asi mumi kalangen da.

27.niv: He is the one who comes after me, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to untie.”
27.cmn: 就是那在我以後來的，我給他解鞋帶也不配。」
27.sry: Teni ta ti ana ka siawug irua yawan, ka nikawuro yawan da, ka asi ko tu kairangan ki kidi, ki aawsasikutaney mawtarapal ki tatapil tin.”

28.niv: This all happened at Bethany on the other side of the Jordan, where John was baptizing.
28.cmn: 這是在約旦河外伯大尼，約翰施洗的地方作的見證。 上帝的羔羊
28.sry: Nimamut ta ata tu Bethabara tu arug ki Yordan, ka mawlulug ta ti Yoanes tu hina.

29.niv: The next day John saw Jesus coming toward him and said, “Look, the Lamb of God, who takes away the sin of the world!
29.cmn: 次日，約翰看見耶穌來到他那裏，就說：「看哪，上帝的羔羊，除去世人罪孽的！
29.sry: Tu sasat apa ki wagi ka tu awug nikitaan ti Yoanes ta ti Yesus ka mukwa tenian, ka kuma: “Kitaey ta patak ki yuko ki Alid, ka tamaawmia ki varaw ki imid ki nay ra.

30.niv: This is the one I meant when I said, ‘A man who comes after me has surpassed me because he was before me.’
30.cmn: 這就是我曾說：『有一位在我以後來、反成了在我以前的，因他本來在我以前。』
30.sry: Teni ta ti ata ka nikwaaw; siawug yawan irua ta parag, ka nikawuro yawan, aley ka itu uro yawan da.

31.niv: I myself did not know him, but the reason I came baptizing with water was that he might be revealed to Israel.”
31.cmn: 我先前不認識他，如今我來用水施洗，為要叫他顯明給以色列人。」
31.sry: Ka asi ko nikmalang tenian, ra tu pupanagan pakavana tenian ki Israel, aley ki ana irua ato ko mawlulug ki ralum.

32.niv: Then John gave this testimony: “I saw the Spirit come down from heaven as a dove and remain on him.
32.cmn: 約翰又作見證說：「我曾看見聖靈，彷彿鴿子從天降下，住在他的身上。
32.sry: Ka nimatagihail ta ti Yoanes, kuma; “nikitaen aw ta Yupan ka murarim maka tunun, mama ki padaug mayali itu halap tenian.

33.niv: And I myself did not know him, but the one who sent me to baptize with water told me, ‘The man on whom you see the Spirit come down and remain is the one who will baptize with the Holy Spirit.’
33.cmn: 我先前不認識他，只是那差我來用水施洗的、對我說：『你看見聖靈降下來，住在誰的身上，誰就是用聖靈施洗的。』
33.sry: Ka asi maw kalangen ta teni, ra teni ka nimadingi yawan paawlug ki ralum, teni ta nikuma yawan, “timang ta kitaey oho itukwa murarim muhalap tenian ta Yupan, mayali apa mahalap tenian, teni ka ata ta mawlug ki Yupan ka Dilig Matiktik.”

34.niv: I have seen and I testify that this is Godʼs Chosen One.”
34.cmn: 我看見了，就證明這是上帝的兒子。」 初次選召門徒
34.sry: Ka ti yaw ta nikmita, ka nimatagihail ko, ka Alak ki Alid ta ti ata ra.

35.niv: The next day John was there again with two of his disciples.
35.cmn: 再次日，約翰同兩個門徒站在那裏。
35.sry: Tu sasat apa ki wagi ka tu awug nimila mituko ta ti Yoanes, ki raruha apa ki patatawutawugan tin.

36.niv: When he saw Jesus passing by, he said, “Look, the Lamb of God!”
36.cmn: 他見耶穌行走，就說：「看哪，這是上帝的羔羊！」
36.sry: Ka ru ararawen tin ta ti Yesusan ka munonang, nikuma ta teni: Kitaey ta patak ki yuko ki Alid.

37.niv: When the two disciples heard him say this, they followed Jesus.
37.cmn: 兩個門徒聽見他的話，就跟從了耶穌。
37.sry: Ka nimilingig ta raruha ki patatawutawugan ki su tin, ka nimawug ti Yesusan.

38.niv: Turning around, Jesus saw them following and asked, “What do you want?” They said, “Rabbi” (which means “Teacher”), “where are you staying?”
38.cmn: 耶穌轉過身來，看見他們跟着，就問他們說：「你們要甚麼？」他們說：「拉比，在哪裏住？」（拉比翻出來就是夫子。）
38.sry: Iru ka mawveyring ta ti Yesus ka ru kmita [ka] mawug tenian, nikuma nenian;

39.niv: “Come,” he replied, “and you will see.” So they went and saw where he was staying, and they spent that day with him. It was about four in the afternoon.
39.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們來看。」他們就去看他在哪裏住，這一天便與他同住；那時約有申正了。
39.sry: Kamang ta kiimen umi? Neni ra nikuma tenian, Rabi (ka ru pahabiriviri teni ki su ki Matatawtawug) itukakuna kaw?

40.niv: Andrew, Simon Peterʼs brother, was one of the two who heard what John had said and who had followed Jesus.
40.cmn: 聽見約翰的話跟從耶穌的那兩個人，一個是西門‧彼得的兄弟安得烈。
40.sry: Nikuma nenian; “Ukwaaw, kmita ato.” Ka niukwa ka nikitaen nein itukuna ta teni, ka nimisasaun tenian sat ki wagi ka ana. Ka tu hivat ato ki sat kitian ki tagley.

41.niv: The first thing Andrew did was to find his brother Simon and tell him, “We have found the Messiah” (that is, the Christ).
41.cmn: 他先找着自己的哥哥西門，對他說：「我們遇見彌賽亞了。」（彌賽亞翻出來就是基督。）
41.sry: Ti Andreas ka tagiaparag ti Simon Petrus ta saat ki raruha [ki vual] ka nimilingig ki ata ti Yoanesan, ka nimawug tenian. [Ki na saat ki raruha ki vual ka niilingigen tin ta su ti Yoanes, ka nimawug tenian, ata ta ti Andreas ka ti tagiaparag ti Petrus.]

42.niv: And he brought him to Jesus. Jesus looked at him and said, “You are Simon son of John. You will be called Cephas” (which, when translated, is Peter).
42.cmn: 於是領他去見耶穌。耶穌看着他，說：「你是約翰的兒子西門，你要稱為磯法。」（磯法翻出來就是彼得。） 呼召腓力和拿但業
42.sry: Ti ata ta nikmauro kmavaley ki tagiaparag tin ka dilig ka ti Simon, ka nikuma tenian; Nitawvaleyen yan ta ti Mesiyas, ata ato du pahabirivirien ki su ta [nivulu ka] ti Kristus.

43.niv: The next day Jesus decided to leave for Galilee. Finding Philip, he said to him, “Follow me.”
43.cmn: 又次日，耶穌想要往加利利去，遇見腓力，就對他說：「來跟從我吧。」
43.sry: Ka nidmilug tin tenian pukwa ti Yesusan. Ka tu ararawen ti Yesus tenian, nikuma; Ti Simon kaw, alak ti Yona; ka pananangey kaw Sefas, ka pahaviribirien ki su ta [vato, ka] ti Petrus.

44.niv: Philip, like Andrew and Peter, was from the town of Bethsaida.
44.cmn: 這腓力是伯賽大人，和安得烈、彼得同城。
44.sry: Tu awug ki wagi nimamuy ta ti Yesus tawhabul mukwa tu Galilaya, ka nikavaleyen tin ta ti Filipus, ka nikuma tenian, Mawuga yawan da.

45.niv: Philip found Nathanael and told him, “We have found the one Moses wrote about in the Law, and about whom the prophets also wrote—Jesus of Nazareth, the son of Joseph.”
45.cmn: 腓力找着拿但業，對他說：「摩西在律法上所寫的和眾先知所記的那一位，我們遇見了，就是約瑟的兒子拿撒勒人耶穌。」
45.sry: Ka maka Betsayda ta ti Filipus, na awma ti Andreas, ti Petrus.

46.niv: “Nazareth! Can anything good come from there?” Nathanael asked. “Come and see,” said Philip.
46.cmn: 拿但業對他說：「拿撒勒還能出甚麼好的嗎？」腓力說：「你來看！」
46.sry: Nikmavaley ta ti Filipus ti Natanaelan, ka kuma tenian; Nitawvaleyen yan [ta ti ana] ka nisulaten ti Moses tu Tatuko, ki Tamamatagitan apa [ata] ta ti ka maka Nazareth.

47.niv: When Jesus saw Nathanael approaching, he said of him, “Here truly is an Israelite in whom there is no deceit.”
47.cmn: 耶穌看見拿但業來，就指着他說：「看哪，這是個真以色列人，他心裏是沒有詭詐的。」
47.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Natanael tenian, hmalpug kawa irua ta mamamang ka mariyang maka Nazareth? Nikuma ta ti Filipus tenian, ukwaaw, kitaey.

48.niv: “How do you know me?” Nathanael asked. Jesus answered, “I saw you while you were still under the fig tree before Philip called you.”
48.cmn: 拿但業對耶穌說：「你從哪裏知道我呢？」耶穌回答說：「腓力還沒有招呼你，你在無花果樹底下，我就看見你了。」
48.sry: Ka nikmita ta ti Yesus ti Natanaelan ka mukwa tenian, ka nimatagimimia tenian, “Kitaey dilig ta Israelit, ka ausi ki sivanavanaan tenian.

49.niv: Then Nathanael declared, “Rabbi, you are the Son of God; you are the king of Israel.”
49.cmn: 拿但業說：「拉比，你是上帝的兒子，你是以色列的王！」
49.sry: Nikuma ta ti Natanael tenian, ayakwaen ka kmalang kaw yawan? Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma tenian, “Siuro ki nitataamen imhuan ti Filipus, du itukwa apa kaw tu ngara ki lakawungan, ka kitaen aw kaw.”

50.niv: Jesus said, “You believe because I told you I saw you under the fig tree. You will see greater things than that.”
50.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「因為我說『在無花果樹底下看見你』，你就信嗎？你將要看見比這更大的事」；
50.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Natanael ka kuma tenian, “Rabi, imhu ta Alak ki Alid, imhu ta Meysasu ka Sibavaw ki Israel.”

51.niv: He then added, “Very truly I tell you, you will see ‘heaven open, and the angels of God ascending and descending on’ the Son of Man.”
51.cmn: 又說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們將要看見天開了，上帝的使者上去下來在人子身上。」
51.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus nikuma tenian, “Aley ka nipasusuen aw imhuan, nikitaen aw kaw tu ngara ki lakawungan, tnamising ato kaw: kmitaa kaw ki masaun irang ki ata.”

1.niv: On the third day a wedding took place at Cana in Galilee. Jesusʼ mother was there,
1.cmn: 第三日，在加利利的迦拿有娶親的筵席，耶穌的母親在那裏。
1.sry: Ka tu wagi ka taturu niakumeya ki uvavatugan ki pakakitilan tu Kana ka tu Galilaya: ka anaen hina ta Rarenan ti Yesus.

2.niv: and Jesus and his disciples had also been invited to the wedding.
2.cmn: 耶穌和他的門徒也被請去赴席。
2.sry: Ka ana patatataam apa ta ti Yesus lam apa ki patatawutawugan tin paukwa tu vatug ki pakakitilan.

3.niv: When the wine was gone, Jesusʼ mother said to him, “They have no more wine.”
3.cmn: 酒用盡了，耶穌的母親對他說：「他們沒有酒了。」
3.sry: Iru ka aulug ta hala ki karawmata, nikuma ta Rarenan ti Yesus tenian, ausi ato ta neni ki hala ki karawmata.

4.niv: “Woman, why do you involve me?” Jesus replied. “My hour has not yet come.”
4.cmn: 耶穌說：「母親，我與你有甚麼相干？我的時候還沒有到。」
4.sry: Nikuma tenian ta ti Yesus, “Ina, manga maw kaw asi apa irua ato ta kidi ki tagley aw”

5.niv: His mother said to the servants, “Do whatever he tells you.”
5.cmn: 他母親對用人說：「他告訴你們甚麼，你們就做甚麼。」
5.sry: Nikuma ta Rarenan tin ki pairungan, “kamamang ka pasusuaney tin imumian akwaaw lato”.

6.niv: Nearby stood six stone water jars, the kind used by the Jews for ceremonial washing, each holding from twenty to thirty gallons.
6.cmn: 照猶太人潔淨的規矩，有六口石缸擺在那裏，每口可以盛兩三桶水。
6.sry: Ka niatakwaan hina ta vaangavang ka aninim ka na vato aley ka puraralumey na kidi ki pakakuptigan ki Yoden, ka sasasat ki ana pukun ruruha tuturu lava [sato ki kairangan] ka metreten

7.niv: Jesus said to the servants, “Fill the jars with water”; so they filled them to the brim.
7.cmn: 耶穌對用人說：「把缸倒滿了水。」他們就倒滿了，直到缸口。
7.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian: “Pasitmuyey ta vaangavang ka puraraluman ki ralum. Ka niputubien nein ta ana tu ngataf.

8.niv: Then he told them, “Now draw some out and take it to the master of the banquet.” They did so,
8.cmn: 耶穌又說：「現在可以舀出來，送給管筵席的。」他們就送了去。
8.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, “haibaw hinin, adaw ki Sibavaw ki talag [ka tamapeylilig], ka niaden nein.

9.niv: and the master of the banquet tasted the water that had been turned into wine. He did not realize where it had come from, though the servants who had drawn the water knew. Then he called the bridegroom aside
9.cmn: 管筵席的嘗了那水變的酒，並不知道是哪裏來的，只有舀水的用人知道。管筵席的便叫新郎來，
9.sry: Iru ka k-kaha kdiman ta Sibavaw ki talag ki ralum, ka nipahahalaen ki karawmata, (ka asi tin umhaen nitagikuna [ta ata], ra umhaen ki pairungan ka nimagib ki ralum da), anata nitataam ki Sibavaw ki talag ta parag ka vahaw.

10.niv: and said, “Everyone brings out the choice wine first and then the cheaper wine after the guests have had too much to drink; but you have saved the best till now.”
10.cmn: 對他說：「人都是先擺上好酒，等客喝足了，才擺上次的，你倒把好酒留到如今！」
10.sry: Ka kuma tenian: “Veyag ka kagulung paiuro ki hala ki karawmata ka mariyang, iru ka nimusangig mit [paitawtawug] ki masaun asi mariyang, ra, imhu nihma kaw ki mariyang tu kidi hinin.”

11.niv: What Jesus did here in Cana of Galilee was the first of the signs through which he revealed his glory; and his disciples believed in him.
11.cmn: 這是耶穌所行的頭一件神蹟，是在加利利的迦拿行的，顯出他的榮耀來；他的門徒就信他了。
11.sry: Naunamu ka ata ki pukidian ka uringawen ta nipamuten ti Yesus tu Kana ka itu Galilaya, ka nipuamag pupanag ki kairangan ki kidi tin, ka nitnamising tenian ta patatawutawugan tin.

12.niv: After this he went down to Capernaum with his mother and brothers and his disciples. There they stayed for a few days.
12.cmn: 這事以後，耶穌與他的母親、弟兄，和門徒都下迦百農去，在那裏住了不多幾日。 潔淨聖殿 （太21‧12－13；可11‧15－17；路19‧45－46）
12.sry: Siawug ki ana nimurapag ta teni mukwa tu Kapernaum, teni, ki Rarenan tin, ki tagiapaparag tin, ki patatawutawugan apa tin ka asi maka dalia ki wagi ki payalien nein hina.

13.niv: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, Jesus went up to Jerusalem.
13.cmn: 猶太人的逾越節近了，耶穌就上耶路撒冷去。
13.sry: Ka itu tamang ta Uvavatugan ki Halidawan [ka Paska] ki Yoden nimubavaw ta ti Yesus mukwa tu Yerusalem.

14.niv: In the temple courts he found people selling cattle, sheep and doves, and others sitting at tables exchanging money.
14.cmn: 看見殿裏有賣牛、羊、鴿子的，並有兌換銀錢的人坐在那裏，
14.sry: Ka nikabaley tin tu Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid ta pasadarima ki luwang, ki yuko, ki padaug, ki tamaviri ki malituk ka mirung ato hina.

15.niv: So he made a whip out of cords, and drove all from the temple courts, both sheep and cattle; he scattered the coins of the money changers and overturned their tables.
15.cmn: 耶穌就拿繩子做成鞭子，把牛羊都趕出殿去，倒出兌換銀錢之人的銀錢，推翻他們的桌子，
15.sry: Ka ru nipeyringey tin ta patawbawrigan ka taritarig nipatagiag imid tin ta teni pautawag, tu Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, ta yuko, ki luwang apa: ka na sasawbug tin ta malituk, ki tamaviri ki malituk, ka nipapawtukag tin ta tpal da.

16.niv: To those who sold doves he said, “Get these out of here! Stop turning my Fatherʼs house into a market!”
16.cmn: 又對賣鴿子的說：「把這些東西拿去！不要將我父的殿當作買賣的地方。」
16.sry: Ka nikuma ki tamapasadima ki padaug, Hamiaw hiya ta ana: inaey pasawkunun papahamikawla ki talag ki pagiasan ta talag ki Raman aw.

17.niv: His disciples remembered that it is written: “Zeal for your house will consume me.”
17.cmn: 他的門徒就想起經上記着說：「我為你的殿心裏焦急，如同火燒。」
17.sry: Ka nihibaleyen ki patatawutawugan tin ki na sasulat, "Aruk ki talag oho ta nirmihal yawan".

18.niv: The Jews then responded to him, “What sign can you show us to prove your authority to do all this?”
18.cmn: 因此猶太人問他說：「你既做這些事，還顯甚麼神蹟給我們看呢？」
18.sry: Anata nimatagivli ta Yoden, ka nikuma tenian: "Pukidien ki mang ta pakitaan hu imianan, ka kuma kaw hina ki ringey?"

19.niv: Jesus answered them, “Destroy this temple, and I will raise it again in three days.”
19.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「你們拆毀這殿，我三日內要再建立起來。」
19.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus ka nikuma nenian: "Kutagaw ta Talag ka ata ka palikugaw maw pagapit ta ana ru kidi ki tuturu ki wagi."

20.niv: They replied, “It has taken forty-six years to build this temple, and you are going to raise it in three days?”
20.cmn: 猶太人便說：「這殿是四十六年才造成的，你三日內就再建立起來嗎？」
20.sry: Anata nikuma ta Yoden, Maka apat kitian ab ki anim ki tawil nipeyringeyen ta kuva ka ata ki tatamudan ki Alid, ka imhu palikugaw moho kawa pagapit ta ana [tu kidi ki] tuturu ki wagi?"

21.niv: But the temple he had spoken of was his body.
21.cmn: 但耶穌這話是以他的身體為殿。
21.sry: Ra nipasusuen tin ta Talag ki vual tin.

22.niv: After he was raised from the dead, his disciples recalled what he had said. Then they believed the scripture and the words that Jesus had spoken.
22.cmn: 所以到他從死裏復活以後，門徒就想起他說過這話，便信了聖經和耶穌所說的。 耶穌洞悉人心
22.sry: Aley ki ana, ru niakaha ta teni gapit ki nikapatayan, nihibaley ki patatawutawugan tin, ka nipasusuen tin nenian ta ata: ka nitnamising ki na sasulat ki na su apa, ka nipasusuen ti Yesus.

23.niv: Now while he was in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, many people saw the signs he was performing and believed in his name.
23.cmn: 當耶穌在耶路撒冷過逾越節的時候，有許多人看見他所行的神蹟，就信了他的名。
23.sry: Iru ka ayakwa ta teni tu Yerusalem, tu Halidawan ka Uvavatugan, mabatung, ta nitnamising ki Nanang tin, ru kakitaan nein ta pukidian tin ka nipeyringey tin da.

24.niv: But Jesus would not entrust himself to them, for he knew all people.
24.cmn: 耶穌卻不將自己交託他們；因為他知道萬人，
24.sry: Ra nimaayas tenian mamado nenian ta ti Yesus, aley ka kimiden tin kmalang nenian.

25.niv: He did not need any testimony about mankind, for he knew what was in each person.
25.cmn: 也用不着誰見證人怎樣，因他知道人心裏所存的。
25.sry: Aley apa ka asi mayaapo ta teni ka gmaila ta timamang ki kagulung, ka umadoen tin mumha mamang ka iturbo ki kagulung.

1.niv: Now there was a Pharisee, a man named Nicodemus who was a member of the Jewish ruling council.
1.cmn: 有一個法利賽人，名叫尼哥德慕，是猶太人的官。
1.sry: Ka niakumeya ta tau ka na Farizeen, ka ti Nikodemus ta nanang tin, ka Sibavaw ki Yoden

2.niv: He came to Jesus at night and said, “Rabbi, we know that you are a teacher who has come from God. For no one could perform the signs you are doing if God were not with him.”
2.cmn: 這人夜裏來見耶穌，說：「拉比，我們知道你是由上帝那裏來作師傅的；因為你所行的神蹟，若沒有上帝同在，無人能行。」
2.sry: Teni ta niirua ka awvanan mukwa ti Yesusan, ka nikun tin tenian, Rabi, kavanaen yan ka tamatawtawug kaw ka nimakakwa ki Alid: aley ka asi palpug ta timamang pamut ki pukidien ka ata ka pamuten oho ra, du asi tulam tenian ta Alid.

3.niv: Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, no one can see the kingdom of God unless they are born again. ”
3.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你，人若不重生，就不能見上帝的國。」
3.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus ka nikuma tenian, Mising, missing kun aw kaw, hairu asi peyalaken meyalak ta timamang, asi kmilpug kmita ta teni ki Peysasuan ki Alid.

4.niv: “How can someone be born when they are old?” Nicodemus asked. “Surely they cannot enter a second time into their motherʼs womb to be born!”
4.cmn: 尼哥德慕說：「人已經老了，如何能重生呢？豈能再進母腹生出來嗎？」
4.sry: Nikuma ta ti Nikudemus tenian: Peylpugaw lato meyalak ta kagulung mamamang [ru] mamu ato ta teni? Mulpug kawa mupuhal muvuil ki Rena tin, ka peylaaw meyalak?

5.niv: Jesus answered, “Very truly I tell you, no one can enter the kingdom of God unless they are born of water and the Spirit.
5.cmn: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你，人若不是從水和聖靈生的，就不能進上帝的國。
5.sry: Nipatagivlien ti Yesus, Mising, missing kun aw kaw: Ru asi peyalaken ta timamang ki ralum ki Yupan, asi tin ulpugen murbo tu Peysasuan ki Alid.

6.niv: Flesh gives birth to flesh, but the Spirit gives birth to spirit.
6.cmn: 從肉身生的就是肉身；從靈生的就是靈。
6.sry: Ka nipeyalak ki vaat, vaat ta ana: peyalak ki Yupan, Yupan ta ana.

7.niv: You should not be surprised at my saying, ‘You must be born again.’
7.cmn: 我說：『你們必須重生』，你不要以為希奇。
7.sry: Ina muringaw ka nivanaen aw kaw, Kidi ato ka peylaawug kamu meyalak ta imumi ra.

8.niv: The wind blows wherever it pleases. You hear its sound, but you cannot tell where it comes from or where it is going. So it is with everyone born of the Spirit.”
8.cmn: 風隨着意思吹，你聽見風的響聲，卻不曉得從哪裏來，往哪裏去；凡從聖靈生的，也是如此。」
8.sry: Bavare ta vare tu mamang ka kamuyen tin, ka ilingigen oho ta harimhim tin, ra asi muho umhaen ka maka kuna ka sakakuna ta ana: kumahina ta meybuavual ka peyalak ki Yupan.

9.niv: “How can this be?” Nicodemus asked.
9.cmn: 尼哥德慕問他說：「怎能有這事呢？」
9.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Nikudemus kuma tenian: Peylpugen pamut ta mamang ka ata mamamang?

10.niv: “You are Israelʼs teacher,” said Jesus, “and do you not understand these things?
10.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「你是以色列人的先生，還不明白這事嗎？
10.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus ka nikuma tenian: Matatawtawug kaw kawa tu Israel ka kauruen apa muho ta ata ra?

11.niv: Very truly I tell you, we speak of what we know, and we testify to what we have seen, but still you people do not accept our testimony.
11.cmn: 我實實在在地告訴你，我們所說的是我們知道的；我們所見證的是我們見過的；你們卻不領受我們的見證。
11.sry: Mising, missing kun aw kaw, ka kavanan yan ta pasasuen yan, ka nikitaan yan ta patagihailen yan, ka asi mumi atararigen ta patagihailen yan da.

12.niv: I have spoken to you of earthly things and you do not believe; how then will you believe if I speak of heavenly things?
12.cmn: 我對你們說地上的事，你們尚且不信，若說天上的事，如何能信呢？
12.sry: Hairu nipasusuen aw kamu ki maka nay, ka asi umi tnamising, tnamisinga kamu mamamang ru pasusuen aw kamu ki maka tunun.

13.niv: No one has ever gone into heaven except the one who came from heaven—the Son of Man.
13.cmn: 除了從天降下、仍舊在天的人子，沒有人升過天。
13.sry: Ka asi nisabavaw satunun ta timamang, dik tenian ka nimurarim maka tunun, [teni] ta Alak ki kagulung ka ayatunun.

14.niv: Just as Moses lifted up the snake in the wilderness, so the Son of Man must be lifted up,
14.cmn: 摩西在曠野怎樣舉蛇，人子也必照樣被舉起來，
14.sry: Ka mama ka nipuvavawen ti Moses tu pawlapawlag ta vuley, kidi ato ka Puvavawaw kumahina ta Alak ki kagulung.

15.niv: that everyone who believes may have eternal life in him.”
15.cmn: 叫一切信他的都得永生。
15.sry: Aley ka asi tawrumaa ta meybuavual ka tnamising tenian ka akumeya lapa ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug.

16.niv: For God so loved the world that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him shall not perish but have eternal life.
16.cmn: 「上帝愛世人，甚至將他的獨生子賜給他們，叫一切信他的，不致滅亡，反得永生。
16.sry: Ka nikavagangoen kumahina ki Alid ta nay, ka pigaen tin ta Alak tin ka Peysaaten, aley ka asi tawrumaa ta meybuavual ka tnamising tenian, ka akumeya lapa ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug.

17.niv: For God did not send his Son into the world to condemn the world, but to save the world through him.
17.cmn: 因為上帝差他的兒子降世，不是要定世人的罪，乃是要叫世人因他得救。
17.sry: Nda ka asi nipadingien ki Alid ta Alak tin tu nay aley ka dungdungaw tin ta nay, aley apa ka pakariyangaw tin ta nay aley tenian.

18.niv: Whoever believes in him is not condemned, but whoever does not believe stands condemned already because they have not believed in the name of Godʼs one and only Son.
18.cmn: 信他的人，不被定罪；不信的人，罪已經定了，因為他不信上帝獨生子的名。
18.sry: Timang ta tnamising tenian, asi dungdungaw, ra timang ta asi tnamising kahan ato hinin dmungdung: aley ka asi nitnamising tu Nanang ki Alak ki Alid ka Peysaaten.

19.niv: This is the verdict: Light has come into the world, but people loved darkness instead of light because their deeds were evil.
19.cmn: 光來到世間，世人因自己的行為是惡的，不愛光，倒愛黑暗，定他們的罪就是在此。
19.sry: Ka ata apa ta dungdungan, ka iru ato ta ramag tu Nay, ka nikasaunen mavagango ki kagulung ta karumduman, ki ramag: aley ka mate ta na ringey nein da.

20.niv: Everyone who does evil hates the light, and will not come into the light for fear that their deeds will be exposed.
20.cmn: 凡作惡的便恨光，並不來就光，恐怕他的行為受責備。
20.sry: Ka timamang ka pamut ki katean, gaasen tin ta ramag, ka asi mukwa tu ramag ta teni, aley ka asi patimahail ato ta na ringey tin.

21.niv: But whoever lives by the truth comes into the light, so that it may be seen plainly that what they have done has been done in the sight of God.
21.cmn: 但行真理的必來就光，要顯明他所行的是靠上帝而行。」 耶穌和施洗約翰
21.sry: Ra timamang ta pamut ki katiktikan ki su, mukwa tu ramag ta teni, ki pakaamagaw ta na ringey tin, aley ka nipamut tu Alilidan.

22.niv: After this, Jesus and his disciples went out into the Judean countryside, where he spent some time with them, and baptized.
22.cmn: 這事以後，耶穌和門徒到了猶太地，在那裏居住，施洗。
22.sry: Siawug ki ana niirua ta ti Yesus, ki patatawutawugan apa tin mukwa tu purug ki Judeya ka nimalanga ta teni hina lam nenian, mawlawlug da.

23.niv: Now John also was baptizing at Aenon near Salim, because there was plenty of water, and people were coming and being baptized.
23.cmn: 約翰在靠近撒冷的哀嫩也施洗；因為那裏水多，眾人都去受洗。（
23.sry: Ka nimawlug apa ta ti Yohanes tu Enon tu tamang ki Salim, aley ka madag hina ta ralum: ka niirua mukwa hina, ka niawlugen ato ra.

24.niv: (This was before John was put in prison.)
24.cmn: 那時約翰還沒有下在監裏。）
24.sry: Ka asi apa pusangaten ta ti Yoanes.

25.niv: An argument developed between some of Johnʼs disciples and a certain Jew over the matter of ceremonial washing.
25.cmn: 約翰的門徒和一個猶太人辯論潔淨的禮，
25.sry: Anata nigapit ta patigtilan ki su ki Patawutawwugan ti Yoanes lam apa ki Yoden aley ki pakakuptigan.

26.niv: They came to John and said to him, “Rabbi, that man who was with you on the other side of the Jordan—the one you testified about—look, he is baptizing, and everyone is going to him.”
26.cmn: 就來見約翰，說：「拉比，從前同你在約旦河外、你所見證的那位，現在施洗，眾人都往他那裏去了。」
26.sry: Ka nimukwa ti Yoanesan, ka nikun nein tenian: “Rabi, teni ka na lam oho tu arug ki Yordan, ka nipatagihailen oho tenian, kitaey, mawlulug ta teni, kamuimid tenian mukwa.

27.niv: To this John replied, “A person can receive only what is given them from heaven.
27.cmn: 約翰說：「若不是從天上賜的，人就不能得甚麼。
27.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yoanes, ka nikumahina, asi alpugen mara ta kagulung ki mamang, ru asi nipigaen tenian maka tunun ki vulum.

28.niv: You yourselves can testify that I said, ‘I am not the Messiah but am sent ahead of him.’
28.cmn: 我曾說：『我不是基督，是奉差遣在他前面的』，你們自己可以給我作見證。
28.sry: Tamahail kamu yawan ta imumi mamado, ka nipasusuen aw, asi ti yaw ta ti Kristus, ra nipadingien ko pasiuro tenian.

29.niv: The bride belongs to the bridegroom. The friend who attends the bridegroom waits and listens for him, and is full of joy when he hears the bridegroomʼs voice. That joy is mine, and it is now complete.
29.cmn: 娶新婦的就是新郎；新郎的朋友站着，聽見新郎的聲音就甚喜樂。故此，我這喜樂滿足了。
29.sry: Timang ta aku Ina ka vahaw, teni ta Parag ka vahaw: nda diu ka Parag ka vahaw ka mituko milingig tenian, ta marayaki karayan ki rig aley ki ingaw ki Parag ka vahaw, anata pakatmuy ato ta karayan aw ka ata.

30.niv: He must become greater; I must become less.”
30.cmn: 他必興旺，我必衰微。」 從天上來的那一位
30.sry: Kidi ka tu sauna kawirang ta teni, ra lawaey ko ta ti yaw.

31.niv: The one who comes from above is above all; the one who is from the earth belongs to the earth, and speaks as one from the earth. The one who comes from heaven is above all.
31.cmn: 「從天上來的是在萬有之上；從地上來的是屬乎地，他所說的也是屬乎地。從天上來的是在萬有之上。
31.sry: Teni ka maka vavaw, itu imid itu vavaw: Teni ka makakwa ki nay, maka nay ta teni, ka pasusuen tin ta a'tu nay. Teni ka maka tunun ki vulum, Sibavaw ta teni ki imid.

32.niv: He testifies to what he has seen and heard, but no one accepts his testimony.
32.cmn: 他將所見所聞的見證出來，只是沒有人領受他的見證。
32.sry: Ka na kakita tin ka na ilalingig tin, patagihailen tin, masusu ta ana: ka asi pabaley matarig sasasat ka timamang ki patagihailen tin da.

33.niv: Whoever has accepted it has certified that God is truthful.
33.cmn: 那領受他見證的，就印上印，證明上帝是真的。
33.sry: Timang ta nipabaley matarig ki patagihailen tin, niputapuyu pushut ka matiktik ki su ta Alid.

34.niv: For the one whom God has sent speaks the words of God, for God gives the Spirit without limit.
34.cmn: 上帝所差來的就說上帝的話，因為上帝賜聖靈給他是沒有限量的。
34.sry: Nda timang ta nipadingien ki Alid, pasusuen tin ta su ki Alid, ka asi pigaen ki Alid [tenian] ta Yupan tu pukakidien repung.

35.niv: The Father loves the Son and has placed everything in his hands.
35.cmn: 父愛子，已將萬有交在他手裏。
35.sry: Mavagango ta Raman ki Alak, ka nipahaimiden ta mamang piga tu rima tin.

36.niv: Whoever believes in the Son has eternal life, but whoever rejects the Son will not see life, for Godʼs wrath remains on them.
36.cmn: 信子的人有永生；不信子的人得不着永生，上帝的震怒常在他身上。」
36.sry: Timang ta tnamising ki Alak akumeya ato ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug: Ra timang ta asi milig ki Alak, asi kmita ta teni ki kawagan: ra mayali misasaun tu halap tenian ta ngale ki alid.

1.niv: Now Jesus learned that the Pharisees had heard that he was gaining and baptizing more disciples than John—
1.cmn: 主知道法利賽人聽見他收門徒，施洗，比約翰還多，（
1.sry: Iru ka mumha ta Meyrang, ka niilingigen ki Farizeen, ka masaun mabatung ta nipapatatawutawugan ta niawlugan apa ti Yesus ti Yoanesan

2.niv: although in fact it was not Jesus who baptized, but his disciples.
2.cmn: 其實不是耶穌親自施洗，乃是他的門徒施洗，）
2.sry: Meyta ka asi nitawmadoen ti Yesus, ra ki patatawutawugan tin

3.niv: So he left Judea and went back once more to Galilee.
3.cmn: 他就離了猶太，又往加利利去。
3.sry: Anata nidarangen tin tu Yuda, ka nisalikug mukwa tu Galilaya.

4.niv: Now he had to go through Samaria.
4.cmn: 必須經過撒馬利亞，
4.sry: Ka kidi ka tawkwaey tin malidawa tu Samaria.

5.niv: So he came to a town in Samaria called Sychar, near the plot of ground Jacob had given to his son Joseph.
5.cmn: 於是到了撒馬利亞的一座城，名叫敘加，靠近雅各給他兒子約瑟的那塊地。
5.sry: Anata niirua tu awma ki Samaria ka Sigar ta nipananangan tin, tu tamang ki magkul tuk ka na papiga ti Yakob ki alak tin ka parag ka ti Yoses.

6.niv: Jacobʼs well was there, and Jesus, tired as he was from the journey, sat down by the well. It was about noon.
6.cmn: 在那裏有雅各井；耶穌因走路困乏，就坐在井旁。那時約有午正。
6.sry: Ka akumeya hina ta na tasik ti Yakob. Iru ra ka siba ta ti Yesus ki niudadarangen tin anata itutuk ato mirung ki tasik. Ka tu hivat ato ki ka anim ki tagley da.

7.niv: When a Samaritan woman came to draw water, Jesus said to her, “Will you give me a drink?”
7.cmn: 有一個撒馬利亞的婦人來打水。耶穌對她說：「請你給我水喝。」（
7.sry: Ka niirua ta Ina ka maka Samaria murauralum. Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, pait yawan da.

8.niv: (His disciples had gone into the town to buy food.)
8.cmn: 那時門徒進城買食物去了。）
8.sry: Ka nidmarang ta patatawutawugan tin muawma ka peylaaw nein ki kakanen da.

9.niv: The Samaritan woman said to him, “You are a Jew and I am a Samaritan woman. How can you ask me for a drink?” (For Jews do not associate with Samaritans.)
9.cmn: 撒馬利亞的婦人對他說：「你既是猶太人，怎麼向我一個撒馬利亞婦人要水喝呢？」原來猶太人和撒馬利亞人沒有來往。
9.sry: Anata nikuma tenian ta ina ka maka Samarien, tmumiaen oho ka Yode kaw mama ki mang, ki paitaw maw kaw, ka ina ko ka maka Samaria? Du ausi ki sausaalen ki pungas ta Yoden ki Samaritanein.

10.niv: Jesus answered her, “If you knew the gift of God and who it is that asks you for a drink, you would have asked him and he would have given you living water.”
10.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「你若知道上帝的恩賜，和對你說『給我水喝』的是誰，你必早求他，他也必早給了你活水。」
10.sry: Nda nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma tenian, hairu kalangen oho lava ta na papa ki Alid, timang apa ta teni ka masasusu imhuan, ‘paiten ko’, ina kaw tmumia tenian, ka pigaa lato imhuan ki ralum ka mawag.

11.niv: “Sir,” the woman said, “you have nothing to draw with and the well is deep. Where can you get this living water?
11.cmn: 婦人說：「先生，沒有打水的器具，井又深，你從哪裏得活水呢？
11.sry: Nikuma ta ina tenian, “Meyrang, ausi kaw ki atug ka malawu ta dauk nda, maka kuna imhuan ta ralum ka mawag?”

12.niv: Are you greater than our father Jacob, who gave us the well and drank from it himself, as did also his sons and his livestock?”
12.cmn: 我們的祖宗雅各將這井留給我們，他自己和兒子並牲畜也都喝這井裏的水，難道你比他還大嗎？」
12.sry: Siuro kaw kawa tu kairangan ki na Raman yan ka ti Yakob, ka na papapa tin imianan ta dauk ka ata? Ka niitan tin tu ata, ki alalak tin ki laulaung apa tin.

13.niv: Jesus answered, “Everyone who drinks this water will be thirsty again,
13.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「凡喝這水的還要再渴；
13.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma tenian, Timamang ta mit ki ralum ka ata, milalaa lapa maito.

14.niv: but whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life.”
14.cmn: 人若喝我所賜的水就永遠不渴。我所賜的水要在他裏頭成為泉源，直湧到永生。」
14.sry: Ra timang ta mita lato ki ralum ka pigaaney maw tenian, asi mitoa tu ikakwan midarinug, nda ralum ka pigaaney maw tenian, kawtasika lato tenian ki ralum ka lboar [kawrabul] tu kawagan tugan ka mikakwa midarinug.

15.niv: The woman said to him, “Sir, give me this water so that I wonʼt get thirsty and have to keep coming here to draw water.”
15.cmn: 婦人說：「先生，請把這水賜給我，叫我不渴，也不用來這麼遠打水。」
15.sry: Nikuma tenian ta ina, Meyrang, pigaey ko ki ralum ka ana, du asia ko milala mito, ka asi maw ukwaaw hiya muraluralum.

16.niv: He told her, “Go, call your husband and come back.”
16.cmn: 耶穌說：「你去叫你丈夫也到這裏來。」
16.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, ukwaaw, tataamaw ta tbung oho kamukwa hiya.

17.niv: “I have no husband,” she replied. Jesus said to her, “You are right when you say you have no husband.
17.cmn: 婦人說：「我沒有丈夫。」耶穌說：「你說沒有丈夫是不錯的。
17.sry: Nimatagivli ta ina ka nikuma, “ausi ko ki tbung.” Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, “mariyang ta su oho, ausi ko ki tbung”

18.niv: The fact is, you have had five husbands, and the man you now have is not your husband. What you have just said is quite true.”
18.cmn: 你已經有五個丈夫，你現在有的並不是你的丈夫。你這話是真的。」
18.sry: Ka niakumeya kaw rarima ki tbung, ra ka akumeya kaw hinin asi tbung oho ka dilig, matiktik ta su oho ka ana.

19.niv: “Sir,” the woman said, “I can see that you are a prophet.
19.cmn: 婦人說：「先生，我看出你是先知。
19.sry: Nikuma ta ina tenian, Meyrang, kmita ko ka Tamamatagitan kaw.

20.niv: Our ancestors worshiped on this mountain, but you Jews claim that the place where we must worship is in Jerusalem.”
20.cmn: 我們的祖宗在這山上禮拜，你們倒說，應當禮拜的地方是在耶路撒冷。」
20.sry: Nireipen tmamud ki na Raraman yan tu vukin ka ata, ra imumi ta kuma ka tu Yerusalem ta itukwaan ki reipen tmamud.

21.niv: “Woman,” Jesus replied, “believe me, a time is coming when you will worship the Father neither on this mountain nor in Jerusalem.
21.cmn: 耶穌說：「婦人，你當信我。時候將到，你們拜父，也不在這山上，也不在耶路撒冷。
21.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Ina, tnamisinga yawan, irua ta kidi ki tagley, ka reipey mumi tmamud ta Raman asi tu vukin ka ata, asi apa tu Yerusalem.

22.niv: You Samaritans worship what you do not know; we worship what we do know, for salvation is from the Jews.
22.cmn: 你們所拜的，你們不知道；我們所拜的，我們知道，因為救恩是從猶太人出來的。
22.sry: Reyp kamu tmamud ta imumi ki asi mumi kavanaen: reip kame tmamud ta imian ki kavanaen yan: ka makakwa ki Yoden ta karariyangan.

23.niv: Yet a time is coming and has now come when the true worshipers will worship the Father in the Spirit and in truth, for they are the kind of worshipers the Father seeks.
23.cmn: 時候將到，如今就是了，那真正拜父的，要用心靈和誠實拜他，因為父要這樣的人拜他。」
23.sry: Ra, irua ta [kidi ki] tagley, ka hinin anaen ta ana, ka reipa tmamud ki Raraman ta tamatmamud ka dilig tu Yupan tu ka dilig da: Ka kiimen ki Rama ta kumahina, reip tmamud tenian.

24.niv: God is spirit, and his worshipers must worship in the Spirit and in truth.”
24.cmn: 上帝是個靈，所以拜他的必須用心靈和誠實拜他。」
24.sry: Yupan ta Alid, na mamang ta reip tmamud tenian, reipa tmamud ta neni tu Yupan tu kadiligan apa

25.niv: The woman said, “I know that Messiah” (called Christ) “is coming. When he comes, he will explain everything to us.”
25.cmn: 婦人說：「我知道彌賽亞（就是那稱為基督的）要來；他來了，必將一切的事都告訴我們。」
25.sry: Nikuma ta ina tenian, kavanaen aw ka irua ta Mesiyas (ka siuwa ti Kristus) ka ru irua lato ta teni, anata gnawa banavana imianan.

26.niv: Then Jesus declared, “I, the one speaking to you—I am he.”
26.cmn: 耶穌說：「這和你說話的就是他！」
26.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, ti yaw ta ti ata, ka makutavag imhuan.

27.niv: Just then his disciples returned and were surprised to find him talking with a woman. But no one asked, “What do you want?” or “Why are you talking with her?”
27.cmn: 當下門徒回來，就希奇耶穌和一個婦人說話；只是沒有人說：「你是要甚麼？」或說：「你為甚麼和她說話？」
27.sry: Ka niirua meyvavaley ki aku su ta patatawutawugan tin, kamuringaw lato ki patatavag tin ki ina; Ra asi nikuma ta timamang, “mang ta talitalig oho?” “Mang lava ta patagitatavag oho tenian.”

28.niv: Then, leaving her water jar, the woman went back to the town and said to the people,
28.cmn: 那婦人就留下水罐子，往城裏去，對眾人說：
28.sry: Anata niataralen ki ina ta atug tin, ka nidmarang mawuma matagikumahina ki tau.

29.niv: “Come, see a man who told me everything I ever did. Could this be the Messiah?”
29.cmn: 「你們來看！有一個人將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了，莫非這就是基督嗎？」
29.sry: Nda, ukwa kit’ey ta tau ka nibanavana yawan imid ki na ringey aw: Asi kawa ti Kristus ta ti ana?

30.niv: They came out of the town and made their way toward him.
30.cmn: 眾人就出城，往耶穌那裏去。
30.sry: Anata nitawpapanag ta neni, nipakaawmaen ka niirua tenian.

31.niv: Meanwhile his disciples urged him, “Rabbi, eat something.”
31.cmn: 這其間，門徒對耶穌說：「拉比，請吃。」
31.sry: Tu pta ki kidi ka ana niunmahi ta patatawutawugan tin tenian kuma, Rabi, mavoka.

32.niv: But he said to them, “I have food to eat that you know nothing about.”
32.cmn: 耶穌說：「我有食物吃，是你們不知道的。」
32.sry: Ra nikuma ta teni nenian, aku kakanen ko ki kakanaw maw, ka asi mumi umhaen.

33.niv: Then his disciples said to each other, “Could someone have brought him food?”
33.cmn: 門徒就彼此對問說：「莫非有人拿甚麼給他吃嗎？」
33.sry: Anata nimataginaunado matagitavag ki su ta patatawutawugan, Nimad kawa ta timamang ki kaneina tin?

34.niv: “My food,” said Jesus, “is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work.
34.cmn: 耶穌說：「我的食物就是遵行差我來者的旨意，做成他的工。
34.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, ka kakanaw maw ta ana ka pamutaw maw ta kamuyen ki nimadingi yawan, ka peymugaaw maw ta ringey tin.

35.niv: Donʼt you have a saying, ‘Itʼs still four months until harvest’? I tell you, open your eyes and look at the fields! They are ripe for harvest.
35.cmn: 你們豈不說『到收割的時候還有四個月』嗎？我告訴你們，舉目向田觀看，莊稼已經熟了，可以收割了。
35.sry: Asi kamu kawa matagikumahina ki su, pa apat apa ta vural, anata irua ta ayaman? Kmita ato, pasusu kun aw kamu ra, papasauvavawa ki mata umi mararaw ki dapudap: ka mapule ato tu ayamey hinin.

36.niv: Even now the one who reaps draws a wage and harvests a crop for eternal life, so that the sower and the reaper may be glad together.
36.cmn: 收割的人得工價，積蓄五穀到永生，叫撒種的和收割的一同快樂。
36.sry: Ka timang ta maayam mara ki than ki uvavarugan ka uluden tin ki vua tu kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug, aley ka masala maray ta dmiri ki maayam.

37.niv: Thus the saying ‘One sows and another reaps’ is true.
37.cmn: 俗語說：『那人撒種，這人收割』，這話可見是真的。
37.sry: Ka dilig tu ata matiktik ta su ka ana, “Pani ta dmiri, pani apa ta maayam.”

38.niv: I sent you to reap what you have not worked for. Others have done the hard work, and you have reaped the benefits of their labor.”
38.cmn: 我差你們去收你們所沒有勞苦的；別人勞苦，你們享受他們所勞苦的。」
38.sry: Nipadingien aw kamu paayam ki asi mumi niumaan mapungas: ra pani ta nimuma mapungas, ka nisakakwaan umi ki niumaan nein mapungas.

39.niv: Many of the Samaritans from that town believed in him because of the womanʼs testimony, “He told me everything I ever did.”
39.cmn: 那城裏有好些撒馬利亞人信了耶穌，因為那婦人作見證說：「他將我素來所行的一切事都給我說出來了。」
39.sry: Ka mabatung ki Samaritanein ka maka awma ka anata nitnamising tenian aley ki ina ka hmail, “nibanavana yawan imid ki na ringey aw.”

40.niv: So when the Samaritans came to him, they urged him to stay with them, and he stayed two days.
40.cmn: 於是撒馬利亞人來見耶穌，求他在他們那裏住下，他便在那裏住了兩天。
40.sry: Iru ka irua ato tenian ta Samaritanein, nitmumimia tenian ki pailiiliey tin nenian: ka nimayali hina maka ruha ki wagi.

41.niv: And because of his words many more became believers.
41.cmn: 因耶穌的話，信的人就更多了，
41.sry: Ka siuro mabatung ta nitnamising aley ki su tin.

42.niv: They said to the woman, “We no longer believe just because of what you said; now we have heard for ourselves, and we know that this man really is the Savior of the world.”
42.cmn: 便對婦人說：「現在我們信，不是因為你的話，是我們親自聽見了，知道這真是救世主。」 耶穌治好大臣的兒子
42.sry: Ka nikuma ki ina, Asi kame tnamising hinin aley ki na su oho, ra nitnamadoen yan milingig, ka kavanaen yan ka mising ti ata ta ti Kristus, ka Tamapakariyang ki imid ki nay.

43.niv: After the two days he left for Galilee.
43.cmn: 過了那兩天，耶穌離了那地方，往加利利去。
43.sry: Ka siawug ki ruha ki wagi, nidmarang hina, ka nisakakwa mukwa tu Galilaya.

44.niv: (Now Jesus himself had pointed out that a prophet has no honor in his own country.)
44.cmn: 因為耶穌自己作過見證說：「先知在本地是沒有人尊敬的。」
44.sry: Ka nimado hmail ti Yesus ka ausi ki lulugan ta Tamamatagitan tu purug ti Ama tin.

45.niv: When he arrived in Galilee, the Galileans welcomed him. They had seen all that he had done in Jerusalem at the Passover Festival, for they also had been there.
45.cmn: 到了加利利，加利利人既然看見他在耶路撒冷過節所行的一切事，就接待他，因為他們也是上去過節。
45.sry: Iru kamukwa ta teni tu Galilaya nipahitatalag tenian ta tau ka maka Galilaya, du nikitaan nein ta mamang ka na ringey tin tu Yerusalem tu wagi ki uvavatugan: ka nilumad apa ta neni tu uvavatugan.

46.niv: Once more he visited Cana in Galilee, where he had turned the water into wine. And there was a certain royal official whose son lay sick at Capernaum.
46.cmn: 耶穌又到了加利利的迦拿，就是他從前變水為酒的地方。有一個大臣，他的兒子在迦百農患病。
46.sry: Anata nisalikug ta ti Yesus mukwa tu Kana tu Galilaya, ka nipahahalaen tin ta ralum ki hala ki karawmata tu hina. Ka akumeya hina ta saat ka tagalalam ki Meysasu ka Sibavaw, ka payalalamen ki alak tin ka parag tu Kapernaum.

47.niv: When this man heard that Jesus had arrived in Galilee from Judea, he went to him and begged him to come and heal his son, who was close to death.
47.cmn: 他聽見耶穌從猶太到了加利利，就來見他，求他下去醫治他的兒子，因為他兒子快要死了。
47.sry: Teni ru nimilig ka lumaden ti Yesus maka Yudea mukwa tu Galilaya nimukwa tenian ka nitmimien tin tenian ka ur apagaw tin padarikag ta alak tin ka parag: ka mitaaw miginaa ta teni.

48.niv: “Unless you people see signs and wonders,” Jesus told him, “you will never believe.”
48.cmn: 耶穌就對他說：「若不看見神蹟奇事，你們總是不信。」
48.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Hairu asi mumi kitaan ta pukidian ki uringawan apa ka ringey, asi kamu tnamisinga.

49.niv: The royal official said, “Sir, come down before my child dies.”
49.cmn: 那大臣說：「先生，求你趁着我的孩子還沒有死就下去。」
49.sry: Nikuma tenian ta talalam ki Meysasu ka sibavaw, Meyrang mur apaga tu uro ka asi apa mapatay ta alak aw.

50.niv: “Go,” Jesus replied, “your son will live.” The man took Jesus at his word and departed.
50.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「回去吧，你的兒子活了！」那人信耶穌所說的話就回去了。
50.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, ukwa, mawag ta alak oho. Ka nitnamising ta tau ki su, ka pasusuen ti Yesus tenian, ka niukwa tin.

51.niv: While he was still on the way, his servants met him with the news that his boy was living.
51.cmn: 正下去的時候，他的僕人迎見他，說他的兒子活了。
51.sry: Iru ka ur apagan tin nidmumaduma tenian ta kuncia tin, hmagnaw kuma, “Mawag ta alak oho.”

52.niv: When he inquired as to the time when his son got better, they said to him, “Yesterday, at one in the afternoon, the fever left him.”
52.cmn: 他就問甚麼時候見好的。他們說：「昨日未時熱就退了。」
52.sry: Anata nitmalig nenian ki kidi ki tagley ki nitmilan ki malaam tin: ka nikuma ta neni tenian, iga tu kapapitu ki tagley niusan ki agingit tenian.

53.niv: Then the father realized that this was the exact time at which Jesus had said to him, “Your son will live.” So he and his whole household believed.
53.cmn: 他便知道這正是耶穌對他說「你兒子活了」的時候；他自己和全家就都信了。
53.sry: Anata nikalangen ki Raman ka dilig ki tagley ka ana ki nipasusuen ti Yesus tenian, "Mawag ta alak oho": Ka nitnamising ta teni tnamado, tnatumuk apa ki talag tin.

54.niv: This was the second sign Jesus performed after coming from Judea to Galilee.
54.cmn: 這是耶穌在加利利行的第二件神蹟，是他從猶太回去以後行的。
54.sry: Ka raruha ki na pukakidi ka ata nihailan ti Yesus pamut, du lumad ato maka Yudea mukwa tu Galilaya.

1.niv: Some time later, Jesus went up to Jerusalem for one of the Jewish festivals.
1.cmn: 這事以後，到了猶太人的一個節期，耶穌就上耶路撒冷去。
1.sry: Siawug ki ana niakumeya ki uvavatugan ki Yoden, ka nisabavaw ta ti Yesus mukwa tu Yerusalem.

2.niv: Now there is in Jerusalem near the Sheep Gate a pool, which in Aramaic is called Bethesda and which is surrounded by five covered colonnades.
2.cmn: 在耶路撒冷，靠近羊門有一個池子，希伯來話叫作畢士大，旁邊有五個廊子；
2.sry: Ka akumeya hina tu Yerusalem itutuk [ki ngataf] ki yuko ta ayawugan ka ralum ka siuwa tu su ki Hebreen, Bethesda, ka na rima ato ki saulan ka laf.

3.niv: Here a great number of disabled people used to lie—the blind, the lame, the paralyzed.
3.cmn: 裏面躺着瞎眼的、瘸腿的、血氣枯乾的許多病人。
3.sry: Ka nimaliku hina ta kabatungan ka irang ka maalam, ka mavuta, ka mapilay, ka iguilan tu amamatan ki kilikalikaey ki ralum.

4.sry: Ka Tamagnaw ta nimurarim tu sasasat ki kidi tu ayawugan tmivu ki ralum: Anata timamang ta nisiuro hina murbo ru tivuan ato ta ralum nikawag darikag ta teni, mukuna ru ka mamang lava ta maalam tin.

5.niv: One who was there had been an invalid for thirty-eight years.
5.cmn: 在那裏有一個人，病了三十八年。
5.sry: Ka niakumeya hina saat ki vual ka maka turu kitian ab ki kuypa ki tawil ki nikaalamen tin.

6.niv: When Jesus saw him lying there and learned that he had been in this condition for a long time, he asked him, “Do you want to get well?”
6.cmn: 耶穌看見他躺着，知道他病了許久，就問他說：「你要痊癒嗎？」
6.sry: Iru ka kmita ta ti Yesus tenian ka maliko, ka kavanaen tin ka maka dalia ato ki nikaalamen tin, nikuma tenian, “mamuy kaw kawa madarikag?

7.niv: “Sir,” the invalid replied, “I have no one to help me into the pool when the water is stirred. While I am trying to get in, someone else goes down ahead of me.”
7.cmn: 病人回答說：「先生，水動的時候，沒有人把我放在池子裏；我正去的時候，就有別人比我先下去。」
7.sry: Nimatagivli tenian ta maalam, Meyrang, ausi yawan sat ki vual ka smakikwa yawan tu ayawugan ru pativuen ta ralum: ka ru ukun ato maw, murarim ta pani siuro yawan.

8.niv: Then Jesus said to him, “Get up! Pick up your mat and walk.”
8.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「起來，拿你的褥子走吧！」
8.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, gapita, angpoaw taapagan oho ka munonanga.

9.niv: At once the man was cured; he picked up his mat and walked. The day on which this took place was a Sabbath,
9.cmn: 那人立刻痊癒，就拿起褥子來走了。
9.sry: Ka madis madarikag ato ta vual ka ana, ka niangpoen tin taapagan tin munonang. Ka kidi ki pahihababan ta wagi ka ana.

10.niv: and so the Jewish leaders said to the man who had been healed, “It is the Sabbath; the law forbids you to carry your mat.”
10.cmn: 那天是安息日，所以猶太人對那醫好的人說：「今天是安息日，你拿褥子是不可的。」
10.sry: Anata nikuma ta Yoden tenian; ka padarikagen ato, wagi ato ki pahihababan, asi hahayen imhuan mangpo maval ki apagan.

11.niv: But he replied, “The man who made me well said to me, ‘Pick up your mat and walk.’ ”
11.cmn: 他卻回答說：「那使我痊癒的，對我說：『拿你的褥子走吧。』」
11.sry: Nimatagivli ta teni nenian; Teni ka nipadarikag, yawan, teni ta nikuma yawan, angpoaw ta aapagan oho, munonanga.

12.niv: So they asked him, “Who is this fellow who told you to pick it up and walk?”
12.cmn: 他們問他說：「對你說『拿褥子走』的是甚麼人？」
12.sry: Anata nitmalig ta neni tenian; timang ta vual ka ana ka nikuma imhuan, angpoaw ta aapagan oho, munonanga?’

13.niv: The man who was healed had no idea who it was, for Jesus had slipped away into the crowd that was there.
13.cmn: 那醫好的人不知道是誰；因為那裏的人多，耶穌已經躲開了。
13.sry: Ka teni ka nipadarikagen, asi mumha ka timang ta teni: Ka nimuzung dmarang ta ti Yesus, aley ka ayakwa hina ki makuilalawlaw tu itukwan ka ana.

14.niv: Later Jesus found him at the temple and said to him, “See, you are well again. Stop sinning or something worse may happen to you.”
14.cmn: 後來耶穌在殿裏遇見他，對他說：「你已經痊癒了，不要再犯罪，恐怕你遭遇的更加利害。」
14.sry: Siawug ki ana nikabaleyen ta teni ti Yesus tu Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, ka nikuma tenian, Kitaey nipadarikagen kaw, ina mila mavaraw, du asia kaw masaun matagirurumang.

15.niv: The man went away and told the Jewish leaders that it was Jesus who had made him well.
15.cmn: 那人就去告訴猶太人，使他痊癒的是耶穌。
15.sry: Nidmarang ta vual ka ana, ka nignawen tin vanavana ki Yoden, ka ti Yesus ta nipadarikag tenian.

16.niv: So, because Jesus was doing these things on the Sabbath, the Jewish leaders began to persecute him.
16.cmn: 所以猶太人逼迫耶穌，因為他在安息日做了這事。
16.sry: Aley ki ana nikmudilug ta Yoden ti Yesusan, kmakiim ki pakapatayaney tenian, aley ka paamuten tin ta ana tu wagi ki pahihababan.

17.niv: In his defense Jesus said to them, “My Father is always at his work to this very day, and I too am working.”
17.cmn: 耶穌就對他們說：「我父做事直到如今，我也做事。」
17.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Yesus nenian, mapungas ta Raman aw tu kidi hinin, ka mapungas apa ko ti yaw.

18.niv: For this reason they tried all the more to kill him; not only was he breaking the Sabbath, but he was even calling God his own Father, making himself equal with God.
18.cmn: 所以猶太人越發想要殺他；因他不但犯了安息日，並且稱上帝為他的父，將自己和上帝當作平等。 子的權柄
18.sry: Aley ki ana nimakisaun kmiim ta Yoden ki pakapatayaney tenian, aley ka asi dik Sidadaen tin ta wagi ki pahihababaan, ra nikuma apa, ka Alid ta Raraman tin tenian mamado ki Alid.

19.niv: Jesus gave them this answer: “Very truly I tell you, the Son can do nothing by himself; he can do only what he sees his Father doing, because whatever the Father does the Son also does.
19.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，子憑着自己不能做甚麼，惟有看見父所做的，子才能做；父所做的事，子也照樣做。
19.sry: Anata nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, kuma nenian, Mising, mising kun aw kamu, Asi peylpug ta Alak sikunung pamado papamut ki mamang, ru asi tin kitaan ta ana pamut ki Rama: ka kamamang ka pamuten tin, ata apa ta pamuten ki Alak.

20.niv: For the Father loves the Son and shows him all he does. Yes, and he will show him even greater works than these, so that you will be amazed.
20.cmn: 父愛子，將自己所做的一切事指給他看，還要將比這更大的事指給他看，叫你們希奇。
20.sry: Ka mavagango ta Rama ki Alak ka pakita tenian ki mamang ka peyringeyen tin: Ka pakitaa lapa tenian ki peyringeyen ka masaun irang ki ata, aley kamuringaa kamu.

21.niv: For just as the Father raises the dead and gives them life, even so the Son gives life to whom he is pleased to give it.
21.cmn: 父怎樣叫死人起來，使他們活着，子也照樣隨自己的意思使人活着。
21.sry: Ka mama ka pagapit pakawag ta Rama ki patay, pakawag apa kumahina ta Alak timamangan ka kamuyen

22.niv: Moreover, the Father judges no one, but has entrusted all judgment to the Son,
22.cmn: 父不審判甚麼人，乃將審判的事全交與子，
22.sry: Ka asi dmungdung timamangan ta Rama, ra nipaaimiden tin piga ki Alak.

23.niv: that all may honor the Son just as they honor the Father. Whoever does not honor the Son does not honor the Father, who sent him.
23.cmn: 叫人都尊敬子如同尊敬父一樣。不尊敬子的，就是不尊敬差子來的父。
23.sry: Aley ka imida ta neni lmulug ki Alak, mama ki lulugen nein ki Rama. Timamang ta asi lmulug ki Alak, asi lmulug ki Rama ka nimadingi tenian.

24.niv: “Very truly I tell you, whoever hears my word and believes him who sent me has eternal life and will not be judged but has crossed over from death to life.
24.cmn: 我實實在在地告訴你們，那聽我話、又信差我來者的，就有永生；不至於定罪，是已經出死入生了。
24.sry: Mising, mising kun aw kamu, Timamang ta milingig ki su aw ka tnamising Tenian ka nimadingi yawan, akumeya ta teni ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug, ka asi tin ukun tu pakuavavagan: ra nisatunun ta teni tu kapatayan sakakwa tu kawagan.

25.niv: Very truly I tell you, a time is coming and has now come when the dead will hear the voice of the Son of God and those who hear will live.
25.cmn: 我實實在在地告訴你們，時候將到，現在就是了，死人要聽見上帝兒子的聲音，聽見的人就要活了。
25.sry: Mising, mising kun aw kamu, Irua ta [kidi ki] tagley, ka anaen hinin, ka milingiga ta patay ki ingaw ki Alak ki Alid, ka na mamang ta milingiga lato, mawaga ta neni.

26.niv: For as the Father has life in himself, so he has granted the Son also to have life in himself.
26.cmn: 因為父怎樣在自己有生命，就賜給他兒子也照樣在自己有生命，
26.sry: Ka mama ka aku kawagan ta Rama tenian mamado, nipigaen apa tin kumahina ki Alak ka aku kawagan ta teni tenian mamado.

27.niv: And he has given him authority to judge because he is the Son of Man.
27.cmn: 並且因為他是人子，就賜給他行審判的權柄。
27.sry: Ka nipigaen tin ta kairangan ki kidi tenian tu paamuten apa ki dungdungan, aley ka Alak ta teni ki kagulung.

28.niv: “Do not be amazed at this, for a time is coming when all who are in their graves will hear his voice
28.cmn: 你們不要把這事看作希奇。時候要到，凡在墳墓裏的，都要聽見他的聲音，就出來：
28.sry: Ina muringaw ki ana: nda irua ta [kidi ki] tagley ka tnaimida milingig ki ingaw tin ta ayarbo ki ravaravak.

29.niv: and come out—those who have done what is good will rise to live, and those who have done what is evil will rise to be condemned.
29.cmn: 行善的，復活得生；作惡的，復活定罪。
29.sry: Ka mupanaga, ta nimapungas ki mariyang, tu likugey gapit ka tu kawagan: Neni apa ka nimapungas ki asi mariyang, tu likugey gapit ka tu pakuavavagan.

30.niv: By myself I can do nothing; I judge only as I hear, and my judgment is just, for I seek not to please myself but him who sent me.
30.cmn: 「我憑着自己不能做甚麼，我怎麼聽見就怎麼審判。我的審判也是公平的；因為我不求自己的意思，只求那差我來者的意思。」 為耶穌作證
30.sry: Asi ko pailpug sikunung pamut ki mamang Mama ki ilingigen aw dmungdung ko: ka matiktik ta dungdungan aw, ka asi ko kmiim ki kamuyen aw, ra kamuyen apa ki Rama ka nimadingi yawan.

31.niv: “If I testify about myself, my testimony is not true.
31.cmn: 「我若為自己作見證，我的見證就不真。
31.sry: Hairu matagihail ko matagimimia yawan matagimado, asi matiktik ta patagihailen aw.

32.niv: There is another who testifies in my favor, and I know that his testimony about me is true.
32.cmn: 另有一位給我作見證，我也知道他給我作的見證是真的。
32.sry: Akumeya ki pani ka matagihail matagimimia yawan, ka kavanaen aw ka matiktik ta patagihailen tin matagimimia yawan.

33.niv: “You have sent to John and he has testified to the truth.
33.cmn: 你們曾差人到約翰那裏，他為真理作過見證。
33.sry: Imumi ta nimadingi paukwa ti Yoanesan, ka nipatagihailen tin ki katiktikan ki su.

34.niv: Not that I accept human testimony; but I mention it that you may be saved.
34.cmn: 其實，我所受的見證不是從人來的；然而，我說這些話，為要叫你們得救。
34.sry: Ra ti yaw asi ko tamamimia ki patagihailan ki kagulung: ra ata apa ta ka suen aw aley ka pakariyangey lato kamu.

35.niv: John was a lamp that burned and gave light, and you chose for a time to enjoy his light.
35.cmn: 約翰是點着的明燈，你們情願暫時喜歡他的光。
35.sry: Na uging ta teni ka maramag ka mawing: ka nimamuy kamu maray asi madalia ki kidi tu ramag tin.

36.niv: “I have testimony weightier than that of John. For the works that the Father has given me to finish—the very works that I am doing—testify that the Father has sent me.
36.cmn: 但我有比約翰更大的見證；因為父交給我要我成就的事，就是我所做的事，這便見證我是父所差來的。
36.sry: Ra akumeya ko ki patagihailan ka masaun irang ka ti Yoanes. Ka ringey ka nipigaen ki Rama yawan tu pamutey maw ki ana, ringey ka paamuten aw matagihail matagimimia yawan, ka nipadingien ko ki Rama.

37.niv: And the Father who sent me has himself testified concerning me. You have never heard his voice nor seen his form,
37.cmn: 差我來的父也為我作過見證。你們從來沒有聽見他的聲音，也沒有看見他的形像。
37.sry: Ka Rama ka nimadingi yawan nimatagimado matagihail matagimimia yawan mikakwa. Asi kamu nimilingig ki ingaw tin, ka asi kamu nikmita ki haway tin.

38.niv: nor does his word dwell in you, for you do not believe the one he sent.
38.cmn: 你們並沒有他的道存在心裏；因為他所差來的，你們不信。
38.sry: Ka asi mayali imumian ta su tin: aley ka asi kamu tnamising tenian ka nipadingien tin.

39.niv: You study the Scriptures diligently because you think that in them you have eternal life. These are the very Scriptures that testify about me,
39.cmn: 你們查考聖經，因你們以為內中有永生；給我作見證的就是這經。
39.sry: Makiriyanga kmiim ki na sasulat: ka pagdumdum kamu ki pakivaleyey mumi tu ata ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug: ana ta matagihail matagimimia yawan.

40.niv: yet you refuse to come to me to have life.
40.cmn: 然而，你們不肯到我這裏來得生命。
40.sry: Ka inang kamu mukwa yawan, aley ka akumeyaa kamu ki kawagan.

41.niv: “I do not accept glory from human beings,
41.cmn: 「我不受從人來的榮耀。
41.sry: Asi ko tmimia ki kairangan ki kidi tu kagulungan.

42.niv: but I know you. I know that you do not have the love of God in your hearts.
42.cmn: 但我知道，你們心裏沒有上帝的愛。
42.sry: Ra kalangen aw kamu, ka ausi [ kamu] imumian ki kavagangoan ki Alid.

43.niv: I have come in my Fatherʼs name, and you do not accept me; but if someone else comes in his own name, you will accept him.
43.cmn: 我奉我父的名來，你們並不接待我；若有別人奉自己的名來，你們倒要接待他。
43.sry: Iru ato ko tu Nanang ki Rama aw, ka asi kamu matarig yawan: iru ra irua lato ta pani [ki vual] tu nanang tin mamado, teni ta atarigey mumi.

44.niv: How can you believe since you accept glory from one another but do not seek the glory that comes from the only God ?
44.cmn: 你們互相受榮耀，卻不求從獨一之上帝來的榮耀，怎能信我呢？
44.sry: Tnalpug kamu tnamising mama ki mang ka pakitavagen umi makimimia ki lulugan, ka lulugan ka ana ka maka dik makakwa ki Alid, asi mumi kiimen?

45.niv: “But do not think I will accuse you before the Father. Your accuser is Moses, on whom your hopes are set.
45.cmn: 不要想我在父面前要告你們；有一位告你們的，就是你們所仰賴的摩西。
45.sry: Ina pagdumdum, ka matagivavulasa ko matagidumadumaa imumian ki Rama: ki matagivavulas matagidumaduma imumian teni ato ta ti Moses, ka hitadugen umi.

46.niv: If you believed Moses, you would believe me, for he wrote about me.
46.cmn: 你們如果信摩西，也必信我，因為他書上有指着我寫的話。
46.sry: Ka ru tnamising kamu ti Mosesan, ina kamu tnamising yawan. Ka nisulaten tin makwa yawan.

47.niv: But since you do not believe what he wrote, how are you going to believe what I say?”
47.cmn: 你們若不信他的書，怎能信我的話呢？」
47.sry: Iru ra asi kamu tnamising ki na sasulat tin, tnamisinga kamu mama ki mang ki su aw?

1.niv: Some time after this, Jesus crossed to the far shore of the Sea of Galilee (that is, the Sea of Tiberias),
1.cmn: 這事以後，耶穌渡過加利利海，就是提比哩亞海。
1.sry: Siawug ki ana nidmarang ta ti Yesus muarug ki vaung ka tu Galilaya ka vaung ki Tiberyas.

2.niv: and a great crowd of people followed him because they saw the signs he had performed by healing the sick.
2.cmn: 有許多人因為看見他在病人身上所行的神蹟，就跟隨他。
2.sry: Ka nismaladilug tenian ta makuilalawlaw ka mabatung, aley ka kakitaan nein ta na pukakidi tin, ka paamuten tin ki maalam.

3.niv: Then Jesus went up on a mountainside and sat down with his disciples.
3.cmn: 耶穌上了山，和門徒一同坐在那裏。
3.sry: Ka nimuvukin ta ti Yesus, mirung hina itulam ki patatawutawugan tin.

4.niv: The Jewish Passover Festival was near.
4.cmn: 那時猶太人的逾越節近了。
4.sry: Ka tu tamang ta uvavatugan ki Halidawan ki Yoden.

5.niv: When Jesus looked up and saw a great crowd coming toward him, he said to Philip, “Where shall we buy bread for these people to eat?”
5.cmn: 耶穌舉目看見許多人來，就對腓力說：「我們從哪裏買餅叫這些人吃呢？」（
5.sry: Iru ka papasauvavaw, ta ti Yesus ki mata, ka kakitaan tin makuilalawlaw ka mabatung kamukwa tenian, nikuma ti Filipusan, “Peylaaw mita tumang ki paul aley ka mavoka ta neni ka ata?

6.niv: He asked this only to test him, for he already had in mind what he was going to do.
6.cmn: 他說這話是要試驗腓力；他自己原知道要怎樣行。）
6.sry: Ra nipasususen tin ta ata tu repungen tenian: ka kavanaen tin mang ta ringeya tin.

7.niv: Philip answered him, “It would take more than half a yearʼs wages to buy enough bread for each one to have a bite!”
7.cmn: 腓力回答說：「就是二十兩銀子的餅，叫他們各人吃一點也是不夠的。」
7.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Filipus tenian, ruruha kaatugan ki lumari ki paul asi mamsinga nenian ka ata, ka atitinga mara ta meybuavual.

8.niv: Another of his disciples, Andrew, Simon Peterʼs brother, spoke up,
8.cmn: 有一個門徒，就是西門‧彼得的兄弟安得烈，對耶穌說：
8.sry: Saat ki patatawutawugan tin, ka ti Andreas, ka tagiaparag ti Simon Petrus, ta nikuma tenian.

9.niv: “Here is a boy with five small barley loaves and two small fish, but how far will they go among so many?”
9.cmn: 「在這裏有一個孩童，帶着五個大麥餅、兩條魚，只是分給這許多人還算甚麼呢？」
9.sry: Tu hiya ta saat ka raway ka akumeya ki ririma ki paul ruruha apa ki tging: ra manga ka ata tu kabatungan ka kumahina?

10.niv: Jesus said, “Have the people sit down.” There was plenty of grass in that place, and they sat down (about five thousand men were there).
10.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們叫眾人坐下。」原來那地方的草多，眾人就坐下，數目約有五千。
10.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus, Pairungaw lato ta tau: ka madag hina ta akag tu itukwan ka ana. Ka nimirung ta papara rima katununan lava ki vual.

11.niv: Jesus then took the loaves, gave thanks, and distributed to those who were seated as much as they wanted. He did the same with the fish.
11.cmn: 耶穌拿起餅來，祝謝了，就分給那坐着的人；分魚也是這樣，都隨着他們所要的。
11.sry: Ka niaraen ti Yesus ta paul, ka ru nipakuvlien tin makualilid nimatatatag ki patatawutawugan, ka patatawutawugan [ta nimatatag] nenian ka mirung ato: makawlawla ki na tging, kumahina ki dag mama ki kamuyen nein.

12.niv: When they had all had enough to eat, he said to his disciples, “Gather the pieces that are left over. Let nothing be wasted.”
12.cmn: 他們吃飽了，耶穌對門徒說：「把剩下的零碎收拾起來，免得有糟蹋的。」
12.sry: Iru ka mibangtaw ta neni, nikuma ki Patatawtawan tin, “Iluda ki nipigpi ka nik da, aley ka asi tawrumaa ta mamang.”

13.niv: So they gathered them and filled twelve baskets with the pieces of the five barley loaves left over by those who had eaten.
13.cmn: 他們便將那五個大麥餅的零碎，就是眾人吃了剩下的，收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
13.sry: Anata niiludan nein putamuy sat kitian ab ki ruha ka lagian ki nipipi ki paul ka ana ka ririma ka na tavag, ka ni‘kda nein kman,

14.niv: After the people saw the sign Jesus performed, they began to say, “Surely this is the Prophet who is to come into the world.”
14.cmn: 眾人看見耶穌所行的神蹟，就說：「這真是那要到世間來的先知！」
14.sry: Iru ka nikmita ta tau ki na pukakidi ti Yesus, nikuma, Mising ti ata ta TamaMatagitan ka ana ka irua lato tu nay.

15.niv: Jesus, knowing that they intended to come and make him king by force, withdrew again to a mountain by himself.
15.cmn: 耶穌既知道眾人要來強逼他作王，就獨自又退到山上去了。 耶穌在海面上行走 （太14‧22－33；可6‧45－52）
15.sry: Iru ka kavanaan ti Yesus ka iruey nein murang bihit tenian ka papeysasuey pasibavaw ta teni, nisalala sauni muvukin tu saat.

16.niv: When evening came, his disciples went down to the lake,
16.cmn: 到了晚上，他的門徒下海邊去，
16.sry: Ka ru madung ato, nitawdarim ta patatawutawugan tin muvaung.

17.niv: where they got into a boat and set off across the lake for Capernaum. By now it was dark, and Jesus had not yet joined them.
17.cmn: 上了船，要過海往迦百農去。天已經黑了，耶穌還沒有來到他們那裏。
17.sry: Ka ru nimuavang nimuarug ta neni ki vaung mukwa tu Kapernaum. Ka marimdim ato, ka asi apa irua ato ta ti Yesus nenian.

18.niv: A strong wind was blowing and the waters grew rough.
18.cmn: 忽然狂風大作，海就翻騰起來。
18.sry: Ka nirmaruar ta vaung aley ka nibavare ta vare ka vagyug.

19.niv: When they had rowed about three or four miles, they saw Jesus approaching the boat, walking on the water; and they were frightened.
19.cmn: 門徒搖櫓，約行了十里多路，看見耶穌在海面上走，漸漸近了船，他們就害怕。
19.sry: Iru ka nitawavang ruha kitian ab ki rima lava ki turu lava kitian ki stadien [ka na pta ki darang] nikmita ta neni ti Yesusan ka munonang hmihalap [ki ralum] ki vaung, muhili ki avang, ka nimatakut ta neni.

20.niv: But he said to them, “It is I; donʼt be afraid.”
20.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「是我，不要怕！」
20.sry: Ra nikuma ta teni nenian, Ti yaw, ina matakut.

21.niv: Then they were willing to take him into the boat, and immediately the boat reached the shore where they were heading.
21.cmn: 門徒就喜歡接他上船，船立時到了他們所要去的地方。 耶穌是生命的糧
21.sry: Ka nimasarul ta neni puavang tenian: ka madis nimuhili ta avang ki purug ka ukwaey nein.

22.niv: The next day the crowd that had stayed on the opposite shore of the lake realized that only one boat had been there, and that Jesus had not entered it with his disciples, but that they had gone away alone.
22.cmn: 第二日，站在海那邊的眾人知道那裏沒有別的船，只有一隻小船，又知道耶穌沒有同他的門徒上船，乃是門徒自己去的。
22.sry: Tu sasat apa ki wagi ka tu awug, iru ka kmita ta makuilalawlaw ka tu arug ki vaung, ka ausi hina ki pani ki avang dik saasat ka ana, ki nipak daken ki patatawutawugan tin, ka asi nitawlam ta ti Yesus ki patatawutawugan tin tawavang, ra nimuavang musinag ta patatawutawugan tin:

23.niv: Then some boats from Tiberias landed near the place where the people had eaten the bread after the Lord had given thanks.
23.cmn: 然而，有幾隻小船從提比哩亞來，靠近主祝謝後分餅給人吃的地方。
23.sry: (Ra pani ki avang ta niirua maka Tiberyas muhili ki itukwan ka ana, ka nikanen nein ta paul, ru nimakuvli makuAlilid ta Meyrang.)

24.niv: Once the crowd realized that neither Jesus nor his disciples were there, they got into the boats and went to Capernaum in search of Jesus.
24.cmn: 眾人見耶穌和門徒都不在那裏，就上了船，往迦百農去找耶穌。
24.sry: Iru ka nikmita ta makuilalawlaw ka ausi hina ta ti Yesus ki patatawutawugan apa tin, nimuavang apa ta neni, mukwa tu Kapernaum, ka kmakiim ti Yesusan.

25.niv: When they found him on the other side of the lake, they asked him, “Rabbi, when did you get here?”
25.cmn: 既在海那邊找着了，就對他說：「拉比，是幾時到這裏來的？」
25.sry: Ka ru nimakivaley ta neni tenian tu arug ki vaung, nikuma tenian, Rabi, niirua kaw ka manu hiya.

26.niv: Jesus answered, “Very truly I tell you, you are looking for me, not because you saw the signs I performed but because you ate the loaves and had your fill.
26.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們找我，並不是因見了神蹟，乃是因吃餅得飽。
26.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian, Mising, mising kun aw kamu, kmakiim kamu yawan, asi aley ka nikitaan umi ta pukidien, aley apa ka nikman kamu ki paul pakabangtaw.

27.niv: Do not work for food that spoils, but for food that endures to eternal life, which the Son of Man will give you. For on him God the Father has placed his seal of approval.”
27.cmn: 不要為那必壞的食物勞力，要為那存到永生的食物勞力，就是人子要賜給你們的，因為人子是父上帝所印證的。」
27.sry: Ina mapungas [aley] ki avovokan ka sanino, ra [aley apa] ki avoken ka mayili tu kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug, ka pigaaney Imumian ta Alak ki kagulung: ka teni ka ata ta niputapuyuen ki Alid Rama.

28.niv: Then they asked him, “What must we do to do the works God requires?”
28.cmn: 眾人問他說：「我們當行甚麼才算做上帝的工呢？」
28.sry: Anata nikuma ta neni tenian, Umanga kame, aley ka kapengasaw yan ta papeyraringaringey ki Alid?

29.niv: Jesus answered, “The work of God is this: to believe in the one he has sent.”
29.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「信上帝所差來的，這就是做上帝的工。」
29.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian, Ata ta peyraringaringey ki Alid, ka tnamisinga kamu tenian, ka nipadingien tin.

30.niv: So they asked him, “What sign then will you give that we may see it and believe you? What will you do?
30.cmn: 他們又說：「你行甚麼神蹟，叫我們看見就信你；你到底做甚麼事呢？
30.sry: Anata nikuma ta neni tenian, Pukidien kimang ka paamuten ‘hu [oho] aley kakitaey yan ta ata tnamsing imhuan? Mapungas kaw ki mang?

31.niv: Our ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness; as it is written: ‘He gave them bread from heaven to eat.’”
31.cmn: 我們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，如經上寫着說：『他從天上賜下糧來給他們吃。』」
31.sry: Nikman ta na ramu yan ki Mana tu pulag: mama ki nisulaten da, Nipigaen tin pavok nenian ki paul ka maka vulum.

32.niv: Jesus said to them, “Very truly I tell you, it is not Moses who has given you the bread from heaven, but it is my Father who gives you the true bread from heaven.
32.cmn: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，那從天上來的糧不是摩西賜給你們的，乃是我父將天上來的真糧賜給你們。
32.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Mising, mising kun aw kamu ra, asi nipiga ta ti Moses imumian ki paul ka maka vulum: ra Rarama apa maw ta piga imumian ki paul ka dilig ka maka tunun ki vulum.

33.niv: For the bread of God is the bread that comes down from heaven and gives life to the world.”
33.cmn: 因為上帝的糧就是那從天上降下來、賜生命給世界的。」
33.sry: Ka paul ki Alid ta teni ka nimurarim maka tunun ki vulum, ka piga ki kawagan ki nay.

34.niv: “Sir,” they said, “always give us this bread.”
34.cmn: 他們說：「主啊，常將這糧賜給我們！」
34.sry: Anata nikuma ta neni tenian, Meyrang, pahakakwaey kame ki paul ka ata.

35.niv: Then Jesus declared, “I am the bread of life. Whoever comes to me will never go hungry, and whoever believes in me will never be thirsty.
35.cmn: 耶穌說：「我就是生命的糧。到我這裏來的，必定不餓；信我的，永遠不渴。
35.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Ti yaw ta paul ki kawagan: timamang ta mukwa yawan, mikakwa asi migangeya: timamang apa ta tnamising yawan, mikakwa asi maitoa.

36.niv: But as I told you, you have seen me and still you do not believe.
36.cmn: 只是我對你們說過，你們已經看見我，還是不信。
36.sry: Ra nipasusuen aw kamu ka nikitaan umi yawan, ka asi kamu tnamising ato.

37.niv: All those the Father gives me will come to me, and whoever comes to me I will never drive away.
37.cmn: 凡父所賜給我的人必到我這裏來；到我這裏來的，我總不丟棄他。
37.sry: Kamamang ka pigaen ko ki Rama mukwaa yawan: ka timamang ta mukwa yawan, asi maw sakitawaganey ta teni.

38.niv: For I have come down from heaven not to do my will but to do the will of him who sent me.
38.cmn: 因為我從天上降下來，不是要按自己的意思行，乃是要按那差我來者的意思行。
38.sry: Ka nimurarim ko maka tunun ki vulum, asi aley ka pamutaw maw ta kamuyen aw, ra kamuyen apa tin ka nimadingi yawan.

39.niv: And this is the will of him who sent me, that I shall lose none of all those he has given me, but raise them up at the last day.
39.cmn: 差我來者的意思就是：他所賜給我的，叫我一個也不失落，在末日卻叫他復活。
39.sry: Ata ta kamuyen ki Rama ka nimadingi yawan, ka asi ko patagirumaa ki mamang ki nipigaen tin yawan, ra pagapitey maw k’ana tu wagi ka tu awug.

40.niv: For my Fatherʼs will is that everyone who looks to the Son and believes in him shall have eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.”
40.cmn: 因為我父的意思是叫一切見子而信的人得永生，並且在末日我要叫他復活。」
40.sry: Ata apa ta kamuyen tin ka nimadingi yawan, imid ka mararaw ki Alak tnamising tenian, akumeya ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug: ka pagapitey maw ta teni tu wagi ka tu awug.

41.niv: At this the Jews there began to grumble about him because he said, “I am the bread that came down from heaven.”
41.cmn: 猶太人因為耶穌說「我是從天上降下來的糧」，就私下議論他，
41.sry: Ka nimimaawrmur ta Yoden tenian aley ki na su tin, “Ti yaw ta paul ka nimurarim maka tunun ki vulum.”

42.niv: They said, “Is this not Jesus, the son of Joseph, whose father and mother we know? How can he now say, ‘I came down from heaven’?”
42.cmn: 說：「這不是約瑟的兒子耶穌嗎？他的父母我們豈不認得嗎？他如今怎麼說『我是從天上降下來的』呢？」
42.sry: Ka nikuma ta neni, Asi kawa ti ata ta ti Yesus ka alak ti Yoses, ka kalangen yan ki Rama ki rarenan tin? Matagimama ki mang ta ti ata, Nimurarim ko maka tunun ki vulum?

43.niv: “Stop grumbling among yourselves,” Jesus answered.
43.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「你們不要大家議論。
43.sry: Anata nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian, ina meynadonado meymaawrmurmur.

44.niv: “No one can come to me unless the Father who sent me draws them, and I will raise them up at the last day.
44.cmn: 若不是差我來的父吸引人，就沒有能到我這裏來的；到我這裏來的，在末日我要叫他復活。
44.sry: Asi mulpug ta timamang mukwa yawan, ru asi vihit tin ta teni ki Rama ka nimadingi yawan, ka pagapitey maw ta teni tu wagi ka tu awug.

45.niv: It is written in the Prophets: ‘They will all be taught by God.’ Everyone who has heard the Father and learned from him comes to me.
45.cmn: 在先知書上寫着說：『他們都要蒙上帝的教訓。』凡聽見父之教訓又學習的，就到我這裏來。
45.sry: Ka nisulaten tu [na sasulat] ki Tamamatagitan, Ka pakuimidey ta neni matawtawug ki Alid. Anata imid ka nimilingig [ki ata] ki Rama, ka nipatagitawugen apa, ta mukwa yawan.

46.niv: No one has seen the Father except the one who is from God; only he has seen the Father.
46.cmn: 這不是說有人看見過父，惟獨從上帝來的，他看見過父。
46.sry: Asi ka nikitaan ta Rama timamang, dik tenian ka nimakakwa ki Alid: teni ta nikmita ki Rama.

47.niv: Very truly I tell you, the one who believes has eternal life.
47.cmn: 我實實在在地告訴你們，信的人有永生。
47.sry: Mising, mising kun aw kamu ra, timamang ta tnamising yawan, akumeya ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug.

48.niv: I am the bread of life.
48.sry: Ti yaw ta paul ki kawagan.

49.niv: Your ancestors ate the manna in the wilderness, yet they died.
49.cmn: 你們的祖宗在曠野吃過嗎哪，還是死了。
49.sry: Nikman ta na Ramu umi ki Mana tu pulag, ka nimapatay ta neni.

50.niv: But here is the bread that comes down from heaven, which anyone may eat and not die.
50.cmn: 這是從天上降下來的糧，叫人吃了就不死。
50.sry: Ata ta paul ka nimurarim maka tunun ki vulum, aley ka kmana ki ata ta timamang ka tau, ka asi mapatayata teni.

51.niv: I am the living bread that came down from heaven. Whoever eats this bread will live forever. This bread is my flesh, which I will give for the life of the world.”
51.cmn: 我是從天上降下來生命的糧；人若吃這糧，就必永遠活着。我所要賜的糧就是我的肉，為世人之生命所賜的。」
51.sry: Ti yaw ta paul ka ana ka mawag ka nimurarim maka tunun ki vulum: timamang ta kman ki paul ka ata mawaga ta teni tu ikakwan midarinug. Ka paul ka pigaey maw vaat aw ka ana, ka pigaey maw aley ki kawagan ki nay.

52.niv: Then the Jews began to argue sharply among themselves, “How can this man give us his flesh to eat?”
52.cmn: 因此，猶太人彼此爭論說：「這個人怎能把他的肉給我們吃呢？」
52.sry: Anata nimacyt ki su ta Yoden mataginaunado, kuma, “Ilpug mama ki mang pakan ta ti ata imitan ki vaat tin?”

53.niv: Jesus said to them, “Very truly I tell you, unless you eat the flesh of the Son of Man and drink his blood, you have no life in you.
53.cmn: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們若不吃人子的肉，不喝人子的血，就沒有生命在你們裏面。
53.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Mising, mising kun aw kamu, hairu asi kamu kman ki vaat ki Alak ki kagulung, ausi kamu ki kawagan imumian.

54.niv: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood has eternal life, and I will raise them up at the last day.
54.cmn: 吃我肉、喝我血的人就有永生，在末日我要叫他復活。
54.sry: Timamang ta kman ki vaat aw, ta mit ki amag aw akumeya ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug: ka pagapitaw maw ta teni tu wagi ka tu awug.

55.niv: For my flesh is real food and my blood is real drink.
55.cmn: 我的肉真是可吃的，我的血真是可喝的。
55.sry: Ka avoken ka dilig ta vaat aw, it apa ka dilig ta amag aw.

56.niv: Whoever eats my flesh and drinks my blood remains in me, and I in them.
56.cmn: 吃我肉、喝我血的人常在我裏面，我也常在他裏面。
56.sry: Timamang ta kman ki vaat aw, ta mit ki amag aw, itukwa ta teni yawan, ka itukwa apa ko tenian.

57.niv: Just as the living Father sent me and I live because of the Father, so the one who feeds on me will live because of me.
57.cmn: 永活的父怎樣差我來，我又因父活着；照樣，吃我肉的人也要因我活着。
57.sry: Mama ki nipadingien ko ki Rama ka mawag, ka kawagen aw aley ki Rama, [kumahina] timamang ta kman yawan, mawaga ta teni aley yawan.

58.niv: This is the bread that came down from heaven. Your ancestors ate manna and died, but whoever feeds on this bread will live forever.”
58.cmn: 這就是從天上降下來的糧。吃這糧的人就永遠活着，不像你們的祖宗吃過嗎哪還是死了。」
58.sry: Ata ta paul ka nimurarim maka tunun ki vulum, Asi mama ki nikanen ki na ramu umi ta Mana, ka nimapatay ta neni ra timamang ta kman ki paul ka ata mawaga ta teni tu ikakwan midarinug.

59.niv: He said this while teaching in the synagogue in Capernaum.
59.cmn: 這些話是耶穌在迦百農會堂裏教訓人說的。 永生的話語
59.sry: Ka mamang ka ata nipasusuen tin tu Pakuisalan, du matawtawug tu Kapernaum.

60.niv: On hearing it, many of his disciples said, “This is a hard teaching. Who can accept it?”
60.cmn: 他的門徒中有好些人聽見了，就說：「這話甚難，誰能聽呢？」
60.sry: Mabatung ki patatawutawugan tin ka milingig [ki ata] ta nikuma, Matag ta su ka ata: timang ta tnalpug ki ata milingig.

61.niv: Aware that his disciples were grumbling about this, Jesus said to them, “Does this offend you?
61.cmn: 耶穌心裏知道門徒為這話議論，就對他們說：「這話是叫你們厭棄嗎？
61.sry: Iru ka umhaen ti Yesus mumado tenian ka mimaawmaw aley ki ata ta patatawutawugan tin, nikuma nenian, Pasaisalakuap kawa ta ata pakate imumian?

62.niv: Then what if you see the Son of Man ascend to where he was before!
62.cmn: 倘或你們看見人子升到他原來所在之處，怎麼樣呢？
62.sry: Umang [alato] ru kmita kamu ki Alak ki kagulung ka sabavaw tu niitu uroen tin itukwa?

63.niv: The Spirit gives life; the flesh counts for nothing. The words I have spoken to you—they are full of the Spirit and life.
63.cmn: 叫人活着的乃是靈，肉體是無益的。我對你們所說的話就是靈，就是生命。
63.sry: Yupan ta pakawag: saukinino ta vaat. Yupan ki kawagan apa ta su ka pasusuen aw imumian.

64.niv: Yet there are some of you who do not believe.” For Jesus had known from the beginning which of them did not believe and who would betray him.
64.cmn: 只是你們中間有不信的人。」耶穌從起頭就知道誰不信他，誰要賣他。
64.sry: Ra akumeya ki raruma imumian ka asi tnamising. Ka kavanaan ti Yesus tu naunamu na mamang ta neni ka asi tnamising, timang apa ta teni ka sivanavanaa tenian.

65.niv: He went on to say, “This is why I told you that no one can come to me unless the Father has enabled them.”
65.cmn: 耶穌又說：「所以我對你們說過，若不是蒙我父的恩賜，沒有人能到我這裏來。」
65.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni, Aley ki ata nipasusuen aw kamu, ka asi mulpug ta timamang mukwa yawan, ru asi papapa ta ata tenian ki Raman aw.

66.niv: From this time many of his disciples turned back and no longer followed him.
66.cmn: 從此，他門徒中多有退去的，不再和他同行。
66.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nidmarang maawlikug ta mabatung ka patatawutawugan tin, ka asi nimunonang hmilala tulam tenian.

67.niv: “You do not want to leave too, do you?” Jesus asked the Twelve.
67.cmn: 耶穌就對那十二個門徒說：「你們也要去嗎？」
67.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus ki saat kitian ka ana ab ki ruha, Mamuy apa kawa dmarang ta imumi?

68.niv: Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom shall we go? You have the words of eternal life.
68.cmn: 西門‧彼得回答說：「主啊，你有永生之道，我們還歸從誰呢？
68.sry: Nimatagivli tenian ta ti Simon Petrus, Meyrang, dmaranga kame mukwa timangan? Akumeya kaw ki su ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug.

69.niv: We have come to believe and to know that you are the Holy One of God.”
69.cmn: 我們已經信了，又知道你是上帝的聖者。」
69.sry: Ka nitnamising kame ka nimumha kame, ka ti Kristus kaw, Alak ki Alid ka mawag.

70.niv: Then Jesus replied, “Have I not chosen you, the Twelve? Yet one of you is a devil!”
70.cmn: 耶穌說：「我不是揀選了你們十二個門徒嗎？但你們中間有一個是魔鬼。」
70.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus nenian, Asi maw kamu kawa niperi ta sasat kitian ab ki ruha? Ra sasat imumian ta Litu?

71.niv: (He meant Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, who, though one of the Twelve, was later to betray him.)
71.cmn: 耶穌這話是指着加略人西門的兒子猶大說的；他本是十二個門徒裏的一個，後來要賣耶穌的。
71.sry: Ka nipasusuen tin [ta ata] matagimimia ti Yudasan ka ti Simon Iskaryot. Ka teni ta sivanavanaa lato tenian, ka saasat ta teni ki saasat kitian ab ki ruha.

1.niv: After this, Jesus went around in Galilee. He did not want to go about in Judea because the Jewish leaders there were looking for a way to kill him.
1.cmn: 這事以後，耶穌在加利利遊行，不願在猶太遊行，因為猶太人想要殺他。
