1.sry: Siawug ki ana nimunonang ta ti Yesus tu Galilaya, ka inang ta teni nimunonang tu Yudea, aley ka kmikiim ta Yoden ki pakapatayey tenian.

2.niv: But when the Jewish Festival of Tabernacles was near,
2.cmn: 當時猶太人的住棚節近了。
2.sry: Ka tu tamang ta Uvavatugan ki Yoden ki Pataararataan.

3.niv: Jesusʼ brothers said to him, “Leave Galilee and go to Judea, so that your disciples there may see the works you do.
3.cmn: 耶穌的弟兄就對他說：「你離開這裏上猶太去吧，叫你的門徒也看見你所行的事。
3.sry: Anata nikuma tenian ta tagiapaparag tin, “Thabula hiya, mukwa tu Yudea, aley ka kmita lapa ta patatawutawugan oho ki ringey oho ka paamuten hu.

4.niv: No one who wants to become a public figure acts in secret. Since you are doing these things, show yourself to the world.”
4.cmn: 人要顯揚名聲，沒有在暗處行事的；你如果行這些事，就當將自己顯明給世人看。」
4.sry: Ka asi meyringey ki mamang tu deng ta timamang, ka makimado apa kmiim ki Patagiamagaw matagimimia tenian. Hairu ki mamang ka ata, pakamadoa pakaamag imhuan ki nay.

5.niv: For even his own brothers did not believe in him.
5.cmn: 因為連他的弟兄說這話，是因為不信他。
5.sry: Ka asi apa nitnamising tenian ta tagiapaparag tin.

6.niv: Therefore Jesus told them, “My time is not yet here; for you any time will do.
6.cmn: 耶穌就對他們說：「我的時候還沒有到；你們的時候常是方便的。
6.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, asi apa ana ta kidi aw: ra mikakwa nitanang ta kidi umi.

7.niv: The world cannot hate you, but it hates me because I testify that its works are evil.
7.cmn: 世人不能恨你們，卻是恨我，因為我指證他們所做的事是惡的。
7.sry: Asi malpug mavahier imumian ta nay, ra mavahier apa yawan, aley ka patagihailen naw ki ata, ka mate ta peyraringaringey tin.

8.niv: You go to the festival. I am not going up to this festival, because my time has not yet fully come.”
8.cmn: 你們上去過節吧，我現在不上去過這節，因為我的時候還沒有滿。」
8.sry: Nda sabavawa ta imumi mukwa tu uvavatugan ka ata: Asi apa maw ukwaey tu uvavatugan, aley ka asi apa nipasitaw ta kidi aw.

9.niv: After he had said this, he stayed in Galilee.
9.cmn: 耶穌說了這話，仍舊住在加利利。 耶穌過住棚節
9.sry: Iru ka patagikahan tin ta mamang ka ata nenian, nimayali tu Galilaya.

10.niv: However, after his brothers had left for the festival, he went also, not publicly, but in secret.
10.cmn: 但他弟兄上去以後，他也上去過節，不是明去，似乎是暗去的。
10.sry: Iru ra taawkaha ato sabavaw ta tagiapaparag tin, anata nisabavaw apa ta teni mukwa tu uvavatugan, asi tu panag, ra mama apa tu deng ra.

11.niv: Now at the festival the Jewish leaders were watching for Jesus and asking, “Where is he?”
11.cmn: 正在節期，猶太人尋找耶穌，說：「他在哪裏？」
11.sry: Anata nikmiim tenian ta Yoden tu uvavatugan, matagikumahina ki su, “Tumang ta teni?”

12.niv: Among the crowds there was widespread whispering about him. Some said, “He is a good man.” Others replied, “No, he deceives the people.”
12.cmn: 眾人為他紛紛議論，有的說：「他是好人。」有的說：「不然，他是迷惑眾人的。」
12.sry: Ka madag hina ta sasaangsang ki makuilalawlaw matagimimia tenian. Nda nikuma ta raruma, mariyang ta teni: nikuma apa ta raruma, Asi: ra patagirahey ta teni ki makuilalawlaw.

13.niv: But no one would say anything publicly about him for fear of the leaders.
13.cmn: 只是沒有人明明地講論他，因為怕猶太人。
13.sry: Ra asi nimatagiamag ta timamang matagimimia tenian, aley ka katakuten nein ki Yoden.

14.niv: Not until halfway through the festival did Jesus go up to the temple courts and begin to teach.
14.cmn: 到了節期，耶穌上殿裏去教訓人。
14.sry: Iru ka tukad ta uvavatugan, nisabavaw ta ti Yesus mukuva ki Kuva tu tatamudan ki Alid matawtawug.

15.niv: The Jews there were amazed and asked, “How did this man get such learning without having been taught?”
15.cmn: 猶太人就希奇，說：「這個人沒有學過，怎麼明白書呢？」
15.sry: Ka nimuringaw ta Yoden matagikumahina ki su, “Mavana mama ki mang ta ti ata ki na sasulat, ru asi ahaw nipatagitawugen tenian?”

16.niv: Jesus answered, “My teaching is not my own. It comes from the one who sent me.
16.cmn: 耶穌說：「我的教訓不是我自己的，乃是那差我來者的。
16.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian, “Asi a'yaw ta patatawutawugan aw, ra a'teni apa ka nimadingi yawan.

17.niv: Anyone who chooses to do the will of God will find out whether my teaching comes from God or whether I speak on my own.
17.cmn: 人若立志遵着他的旨意行，就必曉得這教訓或是出於上帝，或是我憑着自己說的。
17.sry: Hairu mamuy ta timamang akwa ki kamuyen tin, kmalanga tu patatawugan ka ata, malava ka maka Alid, malava ka patagimadoen aw ta ata masusu.

18.niv: Whoever speaks on their own does so to gain personal glory, but he who seeks the glory of the one who sent him is a man of truth; there is nothing false about him.
18.cmn: 人憑着自己說，是求自己的榮耀；惟有求那差他來者的榮耀，這人是真的，在他心裏沒有不義。
18.sry: Timamang ta matagimado matagimimia tenian, kmiim ki lulugan tenian, mamado: ra timamang ta kmiim ki lulugan tenian ka nimadingi tenian, matiktik ta teni ki su, ka ausi ki katukulan

19.niv: Has not Moses given you the law? Yet not one of you keeps the law. Why are you trying to kill me?”
19.cmn: 摩西豈不是傳律法給你們嗎？你們卻沒有一個人守律法。為甚麼想要殺我呢？」
19.sry: Asi kawa na papiga ti Moses ta Tatuko imumian, ka ausi ta timamang imumian ka milig ki Tatuko? Kaumang ka kiimen umi ki pakapataaney imhuan?

20.niv: “You are demon-possessed,” the crowd answered. “Who is trying to kill you?”
20.cmn: 眾人回答說：「你是被鬼附着了！誰想要殺你？」
20.sry: Nimatagivli ta makuilalawlaw matagikumahina, aku litu kaw, timang ta kmiim ki pakapatayey imhuan?

21.niv: Jesus said to them, “I did one miracle, and you are all amazed.
21.cmn: 耶穌說：「我做了一件事，你們都以為希奇。
21.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian, Saasat ki ringey ta nipamuten aw, kamuimid kamu muringaw.

22.niv: Yet, because Moses gave you circumcision (though actually it did not come from Moses, but from the patriarchs), you circumcise a boy on the Sabbath.
22.cmn: 摩西傳割禮給你們（其實不是從摩西起的，乃是從祖先起的），因此你們也在安息日給人行割禮。
22.sry: Aley ki ana papiga ti Moses imumian ta Hiritungan Pahay (asi ka nimakakwa ti Mosesan, ra na tu Mamumu apa) ka hiritungen umi pahay tu wagi ki Pagihababan.

23.niv: Now if a boy can be circumcised on the Sabbath so that the law of Moses may not be broken, why are you angry with me for healing a manʼs whole body on the Sabbath?
23.cmn: 人若在安息日受割禮，免得違背摩西的律法，我在安息日叫一個人全然好了，你們就向我生氣嗎？
23.sry: Hairu ka abaleyen ki kagulung ka hiritungen pahay tu wagi ki Paihababan, ka asi aawkakirigaw ta na Tatuko ti Moses, mangale kawa kamu yawan, ka nipatumuk aw padarikag ta kagulung tu wagi ki pahihababan?

24.niv: Stop judging by mere appearances, but instead judge correctly.”
24.cmn: 不可按外貌斷定是非，總要按公平斷定是非。」 這是基督嗎？
24.sry: Ina dmungdung kmaikahier tu kakitan ki vlung, ra dmungdunga ki dadungdungdung ka matiktik.

25.niv: At that point some of the people of Jerusalem began to ask, “Isnʼt this the man they are trying to kill?
25.cmn: 耶路撒冷人中有的說：「這不是他們想要殺的人嗎？
25.sry: Anata nikuma ta raruma ka maka Yerusalem, Asi kawa ti ata ta ka kiimen nein ki pakapatayey tenian?

26.niv: Here he is, speaking publicly, and they are not saying a word to him. Have the authorities really concluded that he is the Messiah?
26.cmn: 你看他還明明地講道，他們也不向他說甚麼，難道官長真知道這是基督嗎？
26.sry: Ka kitaey, matagidungdung tumuk ki su, ka asi nein pusuen ta sasasat ki su tenian. Mudilig ato kawa mumha ta Meysasu ka dilig ti ata ta ti Kristus?

27.niv: But we know where this man is from; when the Messiah comes, no one will know where he is from.”
27.cmn: 然而，我們知道這個人從哪裏來；只是基督來的時候，沒有人知道他從哪裏來。」
27.sry: Ra ti ata ta kavanaen yan ka tumang ta nipakakwaan tin: Iru ra irua lato ta ti Kristus, asi mumha ta timamang ki nipakakwaan tin.

28.niv: Then Jesus, still teaching in the temple courts, cried out, “Yes, you know me, and you know where I am from. I am not here on my own authority, but he who sent me is true. You do not know him,
28.cmn: 那時，耶穌在殿裏教訓人，大聲說：「你們也知道我，也知道我從哪裏來；我來並不是由於自己。但那差我來的是真的。你們不認識他，
28.sry: Anata nimakulangag ta ti Yesus tu Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, du matawtawug du kuma, “Ka kmalang kamu yawan, ka kavanaen umi ka tumang ta nipakakwaen aw: asi ko nisikunung mamadu irua, ra matiktik ta teni ki su ka nimadingi yawan, ka asi mumi kalangen ta teni.

29.niv: but I know him because I am from him and he sent me.”
29.cmn: 我卻認識他；因為我是從他來的，他也是差了我來。」
29.sry: Ra kalangen aw ta teni, aley ka nimakakwa ko tenian, ka nimadingi ta teni yawan.

30.niv: At this they tried to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him, because his hour had not yet come.
30.cmn: 他們就想要捉拿耶穌；只是沒有人下手，因為他的時候還沒有到。
30.sry: Anata nikmiim ta neni ki turungen tenian, ra asi nipatagikwa ta timamang ki rima tenian, aley ka asi apa irua ato ta [kidi ki] tagley tin.

31.niv: Still, many in the crowd believed in him. They said, “When the Messiah comes, will he perform more signs than this man?”
31.cmn: 但眾人中間有好些信他的，說：「基督來的時候，他所行的神蹟豈能比這人所行的更多嗎？」 差役捉拿耶穌
31.sry: Ka mabatung ki makuilalawlaw ta nitnamising tenian, ka nikun nein, Iru ka irua lato ta ti Kristus, siuru kawa madag ki pukidien ka peyringeyaw tin, ki nipeyringeyen ti ata?

32.niv: The Pharisees heard the crowd whispering such things about him. Then the chief priests and the Pharisees sent temple guards to arrest him.
32.cmn: 法利賽人聽見眾人為耶穌這樣紛紛議論，祭司長和法利賽人就打發差役去捉拿他。
32.sry: Nimilingig ta Farizeen ka mimaawrmur ki ata ta makuilalawlaw matagimimia tenian: ka nimadingi ta Farizeen ki Tamapigik apa ka sibavaw ki kungcia, ka turunganey nein tenian.

33.niv: Jesus said, “I am with you for only a short time, and then I am going to the one who sent me.
33.cmn: 於是耶穌說：「我還有不多的時候和你們同在，以後就回到差我來的那裏去。
33.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Asi madalia ki kidi ka makuisala ko imumian, ka sakakwaa ko mukwa tenian ka nimadingi yawan.

34.niv: You will look for me, but you will not find me; and where I am, you cannot come.”
34.cmn: 你們要找我，卻找不着；我所在的地方你們不能到。」
34.sry: Kmiima kamu yawan, ra asi kamu makivaleya: tu ayakwaey maw, asi kamu hmalpug irua.

35.niv: The Jews said to one another, “Where does this man intend to go that we cannot find him? Will he go where our people live scattered among the Greeks, and teach the Greeks?
35.cmn: 猶太人就彼此對問說：「這人要往哪裏去，叫我們找不着呢？難道他要往散住希臘中的猶太人那裏去教訓希臘人嗎？
35.sry: Anata nimaanaunado ki su ta Yoden, Sakakuna ta ti ata ka asi mita pakivaleyaw ta teni? Mukwaa kawa ta teni nipapayavuhak ka Grieken, tu patagitawugey ki Grieken?

36.niv: What did he mean when he said, ‘You will look for me, but you will not find me,’ and ‘Where I am, you cannot come’?”
36.cmn: 他說：『你們要找我，卻找不着；我所在的地方，你們不能到』，這話是甚麼意思呢？」 活水的江河
36.sry: Ka mang ta su ka ata ka nipasusuen tin? Kmiima kamu yawan, ra asi kamu makivaleya: ka tu ayakwaey maw, asi kamu hmalpuga irua?

37.niv: On the last and greatest day of the festival, Jesus stood and said in a loud voice, “Let anyone who is thirsty come to me and drink.
37.cmn: 節期的末日，就是最大之日，耶穌站着高聲說：「人若渴了，可以到我這裏來喝。
37.sry: Ka tu wagi ka tu awug ka uvavatugan ki kairangan, nimituko ta ti Yesus ka pakulangagen tin kun, Timamang ta maito, mukwaa yawan mit.

38.niv: Whoever believes in me, as Scripture has said, rivers of living water will flow from within them.”
38.cmn: 信我的人就如經上所說：『從他腹中要流出活水的江河來。』」
38.sry: Timamang ta tnamising yawan, mama ka pasusuen ta na sasulat, sasaey ki ralum ka mawag smaayamaka rbo ki vuil tin.

39.niv: By this he meant the Spirit, whom those who believed in him were later to receive. Up to that time the Spirit had not been given, since Jesus had not yet been glorified.
39.cmn: 耶穌這話是指着信他之人要受聖靈說的。那時還沒有賜下聖靈來，因為耶穌尚未得着榮耀。 群眾因耶穌而紛爭
39.sry: (Ka pasusuen tin ta ata matagimimia ki Yupan ka abaleyaw nein ka tnamising tenian. Ka ausi apa ta YUPAN, aley ka asi apa nipukairangen ki kidi ta ti Yesus.)

40.niv: On hearing his words, some of the people said, “Surely this man is the Prophet.”
40.cmn: 眾人聽見這話，有的說：「這真是那先知。」
40.sry: Mabatung ki makuilalawlaw ka milingig ki su ka ata nikuma, dilig ti ata ta Tamamatagitan ka ana.

41.niv: Others said, “He is the Messiah.” Still others asked, “How can the Messiah come from Galilee?
41.cmn: 有的說：「這是基督。」但也有的說：「基督豈是從加利利出來的嗎？
41.sry: Nikuma ta raruma, Ti ata ta ti Kristus. Ra nikuma ta raruma, Makakwaa kawa ki Galilaya ta ti Kristus?

42.niv: Does not Scripture say that the Messiah will come from Davidʼs descendants and from Bethlehem, the town where David lived?”
42.cmn: 經上豈不是說『基督是大衛的後裔，從大衛本鄉伯利恆出來的』嗎？」
42.sry: Asi kawa kumaikumahina ta na sasulat, ka irua ta ti Kristus maka gaap ti David, maka awma ki Bethlehem, tu niayakwan ti David?

43.niv: Thus the people were divided because of Jesus.
43.cmn: 於是眾人因着耶穌起了紛爭。
43.sry: Anata nimamawduha ta su ki makuilalawlaw aley tenian.

44.niv: Some wanted to seize him, but no one laid a hand on him.
44.cmn: 其中有人要捉拿他，只是無人下手。 猶太領袖的不信
44.sry: Ra raruma nenian ta nimamuy tmurung tenian: ra asi nipatagikwa ta timamang ki rima tenian.

45.niv: Finally the temple guards went back to the chief priests and the Pharisees, who asked them, “Why didnʼt you bring him in?”
45.cmn: 差役回到祭司長和法利賽人那裏。他們對差役說：「你們為甚麼沒有帶他來呢？」
45.sry: Anata nisakakwa ta kuncia mukwa ki Tamapigik ka Sibavaw ki Farizeen apa: neni ra ta nikuma nenian, Kaumang ka asi kamu nimad tenian?

46.niv: “No one ever spoke the way this man does,” the guards replied.
46.cmn: 差役回答說：「從來沒有像他這樣說話的！」
46.sry: Nimatagivli ta kuncia, Mikakwa asi nimatagikumahina ki su ta kagulung, mama ki vual ka ana.

47.niv: “You mean he has deceived you also?” the Pharisees retorted.
47.cmn: 法利賽人說：「你們也受了迷惑嗎？
47.sry: Ra nimatagivli nenian ta Farizeen, Patawrahayen ato kamu kawa ta imumi?

48.niv: “Have any of the rulers or of the Pharisees believed in him?
48.cmn: 官長或是法利賽人豈有信他的呢？
48.sry: Nitnamising kawa tenian ta timamang ki Meysasu, timamang lava ka na Farizeen?

49.niv: No! But this mob that knows nothing of the law—there is a curse on them.”
49.cmn: 但這些不明白律法的百姓是被咒詛的！」
49.sry: Ra makuilalawlaw ka ata ka asi mavana ki Tatuko, pakuavavagen ato.

50.niv: Nicodemus, who had gone to Jesus earlier and who was one of their own number, asked,
50.cmn: 內中有尼哥德慕，就是從前去見耶穌的，對他們說：
50.sry: Nikuma ta ti Nikodemus nenian, teni ka niirua ato ka awvanan tenian, ka saat ta teni nenian,

51.niv: “Does our law condemn a man without first hearing him to find out what he has been doing?”
51.cmn: 「不先聽本人的口供，不知道他所做的事，難道我們的律法還定他的罪嗎？」
51.sry: Dmungdeng kawa ta Tatuko eta ki tau, ru asi apa nimilingig tenian, mumha mang ta na ringey tin?

52.niv: They replied, “Are you from Galilee, too? Look into it, and you will find that a prophet does not come out of Galilee.”
52.cmn: 他們回答說：「你也是出於加利利嗎？你且去查考，就可知道加利利沒有出過先知。」
52.sry: Nimatagivli ta neni kuma tenian, Maka Galilaya apa kaw kawa ta imhu? Makiriyanga kmiim ka kmita, ka asi nigapit ato ta timamang ki na Tamamatagitan ka maka Galilaya.

53.sry: Ka nisakakwa ta meybuvuavual sadadilug ki talag tin.

1.niv: but Jesus went to the Mount of Olives.
1.cmn: 於是各人都回家去了；耶穌卻往橄欖山去，
1.sry: Ra nidmarang ta ti Yesus muvukin [tu vukin] ka makavavua ki vua ka maimag.

2.niv: At dawn he appeared again in the temple courts, where all the people gathered around him, and he sat down to teach them.
2.cmn: 清早又回到殿裏。眾百姓都到他那裏去，他就坐下，教訓他們。
2.sry: Ka nisatakung du madama salikug ta teni tu Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, ka maimid ki tau ta niirua tenian, iru ka mirung ato nimatawtawug nenian.

3.niv: The teachers of the law and the Pharisees brought in a woman caught in adultery. They made her stand before the group
3.cmn: 文士和法利賽人帶着一個行淫時被拿的婦人來，叫她站在當中，
3.sry: Ka nimad paukwa tenian ta Makusasulat ki Farizeen apa saat ki ina ka niturung tu parburboen:

4.niv: and said to Jesus, “Teacher, this woman was caught in the act of adultery.
4.cmn: 就對耶穌說：「夫子，這婦人是正行淫之時被拿的。
4.sry: Iru ka nipaitutukaden nein ta teni, nikuma tenian, “Tamamatawtawug, Niturung tu ringey mamado ta ina ka ata ka parburbo ato.

5.niv: In the Law Moses commanded us to stone such women. Now what do you say?”
5.cmn: 摩西在律法上吩咐我們把這樣的婦人用石頭打死。你說該把她怎麼樣呢？」
5.sry: Ka nipakusuen kame ti Moses tu Tatuko, ka citaw ki na vato ta kumahina: Ra imhu mang kuma kaw?”

6.niv: They were using this question as a trap, in order to have a basis for accusing him. But Jesus bent down and started to write on the ground with his finger.
6.cmn: 他們說這話，乃試探耶穌，要得着告他的把柄。耶穌卻彎着腰，用指頭在地上畫字。
6.sry: Ka nipasusuen nein ta ata repung tenian, aley ka akumeya ki patagibarawaney nein tenian. Ra nimaawsusu ta ti Yesus smulat ki kagamus tu nay.

7.niv: When they kept on questioning him, he straightened up and said to them, “Let any one of you who is without sin be the first to throw a stone at her.”
7.cmn: 他們還是不住地問他，耶穌就直起腰來，對他們說：「你們中間誰是沒有罪的，誰就可以先拿石頭打她。」
7.sry: Iru ka itukwa apa ta neni tmalig tenian, nimaawtiktik ta teni kuma nenian, “Timamang imumian ta ausi ki varaw pisurua smit ki na vato tenian.”

8.niv: Again he stooped down and wrote on the ground.
8.cmn: 於是又彎着腰，用指頭在地上畫字。
8.sry: Ka mila nimaawsusu ta teni smulat tu nay.

9.niv: At this, those who heard began to go away one at a time, the older ones first, until only Jesus was left, with the woman still standing there.
9.cmn: 他們聽見這話，就從老到少，一個一個地都出去了，只剩下耶穌一人，還有那婦人仍然站在當中。
9.sry: Iru ra milingig ta neni [ki ata] ka ru nitununein ki vana nein ki rig, Nisamamala ta saat sadilug ki pani, sanaunamu ki na Mamumu salimulimu ki na raraway: ka nipaitusaat tin ta ti Yesus, ki ina apa ka ana ka itu tukad ato mituko.

10.niv: Jesus straightened up and asked her, “Woman, where are they? Has no one condemned you?”
10.cmn: 耶穌就直起腰來，對她說：「婦人，那些人在哪裏呢？沒有人定你的罪嗎？」
10.sry: Iru ka papaawtiktik ta ti Yesus tenian, ka ru asi kit’an ta saat ki vual dik ki ina, nikuma tenian, Ina, tumang ta neni ka aku varaw kuma imhuan? Asi nidmungdung ta timamang imhuan?

11.niv: “No one, sir,” she said. “Then neither do I condemn you,” Jesus declared. “Go now and leave your life of sin.”
11.cmn: 她說：「主啊，沒有。」耶穌說：「我也不定你的罪。去吧，從此不要再犯罪了！」 耶穌是世界的光
11.sry: Nikuma ta teni, Ausi Meyrang. Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Ti yaw apa ta asi dmungdung imhuan: ukwaaw, inang mila mavaraw.

12.niv: When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, “I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.”
12.cmn: 耶穌又對眾人說：「我是世界的光。跟從我的，就不在黑暗裏走，必要得着生命的光。」
12.sry: Anata nimatagila ta ti Yesus ki su nenian, kun, Ti yaw ta ramag ki nay: timamang ta maawug yawan asi munonanga tu karumduman, ra akumeya ki ramag ki kawagan.

13.niv: The Pharisees challenged him, “Here you are, appearing as your own witness; your testimony is not valid.”
13.cmn: 法利賽人對他說：「你是為自己作見證，你的見證不真。」
13.sry: Anata nikuma ta Farizeen tenian, Matagihail kaw mataginado imhuan: asi matiktik ta patagihailen oho.

14.niv: Jesus answered, “Even if I testify on my own behalf, my testimony is valid, for I know where I came from and where I am going. But you have no idea where I come from or where I am going.
14.cmn: 耶穌說：「我雖然為自己作見證，我的見證還是真的；因我知道我從哪裏來，往哪裏去；你們卻不知道我從哪裏來，往哪裏去。
14.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian, Meytaka patagihailen aw Mataginado yawan, ra matiktik ta patagihailen aw: ka kavanaen aw ka tumang ta nipakakwaan aw, tumang apa ta sakakwaey maw: ra asi mavana ta imumi ka tumang ta pakakwaan aw, tumang apa ta sakakwaan aw.

15.niv: You judge by human standards; I pass judgment on no one.
15.cmn: 你們是以外貌判斷人，我卻不判斷人。
15.sry: Imumi ta dmungdung maka ibavaat, ti yaw asi ko dmungdung timamang.

16.niv: But if I do judge, my decisions are true, because I am not alone. I stand with the Father, who sent me.
16.cmn: 就是判斷人，我的判斷也是真的；因為不是我獨自在這裏，還有差我來的父與我同在。
16.sry: Hairu ka dmungdung apa ti yaw, matiktik ta dungdungan aw: ka asi ko itusaat, ra ti yaw, ki Rama apa ka nimadingi yawan.

17.niv: In your own Law it is written that the testimony of two witnesses is true.
17.cmn: 你們的律法上也記着說：『兩個人的見證是真的。』
17.sry: Ka nisulaten apa tu Tatuko umi, ka mashut ta patagihailan ki su ki raruha ki vual.

18.niv: I am one who testifies for myself; my other witness is the Father, who sent me.”
18.cmn: 我是為自己作見證，還有差我來的父也是為我作見證。」
18.sry: Ti yaw ta matagihail mataginado yawan, ka matagihail apa yawan ta Rama ka nimadingi yawan.

19.niv: Then they asked him, “Where is your father?” “You do not know me or my Father,” Jesus replied. “If you knew me, you would know my Father also.”
19.cmn: 他們就問他說：「你的父在哪裏？」耶穌回答說：「你們不認識我，也不認識我的父；若是認識我，也就認識我的父。」
19.sry: Anata nikuma ta neni tenian, tumang ta Raraman oho? Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, “Asi kamu kmalang yawan, ki Raraman apa: Hairu ka kmalang kamu yawan, ina kamu kmalang apa ki Raraman aw.”

20.niv: He spoke these words while teaching in the temple courts near the place where the offerings were put. Yet no one seized him, because his hour had not yet come.
20.cmn: 這些話是耶穌在殿裏的庫房、教訓人時所說的，也沒有人拿他，因為他的時候還沒有到。 我所去的地方你們不能到
20.sry: Nimasusu ta ti Yesus ki su ka ata tu hili ki vatolang ka ata hahaan ki vangey, ka matawtawug ta teni tu Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid: ka asi nitmurung tenian ta timamang Aley ka asi apa irua ato ta kidi ki tagley tin.

21.niv: Once more Jesus said to them, “I am going away, and you will look for me, and you will die in your sin. Where I go, you cannot come.”
21.cmn: 耶穌又對他們說：「我要去了，你們要找我，並且你們要死在罪中。我所去的地方，你們不能到。」
21.sry: Anata nimatagila ta ti Yesus ki su nenian, Dmarang ato ko ti yaw, ka kmiima kamu yawan, ka mapatayakamu tu varaw umi: ka tumang ta sakakwaey maw, asi kamu malpug irua.

22.niv: This made the Jews ask, “Will he kill himself? Is that why he says, ‘Where I go, you cannot come’?”
22.cmn: 猶太人說：「他說『我所去的地方，你們不能到』，難道他要自盡嗎？」
22.sry: Anata nikuma ta Yoden, Papismadoa kawa pakapatay tenian? Aley ka kun tin, Tumang ta sakakwaey maw, asi kamu hmalpug irua.

23.niv: But he continued, “You are from below; I am from above. You are of this world; I am not of this world.
23.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「你們是從下頭來的，我是從上頭來的；你們是屬這世界的，我不是屬這世界的。
23.sry: Ka nikuma teni nenian, Maka rarim kamu ta imumi, maka vavaw ko ti yaw: maka nay kamu ta imumi, ti yaw asi ko maka nay ka ata.

24.niv: I told you that you would die in your sins; if you do not believe that I am he, you will indeed die in your sins.”
24.cmn: 所以我對你們說，你們要死在罪中。你們若不信我是基督，必要死在罪中。」
24.sry: Aley ki ana nipasusuen aw kamu, ka mapatayakamu tu varaw umi. Hairu asi kamu tnamising ka ti yaw ka ata, mapatayakamu tu varaw umi.

25.niv: “Who are you?” they asked. “Just what I have been telling you from the beginning,” Jesus replied.
25.cmn: 他們就問他說：「你是誰？」耶穌對他們說：「就是我從起初所告訴你們的。
25.sry: Anata nikuma ta neni tenian, Imhu timang kaw? Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, [Teni] ka na patagina naunamu aw imumian.

26.niv: “I have much to say in judgment of you. But he who sent me is trustworthy, and what I have heard from him I tell the world.”
26.cmn: 我有許多事講論你們，判斷你們；但那差我來的是真的，我在他那裏所聽見的，我就傳給世人。」
26.sry: Madag apa ta ina maw pasusuaney aley imumian dmungdung: ra matiktik ta teni ki su ka nimadingi yawan: ka kamamang ka niilingigaw tenian, ata ta pasusuen aw ki nay.

27.niv: They did not understand that he was telling them about his Father.
27.cmn: 他們不明白耶穌是指着父說的。
27.sry: Asi hinin umhaen ka pasusuen tin ki Rama nenian.

28.niv: So Jesus said, “When you have lifted up the Son of Man, then you will know that I am he and that I do nothing on my own but speak just what the Father has taught me.
28.cmn: 所以耶穌說：「你們舉起人子以後，必知道我是基督，並且知道我沒有一件事是憑着自己做的。我說這些話乃是照着父所教訓我的。
28.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, “Iru ka puvavawa lato kamu ki Alak ki kagulung, anata umhaey mumi ka ti yaw ka ata, ka asi ko sikunung pamut ki mamang, ra pasusuen aw ta ata mama ki nipatagitawugan yawan ki Raraman aw.

29.niv: The one who sent me is with me; he has not left me alone, for I always do what pleases him.”
29.cmn: 那差我來的是與我同在；他沒有撇下我獨自在這裏，因為我常做他所喜悅的事。」
29.sry: Ka teni ka madingi yawan ta itulam yawan, asi ko nipaitusaaten ki Rama, aley ka pamuten aw mikakwa ta mamang ka kamawen tin.”

30.niv: Even as he spoke, many believed in him.
30.cmn: 耶穌說這話的時候，就有許多人信他。 真理必使你們得自由
30.sry: Iru ka masusu ta teni ki mamang ka ata , mabatung ta nitnamising tenian.

31.niv: To the Jews who had believed him, Jesus said, “If you hold to my teaching, you are really my disciples.
31.cmn: 耶穌對信他的猶太人說：「你們若常常遵守我的道，就真是我的門徒；
31.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus ki Yoden ka tnamising tenian, “Hairu mayali kamu ki su aw, dilig kamu ki patatawutawugan aw.

32.niv: Then you will know the truth, and the truth will set you free.”
32.cmn: 你們必曉得真理，真理必叫你們得以自由。」
32.sry: Ka mumhaa kamu ki katiktikan ki su , ka pasikunungey kamu ki katiktikan ki su. ”

33.niv: They answered him, “We are Abrahamʼs descendants and have never been slaves of anyone. How can you say that we shall be set free?”
33.cmn: 他們回答說：「我們是亞伯拉罕的後裔，從來沒有作過誰的奴僕。你怎麼說『你們必得以自由』呢？」
33.sry: Nimatagivli ta neni tenian, Nagaap kame ti Abraham, ka mikakwa asi kame nipukunciaan timamang: matagimama kaw ki mang, Pasikunungey kamu?

34.niv: Jesus replied, “Very truly I tell you, everyone who sins is a slave to sin.
34.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，所有犯罪的就是罪的奴僕。
34.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus nenian, Mising, mising kun aw kamu ra, Veyag ka pamut ki varaw kuncia ta teni ki varaw.

35.niv: Now a slave has no permanent place in the family, but a son belongs to it forever.
35.cmn: 奴僕不能永遠住在家裏；兒子是永遠住在家裏。
35.sry: Ka asi mayali iturinug tu talag ta kuncia: ra mayali apa iturinug ta Alak.

36.niv: So if the Son sets you free, you will be free indeed.
36.cmn: 所以天父的兒子若叫你們自由，你們就真自由了。
36.sry: Hairu ka pasikunungey lato kamu ki Alak, pasidiligey lato kamu pasikunung.

37.niv: I know that you are Abrahamʼs descendants. Yet you are looking for a way to kill me, because you have no room for my word.
37.cmn: 我知道你們是亞伯拉罕的子孫，你們卻想要殺我，因為你們心裏容不下我的道。
37.sry: Kavanaen aw ka na gaap kamu ti Abraham kamu ki pakapatayaney yawan, aley ka ausi ki itukwaan imumian ta su aw.

38.niv: I am telling you what I have seen in the Fatherʼs presence, and you are doing what you have heard from your father. ”
38.cmn: 我所說的是在我父那裏看見的；你們所行的是在你們的父那裏聽見的。」 你們的父是魔鬼
38.sry: Masusu ko ki nikitaen aw ki Raraman aw: imumi apa ta pamut ki nikitaen umi ki raraman umi.

39.niv: “Abraham is our father,” they answered. “If you were Abrahamʼs children,” said Jesus, “then you would do what Abraham did.
39.cmn: 他們說：「我們的父就是亞伯拉罕。」耶穌說：「你們若是亞伯拉罕的兒子，就必行亞伯拉罕所行的事。
39.sry: Nimatagivli ta neni kuma tenian, Ti Abraham ta na ramu yan. Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Hairu na Alalak kamu ti Abraham, ina kamu akwa [pamut] ki na ringey ti Abraham.

40.niv: As it is, you are looking for a way to kill me, a man who has told you the truth that I heard from God. Abraham did not do such things.
40.cmn: 我將在上帝那裏所聽見的真理告訴了你們，現在你們卻想要殺我，這不是亞伯拉罕所行的事。
40.sry: Hinin da kmiim kamu ki pakapatayey yawan, ka vual ka nimasusu imumian ki katiktikan ki su, ka niilingigen aw ki Alid. Asi nipamut ki ata ta ti Abraham.

41.niv: You are doing the works of your own father.” “We are not illegitimate children,” they protested. “The only Father we have is God himself.”
41.cmn: 你們是行你們父所行的事。」他們說：「我們不是從淫亂生的；我們只有一位父，就是上帝。」
41.sry: Imumi ra ta pamut ki na ringey ki raraman umi. Anata nikuma ta neni tenian; Asi kame nipeyalaken tu kaveyungan: akumeya kame saasat ki Rama ka Alid.

42.niv: Jesus said to them, “If God were your Father, you would love me, for I have come here from God. I have not come on my own; God sent me.
42.cmn: 耶穌說：「倘若上帝是你們的父，你們就必愛我；因為我本是出於上帝，也是從上帝而來，並不是由着自己來，乃是他差我來。
42.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Hairu Raraman umi ta Alid, ina kamu kavagango yawan: ka nipakarboen maw ki Alid mupanag. Ka asi ko sikunung ato irua, ra teni ta nimadingi yawan.

43.niv: Why is my language not clear to you? Because you are unable to hear what I say.
43.cmn: 你們為甚麼不明白我的話呢？無非是因你們不能聽我的道。
43.sry: Kaumang ka asi kamu kmalang ki ingaw aw? Aley [ato] ka asi kamu tnalpug milingig ki su aw.

44.niv: You belong to your father, the devil, and you want to carry out your fatherʼs desires. He was a murderer from the beginning, not holding to the truth, for there is no truth in him. When he lies, he speaks his native language, for he is a liar and the father of lies.
44.cmn: 你們是出於你們的父魔鬼，你們父的私慾你們偏要行。他從起初是殺人的，不守真理，因他心裏沒有真理。他說謊是出於自己；因他本來是說謊的，也是說謊之人的父。
44.sry: Imumi ra, nimakakwa ki rama ki Litu, ka mamuy kamu pamut ki kamuyen ki raraman umi. Na tamalpug ki kagulung maka naunamu ta teni, ka asi niitukakwa tu katiktikan ki su: aley ka ausi tenian ki katiktikan ki su. Iru matagiharang ta teni, masusu ki tagikwa tenian: aley ka tamasihaharang ta teni, ki rama apa ki [sihaharangen] ka ana.

45.niv: Yet because I tell the truth, you do not believe me!
45.cmn: 我將真理告訴你們，你們就因此不信我。
45.sry: Ra ti yaw, aley ka pasuen aw ta katiktikan ki su, asi mumi tnamisingen.

46.niv: Can any of you prove me guilty of sin? If I am telling the truth, why donʼt you believe me?
46.cmn: 你們中間誰能指證我有罪呢？我既然將真理告訴你們，為甚麼不信我呢？
46.sry: Timang imumian ta tmunub yawan ki varaw? Hairu ka Pasusuen aw ta katiktikan ki su, kaumang ka asi kamu tnamising yawan?

47.niv: Whoever belongs to God hears what God says. The reason you do not hear is that you do not belong to God.”
47.cmn: 出於上帝的，必聽上帝的話；你們不聽，因為你們不是出於上帝。」 還沒有亞伯拉罕就有了我
47.sry: Timamang ta makakwa ki Alid, milingig ki na su ki Alid: aley ki ana asi mumi ilingigen, aley ka asi kamu makakwa ato ki Alid.

48.niv: The Jews answered him, “Arenʼt we right in saying that you are a Samaritan and demon-possessed?”
48.cmn: 猶太人回答說：「我們說你是撒馬利亞人，並且是鬼附着的，這話豈不正對嗎？」
48.sry: Anata nimatagivli ta Yoden kuma tenian, Asi kame kawa mariyang ki su ka Samaritan kaw ka aku Litu kaw?

49.niv: “I am not possessed by a demon,” said Jesus, “but I honor my Father and you dishonor me.
49.cmn: 耶穌說：「我不是鬼附着的；我尊敬我的父，你們倒輕慢我。
49.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, Ausi ki Litu yawan, ra lmulug ko ki Raraman aw, imumi ta mupag ki lulugan [murung] yawan.

50.niv: I am not seeking glory for myself; but there is one who seeks it, and he is the judge.
50.cmn: 我不求自己的榮耀，有一位為我求榮耀、定是非的。
50.sry: Ra asi ko kmiim ki lulugan yawan: akumeya ki kmiim ka dmungdunga.

51.niv: Very truly I tell you, whoever obeys my word will never see death.”
51.cmn: 我實實在在地告訴你們，人若遵守我的道，就永遠不見死。」
51.sry: Mising, mising kun aw kamu, Hairu hmaa lato ta timamang ki su aw, asi kmita ki kapatayan tu ikakwan midarinug.

52.niv: At this they exclaimed, “Now we know that you are demon-possessed! Abraham died and so did the prophets, yet you say that whoever obeys your word will never taste death.
52.cmn: 猶太人對他說：「現在我們知道你是鬼附着的。亞伯拉罕死了，眾先知也死了，你還說：『人若遵守我的道，就永遠不嘗死味。』
52.sry: Anata nikuma ta Yoden tenian, hinin kavanaen yan ka aku Litu kaw. Nimapatay ta ti Abraham, ki na TamaMatagitan apa: ka matagikumaa kawa hina ki su, Hairu hmaa lato ta timamang ki su aw, asi kdimana ki kapatayan tu ikakwan midarinug?

53.niv: Are you greater than our father Abraham? He died, and so did the prophets. Who do you think you are?”
53.cmn: 難道你比我們的祖宗亞伯拉罕還大嗎？他死了，眾先知也死了，你將自己當作甚麼人呢？」
53.sry: Siuro kaw kawa tu vavaw ki kidi ki na Ramu yan ka ti Abraham ka nimapatay ato? ka nimapatay apa ta na Matagitan: pakwaen hu timangan pamadu imhuan?

54.niv: Jesus replied, “If I glorify myself, my glory means nothing. My Father, whom you claim as your God, is the one who glorifies me.
54.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「我若榮耀自己，我的榮耀就算不得甚麼；榮耀我的乃是我的父，就是你們所說是你們的上帝。
54.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, Hairu pumado ko puvavaw ki kidi yawan, sawkinanino ta kairangan ki kidi aw: ra ti Ama apa maw ta puvavaw ki kidi yawan, teni ka Alid yan kun umi.

55.niv: Though you do not know him, I know him. If I said I did not, I would be a liar like you, but I do know him and obey his word.
55.cmn: 你們未曾認識他；我卻認識他。我若說不認識他，我就是說謊的，像你們一樣；但我認識他，也遵守他的道。
55.sry: Ka asi kamu kmalang tenian, ra kalangen aw ta teni: hairu kuma ko, asi maw kalangen ta teni, mama lato ko imumian ka tamasihaharang: ra kalangen aw ta teni, ka hma ko ki su tin.

56.niv: Your father Abraham rejoiced at the thought of seeing my day; he saw it and was glad.”
56.cmn: 你們的祖宗亞伯拉罕歡歡喜喜地仰望我的日子，既看見了就快樂。」
56.sry: Ti Abraham ka na ramamuan umi nim apangaw ki tatbatban ki muy ka kitaey tin ta wagi aw: ka nikitaan tin [ta ata,] ka nimaray ato ra

57.niv: “You are not yet fifty years old,” they said to him, “and you have seen Abraham!”
57.cmn: 猶太人說：「你還沒有五十歲，豈見過亞伯拉罕呢？」
57.sry: Anata nikuma ta Yoden tenian, Ausi apa kaw ki rima kitian ki tawil, ka nikitaen hu kawa ta ti Abraham?

58.niv: “Very truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “before Abraham was born, I am!”
58.cmn: 耶穌說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，還沒有亞伯拉罕就有了我。」
58.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, missing, missing kun aw kamu ra, Siuro ka akumeya ta ti Abraham, akumeya ko ti yaw.

59.niv: At this, they picked up stones to stone him, but Jesus hid himself, slipping away from the temple grounds.
59.cmn: 於是他們拿石頭要打他；耶穌卻躲藏，從殿裏出去了。
59.sry: Anata niara nein ta vato ki citaney tenian. Ra nisuivung ta ti Yesus samamala tu Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, ka nitumukad nenian, maliawrag kumahina.

1.niv: As he went along, he saw a man blind from birth.
1.cmn: 耶穌過去的時候，看見一個人生來是瞎眼的。
1.sry: Ru ka maliawrag, nikmita ki saat ki vual ka mavuta ki na tanay tu peyrawayen.

2.niv: His disciples asked him, “Rabbi, who sinned, this man or his parents, that he was born blind?”
2.cmn: 門徒問耶穌說：「拉比，這人生來是瞎眼的，是誰犯了罪？是這人呢？是他父母呢？」
2.sry: Ka nitmalig tenian ta patatawutawugan tin, Rabi, timang ta puvaraw, ti ata kawa, ki tagialak kawa tenian, ka nipeyvutaan meyalak ta teni? Kuma.

3.niv: “Neither this man nor his parents sinned,” said Jesus, “but this happened so that the works of God might be displayed in him.
3.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「也不是這人犯了罪，也不是他父母犯了罪，是要在他身上顯出上帝的作為來。
3.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, asi nipuvaraw ta ti ata, asi ki tagialak tenian: ra [nipamuten ato ta ata] ka pakaamagaw pakakwa tenian ta peyringeyey ki Alid

4.niv: As long as it is day, we must do the works of him who sent me. Night is coming, when no one can work.
4.cmn: 趁着白日，我們必須做那差我來者的工；黑夜將到，就沒有人能做工了。
4.sry: Kidi ato ka kapengasaw maw ta ringey tin ka nimadingi yawan, ru akumeya apa ta wagi: iruaa ta awvan, ka asi malpuga mapungas ta timamang.

5.niv: While I am in the world, I am the light of the world.”
5.cmn: 我在世上的時候，是世上的光。」
5.sry: Ru ayakwa apa ko tu nay, ramag ko ki nay.

6.niv: After saying this, he spit on the ground, made some mud with the saliva, and put it on the manʼs eyes.
6.cmn: 耶穌說了這話，就吐唾沫在地上，用唾沫和泥抹在瞎子的眼睛上，
6.sry: Iru ka nimatagikaha ki ata, nipangareyen tin tu nay, silutalutak ki na ngarey, ka nihmaik ki lutak ka ana tu mata ki mavuta.

7.niv: “Go,” he told him, “wash in the Pool of Siloam” (this word means “Sent”). So the man went and washed, and came home seeing.
7.cmn: 對他說：「你往西羅亞池子裏去洗。」（西羅亞翻出來就是「奉差遣」。） 他去一洗，回頭就看見了。
7.sry: Ka nikun tin tenian, ukukwa madiupa [imhuan] tu Ayawugan ki Siluam (ka patagi tununein ki su, nipadingien.) Ka niukwaen tin madiup [tenian,] ka irua ato ka kmita ato.

8.niv: His neighbors and those who had formerly seen him begging asked, “Isnʼt this the same man who used to sit and beg?”
8.cmn: 他的鄰舍和那素常見他是討飯的，就說：「這不是那從前坐着討飯的人嗎？」
8.sry: Anata kahalahalawan, neni apa ka nikmita tenian kalahay ka mavuta apa, kuma, asi kawa teni ta nimiraung ka ana tmumimia ki atagey ki harum?

9.niv: Some claimed that he was. Others said, “No, he only looks like him.” But he himself insisted, “I am the man.”
9.cmn: 有人說：「是他」；又有人說：「不是，卻是像他。」他自己說：「是我。」
9.sry: Nikuma ta raruma, teni ka ana: raruma apa, “mahaway tenian”, nikuma ta teni, “ti yaw ka ata.”

10.niv: “How then were your eyes opened?” they asked.
10.cmn: 他們對他說：「你的眼睛是怎麼開的呢？」
10.sry: Anata nikuma ta neni tenian, niparukilaten kaw mama ki mang ki mata?

11.niv: He replied, “The man they call Jesus made some mud and put it on my eyes. He told me to go to Siloam and wash. So I went and washed, and then I could see.”
11.cmn: 他回答說：「有一個人，名叫耶穌，他和泥抹我的眼睛，對我說：『你往西羅亞池子去洗。』我去一洗，就看見了。」
11.sry: Nimatagivli ta teni kuma, Vual ka ana ka pananangen Yesus ta nisilutalutak ki na ngarey hmaik ki mata aw, ka kun tin yawan, ‘ukwaa tu ayawugan ki Siluam, madiup imhuan. Ka nimukwa ko madiup yawan, ka kmita ato ko.

12.niv: “Where is this man?” they asked him. “I donʼt know,” he said.
12.cmn: 他們說：「那個人在哪裏？」他說：「我不知道。」 法利賽人盤問醫治的事
12.sry: Anata nikuma ta neni tenian, tumang ta teni ka ana? Nikuma [ta teni,] asi maw umhaen ato.

13.niv: They brought to the Pharisees the man who had been blind.
13.cmn: 他們把從前瞎眼的人帶到法利賽人那裏。
13.sry: Ka niaden nein paukwa tenian ki Farizeen, tenian ka ana ka nimavuta kalahay.

14.niv: Now the day on which Jesus had made the mud and opened the manʼs eyes was a Sabbath.
14.cmn: 耶穌和泥開他眼睛的日子是安息日。
14.sry: Ka na wagi ato ki pahihababan, ru nisilutalutak ta ti Yesus ki na ngarey parukilat ki mata tin.

15.niv: Therefore the Pharisees also asked him how he had received his sight. “He put mud on my eyes,” the man replied, “and I washed, and now I see.”
15.cmn: 法利賽人也問他是怎麼得看見的。瞎子對他們說：「他把泥抹在我的眼睛上，我去一洗，就看見了。」
15.sry: Anata nitmawkala apa tmalig tenian ta Farizeen, mama ki mang ka kitaan ato tin? Nikuma ta teni nenian, “Nihaiken tin ta lutak tu mata aw, ka nimadiup ko yawan, ka kmita ato ko.”

16.niv: Some of the Pharisees said, “This man is not from God, for he does not keep the Sabbath.” But others asked, “How can a sinner perform such signs?” So they were divided.
16.cmn: 法利賽人中有的說：「這個人不是從上帝來的，因為他不守安息日。」又有人說：「一個罪人怎能行這樣的神蹟呢？」他們就起了紛爭。
16.sry: Anata nikuma ta raruma ki Farizeen, Asi nimakakwa ki Alid ta vual ka ana: aley ka asi tin iligen ta wagi ki Pahihababan. Nikuma ta raruma, palpug mama ki mang ta tau ka tamakavaraw pamut ki pukidien ka kumahina? Ka mamawruha ato ta su nein.

17.niv: Then they turned again to the blind man, “What have you to say about him? It was your eyes he opened.” The man replied, “He is a prophet.”
17.cmn: 他們又對瞎子說：「他既然開了你的眼睛，你說他是怎樣的人呢？」他說：「是個先知。」
17.sry: Nimatagila ta neni ki nimavuta, imhu, matagimang kaw aley tenian, ka niparukilaten tin ta mata oho? Nikuma ta teni, Tamamatagitan ta ti ana.

18.niv: They still did not believe that he had been blind and had received his sight until they sent for the manʼs parents.
18.cmn: 猶太人不信他從前是瞎眼，後來能看見的，等到叫了他的父母來，
18.sry: Anata asi nitnamising ta Yoden tenian, ka nimavuta ta teni kalahay, ka kmita ato hinin, tu kidi apa ka ana ki nitataamen nein ta tagialak tenian, ka kmita ato.

19.niv: “Is this your son?” they asked. “Is this the one you say was born blind? How is it that now he can see?”
19.cmn: 問他們說：「這是你們的兒子嗎？你們說他生來是瞎眼的，如今怎麼能看見了呢？」
19.sry: Ka nitmalig ta neni kuma nenian, alak umi kawa ta ti ata ka nipaivutaan meyalak kun umi? Mama ki mang ka kmita ato hinin?

20.niv: “We know he is our son,” the parents answered, “and we know he was born blind.
20.cmn: 他父母回答說：「他是我們的兒子，生來就瞎眼，這是我們知道的。
20.sry: Nimatagivli ta tagialalak tenian [tin], kuma nenian, kavanaen yan ka alak yan ta ti ata, ka nipaivutaan apa meyalak:

21.niv: But how he can see now, or who opened his eyes, we donʼt know. Ask him. He is of age; he will speak for himself.”
21.cmn: 至於他如今怎麼能看見，我們卻不知道；是誰開了他的眼睛，我們也不知道。他已經成了人，你們問他吧，他自己必能說。」
21.sry: Ra mama ki mang ka kmita ato hinin, asi yan kavanaan: timang lava ta niparukilat ki mata tin, asi yan umhaen: kawkaha ato ta teni kawumha, tmawki madoa tmalig tenian: sikununga ta teni pupanag ki su.

22.niv: His parents said this because they were afraid of the Jewish leaders, who already had decided that anyone who acknowledged that Jesus was the Messiah would be put out of the synagogue.
22.cmn: 他父母說這話，是怕猶太人；因為猶太人已經商議定了，若有認耶穌是基督的，要把他趕出會堂。
22.sry: Nimatagikumahina ta tagialak tenian, aley ki ka atakuten nein ki Yoden. Nda nimatagikaha matagisal matagipuk ki su ta Yoden, hairu ka matagiamaga lato ta timamang ka ti Kristus ta ti ana, ka padarangey ta teni tu Pakuisalan.

23.niv: That was why his parents said, “He is of age; ask him.”
23.cmn: 因此他父母說：「他已經成了人，你們問他吧。」
23.sry: Aley ki ana nikuma ta tagialak tenian, Kawkaha ato ta teni kawumha, tmawki madoa tenian tmalig.

24.niv: A second time they summoned the man who had been blind. “Give glory to God by telling the truth,” they said. “We know this man is a sinner.”
24.cmn: 所以法利賽人第二次叫了那從前瞎眼的人來，對他說：「你該將榮耀歸給上帝，我們知道這人是個罪人。」
24.sry: Anata nimakukararuha ta neni tmataam ki vual ka ana ka nimavuta kalahay, ka kuma tenian, Pigaey ato ki Alid ta lulugan: kavanaen yan ka tamakavaraw ta vual ka ana.

25.niv: He replied, “Whether he is a sinner or not, I donʼt know. One thing I do know. I was blind but now I see!”
25.cmn: 他說：「他是個罪人不是，我不知道；有一件事我知道，從前我是眼瞎的，如今能看見了。」
25.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta teni kuma, Malava ka tamakavaraw ta teni asi maw kavan’en: saasat ta kavanaen aw, ka na mavuta ko kalahay, ka kmita ato ko hinin.

26.niv: Then they asked him, “What did he do to you? How did he open your eyes?”
26.cmn: 他們就問他說：「他向你做甚麼？是怎麼開了你的眼睛呢？」
26.sry: Ka nimatagila ta neni tenian, niumamang ta teni imhuan? niparukilaten tin mama ki mang ta mata oho?

27.niv: He answered, “I have told you already and you did not listen. Why do you want to hear it again? Do you want to become his disciples too?”
27.cmn: 他回答說：「我方才告訴你們，你們不聽，為甚麼又要聽呢？莫非你們也要作他的門徒嗎？」
27.sry: Nimatagivli ta teni, Patagi kahan ato maw kamu masusu, ka asi kamu nimilingig: mang ta kamuyen umi tnalala milingig? Mamuy kamu kawa kawraraway ka patatawtawugey tin ta imumi apa?

28.niv: Then they hurled insults at him and said, “You are this fellowʼs disciple! We are disciples of Moses!
28.cmn: 他們就罵他說：「你是他的門徒；我們是摩西的門徒。
28.sry: Anata nimatagisamuk ta neni ki su tenian, kuma, imhu ta patatawutawugan tin: ra imian ta na patatawutawugan ti Moses.

29.niv: We know that God spoke to Moses, but as for this fellow, we donʼt even know where he comes from.”
29.cmn: 上帝對摩西說話是我們知道的；只是這個人，我們不知道他從哪裏來！」
29.sry: Kavanaen yan ka nipasusuen ki Alid ti Mosesan: ta ti ata asi yan kavanaan tumang ka nipakakwan tin.

30.niv: The man answered, “Now that is remarkable! You donʼt know where he comes from, yet he opened my eyes.
30.cmn: 那人回答說：「他開了我的眼睛，你們竟不知道他從哪裏來，這真是奇怪！
30.sry: Nimatagivli ta vual ka ana kuma nenian, Ata ta uringawen, ka asi mumi kavanaan ka tumang ta nipakakwan tin, iru apa ka ana ka niparukilat tin ta mata aw.

31.niv: We know that God does not listen to sinners. He listens to the godly person who does his will.
31.cmn: 我們知道上帝不聽罪人，惟有敬奉上帝、遵行他旨意的，上帝才聽他。
31.sry: Ka kavanaan eta ka asi snavaley ta Alid ki tamakavaraw: ra timamang ta tamatamud ki Alid, akwa apa ki kamuyen tin, teni ta tnavaleyen tin.

32.niv: Nobody has ever heard of opening the eyes of a man born blind.
32.cmn: 從創世以來，未曾聽見有人把生來是瞎子的眼睛開了。
32.sry: Tu [imid ki] idarinugan asi niilingigen, ka niparkilat ta timamang ki mata ki nipeyvutaen meyalak.

33.niv: If this man were not from God, he could do nothing.”
33.cmn: 這人若不是從上帝來的，甚麼也不能做。」
33.sry: Hairu asi nimakakwa ki Alid ta ti ana, asi peylpuga pamut ki mamang.

34.niv: To this they replied, “You were steeped in sin at birth; how dare you lecture us!” And they threw him out.
34.cmn: 他們回答說：「你全然生在罪孽中，還要教訓我們嗎？」於是把他趕出去了。 靈性的盲目
34.sry: Nimatagivli ta neni kuma tenian, Nipeytumuk kaw meyalak tu varaw ta imhu, ka matawtawug kaw imianan? Ka nipadarang ta neni paumala tenian.

35.niv: Jesus heard that they had thrown him out, and when he found him, he said, “Do you believe in the Son of Man?”
35.cmn: 耶穌聽說他們把他趕出去，後來遇見他，就說：「你信上帝的兒子嗎？」
35.sry: Nimilingig ta ti Yesus ka nipadarang nein paumala tenian, iru ka kabaleyen tin ta teni nikuma tenian, tnamising kaw kawa ki Alak ki Alid?

36.niv: “Who is he, sir?” the man asked. “Tell me so that I may believe in him.”
36.cmn: 他回答說：「主啊，誰是上帝的兒子，叫我信他呢？」
36.sry: Nimatagivli ta teni kuma, timang ta teni, Meyrang, aley ka tnamisingaw maw tenian?

37.niv: Jesus said, “You have now seen him; in fact, he is the one speaking with you.”
37.cmn: 耶穌說：「你已經看見他，現在和你說話的就是他。」
37.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, ka nikitaen hu ta teni, ka teni ka matavag imhuan, teni ta ti ata.

38.niv: Then the man said, “Lord, I believe,” and he worshiped him.
38.cmn: 他說：「主啊，我信！」就拜耶穌。
38.sry: Nikuma ta teni, tnamising ko, Meyrang: ka nireip ta teni tenian.

39.niv: Jesus said, “For judgment I have come into this world, so that the blind will see and those who see will become blind.”
39.cmn: 耶穌說：「我為審判到這世上來，叫不能看見的，可以看見；能看見的，反瞎了眼。」
39.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus, irua ato ko tu nay ka ata aley ki dungdungan, ka kmitaa ta neni ka asi apa kmita, ka mavutaa lato ta neni ka kmita.

40.niv: Some Pharisees who were with him heard him say this and asked, “What? Are we blind too?”
40.cmn: 同他在那裏的法利賽人聽見這話，就說：「難道我們也瞎了眼嗎？」
40.sry: Nimilingig ki ata ta [raruma ki] Farizeen, ka ayakwa tenian, ka nikuma ta neni tenian, Mavuta apa kame kawa ta imian?

41.niv: Jesus said, “If you were blind, you would not be guilty of sin; but now that you claim you can see, your guilt remains.
41.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「你們若瞎了眼，就沒有罪了；但如今你們說『我們能看見』，所以你們的罪還在。」
41.sry: Nikma ta ti Yesus nenian, Hairu mavuta kamu, ina kamu ausi ki varaw: ra hinin kmita kame kun umi: aley ki ana mayali ta varaw umi.

1.niv: “Very truly I tell you Pharisees, anyone who does not enter the sheep pen by the gate, but climbs in by some other way, is a thief and a robber.
1.cmn: 「我實實在在地告訴你們，人進羊圈，不從門進去，倒從別處爬進去，那人就是賊，就是強盜。
1.sry: Mising, mising kun aw kamu, timamang ta asi tawkwa tu ngataf sararbo tu arag ki yuko ra mak dahey mak daken tu pani, tamahauzung ta teni ki tamariug apa.

2.niv: The one who enters by the gate is the shepherd of the sheep.
2.cmn: 從門進去的，才是羊的牧人。
2.sry: Ra timamang ta sararbo tu ngataf tamakading ta teni ki yuko.

3.niv: The gatekeeper opens the gate for him, and the sheep listen to his voice. He calls his own sheep by name and leads them out.
3.cmn: 看門的就給他開門；羊也聽他的聲音。他按着名叫自己的羊，把羊領出來。
3.sry: Teni ta aawlufen ki suayam ki ngataf, ka milingig ta yuko ki ingaw tin: ka pakuvua vualen tin ki nanang tmataam ta yuko tin, tu dilugey nenian.

4.niv: When he has brought out all his own, he goes on ahead of them, and his sheep follow him because they know his voice.
4.cmn: 既放出自己的羊來，就在前頭走，羊也跟着他，因為認得他的聲音。
4.sry: Iru ka nipumalaen tin ta yuko tin, mudadarang siuru nenian, ka maawawug tenian ta yuko, aley ka kalangen nein ta ingaw tin.

5.niv: But they will never follow a stranger; in fact, they will run away from him because they do not recognize a strangerʼs voice.”
5.cmn: 羊不跟着生人；因為不認得他的聲音， 必要逃跑。」
5.sry: Asi maawuga ta neni maravey ki pani, ra ilputa lapa tenian: aley ka asi nein kalangen ta ingaw ki pani.

6.niv: Jesus used this figure of speech, but the Pharisees did not understand what he was telling them.
6.cmn: 耶穌將這比喻告訴他們，但他們不明白所說的是甚麼意思。 好牧人耶穌
6.sry: Pamikawlawlan ka ata nipasusuen ti Yesus nenian: ra asi nein umhaen, mang ta na su tin nenian.

7.niv: Therefore Jesus said again, “Very truly I tell you, I am the gate for the sheep.
7.cmn: 所以，耶穌又對他們說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，我就是羊的門。
7.sry: Anata nimatagila ta ti Yesus nenian, Missing, missing kun aw kamu ra ti yaw ta ngataf ki yuko.

8.niv: All who have come before me are thieves and robbers, but the sheep have not listened to them.
8.cmn: 凡在我以先來的都是賊，是強盜；羊卻不聽他們。
8.sry: Maimid ta na mamang ka nisiuru irua yawan, tamahauzung ta neni ki tamaarug apa, ra asi nimilingig ta yuko nenian.

9.niv: I am the gate; whoever enters through me will be saved. They will come in and go out, and find pasture.
9.cmn: 我就是門；凡從我進來的，必然得救，並且出入得草吃。
9.sry: Ti yaw ta ngataf: hairu timamang ta tawkwa yawan sararbo, kadingaw lato ta teni pakariyang: ka sararboa samamala, ka makivaleya ki aalufan.

10.niv: The thief comes only to steal and kill and destroy; I have come that they may have life, and have it to the full.
10.cmn: 盜賊來，無非要偷竊，殺害，毀壞；我來了，是要叫羊得生命，並且得的更豐盛。
10.sry: Asi mukwa ta tamahauzung dik ka hauzungey tin, lpug, pidada: irua ato ko ti yaw, aley ka akumeyaa ta neni ki kawagan, ki kahuvaran apa.

11.niv: “I am the good shepherd. The good shepherd lays down his life for the sheep.
11.cmn: 我是好牧人；好牧人為羊捨命。
11.sry: Ti yaw ta Tamakading ka mariyang: Tamakading ka mariyang pukakwa ki kawagan tin publi ki yuko.

12.niv: The hired hand is not the shepherd and does not own the sheep. So when he sees the wolf coming, he abandons the sheep and runs away. Then the wolf attacks the flock and scatters it.
12.cmn: 若是雇工，不是牧人，羊也不是他自己的，他看見狼來，就撇下羊逃走；狼抓住羊，趕散了羊群。
12.sry: Ra muvarug ki daug ka asi tamakading, ka asi tagiyuko, iru kmita ki iruan ki tamamakakan ki yuko, darangen tin ta yuko, ka ilputen tin da: ka mihakub ta tamamakakan papavavuak ki yuko.

13.niv: The man runs away because he is a hired hand and cares nothing for the sheep.
13.cmn: 雇工逃走，因他是雇工，並不顧念羊。
13.sry: Ka ilput ta muvarug ki daug, aley ka uvarugen tin ta daug, ka asi tin iligen ta yuko.

14.niv: “I am the good shepherd; I know my sheep and my sheep know me—
14.cmn: 我是好牧人；我認識我的羊，我的羊也認識我，
14.sry: Ti yaw ta Tamakading ka mariyang : ka kmalang ko ki a'yaw, ka kalangen apa ko ki a'yaw.

15.niv: just as the Father knows me and I know the Father—and I lay down my life for the sheep.
15.cmn: 正如父認識我，我也認識父一樣；並且我為羊捨命。
15.sry: Mama ka kalangen ko ki Rama, [kumahina] kmalang apa ko ti Raman: ka pukakwa ko ki kawagan aw paubli ki yuko.

16.niv: I have other sheep that are not of this sheep pen. I must bring them also. They too will listen to my voice, and there shall be one flock and one shepherd.
16.cmn: 我另外有羊，不是這圈裏的；我必須領他們來，他們也要聽我的聲音，並且要合成一群，歸一個牧人了。
16.sry: Akumeya apa ko ki yuko ka pani, ka asi naarag ka ata: adey lapa maw ta ana: ka milingiga ki ingaw aw, ka saasata lato ka ana ka yuagan, sasata lapa ki Tamakading.

17.niv: The reason my Father loves me is that I lay down my life—only to take it up again.
17.cmn: 我父愛我；因我將命捨去，好再取回來。
17.sry: Aley ki ana kavagangoen ko ki Rama, ka pukakwa ko ki kawagan aw, tu alikugey maw mara ki ata.

18.niv: No one takes it from me, but I lay it down of my own accord. I have authority to lay it down and authority to take it up again. This command I received from my Father.”
18.cmn: 沒有人奪我的命去，是我自己捨的。我有權柄捨了，也有權柄取回來。這是我從我父所受的命令。」
18.sry: Asi maawmia ki ata ta timamang yawan, ra sikunung ko ki ata pukwan ki ata, aku ilig apa ko tu alikugan ki ata. Su ka ata ki na pakusasu niaraen aw ti Raman.

19.niv: The Jews who heard these words were again divided.
19.cmn: 猶太人為這些話又起了紛爭。
19.sry: Anata mamawduha ato mila ta su ki Yoden, aley ki su ka ata.

20.niv: Many of them said, “He is demon-possessed and raving mad. Why listen to him?”
20.cmn: 內中有好些人說：「他是被鬼附着，而且瘋了，為甚麼聽他呢？」
20.sry: Ka mabatung nenian ta nikuma, aku litu tenian, ka sadaruman apa ki rig: mang ka milingig kamu tenian.

21.niv: But others said, “These are not the sayings of a man possessed by a demon. Can a demon open the eyes of the blind?”
21.cmn: 又有人說：「這不是鬼附之人所說的話。鬼豈能叫瞎子的眼睛開了呢？」 被猶太人棄絕
21.sry: Nikuma ta raruma, asi su ka ana ki pualituen: ilpug kawa ta litu parukilat ki mavuta?

22.niv: Then came the Festival of Dedication at Jerusalem. It was winter,
22.cmn: 在耶路撒冷有修殿節，是冬天的時候。
22.sry: Ka wagi ato ki uvavatugan ki nipaivahawen ki Kuva ki tatamudan tu Yerusalem, ka kidi ato ki amigan.

23.niv: and Jesus was in the temple courts walking in Solomonʼs Colonnade.
23.cmn: 耶穌在殿裏所羅門的廊下行走。
23.sry: Ka nimunonang ta ti Yesus tu Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, tu duma ki talag ki tatamudan ti Salomon,

24.niv: The Jews who were there gathered around him, saying, “How long will you keep us in suspense? If you are the Messiah, tell us plainly.”
24.cmn: 猶太人圍着他，說：「你叫我們猶疑不定到幾時呢？你若是基督，就明明地告訴我們。」
24.sry: Anata niuritungen ta teni ki Yoden kuma tenian, Maka mang maka dalia ka parkawaw muho ta vati yan? Hairu ti Kristus kaw, pupanagen kame bana.

25.niv: Jesus answered, “I did tell you, but you do not believe. The works I do in my Fatherʼs name testify about me,
25.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「我已經告訴你們，你們不信。我奉我父之名所行的事可以為我作見證；
25.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus nenian, Patagikahan ato maw kamu, ra asi kamu tnamising. Ringey ka ana ka pamuten aw tu Nanang ki Rama aw, anata hmail yawan.

26.niv: but you do not believe because you are not my sheep.
26.cmn: 只是你們不信，因為你們不是我的羊。
26.sry: Ra imumi ta asi tnamising aley ka asi kamu yuko aw, mama ki nipasusuen aw imumian.

27.niv: My sheep listen to my voice; I know them, and they follow me.
27.cmn: 我的羊聽我的聲音，我也認識他們，他們也跟着我。
27.sry: Milingig ta yuko aw ki ingaw aw, ka kmalang ko nenian, ka mawug ta neni yawan.

28.niv: I give them eternal life, and they shall never perish; no one will snatch them out of my hand.
28.cmn: 我又賜給他們永生；他們永不滅亡，誰也不能從我手裏把他們奪去。
28.sry: Ka pigaen aw nenian ta kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug: ka asi tawrumaa ta neni tu ikakwan midarinug, ka asi bihita ta timamang hmimurang nenian tu rima aw.

29.niv: My Father, who has given them to me, is greater than all ; no one can snatch them out of my Fatherʼs hand.
29.cmn: 我父把羊賜給我，他比萬有都大，誰也不能從我父手裏把他們奪去。
29.sry: Rama aw ka nipiga nenian yawan, ta siuru malig ki imid, ka asi hmilpug ta timamang hmimurang nenian tu rima ki Rama aw.

30.niv: I and the Father are one.”
30.cmn: 我與父原為一。」
30.sry: Ti yaw, ki Rama apa, saasat kame.

31.niv: Again his Jewish opponents picked up stones to stone him,
31.cmn: 猶太人又拿起石頭來要打他。
31.sry: Anata nid mawg ta Yoden mila ki vato ka citaney tenian.

32.niv: but Jesus said to them, “I have shown you many good works from the Father. For which of these do you stone me?”
32.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「我從父顯出許多善事給你們看，你們是為哪一件拿石頭打我呢？」
32.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus nenian, Madag ki ringey ka mariyang ta na pakakita aw imumian ki rama aw: aley ki ringey kamang ta citey mumi ki vato yawan?

33.niv: “We are not stoning you for any good work,” they replied, “but for blasphemy, because you, a mere man, claim to be God.”
33.cmn: 猶太人回答說：「我們不是為善事拿石頭打你，是為你說僭妄的話；又為你是個人，反將自己當作上帝。」
33.sry: Nimatagivli tenian ta Yoden, kuma, Asi kame smita ki vato imhuan aley ki ringey ka mariyang, ra aley apa ki barugan, aley ka kagulung kaw ta imhu, pumado kaw puAlid imhuan.

34.niv: Jesus answered them, “Is it not written in your Law, ‘I have said you are “gods” ’ ?
34.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們的律法上豈不是寫着『我曾說你們是神』嗎？
34.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus nenian, Asi kawa nisasulaten tu tatuko umi, nipasusuen aw ka Alialid kamu?

35.niv: If he called them ‘gods,’ to whom the word of God came—and Scripture cannot be set aside—
35.cmn: 經上的話是不能廢的；若那些承受上帝道的人尚且稱為神，
35.sry: Hairu Alid kuma [ta tatuko] nenian, ka nipupanagen ta su ki Alid, ra asi aawlpugen maawkakirig ta na sasulat:

36.niv: what about the one whom the Father set apart as his very own and sent into the world? Why then do you accuse me of blasphemy because I said, ‘I am Godʼs Son’?
36.cmn: 父所分別為聖、又差到世間來的，他自稱是上帝的兒子，你們還向他說『你說僭妄的話』嗎？
36.sry: Matagi kumahina kamu [yawan] ka nipasani ki Rama [pasitukad] madingi tu nay, barug kaw [ki Alid], aley ka nipasusuen aw, Alak ko ki Alid?

37.niv: Do not believe me unless I do the works of my Father.
37.cmn: 我若不行我父的事，你們就不必信我；
37.sry: Hairu asi ko pamut ki peyraringey ki Rama aw, ina tnamising yawan:

38.niv: But if I do them, even though you do not believe me, believe the works, that you may know and understand that the Father is in me, and I in the Father.”
38.cmn: 我若行了，你們縱然不信我，也當信這些事，叫你們又知道又明白父在我裏面，我也在父裏面。」
38.sry: Hairu ra pamuten aw ta ana, ru asi kamu tnamising yawan, anata tnamising apa ki ringey: aley ka kmalanga kamu ka tnamisinga kamu ka itukwa ta Rama yawan, ka itukwa apa ko tenian.

39.niv: Again they tried to seize him, but he escaped their grasp.
39.cmn: 他們又要拿他，他卻逃出他們的手走了。
39.sry: Anata nikiim nein mila ki turunganey tenian, ra nisahatatawag ta teni ki rima nein.

40.niv: Then Jesus went back across the Jordan to the place where John had been baptizing in the early days. There he stayed,
40.cmn: 耶穌又往約旦河外去，到了約翰起初施洗的地方，就住在那裏。
40.sry: Ka nisalikug muarug ki Yordan tu itukwan ka niawlugan siuru ti Yoanes, ka nipayalilien tin hina.

41.niv: and many people came to him. They said, “Though John never performed a sign, all that John said about this man was true.”
41.cmn: 有許多人來到他那裏。他們說：「約翰一件神蹟沒有行過，但約翰指着這人所說的一切話都是真的。」
41.sry: Ka mabatung ta niirua tenian, kuma, Asi nipamut ta ti Yoanes ki pukidien: ra kamamang ka nipatagimimien ti Yoanes tenian mayamu matiktik ka ana.

42.niv: And in that place many believed in Jesus.
42.cmn: 在那裏，信耶穌的人就多了。
42.sry: Ka mabatung ta nitnamising hina tenian.

1.niv: Now a man named Lazarus was sick. He was from Bethany, the village of Mary and her sister Martha.
1.cmn: 有一個患病的人，名叫拉撒路，住在伯大尼，就是馬利亞和她姊姊馬大的村莊。
1.sry: Ka aku vual ka saasat ka maalam ka ti Lazarus [ta nanang tin,] ka maka Betaniya, ka na kuma ti Maria ki tagiaparag apa tin ka ti Marta.

2.niv: (This Mary, whose brother Lazarus now lay sick, was the same one who poured perfume on the Lord and wiped his feet with her hair.)
2.cmn: 這馬利亞就是那用香膏抹主，又用頭髮擦他腳的；患病的拉撒路是她的兄弟。
2.sry: (Ti Maria teni ta ti ana ka nismala imag ki imag ki Meyrang, ka nirigkag ki rapal tin ki vukug tin: ka niaha tin ka ti Lazarus ta nimaalam.)

3.niv: So the sisters sent word to Jesus, “Lord, the one you love is sick.”
3.cmn: 她姊妹兩個就打發人去見耶穌，說：「主啊，你所愛的人病了。」
3.sry: Anata nimadingi ta niaha tin paukwa tenian, kuma, Meyrang, teni ka kavagangoen hu ta maalam.

4.niv: When he heard this, Jesus said, “This sickness will not end in death. No, it is for Godʼs glory so that Godʼs Son may be glorified through it.”
4.cmn: 耶穌聽見，就說：「這病不至於死，乃是為上帝的榮耀，叫上帝的兒子因此得榮耀。」
4.sry: Iru ka milingig [ki ata] ta ti Yesus nikuma, Asi tu k apatayey tin ta maalam ka ata, ra tu puvavawey ki kidi ki Alid: aley ka puvavawey ki ata ki kidi ta Alak ki Alid.

5.niv: Now Jesus loved Martha and her sister and Lazarus.
5.cmn: 耶穌素來愛馬大和她妹子並拉撒路。
5.sry: Nda kavagangoen ti Yesus ta ti Marta, ki tagiaparag apa tin, ta ti Lazarus ki ruma.

6.niv: So when he heard that Lazarus was sick, he stayed where he was two more days,
6.cmn: 聽見拉撒路病了，就在所居之地仍住了兩天。
6.sry: Iru ra nimilingig ta teni ka maalam ta teni, nimayali [ apa] maka ruha ki wagi tu itukwaan ka ayakwaan tin.

7.niv: and then he said to his disciples, “Let us go back to Judea.”
7.cmn: 然後對門徒說：「我們再往猶太去吧。」
7.sry: Siawug ki ana nimasusu ki patatawutawugan tin, Salikugey eta mukwa tu Yudea

8.niv: “But Rabbi,” they said, “a short while ago the Jews there tried to stone you, and yet you are going back?”
8.cmn: 門徒說：「拉比，猶太人近來要拿石頭打你，你還往那裏去嗎？」
8.sry: Nikuma ta patatawutawugan tenian, Rabi, asi apa madalia ka nikmiim ta Yoden ki citaney ki vato imhuan, ka salikuga kaw mukwa hina?

9.niv: Jesus answered, “Are there not twelve hours of daylight? Anyone who walks in the daytime will not stumble, for they see by this worldʼs light.
9.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「白日不是有十二小時嗎？人在白日走路，就不致跌倒，因為看見這世上的光。
9.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, Asi kawa sat kitian ab ki ruha ta tagley ki sasat ki wagi? Hairu munonang ta timamang du aku wagi, asi hmalidawraw ta teni: aley ka kitaan tin ta ramag ki nay ka ata:

10.niv: It is when a person walks at night that they stumble, for they have no light.”
10.cmn: 若在黑夜走路，就必跌倒，因為他沒有光。」
10.sry: Iru ra munonang ta timamang du awvanan, hmalidawraw ta teni: aley ka ausi ki ramag tenian.

11.niv: After he had said this, he went on to tell them, “Our friend Lazarus has fallen asleep; but I am going there to wake him up.”
11.cmn: 耶穌說了這話，隨後對他們說：「我們的朋友拉撒路睡了，我去叫醒他。」
11.sry: Ata ta nipasusuen tin: siawug ki ana nikuma ta teni nenian, mirip ta ti Lazarus ka riu eta: ra mukwa ko tenian ki papatimawagey maw tu iripan tin.

12.niv: His disciples replied, “Lord, if he sleeps, he will get better.”
12.cmn: 門徒說：「主啊，他若睡了，就必好了。」
12.sry: Anata nikuma ta patatawutawugan tin, Meyrang, Hairu mirip ta teni kawdarikaga lato.

13.niv: Jesus had been speaking of his death, but his disciples thought he meant natural sleep.
13.cmn: 耶穌這話是指着他死說的，他們卻以為是說照常睡了。
13.sry: Ra ti Yesus ta nimasusu ki nikapatayan tin: ra nipagdimdimen nein ka pasusuen tin ki irip ka iripen.

14.niv: So then he told them plainly, “Lazarus is dead,
14.cmn: 耶穌就明明地告訴他們說：「拉撒路死了。
14.sry: Anata nimatagitumtum, ta ti Yesus nenian, Nimapatay ato ta ti Lazarus.

15.niv: and for your sake I am glad I was not there, so that you may believe. But let us go to him.”
15.cmn: 我沒有在那裏就歡喜，這是為你們的緣故，好叫你們相信。如今我們可以往他那裏去吧。」
15.sry: Ka maray ko aley imumian, ka asi ko niayakwa hina, aley ka nitnamisingey mumi: nda mukwaey eta tenian.

16.niv: Then Thomas (also known as Didymus) said to the rest of the disciples, “Let us also go, that we may die with him.”
16.cmn: 多馬，又稱為低土馬，就對那同作門徒的說：「我們也去和他同死吧。」 復活在我，生命在我
16.sry: Ti Tomas ka Didimus ta siuwa tin, nikuma ki patatawutawugan ka lam tin Mukwa apa ta imita, aley ka pisparag kita tenian mapatay.

17.niv: On his arrival, Jesus found that Lazarus had already been in the tomb for four days.
17.cmn: 耶穌到了，就知道拉撒路在墳墓裏已經四天了。
17.sry: Iru ka irua ato ta ti Yesus nikabaley tin ka maka apat ki wagi ka ayaravak ato ta teni.

18.niv: Now Bethany was less than two miles from Jerusalem,
18.cmn: 伯大尼離耶路撒冷不遠，約有六里路。
18.sry: (Ka Betanya ta itu tamang ki Yerusalem, Sat kitian lava ab ki rima ki stadien ki na ka dadalia hina.)

19.niv: and many Jews had come to Martha and Mary to comfort them in the loss of their brother.
19.cmn: 有好些猶太人來看馬大和馬利亞，要為她們的兄弟安慰她們。
19.sry: Ka mabatung ki Yoden ta irua ato ti Martaan ti Mariaan, tu pakahaniapey nenian aley ki niahan nein.

20.niv: When Martha heard that Jesus was coming, she went out to meet him, but Mary stayed at home.
20.cmn: 馬大聽見耶穌來了，就出去迎接他；馬利亞卻仍然坐在家裏。
20.sry: Anata ti Marta, iru ka milingig ki iruan ti Yesus, nidmumaduma tenian: ra ti Maria ta nitaga irarung tu talag da.

21.niv: “Lord,” Martha said to Jesus, “if you had been here, my brother would not have died.
21.cmn: 馬大對耶穌說：「主啊，你若早在這裏，我兄弟必不死。
21.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Marta ti Yesusan, Meyrang, Hairu na anaen kaw hiya, ina asi k apatay ta niaha [tagiaparag] aw.

22.niv: But I know that even now God will give you whatever you ask.”
22.cmn: 就是現在，我也知道，你無論向上帝求甚麼，上帝也必賜給你。」
22.sry: Ra kavanaen aw hinin, kamamang ka tmimiaw muho ki Alid, ka pigaa ki ata ta Alid imhuan.

23.niv: Jesus said to her, “Your brother will rise again.”
23.cmn: 耶穌說：「你兄弟必然復活。」
23.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Likuga gapit ta niaha [tagiaparag] oho.

24.niv: Martha answered, “I know he will rise again in the resurrection at the last day.”
24.cmn: 馬大說：「我知道在末日復活的時候，他必復活。」
24.sry: Nikuma ta ti Marta tenian, Kavanaen aw ka likuga ta teni tu likugan gapit tu wagi ka tu awug.

25.niv: Jesus said to her, “I am the resurrection and the life. The one who believes in me will live, even though they die;
25.cmn: 耶穌對她說：「復活在我，生命也在我。信我的人雖然死了，也必復活；
25.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Ti yaw ta likugan gapit, ki kawagan apa: Timamang ta tnamising yawan, mawaga ta teni meyta ru piskaha ato.

26.niv: and whoever lives by believing in me will never die. Do you believe this?”
26.cmn: 凡活着信我的人必永遠不死。你信這話嗎？」
26.sry: Veyag apa ka mawag ka tnamising yawan, asi mapatayatu ikakwan midarinug. Tnamising kaw kawa ki ata.

27.niv: “Yes, Lord,” she replied, “I believe that you are the Messiah, the Son of God, who is to come into the world.”
27.cmn: 馬大說：「主啊，是的，我信你是基督，是上帝的兒子，就是那要臨到世界的。」 耶穌哭了
27.sry: Nikuma ta teni tenian, Hahay Meyrang: tnamising ko ka ti Kristus kaw ka alak ki Alid, ka irua lato tu nay.

28.niv: After she had said this, she went back and called her sister Mary aside. “The Teacher is here,” she said, “and is asking for you.”
28.cmn: 馬大說了這話，就回去暗暗地叫她妹子馬利亞，說：「夫子來了，叫你。」
28.sry: Iru ka patagikahan tin ta ata nidmarang ta teni, ka nimakuuzung tmataam ti Mariaan ka tagiaparag tin, kuma, Anaen ta Tamamatawtawug, tmataam ta teni imhuan.

29.niv: When Mary heard this, she got up quickly and went to him.
29.cmn: 馬利亞聽見了，就急忙起來，到耶穌那裏去。
29.sry: Teni ru milingig [ki ata,] madis gapit, ka nidmumaduma tenian.

30.niv: Now Jesus had not yet entered the village, but was still at the place where Martha had met him.
30.cmn: 那時，耶穌還沒有進村子，仍在馬大迎接他的地方。
30.sry: (Ka asi apa maawma ato ta ti Yesus: ra ayakwa apa tu nipaawklaen ti Marta tenian.)

31.niv: When the Jews who had been with Mary in the house, comforting her, noticed how quickly she got up and went out, they followed her, supposing she was going to the tomb to mourn there.
31.cmn: 那些同馬利亞在家裏安慰她的猶太人，見她急忙起來出去，就跟着她，以為她要往墳墓那裏去哭。
31.sry: Ka Yoden ka ana ka ayalam tin tu talag pakahaniap tenian, iru ka kmita ta neni ti Mariaan ka disen tin gapit samamala, nimawug ta neni tenian kuma, Sakakwa ta teni tu ravak, aley ka tmangitangia hina.

32.niv: When Mary reached the place where Jesus was and saw him, she fell at his feet and said, “Lord, if you had been here, my brother would not have died.”
32.cmn: 馬利亞到了耶穌那裏，看見他，就俯伏在他腳前，說：「主啊，你若早在這裏，我兄弟必不死。」
32.sry: Anata ti Maria, iru kamukwa ato ti Yesusan, ka ru kitaan tin tenian, nisaihakub tu rapal tin kuma tenian, Meyrang, hairu na anaen kaw hiya, ina asi k apatay ta niaha aw.

33.niv: When Jesus saw her weeping, and the Jews who had come along with her also weeping, he was deeply moved in spirit and troubled.
33.cmn: 耶穌看見她哭，並看見與她同來的猶太人也哭，就心裏悲歎，又甚憂愁，
33.sry: Iru ka kmita ta ti Yesus tenian ka tmangitangi ta teni, ka tmangitangi [ apa] ta Yoden ka tu lam tenian, nibakan ki rig ka niumamado mutkaw.

34.niv: “Where have you laid him?” he asked. “Come and see, Lord,” they replied.
34.cmn: 便說：「你們把他安放在哪裏？」他們回答說：「請主來看。」
34.sry: Nikuma apa, nimatakuna kamu tenian? Nikuma ta teni tenian, Meyrang mukwa kitaey ato.

35.niv: Jesus wept.
35.cmn: 耶穌哭了。
35.sry: Nitmangitangi ta ti Yesus

36.niv: Then the Jews said, “See how he loved him!”
36.cmn: 猶太人就說：「你看他愛這人是何等懇切。」
36.sry: Anata nikuma ta Yoden, kitaey mama ki mang ka kavagangoen tin tenian.

37.niv: But some of them said, “Could not he who opened the eyes of the blind man have kept this man from dying?”
37.cmn: 其中有人說：「他既然開了瞎子的眼睛，豈不能叫這人不死嗎？」 拉撒路復活
37.sry: Ka nikuma ta raruma nenian, asi nipailpug kawa pamut ta teni, ka niparkilat ki mata ki mavuta, ka asi paimamaramagen ta ti ata?

38.niv: Jesus, once more deeply moved, came to the tomb. It was a cave with a stone laid across the entrance.
38.cmn: 耶穌又心裏悲歎，來到墳墓前；那墳墓是個洞，有一塊石頭擋着。
38.sry: Iru ka niilan ibak ki rig ta ti Yesus, nisakakwa tu ravak: Ka karivikif ta ana, ka niatahalapen ki vato.

39.niv: “Take away the stone,” he said. “But, Lord,” said Martha, the sister of the dead man, “by this time there is a bad odor, for he has been there four days.”
39.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們把石頭挪開。」那死人的姊姊馬大對他說：「主啊，他現在必是臭了，因為他死了已經四天了。」
39.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus, hamiaw ta vato. Ti Marta ka niaha ki nimapatay, ta nikuma tenian, Meyrang, milalangso ato hinin, aley ka maka apat ki wagi [ki nikikwaan tin tu hina]

40.niv: Then Jesus said, “Did I not tell you that if you believe, you will see the glory of God?”
40.cmn: 耶穌說：「我不是對你說過，你若信，就必看見上帝的榮耀嗎？」
40.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Asi maw kaw kawa nipasusuen, Ru tnamising kaw, ka kmitaa kaw ki kairangan ki kidi ki Alid?

41.niv: So they took away the stone. Then Jesus looked up and said, “Father, I thank you that you have heard me.
41.cmn: 他們就把石頭挪開。耶穌舉目望天，說：「父啊，我感謝你，因為你已經聽我。
41.sry: Anata nihamian nein ta vato ka ikwan ki patay. Ka nipapasuvavaw ta ti Yesus ki mata, kuma, Rama, lulugen aw kaw, ki nitnavaley hu yawan.

42.niv: I knew that you always hear me, but I said this for the benefit of the people standing here, that they may believe that you sent me.”
42.cmn: 我也知道你常聽我，但我說這話是為周圍站着的眾人，叫他們信是你差了我來。」
42.sry: Ka kavanaen aw ka mikakwa kaw milingig yawan: ra aley ki makuilalawlaw, ka itu ritung mituko nipasusuen aw [ki ata,] aley ka tnamisinga ta neni, ka nipadingien hu yawan.

43.niv: When he had said this, Jesus called in a loud voice, “Lazarus, come out!”
43.cmn: 說了這話，就大聲呼叫說：「拉撒路出來！」
43.sry: Iru ka matagikaha ki ata nimakulangag ta teni ki ingaw ka irang, Lazarus mupanaga.

44.niv: The dead man came out, his hands and feet wrapped with strips of linen, and a cloth around his face. Jesus said to them, “Take off the grave clothes and let him go.”
44.cmn: 那死人就出來了，手腳裹着布，臉上包着手巾。耶穌對他們說：「解開，叫他走！」 殺害耶穌的陰謀 （太26‧1－5；可14‧1－2；路22‧1－2）
44.sry: Ka nimupanag ta nimapatay, ka niafut tu rima tu rapal ki na avut, ka nitupo ta vulung tin ki na tatupo ki mula. Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Aawena afutey tenian ka padaranga tenian.

45.niv: Therefore many of the Jews who had come to visit Mary, and had seen what Jesus did, believed in him.
45.cmn: 那些來看馬利亞的猶太人見了耶穌所做的事，就多有信他的；
45.sry: Anata mabatung ki Yoden ka irua ato ti Mariaan, ka nimararaw ki peyringaringey ti Yesus, nitnamising tenian.

46.niv: But some of them went to the Pharisees and told them what Jesus had done.
46.cmn: 但其中也有去見法利賽人的，將耶穌所做的事告訴他們。
46.sry: Ra nidmarang ta raruma nenian mukwa ki Farizeen, bana nenian ki na ringey ti Yesus.

47.niv: Then the chief priests and the Pharisees called a meeting of the Sanhedrin. “What are we accomplishing?” they asked. “Here is this man performing many signs.
47.cmn: 祭司長和法利賽人聚集公會，說：「這人行好些神蹟，我們怎麼辦呢？
47.sry: Anata nipapawukipukipo ta Tamapigik ka Sibavaw ki Farizeen apa ki peysasalan, ka kun nein, ‘Umanga kita? Ka madag ki pukidien ka pamuten ki vual ka ata.

48.niv: If we let him go on like this, everyone will believe in him, and then the Romans will come and take away both our temple and our nation.”
48.cmn: 若這樣由着他，人人都要信他，羅馬人也要來奪我們的地土和我們的百姓。」
48.sry: Hairu paikakwa kita kumahina tenian, tnaimida ta neni tnamising tenian, ka irua ta Romeynein maril ki itukwaan eta ki tau apa.

49.niv: Then one of them, named Caiaphas, who was high priest that year, spoke up, “You know nothing at all!
49.cmn: 內中有一個人，名叫該亞法，本年作大祭司，對他們說：「你們不知道甚麼。
49.sry: Ka saat nenian ti Kayafas ka Dadilug ka Sibavaw tu tawil ka ana, ta nikuma nenian, “Asi kamu mumha ki mamang:

50.niv: You do not realize that it is better for you that one man die for the people than that the whole nation perish.”
50.cmn: 獨不想一個人替百姓死，免得通國滅亡，就是你們的益處。」
50.sry: Ka asi kamu pabaley ka mariyanga imitan ka mapatayata saasat ki vual mivli ki tau, aley ka asi tawtumuka tawruma ta tau.

51.niv: He did not say this on his own, but as high priest that year he prophesied that Jesus would die for the Jewish nation,
51.cmn: 他這話不是出於自己，是因他本年作大祭司，所以預言耶穌將要替這一國死；
51.sry: Ka asi tin ka ata nipatagimado: ra aley ka Dadilug ka Sibavaw tu tawil ka ana, nipatagitan tin, ka mapatayata ti Yesus miv’li ki tau:

52.niv: and not only for that nation but also for the scattered children of God, to bring them together and make them one.
52.cmn: 也不但替這一國死，並要將上帝四散的子民都聚集歸一。
52.sry: Ka asi dik mivli ki tau ka ana, ra aley apa ka iludaw tin ta nipapayavoak ka alalak ki Alid.

53.niv: So from that day on they plotted to take his life.
53.cmn: 從那日起，他們就商議要殺耶穌。
53.sry: Anata na kidi ki wagi ka ana nipapakipo ta neni ki su ki pakapatayaney tenian.

54.niv: Therefore Jesus no longer moved about publicly among the people of Judea. Instead he withdrew to a region near the wilderness, to a village called Ephraim, where he stayed with his disciples.
54.cmn: 所以，耶穌不再顯然行在猶太人中間，就離開那裏往靠近曠野的地方去，到了一座城，名叫以法蓮，就在那裏和門徒同住。
54.sry: Anata asi nimunonang ta ti Yesus hmitamawug tu panag ki Yoden: ra nidmarang apa hina mukwa tu purug ka tu hili ki pawlag tu awma ka pananangen Efraim: ka nihmikwa tu hina hmilam ki patatawutawugan tin.

55.niv: When it was almost time for the Jewish Passover, many went up from the country to Jerusalem for their ceremonial cleansing before the Passover.
55.cmn: 猶太人的逾越節近了，有許多人從鄉下上耶路撒冷去，要在節前潔淨自己。
55.sry: Ka ayatamang ta Uvavatugan ki Halidawan ki Yoden, ka mabatung ta vual tu purug ka ana ka nisabavaw muYerusalem, tu uru ki Uvavatugan ki Halidawan, aley ki pakakuptigey nenian.

56.niv: They kept looking for Jesus, and as they stood in the temple courts they asked one another, “What do you think? Isnʼt he coming to the festival at all?”
56.cmn: 他們就尋找耶穌，站在殿裏彼此說：「你們的意思如何，他不來過節嗎？」
56.sry: Anata nikiim nein ta ti Yesus, ka nimatagitavatavag ta neni mituko tu Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, “Pagmangen umi pagdimdim? Asi kawa irua ta teni tu uvavatugan?”

57.niv: But the chief priests and the Pharisees had given orders that anyone who found out where Jesus was should report it so that they might arrest him.
57.cmn: 那時，祭司長和法利賽人早已吩咐說，若有人知道耶穌在哪裏，就要報明，好去拿他。
57.sry: Ka nimakusu ta Tamapigik ka Sibavaw ki Farizeen apa, hairu mumha lava ta timamang ka ayakuna ta teni, ka pakavanaaw tin ta ana, aley ka turungaw nein tenian.

1.niv: Six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus lived, whom Jesus had raised from the dead.
1.cmn: 逾越節前六日，耶穌來到伯大尼，就是他叫拉撒路從死裏復活之處。
1.sry: Anata niirua ta ti Yesus anim ki wagi tu uru ki Uvavatugan ki Halidawan tu Bethanien tu ayakwan ti Lazarus ka nimapatay ato kalahay, ka nipapatimawagen tin ki nikapatayan.

2.niv: Here a dinner was given in Jesusʼ honor. Martha served, while Lazarus was among those reclining at the table with him.
2.cmn: 有人在那裏給耶穌預備筵席；馬大伺候，拉撒路也在那同耶穌坐席的人中。
2.sry: Ka nitmanang tenian hina ki hiadudengan, ka paililigen ti Marta: Ka ti Lazarus ta saat nenian ka itu lam tenian miraung tu avokan.

3.niv: Then Mary took about a pint of pure nard, an expensive perfume; she poured it on Jesusʼ feet and wiped his feet with her hair. And the house was filled with the fragrance of the perfume.
3.cmn: 馬利亞就拿着一斤極貴的真哪噠香膏，抹耶穌的腳，又用自己頭髮去擦，屋裏就滿了膏的香氣。
3.sry: Iru ka niara ti Maria sasat ki tingting ki rapul ka Nardus ka mangal, ka asi nihurad, nisalaimagen tin ta rapal ti Yesus, ka nirikag ki vukug tin ki rapal tin, kamutumuk ta ait ki rapul tu talag ka ana.

4.niv: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, who was later to betray him, objected,
4.cmn: 有一個門徒，就是那將要賣耶穌的加略人猶大，
4.sry: Anata nikuma ta saat ki Patatawugan tin, ti Yudas ka ti Simon Iskariyut, ka sivanavanaa tenian.

5.niv: “Why wasnʼt this perfume sold and the money given to the poor? It was worth a yearʼs wages.”
5.cmn: 說：「這香膏為甚麼不賣三十兩銀子賙濟窮人呢？」
5.sry: Kaumang ka asi papapeyla ta rapul ka ata [ki turu kaatugan ki malituk] ka nipigen ki ana ta malimuk?

6.niv: He did not say this because he cared about the poor but because he was a thief; as keeper of the money bag, he used to help himself to what was put into it.
6.cmn: 他說這話，並不是掛念窮人，乃因他是個賊，又帶着錢囊，常取其中所存的。
6.sry: Nipasusuen tin ta ata, asi aley ka pakuboen tin ta malimuk, ra aley apa ka tamahauzung ta teni, ka aku pauti meykwa ki ata ka pukwan ato.

7.niv: “Leave her alone,” Jesus replied. “It was intended that she should save this perfume for the day of my burial.
7.cmn: 耶穌說：「由她吧！她是為我安葬之日存留的。
7.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus, Pasikunungaw ta teni: Nihaa tin ta ata tu wagi ki ravakey yawan.

8.niv: You will always have the poor among you, but you will not always have me.”
8.cmn: 因為常有窮人和你們同在，只是你們不常有我。」 殺害拉撒路的陰謀
8.sry: Ka itukakwa imumian ta malimuk, ra ausia kamu mikakwa yawan.

9.niv: Meanwhile a large crowd of Jews found out that Jesus was there and came, not only because of him but also to see Lazarus, whom he had raised from the dead.
9.cmn: 有許多猶太人知道耶穌在那裏，就來了，不但是為耶穌的緣故，也是要看他從死裏所復活的拉撒路。
9.sry: Ka makuilalawlaw ka mabatung ki Yoden ta mumha ki ayakwan tin hina: ka niirua asi dik aley ti Yesusan, aley apa ka kmitaa ta neni ti Lazarusan, ka nipapatimawagen tin ki nik apateyan.

10.niv: So the chief priests made plans to kill Lazarus as well,
10.cmn: 但祭司長商議連拉撒路也要殺了；
10.sry: Ka nimatagisaal matagikipu ki su ta Tamapigik ka Sibavaw ka pakapatayalapa ta neni ti Lazarusan.

11.niv: for on account of him many of the Jews were going over to Jesus and believing in him.
11.cmn: 因有好些猶太人為拉撒路的緣故，回去信了耶穌。 光榮地進耶路撒冷 （太21‧1－11；可11‧1－11；路19‧28－40）
11.sry: Ka mabatung ki Yoden ta nidmarang mukwa aley tenian, ka nitnamising [ apa] ti Yesusan.

12.niv: The next day the great crowd that had come for the festival heard that Jesus was on his way to Jerusalem.
12.cmn: 第二天，有許多上來過節的人聽見耶穌將到耶路撒冷，
12.sry: Tu sasat ki wagi ka tu awug makuilalawlaw ka mabatung ka iru ato tu uvavatugan, du milingig ka sakakwan ti Yesus muYerusalem,

13.niv: They took palm branches and went out to meet him, shouting, “Hosanna!” “Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Blessed is the king of Israel!”
13.cmn: 就拿着棕樹枝出去迎接他，喊着說： 和散那！ 奉主名來的以色列王是應當稱頌的！
13.sry: Niara nein ta pehil ki paranag ka palma, ka nitawpapanag dumaduma tenian nimakulangag, “Hosana, pakariyangaw ta teni lmulug ka irua tu Nanang ki MEYRANG ka Meysasu ka Sibavaw tu Israel.

14.niv: Jesus found a young donkey and sat on it, as it is written:
14.cmn: 耶穌得了一個驢駒，就騎上，如經上所記的說：
14.sry: Ka nikabaley ti Yesus ta patak ki luwang ka haava [kaezel], ka niituhaavaen tin ki ana, mama ki na sasulat,

15.niv: “Do not be afraid, Daughter Zion; see, your king is coming, seated on a donkeyʼs colt.”
15.cmn: 錫安的民哪，不要懼怕！ 你的王騎着驢駒來了。
15.sry: Ina matakut Tatimian ki Sion: kitaey, irarurua ta Meysasu ka Sibavaw imhuan ituhaava tu patak ki luwang ka ipu ka haava.

16.niv: At first his disciples did not understand all this. Only after Jesus was glorified did they realize that these things had been written about him and that these things had been done to him.
16.cmn: 這些事門徒起先不明白，等到耶穌得了榮耀以後才想起這話是指着他寫的，並且眾人果然向他這樣行了。
16.sry: Ra asi umhaen ta ata ki patatawutawugan tin tu naunamu: Iru ra nipuvavawen ki kidi ta ti Yesus, anata nihibaley nein ka nisulaten ta maawkwa tenian, ka nipamut apa nein ta ata tenian.

17.niv: Now the crowd that was with him when he called Lazarus from the tomb and raised him from the dead continued to spread the word.
17.cmn: 當耶穌呼喚拉撒路，叫他從死復活出墳墓的時候，同耶穌在那裏的眾人就作見證。
17.sry: Ka makuilalawlaw ka ana ka na lam tin [tenian] ta nihmail ki nitataam tin ti Lazarus pupanag tu ravak, ka nipapatimawag tin tenian ki nikapatayan.

18.niv: Many people, because they had heard that he had performed this sign, went out to meet him.
18.cmn: 眾人因聽見耶穌行了這神蹟，就去迎接他。
18.sry: Aley ki ana nidmumaduma apa tenian ta makuilalawlaw, aley ka niilingigen nein ka nipamuten tin ta nipukidien ka ata.

19.niv: So the Pharisees said to one another, “See, this is getting us nowhere. Look how the whole world has gone after him!”
19.cmn: 法利賽人彼此說：「看哪，你們是徒勞無益，世人都隨從他去了。」 希臘人求見耶穌
19.sry: Anata nimatagitavatavag ta Farizeen, Kitaan umi kawa ka asi umi putanein? Kitaey, smaladilug tenian ta imid ki nay.

20.niv: Now there were some Greeks among those who went up to worship at the festival.
20.cmn: 那時，上來過節禮拜的人中，有幾個希臘人。
20.sry: Ka akumeya ato hina ta raruma ka Grieken ka na tau ka ana ka nisabavaw ki deypey nein tu uvavatugan.

21.niv: They came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida in Galilee, with a request. “Sir,” they said, “we would like to see Jesus.”
21.cmn: 他們來見加利利、伯賽大的腓力，求他說：「先生，我們願意見耶穌。」
21.sry: Neni ta nimukwa Filipusan ka maka Betzayda ka tu Galilaya, nitmumimia tenian, kun, Meyrang, mamuy kame kmita ti Yesusan.

22.niv: Philip went to tell Andrew; Andrew and Philip in turn told Jesus.
22.cmn: 腓力去告訴安得烈，安得烈同腓力去告訴耶穌。
22.sry: Nimukwa ta ti Filipus vanavana ti Andreasan: ti Andreas ti Filipus apa ta nivanavana ki ata ti Yesusan.

23.niv: Jesus replied, “The hour has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
23.cmn: 耶穌說：「人子得榮耀的時候到了。
23.sry: Ra ti Yesus ta nimatagivli nenian, kuma, Iru ato ta kidi ki tagley ka puvavawey ki kidi ta Alak ki kagulung.

24.niv: Very truly I tell you, unless a kernel of wheat falls to the ground and dies, it remains only a single seed. But if it dies, it produces many seeds.
24.cmn: 我實實在在地告訴你們，一粒麥子不落在地裏死了，仍舊是一粒，若是死了，就結出許多子粒來。
24.sry: Mising, mising kun aw kamu, Hairu asi tawkwa tu nay mapatay ta viturug ki sivag mikakwa tu saat ta ana, iru ra mapatay maka t apang ta ana makavua.

25.niv: Anyone who loves their life will lose it, while anyone who hates their life in this world will keep it for eternal life.
25.cmn: 愛惜自己生命的，就失喪生命；在這世上恨惡自己生命的，就要保守生命到永生。
25.sry: Timamang ta mavagango ki kawagan tin patagirumaen ki ana: timamang apa mavahier ki kawagan tin tu nay ka ata, mahaa ki ana tu kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug.

26.niv: Whoever serves me must follow me; and where I am, my servant also will be. My Father will honor the one who serves me.
26.cmn: 若有人服事我，就當跟從我；我在哪裏，服事我的人也要在那裏；若有人服事我，我父必尊重他。」 人子必須被舉起來
26.sry: Hairu timamang ta mirung yawan, smaladiluga yawan: ka tumamang ta ayakwaen aw, ayakwa lapa hina ta tamairung yawan. Ka timamang ta mirung yawan teni ta iligaw ki Rama.

27.niv: “Now my soul is troubled, and what shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this hour’? No, it was for this very reason I came to this hour.
27.cmn: 「我現在心裏憂愁，我說甚麼才好呢？父啊，救我脫離這時候；但我原是為這時候來的。
27.sry: Hinin miringaw ta vati aw ki vulas: kamang ta sua maw? Rama, hamiey ko tu kidi ki tagley ka ata. Ra aley apa ki ana iru ato ko tu kidi ki tagley ka ata.

28.niv: Father, glorify your name!” Then a voice came from heaven, “I have glorified it, and will glorify it again.”
28.cmn: 父啊，願你榮耀你的名！」當時就有聲音從天上來，說：「我已經榮耀了我的名，還要再榮耀。」
28.sry: Rama puvavawey ki kidi ta Nanang oho. Anata niirua ta ingaw maka tunun ki vulum, [kun], Nipuvavawen aw ki kidi ka milaa ko puvavaw ki kidi [tenian.]

29.niv: The crowd that was there and heard it said it had thundered; others said an angel had spoken to him.
29.cmn: 站在旁邊的眾人聽見，就說：「打雷了。」還有人說：「有天使對他說話。」
29.sry: Anata makuilalawlaw ka mituko hina milingig [ki ata,] nikuma, akumeya ato ki iltag. Nikuma ta raruma, ka ingawen ta teni ki tamagnaw.

30.niv: Jesus said, “This voice was for your benefit, not mine.
30.cmn: 耶穌說：「這聲音不是為我，是為你們來的。
30.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus ka nikun tin, Asi aley yawan ka nipamuten ta ingaw ka ata, ra aley apa imumian.

31.niv: Now is the time for judgment on this world; now the prince of this world will be driven out.
31.cmn: 現在這世界受審判，這世界的王要被趕出去。
31.sry: Anata hinin ta dungdungan ki nay ka ata: aringaney hinin putawag ta Meysasu ki nay ka ata.

32.niv: And I, when I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
32.cmn: 我若從地上被舉起來，就要吸引萬人來歸我。」
32.sry: Ka ti yaw ru puvavawey lato ko maka nay hmimida ko bihit nenian paukwa yawan.

33.niv: He said this to show the kind of death he was going to die.
33.cmn: 耶穌這話原是指着自己將要怎樣死說的。
