33.sry: Nipasusuen tin ta ata ka pukidiey kapatayan ka mama ki mang ka k apatayey tin.)

34.niv: The crowd spoke up, “We have heard from the Law that the Messiah will remain forever, so how can you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up’? Who is this ‘Son of Man’?”
34.cmn: 眾人回答說：「我們聽見律法上有話說，基督是永存的，你怎麼說『人子必須被舉起來』呢？這人子是誰呢？」
34.sry: Nimatagivli tenian ta makuilalawlaw, Nimilingig kame tu rinug ta ti Kristus: ka matagimang kaw imhu, ka puvavawey lato ta Alak ki kagulung? Timang ta Alak ka ana ki kagulung?

35.niv: Then Jesus told them, “You are going to have the light just a little while longer. Walk while you have the light, before darkness overtakes you. Whoever walks in the dark does not know where they are going.
35.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「光在你們中間還有不多的時候，應當趁着有光行走，免得黑暗臨到你們；那在黑暗裏行走的，不知道往何處去。
35.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Asi madalia ki kidi ka ayakwa apa ta ramag imumian: munonanga du aku ramag imumian, aley ka asi kamu tawkwaey ki karumduman. Ka timamang ta munonang tu karumduman, asi mumha tu mamang ka sakakwan tin.

36.niv: Believe in the light while you have the light, so that you may become children of light.” When he had finished speaking, Jesus left and hid himself from them.
36.cmn: 你們應當趁着有光，信從這光，使你們成為光明之子。」 猶太人的不信 耶穌說了這話，就離開他們隱藏了。
36.sry: Du akumeya apa ta ramag imumian tnamisinga ki ramag, aley ka alalaka kamu ki kararamagan. Ta mamang ka ata nipasusuen ti Yesus: ka ru dmarang nihmaa tenian pautawag nenian.

37.niv: Even after Jesus had performed so many signs in their presence, they still would not believe in him.
37.cmn: 他雖然在他們面前行了許多神蹟，他們還是不信他。
37.sry: Meyta ka madag kumahina ki na pukakidi nipamuten tin tu amag nenian, asi nitnamising ta neni tenian.

38.niv: This was to fulfill the word of Isaiah the prophet: “Lord, who has believed our message and to whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
38.cmn: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說： 主啊，我們所傳的有誰信呢？ 主的膀臂向誰顯露呢？
38.sry: Aley ka k apavawutaw ta na su ti Esiyas ka na Tamamatagitan, ka nipasusuen tin, Meyrang, timang ta nitnamising ki na patasasu yan? Nipupanagen timangan ta paryu ti YEHOVA?

39.niv: For this reason they could not believe, because, as Isaiah says elsewhere:
39.cmn: 他們所以不能信，因為以賽亞又說：
39.sry: Aley ki ana asi nitnalpug tnamising, aley ka nimatagila ta ti Esayas;

40.niv: “He has blinded their eyes and hardened their hearts, so they can neither see with their eyes, nor understand with their hearts, nor turn—and I would heal them.”
40.cmn: 主叫他們瞎了眼， 硬了心， 免得他們眼睛看見， 心裏明白，回轉過來， 我就醫治他們。
40.sry: Nipakavutaan tin ta mata nein, nipaka atagan tin ta tintin nein: ka asi kitaey ki mata nein, ka asi umhaey ki tintin nein, ki pasilalaey ta neni ka smimiaa ko nenian.

41.niv: Isaiah said this because he saw Jesusʼ glory and spoke about him.
41.cmn: 以賽亞因為看見他的榮耀，就指着他說這話。
41.sry: Ata ta nipasusuen ti Esayas, du kitaan tin ta kairangan ki kidi tin, matagimimia tenian.

42.niv: Yet at the same time many even among the leaders believed in him. But because of the Pharisees they would not openly acknowledge their faith for fear they would be put out of the synagogue;
42.cmn: 雖然如此，官長中卻有好些信他的，只因法利賽人的緣故，就不承認，恐怕被趕出會堂。
42.sry: Iru apa ka ana ka nitnamising tenian ta mabatung ka na Meysasu: ra aley ki Farizeen asi nein nipatagi amag ta ana, aley ka asi putawagaw ta neni ki Pakuisasalan.

43.niv: for they loved human praise more than praise from God.
43.cmn: 這是因他們愛人的榮耀過於愛上帝的榮耀。 耶穌的話要審判人
43.sry: Ka nikasaunein nein mavagango ta lulugan ki kagulung ki lulugan ki Alid.

44.niv: Then Jesus cried out, “Whoever believes in me does not believe in me only, but in the one who sent me.
44.cmn: 耶穌大聲說：「信我的，不是信我，乃是信那差我來的。
44.sry: Ka nimakulangag ta ti Yesus, ka nikun tin, Timamang ta tnamising yawan, asi tnamising yawan, ra tenian apa ka nimadingi yawan.

45.niv: The one who looks at me is seeing the one who sent me.
45.cmn: 人看見我，就是看見那差我來的。
45.sry: Ka timamang ta kmita yawan, kmita tenian ka nimadingi yawan.

46.niv: I have come into the world as a light, so that no one who believes in me should stay in darkness.
46.cmn: 我到世上來，乃是光，叫凡信我的，不住在黑暗裏。
46.sry: Ti yaw ta ramag ka irua ato tu nay, aley ka veyaveyag ka tamatnamising yawan, asi itukakwaa tu karumduman

47.niv: “If anyone hears my words but does not keep them, I do not judge that person. For I did not come to judge the world, but to save the world.
47.cmn: 若有人聽見我的話不遵守，我不審判他。我來本不是要審判世界，乃是要拯救世界。
47.sry: Hairu ka milingiga lato ta timamang ki su aw, ru asi tnamising, asi ko dmungdung tenian. Ka asi ko iru ato tu dungdungey maw ki nay, ra aley apa ka pakariyangey maw ta nay.

48.niv: There is a judge for the one who rejects me and does not accept my words; the very words I have spoken will condemn them at the last day.
48.cmn: 棄絕我、不領受我話的人，有審判他的－就是我所講的道在末日要審判他。
48.sry: Timamang ta murung putawag yawan, ka asi matarig ki su aw, akumeya ki dmungdunga tenian: su ka ata ka nipasusuen aw, ata ta dmungdunga tenian tu wagi ka tu awug.

49.niv: For I did not speak on my own, but the Father who sent me commanded me to say all that I have spoken.
49.cmn: 因為我沒有憑着自己講，惟有差我來的父已經給我命令，叫我說甚麼，講甚麼。
49.sry: Ka asi ko nisikunung masusu, ra ti Rama apa ka nimadingi yawan, teni ta nimakusu yawan ki mamang ka kwaaw maw, ki mamang apa ka pasusuaw maw.

50.niv: I know that his command leads to eternal life. So whatever I say is just what the Father has told me to say.”
50.cmn: 我也知道他的命令就是永生。故此，我所講的話正是照着父對我所說的。」
50.sry: Ka kavanaen aw ka kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug ta pakusuen tin. Anata kamamang ka pasusuen aw matagikuma ko hina, mama ki nipasusuen ti Rama yawan.

1.niv: It was just before the Passover Festival. Jesus knew that the hour had come for him to leave this world and go to the Father. Having loved his own who were in the world, he loved them to the end.
1.cmn: 逾越節以前，耶穌知道自己離世歸父的時候到了。他既然愛世間屬自己的人，就愛他們到底。
1.sry: Ka tu uru ki Uvavatugan ki Halidawan, iru kavanaen ti Yesus ka iru ato ta kidi ki tagley tin, ki satununey tin tu nay ka ata mukwa ti Ramaan, mama ki nikavagangoen tin ta a'teni ka ayanay, kumahina nikavagangoen tin nenian tu kidi ki limulimu.

2.niv: The evening meal was in progress, and the devil had already prompted Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot, to betray Jesus.
2.cmn: 吃晚飯的時候，魔鬼已將賣耶穌的意思放在西門的兒子加略人猶大心裏。
2.sry: Iru ka ikahaan ta Hiadudengan (du nipurarig ta Litu tu tintin ti Yudas ka ti Simon Iskariyut ki sivanavanaey tin tenian)

3.niv: Jesus knew that the Father had put all things under his power, and that he had come from God and was returning to God;
3.cmn: 耶穌知道父已將萬有交在他手裏，且知道自己是從上帝出來的，又要歸到上帝那裏去，
3.sry: Du kavanaen ti Yesus ka nipahaimiden ta mamang piga ki Rama tu rima tenian, ka nipakakwaan tin ki Alid, ka milikuga lapa mukwa ki Alid,

4.niv: so he got up from the meal, took off his outer clothing, and wrapped a towel around his waist.
4.cmn: 就離席站起來，脫了衣服，拿一條手巾束腰，
4.sry: Nigapit [ta ti Yesus] ki Hiadudengan, ka nitmura ki kulamug [tin,] ka du ara tin ta ait, nimait tenian.

5.niv: After that, he poured water into a basin and began to wash his disciplesʼ feet, drying them with the towel that was wrapped around him.
5.cmn: 隨後把水倒在盆裏，就洗門徒的腳，並用自己所束的手巾擦乾。
5.sry: Siawug ki ana niduduen tin ta ralum tu padadiayan, ka nimadiay ki rapal ki patatawutawugan, ka nirikag apa ki ait ka aitan tin.

6.niv: He came to Simon Peter, who said to him, “Lord, are you going to wash my feet?”
6.cmn: 挨到西門‧彼得，彼得對他說：「主啊，你洗我的腳嗎？」
6.sry: Anata nimukwa ti Simon Petrusan, ka teni ta nikuma tenian, Meyrang, padiayey muho kawa ta rapal aw?

7.niv: Jesus replied, “You do not realize now what I am doing, but later you will understand.”
7.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「我所做的，你如今不知道，後來必明白。」
7.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma tenian, Asi kaw mumha hinin ta ringey aw, ra mumhaa kaw ruruman.

8.niv: “No,” said Peter, “you shall never wash my feet.” Jesus answered, “Unless I wash you, you have no part with me.”
8.cmn: 彼得說：「你永不可洗我的腳！」耶穌說：「我若不洗你，你就與我無分了。」
8.sry: Nikuma ta ti Petrus tenian, Asi kaw madiayaki rapal aw lato ikakwan midarinug. Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus tenian, Hairu asi ko madiay imhuan, ausia kaw ki atag lam yawan.

9.niv: “Then, Lord,” Simon Peter replied, “not just my feet but my hands and my head as well!”
9.cmn: 西門‧彼得說：「主啊，不但我的腳，連手和頭也要洗。」
9.sry: Nikuma ta ti Simon Petrus tenian, Meyrang, asi dik ki rapal aw, ra ki rima ki vungo apa.

10.niv: Jesus answered, “Those who have had a bath need only to wash their feet; their whole body is clean. And you are clean, though not every one of you.”
10.cmn: 耶穌說：「凡洗過澡的人，只要把腳一洗，全身就乾淨了。你們是乾淨的，然而不都是乾淨的。」
10.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Timamang ta nimiawlug asi mayaapo dik ki padiayen ki rapal: ra matumuk ato makuptig. Ka makuptig kamu ra asi maimid.

11.niv: For he knew who was going to betray him, and that was why he said not every one was clean.
11.cmn: 耶穌原知道要賣他的是誰，所以說：「你們不都是乾淨的。」
11.sry: Ka kavanaen tin timang ta sivanavanaa tenian: aley ki ana ka kun tin, Asi kamu maimid makuptig.

12.niv: When he had finished washing their feet, he put on his clothes and returned to his place. “Do you understand what I have done for you?” he asked them.
12.cmn: 耶穌洗完了他們的腳，就穿上衣服，又坐下，對他們說：「我向你們所做的，你們明白嗎？
12.sry: Iru ka nimadiay ato ki rapal nein, ka ru nialikug ki pamamian tin, nimila mirung tu avokan, ka ni kuma nenian, “Mumha kamu kawa ki na ringey aw imumian?

13.niv: “You call me ‘Teacher’ and ‘Lord,’ and rightly so, for that is what I am.
13.cmn: 你們稱呼我夫子，稱呼我主，你們說的不錯，我本來是。
13.sry: Mananang kamu yawan Matawtawug ki Meyrang apa, ka mariyang kamu ki su aley ka ti yaw ka ana.

14.niv: Now that I, your Lord and Teacher, have washed your feet, you also should wash one anotherʼs feet.
14.cmn: 我是你們的主，你們的夫子，尚且洗你們的腳，你們也當彼此洗腳。
14.sry: Hairu ka nimadiay ko ti yaw ka Meyrang ki Matatawtawug apa ki rapal umi, anata kidi ato ka patitavatavagey mumi madiay ta r apapal umi.

15.niv: I have set you an example that you should do as I have done for you.
15.cmn: 我給你們作了榜樣，叫你們照着我向你們所做的去做。
15.sry: Ka nipapeykunungen aw kamu ra, mama ka nipamuten aw, ka meykumaa kamu hina ta imumi.

16.niv: Very truly I tell you, no servant is greater than his master, nor is a messenger greater than the one who sent him.
16.cmn: 我實實在在地告訴你們，僕人不能大於主人，差人也不能大於差他的人。
16.sry: Mising, mising kun aw kamu, Asi masaun tu vavaw ki kidi ta kungcia ki Meyrang tin, asi masaun tu vavaw ki kidi ta nipadadingien ki nimadingi tenian.

17.niv: Now that you know these things, you will be blessed if you do them.
17.cmn: 你們既知道這事，若是去行就有福了。
17.sry: Hairu mavana kamu ki mamang ka ata, tamatagiriyang kamu ru pamuten umi ta ata.

18.niv: “I am not referring to all of you; I know those I have chosen. But this is to fulfill this passage of Scripture: ‘He who shared my bread has turned against me.’
18.cmn: 我這話不是指着你們眾人說的，我知道我所揀選的是誰。現在要應驗經上的話，說：『同我吃飯的人用腳踢我。』
18.sry: Asi ko matagisal imumian: kavanaen aw na mamang ta niperi aw: ra aley apa ka pavawutaw ta na Sasulat, Teni ka milam ki paul yawan, nipul’ey ki nguro tin maawduma yawan.

19.niv: “I am telling you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe that I am who I am.
19.cmn: 如今事情還沒有成就，我要先告訴你們，叫你們到事情成就的時候可以信我是基督。
19.sry: Vanavanaen aw kamu hinin, ru asi apa pavawuten, aley ka ru nipavut ato, ka tnamisinga kamu ka ti yaw ka ana.

20.niv: Very truly I tell you, whoever accepts anyone I send accepts me; and whoever accepts me accepts the one who sent me.”
20.cmn: 我實實在在地告訴你們，有人接待我所差遣的，就是接待我；接待我，就是接待那差遣我的。」 預言自己將被出賣 （太26‧20－25；可14‧17－21；路22‧21－23）
20.sry: Mising, mising kun aw kamu ra, Hairu paitatalag ta ti mamang ki padadingienaw, teni ta paitatalag yawan, timamang apa ta paitatalag yawan, teni ta paitatalag yawan, teni ta paitatalag tenian ka nimadingi yawan.

21.niv: After he had said this, Jesus was troubled in spirit and testified, “Very truly I tell you, one of you is going to betray me.”
21.cmn: 耶穌說了這話，心裏憂愁，就明說：「我實實在在地告訴你們，你們中間有一個人要賣我了。」
21.sry: Iru ka matagikaha ta ti Yesus ki mamang ka ata, miringaw lato ki vulas tu rig tin, ka nihmail matagiamag, ka nikun tin, Mising, mising kunaw kamu, saasat imumian ta sivanavanaa yawan.

22.niv: His disciples stared at one another, at a loss to know which of them he meant.
22.cmn: 門徒彼此對看，猜不透所說的是誰。
22.sry: Anata nimasatatimi ta patatawutawugan, padalag timang lava ta patagimimimien tin.

23.niv: One of them, the disciple whom Jesus loved, was reclining next to him.
23.cmn: 有一個門徒，是耶穌所愛的，側身挨近耶穌的懷裏。
23.sry: Ka sasat ki patatawutawugan tin ta nigeni ki vungo tu ayva ti Yesus, ka kavagangoen ti Yesus.

24.niv: Simon Peter motioned to this disciple and said, “Ask him which one he means.”
24.cmn: 西門‧彼得點頭對他說：「你告訴我們，主是指着誰說的。」
24.sry: Teni ta tikpaten ti Simon Petrus ka tagitaligaw tin, timang lava ta nipatagimimia tin.

25.niv: Leaning back against Jesus, he asked him, “Lord, who is it?”
25.cmn: 那門徒便就勢靠着耶穌的胸膛，問他說：「主啊，是誰呢？」
25.sry: Ka teni ka ana ta nigeni tu avaw ti Yesus kuma tenian, Meyrang, timang ta teni ka ana?

26.niv: Jesus answered, “It is the one to whom I will give this piece of bread when I have dipped it in the dish.” Then, dipping the piece of bread, he gave it to Judas, the son of Simon Iscariot.
26.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「我蘸一點餅給誰，就是誰。」耶穌就蘸了一點餅，遞給加略人西門的兒子猶大。
26.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, teni ta ti ana ka pigaey maw ki napi ka na dadauken aw: Iru ka nidadauk tin ta napi, nipigaen tin ti Yudasan ka ti Simon Iskariyut.

27.niv: As soon as Judas took the bread, Satan entered into him. So Jesus told him, “What you are about to do, do quickly.”
27.cmn: 他吃了以後，撒但就入了他的心。耶穌便對他說：「你所做的，快做吧！」
27.sry: Ka ru niara tin ta napi ka ana, nisararbu ta Litu tenian, Kamamang ka pamutey muho madisa.

28.niv: But no one at the meal understood why Jesus said this to him.
28.cmn: 同席的人沒有一個知道是為甚麼對他說這話。
28.sry: Ka asi mumha ki ata ta timamang nenian ka mirung hina, Aley kimang ka pasusuen tin [ta ata] tenian.

29.niv: Since Judas had charge of the money, some thought Jesus was telling him to buy what was needed for the festival, or to give something to the poor.
29.cmn: 有人因猶大帶着錢囊，以為耶穌是對他說：「你去買我們過節所應用的東西」，或是叫他拿甚麼賙濟窮人。
29.sry: Ka nipagdimdim ta raruma, aley ka meypauti ta ti Yudas, ka pasusuen ti Yesus tenian, Peylaa ato ki mayaapo kita tu uvavatugan, ka pigaa lato lava ta teni ki mamang ki malimuk.

30.niv: As soon as Judas had taken the bread, he went out. And it was night.
30.cmn: 猶大受了那點餅，立刻就出去。那時候是夜間了。 新的命令
30.sry: Iru ka niara tin ta napi ka ana nimadis samamala. Ka awvanan ta kidi.

31.niv: When he was gone, Jesus said, “Now the Son of Man is glorified and God is glorified in him.
31.cmn: 他既出去，耶穌就說：「如今人子得了榮耀，上帝在人子身上也得了榮耀。
31.sry: Iru ka nisamamala ta teni, nikuma ta ti Yesus, Puvavawen ato hinin ki kidi ta Alak ki kagulung, ka puvavawen apa ki kidi ta Alid tenian.

32.niv: If God is glorified in him, God will glorify the Son in himself, and will glorify him at once.
32.cmn: 上帝要因自己榮耀人子，並且要快快地榮耀他。
32.sry: Hairu nipuvavawen ki kidi ta Alid tenian puvavawa lapa ki kidi tenian, ta Alid tenian mamadu, ka pudisa puvavaw ki kidi tenian.

33.niv: “My children, I will be with you only a little longer. You will look for me, and just as I told the Jews, so I tell you now: Where I am going, you cannot come.
33.cmn: 小子們，我還有不多的時候與你們同在；後來你們要找我，但我所去的地方你們不能到。這話我曾對猶太人說過，如今也照樣對你們說。
33.sry: Kaalalak, asi madalia ka ayalam apa ko imumian. Kmiima kamu yawan ka mama ki nipasusuen aw ki Yoden, Tu sakakwaey maw asi kamu malpuga irua, Matagi kumahina apa ko hinin imumian.

34.niv: “A new command I give you: Love one another. As I have loved you, so you must love one another.
34.cmn: 我賜給你們一條新命令，乃是叫你們彼此相愛；我怎樣愛你們，你們也要怎樣相愛。
34.sry: Vahaw ki pakusasu ta papa aw imumian, ka maka nanadoa kamu maka vavagango. Mama ki nikavagangoen aw imumian, ka maka nanadoa kamu kumahina maka vavagango.

35.niv: By this everyone will know that you are my disciples, if you love one another.”
35.cmn: 你們若有彼此相愛的心，眾人因此就認出你們是我的門徒了。」 預言彼得不認主 （太26‧ 31 －35；可14‧27 －31；路22‧31－34）
35.sry: Tu ata kimida ta neni kmalang, ka Patatawtawwugan aw kamu ta imumi, du maka nanado kamu maka vavagango.

36.niv: Simon Peter asked him, “Lord, where are you going?” Jesus replied, “Where I am going, you cannot follow now, but you will follow later.”
36.cmn: 西門‧彼得問耶穌說：「主往哪裏去？」耶穌回答說：「我所去的地方，你現在不能跟我去，後來卻要跟我去。」
36.sry: Nikuma ta ti Simon Petrus tenian, Meyrang, dmaranga kaw mukwa tumang? Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus tenian, Tu sakakwaey maw, asi kaw smalalpug hinin smaladilug yawan: ra smaladiluga kaw du rumang.

37.niv: Peter asked, “Lord, why canʼt I follow you now? I will lay down my life for you.”
37.cmn: 彼得說：「主啊，我為甚麼現在不能跟你去？我願意為你捨命！」
37.sry: Nikuma ta ti Petrus tenian, Meyrang, kaumang ka asi ko smalalpug hinin smaladilug imhuan? pukwaa ko puvli imhuan ki kawagan aw.

38.niv: Then Jesus answered, “Will you really lay down your life for me? Very truly I tell you, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times!
38.cmn: 耶穌說：「你願意為我捨命嗎？我實實在在地告訴你，雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」
38.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus tenian, Pukwaey mhu kawa publi yawan ta kawagan hu? Mising, mising kun naw kaw, asi munia ta tafuka ru asi kaw taturu lato rmaw yawan.

1.niv: “Do not let your hearts be troubled. You believe in God ; believe also in me.
1.cmn: 「你們心裏不要憂愁；你們信上帝，也當信我。
1.sry: Ina miringaw ki vulas tu tintin umi: tnamising kamu ki Alid, tnamisinga apa yawan.

2.niv: My Fatherʼs house has many rooms; if that were not so, would I have told you that I am going there to prepare a place for you?
2.cmn: 在我父的家裏有許多住處；若是沒有，我就早已告訴你們了。我去原是為你們預備地方去。
2.sry: Tu talag ki Rama aw ta madag ko itukakwaan: ru asi kumahina ina ko banavana imumian: mukwa ko tmanang ki itukwaan ka itukwaey mumi.

3.niv: And if I go and prepare a place for you, I will come back and take you to be with me that you also may be where I am.
3.cmn: 我若去為你們預備了地方，就必再來接你們到我那裏去，我在哪裏，叫你們也在那裏。
3.sry: Iru ka dmaranga lato mukwa tmanang imumian ki itukwaan, salikuga ko mara imumian paukwa imumian, aley ka ayakwa imumian, aley ka ayakwaa lapa kamu ta imumi tu ayakwaey maw.

4.niv: You know the way to the place where I am going.”
4.cmn: 我往哪裏去，你們知道；那條路，你們也知道。」
4.sry: Ka tumang ka sakakwaey maw mavana kamu, kamumha kamu ki darang.

5.niv: Thomas said to him, “Lord, we donʼt know where you are going, so how can we know the way?”
5.cmn: 多馬對他說：「主啊，我們不知道你往哪裏去，怎麼知道那條路呢？」
5.sry: Nikuma ta ti Tomas tenian, “Meyrang, asi kame mavana tumang ta sakakwaey mhu: kamulpug kame mama ki mang mumha ki darang?

6.niv: Jesus answered, “I am the way and the truth and the life. No one comes to the Father except through me.
6.cmn: 耶穌說：「我就是道路、真理、生命；若不藉着我，沒有人能到父那裏去。
6.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, “Ti yaw ta darang, ki kadiligan, ki kawagan apa. Asi mukwa ta timamang ki Ramaan, dik aley yawan.

7.niv: If you really know me, you will know my Father as well. From now on, you do know him and have seen him.”
7.cmn: 你們若認識我，也就認識我的父。從今以後，你們認識他，並且已經看見他。」
7.sry: Hairu kmalang kamu yawan, ina kamu kalang ato ki Rama aw: ka hinin kmalang kamu tenian, ka nikmita kamu tenian.”

8.niv: Philip said, “Lord, show us the Father and that will be enough for us.”
8.cmn: 腓力對他說：「求主將父顯給我們看，我們就知足了。」
8.sry: Nikuma ta ti Filipus tenian, Meyrang, pakitaaw kame ki Rama, ka mamsinga lato imianan.

9.niv: Jesus answered: “Donʼt you know me, Philip, even after I have been among you such a long time? Anyone who has seen me has seen the Father. How can you say, ‘Show us the Father’?
9.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「腓力，我與你們同在這樣長久，你還不認識我嗎？人看見了我，就是看見了父；你怎麼說『將父顯給我們看』呢？
9.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Maka kumahina ki dalia ka ayalam ko imumian, ka asi kaw kmalang yawan, Filipus? Timamang ta nikmita yawan, nikmita apa ki Rama: ka matagimang kaw, pakitaaw kame ki Rama?

10.niv: Donʼt you believe that I am in the Father, and that the Father is in me? The words I say to you I do not speak on my own authority. Rather, it is the Father, living in me, who is doing his work.
10.cmn: 我在父裏面，父在我裏面，你不信嗎？我對你們所說的話，不是憑着自己說的，乃是住在我裏面的父做他自己的事。
10.sry: Asi kaw kawa tnamising ka itukwaen aw ki Rama, ka itukwa apa ta rama yawan? Su ka ata ka pasusuen aw imumian, asi ko sikunung masusu, ra Rama apa ka mayali yawan, teni ta pamut ki ringey.

11.niv: Believe me when I say that I am in the Father and the Father is in me; or at least believe on the evidence of the works themselves.
11.cmn: 你們當信我，我在父裏面，父在我裏面；即或不信，也當因我所做的事信我。
11.sry: Tnamisinga yawan, ka itukwa ko ki Rama, ka itukwa apa ta Rama yawan, ka hairu asi, anata tnamisinga yawan aley ki ringey mamado.

12.niv: Very truly I tell you, whoever believes in me will do the works I have been doing, and they will do even greater things than these, because I am going to the Father.
12.cmn: 我實實在在地告訴你們，我所做的事，信我的人也要做，並且要做比這更大的事，因為我往父那裏去。
12.sry: Mising, mising kun aw kamu ra, timamang ta tnamising yawan, ringey ka ana ka pamuten aw, pamutaw lapa tin, ka misauna lapa ki ana. Ka dmarang ko mukwa ki Ramaan:

13.niv: And I will do whatever you ask in my name, so that the Father may be glorified in the Son.
13.cmn: 你們奉我的名無論求甚麼，我必成就，叫父因兒子得榮耀。
13.sry: Ka mamang ka tmumiaey mumi tu Nanang aw, pamutaw maw ka ana: aley ka puvavawey ki kidi ta Rama tu Alak.

14.niv: You may ask me for anything in my name, and I will do it.
14.cmn: 你們若奉我的名求甚麼，我必成就。」 應許賜聖靈
14.sry: Hairu tmumimia kamu ki mamang tu Nanang aw, pamutaw maw ka ana.

15.niv: “If you love me, keep my commands.
15.cmn: 「你們若愛我，就必遵守我的命令。
15.sry: Hairu mavagango kamu yawan, hmaa ato ki pakusuen aw.

16.niv: And I will ask the Father, and he will give you another advocate to help you and be with you forever—
16.cmn: 我要求父，父就另外賜給你們一位保惠師，叫他永遠與你們同在，
16.sry: Ka tmumimia ko ki Rama, ka pigaa ki Tam apakahaniap ka pani imumian tu ikakwan midarinug.

17.niv: the Spirit of truth. The world cannot accept him, because it neither sees him nor knows him. But you know him, for he lives with you and will be in you.
17.cmn: 就是真理的聖靈，乃世人不能接受的；因為不見他，也不認識他。你們卻認識他，因他常與你們同在，也要在你們裏面。
17.sry: Tenian ka Yupan ki katiktikan ki su, ka asi atalpugen matarig ki nay, aley ka asi kmita tenian, ka asi kmalang tenian: ra kmalang kamu tenian ta imumi, ka mayali ta teni imumian, ka itukwaa lapa imumian.

18.niv: I will not leave you as orphans; I will come to you.
18.cmn: 我不撇下你們為孤兒，我必到你們這裏來。
18.sry: Asi ko patusinaga imumian: salikuga ko mukwa imumian.

19.niv: Before long, the world will not see me anymore, but you will see me. Because I live, you also will live.
19.cmn: 還有不多的時候，世人不再看見我，你們卻看見我；因為我活着，你們也要活着。
19.sry: Asi madalia ka asi kmitaa yawan ta nay: ra kmitaa kamu yawan ta imumi: Aley ka mawag ko, ka mawaga kamu ta imumi.

20.niv: On that day you will realize that I am in my Father, and you are in me, and I am in you.
20.cmn: 到那日，你們就知道我在父裏面，你們在我裏面，我也在你們裏面。
20.sry: Tu wagi ka ana kmalanga kamu, ka [itukwa] ko ki Rama, ka [itukwa] kamu yawan, ka [itukwa apa] ko imumian.

21.niv: Whoever has my commands and keeps them is the one who loves me. The one who loves me will be loved by my Father, and I too will love them and show myself to them.”
21.cmn: 有了我的命令又遵守的，這人就是愛我的；愛我的必蒙我父愛他，我也要愛他，並且要向他顯現。」
21.sry: Timamang ta akumeya ki pakusuen aw, ka hmaa apa ki ana, teni ta mavagango yawan: ka timamang ta mavagango yawan, teni ta ka mavagangoey ki Raraman aw: ka mavagangoa ko tenian, ka pakamadoey maw yawan pakaamag tenian.

22.niv: Then Judas (not Judas Iscariot) said, “But, Lord, why do you intend to show yourself to us and not to the world?”
22.cmn: 猶大（不是加略人猶大）問耶穌說：「主啊，為甚麼要向我們顯現，不向世人顯現呢？」
22.sry: Nikuma tenian ta ti Yudas, asi ti Iskariyut, “Meyrang, kamang ka ana, ka pakamadoey muho imhuan pakaamag imianan, asi pakaamag ki nay?

23.niv: Jesus replied, “Anyone who loves me will obey my teaching. My Father will love them, and we will come to them and make our home with them.
23.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「人若愛我，就必遵守我的道；我父也必愛他，並且我們要到他那裏去，與他同住。
23.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma tenian, Timamang ta mavagango yawan, hmaaa ki su aw: ka rama aw ta mavagangoa tenian, ka mukwaa kame tenian, ka itukakwaa kame tenian.

24.niv: Anyone who does not love me will not obey my teaching. These words you hear are not my own; they belong to the Father who sent me.
24.cmn: 不愛我的人就不遵守我的道。你們所聽見的道不是我的，乃是差我來之父的道。
24.sry: Timamang ta asi mavagango yawan, asi hmaa ki su aw. Ka su ka ata ka ilingigen umi, asi a'yaw, ra a'tu Rama apa, ka nimadingi yawan.

25.niv: “All this I have spoken while still with you.
25.cmn: 「我還與你們同住的時候，已將這些話對你們說了。
25.sry: Pasusuen ato maw kamu ki mamang k’ata du mayali apa ko imumian.

26.niv: But the Advocate, the Holy Spirit, whom the Father will send in my name, will teach you all things and will remind you of everything I have said to you.
26.cmn: 但保惠師，就是父因我的名所要差來的聖靈，他要將一切的事指教你們，並且要叫你們想起我對你們所說的一切話。
26.sry: Ra Tam apakahaniap ka YUPAN, ka padingiey ki Rama tu Nanang aw, teni ta makuatiga makuamis imumian, ka pahibaleya lapa ki mamang ka na su aw imumian.

27.niv: Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid.
27.cmn: 我留下平安給你們；我將我的平安賜給你們。我所賜的，不像世人所賜的。你們心裏不要憂愁，也不要膽怯。
27.sry: Reya ta atakwaen aw imumian, reya aw ta papiga aw imumian: asi mama ka papigaen ki nay, ta papapa aw ka ana imumian. ina miringaw ki vulas tu tintin umi, ina matakut.

28.niv: “You heard me say, ‘I am going away and I am coming back to you.’ If you loved me, you would be glad that I am going to the Father, for the Father is greater than I.
28.cmn: 你們聽見我對你們說了，我去還要到你們這裏來。你們若愛我，因我到父那裏去，就必喜樂，因為父是比我大的。
28.sry: Nimilingig kamu ka nipasusuen aw imumian, dmarang ko, ka salikuga ko mukwa imumian. Hairu ra mavagango ato kamu yawan, ina kamu karay aley ka na su aw, Dmarang ko mukwa ki Ramaan: ka Rama aw ta siuru ituvavaw ki kidi yawan.

29.niv: I have told you now before it happens, so that when it does happen you will believe.
29.cmn: 現在事情還沒有成就，我預先告訴你們，叫你們到事情成就的時候就可以信。
29.sry: Ka nivanavanaen aw kamu hinin ru asi apa pavawuten, aley ka ru pavut ato, ka tnamisinga kamu ra.

30.niv: I will not say much more to you, for the prince of this world is coming. He has no hold over me,
30.cmn: 以後我不再和你們多說話，因為這世界的王將到。他在我裏面是毫無所有；
30.sry: Asi ko matagit apanga hinin ki su imumian: aley ka irarurua ta Meysasu ki nay ka ata, ra ausi ta teni ki mamang yawan.

31.niv: but he comes so that the world may learn that I love the Father and do exactly what my Father has commanded me. “Come now; let us leave.
31.cmn: 但要叫世人知道我愛父，並且父怎樣吩咐我，我就怎樣行。起來，我們走吧！」
31.sry: Aley apa kamumhaa ta nay ka kavagangoen aw ta Rama, ka pamut ko kumahina mama ki nipakusuen ki Rama yawan. Gapita, dmarang kita hiya.

1.niv: “I am the true vine, and my Father is the gardener.
1.cmn: 「我是真葡萄樹，我父是栽培的人。
1.sry: Ti yaw ta na ngara ka dilig ki karawmata, ka tamatalum ta Raman aw.

2.niv: He cuts off every branch in me that bears no fruit, while every branch that does bear fruit he prunes so that it will be even more fruitful.
2.cmn: 凡屬我不結果子的枝子，他就剪去；凡結果子的，他就修理乾淨，使枝子結果子更多。
2.sry: Imid ki pehil ka itukwa yawan asi makavua, hamian tin ta ana, ka imid ka makavua, pakakuptigen tin, aley ka makasauna makavua.

3.niv: You are already clean because of the word I have spoken to you.
3.cmn: 現在你們因我講給你們的道，已經乾淨了。
3.sry: Makuptig kamu hinin ta imumi, aley ki su, ka nipasusuen aw imumian.

4.niv: Remain in me, as I also remain in you. No branch can bear fruit by itself; it must remain in the vine. Neither can you bear fruit unless you remain in me.
4.cmn: 你們要常在我裏面，我也常在你們裏面。枝子若不常在葡萄樹上，自己就不能結果子；你們若不常在我裏面，也是這樣。
4.sry: Mayalia yawan, ti yaw apa imumian da. Mama ka asi makalpug makavua sikunung ta pehil, ru asi mayali ki na ngara ki karawmata: kuma apa kamu ta imumi asi makalpug, ru asi kamu mayali yawan.

5.niv: “I am the vine; you are the branches. If you remain in me and I in you, you will bear much fruit; apart from me you can do nothing.
5.cmn: 我是葡萄樹，你們是枝子。常在我裏面的，我也常在他裏面，這人就多結果子；因為離了我，你們就不能做甚麼。
5.sry: Ti yaw ta na ngara ki karawmata, imumi ra ta pehil: timamang ta mayali yawan, ti yaw apa tenian, teni ta maka at apang makavua: aley ka du ausi ko asi kamu peylpug pamut kamamang.

6.niv: If you do not remain in me, you are like a branch that is thrown away and withers; such branches are picked up, thrown into the fire and burned.
6.cmn: 人若不常在我裏面，就像枝子丟在外面枯乾，人拾起來，扔在火裏燒了。
6.sry: Timamang ta asi mayali yawan, sakitawagen mama ki pehil ka milaklak ato: ka paliliden smakikwa tu apuy pailamag.

7.niv: If you remain in me and my words remain in you, ask whatever you wish, and it will be done for you.
7.cmn: 你們若常在我裏面，我的話也常在你們裏面，凡你們所願意的，祈求，就給你們成就。
7.sry: Hairu mayali kamu yawan, ka ru mayali imumian ta su aw, kamamang ka kamuyey mumi, tmumiaa ato, ka paamutey imumian.

8.niv: This is to my Fatherʼs glory, that you bear much fruit, showing yourselves to be my disciples.
8.cmn: 你們多結果子，我父就因此得榮耀，你們也就是我的門徒了。
8.sry: Tu ata puvavawen ato ki kidi ta Rama aw, ka maka t apang kamu makavua: ka patatawtawugey maw kamu.

9.niv: “As the Father has loved me, so have I loved you. Now remain in my love.
9.cmn: 我愛你們，正如父愛我一樣；你們要常在我的愛裏。
9.sry: Mama ki nikavagangoen ko ki Rama, nimavagango apa ko imumian: mayalia tu kavagangoen aw ka ata.

10.niv: If you keep my commands, you will remain in my love, just as I have kept my Fatherʼs commands and remain in his love.
10.cmn: 你們若遵守我的命令，就常在我的愛裏，正如我遵守了我父的命令，常在他的愛裏。
10.sry: Hairu hmaa kamu ki pakusuen aw, mayalia kamu tu vagango aw: mama ki nihaaw ta pakusasu ki Raman aw, ka mayali ko tu vagango tin.

11.niv: I have told you this so that my joy may be in you and that your joy may be complete.
11.cmn: 「這些事我已經對你們說了，是要叫我的喜樂存在你們心裏，並叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。
11.sry: Ka mamang ka ata ta nipasusuen aw imumian, aley ka mayalia imumian ta karayen aw, ka pavawutaw lapa ta karay umi.

12.niv: My command is this: Love each other as I have loved you.
12.cmn: 你們要彼此相愛，像我愛你們一樣；這就是我的命令。
12.sry: Ata ta pakusuen aw, ka maka nanadoa kamu maka vagango, mama ka nikavagango imumian.

13.niv: Greater love has no one than this: to lay down oneʼs life for oneʼs friends.
13.cmn: 人為朋友捨命，人的愛心沒有比這個大的。
13.sry: Ausi ta timamang ki kavagangoen ka siuru irang dik ki ata, ka pukwaan tin ta kawagan tin aley ki riu tin.

14.niv: You are my friends if you do what I command.
14.cmn: 你們若遵行我所吩咐的，就是我的朋友了。
14.sry: Riua maw kamu ta imumi, ru pamuten umi ta pakusuen aw imumian.

15.niv: I no longer call you servants, because a servant does not know his masterʼs business. Instead, I have called you friends, for everything that I learned from my Father I have made known to you.
15.cmn: 以後我不再稱你們為僕人，因僕人不知道主人所做的事。我乃稱你們為朋友；因我從我父所聽見的，已經都告訴你們了。
15.sry: Asi ko kuncia nikuma imumian: ka asi mavana ta kungcia ki pengas ki Meyrang tin: riu aw nikwaaw kamu ra, aley ka kamamang ka niilingigen aw ti Ramaan, nipaumha ko imumian.

16.niv: You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you so that you might go and bear fruit—fruit that will last—and so that whatever you ask in my name the Father will give you.
16.cmn: 不是你們揀選了我，是我揀選了你們，並且分派你們去結果子，叫你們的果子常存，使你們奉我的名，無論向父求甚麼，他就賜給你們。
16.sry: Asi kamu niperi yawan, ra ti yaw ta niperi imumian, ka nisikidien aw kamu ka ukwaey mumi makavua, ka mayalia lapa ta vua umi: aley ka ru kamamang ka tmimiey mumi ta Ramaan tu Nanang aw, ka pigaa [ki ana] imumian.

17.niv: This is my command: Love each other.
17.cmn: 我這樣吩咐你們，是要叫你們彼此相愛。」 世人的憎恨
17.sry: Ata ta pakusuen aw kamu, aley ka maka nanadoa kamu maka vavagango.

18.niv: “If the world hates you, keep in mind that it hated me first.
18.cmn: 「世人若恨你們，你們知道，恨你們以先已經恨我了。
18.sry: Hairu mavahir imumian ta nay, mumhaa ka nimavahir ato yawan siuro imumian.

19.niv: If you belonged to the world, it would love you as its own. As it is, you do not belong to the world, but I have chosen you out of the world. That is why the world hates you.
19.cmn: 你們若屬世界，世界必愛屬自己的；只因你們不屬世界，乃是我從世界中揀選了你們，所以世界就恨你們。
19.sry: Hairu maka nay kamu lava, ina kavagangoey ki nay ta a'teni: Ra aley ka asi kamu maka nay ato, niperi apa maw kamu tu nay, aley ki ana mavahir ta nay imumian.

20.niv: Remember what I told you: ‘A servant is not greater than his master.’ If they persecuted me, they will persecute you also. If they obeyed my teaching, they will obey yours also.
20.cmn: 你們要記念我從前對你們所說的話：『僕人不能大於主人。』他們若逼迫了我，也要逼迫你們；若遵守了我的話，也要遵守你們的話。
20.sry: Mibaleya ki na su aw imumian, Asi masaun tu vavaw ki kidi ta kuncia ki Meyrang tin. Hairu nikmudilug ta neni yawan, kmudiluga lapa imumian: hairu nihmaa ta neni ki su aw, hmaaa lapa [ki su] umi.

21.niv: They will treat you this way because of my name, for they do not know the one who sent me.
21.cmn: 但他們因我的名要向你們行這一切的事，因為他們不認識那差我來的。
21.sry: Ra pamutaw nein imid ki mamang ka ata imumian aley ki Nanang aw, aley ka asi nein kalangen ta teni ka nimadingi yawan.

22.niv: If I had not come and spoken to them, they would not be guilty of sin; but now they have no excuse for their sin.
22.cmn: 我若沒有來教訓他們，他們就沒有罪；但如今他們的罪無可推諉了。
22.sry: Hairu niina ko irua masusu nenian, ina ausi ki varaw ta neni: ra hinin aulug ta neni ki tagpagey ta varaw nein.

23.niv: Whoever hates me hates my Father as well.
23.cmn: 恨我的，也恨我的父。
23.sry: Timamang ta mavahier yawan, mavahier apa ki Raraman aw.

24.niv: If I had not done among them the works no one else did, they would not be guilty of sin. As it is, they have seen, and yet they have hated both me and my Father.
24.cmn: 我若沒有在他們中間行過別人未曾行的事，他們就沒有罪；但如今連我與我的父，他們也看見也恨惡了。
24.sry: Hairu niina ko pamut ki na ringey nenian, ka asi nipamuten timamang ka pani, ina ka ausi ta varaw nenian ra hinin nikitaan nein [ta ana], ka nimavahier yawan ti Raraman apa maw ra.

25.niv: But this is to fulfill what is written in their Law: ‘They hated me without reason.’
25.cmn: 這要應驗他們律法上所寫的話，說：『他們無故地恨我。』
25.sry: Aley ka pavawutaw ta su ka na sasulat tu Tatuko nein, nimavahier ta neni yawan tu ausi ki aley.

26.niv: “When the Advocate comes, whom I will send to you from the Father—the Spirit of truth who goes out from the Father—he will testify about me.
26.cmn: 但我要從父那裏差保惠師來，就是從父出來真理的聖靈；他來了，就要為我作見證。
26.sry: Iru ra irua lato ta Tam apakahaniap, ka padingiey maw kamu ti Raman, ta Yupan ki katiktikan ki su, ka paukwaan ki Rama, teni ta gmaila yawan.

27.niv: And you also must testify, for you have been with me from the beginning.
27.cmn: 你們也要作見證，因為你們從起頭就與我同在。」
27.sry: Ka gmaila lapa kamu ta imumi, aley ka nitulam kamu yawan tu naunamu.

1.niv: “All this I have told you so that you will not fall away.
1.cmn: 「我已將這些事告訴你們，使你們不至於跌倒。
1.sry: Ka mamang ka ata nipasusuen aw imumian, aley ka asia kamu pasaisalakuapen.

2.niv: They will put you out of the synagogue; in fact, the time is coming when anyone who kills you will think they are offering a service to God.
2.cmn: 人要把你們趕出會堂，並且時候將到，凡殺你們的就以為是事奉上帝。
2.sry: Putawaga ta neni imumian ki Pakuisasalan: ra irua ta kidi ki tagley, ka veyag ka pakapatayaimumian, padimdimey tin kailigaw [ ki ana] tmamud ki Alid.

3.niv: They will do such things because they have not known the Father or me.
3.cmn: 他們這樣行，是因未曾認識父，也未曾認識我。
3.sry: Ka paamutey nein ta kamamang ka ata imumian, aley ka asi nein nikalangen ta Rama ti yaw apa ki ruma.

4.niv: I have told you this, so that when their time comes you will remember that I warned you about them. I did not tell you this from the beginning because I was with you,
4.cmn: 我將這事告訴你們，是叫你們到了時候可以想起我對你們說過了。」 聖靈的工作 「我起先沒有將這事告訴你們，因為我與你們同在。
4.sry: Ra nipasusuen naw kamu ki mamang ka ata, aley ka ru irua lato ta kidi ki tagley, ka mibaleya kamu ki nivanavanaen aw imumian: ra asi maw nipasusuen imumian ta mamang ka ata tu naunamu kalahey, aley ka itulam apa ko imumian.

5.niv: but now I am going to him who sent me. None of you asks me, ‘Where are you going?’
5.cmn: 現今我往差我來的父那裏去，你們中間並沒有人問我：『你往哪裏去？』
5.sry: Ka hinin dmarang ko mukwa tenian ka nimadingi yawan, ka asi tmalig yawan ta timamang imumian, “dmarang kaw mukwa tumang?”

6.niv: Rather, you are filled with grief because I have said these things.
6.cmn: 只因我將這事告訴你們，你們就滿心憂愁。
6.sry: Ra aley ka nipasusuen aw ta mamang ka ata imumian, patahabunen ato ki vulas ta tintin umi.

7.niv: But very truly I tell you, it is for your good that I am going away. Unless I go away, the Advocate will not come to you; but if I go, I will send him to you.
7.cmn: 然而，我將真情告訴你們，我去是與你們有益的；我若不去，保惠師就不到你們這裏來；我若去，就差他來。
7.sry: Ra matagitiktik ko imumian, mariyang imumian ka dmarang ko: Nda ru asi ko dmarang, asi irua imumian ta Tam apakahaniap: hairu ra dmarang ko, padingiey maw ta teni paukwa imumian.

8.niv: When he comes, he will prove the world to be in the wrong about sin and righteousness and judgment:
8.cmn: 他既來了，就要叫世人為罪、為義、為審判，自己責備自己。
8.sry: Iru ka irua ato ta teni, pakisaw tin ta nay ki varaw, ka katiktikan, ki dungdungan.

9.niv: about sin, because people do not believe in me;
9.cmn: 為罪，是因他們不信我；
9.sry: Ki varaw, aley ka asi nein tnamisingen yawan:

10.niv: about righteousness, because I am going to the Father, where you can see me no longer;
10.cmn: 為義，是因我往父那裏去，你們就不再見我；
10.sry: Ki katiktikan, aley ka dmarang ko mukwa ti Ramaan, ka asi kamu kmitaa lato yawan:

11.niv: and about judgment, because the prince of this world now stands condemned.
11.cmn: 為審判，是因這世界的王受了審判。
11.sry: Ki dungdungan, aley ka kahaanein ato dmungdung ta Maisasu ki nay ka ata.

12.niv: “I have much more to say to you, more than you can now bear.
12.cmn: 「我還有好些事要告訴你們，但你們現在擔當不了。
12.sry: Madag apa ko ki ina maw ka su imumian, ra asi kamu ilpug tubug hinin.

13.niv: But when he, the Spirit of truth, comes, he will guide you into all the truth. He will not speak on his own; he will speak only what he hears, and he will tell you what is yet to come.
13.cmn: 只等真理的聖靈來了，他要引導你們明白一切的真理；因為他不是憑自己說的，乃是把他所聽見的都說出來，並要把將來的事告訴你們。
13.sry: Iru ka irua lato ta teni ka Yupan ki katiktikan ki su, teni ta dmiluga imumian tu imid ki katiktikan ki su. Ka asi sikununga niilingen tin, pasusuey tin, kamamang apa ka irua du rumang paumhaey tin imumian.

14.niv: He will glorify me because it is from me that he will receive what he will make known to you.
14.cmn: 他要榮耀我，因為他要將受於我的告訴你們。
14.sry: Teni ta puvavawa ki kidi yawan: ka araaw tin ki na a'yaw, paumha [ki ata] imumian.

15.niv: All that belongs to the Father is mine. That is why I said the Spirit will receive from me what he will make known to you.”
15.cmn: 凡父所有的，都是我的；所以我說，他要將受於我的告訴你們。」 憂愁變為喜樂
15.sry: Ka mamang ka a'tu Rama, a'yaw ta ana: aley ki ata nipasusuen aw, ka araaw tin ki na a'yaw, paumha imumian.

16.niv: Jesus went on to say, “In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me.”
16.cmn: 「等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我。」
16.sry: Asi madalia, ka asia lato kamu kmita yawan: ka mila, asi madalia, ka kmitaa lato kamu yawan, aley ka sakakwaa ko mukwa ti Ramaan.

17.niv: At this, some of his disciples said to one another, “What does he mean by saying, ‘In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me,’ and ‘Because I am going to the Father’?”
17.cmn: 有幾個門徒就彼此說：「他對我們說：『等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我』；又說：『因我往父那裏去。』這是甚麼意思呢？」
17.sry: Anata nimatavatavag ta [raruma ki] patatawutawugan tin, Mang ta pasusuen tin ka ana imitan, asi madalia, ka asia lato kamu kmita yawan: ka mila, asi madalia, ka kmitaa lato kamu yawan: ka, Aley ka sakakwaa ko mukwa ti Ramaan?

18.niv: They kept asking, “What does he mean by ‘a little while’? We donʼt understand what he is saying.”
18.cmn: 門徒彼此說：「他說『等不多時』到底是甚麼意思呢？我們不明白他所說的話。」
18.sry: Ka nikuma ta neni; Mang ta pasusuen tin ka ana; Asi madalia? Asi kita mumha mang ta su tin.

19.niv: Jesus saw that they wanted to ask him about this, so he said to them, “Are you asking one another what I meant when I said, ‘In a little while you will see me no more, and then after a little while you will see me’?
19.cmn: 耶穌看出他們要問他，就說：「我說『等不多時，你們就不得見我；再等不多時，你們還要見我』，你們為這話彼此相問嗎？
19.sry: Ra ti Yesus ka kmalang ki kamuyen nein tmalig tenian, nikuma nenian, Asi Matavatavag kamu ki ata matagitalig, ka nipasusuen naw, madalia ka asia lato kamu kmita yawan: ka mila, Asi madalia, ka kmitaa lato kamu yawan?

20.niv: Very truly I tell you, you will weep and mourn while the world rejoices. You will grieve, but your grief will turn to joy.
20.cmn: 我實實在在地告訴你們，你們將要痛哭、哀號，世人倒要喜樂；你們將要憂愁，然而你們的憂愁要變為喜樂。
20.sry: Mising, mising kun aw kamu ra, tmangitangia kamu rmarungorungo, ra maraya ta nay: ka mavulasa kamu, ra pasilalaey ta kavulasen umi tu karayan.

21.niv: A woman giving birth to a child has pain because her time has come; but when her baby is born she forgets the anguish because of her joy that a child is born into the world.
21.cmn: 婦人生產的時候就憂愁，因為她的時候到了；既生了孩子，就不再記念那苦楚，因為歡喜世上生了一個人。
21.sry: Aku vulas ta ina ru meyraway, aley ka irua ato ta kidi ki tagley tin: Iru ra meykaha meyraway ki alak, asi tin hibaleyen ta nikahimkoan tin, aley ki karayan ka peyrawayen ato ta kagulung tu nay.

22.niv: So with you: Now is your time of grief, but I will see you again and you will rejoice, and no one will take away your joy.
22.cmn: 你們現在也是憂愁，但我要再見你們，你們的心就喜樂了；這喜樂也沒有人能奪去。
22.sry: Ka aku vulas kamu hinin ta imumi, ra milaa ko kmita imumian, ka maraya kamu ki tintin, ka asi maawmia imumian ta timamang ki karayey mumi.

23.niv: In that day you will no longer ask me anything. Very truly I tell you, my Father will give you whatever you ask in my name.
23.cmn: 到那日，你們甚麼也就不問我了。我實實在在地告訴你們，你們若向父求甚麼，他必因我的名賜給你們。
23.sry: Ka tu wagi ka ana asi kamu tmaliga yawan ki mamang. Mising, missing kun aw kamu ra, kamamang ka tmumiaey mumi ti Ramaan tu nanang aw, pigaa ta teni imumian.

24.niv: Until now you have not asked for anything in my name. Ask and you will receive, and your joy will be complete.
24.cmn: 向來你們沒有奉我的名求甚麼，如今你們求，就必得着，叫你們的喜樂可以滿足。」 我已經勝過世界
24.sry: Tu kidi apa hinin asi kamu nitmumimia tu nanang aw: Tmumimia, ka araaw mumi, aley ka pakatmuyaw ta karayan umi.

25.niv: “Though I have been speaking figuratively, a time is coming when I will no longer use this kind of language but will tell you plainly about my Father.
25.cmn: 「這些事，我是用比喻對你們說的；時候將到，我不再用比喻對你們說，乃要將父明明地告訴你們。
25.sry: Ka mamang ka ata nipasusuen naw kamu ki pamikawlawlaan, ra pudingdingey maw kamu pupanag ti Ramaan.

26.niv: In that day you will ask in my name. I am not saying that I will ask the Father on your behalf.
26.cmn: 到那日，你們要奉我的名祈求；我並不對你們說，我要為你們求父。
26.sry: Tu wagi ka ana tmumimia kamu tu Nanang aw, ka asi maw kamu pasusuen, ka tmumimia ko tmumia ti Ramaan aley imumian.

27.niv: No, the Father himself loves you because you have loved me and have believed that I came from God.
27.cmn: 父自己愛你們；因為你們已經愛我，又信我是從父出來的。
27.sry: Ka ti Rama ta mamado mavagango imumian, aley ka nimavagango kamu yawan tnamising ka nipairuakwaen aw mupanag ki Alid.

28.niv: I came from the Father and entered the world; now I am leaving the world and going back to the Father.”
28.cmn: 我從父出來，到了世界；我又離開世界，往父那裏去。」
28.sry: Nitagikwaen aw ki Rama mupanag tu nay, mila takalaa ko ki nay sakakwa ti Ramaan.

29.niv: Then Jesusʼ disciples said, “Now you are speaking clearly and without figures of speech.
29.cmn: 門徒說：「如今你是明說，並不用比喻了。
29.sry: Nikuma tenian ta patatawutawugan tin, Kitaey, matagidingding kaw hnin ki su tu asi ki pamikawlawlawan ki mamang.

30.niv: Now we can see that you know all things and that you do not even need to have anyone ask you questions. This makes us believe that you came from God.”
30.cmn: 現在我們曉得你凡事都知道，也不用人問你，因此我們信你是從上帝出來的。」
30.sry: Kavanaen yan hinin kamuatig kaw mumha ki mamang, ka asi kaw mayaapo ka tagitaligen kaw timamang. Aley ki ana tanamising kame ka nitagikwaen hu makakwa ki Alid.

31.niv: “Do you now believe?” Jesus replied.
31.cmn: 耶穌說：「現在你們信嗎？
31.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus nenian, Tnamising kamu kawa hinin?

32.niv: “A time is coming and in fact has come when you will be scattered, each to your own home. You will leave me all alone. Yet I am not alone, for my Father is with me.
32.cmn: 看哪，時候將到，且是已經到了，你們要分散，各歸自己的地方去，留下我獨自一人；其實我不是獨自一人，因為有父與我同在。
32.sry: Kitaey irua ta kidi ki tagley, ka makaha ato irua hinin, ka papeyavovoakey kamu ta meybuavual tu a'teni, ka paitusaata kamu yawan. Irua apa ka ana ka asi ko tu saat: ka ti Rama ta tulam yawan.

33.niv: “I have told you these things, so that in me you may have peace. In this world you will have trouble. But take heart! I have overcome the world.”
33.cmn: 我將這些事告訴你們，是要叫你們在我裏面有平安。在世上，你們有苦難；但你們可以放心，我已經勝了世界。」
33.sry: Kamamang ka ata nipasusuen aw imumian, aley ka aku reyaa kamu yawan. Akumeyaa kamu tu nay ki sasamukan: ra mashuta ki rig, nitununein aw ta nay.

1.niv: After Jesus said this, he looked toward heaven and prayed: “Father, the hour has come. Glorify your Son, that your Son may glorify you.
1.cmn: 耶穌說了這話，就舉目望天，說：「父啊，時候到了，願你榮耀你的兒子，使兒子也榮耀你；
1.sry: Ata ta nipasusuen ti Yesus, ka nipapasuvavawen tin papasuvavulum ta mata tin, kuma, Rama irua ato ta kidi ki tagley, puvavawaw ki kidi ta Alak oho, aley ka puvavawa lapa ki kidi ta Alak oho imhuan.

2.niv: For you granted him authority over all people that he might give eternal life to all those you have given him.
2.cmn: 正如你曾賜給他權柄管理凡有血氣的，叫他將永生賜給你所賜給他的人。
2.sry: Mama ki nipigaen hu tenian ta lig tu imid ki vaat, aley ka kamamang ka nipigaen hu tenian, pigaey tin nenian ta kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug.

3.niv: Now this is eternal life: that they know you, the only true God, and Jesus Christ, whom you have sent.
3.cmn: 認識你－獨一的真神，並且認識你所差來的耶穌基督，這就是永生。
3.sry: Ata apa ta kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug, ka kmalanga ta neni imhuan dik saasat ki Alid ka dilig, ti Yesusan apa ka ti Kristus ka nipadingien hu.

4.niv: I have brought you glory on earth by finishing the work you gave me to do.
4.cmn: 我在地上已經榮耀你，你所託付我的事，我已成全了。
4.sry: Nipuvavawen aw kaw ki kidi tu nay: nimalimulimu ko ki pengas ka nipigaen aw pakapengas yawan.

5.niv: And now, Father, glorify me in your presence with the glory I had with you before the world began.
5.cmn: 父啊，現在求你使我同你享榮耀，就是未有世界以先，我同你所有的榮耀。
5.sry: Ra hinin puvavawa ki kidi yawan imhu Rama ki kidi ka akumeyaen aw imhuan, ru ausi apa ta nay.

6.niv: “I have revealed you to those whom you gave me out of the world. They were yours; you gave them to me and they have obeyed your word.
6.cmn: 「你從世上賜給我的人，我已將你的名顯明與他們。他們本是你的，你將他們賜給我，他們也遵守了你的道。
6.sry: Nipupanag ko ki Nanang hu tu kagulungan ka nipigaen hu yawan tu nay. Amuho ta neni, ka nipigaen hu ta neni yawan, ka nihma ta neni ki su oho

7.niv: Now they know that everything you have given me comes from you.
7.cmn: 如今他們知道，凡你所賜給我的，都是從你那裏來的；
7.sry: Hinin kmalang ato ta neni kamamang, ka nipigaen hu yawan, ka na a'muho ta ana.

8.niv: For I gave them the words you gave me and they accepted them. They knew with certainty that I came from you, and they believed that you sent me.
8.cmn: 因為你所賜給我的道，我已經賜給他們，他們也領受了，又確實知道，我是從你出來的，並且信你差了我來。
8.sry: Ka su ka ana ka nipigaen hu yawan, na papiga aw nenian, ka dilig ato kmalang ka nitagikwaen aw maka rbo imhuan, ka tnamising ato ta neni ka nipadingien hu yawan.

9.niv: I pray for them. I am not praying for the world, but for those you have given me, for they are yours.
9.cmn: 我為他們祈求，不為世人祈求，卻為你所賜給我的人祈求，因他們本是你的。
9.sry: Tmumimia ko aley nenian: Asi ko tmumimia aley ki nay, ra aley apa nenian ka nipigaen hu yawan, aley ka a'muho ta neni.

10.niv: All I have is yours, and all you have is mine. And glory has come to me through them.
10.cmn: 凡是我的，都是你的；你的也是我的，並且我因他們得了榮耀。
10.sry: Ka imid ki a'yaw, a'muho apa, ka a'muho a'yaw apa: ka nipuvavawen ko ki kidi nenian.

11.niv: I will remain in the world no longer, but they are still in the world, and I am coming to you. Holy Father, protect them by the power of your name, the name you gave me, so that they may be one as we are one.
11.cmn: 從今以後，我不在世上，他們卻在世上；我往你那裏去。聖父啊，求你因你所賜給我的名保守他們，叫他們合而為一像我們一樣。
11.sry: Ka awlug ko hnin tu nay, ra ayanay apa ta neni ka ata, ka mukwaa ko imhuan. Rama ka dilig matiktik, kadingaw ta neni tu Nanang oho, ka nipigaen hu yawan, aley ka sasata ta neni mama imitan.

12.niv: While I was with them, I protected them and kept them safe by that name you gave me. None has been lost except the one doomed to destruction so that Scripture would be fulfilled.
12.cmn: 我與他們同在的時候，因你所賜給我的名保守了他們，我也護衛了他們；其中除了那滅亡之子，沒有一個滅亡的，好叫經上的話得應驗。
12.sry: Du ayalam apa ko nenian tu nay, nikading aw ta neni tu Nanang oho. Neni ka nipigaen hu yawan nikadingen aw, ka asi nitawruma ta timamang nenian, dik ki Alak ki sidadan, aley ka pavawutaw ta na Sasulat.

13.niv: “I am coming to you now, but I say these things while I am still in the world, so that they may have the full measure of my joy within them.
13.cmn: 現在我往你那裏去，我還在世上說這話，是叫他們心裏充滿我的喜樂。
13.sry: Ra hinin mukwa ko imhuan, ka pasusuen aw ta ata tu nay, aley ka pakatmuyaw nenian ta karayen aw.

14.niv: I have given them your word and the world has hated them, for they are not of the world any more than I am of the world.
14.cmn: 我已將你的道賜給他們。世界又恨他們；因為他們不屬世界，正如我不屬世界一樣。
14.sry: Nipigaen aw nenian ta su oho, ka nay ta nimavahier nenian, aley ka asi maka nay ta neni, mama ka asi ko maka nay ti yaw.

15.niv: My prayer is not that you take them out of the world but that you protect them from the evil one.
15.cmn: 我不求你叫他們離開世界，只求你保守他們脫離那惡者。
15.sry: Asi ko tmumimia ki aawmiey muho ta neni tu nay, ra kadingaw lapa muho ta neni ki Tam apakate.

16.niv: They are not of the world, even as I am not of it.
16.cmn: 他們不屬世界，正如我不屬世界一樣。
16.sry: Asi maka nay ta neni mama yawan ka asi ko maka nay.

17.niv: Sanctify them by the truth; your word is truth.
17.cmn: 求你用真理使他們成聖；你的道就是真理。
17.sry: Pakadiligaw pakatiktik ta neni tu katiktikan ki su oho: nda su oho ta katiktikan ki su.

18.niv: As you sent me into the world, I have sent them into the world.
18.cmn: 你怎樣差我到世上，我也照樣差他們到世上。
18.sry: Mama ki nipadadingien hu yawan paukwa tu nay, nipadingi aw kumahina paukwa ta neni tu nay.

19.niv: For them I sanctify myself, that they too may be truly sanctified.
19.cmn: 我為他們的緣故，自己分別為聖，叫他們也因真理成聖。
19.sry: Ka pakamadoen aw pakadilig pakatiktik yawan aley nenian, ki pakadiligey lapa ta neni pakatiktik tu katiktikan ki su.

20.niv: “My prayer is not for them alone. I pray also for those who will believe in me through their message,
20.cmn: 「我不但為這些人祈求，也為那些因他們的話信我的人祈求，
20.sry: Asi ko tmudik tmumimia aley nenian ka ata, ra aley apa nenian ka tnamisinga yawan ki na su nein.

21.niv: that all of them may be one, Father, just as you are in me and I am in you. May they also be in us so that the world may believe that you have sent me.
21.cmn: 使他們都合而為一。正如你父在我裏面，我在你裏面，使他們也在我們裏面，叫世人可以信你差了我來。
21.sry: Aley ka makuayaimida makuisat ta neni, mama imhu Rama yawan, ti yaw apa imhuan, ka makuisaata lapa ta neni imitan: aley ka tnamisinga ta nay ki nipadingien hu yawan.

22.niv: I have given them the glory that you gave me, that they may be one as we are one—
22.cmn: 你所賜給我的榮耀，我已賜給他們，使他們合而為一，像我們合而為一。
22.sry: Ka nipigaen aw nenian ta kairangan ki kidi ka ana papiga oho yawan: aley ka saasata ta neni mama ka saasat kita ta imita.

23.niv: I in them and you in me—so that they may be brought to complete unity. Then the world will know that you sent me and have loved them even as you have loved me.
23.cmn: 我在他們裏面，你在我裏面，使他們完完全全地合而為一，叫世人知道你差了我來，也知道你愛他們如同愛我一樣。
23.sry: Ti yaw nenian imhu apa yawan: aley ka makuitarawuga ta neni makusat, ka kmalanga lapa ta nay, ki nipadingien hu yawan, ka nikavagangoen apa imhu nenian: mama ki nikavagangoen hu yawan.

24.niv: “Father, I want those you have given me to be with me where I am, and to see my glory, the glory you have given me because you loved me before the creation of the world.
24.cmn: 父啊，我在哪裏，願你所賜給我的人也同我在那裏，叫他們看見你所賜給我的榮耀；因為創立世界以前，你已經愛我了。
24.sry: Rama, mamuy ko tu ayakwaey maw, itulam apa yawan ka nipigaen hu yawan: aley ka mararawa ta neni ki kairangen ki kidi aw, ka nipigaen hu yawan, nda nimavagango kaw yawan, ru asi apa nipaitusamdingen ta rarun ki nay.

25.niv: “Righteous Father, though the world does not know you, I know you, and they know that you have sent me.
25.cmn: 公義的父啊，世人未曾認識你，我卻認識你；這些人也知道你差了我來。
25.sry: Rama ka matiktik, asi nikmalang imhuan ta nay: ra ti yaw ta nikmalang imhuan, ka nikmalang apa ta neni ka ata ki nipadingien hu yawan.

26.niv: I have made you known to them, and will continue to make you known in order that the love you have for me may be in them and that I myself may be in them.”
26.cmn: 我已將你的名指示他們，還要指示他們，使你所愛我的愛在他們裏面，我也在他們裏面。」
26.sry: Ka nipakalangen aw nenian ta Nanang oho, ka pakalangey lapa maw: aley ka kavagangoen ka ana ki nikavagangoen hu yawan itukwaa lato nenian, ti yaw apa nenian.

1.niv: When he had finished praying, Jesus left with his disciples and crossed the Kidron Valley. On the other side there was a garden, and he and his disciples went into it.
1.cmn: 耶穌說了這話，就同門徒出去，過了汲淪溪。在那裏有一個園子，他和門徒進去了。
1.sry: Iru matagikaha ta ti Yesus ki mamang ka ata, nitawpapanag lam ki patatawutawugan tin muarug ki karot ki Kedron, ka aku raul hina, ki nisararboen tin ki patatawutawugan apa tin.

2.niv: Now Judas, who betrayed him, knew the place, because Jesus had often met there with his disciples.
2.cmn: 賣耶穌的猶大也知道那地方，因為耶穌和門徒屢次上那裏去聚集。
2.sry: Ka ti Yudas ka nisivanavana tenian, ta mumha apa ki itukwaan ka ana, aley ka vunavunay nimakuisalato hina ta ti Yesus lam ki patatawutawugan tin.

3.niv: So Judas came to the garden, guiding a detachment of soldiers and some officials from the chief priests and the Pharisees. They were carrying torches, lanterns and weapons.
3.cmn: 猶大領了一隊兵，和祭司長並法利賽人的差役，拿着燈籠、火把、兵器，就來到園裏。
3.sry: Iru ka nipatulam ta ti Yudas tenian [ki tamamacit] ki [raruma apa]ka Kuncia ki Tamapigik ka Sibavaw, ki Farizeen apa, niirua hina meykwa ki pataawingan, ki awnam ka taawingan, ki peykakwaan apa macit.

4.niv: Jesus, knowing all that was going to happen to him, went out and asked them, “Who is it you want?”
4.cmn: 耶穌知道將要臨到自己的一切事，就出來對他們說：「你們找誰？」
4.sry: Ka du kavanaan ti Yesus ta mamang ka pairuaey tenian, nitawpapanag ta teni kuma nenian, Timang ta kiimen umi?

5.niv: “Jesus of Nazareth,” they replied. “I am he,” Jesus said. (And Judas the traitor was standing there with them.)
5.cmn: 他們回答說：「找拿撒勒人耶穌。」耶穌說：「我就是！」賣他的猶大也同他們站在那裏。
5.sry: Nimatagivli ta neni tenian, “Ti Yesusan ka maka Nazareth.” Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, “Ti yaw ka ata.” Ka ti Yudas ka sivanavana tenian, ta itulam apa nenian mituko.

6.niv: When Jesus said, “I am he,” they drew back and fell to the ground.
6.cmn: 耶穌一說「我就是」，他們就退後倒在地上。
6.sry: Iru ka matagikumahina ta teni nenian, “Ti yaw ka ata,” nisaitatara ta neni muaring tu nay.

7.niv: Again he asked them, “Who is it you want?” “Jesus of Nazareth,” they said.
7.cmn: 他又問他們說：「你們找誰？」他們說：「找拿撒勒人耶穌。」
7.sry: Anata nitmawkila ta teni tmalig nenian, “Timang ta kiimen umi?” Ka nikuma ta neni, “Ti Yesusan ka maka Nazareth.”

8.niv: Jesus answered, “I told you that I am he. If you are looking for me, then let these men go.”
8.cmn: 耶穌說：「我已經告訴你們，我就是。你們若找我，就讓這些人去吧。」
8.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, Patagikahaen ato maw kamu ka Ti Yaw ka ata. Hairu kmiim kamu yawan, padarangaw lato ta neni ka ata.

9.niv: This happened so that the words he had spoken would be fulfilled: “I have not lost one of those you gave me.”
9.cmn: 這要應驗耶穌從前的話，說：「你所賜給我的人，我沒有失落一個。」
9.sry: Aley ka pavawutaw ta su ka nipasusuen tin: neni ka nipigaen hu yawan, asi maw nipatagirumaen ta timamang.

10.niv: Then Simon Peter, who had a sword, drew it and struck the high priestʼs servant, cutting off his right ear. (The servantʼs name was Malchus.)
10.cmn: 西門‧彼得帶着一把刀，就拔出來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉他的右耳；那僕人名叫馬勒古。
10.sry: Ka ti Simon Petrus ka mitiraw, ta nilmugut ki ana, ka nimapihit ki kuncia ki Dadilug ka Sibavaw, ka nipalikud tin ta tangira tin ka uwal. Ka ti Malkus ta nanang ki kuncia ka ana.

11.niv: Jesus commanded Peter, “Put your sword away! Shall I not drink the cup the Father has given me?”
11.cmn: 耶穌就對彼得說：「收刀入鞘吧，我父所給我的那杯，我豈可不喝呢？」 耶穌被帶到亞那面前
11.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus ti Petrusan, “Pukarulungaw ta tiraw oho. Hawug ka ana ka aitan ka na papiga ki Rama yawan, asi maw itey ta ana?

12.niv: Then the detachment of soldiers with its commander and the Jewish officials arrested Jesus. They bound him
12.cmn: 那隊兵和千夫長，並猶太人的差役就拿住耶穌，把他捆綁了，
12.sry: Anata kabatugan ka ana, ki Meysasu apa ki sat katununan lam ki kuncia ki Yoden nitagisal tagingit ti Yesusan bawut tenian.

13.niv: and brought him first to Annas, who was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, the high priest that year.
13.cmn: 先帶到亞那面前，因為亞那是本年作大祭司該亞法的岳父。
13.sry: Ka nimad tenian siuro ti Anasan: aley ka raraman ta teni ki keyan ti Kayfas, ka Dadilug ka Sibavaw tu tawil ka ana.

14.niv: Caiaphas was the one who had advised the Jewish leaders that it would be good if one man died for the people.
14.cmn: 這該亞法就是從前向猶太人發議論說「一個人替百姓死是有益的」那位。 彼得不認耶穌 （太26‧69－70；可14‧66－68；路22‧55－57)
14.sry: Ka ti Kayfas ta ti ana ka nimatamha ki Yoden, ka mariyanga lato, ru k apatayey ki saat ki vual mivli ki tau.

15.niv: Simon Peter and another disciple were following Jesus. Because this disciple was known to the high priest, he went with Jesus into the high priestʼs courtyard,
15.cmn: 西門‧彼得跟着耶穌，還有一個門徒跟着。那門徒是大祭司所認識的，他就同耶穌進了大祭司的院子。
15.sry: Ka nismaladilug ta ti Simon Petrus ti Yesusan, lam ki patatawutawugan ka pani. Ka patatawutawugan ka ana ta kalangen ki Dadilug ka Sibavaw, ka nisararboen tin lam ti Yesusan tu glaf ki Dadilug ka Sibavaw.

16.niv: but Peter had to wait outside at the door. The other disciple, who was known to the high priest, came back, spoke to the servant girl on duty there and brought Peter in.
16.cmn: 彼得卻站在門外。大祭司所認識的那個門徒出來，和看門的使女說了一聲，就領彼得進去。
16.sry: Ka ti Petrus ta itumala mituko tu ngangatafan. Anata patatawutawugan ka ana ka pani ka kalangen ki Dadilug ka Sibavaw, nisamamala, matagitavag ki Suayam tu ngangatafan, ka nipapadakenan tin ti Petrusan.

17.niv: “You arenʼt one of this manʼs disciples too, are you?” she asked Peter. He replied, “I am not.”
17.cmn: 那看門的使女對彼得說：「你不也是這人的門徒嗎？」他說：「我不是。」
17.sry: Anata nikuma ti Petrusan ta ina ka ana ka kuncia ka suayam tu ngataf, “Asi kawa imhu apa ta na patatawtawug ki vual ka ata? Nikuma ta teni, “Asi ti yaw.”

18.niv: It was cold, and the servants and officials stood around a fire they had made to keep warm. Peter also was standing with them, warming himself.
18.cmn: 僕人和差役因為天冷，就生了炭火，站在那裏烤火；彼得也同他們站着烤火。 大祭司盤問耶穌 （太26‧59－66；可14‧55－64；路22‧66－71）
18.sry: Ka pairungen ki kungcia apa ka ana ta mituko tu nisiapuypuyan ka na vaga, aley ki maharmil pakalado nenian, ka ti Petrus ta itulam nenian mituko pakalado tenian.

19.niv: Meanwhile, the high priest questioned Jesus about his disciples and his teaching.
19.cmn: 大祭司就以耶穌的門徒和他的教訓盤問他。
19.sry: Anata nitmalig ta Dadilug ka Sibavaw ti Yesusan aley ki patatawutawugan tin, ki nipatagitawugen apa tin.

20.niv: “I have spoken openly to the world,” Jesus replied. “I always taught in synagogues or at the temple, where all the Jews come together. I said nothing in secret.
20.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「我從來是明明地對世人說話。我常在會堂和殿裏，就是猶太人聚集的地方教訓人；我在暗地裏並沒有說甚麼。
20.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus tenian, Nipatagidingdingen aw ki su tu nay: nimikakwa ko matawtawug tu Pakuisalan, tu Kuva apa ki tatamudan ki Alid, tu paawklaklaan ki asi ko nimasusu tu deng ki mamang.

21.niv: Why question me? Ask those who heard me. Surely they know what I said.”
21.cmn: 你為甚麼問我呢？可以問那聽見的人，我對他們說的是甚麼；我所說的，他們都知道。」
21.sry: Mang ka tmalig kaw yawan? Tmaliga nenian ka nimilingig, mang ta na su aw nenian, kitaey, mumha ta neni ka ata mang ta na su aw.

22.niv: When Jesus said this, one of the officials nearby slapped him in the face. “Is this the way you answer the high priest?” he demanded.
22.cmn: 耶穌說了這話，旁邊站着的一個差役用手掌打他，說：「你這樣回答大祭司嗎？」
22.sry: Iru ka pasusuen tin ta ata, saat ki kuncia ka itusal hina mituko, ta nitmaplag ti Yesusan tu timi, ka nikun tin, “Matagivlia kaw kumahina ki su ki Dadilug ka Sibavaw?”

23.niv: “If I said something wrong,” Jesus replied, “testify as to what is wrong. But if I spoke the truth, why did you strike me?”
23.cmn: 耶穌說：「我若說的不是，你可以指證那不是；我若說的是，你為甚麼打我呢？」
23.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus tenian, “Hairu nimatagirmarma ko ki su, gmaila ki nipatagirmarman: hairu nikumamsing ko, kaumang ka tmaplag kaw yawan?”

24.niv: Then Annas sent him bound to Caiaphas the high priest.
24.cmn: 亞那就把耶穌解到大祭司該亞法那裏，仍是捆着解去的。 彼得再次不認耶穌 （太26‧71－75；可14‧69－72；路22‧58－62）
24.sry: (Ka ti Anas ta nipaad ato tenian paukwa ti Kayfasan ka Dadilug ka Sibavaw.)

25.niv: Meanwhile, Simon Peter was still standing there warming himself. So they asked him, “You arenʼt one of his disciples too, are you?” He denied it, saying, “I am not.”
25.cmn: 西門‧彼得正站着烤火，有人對他說：「你不也是他的門徒嗎？」彼得不承認，說：「我不是。」
25.sry: Ka nimituko ta ti Simon Petrus pakalado tenian: anata nikuma ta neni tenian, “Asi kawa imhu apa ta na patatawutawugan tin?” Nirmaw ta teni, kuma, “Asi ti yaw.”

26.niv: One of the high priestʼs servants, a relative of the man whose ear Peter had cut off, challenged him, “Didnʼt I see you with him in the garden?”
26.cmn: 有大祭司的一個僕人，是彼得削掉耳朵那人的親屬，說：「我不是看見你同他在園子裏嗎？」
26.sry: Saat ka kuncia ki Dadilug ka Sibavau, ka makatautauey tenian ka nipalukuten ti Petrus ki tangira, ta nikuma, “Asi maw kaw kawa nikitaan tu raul ka tulam kaw tenian?”

27.niv: Again Peter denied it, and at that moment a rooster began to crow.
27.cmn: 彼得又不承認。立時雞就叫了。 耶穌在彼拉多面前受審 （太27‧1－2，11－14；可15‧1－5；路23‧1－5）
27.sry: Ka nimila rmaw ta ti Petrus. Ka madis nimuni ta tafuka.

28.niv: Then the Jewish leaders took Jesus from Caiaphas to the palace of the Roman governor. By now it was early morning, and to avoid ceremonial uncleanness they did not enter the palace, because they wanted to be able to eat the Passover.
28.cmn: 眾人將耶穌從該亞法那裏往衙門內解去，那時天還早。他們自己卻不進衙門，恐怕染了污穢，不能吃逾越節的筵席。
28.sry: Anata nimad ta neni ti Yesusan padarang ti Kayfasan paukwa tu talag ka kairangan ki papamamagan. Ka mararamag ato ka madama: ka asi nimurbo ta neni tu talag ki papamamagan, aley ka asi ahidey, ra kmana lapa ta neni yuko ki Halidawan.

29.niv: So Pilate came out to them and asked, “What charges are you bringing against this man?”
29.cmn: 彼拉多就出來，到他們那裏，說：「你們告這人是為甚麼事呢？」
29.sry: Anata nisamamala ta ti Pilatus mupanag nenian, kuma, Patawbarawen umi ki mang ta kagulung ka ata?

30.niv: “If he were not a criminal,” they replied, “we would not have handed him over to you.”
30.cmn: 他們回答說：「這人若不是作惡的，我們就不把他交給你。」
30.sry: Nimatagivli ta neni kuma tenian, Hairu niina puvaraw ta ti ata, ina kame asi pahatunun tenian imhuan.

31.niv: Pilate said, “Take him yourselves and judge him by your own law.” “But we have no right to execute anyone,” they objected.
31.cmn: 彼拉多說：「你們自己帶他去，按着你們的律法審問他吧。」猶太人說：「我們沒有殺人的權柄。」
31.sry: Nikuma ta ti Pilatus nenian, Araw tenian ta imumi, ka dmungdunga tenian ki tatuko umi. Anata nikuma ta Yoden tenian, Asi kame hahayen pakapatay timamangan.

32.niv: This took place to fulfill what Jesus had said about the kind of death he was going to die.
32.cmn: 這要應驗耶穌所說自己將要怎樣死的話了。
32.sry: Aley ka pavawutaw ta na su ti Yesus, ka nipasusuen tin, pukidi kapatayan ki mang ka k apatayey tin.

33.niv: Pilate then went back inside the palace, summoned Jesus and asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?”
33.cmn: 彼拉多又進了衙門，叫耶穌來，對他說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」
33.sry: Anata nimurbo ta ti Pilatus mila tu talag ki papamamagan tmataam ti Yesusan, kuma tenian, “Meysasu kaw kawa ka Sibavaw ki Yoden?”

34.niv: “Is that your own idea,” Jesus asked, “or did others talk to you about me?”
34.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「這話是你自己說的，還是別人論我對你說的呢？」
34.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus tenian, “Sikunung kaw kawa Masusu ki ata, nivanavana lava ta raruma imhuan Matagimimia yawan?”

35.niv: “Am I a Jew?” Pilate replied. “Your own people and chief priests handed you over to me. What is it you have done?”
35.cmn: 彼拉多說：「我豈是猶太人呢？你本國的人和祭司長把你交給我。你做了甚麼事呢？」
35.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Pilatus, “Yoden ko kawa? Tau oho ki Tamapigik apa ka Sibavaw ta nipahatunun imhuan yawan: kamang ta nipamuten ‘hu?”

36.niv: Jesus said, “My kingdom is not of this world. If it were, my servants would fight to prevent my arrest by the Jewish leaders. But now my kingdom is from another place.”
36.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「我的國不屬這世界；我的國若屬這世界，我的臣僕必要爭戰，使我不至於被交給猶太人。只是我的國不屬這世界。」
36.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, “Asi maka nay ka ata ta Peysasuan aw: Hairu maka nay lava ka ata ta Peysasuan aw, ina macit ta mukwa sidarim yawan, ki asi pahatununein ki Yoden: ra hinin asi tagikwa hiya ta Peysasuan aw.”

37.niv: “You are a king, then!” said Pilate. Jesus answered, “You say that I am a king. In fact, the reason I was born and came into the world is to testify to the truth. Everyone on the side of truth listens to me.”
37.cmn: 彼拉多就對他說：「這樣，你是王嗎？」耶穌回答說：「你說我是王。我為此而生，也為此來到世間，特為給真理作見證。凡屬真理的人就聽我的話。」
37.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Pilatus tenian, “Meysasu kaw kawa ka Sibavaw?” Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, “Matagimising kaw ka Meysasu ko ka Sibavaw. Aley ki ata nipeyalaken ko, aley apa ki ata irua ato ko tu nay, ki hailey maw ta katiktikan ki su. Veyag ka tagikwa ki katiktikan ki su, milingig ki ingaw aw.”

38.niv: “What is truth?” retorted Pilate. With this he went out again to the Jews gathered there and said, “I find no basis for a charge against him.
38.cmn: 彼拉多說：「真理是甚麼呢？」 耶穌被判死刑 （太27‧15－31；可15‧6－20；路23‧13－25） 說了這話，又出來到猶太人那裏，對他們說：「我查不出他有甚麼罪來。
38.sry: Nikuma ta ti Pilatus tenian, “Kamang ta katiktikan ki su?” Iru ka matagikaha ki ata, nisamamala mila mukwa ki Yoden, kuma nenian, “Asi maw pakivaleyen ta varaw tenian.

39.niv: But it is your custom for me to release to you one prisoner at the time of the Passover. Do you want me to release ‘the king of the Jews’?”
39.cmn: 但你們有個規矩，在逾越節要我給你們釋放一個人，你們要我給你們釋放猶太人的王嗎？」
39.sry: Ra kidi umi kaawmien aw kamu ta sasat ru uvavatugan ki Halidawan. Mamuy kamu kawa kaawmiaw maw kamu ta Meysasu ka Sibavaw ki Yoden?”

40.niv: They shouted back, “No, not him! Give us Barabbas!” Now Barabbas had taken part in an uprising.
40.cmn: 他們又喊着說：「不要這人，要巴拉巴！」這巴拉巴是個強盜。
40.sry: Anata nimakulig ta neni mila makuimid, kuma, “Asi ti ata, ra ti Barabas apa. Ka na tamalpug ta ti Barabas.”

1.niv: Then Pilate took Jesus and had him flogged.
1.cmn: 當下彼拉多將耶穌鞭打了。
1.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nimara ta ti Pilatus ti Yesusan, ka nipatawbawrig smaplat [tenian.]

2.niv: The soldiers twisted together a crown of thorns and put it on his head. They clothed him in a purple robe
2.cmn: 兵丁用荊棘編做冠冕戴在他頭上，給他穿上紫袍，
2.sry: Iru ka tkaha tminun ta masacit ki sakiru ki na adum, nipukwa pakahalap tu vungo tin, ka nipapakulamug apa tenian ki kuvar ka na patag ka mameyapuy.

3.niv: and went up to him again and again, saying, “Hail, king of the Jews!” And they slapped him in the face.
3.cmn: 又挨近他，說：「恭喜，猶太人的王啊！」他們就用手掌打他。
3.sry: Ka nikuma, Tabe, Meysasu ka Sibavaw ki Yoden. Ka nitmaplag tu timi tenian.

4.niv: Once more Pilate came out and said to the Jews gathered there, “Look, I am bringing him out to you to let you know that I find no basis for a charge against him.”
4.cmn: 彼拉多又出來對眾人說：「我帶他出來見你們，叫你們知道我查不出他有甚麼罪來。」
4.sry: Anata nimila ta ti Pilatus samamala, kuma nenian, Kitaey, paupanagen aw ta teni imumian, aley ka kavanaey mumi, ka asi maw pakivaleyen ta varaw tenian.

5.niv: When Jesus came out wearing the crown of thorns and the purple robe, Pilate said to them, “Here is the man!”
5.cmn: 耶穌出來，戴着荊棘冠冕，穿着紫袍。彼拉多對他們說：「你們看這個人！」
5.sry: Anata nisamamala ta ti Yesus, ka nipakasakiru ki na adum makulamug ki na patag ka mama ki apuy. Ka nikuma [ta ti Pilatus] nenian, Kitaey, ta kagulung,

6.niv: As soon as the chief priests and their officials saw him, they shouted, “Crucify! Crucify!” But Pilate answered, “You take him and crucify him. As for me, I find no basis for a charge against him.”
6.cmn: 祭司長和差役看見他，就喊着說：「釘他十字架！釘他十字架！」彼拉多說：「你們自己把他釘十字架吧！我查不出他有甚麼罪來。」
6.sry: Iru ka kmita tenian ta Tamapigik ka Sibavaw ki mukwa apa sidarim [nenian,] nimakulig ta neni, kuma, punavavaraga, punavavaraga tenian. Nikuma ta ti Pilatus nenian, araaw lato tenian ta imumi, ka punavavaraga tenian. Nda asien aw makivaley ta varaw tenian.

7.niv: The Jewish leaders insisted, “We have a law, and according to that law he must die, because he claimed to be the Son of God.”
7.cmn: 猶太人回答說：「我們有律法，按那律法，他是該死的，因他以自己為上帝的兒子。」
7.sry: Nimatagivli ta Yoden tenian, aku Tatuko kame, ka mapatayata teni ki Tatuko yan, aley ka nipumaduen tin puAlak ki Alid tenian.

8.niv: When Pilate heard this, he was even more afraid,
8.cmn: 彼拉多聽見這話，越發害怕，
8.sry: Iru ka milingig ki su k’ata ta ti Pilatus, nikasaunein tin matakut.

9.niv: and he went back inside the palace. “Where do you come from?” he asked Jesus, but Jesus gave him no answer.
9.cmn: 又進衙門，對耶穌說：「你是哪裏來的？」耶穌卻不回答。
9.sry: Ka nimurbo mila tu talag ka kairangan ki papamamagan, ka nik’ma ti Yesusan, Mang kaw ki awma? Ra asi nimatagivli ta ti Yesus ki su tenian.

10.niv: “Do you refuse to speak to me?” Pilate said. “Donʼt you realize I have power either to free you or to crucify you?”
10.cmn: 彼拉多說：「你不對我說話嗎？你豈不知我有權柄釋放你，也有權柄把你釘十字架嗎？」
10.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Pilatus tenian, Asi imhu kawa ka ingawey yawan? Asi kaw kawa mumha ka akulig ko tu punavavaragen imhuan, ka akulig apa ko tu awmien imhuan?

11.niv: Jesus answered, “You would have no power over me if it were not given to you from above. Therefore the one who handed me over to you is guilty of a greater sin.”
11.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「若不是從上頭賜給你的，你就毫無權柄辦我。所以，把我交給你的那人罪更重了。」
11.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, ausia kaw ki lig yawan, hairu niina papigaen ta ata maka vavaw imhuan: aley ki ana teni ka nipahatunun yawan imhuan, aku varaw ka siuru irang.

12.niv: From then on, Pilate tried to set Jesus free, but the Jewish leaders kept shouting, “If you let this man go, you are no friend of Caesar. Anyone who claims to be a king opposes Caesar.”
12.cmn: 從此，彼拉多想要釋放耶穌，無奈猶太人喊着說：「你若釋放這個人，就不是凱撒的忠臣。凡以自己為王的，就是背叛凱撒了。」
12.sry: Tu kidi k’ana nikmiim ta ti Pilatus ki awmiey tin tenian: ra nimakutun ta Yoden, kuma, Hairu mawmia kaw ti ataan, asi ato kaw riu ki Siatug Sibavaw: veyag ka papeynado papeysasu tenian, makuduma ta teni ki su ki Siatug Sibavaw.

13.niv: When Pilate heard this, he brought Jesus out and sat down on the judgeʼs seat at a place known as the Stone Pavement (which in Aramaic is Gabbatha).
13.cmn: 彼拉多聽見這話，就帶耶穌出來，到了一個地方，名叫「鋪華石處」，希伯來話叫厄巴大，就在那裏坐堂。
13.sry: Iru ka nimilingig ta ti Pilatus ki su ka ata, niad tin ta ti Yesus pasamamala, ka nimirung tu irarungan papamamag tu itukwaan ka pananangen Lithostrotos, ra tu su ki Hebren Gabatha.

14.niv: It was the day of Preparation of the Passover; it was about noon. “Here is your king,” Pilate said to the Jews.
14.cmn: 那日是預備逾越節的日子，約有午正。彼拉多對猶太人說：「看哪，這是你們的王！」
14.sry: Ka sitatanangen ato ta uvavatugan ki Halidawan, tu hivat lava ki ka anim ki tagley: ka nik’ma ki Yoden, kitey, ta Meysasu ka Sibavaw imumian.

15.niv: But they shouted, “Take him away! Take him away! Crucify him!” “Shall I crucify your king?” Pilate asked. “We have no king but Caesar,” the chief priests answered.
15.cmn: 他們喊着說：「除掉他！除掉他！釘他在十字架上！」彼拉多說：「我可以把你們的王釘十字架嗎？」祭司長回答說：「除了凱撒，我們沒有王。」
15.sry: Ra nimakutun ta neni, Araaw, araaw, punavavarag ato tenian. Nikuma ta ti Pilatus nenian, Punavavaragey maw kawa ta Meysasu ka Sibavaw imumian? Nimatagivli ta Tamapigik ka Sibavaw, Ausi kame ki Meysasu, dik ki Siatug Sibavaw.

16.niv: Finally Pilate handed him over to them to be crucified. So the soldiers took charge of Jesus.
16.cmn: 於是彼拉多將耶穌交給他們去釘十字架。 耶穌被釘十字架 （太27‧32－44；可15‧21－32；路23‧26－43）
16.sry: Anata nipahatunun tenian pahakwa nenian, aley ka punavavaragey lato ta teni. Ka nimara ta neni ti Yesusan patagipanag.

17.niv: Carrying his own cross, he went out to the place of the Skull (which in Aramaic is called Golgotha).
17.cmn: 他們就把耶穌帶了去。耶穌背着自己的十字架出來，到了一個地方，名叫「髑髏地」，希伯來話叫各各他。
17.sry: Iru ka avalen tin ta na vavarag tin, nitawpapanag mukwa [tu itukwaan] ka pananangen itukwaan ki tuktuk ki vungo, ra tu su ki Hebreen Golgatha:

18.niv: There they crucified him, and with him two others—one on each side and Jesus in the middle.
18.cmn: 他們就在那裏釘他在十字架上，還有兩個人和他一同釘着，一邊一個，耶穌在中間。
18.sry: Tu hina nipunavavarag tenian, ka pulam apa tenian raruha ki pani, tu idiidi ki sasasat, ka niputukaden nein ta ti Yesus.

19.niv: Pilate had a notice prepared and fastened to the cross. It read: Jesus of Nazareth, the King of the Jews.
19.cmn: 彼拉多又用牌子寫了一個名號，安在十字架上，寫的是：「猶太人的王，拿撒勒人耶穌。」
19.sry: Ka nismulat apa ta ti Pilatus ki na aahalap, ka atahalapen tin tu na vavarag: ka nisulat tin kumahina, YESUS KA MAKA NAZARET MEYSASU KA SIBAVAW KI YODEN.

20.niv: Many of the Jews read this sign, for the place where Jesus was crucified was near the city, and the sign was written in Aramaic, Latin and Greek.
20.cmn: 有許多猶太人念這名號；因為耶穌被釘十字架的地方與城相近，並且是用希伯來、羅馬、希臘三樣文字寫的。
20.sry: Na aahalap ka ana ta nikuting ki mabatung ki Yoden: aley ka tu tamang ki Awma ta itukwaan ki nipunavavaragen ta ti Yesus: ka nisulaten ta ana tu su ki Hebreen, ki Grieken, ki Romeynein.

21.niv: The chief priests of the Jews protested to Pilate, “Do not write ‘The King of the Jews,’ but that this man claimed to be king of the Jews.”
21.cmn: 猶太人的祭司長就對彼拉多說：「不要寫『猶太人的王』，要寫『他自己說：我是猶太人的王』。」
21.sry: Anata nikuma ta Tamapigik ka Sibavaw ki Yoden ti Pilatusan, Inaey ato smulat, Ta Meysasu ka Sibavaw ki Yoden: Ra ata apa, ka nipasusuen tin, Meysasu ko ka Sibavaw ki Yoden.

22.niv: Pilate answered, “What I have written, I have written.”
22.cmn: 彼拉多說：「我所寫的，我已經寫上了。」
22.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Pilatus, Ka nisulaten aw, ta nisulaten aw.

23.niv: When the soldiers crucified Jesus, they took his clothes, dividing them into four shares, one for each of them, with the undergarment remaining. This garment was seamless, woven in one piece from top to bottom.
23.cmn: 兵丁既然將耶穌釘在十字架上，就拿他的衣服分為四分，每兵一分；又拿他的裏衣，這件裏衣原來沒有縫兒，是上下一片織成的。
23.sry: Masacit k’ana ru nipunavavarag ti Yesusan, nimara ki nipamien tin, (ka hipaten nein, matatag ki masacit ka sasasat ta sasat ki atag) ki suluy apa.Ka rulen ka suluy ka ana ta ausi ki nipadudomaen, ra maka vavaw nitumuk tminun.

24.niv: “Letʼs not tear it,” they said to one another. “Letʼs decide by lot who will get it.” This happened that the scripture might be fulfilled that said, “They divided my clothes among them and cast lots for my garment.” So this is what the soldiers did.
24.cmn: 他們就彼此說：「我們不要撕開，只要拈鬮，看誰得着。」這要應驗經上的話說： 他們分了我的外衣， 為我的裏衣拈鬮。 兵丁果然做了這事。
24.sry: Anata nimatavatavag ta neni ki su, “Inaen eta ki’it ki ata, ra pakyaw eta ru a'timanga”: aley ka pavawutaw ta na Sasulat, ka kuma, “Nimatatag ato ki nipamiaen aw, nipakyaw apa aley ki kulamug aw.” Ata ta nipamuten ki masacit.

25.niv: Near the cross of Jesus stood his mother, his motherʼs sister, Mary the wife of Clopas, and Mary Magdalene.
25.cmn: 站在耶穌十字架旁邊的，有他母親與他母親的姊妹，並革羅罷的妻子馬利亞，和抹大拉的馬利亞。
25.sry: Ka nimituk ki na vavarag ti Yesus mituko ta rarenan tin, ki tagiaparag apa ki rarenan tin, ti Maria ka [nikaia] ti Klope, ti Maria apa Magdalena.

26.niv: When Jesus saw his mother there, and the disciple whom he loved standing nearby, he said to her, “Woman, here is your son,”
26.cmn: 耶穌見母親和他所愛的那門徒站在旁邊，就對他母親說：「母親，看，你的兒子！」
26.sry: Iru ka kmita ta ti Yesus ki Rarenan [tin,] ki patatawutawugan apa ka kavagangoen tin ka itulam mituko, nikuma ki rarenan tin, Ina, kitaey ta Alak oho.

27.niv: and to the disciple, “Here is your mother.” From that time on, this disciple took her into his home.
27.cmn: 又對那門徒說：「看，你的母親！」從此，那門徒就接她到自己家裏去了。 耶穌的死 （太27‧45－56；可15‧33－41；路23‧44－49）
27.sry: Siawug ki ana nikuma ki patatawutawugan, “Kitaey, ta ti Ina oho”. Ka tu kidi ki tagley ka ana nipatulam tenian ta patatawutawugan pataawkwa tu talag tin.

28.niv: Later, knowing that everything had now been finished, and so that Scripture would be fulfilled, Jesus said, “I am thirsty.”
28.cmn: 這事以後，耶穌知道各樣的事已經成了，為要使經上的話應驗，就說：「我渴了。」
28.sry: Siawug ki ana ru kavanaen ti Yesus ka pafutey lato ta imid ki mamang, aley ka pavawutaw ta na Sasulat, nikuma ta teni, “Mito ko.”

29.niv: A jar of wine vinegar was there, so they soaked a sponge in it, put the sponge on a stalk of the hyssop plant, and lifted it to Jesusʼ lips.
29.cmn: 有一個器皿盛滿了醋，放在那裏；他們就拿海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在牛膝草上，送到他口。
29.sry: Ka niatakwaan hina ta sato ka matmuy ki mapingit, ka niputmuyen nein ki mapingit ta na vadiu ka mama ki purut, maritung malifvit ki isope, ka nipatutukil ki ana tu mutus tin.

30.niv: When he had received the drink, Jesus said, “It is finished.” With that, he bowed his head and gave up his spirit.
30.cmn: 耶穌嘗了那醋，就說：「成了！」便低下頭，將靈魂交付上帝了。 肋旁被扎
30.sry: Iru ka nikdiman ta ti Yesus ki mapingit, nikuma, “peykahaen ato meyamut”: ka ru maawsusu ki vungo nimitarawug ki hinawa.

31.niv: Now it was the day of Preparation, and the next day was to be a special Sabbath. Because the Jewish leaders did not want the bodies left on the crosses during the Sabbath, they asked Pilate to have the legs broken and the bodies taken down.
31.cmn: 猶太人因這日是預備日，又因那安息日是個大日，就求彼拉多叫人打斷他們的腿，把他們拿去，免得屍首當安息日留在十字架上。
31.sry: Anata Yoden aley ka asi paitukwaey tu na vavarag ta vuavual ru wagi ki pahihababan, aley ka kidi ato ki siatatanangen (nda tu kairangan ta wagi ka ana ki pahihababan) nitmumumia ti Pilatusan, ka vlaey ki tural nein, ka awmiey lapa ta neni.

32.niv: The soldiers therefore came and broke the legs of the first man who had been crucified with Jesus, and then those of the other.
32.cmn: 於是兵丁來，把頭一個人的腿，並與耶穌同釘第二個人的腿，都打斷了。
32.sry: Anata niirua ta masacit, ka nivlaen nein ta tural ki naunamu, ki kararuha, ka nipulam tenian punavavarag.

33.niv: But when they came to Jesus and found that he was already dead, they did not break his legs.
33.cmn: 只是來到耶穌那裏，見他已經死了，就不打斷他的腿。
33.sry: Iru ra mukwa ti Yesusan, ru kitaan nein ka piskaha ato mapatay, anata asi nein nivlaen ta tural tin.

34.niv: Instead, one of the soldiers pierced Jesusʼ side with a spear, bringing a sudden flow of blood and water.
34.cmn: 惟有一個兵拿槍扎他的肋旁，隨即有血和水流出來。
34.sry: Ra saat ki masacit ta nitmivus tu kating tin ki rarurug, ka madis nimupanag hina ta gamag ki ralum apa.

35.niv: The man who saw it has given testimony, and his testimony is true. He knows that he tells the truth, and he testifies so that you also may believe.
35.cmn: 看見這事的那人就作見證－他的見證也是真的，並且他知道自己所說的是真的－叫你們也可以信。
35.sry: Ka teni ka nikmita, hmail ki ata, ka matiktik ta hailen tin: ka kavanaen tin ka mashut ta su tin, aley ka tnamisinga lapa kamu ta imumi.

36.niv: These things happened so that the scripture would be fulfilled: “Not one of his bones will be broken,”
36.cmn: 這些事成了，為要應驗經上的話說：「他的骨頭一根也不可折斷。」
36.sry: Ka nipamuten ta mamang ka ata, aley ka pavawutaw ta na Sasulat, Asi vlaaney ta sasasat ki tural tenian.

37.niv: and, as another scripture says, “They will look on the one they have pierced.”
37.cmn: 經上又有一句說：「他們要仰望自己所扎的人。」 耶穌的安葬 （太27‧57－61；可15‧42－47；路23‧50－56）
37.sry: Ka matagila ta pani ki na Sasulat, Kmitaa ta neni ka nitivusen nein.

38.niv: Later, Joseph of Arimathea asked Pilate for the body of Jesus. Now Joseph was a disciple of Jesus, but secretly because he feared the Jewish leaders. With Pilateʼs permission, he came and took the body away.
38.cmn: 這些事以後，有亞利馬太人約瑟，是耶穌的門徒，只因怕猶太人，就暗暗地作門徒。他來求彼拉多，要把耶穌的身體領去。彼拉多允准，他就把耶穌的身體領去了。
38.sry: Siawug ki ana ti Yosef ka maka Arimateya, (ka na Patatawtawug ti Yesus, ra tu deng aley ki takut tin ki Yoden) ta nitmumimia ti Pilatusan, ki paaraaney tenian ta vual ti Yesus: ka hahayen ta ata ti Pilatus. Anata niukwa tin mawmia ki vual ti Yesus.

39.niv: He was accompanied by Nicodemus, the man who earlier had visited Jesus at night. Nicodemus brought a mixture of myrrh and aloes, about seventy-five pounds.
39.cmn: 又有尼哥德慕，就是先前夜裏去見耶穌的，帶着沒藥和沉香約有一百斤前來。
39.sry: Ka nimukwa apa ta ti Nikodemus, (teni ta niirua tu naunamu ka awvanan ti Yesusan) ka akakeyul tin ki nihurat ka pa atoen ki Mirhe ki Aluy, sat kaatugan lava ki tingting.

40.niv: Taking Jesusʼ body, the two of them wrapped it, with the spices, in strips of linen. This was in accordance with Jewish burial customs.
40.cmn: 他們就照猶太人殯葬的規矩，把耶穌的身體用細麻布加上香料裹好了。
40.sry: Anata niara nein ta vual ti Yesus, ka nitmupu ki ata tu ayt lam ki uru ka mavangug, mama ka na kidi ki Yoden ru ravaken.

41.niv: At the place where Jesus was crucified, there was a garden, and in the garden a new tomb, in which no one had ever been laid.
41.cmn: 在耶穌釘十字架的地方有一個園子，園子裏有一座新墳墓，是從來沒有葬過人的。
41.sry: Ka aku Raul hina tu itukwaan, ki nipunavavaragan tenian, ka tu raul ka ana ta ravak ka vahaw, ka asi apa niatakwaan ta timamang.

42.niv: Because it was the Jewish day of Preparation and since the tomb was nearby, they laid Jesus there.
42.cmn: 只因是猶太人的預備日，又因那墳墓近，他們就把耶穌安放在那裏。
42.sry: Tu hina niatakwaan nein ta ti Yesus, aley ki Sitatanangan ki Yoden, nda itutamang ta ravak ka ana.

1.niv: Early on the first day of the week, while it was still dark, Mary Magdalene went to the tomb and saw that the stone had been removed from the entrance.
1.cmn: 七日的第一日清早，天還黑的時候，抹大拉的馬利亞來到墳墓那裏，看見石頭從墳墓挪開了，
1.sry: Ka tu wagi ka naunamu ki pta ki pahihababan nisatakug ta ti Maria Magdalena, ru marimdim apa, mukwa tu ravak: ka nikitaan tin ta vato ka awmien ato tu ravak.

2.niv: So she came running to Simon Peter and the other disciple, the one Jesus loved, and said, “They have taken the Lord out of the tomb, and we donʼt know where they have put him!”
