2.cmn: 就跑來見西門‧彼得和耶穌所愛的那個門徒，對他們說：「有人把主從墳墓裏挪了去，我們不知道放在哪裏。」
2.sry: Anata nisium mukwa ti Simon Petrusan, ki patatawutawugan apa ka sasat ka kavagangoen ti Yesus, ka nikuma nenian, Araen ato ta Meyrang, maawmia tu ravak ka asi yan kavanaen nimakakuna ta neni tenian.

3.niv: So Peter and the other disciple started for the tomb.
3.cmn: 彼得和那門徒就出來，往墳墓那裏去。
3.sry: Anata nitawpapanag ta ti Petrus, ki Patawutawwugan apa ka saasat, ka niirua tu ravak.

4.niv: Both were running, but the other disciple outran Peter and reached the tomb first.
4.cmn: 兩個人同跑，那門徒比彼得跑得更快，先到了墳墓，
4.sry: Ra daruha ka ana ta nimakaula sium: ra patatawutawugan siuro matag ti Petrusan, ka siuroen tin mukwa tu ravak.

5.niv: He bent over and looked in at the strips of linen lying there but did not go in.
5.cmn: 低頭往裏看，就見細麻布還放在那裏，只是沒有進去。
5.sry: Iru ka maawsusu, nikitaan tin ta atakwaan ka ayit, ra asi nimurbo hina.

6.niv: Then Simon Peter came along behind him and went straight into the tomb. He saw the strips of linen lying there,
6.cmn: 西門‧彼得隨後也到了，進墳墓裏去，就看見細麻布還放在那裏，
6.sry: Ka niirua apa ta ti Simon Petrus maawug tenian, ka nimurbo ta teni tu ravak, kmita ki atakwaan ka ayit.

7.niv: as well as the cloth that had been wrapped around Jesusʼ head. The cloth was still lying in its place, separate from the linen.
7.cmn: 又看見耶穌的裹頭巾沒有和細麻布放在一處，是另在一處捲着。
7.sry: Ka ana ta tupu ki mula ka niatahalapen tu vungo tin, asi niatasalan ki ayit, ra niatalbagen apa matakuruk tu pani ki itukwaan.

8.niv: Finally the other disciple, who had reached the tomb first, also went inside. He saw and believed.
8.cmn: 先到墳墓的那門徒也進去，看見就信了。（
8.sry: Anata nimurbo apa ta patatawutawugan ka saasat ka nisiuro mukwa tu ravak, ka nikitaan tin, ka nitnamising apa.

9.niv: (They still did not understand from Scripture that Jesus had to rise from the dead.)
9.cmn: 因為他們還不明白聖經的意思，就是耶穌必要從死裏復活。）
9.sry: Nda asi apa nein umhaen ta na Sasulat, ka likugey tin gapit ki nikapatayan.

10.niv: Then the disciples went back to where they were staying.
10.cmn: 於是兩個門徒回自己的住處去了。 向抹大拉的馬利亞顯現 （太28‧9－10；可16‧9－11）
10.sry: Anata nidmarang ta patatawutawugan salikug mutalag.

11.niv: Now Mary stood outside the tomb crying. As she wept, she bent over to look into the tomb
11.cmn: 馬利亞卻站在墳墓外面哭。哭的時候，低頭往墳墓裏看，
11.sry: Ka nimituko ta ti Maria itumala tu ravak, ka tmangitangi. Iru ka tmangitangi nimaawsusu ta teni tu ravak.

12.niv: and saw two angels in white, seated where Jesusʼ body had been, one at the head and the other at the foot.
12.cmn: 就見兩個天使，穿着白衣，在安放耶穌身體的地方坐着，一個在頭，一個在腳。
12.sry: Ka nikitaan tin ta raruha ki TamaGnaw tu [pamimian ka] mapule, ka mirung ta saasat tu vungo, saasat apa tu rapal, ki niatakwaan vual ti Yesus.

13.niv: They asked her, “Woman, why are you crying?” “They have taken my Lord away,” she said, “and I donʼt know where they have put him.”
13.cmn: 天使對她說：「婦人，你為甚麼哭？」她說：「因為有人把我主挪了去，我不知道放在哪裏。」
13.sry: Ka nikuma ta neni tenian, Ina, mang ka ta tangitangien hu? Nikuma nenian: Aley ka niara ta Meyrang aw, ka asi maw umhaen nimatakuna ta neni tenian.

14.niv: At this, she turned around and saw Jesus standing there, but she did not realize that it was Jesus.
14.cmn: 說了這話，就轉過身來，看見耶穌站在那裏，卻不知道是耶穌。
14.sry: Iru ka matagikaha ki ata, nirmiduk ta teni maawvering, ka nikitaan tin ta ti Yesus ka mituko, ra asi tin umhaen ka ti Yesus ta ti ana.

15.niv: He asked her, “Woman, why are you crying? Who is it you are looking for?” Thinking he was the gardener, she said, “Sir, if you have carried him away, tell me where you have put him, and I will get him.”
15.cmn: 耶穌問她說：「婦人，為甚麼哭？你找誰呢？」馬利亞以為是看園的，就對他說：「先生，若是你把他移了去，請告訴我，你把他放在哪裏，我便去取他。」
15.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Ina, mang ta tangitangien hu? Timang ta kiimen hu? Tamasiraraul lava nikwa tin, ka nikuma ta teni tenian, Meyrang, haitu nimara kaw tenian putawag, vanaey ko nimatakuna kaw tenian, ka araaw maw ta teni.

16.niv: Jesus said to her, “Mary.” She turned toward him and cried out in Aramaic, “Rabboni!” (which means “Teacher”).
16.cmn: 耶穌說：「馬利亞。」馬利亞就轉過來，用希伯來話對他說：「拉波尼！」（拉波尼就是夫子的意思。）
16.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, “Maria”. Iru ka maawduma ta teni nikuma tenian, Rabuni: inaakuaney ki su, “Tamamatawtawug”.

17.niv: Jesus said, “Do not hold on to me, for I have not yet ascended to the Father. Go instead to my brothers and tell them, ‘I am ascending to my Father and your Father, to my God and your God.’ ”
17.cmn: 耶穌說：「不要摸我，因我還沒有升上去見我的父。你往我弟兄那裏去，告訴他們說，我要升上去見我的父，也是你們的父，見我的上帝，也是你們的上帝。」
17.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, “Inaey ko smukla, asi apa maw nisabavawen tu Raraman aw: ra ukwaaw ki tagiapaparag aw, vanavana nenian, Sabavaw ko tu Raraman aw tu Raraman apa mumi, tu Alid aw, tu Alid apa mumi.

18.niv: Mary Magdalene went to the disciples with the news: “I have seen the Lord!” And she told them that he had said these things to her.
18.cmn: 抹大拉的馬利亞就去告訴門徒說：「我已經看見了主。」她又將主對她說的這話告訴他們。 向門徒顯現 （太28‧16－20；可16‧14－18；路24‧36－49）
18.sry: Ka nimukwa ta ti Maria Magdalena magnaw ki patatawutawugan, ka nikitaan tin ta Meyrang, ka nipasusuen apa tin ta ata tenian.

19.niv: On the evening of that first day of the week, when the disciples were together, with the doors locked for fear of the Jewish leaders, Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you!”
19.cmn: 那日（就是七日的第一日）晚上，門徒所在的地方，因怕猶太人，門都關了。耶穌來，站在當中，對他們說：「願你們平安！」
19.sry: Iru ka madung ato tu saasat ki wagi ka ana ka naunamu ki pta ki pahihababan, ru niilub ta ngataf, tu nipaawaklaklaen ki patatawutawugan aley ki takuten nein ki Yoden, niirua ta ti Yesus mituko itu tukad, ka nikuma nenian, “Aku reya imumian.”

20.niv: After he said this, he showed them his hands and side. The disciples were overjoyed when they saw the Lord.
20.cmn: 說了這話，就把手和肋旁指給他們看。門徒看見主，就喜樂了。
20.sry: Iru ka matagikaha ki ata nipakitaan tin nenian ta rima tin ki kating apa [tin]. Anata nimaray ta patatawutawugan du kitaan nein ta Meyrang.

21.niv: Again Jesus said, “Peace be with you! As the Father has sent me, I am sending you.”
21.cmn: 耶穌又對他們說：「願你們平安！父怎樣差遣了我，我也照樣差遣你們。」
21.sry: Anata nimatagila ta ti Yesus nenian, Aku reya imumian: mama ki nipadingien ki Rama yawan, madingi apa ko imumian.

22.niv: And with that he breathed on them and said, “Receive the Holy Spirit.
22.cmn: 說了這話，就向他們吹一口氣，說：「你們受聖靈！
22.sry: Iru ka nimatagikaha ki ata nimiyup ta teni, kuma nenian, “Araaw lato ta Yupan ka Dilig Matiktik”.

23.niv: If you forgive anyoneʼs sins, their sins are forgiven; if you do not forgive them, they are not forgiven.”
23.cmn: 你們赦免誰的罪，誰的罪就赦免了；你們留下誰的罪，誰的罪就留下了。」 耶穌和多馬
23.sry: Na mamang ka ataraley mumi ta varaw, ataraley lato ka ana nenian: na mamang apa ka paikakwaey mumi, paikwaey lato ka ana nenian.

24.niv: Now Thomas (also known as Didymus), one of the Twelve, was not with the disciples when Jesus came.
24.cmn: 那十二個門徒中，有稱為低土馬的多馬；耶穌來的時候，他沒有和他們同在。
24.sry: Ka ti Tomas ka saat ki sat kitian ab ki ruha, ka siuwa Didimus, asi itulam nenian du iru ato ta ti Yesus.

25.niv: So the other disciples told him, “We have seen the Lord!” But he said to them, “Unless I see the nail marks in his hands and put my finger where the nails were, and put my hand into his side, I will not believe.”
25.cmn: 那些門徒就對他說：「我們已經看見主了。」多馬卻說：「我非看見他手上的釘痕，用指頭探入那釘痕，又用手探入他的肋旁，我總不信。」
25.sry: Anata nikuma tenian ta patatawutawugan ka raruma, Nikitaan nein ta Meyrang. Ra nikuma ta teni, Hairu asi ko kmita ki na luka ki pahu tu rima tin, ru asi ko tumu ki kagamus aw tu na luka ki pahu, tumu apa ki rima aw tu kating tin, asi ko tnamisinga.

26.niv: A week later his disciples were in the house again, and Thomas was with them. Though the doors were locked, Jesus came and stood among them and said, “Peace be with you!”
26.cmn: 過了八日，門徒又在屋裏，多馬也和他們同在，門都關了。耶穌來，站在當中說：「願你們平安！」
26.sry: Ka siawug ki kuypa ki wagi ayarbo mila ta patatawutawugan, ka itulam nenian ta ti Tomas: ka niirua ta ti Yesus ru niilif ta ngataf, mituko itu tukad, ka nikuma, Akureya imumian.

27.niv: Then he said to Thomas, “Put your finger here; see my hands. Reach out your hand and put it into my side. Stop doubting and believe.”
27.cmn: 就對多馬說：「伸過你的指頭來，摸我的手；伸出你的手來，探入我的肋旁。不要疑惑，總要信！」
27.sry: Siawug ki ana nikuma ti Tomasan, Adawa ato hiya ki kagamus oho, kitaey ta rima aw, ka adawa ato ta rima oho, tmuaw tu kating aw, Ka ina asi tnamising, ra tamatnamising apa.

28.niv: Thomas said to him, “My Lord and my God!”
28.cmn: 多馬說：「我的主！我的上帝！」
28.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Tomas kuma tenian, Meyrang aw, Alid apa maw.

29.niv: Then Jesus told him, “Because you have seen me, you have believed; blessed are those who have not seen and yet have believed.”
29.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「你因看見了我才信；那沒有看見就信的有福了。」 本書的目的
29.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Aley ka nikmita kaw yawan Tomas, tnamising ato kaw: Tamatagiriyang ta asi nikmita, ka tnamisinga lato.

30.niv: Jesus performed many other signs in the presence of his disciples, which are not recorded in this book.
30.cmn: 耶穌在門徒面前另外行了許多神蹟，沒有記在這書上。
30.sry: Madag apa ki na pukakidi ka pani ta nipamuten ti Yesus tu ayakwan ki Patatawutawugan tin, ka asi nisulaten tu sulat ka ata.

31.niv: But these are written that you may believe that Jesus is the Messiah, the Son of God, and that by believing you may have life in his name.
31.cmn: 但記這些事要叫你們信耶穌是基督，是上帝的兒子，並且叫你們信了他，就可以因他的名得生命。
31.sry: Ra nisulaten ta mamang ka ata, aley ka tnamisinga kamu ka ti Yesus ta ti Kristus, Alak ki Alid, ka ru tnamising kamu ka akumeya kamu ki kawagan tu Nanang tin.

1.niv: Afterward Jesus appeared again to his disciples, by the Sea of Galilee. It happened this way:
1.cmn: 這些事以後，耶穌在提比哩亞海邊又向門徒顯現。他怎樣顯現記在下面：
1.sry: Siawug ki ana nipakita ta ti Yesus mila tenian ki patatawutawugan tu vaung ki Teberiyas. Ka nipakitaan tin kumahina tenian:

2.niv: Simon Peter, Thomas (also known as Didymus), Nathanael from Cana in Galilee, the sons of Zebedee, and two other disciples were together.
2.cmn: 有西門‧彼得和稱為低土馬的多馬，並加利利的迦拿人拿但業，還有西庇太的兩個兒子，又有兩個門徒，都在一處。
2.sry: Itusaal ta ti Simon Petrus, ti Tomas ka siuwa Didimus, ti Natanael ka maka Kana tu Galilaya, ta alalak ti Zebedeyus, ki raruha apa ka pani ki patatawutawugan tin.

3.niv: “Iʼm going out to fish,” Simon Peter told them, and they said, “Weʼll go with you.” So they went out and got into the boat, but that night they caught nothing.
3.cmn: 西門‧彼得對他們說：「我打魚去。」他們說：「我們也和你同去。」他們就出去，上了船；那一夜並沒有打着甚麼。
3.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Simon Petrus nenian, mukwaa ko mudulum. Nikuma neni tenian, tawlama kame imhuan. Ka nitawpapanag ta neni madis madaken tu avang, ka asi nimara ta neni ki mamang maka sat ki awvanan ka ana.

4.niv: Early in the morning, Jesus stood on the shore, but the disciples did not realize that it was Jesus.
4.cmn: 天將亮的時候，耶穌站在岸上，門徒卻不知道是耶穌。
4.sry: Iru ka maramag ato madama, nimituko ta ti Yesus tu karivil: ra asi mumha ta patatawutawugan ka ti Yesus ta ti ana.

5.niv: He called out to them, “Friends, havenʼt you any fish?” “No,” they answered.
5.cmn: 耶穌就對他們說：「小子！你們有吃的沒有？」他們回答說：「沒有。」
5.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Kaalalak, ausi kamu kawa ki avovok ka upapara mavok? Nimatagivli tenian, ausi kame.

6.niv: He said, “Throw your net on the right side of the boat and you will find some.” When they did, they were unable to haul the net in because of the large number of fish.
6.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們把網撒在船的右邊，就必得着。」他們便撒下網去，竟拉不上來了，因為魚甚多。
6.sry: Nikuma ta teni nenian, “smakiraluma ki sasamlid smakiuwal ki avang, ka maraa kamu.” Anata nisakiralumen nein, ka asi nein hilpugen vihit ta ana, aley ki t apang ki tging.

7.niv: Then the disciple whom Jesus loved said to Peter, “It is the Lord!” As soon as Simon Peter heard him say, “It is the Lord,” he wrapped his outer garment around him (for he had taken it off) and jumped into the water.
7.cmn: 耶穌所愛的那門徒對彼得說：「是主！」那時西門‧彼得赤着身子，一聽見是主，就束上一件外衣，跳在海裏。
7.sry: Anata patatawutawugan ka ana ka kavagangoen ti Yesus nikuma ti Petrusan, Meyrang ta ti ata. Iru ka milingig ta Simon Petrus ka Meyrang ta ti ata, niayten tin ta pahaalapen tin mamia, (aley ka manana ta teni) ka nipuralum tenian puvaung.

8.niv: The other disciples followed in the boat, towing the net full of fish, for they were not far from shore, about a hundred yards.
8.cmn: 其餘的門徒離岸不遠，約有二百肘，就在小船上把那網魚拉過來。
8.sry: Ka patatawutawugan ka raruma niirua lam ki avang (nda asi madalia nenian ta purug ruha lava kaatugan ki na rarepung ki pariu) ka vihiten nein ta sasamlid ka idadingen.

9.niv: When they landed, they saw a fire of burning coals there with fish on it, and some bread.
9.cmn: 他們上了岸，就看見那裏有炭火，上面有魚，又有餅。
9.sry: Iru ka nimupurug ta neni nikitaan nein ta niatakwan ki apuy ka vaga, ka pakahalapen ki tging ki paul.

10.niv: Jesus said to them, “Bring some of the fish you have just caught.”
10.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「把剛才打的魚拿幾條來。」
10.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, ‘Adey ki tging ka ana ka niara umi hinin.

11.niv: So Simon Peter climbed back into the boat and dragged the net ashore. It was full of large fish, 153, but even with so many the net was not torn.
11.cmn: 西門‧彼得就去，把網拉到岸上。那網滿了大魚，共一百五十三條；魚雖這樣多，網卻沒有破。
11.sry: Ka nimuvavaw ta ti Simon Petrus vihit ki sasamlid pupurug ka matmuy ki tging ka irirang sat kaatugan ab ki rima kitian ab ki turu: mukuna kadag ka kumahina, asi nikiit ta sasamlid.

12.niv: Jesus said to them, “Come and have breakfast.” None of the disciples dared ask him, “Who are you?” They knew it was the Lord.
12.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們來吃早飯。」門徒中沒有一個敢問他：「你是誰？」因為知道是主。
12.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, ‘Mukwaa apa hiya, mirangaranga mavok. Ka mangala ta timamang ki patatawutawugan tmalig tenian, Timang kaw? Ra umhaen nein ka Meyrang ta ti ata.

13.niv: Jesus came, took the bread and gave it to them, and did the same with the fish.
13.cmn: 耶穌就來拿餅和魚給他們。
13.sry: Anata nimukwa ta ti Yesus ka niara tin ta paul ka nipigaen tin nenian makaulaulau ki tging.

14.niv: This was now the third time Jesus appeared to his disciples after he was raised from the dead.
14.cmn: 耶穌從死裏復活以後，向門徒顯現，這是第三次。 耶穌和彼得
14.sry: Ka ka taturu ato ka ana ki nipakitaan ti Yesus tenian ki patatawutawugan tin, siawug ki nipagapiten tenian ki nikapatayan tin.

15.niv: When they had finished eating, Jesus said to Simon Peter, “Simon son of John, do you love me more than these?” “Yes, Lord,” he said, “you know that I love you.” Jesus said, “Feed my lambs.”
15.cmn: 他們吃完了早飯，耶穌對西門‧彼得說：「約翰的兒子西門，你愛我比這些更深嗎？」彼得說：「主啊，是的，你知道我愛你。」耶穌對他說：「你餵養我的小羊。」
15.sry: Iru ka mikaha ta neni mirangaranga mavok, nikuma ta ti Yesus ti Simon Petrusan, Simon [alak] ti Yona, masaun kaw kawa mavagango yawan Nenian ka ata? Nikuma tenian, Hahay, Meyrang, kavanaen hu ta kavagangoen aw imhuan. Nikuma tenian, [Kadingaw ru] pakakanaw ta patak ki yuko aw.

16.niv: Again Jesus said, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” He answered, “Yes, Lord, you know that I love you.” Jesus said, “Take care of my sheep.”
16.cmn: 耶穌第二次又對他說：「約翰的兒子西門，你愛我嗎？」彼得說：「主啊，是的，你知道我愛你。」耶穌說：「你牧養我的羊。」
16.sry: Nimatagila tenian tu kararuha, Simon alak ti Yona, mavagango kaw kawa yawan? Nikuma tenian, hahay, Meyrang, kavanaen hu ta kavagangoen aw imhuan. Nikuma tenian, Kadingaw ru pakakanaw ta yuko aw.

17.niv: The third time he said to him, “Simon son of John, do you love me?” Peter was hurt because Jesus asked him the third time, “Do you love me?” He said, “Lord, you know all things; you know that I love you.” Jesus said, “Feed my sheep.
17.cmn: 第三次對他說：「約翰的兒子西門，你愛我嗎？」彼得因為耶穌第三次對他說「你愛我嗎」，就憂愁，對耶穌說：「主啊，你是無所不知的；你知道我愛你。」耶穌說：「你餵養我的羊。
17.sry: Nikuma tenian tu ka taturu, Simon alak ti Yona, mavagango kaw kawa yawan? Ka mavulas ta ti Petrus, ka pasusuen tin tenian tu ka taturu, Mavagango kaw kawa yawan? ka nikuma tenian, Meyrang, muatig kaw mumha ki mamang, kavanaen oho ka kavagangoen aw imhuan. Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, “Kadingaw ru pakakanaw ta yuko aw.

18.niv: Very truly I tell you, when you were younger you dressed yourself and went where you wanted; but when you are old you will stretch out your hands, and someone else will dress you and lead you where you do not want to go.”
18.cmn: 我實實在在地告訴你，你年少的時候，自己束上帶子，隨意往來；但年老的時候，你要伸出手來，別人要把你束上，帶你到不願意去的地方。」
18.sry: Mising, mising kun aw kaw, du masaun apa kaw raway, nimalimado kaw mait imhuan, ka nimunonang tu mamang ka kamuyen hu: Iru ra kawmamu alato kaw, siksikai muho ta rima oho, ka maita ta pani imhuan mad tu asi muho kamuyen.

19.niv: Jesus said this to indicate the kind of death by which Peter would glorify God. Then he said to him, “Follow me!”
19.cmn: （耶穌說這話是指着彼得要怎樣死，榮耀上帝。）說了這話，就對他說：「你跟從我吧！」 耶穌和他所愛的那門徒
19.sry: Ka pasusuen tin ta ata, pukidi ki su kapatayan ka mamamang ka puvavawey tin ki kidi ta Alid. Iru ka matagikaha ki ata, nikuma tenian, maawuga yawan.

20.niv: Peter turned and saw that the disciple whom Jesus loved was following them. (This was the one who had leaned back against Jesus at the supper and had said, “Lord, who is going to betray you?”)
20.cmn: 彼得轉過來，看見耶穌所愛的那門徒跟着，（就是在晚飯的時候，靠着耶穌胸膛說：「主啊，賣你的是誰？」的那門徒。）
20.sry: Iru ka maawduma ta ti Petrus, nikitaan tin ka maawug ta patatawutawugan Ka ana ka kavagangoen, ka nimuogo apa ru hiadudongen tu avaw ti Yesus, kuma, Meyrang timang ta sivanavanaa imhuan?

21.niv: When Peter saw him, he asked, “Lord, what about him?”
21.cmn: 彼得看見他，就問耶穌說：「主啊，這人將來如何？」
21.sry: Iru ka kit’an ti Petrus ta ti ata, nikuma Yesusan, Meyrang, umanga ta teni ka ata?

22.niv: Jesus answered, “If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you? You must follow me.”
22.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「我若要他等到我來的時候，與你何干？你跟從我吧！」
22.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Hairu mamuy ko ka mayali ta teni tu kidi ki iraruruan aw, manga muho? Maawuga ta imhu yawan.

23.niv: Because of this, the rumor spread among the believers that this disciple would not die. But Jesus did not say that he would not die; he only said, “If I want him to remain alive until I return, what is that to you?”
23.cmn: 於是這話傳在弟兄中間，說那門徒不死。其實，耶穌不是說他不死，乃是說：「我若要他等到我來的時候，與你何干？」
23.sry: Anata nimupanag ta su ka ata tu tagiapaparag, ka asi mapatayata patatawutawugan ka ana. Ka asi nipasusuen ti Yesus, ki asi tin k apatayey: ra ata apa, hairu mamuy ko ka mayali ta teni tu kidi ki iraruruan aw, manga muho?

24.niv: This is the disciple who testifies to these things and who wrote them down. We know that his testimony is true.
24.cmn: 為這些事作見證，並且記載這些事的就是這門徒；我們也知道他的見證是真的。
24.sry: Teni ta patatawutawugan ka hmail, ka nismulat apa ki mamang ka ata: Kavanaen yan ka matiktik ki su ta hailan tin.

25.niv: Jesus did many other things as well. If every one of them were written down, I suppose that even the whole world would not have room for the books that would be written.
25.cmn: 耶穌所行的事還有許多，若是一一地都寫出來，我想，所寫的書就是世界也容不下了。
25.sry: Madag apa ta panini ki mamang, ka nipamuten ti Yesus, hairu aatiluganey maasasat lava smulat ta mamang ka ana, pukidianaw asi mamsinga ta imid ki nay mara ki na sasulat ka ana. Amen.

1.niv: The beginning of the good news about Jesus the Messiah, the Son of God,
1.cmn: 上帝的兒子，耶穌基督福音的起頭。
1.sry: Naunamu ki hagnaw ka mariyang ti Yesus Kristus, ka Alak ki Alid.

2.niv: as it is written in Isaiah the prophet: “I will send my messenger ahead of you, who will prepare your way”—
2.cmn: 正如先知以賽亞書上記着說： 看哪，我要差遣我的使者在你前面， 預備道路。
2.sry: Mama ki nisulaten tu na tamamatagitan ka ti Esayas, "Kitaey, padingien aw ta tamagnaw aw pasiuro ki vulung oho, ka sidadaranga ki darang oho siururo imhuan.

3.niv: “a voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ ”
3.cmn: 在曠野有人聲喊着說： 預備主的道， 修直他的路。
3.sry: Ingaw ki sat ka makulangag tu pawlapawlag da, 'Sidadaranga pakaparilpil ki darang ki Meyrang, peytiktikaw ta pukakun tin.' "

4.niv: And so John the Baptist appeared in the wilderness, preaching a baptism of repentance for the forgiveness of sins.
4.cmn: 照這話，約翰來了，在曠野施洗，傳悔改的洗禮，使罪得赦。
4.sry: Nda nimawlug ta ti Yoanes tu pawlapawlag, ka matasasu ki awlugan ki pasalikugen ki silala tu atanino ki varaw.

5.niv: The whole Judean countryside and all the people of Jerusalem went out to him. Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
5.cmn: 猶太全地和耶路撒冷的人都出去到約翰那裏，承認他們的罪，在約旦河裏受他的洗。
5.sry: Ka nitawpapanag mukwa tenian ta imid ki purug ki Yudea, neni apa ka tu Yerusalem, ka niawlugen tin ta neni imid nenian tu aguan ki Yordan, tu pupapanagen ki varaw nein ra.

6.niv: John wore clothing made of camelʼs hair, with a leather belt around his waist, and he ate locusts and wild honey.
6.cmn: 約翰穿駱駝毛的衣服，腰束皮帶，吃的是蝗蟲、野蜜。
6.sry: Ka nimami ta ti Yoanes ki pamamian ka na riving ki luwang ka kemel ka aku tuuk kumakwa ki ayt apa ka na kuraaw, ka nimaid ki valut tin, ka kanen tin idahi, na huwalu apa ta ana.

7.niv: And this was his message: “After me comes the one more powerful than I, the straps of whose sandals I am not worthy to stoop down and untie.
7.cmn: 他傳道說：「有一位在我以後來的，能力比我更大，我就是彎腰給他解鞋帶也是不配的。
7.sry: Ka nipatasasuen tin, kun, "Teni ka masaun malig yawan ta iruaa siawug yawan, ka asi ko tu kairangan ki kidi aawsusuaney maw ta rapal ki tatapil tin.

8.niv: I baptize you with water, but he will baptize you with the Holy Spirit.”
8.cmn: 我是用水給你們施洗，他卻要用聖靈給你們施洗。」 耶穌受洗 （太3‧13－17；路3‧21－22）
8.sry: Ti yaw ta niawlugen aw kamu ki ralum, ra teni ta mawlug imumian ki YUPAN."

9.niv: At that time Jesus came from Nazareth in Galilee and was baptized by John in the Jordan.
9.cmn: 那時，耶穌從加利利的拿撒勒來，在約旦河裏受了約翰的洗。
9.sry: Ka nikuma ato hina tu wagi ka ana niirua ta ti Yesus maka Nazareth ka tu Galilaya, ka niawlugen ti Yoanes tenian tu aguan ki Yordan.

10.niv: Just as Jesus was coming up out of the water, he saw heaven being torn open and the Spirit descending on him like a dove.
10.cmn: 他從水裏一上來，就看見天裂開了，聖靈彷彿鴿子，降在他身上。
10.sry: Ka madis du nipadaken ka maka ralum, nikitaan tin ta vuluvulum ka nilutuaf, ka YUPAN ka nimurarim mama ki padaug tu halap tenian.

11.niv: And a voice came from heaven: “You are my Son, whom I love; with you I am well pleased.”
11.cmn: 又有聲音從天上來，說：「你是我的愛子，我喜悅你。」 耶穌受試探 （太4‧1－11；路4‧1－13）
11.sry: Ka niirua ta ingaw maka tunun ki vuluvulum, ka nikuma, "Alak aw kaw ka kavagangoen, ka kamawen aw ta imhu."

12.niv: At once the Spirit sent him out into the wilderness,
12.cmn: 聖靈就把耶穌催到曠野裏去。
12.sry: Ka madis nidmilug ta YUPAN pukwa tenian tu pawlapawlag.

13.niv: and he was in the wilderness forty days, being tempted by Satan. He was with the wild animals, and angels attended him.
13.cmn: 他在曠野四十天，受撒但的試探，並與野獸同在一處，且有天使來伺候他。 開始在加利利傳道 （太4‧12－17；路4‧14－15）
13.sry: Ka niitukwa hina tu pawlapawlag maka apat kitian ki wagi, ka repungey ki Satan ka itulam tenian ta ayayam ka pupu, ka Tamagnaw ta nimilig tenian.

14.niv: After John was put in prison, Jesus went into Galilee, proclaiming the good news of God.
14.cmn: 約翰下監以後，耶穌來到加利利，宣傳上帝的福音，
14.sry: Tu awug ka nipaatunun papusangat ta ti Yoanes, niirua ta ti Yesus mukwa tu Galilaya, matasasu ki Hagnaw ka mariyang ki Peysasuan ki Alid.

15.niv: “The time has come,” he said. “The kingdom of God has come near. Repent and believe the good news!”
15.cmn: 說：「日期滿了，上帝的國近了。你們當悔改，信福音！」 呼召四個漁夫 （太4‧18－22；路5‧1－11）
15.sry: Kuma, "nipamut ato ta kidi, ka nimutuk ta peysasuan ki Alid. Pasalikuga ki vana umi ki rig, tnamisinga apa ki hagnaw ka mariyang."

16.niv: As Jesus walked beside the Sea of Galilee, he saw Simon and his brother Andrew casting a net into the lake, for they were fishermen.
16.cmn: 耶穌順着加利利的海邊走，看見西門和西門的兄弟安得烈在海裏撒網；他們本是打魚的。
16.sry: Ka tu hiritungen tin munonang tu said ki vaung ki Galilaya, nikitaan tin ta ti Simon, ti Andreas apa ka tagiapaparag tin, ka smakivaung ki rareyhul: aley ka tamapudulum ta neni.

17.niv: “Come, follow me,” Jesus said, “and I will send you out to fish for people.”
17.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「來跟從我，我要叫你們得人如得魚一樣。」
17.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, "Maawuga yawan, ka pasikwaaw maw kamu paudulum ki kagulung."

18.niv: At once they left their nets and followed him.
18.cmn: 他們就立刻捨了網，跟從了他。
18.sry: Ka du madis ataral ki rareyhul, nimaawug ta neni tenian.

19.niv: When he had gone a little farther, he saw James son of Zebedee and his brother John in a boat, preparing their nets.
19.cmn: 耶穌稍往前走，又見西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰在船上補網。
19.sry: Hairu ka nimalidaw ta teni makakwa hina, nikitaan tin ta ti Yakobus ka alak ti Zebedeyus, ti Yoanes apa ka tagiapaparag tin, ka tu avang nein papapat ki kakawaur ki rareyhul nein.

20.niv: Without delay he called them, and they left their father Zebedee in the boat with the hired men and followed him.
20.cmn: 耶穌隨即招呼他們，他們就把父親西庇太和雇工人留在船上，跟從耶穌去了。 一個污鬼附身的人 （路4‧31－37）
20.sry: Ka madis nitataam tin nenian, ka ru paitukakwa ki raraman nein ka ti Zebedeyus tu avang lam ki nipapakalalamen tenian, nimaawug ta neni tenian.

21.niv: They went to Capernaum, and when the Sabbath came, Jesus went into the synagogue and began to teach.
21.cmn: 到了迦百農，耶穌就在安息日進了會堂教訓人。
21.sry: Ka nisakakwa ta neni tu Kapernaum, ka madis tu wagi ki pahihababan nisararbo tu pakuisalan matawtawug.

22.niv: The people were amazed at his teaching, because he taught them as one who had authority, not as the teachers of the law.
22.cmn: 眾人很希奇他的教訓；因為他教訓他們，正像有權柄的人，不像文士。
22.sry: Ka nimukiap ta neni ki nipatatawtawugan tin, aley ka nimatatawtawug nenian mama ki aku kairangan ki kidi, asi mama ki makusasulat.

23.niv: Just then a man in their synagogue who was possessed by an impure spirit cried out,
23.cmn: 在會堂裏，有一個人被污鬼附着。他喊叫說：
23.sry: Ka niayakwa tu pakuisalan nein ta tau ka aku yupan ka asi matikanag, ka nimakulangag ta teni.

24.niv: “What do you want with us, Jesus of Nazareth? Have you come to destroy us? I know who you are—the Holy One of God!”
24.cmn: 「拿撒勒人耶穌，我們與你有甚麼相干？你來滅我們嗎？我知道你是誰，乃是上帝的聖者。」
24.sry: Kuma , "Dmaranga imianan, mang yan imhu Yesus ka maka Nazareth? Irua ato kaw tu parumarumaa imianan? Kavanaen aw kaw timang ka imhu, Dilig Matiktik ki Alid."

25.niv: “Be quiet!” said Jesus sternly. “Come out of him!”
25.cmn: 耶穌責備他說：「不要作聲！從這人身上出來吧。」
25.sry: Ka nimatimha ta ti Yesus tenian, kun, "Mipata, mupanag tenian."

26.niv: The impure spirit shook the man violently and came out of him with a shriek.
26.cmn: 污鬼叫那人抽了一陣瘋，大聲喊叫，就出來了。
26.sry: Ka ru nidilidilen ta rig ki yupan ka asi matikanag, nimakulangag ki ingaw ka irang, mupanag tenian.

27.niv: The people were all so amazed that they asked each other, “What is this? A new teaching—and with authority! He even gives orders to impure spirits and they obey him.”
27.cmn: 眾人都驚訝，以致彼此對問說：「這是甚麼事？是個新道理啊！他用權柄吩咐污鬼，連污鬼也聽從了他。」
27.sry: Ka nimuimid ta neni mukiap, kuma apa hina ka patagitavatavag ta neni, kun, "Mang ta ata? Mang ta patawtawugan ka vahaw ka ata? Ka kairangan ki kidi pasusuen tin ta yupan ka asi matikanag, ka milig tenian."

28.niv: News about him spread quickly over the whole region of Galilee.
28.cmn: 耶穌的名聲就傳遍了加利利的四方。 治好許多病人 （太8‧14－17；路4‧38－41）
28.sry: Ka madis nimupanag ta kalawakaw ki nanang tin tu imid apa ki purug ka tu tamang ki Galilaya.

29.niv: As soon as they left the synagogue, they went with James and John to the home of Simon and Andrew.
29.cmn: 他們一出會堂，就同着雅各、約翰，進了西門和安得烈的家。
29.sry: Ka madis du samamala tu pakuisalan, niirua ta neni tu talag ti Simon ti Andreas lam ti Yakobusan ti Yoanesan apa.

30.niv: Simonʼs mother-in-law was in bed with a fever, and they immediately told Jesus about her.
30.cmn: 西門的岳母正害熱病躺着，就有人告訴耶穌。
30.sry: Ka rarenan ki keyan ti Simon ta nialikug ka ayngit, ka nivanavanaen nein tenian aley tenian.

31.niv: So he went to her, took her hand and helped her up. The fever left her and she began to wait on them.
31.cmn: 耶穌進前拉着她的手，扶她起來，熱就退了，她就服事他們。
31.sry: Iru ka mukwa ta teni, nimakitil ki rima tin, ka nipatimawagen tin, ka madis niataral ta ayngit tenian, ka nipeylilig tin tenian.

32.niv: That evening after sunset the people brought to Jesus all the sick and demon-possessed.
32.cmn: 天晚日落的時候，有人帶着一切害病的，和被鬼附的，來到耶穌跟前。
32.sry: Iru ka madung ato du nisamdam ta wagi, niad nein tenian imid nenian ka asi mariyang ki vual, ki niulitu apa.

33.niv: The whole town gathered at the door,
33.cmn: 合城的人都聚集在門前。
33.sry: Ka nimawisal ato ta sat kaawmaan tu ngataf.

34.niv: and Jesus healed many who had various diseases. He also drove out many demons, but he would not let the demons speak because they knew who he was.
34.cmn: 耶穌治好了許多害各樣病的人，又趕出許多鬼，不許鬼說話，因為鬼認識他。 在加利利各會堂傳道 （路4‧42－44）
34.sry: Ka nipadarikag tin ta mabatung ka asi mariyang ki vual ka manini ki malam, ka nipadarangen tin ta madadag ki litu: ka asi tin hahayen ki pasusuey ta litu, aley ka kalangen nein tenian.

35.niv: Very early in the morning, while it was still dark, Jesus got up, left the house and went off to a solitary place, where he prayed.
35.cmn: 次日早晨，天未亮的時候，耶穌起來，到曠野地方去，在那裏禱告。
35.sry: Ka ru matakung tu madama apa, du ausi apa ki wagi, nigapit ta teni nitawpapanag, ka nidmarang mukwa tu itukwaan ki pulag, ka nimakualilid hina.

36.niv: Simon and his companions went to look for him,
36.cmn: 西門和同伴追了他去，
36.sry: Ka nikmiim tenian ta ti Simon, neni apa lam tenian.

37.niv: and when they found him, they exclaimed: “Everyone is looking for you!”
37.cmn: 遇見了就對他說：「眾人都找你。」
37.sry: Ka ru nipakivaley nein tenian, nikuma tenian, "Kmiim ta imid imhuan."

38.niv: Jesus replied, “Let us go somewhere else—to the nearby villages—so I can preach there also. That is why I have come.”
38.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「我們可以往別處去，到鄰近的鄉村，我也好在那裏傳道，因為我是為這事出來的。」
38.sry: Ra nikuma ta teni nenian, "Ukwaey eta tu awmaawma ka tu tamang, aley ka matasasu ko apa hina, ka aley ki ana nitawpapanag ko."

39.niv: So he traveled throughout Galilee, preaching in their synagogues and driving out demons.
39.cmn: 於是在加利利全地，進了會堂，傳道，趕鬼。 潔淨長大痲瘋的人 （太8‧1－4；路5‧12－16）
39.sry: Ka nimatagisasu ta teni tu pakuisalan nein tu imid apa ki Galilaya, ka nipadarangen tin ta litu.

40.niv: A man with leprosy came to him and begged him on his knees, “If you are willing, you can make me clean.”
40.cmn: 有一個長大痲瘋的來求耶穌，向他跪下，說：「你若肯，必能叫我潔淨了。」
40.sry: Ka niirua tenian ta Lepros ka utatauman, tmumimia ru matalikurug tenian, kuma tenian, "Iru mamuy kaw, pakalpug kaw pakakuptig yawan da."

41.niv: Jesus was indignant. He reached out his hand and touched the man. “I am willing,” he said. “Be clean!”
41.cmn: 耶穌動了慈心，就伸手摸他，說：「我肯，你潔淨了吧！」
41.sry: Ka ru mararig ato maharum ta ti Yesus, nisikidi ki rima tin, nismukla tenian, kuma tenian, "Mamuy ko, nda kmuptiga."

42.niv: Immediately the leprosy left him and he was cleansed.
42.cmn: 大痲瘋即時離開他，他就潔淨了。
42.sry: Ka madis nimasusu ta teni, ka niataral tenian ta utatauman, ka nipakakuptig.

43.niv: Jesus sent him away at once with a strong warning:
43.cmn: 耶穌嚴嚴地囑咐他，就打發他走，
43.sry: Ka nisingig mavag tenian, nipadarangen tin madis ta teni.

44.niv: “See that you donʼt tell this to anyone. But go, show yourself to the priest and offer the sacrifices that Moses commanded for your cleansing, as a testimony to them.”
44.cmn: 對他說：「你要謹慎，甚麼話都不可告訴人，只要去把身體給祭司察看，又因為你潔淨了，獻上摩西所吩咐的禮物，對眾人作證據。」
44.sry: Ka nikuma tenian, "Kitaey, ka asi imhu banavanaey timamangan. Ra ukwa, pakitaa imhuan ki dadilug, ka pigika ki pakakuptigan oho, ki na sikakidi ti Moses, tu patagitununen ki rig nein."

45.niv: Instead he went out and began to talk freely, spreading the news. As a result, Jesus could no longer enter a town openly but stayed outside in lonely places. Yet the people still came to him from everywhere.
45.cmn: 那人出去，倒說許多的話，把這件事傳揚開了，叫耶穌以後不得再明明地進城，只好在外邊曠野地方。人從各處都就了他來。
45.sry: Ra teni ru dmarang, nimataginaunamu banavana ki ata, kumahina ka asi nipailpug ta ti Yesus murbo tu awma pupanag, ra itukwa apa tu itukwaan ka maawmia. Ka niirua ta neni mukwa tenian maka imid ki kidi.

1.niv: A few days later, when Jesus again entered Capernaum, the people heard that he had come home.
1.cmn: 過了些日子，耶穌又進了迦百農。人聽見他在房子裏，
1.sry: Siawug ki wawagi, nimila sararbo ta teni tu Kapernaum ka nipubeyag ka ayaawma nimutalag ta teni.

2.niv: They gathered in such large numbers that there was no room left, not even outside the door, and he preached the word to them.
2.cmn: 就有許多人聚集，甚至連門前都沒有空地；耶穌就對他們講道。
2.sry: Ka madag ta nimawisal hina, kumahina ka ausi apa ki itukwaan nenian, asi apa tu mala ki ngataf. Ka nipatagisasuen tin ta su nenian.

3.niv: Some men came, bringing to him a paralyzed man, carried by four of them.
3.cmn: 有人帶着一個癱子來見耶穌，是用四個人抬來的；
3.sry: Ka niirua ta neni tenian, ka akakeyul ki saat ka dimidimien ki vual, ka niaden ki apat ki vual.

4.niv: Since they could not get him to Jesus because of the crowd, they made an opening in the roof above Jesus by digging through it and then lowered the mat the man was lying on.
4.cmn: 因為人多，不得近前，就把耶穌所在的房子，拆了房頂，既拆通了，就把癱子連所躺臥的褥子都縋下來。
4.sry: Ka ru asi nein ilpugen mukwa tenian aley ki makuilalawlaw, niawluben nein ta apang ka ayakwaan tin, ka ru niaawtapangen ta ata, nipeyrarim nein ta apagan ki dimidimien ki vual ka ana.

5.niv: When Jesus saw their faith, he said to the paralyzed man, “Son, your sins are forgiven.”
5.cmn: 耶穌見他們的信心，就對癱子說：「小子，你的罪赦了。」
5.sry: Iru ka kakitan ti Yesus ta tnamisingan nein, nikuma ki dimidimien da, "Alak, niataralen kaw ki varaw oho."

6.niv: Now some teachers of the law were sitting there, thinking to themselves,
6.cmn: 有幾個文士坐在那裏，心裏議論，說：
6.sry: Ka aku raruma ki makusasulat ka mirung hina, matagirmur tu tintin nein

7.niv: “Why does this fellow talk like that? Heʼs blaspheming! Who can forgive sins but God alone?”
7.cmn: 「這個人為甚麼這樣說呢？他說僭妄的話了。除了上帝以外，誰能赦罪呢？」
7.sry: "Kamang ka kumahina ta ti ata matagikumahina ki barugan? Timang ta tnalpug ataral ki varaw, dik ki Alid tu saat?"

8.niv: Immediately Jesus knew in his spirit that this was what they were thinking in their hearts, and he said to them, “Why are you thinking these things?
8.cmn: 耶穌心中知道他們心裏這樣議論，就說：「你們心裏為甚麼這樣議論呢？
8.sry: Ka madis du umhaen ti Yesus tu yupan tin ka ata ta pagdumdum nein, nikuma nenian, "Kamang ta pagdumdum umi ki ata tu tintin umi?

9.niv: Which is easier: to say to this paralyzed man, ‘Your sins are forgiven,’ or to say, ‘Get up, take your mat and walk’?
9.cmn: 或對癱子說『你的罪赦了』，或說『起來！拿你的褥子行走』，哪一樣容易呢？
9.sry: Kamang ta masaun asi mahugfpit ka su ki dimidimien, 'Ataralen kaw ki varaw hu'; ki pusuen lava, 'gapita, araw ta apagan oho, munonanga?' "

10.niv: But I want you to know that the Son of Man has authority on earth to forgive sins.” So he said to the man,
10.cmn: 但要叫你們知道，人子在地上有赦罪的權柄。」就對癱子說：
10.sry: Ka aley ka mumhaa kamu, ka aku kairangan ki kailgan ta Alak ki kagulung tu ataralan ki varaw tu Nay ra." Nda nikuma tu dimidimien,

11.niv: “I tell you, get up, take your mat and go home.”
11.cmn: 「我吩咐你，起來！拿你的褥子回家去吧。」
11.sry: "Pasusuen aw kaw, gapita, angpoaw ta apagan oho, dmaranga mukwa tu talag oho."

12.niv: He got up, took his mat and walked out in full view of them all. This amazed everyone and they praised God, saying, “We have never seen anything like this!”
12.cmn: 那人就起來，立刻拿着褥子，當眾人面前出去了，以致眾人都驚奇，歸榮耀與上帝，說：「我們從來沒有見過這樣的事！」 呼召利未 （太9‧9－13；路5‧27－32）
12.sry: Ka madis nigapit ta teni, ka ru niara tin ta apagan tin, nidmarang tu amag nenian, kumahina ka nimukiap ta neni ka imid, ka nipakairang ki kidi ki Alid, kun, "Mikakwa asi kame nikmita ki kumahina."

13.niv: Once again Jesus went out beside the lake. A large crowd came to him, and he began to teach them.
13.cmn: 耶穌又出到海邊去，眾人都就了他來，他便教訓他們。
13.sry: Ka nisalikug ta teni muarug ki vaung, ka maimid ki makuilalawlaw ta niirua tenian, ka nimatawtawug ta teni nenian.

14.niv: As he walked along, he saw Levi son of Alphaeus sitting at the tax collectorʼs booth. “Follow me,” Jesus told him, and Levi got up and followed him.
14.cmn: 耶穌經過的時候，看見亞勒腓的兒子利未坐在稅關上，就對他說：「你跟從我來。」他就起來，跟從了耶穌。
14.sry: Ka tu hiritungen tin, nikmita ti Levian ka alak ti Alfeus ka mirung tu talag ki ahimugan, ka nikuma tenian, "Maawuga yawan." Ka ru nigapit nimaawug tenian.

15.niv: While Jesus was having dinner at Leviʼs house, many tax collectors and sinners were eating with him and his disciples, for there were many who followed him.
15.cmn: 耶穌在利未家裏坐席的時候，有好些稅吏和罪人與耶穌並門徒一同坐席；因為這樣的人多，他們也跟隨耶穌。
15.sry: Ka ru mirung ta ti Yesus mavok tu talag ti Levi, mabatung ta tamaimug, ki tamakavaraw apa ka nikman lam tenian ki patatawtawugan apa tin aley ka mabatung ta neni ka nimaawug tenian.

16.niv: When the teachers of the law who were Pharisees saw him eating with the sinners and tax collectors, they asked his disciples: “Why does he eat with tax collectors and sinners?”
16.cmn: 法利賽人中的文士看見耶穌和罪人並稅吏一同吃飯，就對他門徒說：「他和稅吏並罪人一同吃喝嗎？」
16.sry: Ka ru nikmita ta teni ki makusasulat ki Farizeen apa ka ana mavok ki tamaimug ki tamakavaraw apa, nikuma ta neni ki Patatawtawugan tin, 'Kamang ka mavok ta teni, ka mit ki tamaimug ki tamakavaraw apa?'

17.niv: On hearing this, Jesus said to them, “It is not the healthy who need a doctor, but the sick. I have not come to call the righteous, but sinners.”
17.cmn: 耶穌聽見，就對他們說：「康健的人用不着醫生，有病的人才用得着。我來本不是召義人，乃是召罪人。」 禁食的問題 （太9‧14－17；路5‧33－39）
17.sry: Iru ka milingig ta ti Yesus ki ata, nikuma nenian, "Manga nenian ka madarikag ta asi mayaapo ki tamasimimia ki malam, ka dik aley ki asi mariyang ki vual. Asi ko irua lato tmataam ki matiktik, ra tmataam apa ki tamakavaraw tu silala."

18.niv: Now Johnʼs disciples and the Pharisees were fasting. Some people came and asked Jesus, “How is it that Johnʼs disciples and the disciples of the Pharisees are fasting, but yours are not?”
18.cmn: 當下，約翰的門徒和法利賽人禁食。他們來問耶穌說：「約翰的門徒和法利賽人的門徒禁食，你的門徒倒不禁食，這是為甚麼呢？」
18.sry: Ka nirmirkut ta patatawtawugan ti Yoanes, ki Farizeen apa: ka niirua ta neni, ka nikuma tenian, "Kaumang ka nirmirkut ta patatawtawugan ti Yoanes, ki Farizeen apa, ra asi rmirkut ta patatawtawugan oho?"

19.niv: Jesus answered, “How can the guests of the bridegroom fast while he is with them? They cannot, so long as they have him with them.
19.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「新郎和陪伴之人同在的時候，陪伴之人豈能禁食呢？新郎還同在，他們不能禁食。
19.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, "Hmahay kawa mirkut ta Alalak ka pulalam ki parag ka vahaw, ru ayakwa apa nenian ta parag ka makakakitil ka ana? Ru ayakwa apa nenian ta parag ka makakakitil [tu peykakitilan], asi hmahay mirkut ta neni.

20.niv: But the time will come when the bridegroom will be taken from them, and on that day they will fast.
20.cmn: 但日子將到，新郎要離開他們，那日他們就要禁食。
20.sry: Ra irua ta wagi, ka hamiaw nenian ta parag ka vahaw, anata mirkuta ta neni tu wagi ka ana.

21.niv: “No one sews a patch of unshrunk cloth on an old garment. Otherwise, the new piece will pull away from the old, making the tear worse.
21.cmn: 沒有人把新布縫在舊衣服上，恐怕所補上的新布帶壞了舊衣服，破的就更大了。
21.sry: Ausi ta timamang ka puhalap ki apapad ka ausi apa ki huping ka vahaw tu kulamug ka marufpa ka rie, iru kumahina, mukhit ta na apad ka ausi apa ki huping ki rie, ka mudarima mukhit ta khit.

22.niv: And no one pours new wine into old wineskins. Otherwise, the wine will burst the skins, and both the wine and the wineskins will be ruined. No, they pour new wine into new wineskins.”
22.cmn: 也沒有人把新酒裝在舊皮袋裏，恐怕酒把皮袋裂開，酒和皮袋就都壞了；惟把新酒裝在新皮袋裏。」 安息日的問題 （太12‧1－8；路6‧1－5）
22.sry: Ka asi pukwan ta timamang ki hala ki karawmata ka vahaw tu vanak ka rie: iru kumahina, muptu ta hala ka vahaw ki vanak, ka pautirien ta hala, ka mikuley ta vanak: ra kidi pukwan ta hala ki karawmata ka vahaw tu vanak ka vahaw."

23.niv: One Sabbath Jesus was going through the grainfields, and as his disciples walked along, they began to pick some heads of grain.
23.cmn: 耶穌當安息日從麥地經過。他門徒行路的時候，掐了麥穗。
23.sry: Ka nikuma ato hina ka nitawkwa ta teni ki uma tu wagi ki pahihababan, ka patatawtawugan tin, tu darang nein, madis mutut apa ki nanag.

24.niv: The Pharisees said to him, “Look, why are they doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath?”
24.cmn: 法利賽人對耶穌說：「看哪，他們在安息日為甚麼做不可做的事呢？」
24.sry: Ka nikuma tenian ta Farizeen, "Kitaey, kaumang ka pamut nein ta asi hahayen pamut tu wagi ki pahihababan?"

25.niv: He answered, “Have you never read what David did when he and his companions were hungry and in need?
25.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「經上記着大衛和跟從他的人缺乏飢餓之時所做的事，你們沒有念過嗎？
25.sry: Ra nikuma ta teni nenian, "Mikakwa kawa asi umi nikting kamang ta niringeyen ti David, du mayaapo ka magangey, teni, ki lam apa tin?

26.niv: In the days of Abiathar the high priest, he entered the house of God and ate the consecrated bread, which is lawful only for priests to eat. And he also gave some to his companions.”
26.cmn: 他當亞比亞他作大祭司的時候，怎麼進了上帝的殿，吃了陳設餅，又給跟從他的人吃。這餅除了祭司以外，人都不可吃。」
26.sry: Mama ki mang ka nimurbo tu talag ki Alid, tu wagi ki Dadilug ka Sibavaw ka ti Abiatar, ka nikman ki paul ki puamagen, ka asi hahayen pakan dik ki dadilug, dik ki tamapigik, ka nipiga apa tin ki lam tin da?"

27.niv: Then he said to them, “The Sabbath was made for man, not man for the Sabbath.
27.cmn: 又對他們說：「安息日是為人設立的，人不是為安息日設立的。
27.sry: Ka nikuma apa ta teni nenian, "Nipeyringey ta wagi ki pahihababan aley ki kagulung, asi ki kagulung aley ki wagi ki pahihababan.

28.niv: So the Son of Man is Lord even of the Sabbath.”
28.cmn: 所以，人子也是安息日的主。」
28.sry: Anata Meyrang apa ki wagi ki pahihababan ta Alak ki kagulung."

1.niv: Another time Jesus went into the synagogue, and a man with a shriveled hand was there.
1.cmn: 耶穌又進了會堂，在那裏有一個人枯乾了一隻手。
1.sry: Ka nimurbo ta teni mila tu Pakuisalan, ka akumeya hina ta tau ka nilaklak ato ki rima.

2.niv: Some of them were looking for a reason to accuse Jesus, so they watched him closely to see if he would heal him on the Sabbath.
2.cmn: 眾人窺探耶穌，在安息日醫治不醫治，意思是要控告耶穌。
2.sry: Ka nikmiim ta neni tenian, malava ka padarikag tin ta teni tu wagi ki pahihababan, aley ka pakavavarawa tenian.

3.niv: Jesus said to the man with the shriveled hand, “Stand up in front of everyone.”
3.cmn: 耶穌對那枯乾一隻手的人說：「起來，站在當中。」
3.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus ki vual ka niilaklaken ki rima, "gapita".

4.niv: Then Jesus asked them, “Which is lawful on the Sabbath: to do good or to do evil, to save life or to kill?” But they remained silent.
4.cmn: 又問眾人說：「在安息日行善行惡，救命害命，哪樣是可以的呢？」他們都不作聲。
4.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, "Hahayen kawa pamut ki mariyang tu wagi ki pahihababan, ka asi lava pamut ki mariyang ki pakariyang ki kawagan, ki pakapatayey kawa?" Neni ra mipat.

5.niv: He looked around at them in anger and, deeply distressed at their stubborn hearts, said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” He stretched it out, and his hand was completely restored.
5.cmn: 耶穌怒目周圍看他們，憂愁他們的心剛硬，就對那人說：「伸出手來！」他把手一伸，手就復了原。
5.sry: Ka ru ararawen tin tu hivat mararaw nenian ki ngale, ka uhang mivavulas aley ki tihag nein ki tintin, nikuma ki vual, "Siksikaw ta rima oho". Ka nisiken tin, ka nikawlikug kawriyang ta rima tin [mama ki ruma].

6.niv: Then the Pharisees went out and began to plot with the Herodians how they might kill Jesus.
6.cmn: 法利賽人出去，同希律一黨的人商議怎樣可以除滅耶穌。 海邊的群眾
6.sry: Iru ka nimumala ta Farizeen, madis nimakuisal ki su ki Herodianen sadaduma tenian, mamamang ka parumarumaa tenian.

7.niv: Jesus withdrew with his disciples to the lake, and a large crowd from Galilee followed.
7.cmn: 耶穌和門徒退到海邊去，有許多人從加利利跟隨他。
7.sry: Ka nitawpapanag ta ti Yesus lam ki patatawtawugan tin paukwa tu vaung, ka nimuawug tenian ta makuilalawlaw mabatung, maka Galilaya, maka Yudea apa.

8.niv: When they heard about all he was doing, many people came to him from Judea, Jerusalem, Idumea, and the regions across the Jordan and around Tyre and Sidon.
8.cmn: 還有許多人聽見他所做的大事，就從猶太、耶路撒冷、以土買、約旦河外，並泰爾、西頓的四方來到他那裏。
8.sry: Du milingig ki madag ki na ringey tin, niirua tenian makuilalawlaw ka irang, maka Yerusalem, maka Idumea, maka arug ki Yordan, maka lbag ki nay ki Tayrus ki Sidon.

9.niv: Because of the crowd he told his disciples to have a small boat ready for him, to keep the people from crowding him.
9.cmn: 他因為人多，就吩咐門徒叫一隻小船伺候着，免得眾人擁擠他。
9.sry: Ka nimasusu ki patatawtawugan tin ka paamata tenian ta avang ka using aley ka asi ki makuilalawlaw dmudunga ta neni tenian.

10.niv: For he had healed many, so that those with diseases were pushing forward to touch him.
10.cmn: 他治好了許多人，所以凡有災病的，都擠進來要摸他。
10.sry: Aley ka nipadarikag tin ta mabatung, kumahina ka nismakiduma ta neni tenian, aley ka smukla tenian, imid ka aku maalam ki vual.

11.niv: Whenever the impure spirits saw him, they fell down before him and cried out, “You are the Son of God.”
11.cmn: 污鬼無論何時看見他，就俯伏在他面前，喊着說：「你是上帝的兒子。」
11.sry: Ka du ararawen ta yupan ka asi matikanag, ru kitaan nein tenian, maawhakub tu duma tenian, makulangag ta neni, kuma, "Alak kaw ki Alid."

12.niv: But he gave them strict orders not to tell others about him.
12.cmn: 耶穌再三地囑咐他們，不要把他顯露出來。 設立十二門徒 （太10‧1－4；路6‧12－16）
12.sry: Ka nisingig mavag nenian, ka asi pakaamaga tenian.

13.niv: Jesus went up on a mountainside and called to him those he wanted, and they came to him.
13.cmn: 耶穌上了山，隨自己的意思叫人來；他們便來到他那裏。
13.sry: Ka nimagdak ta ti Yesus muvukin, nitmataam tenian ka kamuyen tin, ka nimukwa ta neni tenian.

14.niv: He appointed twelve that they might be with him and that he might send them out to preach
14.cmn: 他就設立十二個人，要他們常和自己同在，也要差他們去傳道，
14.sry: Ka nisikidi ta teni ki sat kitian ab ki ruha ki vual ka itulam ta neni tenian, aley apa ka apostolos tin ta neni tu patasasuey nein,

15.niv: and to have authority to drive out demons.
15.cmn: 並給他們權柄趕鬼。
15.sry: ka akumeya ki kailigan ki padarikagey ta maalam, ki padarangaw apa ta litu.

16.niv: These are the twelve he appointed: Simon (to whom he gave the name Peter),
16.cmn: 這十二個人有西門（耶穌又給他起名叫彼得），
16.sry: Ti Simon ka nipananangen tin ta ti Petrus,

17.niv: James son of Zebedee and his brother John (to them he gave the name Boanerges, which means “sons of thunder”),
17.cmn: 還有西庇太的兒子雅各和雅各的兄弟約翰（又給這兩個人起名叫半尼其，就是雷子的意思），
17.sry: ti Yakobus ka alak ti Zebedeyus, ti Yoanes apa ka tagiapaparag ti Yakobus ka nismakinanang tin ta neni Boanerges, ka siuwa alalak ki iltag,

18.niv: Andrew, Philip, Bartholomew, Matthew, Thomas, James son of Alphaeus, Thaddaeus, Simon the Zealot
18.cmn: 又有安得烈、腓力、巴多羅買、馬太、多馬、亞勒腓的兒子雅各，和達太，並奮銳黨的西門，
18.sry: ti Andreas, ti Filipus, ti Bartolomeus, ti Mateus, ti Tomas, ti Yakobus ka alak ti Alfeus, ti Tadeus, ti Simon ka Malingag apa,

19.niv: and Judas Iscariot, who betrayed him.
19.cmn: 還有賣耶穌的加略人猶大。 耶穌和別西卜 （太12‧22－32；路11‧14－23；12‧10）
19.sry: ti Yudas Iskariot ka nisitunun sihmamha tenian.

20.niv: Then Jesus entered a house, and again a crowd gathered, so that he and his disciples were not even able to eat.
20.cmn: 耶穌進了一個屋子，眾人又聚集，甚至他連飯也顧不得吃。
20.sry: Ka nimurbo ta neni ki talag. Ka nimawisal mila ta makuilalawlaw, kumahina ka asi nein palpugen kman ki paul.

21.niv: When his family heard about this, they went to take charge of him, for they said, “He is out of his mind.”
21.cmn: 耶穌的親屬聽見，就出來要拉住他，因為他們說他癲狂了。
21.sry: Iru ka nimilingig ta neni ki ata, nitawpapanag ta neni tu turungen tenian, aley ka nikuma ta neni, "Pisburavural ta teni."

22.niv: And the teachers of the law who came down from Jerusalem said, “He is possessed by Beelzebul! By the prince of demons he is driving out demons.”
22.cmn: 從耶路撒冷下來的文士說：「他是被別西卜附着」；又說：「他是靠着鬼王趕鬼。」
22.sry: Ka nikuma ta makusasulat ka nimurarim maka Yerusalem, kun, "aku na Beelzebul ta teni, ka padarangen tin ta litu ki sibavaw ki litulitu."

23.niv: So Jesus called them over to him and began to speak to them in parables: “How can Satan drive out Satan?
23.cmn: 耶穌叫他們來，用比喻對他們說：「撒但怎能趕出撒但呢？
23.sry: Ka nitataam ti Yesus paukwa tenian, nikuma nenian ki pamikawlawan ki su, "Mulpug mama ki mang ta litu padarang ki Satanan?

24.niv: If a kingdom is divided against itself, that kingdom cannot stand.
24.cmn: 若一國自相紛爭，那國就站立不住；
24.sry: Ka ru peypapurupurug ta peysasuan ka peypapurupurug tenian mamado, asi itukakwaa ta peysasuan ka ana.

25.niv: If a house is divided against itself, that house cannot stand.
25.cmn: 若一家自相紛爭，那家就站立不住。
25.sry: Ka ru maawduma ta talag tenian mamado, asi itukakwaa ta talag ka ana.

26.niv: And if Satan opposes himself and is divided, he cannot stand; his end has come.
26.cmn: 若撒但自相攻打紛爭，他就站立不住，必要滅亡。
26.sry: Ka ru gapita ta Satan makuduma tenian mamado, ka papiagaw, asi itukakwaa ta teni, ra irua ato ki kawkahan tin.

27.niv: In fact, no one can enter a strong manʼs house without first tying him up. Then he can plunder the strong manʼs house.
27.cmn: 沒有人能進壯士家裏，搶奪他的家具；必先捆住那壯士，才可以搶奪他的家。
27.sry: Asi mulpug ta timamang murbo ki talag ki siuro malig pasawara ki sato tin, ru asi tin aliuroen bawut ta siuro malig, anata pasawaraa ki talag tin.

28.niv: Truly I tell you, people can be forgiven all their sins and every slander they utter,
28.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，世人一切的罪和一切褻瀆的話都可得赦免；
28.sry: Dilig kun aw kamu ra, ataraley ta imid ki varaw ki alalak ki kagulung, ki barugan apa ka barugan ato nein makutalum.

29.niv: but whoever blasphemes against the Holy Spirit will never be forgiven; they are guilty of an eternal sin.”
29.cmn: 凡褻瀆聖靈的，卻永不得赦免，乃要擔當永遠的罪。」
29.sry: Ra timamang ta makuavavag makutalum ki YUPAN, ausia ki ataraley tu ikakwan midarinug, ra akumeya ta neni ki pakuavavagan ka mikakwa midarinug."

30.niv: He said this because they were saying, “He has an impure spirit.”
30.cmn: 這話是因為他們說：「他是被污鬼附着的。」 耶穌的母親和兄弟們 （太12‧46－50；路8‧19－21）
30.sry: Nikun tin ta ta ata aley ka nikuma ta neni, "aku tenian ki yupan ka asi matikanag."

31.niv: Then Jesusʼ mother and brothers arrived. Standing outside, they sent someone in to call him.
31.cmn: 當下，耶穌的母親和弟兄來，站在外邊，打發人去叫他。
31.sry: Ka niirua ta ti ina tin ki tagiapaparag apa tin, ka ru mituko itu mala, nimadingi tmataam tenian.

32.niv: A crowd was sitting around him, and they told him, “Your mother and brothers are outside looking for you.”
32.cmn: 有許多人在耶穌周圍坐着，他們就告訴他說：「看哪，你母親和你弟兄在外邊找你。」
32.sry: Ka makuilalawlaw ka itu ritung tenian mirung, nikuma ta neni tenian, "Kitaey, itu mala hina ta ti rena ki tagiapaparag apa oho, kmiim imhuan."

33.niv: “Who are my mother and my brothers?” he asked.
33.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「誰是我的母親？誰是我的弟兄？」
33.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta teni kuma nenian, "Timang ta rarenan aw, ki tagiapaparag apa maw?"

34.niv: Then he looked at those seated in a circle around him and said, “Here are my mother and my brothers!
34.cmn: 就四面觀看那周圍坐着的人，說：「看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄。
34.sry: Ka ru ararawen tin mararaw nenian ka itu ritung tenian mirung, nikuma, "Kitaey ta rarenan aw, ki tagiapaparag apa maw.

35.niv: Whoever does Godʼs will is my brother and sister and mother.”
35.cmn: 凡遵行上帝旨意的人就是我的弟兄姊妹和母親了。」
35.sry: Ka timamang ta paamuta lato ki kamuyen ki Alid, teni ta tagiapaparag aw, ki niaha, ki rena apa maw."

1.niv: Again Jesus began to teach by the lake. The crowd that gathered around him was so large that he got into a boat and sat in it out on the lake, while all the people were along the shore at the waterʼs edge.
1.cmn: 耶穌又在海邊教訓人。有許多人到他那裏聚集，他只得上船坐下。船在海裏，眾人都靠近海，站在岸上。
1.sry: Ka nimataginaunamu mila ta teni matawtawug tu said ki vaung, ka mabatung ta makuilalawlaw ka nimawawakla tenian, ka nimuavang mirung ta teni tu avang ka ana ka itu vaung, ka niitukwa ta imid ki makuilalawlaw tu said ki purug tu duma ki vaung.

2.niv: He taught them many things by parables, and in his teaching said:
2.cmn: 耶穌就用比喻教訓他們許多道理。在教訓之間，對他們說：
2.sry: Ka nimatatawtawug nenian ki madadag ki pamikawlawan; ka nikuma nenian tu patatawtawugan tin,

3.niv: “Listen! A farmer went out to sow his seed.
3.cmn: 「你們聽啊！有一個撒種的出去撒種。
3.sry: "Milingiga! Kitaey, nitawpapanag muawma aley ki dirien ta tamadiri;

4.niv: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.
4.cmn: 撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；
4.sry: Ka nikuma ato hina tu dadirien tin, nitawkwa ta ruma ki gaap tu vidag ki darang, ka niirua ta ayayam ka subug, ka nirmuruk kman ki ana.

5.niv: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.
5.cmn: 有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，
5.sry: Ka nitawkwa ta ruma tu vatugtugan ka mausing malii, ka nimadis kawrbulan ta ana, aley ka ausi ki malawhaw ka nay ra.

6.niv: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
6.cmn: 日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；
6.sry: Iru ra nimutiag ta wagi, dumiaka nipatihuwilen aley ka ausi ki patar, nimilaklak da.

7.niv: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants, so that they did not bear grain.
7.cmn: 有落在荊棘裏的，荊棘長起來，把它 擠住了，就不結實；
7.sry: Ka nitawkwa ta ruma tu adaduman, ka nikumaralib ta adum, ka nipaipatay ki ana, ka asi nimakavua.

8.niv: Still other seed fell on good soil. It came up, grew and produced a crop, some multiplying thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times.”
8.cmn: 又有落在好土裏的，就發生長大，結實有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的」；
8.sry: Ka nitawkwa ta ruma tu nay ka mariyang, ka nimakavua ki vua ka nimupanag ta ana, ka nimakavua, ka maka turu kitian ta sasat, anim kitian ta pani, ka sat kaatugan ta ruma ra."

9.niv: Then Jesus said, “Whoever has ears to hear, let them hear.”
9.cmn: 又說：「有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」 用比喻的目的 （太13‧10－17；路8‧9－10）
9.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Timamang ka aku tangira ki ailingilingig, hmilingiga lato."

10.niv: When he was alone, the Twelve and the others around him asked him about the parables.
10.cmn: 無人的時候，跟隨耶穌的人和十二個門徒問他這比喻的意思。
10.sry: Iru ka itusaat ta teni, neni ka tu ritung tenian lam ki sat kitian ab ki ruha nitmalig tenian ki pamikawlawan ka ana.

11.niv: He told them, “The secret of the kingdom of God has been given to you. But to those on the outside everything is said in parables
11.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「上帝國的奧祕只叫你們知道，若是對外人講，凡事就用比喻，
11.sry: Teni ra nikuma nenian, "Nipigaan imumian mumha ki kawlawaw ki peysasuan ki Alid, ra nenian ka tu mala, pamut ato imid ki mamang ka ata tu pamikawlawan.

12.niv: so that, “ ‘they may be ever seeing but never perceiving, and ever hearing but never understanding; otherwise they might turn and be forgiven!’ ”
12.cmn: 叫他們 看是看見，卻不曉得； 聽是聽見，卻不明白； 恐怕他們回轉過來，就得赦免。」 解明撒種的比喻 （太13‧18－23；路8‧11－15）
12.sry: Aley ka tu kakitaan nein kmita, asi kmitaa lato; ka tu ailingigen nein milingig, asi mumhaa lato: aley ka asi silalaey ta neni, ki ataraley lato ta varaw nein."

13.niv: Then Jesus said to them, “Donʼt you understand this parable? How then will you understand any parable?
13.cmn: 又對他們說：「你們不明白這比喻嗎？這樣怎能明白一切的比喻呢？
13.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Asi kamu kawa mumha ki pamikawlawan ka ata? Ka mumhaa kamu mama ki mang ki pamikawlawan ka raruma?"

14.niv: The farmer sows the word.
14.cmn: 撒種之人所撒的就是道。
14.sry: Tamadiri ta dmadiri ki su.

15.niv: Some people are like seed along the path, where the word is sown. As soon as they hear it, Satan comes and takes away the word that was sown in them.
15.cmn: 那撒在路旁的，就是人聽了道，撒但立刻來，把撒在他心裏的道奪了去。
15.sry: Neni ra ta neni ka itukwa tu vidag ki darang, ka nidiri ki su: iru ka milingig ta neni, madis irua ta Satan smimurang mara ki su ka nidiri tu tintin nein.

16.niv: Others, like seed sown on rocky places, hear the word and at once receive it with joy.
16.cmn: 那撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，立刻歡喜領受，
16.sry: Ka neni apa ta neni ka nidiri tu vatugtugan ka mahurat ki nay, ka du milingig ki su, matadis mataray ki ana matarig

17.niv: But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
17.cmn: 但他心裏沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。
17.sry: Ra ausi ki patar tu mamado nenian, ka kumahina tnadis tnakaha ta neni, siawug ki ana ru irua ta samukan ki kudilugan lava aley ki su, madis pakavarawen ato.

18.niv: Still others, like seed sown among thorns, hear the word;
18.cmn: 還有那撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，
18.sry: Ka neni ka ana ta nidiri tu adaduman, neni ta ti ana ka milingig ki su,

19.niv: but the worries of this life, the deceitfulness of wealth and the desires for other things come in and choke the word, making it unfruitful.
19.cmn: 後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑，和別樣的私慾進來，把道擠住了，就不能結實。
19.sry: ra pagkuboen pagdumdum ki kawagan ka ata, ki simhamhan apa ki vangey, ki kamuyen apa ki mamang, du murbo, tmurung ki su, ka maka pawupag ta ana.

20.niv: Others, like seed sown on good soil, hear the word, accept it, and produce a crop—some thirty, some sixty, some a hundred times what was sown.”
20.cmn: 那撒在好地上的，就是人聽道，又領受，並且結實，有三十倍的，有六十倍的，有一百倍的。」 斗底下的燈 （路8‧16－18）
20.sry: Ka neni ka ana ta nidiri tu nay ka mariyang, neni ta ti ana ka milingig ki su ka matarig ki ata, ka makavua ki vua, turu kitian ta sasat, anim kitian ta pani, ka sat kaatugan ta ruma ra.

21.niv: He said to them, “Do you bring in a lamp to put it under a bowl or a bed? Instead, donʼt you put it on its stand?
21.cmn: 耶穌又對他們說：「人拿燈來，豈是要放在斗底下，床底下，不放在燈臺上嗎？
21.sry: Ka nikuma apa ta teni nenian, "Adey kawa ta uging ka paiturboey lato ki sato, ki paiturboey apa ki apagan? Asi kawa paiturboey ato tu pawugingan?

22.niv: For whatever is hidden is meant to be disclosed, and whatever is concealed is meant to be brought out into the open.
22.cmn: 因為掩藏的事，沒有不顯出來的；隱瞞的事，沒有不露出來的。
22.sry: Ka ausi tagaawufen ki mamang, ka asi aawtatawufey, ka ausi nihaen ki mamang, ka asi aawtatawufey tu ramag.

23.niv: If anyone has ears to hear, let them hear.”
23.cmn: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」
23.sry: Hairu timamang ta aku tangira ki ailingilingig, hmilingiga lato."

24.niv: “Consider carefully what you hear,” he continued. “With the measure you use, it will be measured to you—and even more.
24.cmn: 又說：「你們所聽的要留心。你們用甚麼量器量給人，也必用甚麼量器量給你們，並且要多給你們。
24.sry: Ka nikuma apa ta teni nenian, "Pulilita ki ilingigen umi: tu rarepungan ka nirmarepung kamu, rarepungaw kamu ra: imumi ka milingig, pigaey apa kamu ra.

25.niv: Whoever has will be given more; whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.”
25.cmn: 因為有的，還要給他；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪去。」 種子長大的比喻
25.sry: Ka timamang ta akumeya, tenian apa ta pigaey, ra timamang ta ausi, haawmiey apa tenian ta akumeya tin."

26.niv: He also said, “This is what the kingdom of God is like. A man scatters seed on the ground.
26.cmn: 又說：「上帝的國如同人把種撒在地上。
26.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni, "Kumahina ta peysasuan ki Alid, mama ki ata, du aringey ki tau ta gaap tu nay.

27.niv: Night and day, whether he sleeps or gets up, the seed sprouts and grows, though he does not know how.
27.cmn: 黑夜睡覺，白日起來，這種就發芽漸長，那人卻不曉得如何這樣。
27.sry: Ka du mirip ta teni, ka gapit apa tu awvanan lava tu wagi, ka musurag ta gaap tmatul, ka asi tin umhaen mama ki mang.

28.niv: All by itself the soil produces grain—first the stalk, then the head, then the full kernel in the head.
28.cmn: 地生五穀是出於自然的：先發苗，後長穗，再後穗上結成飽滿的子粒；
28.sry: Ka makavua sikunung ta nay, naunamu ta pehil, siawug ki tangira, siawug ki nanag ka matmuy tu tangira.

29.niv: As soon as the grain is ripe, he puts the sickle to it, because the harvest has come.”
29.cmn: 穀既熟了，就用鐮刀去割，因為收成的時候到了。」 芥菜種的比喻 （太13‧31－32；路13‧18－19）
29.sry: Iru ra madoem ta vua, madis atakwaen ta tiul ka ayt, aley ka irua lato ta ayaman."

30.niv: Again he said, “What shall we say the kingdom of God is like, or what parable shall we use to describe it?
30.cmn: 又說：「上帝的國，我們可用甚麼比較呢？可用甚麼比喻表明呢？
30.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni, "Pamikawlawlawen yan ki mang ta peysasuan ki Alid? Pamikawlawlaan lava ka papamikawlawlawen yan?

31.niv: It is like a mustard seed, which is the smallest of all seeds on earth.
31.cmn: 好像一粒芥菜種，種在地裏的時候，雖比地上的百種都小，
31.sry: Mama ki tugto ki suhay ka kailwa, ka ru dadirien tu nay, masaun asi mariyang ki imid ki tugto ka ayanay ra.

32.niv: Yet when planted, it grows and becomes the largest of all garden plants, with such big branches that the birds can perch in its shade.”
32.cmn: 但種上以後，就長起來，比各樣的菜都大，又長出大枝來，甚至天上的飛鳥可以宿在它 的蔭下。」 耶穌用比喻講道 （太13‧34）
32.sry: Iru ra dadirien tin, tawpapanag ta ana, ka siuro tu vavaw ki imid ki uruuru, ka pupanag ki pehil ka irang, kuma apa hina ka iligaw ki ayayam ka subug silawlaw tu halung tin."

33.niv: With many similar parables Jesus spoke the word to them, as much as they could understand.
33.cmn: 耶穌用許多這樣的比喻，照他們所能聽的，對他們講道。
33.sry: Ka tu na madadag ki pamikawlawlaan ka kumahina nimasusu ki su nenian, mama ki ilpugen nein milingig.

34.niv: He did not say anything to them without using a parable. But when he was alone with his own disciples, he explained everything.
34.cmn: 若不用比喻，就不對他們講；沒有人的時候，就把一切的道講給門徒聽。 平靜風和海 （太8‧23－27；路8‧22－25）
34.sry: Ka asi nipasusuen tin ki mamang tu ausi ki pamikawlawan. Ra du itulam du makuisal, nipatagitumuk ki mamang ki patatawtawugan tin.

35.niv: That day when evening came, he said to his disciples, “Let us go over to the other side.”
35.cmn: 當那天晚上，耶穌對門徒說：「我們渡到那邊去吧。」
35.sry: Ka tu wagi ka ana ru madung ato, nikuma ta teni nenian, "Salikugey eta muarug."

36.niv: Leaving the crowd behind, they took him along, just as he was, in the boat. There were also other boats with him.
36.cmn: 門徒離開眾人，耶穌仍在船上，他們就把他一同帶去；也有別的船和他同行。
36.sry: Ka ru nipadarangen nein ta makuilalawlaw, niara nein tenian, mama ki na nimuavang ta teni. Ka tulam apa tenian ta pani ki avang.

37.niv: A furious squall came up, and the waves broke over the boat, so that it was nearly swamped.
37.cmn: 忽然起了暴風，波浪打入船內，甚至船要滿了水。
37.sry: Ka nimapit ta ruar ka irang, ka nismirif ta rungwal muhalap ki avang, kuma apa hina ka patahabunen ta ana.

38.niv: Jesus was in the stern, sleeping on a cushion. The disciples woke him and said to him, “Teacher, donʼt you care if we drown?”
38.cmn: 耶穌在船尾上，枕着枕頭睡覺。門徒叫醒了他，說：「夫子！我們喪命，你不顧嗎？」
38.sry: Ka itu awug ta teni ki avang, ru mirip tu ivavungoan, nipatimawag ta neni tenian, kuma tenian, 'Tamamatawtawug, asi kaw kawa pagkubo ka mapapatay kita?'

39.niv: He got up, rebuked the wind and said to the waves, “Quiet! Be still!” Then the wind died down and it was completely calm.
39.cmn: 耶穌醒了，斥責風，向海說：「住了吧！靜了吧！」風就止住，大大地平靜了。
39.sry: Ka ru nipatimawagen tin, nipatimhan tin ta vare, ka nikuma ki vaung, "Reya, maipata lato!" Ka palungpung ato ta vare, ka uhang ato palungpung ka niausi ki sipaw.

40.niv: He said to his disciples, “Why are you so afraid? Do you still have no faith?”
40.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「為甚麼膽怯？你們還沒有信心嗎？」
40.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Kamang ka matakut kamu kumahina? Ausi kamu kawa ki tnamisingan?"

41.niv: They were terrified and asked each other, “Who is this? Even the wind and the waves obey him!”
41.cmn: 他們就大大地懼怕，彼此說：「這到底是誰，連風和海也聽從他了。」
41.sry: Ka uhang ta neni ki takut, nimatagitavatavag ta neni, 'Mamang ta teni ka ata, ka milig tenian ta vare vaung apa?'

1.niv: They went across the lake to the region of the Gerasenes.
1.cmn: 他們來到海那邊格拉森人的地方。
1.sry: Ka niirua ta neni muarug ki vaung tu purug ki Gadarenen.

2.niv: When Jesus got out of the boat, a man with an impure spirit came from the tombs to meet him.
2.cmn: 耶穌一下船，就有一個被污鬼附着的人從墳塋裏出來迎着他。
2.sry: Iru ka nimurarim ta teni mumala ki avang, madis nimuakla tenian ta vual ka aku yupan ka asi matikanag ki ravaravak.

3.niv: This man lived in the tombs, and no one could bind him anymore, not even with a chain.
3.cmn: 那人常住在墳塋裏，沒有人能捆住他，就是用鐵鍊也不能；
3.sry: Ka niitukakwaan tin tu ravaravak, ka asi matagilpug ta timamang bawut tenian, asi apa ki tatakiran.

4.niv: For he had often been chained hand and foot, but he tore the chains apart and broke the irons on his feet. No one was strong enough to subdue him.
4.cmn: 因為人屢次用腳鐐和鐵鍊捆鎖他，鐵鍊竟被他掙斷了，腳鐐也被他弄碎了；總沒有人能制伏他。
4.sry: Ka vunavunaen ato nivawut ki rima, ki rapal apa tin, ka nipuduhaen tin papupto ta tatakir ka bawut, ka asi matagilpug ta timamang tmurung tenian.

5.niv: Night and day among the tombs and in the hills he would cry out and cut himself with stones.
5.cmn: 他晝夜常在墳塋裏和山中喊叫，又用石頭砍自己。
5.sry: Ka mikakwa du awvanan tu wagi apa, itukwa tu buvukin, ka itu ravaravak da, makulangag ta teni, tmagta mamado tenian ki vato.

6.niv: When he saw Jesus from a distance, he ran and fell on his knees in front of him.
6.cmn: 他遠遠地看見耶穌，就跑過去拜他，
6.sry: Iru ka kmita ta teni ti Yesusan tu dalia, nisium ta teni tmamud tenian.

7.niv: He shouted at the top of his voice, “What do you want with me, Jesus, Son of the Most High God? In Godʼs name donʼt torture me!”
7.cmn: 大聲呼叫說：「至高上帝的兒子耶穌，我與你有甚麼相干？我指着上帝懇求你，不要叫我受苦！」
7.sry: Ka nimakulangag ki ingaw ka irang, kuma, "Manga ko imhuan, Yesus ka Alak ki Alid ka Sibavaw tu vavaw ki kidi? Pakariherihe ko imhuan ki Alid, ka asi kaw pakhaut yawan."

8.niv: For Jesus had said to him, “Come out of this man, you impure spirit!”
8.cmn: 是因耶穌曾吩咐他說：「污鬼啊，從這人身上出來吧！」
8.sry: Aley ka nikuma ta teni tenian, "mupanag ki kagulung, yupan ka asi matikanag."

9.niv: Then Jesus asked him, “What is your name?” “My name is Legion,” he replied, “for we are many.”
9.cmn: 耶穌問他說：「你名叫甚麼？」回答說：「我名叫『群』，因為我們多的緣故」；
9.sry: Ka nitmalig ta teni tenian, "Mang ta nanang oho? Ka nimatagivli ta teni kuma, "Legion ta nanang aw, aley ka mabatung kame."

10.niv: And he begged Jesus again and again not to send them out of the area.
10.cmn: 就再三地求耶穌，不要叫他們離開那地方。
10.sry: Ka nitmumimia tenian ki su ka asi padarangen ta teni pukwa tu tawag ki purug ka ana.

11.niv: A large herd of pigs was feeding on the nearby hillside.
11.cmn: 在那裏山坡上，有一大群豬吃食；
11.sry: Ka niayakwa hina tu hili ki vukin ta yuag ki madag ki vavuy ka bavawavawag kmiim ki kanaw nein.

12.niv: The demons begged Jesus, “Send us among the pigs; allow us to go into them.”
12.cmn: 鬼就央求耶穌說：「求你打發我們往豬群裏，附着豬去。」
12.sry: Ka nitmumimia tenian ta imid ki litulitu, kun, "Padarangaw kame murbo ki vavuy, aley ka murboa kame nenian."

13.niv: He gave them permission, and the impure spirits came out and went into the pigs. The herd, about two thousand in number, rushed down the steep bank into the lake and were drowned.
13.cmn: 耶穌准了他們，污鬼就出來，進入豬裏去。於是那群豬闖下山崖，投在海裏，淹死了。豬的數目約有二千。
13.sry: Ka madis nimatagivli ta ti Yesus nimus ato nenian. Ka dmarang ta yupan ka asi matikanag, nimurbo ki bavavuy, ka nisium ta yuag maka abavoak tu vaung, ka ru ruruha ato katununan lava, ka nipaitukwa tu vaung ka patahabunen.

14.niv: Those tending the pigs ran off and reported this in the town and countryside, and the people went out to see what had happened.
14.cmn: 放豬的就逃跑了，去告訴城裏和鄉下的人。眾人就來，要看是甚麼事。
14.sry: Ka niilput ta nisuayam, ka nignawen tin ta ata tu awma ki purug apa: ka nitawpapanag ta neni kmita mang ta nipamuten ato.

15.niv: When they came to Jesus, they saw the man who had been possessed by the legion of demons, sitting there, dressed and in his right mind; and they were afraid.
15.cmn: 他們來到耶穌那裏，看見那被鬼附着的人，就是從前被群鬼所附的，坐着，穿上衣服，心裏明白過來，他們就害怕。
15.sry: Ka ru irua ato ti Yesusan, nikmita tenian ka niulitu, ka niakumeya ki litu ka Legion, ka mirung ato ka nipamimian, ka madarikag apa ki rig tin: ka nimatakut ta neni.

16.niv: Those who had seen it told the people what had happened to the demon-possessed man—and told about the pigs as well.
16.cmn: 看見這事的，便將鬼附之人所遇見的和那群豬的事都告訴了眾人；
16.sry: Ka neni ka nikmita, nipatagikahan nenian ta nipamuten tenian ka niulitu, ki bavavuy apa ra.

17.niv: Then the people began to plead with Jesus to leave their region.
17.cmn: 眾人就央求耶穌離開他們的境界。
17.sry: Ka nimanaunamu tmumimia ti Yesusan ka malidawa ki kidi ki purug nein.

18.niv: As Jesus was getting into the boat, the man who had been demon-possessed begged to go with him.
18.cmn: 耶穌上船的時候，那從前被鬼附着的人懇求和耶穌同在。
18.sry: Ka ru nimuavang ta teni, teni ka niulitu nitmumimia ka paukwaey tin tenian.

19.niv: Jesus did not let him, but said, “Go home to your own people and tell them how much the Lord has done for you, and how he has had mercy on you.”
19.cmn: 耶穌不許，卻對他說：「你回家去，到你的親屬那裏，將主為你所做的是何等大的事，是怎樣憐憫你，都告訴他們。」
19.sry: Ra asi hahayen ta ti Yesus tenian, ra nikuma tenian, "Ukwaaw tu talag oho ki tagiapaparag oho, vanavana nenian kamang ka irang ta na ringey ki Meyrang imhuan, ka nimaharum apa imhuan."

20.niv: So the man went away and began to tell in the Decapolis how much Jesus had done for him. And all the people were amazed.
20.cmn: 那人就走了，在低加坡里傳揚耶穌為他做了何等大的事，眾人就都希奇。 睚魯的女兒和血漏的女人 （太9‧18－26；路8‧40－56）
20.sry: Anata nidmarang ta teni, nimataginaunamu gnawen tu Dekapolis, kamang ka irang ta nipamuten ti Yesus tenian, ka nimukiap ta imid nenian.

21.niv: When Jesus had again crossed over by boat to the other side of the lake, a large crowd gathered around him while he was by the lake.
21.cmn: 耶穌坐船又渡到那邊去，就有許多人到他那裏聚集；他正在海邊上。
21.sry: Iru ka nimuarug ato muavang ta ti Yesus tu ruma ki arug, ka ru tamang ta teni ki vaung, mabatung ta makuilalawlaw ka nimawawakla tenian.

22.niv: Then one of the synagogue leaders, named Jairus, came, and when he saw Jesus, he fell at his feet.
22.cmn: 有一個管會堂的人，名叫睚魯，來見耶穌，就俯伏在他腳前，
22.sry: Ka kitaey, niirua ta saat ka Sibavaw ki Pakuisasalan, ka ti Yairus ki nanang, ka ru kmita tenian, nidmangus tu rapal tin.

23.niv: He pleaded earnestly with him, “My little daughter is dying. Please come and put your hands on her so that she will be healed and live.”
23.cmn: 再三地求他，說：「我的小女兒快要死了，求你去按手在她身上，使她痊癒，得以活了。」
23.sry: Ka nitmumimia tenian matagikumakwa, "Alak aw ka ina ka raway ta mihaung ato mapatay, nda ukwaaw kaw puhalap ki rima oho tenian, aley ka madarikag ta teni, ka mawaga ta teni."

24.niv: So Jesus went with him. A large crowd followed and pressed around him.
24.cmn: 耶穌就和他同去。 有許多人跟隨擁擠他。
24.sry: Ka nidmarang ta ti Yesus lam tenian, ka mabatung ta makuilalawlaw ka nimuawug tenian, ka nipipipit tenian.

25.niv: And a woman was there who had been subject to bleeding for twelve years.
25.cmn: 有一個女人，患了十二年的血漏，
25.sry: Ka saat ki ina ka ana ka tawmagan maka sat kitian ab ki ruha ki tawil,

26.niv: She had suffered a great deal under the care of many doctors and had spent all she had, yet instead of getting better she grew worse.
26.cmn: 在好些醫生手裏受了許多的苦，又花盡了她所有的，一點也不見好，病勢反倒更重了。
26.sry: Ka nipadarangen tin madag ki tamasimimia, ka nipapahakakwaan tin ta imid ki mamang tin, ka asi nimadarikag, ra nimakasiuro mate.

27.niv: When she heard about Jesus, she came up behind him in the crowd and touched his cloak,
27.cmn: 她聽見耶穌的事，就從後頭來，雜在眾人中間，摸耶穌的衣裳，
27.sry: Du nimilingig ta teni ki mamang ti Yesusan, niirua muawug tu makuilalawlaw, ka nismukla ki kulamug tin.

28.niv: because she thought, “If I just touch his clothes, I will be healed.”
28.cmn: 意思說：「我只摸他的衣裳，就必痊癒。」
28.sry: Ka nimatagimado tenian, "Ru sudiken aw smukla ki kulamug tin, dumiaka darikaga ko."

29.niv: Immediately her bleeding stopped and she felt in her body that she was freed from her suffering.
29.cmn: 於是她血漏的源頭立刻乾了；她便覺得身上的災病好了。
29.sry: Ka madis nitmil ta gamag tin ki na ududoen, ka niumhaen tin tu vual ka nipadarikag tenian ki na kaalam tin.

30.niv: At once Jesus realized that power had gone out from him. He turned around in the crowd and asked, “Who touched my clothes?”
30.cmn: 耶穌頓時心裏覺得有能力從自己身上出去，就在眾人中間轉過來，說：「誰摸我的衣裳？」
30.sry: Ka madis du umhaen ti Yesus mumado tenian ka nidmarang tenian ta kailgan, nirmiduk ta teni tu makuilalawlaw, ka nikuma, "Timang ta nismukla ki kulamug aw?"

31.niv: “You see the people crowding against you,” his disciples answered, “and yet you can ask, ‘Who touched me?’ ”
31.cmn: 門徒對他說：「你看眾人擁擠你，還說『誰摸我』嗎？」
31.sry: Ka nikuma ta patatawtawugan tin tenian, "Kitaan hu ta makuilalawlaw ka dmudung imhuan, ka matagikumaa kaw, Timang ta nismukla yawan?"

32.niv: But Jesus kept looking around to see who had done it.
32.cmn: 耶穌周圍觀看，要見做這事的女人。
32.sry: Ka nirmiduk ta teni mararaw apa ka kmita tenian ka nimamut ki ata.

33.niv: Then the woman, knowing what had happened to her, came and fell at his feet and, trembling with fear, told him the whole truth.
33.cmn: 那女人知道在自己身上所成的事，就恐懼戰兢，來俯伏在耶穌跟前，將實情全告訴他。
33.sry: Anata matakut ta ina ka madilidil apa, du kavanen tin kamang ta nipamuten tenian, niirua, ka nireip tu duma tenian, ka nimatagimimia ki su ka dilig tenian.

34.niv: He said to her, “Daughter, your faith has healed you. Go in peace and be freed from your suffering.”
34.cmn: 耶穌對她說：「女兒，你的信救了你，平平安安地回去吧！你的災病痊癒了。」
34.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni tenian, "Alakina, nipakariyang imhuan ta tnamisingan oho; ukwaaw tu reya, ka madarikag ato ki sasamukan oho."

35.niv: While Jesus was still speaking, some people came from the house of Jairus, the synagogue leader. “Your daughter is dead,” they said. “Why bother the teacher anymore?”
35.cmn: 還說話的時候，有人從管會堂的家裏來，說：「你的女兒死了，何必還勞動先生呢？」
35.sry: Tu pasusuen apa tin, niirua ta timamang ka maka talag ki Sibavaw ki Pakuisasalan, ka nikuma, "Nimapatay ta alak oho ka ina, kaumang ka pakahimkoen hu lato ta Tamamatawtawug?"

36.niv: Overhearing what they said, Jesus told him, “Donʼt be afraid; just believe.”
36.cmn: 耶穌聽見所說的話，就對管會堂的說：「不要怕，只要信！」
36.sry: Ra madis milingig ta ti Yesus ki su ka ata ka pasusuen, nikuma ki Sibavaw ki Pakuisalan, "Ina matakut, tnamisinga ra."

37.niv: He did not let anyone follow him except Peter, James and John the brother of James.
37.cmn: 於是帶着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰同去，不許別人跟隨他。
37.sry: Ka asi hahayen tin maawug ta timamang tenian, dik ti Petrus, ti Yakobus, ti Yoanes apa, ka tagiapaparag ti Yakobus.

38.niv: When they came to the home of the synagogue leader, Jesus saw a commotion, with people crying and wailing loudly.
38.cmn: 他們來到管會堂的家裏；耶穌看見那裏亂嚷，並有人大大地哭泣哀號，
38.sry: Ka ru irua ato tu talag ki Meysasu ka Sibavaw ki Pakuisasalan, nikitaan tin ta karakarakan, ka makulangag ta neni tmangitangi.

39.niv: He went in and said to them, “Why all this commotion and wailing? The child is not dead but asleep.”
39.cmn: 進到裏面，就對他們說：「為甚麼亂嚷哭泣呢？孩子不是死了，是睡着了。」
39.sry: Ka ru nimurbo ta teni, nikuma nenian, "Kaumang ta iraruruan umi ki tangitangien? Asi nimapatay ta tamatul dik mirip ra."

40.niv: But they laughed at him. After he put them all out, he took the childʼs father and mother and the disciples who were with him, and went in where the child was.
40.cmn: 他們就嗤笑耶穌。耶穌把他們都攆出去，就帶着孩子的父母和跟隨的人進了孩子所在的地方，
40.sry: Ra nimawakakak matawa tenian. Ka nipadarangen tin pasamamala ta neni, nimara tin ta raraman ki rarenan ki tamatul, patawtawugan apa ka na lam tin, ka nimurbo tu ayakwaan ki tamatul.

41.niv: He took her by the hand and said to her, “Talitha koum!” (which means “Little girl, I say to you, get up!”).
41.cmn: 就拉着孩子的手，對她說：「大利大，古米！」（翻出來就是說：「閨女，我吩咐你起來！」）
41.sry: Ka nimakitil ki rima ki tamatul, nikuma tenian, "Talita kum," ka inaakwaaney, "Tamatul ka raway, pasusuen aw kaw, gapita ato."

42.niv: Immediately the girl stood up and began to walk around (she was twelve years old). At this they were completely astonished.
42.cmn: 那閨女立時起來走。他們就大大地驚奇；閨女已經十二歲了。
42.sry: Ka madis nimatimawag ta tamatul ka ana, ka nimunonang. Akumeya ato ta teni ki sat kitian ab ki ruha ki tawil. Ka uhang nimukiap ta neni ki uringawen ka irang.

43.niv: He gave strict orders not to let anyone know about this, and told them to give her something to eat.
43.cmn: 耶穌切切地囑咐他們，不要叫人知道這事，又吩咐給她東西吃。
43.sry: Ka nisingig mavag nenian, ka asi umhaey timamang ki ata; ka nipakusuen tin ka pigaey ato ki kakanaw tin.

1.niv: Jesus left there and went to his hometown, accompanied by his disciples.
1.cmn: 耶穌離開那裏，來到自己的家鄉；門徒也跟從他。
1.sry: Ka nidmarang hina ta ti Yesus, niirua tu purug ki rama tin, ka nimaawug tenian ta patatawtawugan tin.

2.niv: When the Sabbath came, he began to teach in the synagogue, and many who heard him were amazed. “Where did this man get these things?” they asked. “Whatʼs this wisdom that has been given him? What are these remarkable miracles he is performing?
2.cmn: 到了安息日，他在會堂裏教訓人。眾人聽見，就甚希奇，說：「這人從哪裏有這些事呢？所賜給他的是甚麼智慧？他手所做的是何等的異能呢？
2.sry: Iru ka irua ato ki wagi ki pahihababan nimataginaunamu matawtawug tu Pakuisasalan, ka mabatung ta milingig nimukiap ato, ka nikuma, "Makakuna ki kagulung ta mamang ka ata? Kamang ta kakusacingan ka ata ka nipigaan tenian, ka pamut ato ki rima tin ta kailgan ka kumahina?

3.niv: Isnʼt this the carpenter? Isnʼt this Maryʼs son and the brother of James, Joseph, Judas and Simon? Arenʼt his sisters here with us?” And they took offense at him.
3.cmn: 這不是那木匠嗎？不是馬利亞的兒子雅各、約西、猶大、西門的長兄嗎？他妹妹們不也是在我們這裏嗎？」他們就厭棄他。
3.sry: Asi kawa ti ata ta suyhu, ka alak ti Maria, ka tagiaparag ti Yakobus, ti Yoses, ti Yudas, ti Simon? Ka asi kawa ayalam imitan ta niaha tin?" Ka nisaisalakuap ta neni pakavaraw tenian.

4.niv: Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor except in his own town, among his relatives and in his own home.”
4.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「大凡先知，除了本地、親屬、本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。」
4.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, "Ausi ki rikuren lmulug ta tamamatagitan, dik tu purug tin, tu tagiapaparag tin, tu talag apa tin."

5.niv: He could not do any miracles there, except lay his hands on a few sick people and heal them.
5.cmn: 耶穌就在那裏不得行甚麼異能，不過按手在幾個病人身上，治好他們。
5.sry: Ka asi tin peylpug pamut hina ki kailgan ka uringawen, dik ka niatahalapen tin ta rima ki maalam, ka nipakakuridag nenian.

6.niv: He was amazed at their lack of faith. Then Jesus went around teaching from village to village.
6.cmn: 他也詫異他們不信，就往周圍鄉村教訓人去了。 耶穌差遣十二門徒 （太10‧5－15；路9‧1－6）
6.sry: Ka nimukiap ta teni aley ki ausi ki tnamisingan nein. Ka nimukwa tawritung tu awmaawma ka tu tamang, matawtawug.

7.niv: Calling the Twelve to him, he began to send them out two by two and gave them authority over impure spirits.
7.cmn: 耶穌叫了十二個門徒來，差遣他們兩個兩個地出去，也賜給他們權柄，制伏污鬼；
7.sry: Ka ru nitataam tin paukwa tenian ki sat kitian ab ki ruha, nimataginaunamu madingi nenian ta raruharuha, ka nipigaan tin nenian ta kailgan smakilpug ki yupan ka asi matikanag.

8.niv: These were his instructions: “Take nothing for the journey except a staff—no bread, no bag, no money in your belts.
8.cmn: 並且囑咐他們：「行路的時候不要帶食物和口袋，腰袋裏也不要帶錢，除了柺杖以外，甚麼都不要帶；
8.sry: Ka nipakusuen tin nenian, "ka asi mara ki mamang tu darang dik ki angto, asi ki atakwaan, asi paul, asi malituk, asi malituk tu ayt nein ka ripirip.

9.niv: Wear sandals but not an extra shirt.
9.cmn: 只要穿鞋，也不要穿兩件褂子」；
9.sry: Ra nipakararuha ki tatapil, ka asi makulamug ki ruruha ki kulamug.

10.niv: Whenever you enter a house, stay there until you leave that town.
10.cmn: 又對他們說：「你們無論到何處，進了人的家，就住在那裏，直到離開那地方。
10.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Tumamang ta sararboey mumi tu talag, itukwa hina tu kidi ki darangey mumi."

11.niv: And if any place will not welcome you or listen to you, leave that place and shake the dust off your feet as a testimony against them.”
11.cmn: 何處的人不接待你們，不聽你們，你們離開那裏的時候，就把腳上的塵土跺下去，對他們作見證。」
11.sry: Ka ru timamang ta asi makutatalag imumian, asi apa milingiga imumian, ru dmarang kamu hina, taptapey ta rapul ki rapal umi tu patagihailen nenian. Dilig kun aw kamu ra, ka sauney lmawa ta pahahavuhavung ki Sodoma ki Gomora tu wagi ki papamamagan ki awma ka ana.

12.niv: They went out and preached that people should repent.
12.cmn: 門徒就出去傳道，叫人悔改，
12.sry: Ka nidmarang ta neni, nipatasasuey ka silalaey ki kagulung.

13.niv: They drove out many demons and anointed many sick people with oil and healed them.
13.cmn: 又趕出許多的鬼，用油抹了許多病人，治好他們。 施洗約翰的死 （太14‧1－12；路9‧7－9）
13.sry: Ka nipadarangen nein ta madadag ki litu, ka niatahabilen nein ki imag ta madag ki maalam, ka nipadarikagen nein ta neni.

14.niv: King Herod heard about this, for Jesusʼ name had become well known. Some were saying, “John the Baptist has been raised from the dead, and that is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
14.cmn: 耶穌的名聲傳揚出來。希律王聽見了，就說：「施洗的約翰從死裏復活了，所以這些異能由他裏面發出來。」
14.sry: Ka niilingig apa ta ata ki Meysasu ka Sibavaw ka ti Herodes, aley ka nipaulumaluman ato ta Nanang tin, ka nikuma, 'Nipatimawagen ta ti Yoanes ka tamaawlug ki kapatayan, ka aley ki ata peyraringeyan tenian ta kailgan ka ringey.'

15.niv: Others said, “He is Elijah.” And still others claimed, “He is a prophet, like one of the prophets of long ago.”
15.cmn: 但別人說：「是以利亞。」又有人說：「是先知，正像先知中的一位。」
15.sry: Nikuma ta raruma, 'ka ti Eliyas ta ti ana,' nikuma apa ta raruma, 'ka tamamatagitan ta teni, lava ki saat ki na tamamatagitan.'

16.niv: But when Herod heard this, he said, “John, whom I beheaded, has been raised from the dead!”
16.cmn: 希律聽見卻說：「是我所斬的約翰，他復活了。」
16.sry: Iru ka milingig ki ata ta ti Herodes, nikuma, 'ti Yoanes ta ti ana, ka nipalukuten aw ta vungo, nipatimawagen ta teni ki nikapatayan.'

17.niv: For Herod himself had given orders to have John arrested, and he had him bound and put in prison. He did this because of Herodias, his brother Philipʼs wife, whom he had married.
17.cmn: 先是希律為他兄弟腓力的妻子希羅底的緣故，差人去拿住約翰，鎖在監裏，因為希律已經娶了那婦人。
17.sry: Ka ti Herodes ta nimadingi turungen ti Yoanesan, nipavawut papusangat tenian aley ti Herodiasan ka keyan ki tagiapaparag tin ka ti Filipus, aley ka niputbung tin tenian.

18.niv: For John had been saying to Herod, “It is not lawful for you to have your brotherʼs wife.”
18.cmn: 約翰曾對希律說：「你娶你兄弟的妻子是不合理的。」
18.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yoanes ti Herodesan, 'Asi kaw hahayen meya ki keyan ki tagiapaparag oho.'

19.niv: So Herodias nursed a grudge against John and wanted to kill him. But she was not able to,
19.cmn: 於是希羅底懷恨他，想要殺他，只是不能；
19.sry: Aley ki ana nimavahier ta ti Herodias tenian ka nikamuyen tin pakapatay tenian, ra asi tin palpugen,

20.niv: because Herod feared John and protected him, knowing him to be a righteous and holy man. When Herod heard John, he was greatly puzzled; yet he liked to listen to him.
20.cmn: 因為希律知道約翰是義人，是聖人，所以敬畏他，保護他，聽他講論，就多照着行，並且樂意聽他。
20.sry: aley ka nimatakut ta ti Herodes ti Yoanesan, nikadingen tin tenian, ka kavanen tin ka na tau ka matiktik ka dilig matiktik: ka du milingig tenian, madag ki mamang ta nipamuten tin, ka kamuyen apa tin milingig tenian.

21.niv: Finally the opportune time came. On his birthday Herod gave a banquet for his high officials and military commanders and the leading men of Galilee.
21.cmn: 有一天，恰巧是希律的生日，希律擺設筵席，請了大臣和千夫長，並加利利作首領的。
