21.sry: Iru ka niirua ta wagi ka mariyang ka ti Herodes, tu wagi ki nipeyalaken tin, nimuvatug tmanang aley ki meysasu ka sibavaw, ki tamamacit ki meysasu apa ka sibavaw, ki sibavaw apa ki purug ki Galilaya.

22.niv: When the daughter of Herodias came in and danced, she pleased Herod and his dinner guests. The king said to the girl, “Ask me for anything you want, and Iʼll give it to you.”
22.cmn: 希羅底的女兒進來跳舞，使希律和同席的人都歡喜。王就對女子說：「你隨意向我求甚麼，我必給你。」
22.sry: Ka ru nimurbo ta tatimian ka ti Herodias, ka nirmangtultul, ka nipakamawen ti Herodes, neni apa ka itu lam tenian miraung. Ka nikuma ta meysasu ka sibavaw ki tamatul, 'Kamamang ka kamuyen hu, tmimia yawan, ka pigaa ko imhuan.'

23.niv: And he promised her with an oath, “Whatever you ask I will give you, up to half my kingdom.”
23.cmn: 又對她起誓說：「隨你向我求甚麼，就是我國的一半，我也必給你。」
23.sry: Ka nipatumising sawlalukut tenian, 'Kamamang ka tmimiaw muho yawan, pigaey maw kaw ka ana, tu kidi apa ki na aruhaen ki peysasuan aw.'

24.niv: She went out and said to her mother, “What shall I ask for?” “The head of John the Baptist,” she answered.
24.cmn: 她就出去對她母親說：「我可以求甚麼呢？」她母親說：「施洗約翰的頭。」
24.sry: Ka ru nisamamala ta teni, nikuma ti ina tin, 'Kamang ta tmimiaw maw?' Ka nikuma ta teni, vungo ti Yoanes ka tamaawlug.

25.niv: At once the girl hurried in to the king with the request: “I want you to give me right now the head of John the Baptist on a platter.”
25.cmn: 她就急忙進去見王，求他說：「我願王立時把施洗約翰的頭放在盤子裏給我。」
25.sry: Ka madis nimurbo mukwa ki meysasu ka sibavaw, nitmimien tin, kun, mamuy ko ka pigaey muho yawan tu tangya ta vungo ti Yoanes ka tamaawlug.

26.niv: The king was greatly distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he did not want to refuse her.
26.cmn: 王就甚憂愁；但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就不肯推辭，
26.sry: Ka kawbulas ta sibavaw ka meysasu, ra aley ki nisawlukutan tin, aley apa nenian ka misal tenian asi tin rmawa tenian.

27.niv: So he immediately sent an executioner with orders to bring Johnʼs head. The man went, beheaded John in the prison,
27.cmn: 隨即差一個護衛兵，吩咐拿約翰的頭來。護衛兵就去，在監裏斬了約翰，
27.sry: Ka madis nimadingi ta meysasu ka sibavaw ki kmakading, ka nipakusuen tin ka adey ta vungo tin. Ka ru ukwaen tin, nipalud ki vungo tenian tu sangat.

28.niv: and brought back his head on a platter. He presented it to the girl, and she gave it to her mother.
28.cmn: 把頭放在盤子裏，拿來給女子，女子就給她母親。
28.sry: Ka niad tin ta vungo tin tu tangya, ka nipiga ki tamian, ka nipigaen tin ti ina tenian.

29.niv: On hearing of this, Johnʼs disciples came and took his body and laid it in a tomb.
29.cmn: 約翰的門徒聽見了，就來把他的屍首領去，葬在墳墓裏。 耶穌給五千人吃飽 （太14‧13－21；路9‧10－17；約6‧1－14）
29.sry: Ka ru ilingigen ta ata ki patawtawugan tin, niirua ta neni ka niara nein ta vual tin, ka niatakwaan nein ta ana tu ravak.

30.niv: The apostles gathered around Jesus and reported to him all they had done and taught.
30.cmn: 使徒聚集到耶穌那裏，將一切所做的事、所傳的道全告訴他。
30.sry: Ka ru mawisal ta padadingian ti Yesusan, niimiden nein tenian ta mamang, ki na ringey nein ki nipatagitawugen apa nein.

31.niv: Then, because so many people were coming and going that they did not even have a chance to eat, he said to them, “Come with me by yourselves to a quiet place and get some rest.”
31.cmn: 他就說：「你們來，同我暗暗地到曠野地方去歇一歇。」這是因為來往的人多，他們連吃飯也沒有工夫。
31.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Mukwaa apa ta imumi tu itukakwaan ka maawmiaw, ka pahalikuga kamu madalia." Ka mabatung ta irua ato mukwa, ka ausi ki kidi ki kanaw nein.

32.niv: So they went away by themselves in a boat to a solitary place.
32.cmn: 他們就坐船，暗暗地往曠野地方去。
32.sry: Ka nidmarang ta neni puavang mukwa tu itukwaan ka maawmiag.

33.niv: But many who saw them leaving recognized them and ran on foot from all the towns and got there ahead of them.
33.cmn: 眾人看見他們去，有許多認識他們的，就從各城步行，一同跑到那裏，比他們先趕到了。
33.sry: Ka nikmita ta makuilalawlaw ka dmarang ta neni, ka mabatung ta nikmalang tenian: ka nisium mukwa hina tu rapal tu imid ki awmaawma. Ka niirua ta neni siuro nenian, nimawisal mukwa tenian.

34.niv: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them, because they were like sheep without a shepherd. So he began teaching them many things.
34.cmn: 耶穌出來，見有許多的人，就憐憫他們，因為他們如同羊沒有牧人一般，於是開口教訓他們許多道理。
34.sry: Iru ka tawpapanag ta ti Yesus nikitaan tin ta makuilalawlaw ka mabatung, ka nimararig maharum nenian, aley ka mama ki yuko ka ausi ki tamakading: ka nimataginaunamu matawtawug nenian ki madadag ki mamang.

35.niv: By this time it was late in the day, so his disciples came to him. “This is a remote place,” they said, “and itʼs already very late.
35.cmn: 天已經晚了，門徒進前來，說：「這是野地，天已經晚了，
35.sry: Iru ka madung ato, niirua ta patawtawugan tin tenian, kun, 'Mapawlapawlag ta itukwaan, ka madung ato hinin ta kidi.

36.niv: Send the people away so that they can go to the surrounding countryside and villages and buy themselves something to eat.”
36.cmn: 請叫眾人散開，他們好往四面鄉村裏去，自己買甚麼吃。」
36.sry: Padarangaw ta neni, aley ka ukwaey nein tu purug tu awma ka tu tamang peyla ki paul nenian, ka ausi ki mamang ta neni ka kanen nein.'

37.niv: But he answered, “You give them something to eat.” They said to him, “That would take more than half a yearʼs wages! Are we to go and spend that much on bread and give it to them to eat?”
37.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「你們給他們吃吧。」門徒說：「我們可以去買二十兩銀子的餅給他們吃嗎？」
37.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta teni kuma nenian, "Pigaey ato ki kakanaw nein ta imumi." Ka nikuma ta neni tenian, 'Ukwaey yan kawa peyla maka ruruha kaatugan ki paul, ka pigaey yan nenian ka kman da?'

38.niv: “How many loaves do you have?” he asked. “Go and see.” When they found out, they said, “Five—and two fish.”
38.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們有多少餅，可以去看看。」他們知道了，就說：「五個餅，兩條魚。」
38.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Pipina ato ta paul imumian? Ukwaaw kmita." Iru ka nikmita ato, nikuma lato, 'ririma, duruha apa ki tging.'

39.niv: Then Jesus directed them to have all the people sit down in groups on the green grass.
39.cmn: 耶穌吩咐他們，叫眾人一幫一幫地坐在青草地上。
39.sry: Ka nipakusuen tin nenian pairungaw ta neni imid tu kabatungan tu kuvul ka mahapul.

40.niv: So they sat down in groups of hundreds and fifties.
40.cmn: 眾人就一排一排地坐下，有一百一排的，有五十一排的。
40.sry: Ka nimirung ta neni tu kaililan, tu sat kaatugan, tu rima kitian apa ki rima kitian.

41.niv: Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people. He also divided the two fish among them all.
41.cmn: 耶穌拿着這五個餅，兩條魚，望着天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，擺在眾人面前，也把那兩條魚分給眾人。
41.sry: Ka ru niara tin ta ririma ki paul duruha apa ki tging, nipasawvavulumen tin ki lalululug, ka nipipi ki paul, ka nipigaen tin ki patawtawugan tin, aley ka pahitukwaey nein nenian: ka nipatatagen tin ta raruha ki tging nenian imid ra.

42.niv: They all ate and were satisfied,
42.cmn: 他們都吃，並且吃飽了。
42.sry: Ka nikuimid kman ka mibangtaw ta neni.

43.niv: and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces of bread and fish.
43.cmn: 門徒就把碎餅碎魚收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
43.sry: Ka niara nein mara sat kitian ab ki ruha ka lagian ta matmuy ki na pipi ki tging apa.

44.niv: The number of the men who had eaten was five thousand.
44.cmn: 吃餅的男人共有五千。 耶穌在海上行走 （太14‧22－33；約6‧16－21）
44.sry: Neni ka nikman ki paul na rima katununan lava ta paparag.

45.niv: Immediately Jesus made his disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to Bethsaida, while he dismissed the crowd.
45.cmn: 耶穌隨即催門徒上船，先渡到那邊伯賽大去，等他叫眾人散開。
45.sry: Ka madis nimigarey ta teni puavang ki patawtawugan tin pasiuro nenian puarug tu Bethsaida, du padarangaw tin ta makuilalawlaw.

46.niv: After leaving them, he went up on a mountainside to pray.
46.cmn: 他既辭別了他們，就往山上去禱告。
46.sry: Ka ru nipadarangen tin ta neni, nimagdaken muvukin tu pakualiliden.

47.niv: Later that night, the boat was in the middle of the lake, and he was alone on land.
47.cmn: 到了晚上，船在海中，耶穌獨自在岸上；
47.sry: Iru ka madung ato, ayatukad ki vaung ta avang, ka itusaat tin tu purug ta teni.

48.niv: He saw the disciples straining at the oars, because the wind was against them. Shortly before dawn he went out to them, walking on the lake. He was about to pass by them,
48.cmn: 看見門徒因風不順，搖櫓甚苦。夜裏約有四更天，就在海面上走，往他們那裏去，意思要走過他們去。
48.sry: Ka nikitaan tin ta neni ka nimapungas smasaguan, aley ka hmaduma ta vare nenian: ka tu hivat lava ki ka apat ki awvan, niirua ta teni nenian, ka munonang hmihalap ki vaung: ka hmarivat ta teni nenian.

49.niv: but when they saw him walking on the lake, they thought he was a ghost. They cried out,
49.cmn: 但門徒看見他在海面上走，以為是鬼怪，就喊叫起來；
49.sry: Iru ka kmita ta neni tenian ka unonangen tin hmihalap ki vaung, nipagdimdimen nein ka litu ta ana, ka nihmuhuwahuwaw ta neni,

50.niv: because they all saw him and were terrified. Immediately he spoke to them and said, “Take courage! It is I. Donʼt be afraid.”
50.cmn: 因為他們都看見了他，且甚驚慌。耶穌連忙對他們說：「你們放心！是我，不要怕！」
50.sry: aley ka nikmita ta neni tenian, ka miharafhaf ato ta neni. Ra madis masusu nenian, kun tin, "Pashuta ki rig, ti yaw ka ata, inang matakut."

51.niv: Then he climbed into the boat with them, and the wind died down. They were completely amazed,
51.cmn: 於是到他們那裏，上了船，風就住了；他們心裏十分驚奇。
51.sry: Ka ru nimagdaken muavang nenian, palungpung ato ta vare; ka uhang nimukiap ta neni matagiduma, nimukiap apa ta neni.

52.niv: for they had not understood about the loaves; their hearts were hardened.
52.cmn: 這是因為他們不明白那分餅的事，心裏還是愚頑。 治好革尼撒勒的病人 （太14‧34－36）
52.sry: Ka asi nein umhaen ta nipukidi ki paul, nda nithagen ato ta tintin nein.

53.niv: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret and anchored there.
53.cmn: 既渡過去，來到革尼撒勒地方，就靠了岸，
53.sry: Ka ru tawavang muarug, niirua tu purug ka Genesaret, ka nikmakatar ta neni.

54.niv: As soon as they got out of the boat, people recognized Jesus.
54.cmn: 一下船，眾人認得是耶穌，
54.sry: Iru ka nimagdaken mumala ta neni ki avang, madis nikmalang tenian ta neni.

55.niv: They ran throughout that whole region and carried the sick on mats to wherever they heard he was.
55.cmn: 就跑遍那一帶地方，聽見他在何處，便將有病的人用褥子抬到那裏。
55.sry: Ka nipulamen nein imid ki purug ka ana ka tu tamang, ka nimataginaunamu tu apagan ta maalam, tu mamang ka ilingigen nein ka ayakwa tenian.

56.niv: And wherever he went—into villages, towns or countryside—they placed the sick in the marketplaces. They begged him to let them touch even the edge of his cloak, and all who touched it were healed.
56.cmn: 凡耶穌所到的地方，或村中，或城裏，或鄉間，他們都將病人放在街市上，求耶穌只容他們摸他的衣裳繸子；凡摸着的人就都好了。
56.sry: Ka tumamang ta niiruaan tin, tu awmaawma lava, tu awma lava, tu purug apa ta niatakwaan nein ta maalam tu kairagan, ka nitmumimia tenian ka smudika smukla ki na papidpid ki kulamug tin: ka timamang ta nismukla tenian, nipadarikagen.

1.niv: The Pharisees and some of the teachers of the law who had come from Jerusalem gathered around Jesus
1.cmn: 有法利賽人和幾個文士從耶路撒冷來，到耶穌那裏聚集。
1.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nimawisal ti Yesusan ta Farizeen ki raruma apa ki makusasulat ka nimaka Yerusalem.

2.niv: and saw some of his disciples eating food with hands that were defiled, that is, unwashed.
2.cmn: 他們曾看見他的門徒中有人用俗手，就是沒有洗的手，吃飯。（
2.sry: Nda iru ka nikitaan nein ta raruma ki patatawtawugan tin ka kman ki paul ki na rima ka asi makuptig, ka asi nipadinaw, nikavaleyen nein ta varaw.

3.niv: (The Pharisees and all the Jews do not eat unless they give their hands a ceremonial washing, holding to the tradition of the elders.
3.cmn: 原來法利賽人和猶太人都拘守古人的遺傳，若不仔細洗手就不吃飯；
3.sry: Ka asi kman ta Farizeen ki Yoden apa ru asi nein vunavuney madinaw ki rima, aley ka hmaa lato ki na pahatatunun ki mamumu.

4.niv: When they come from the marketplace they do not eat unless they wash. And they observe many other traditions, such as the washing of cups, pitchers and kettles.)
4.cmn: 從市上來，若不洗浴也不吃飯；還有好些別的規矩，他們歷代拘守，就是洗杯、罐、銅器等物。）
4.sry: Ka ru irua ato ta neni tu kairagan, asi mavok ta neni ru asi nimiawlug. Ka pamuten apa ta madag ki mamang ka pani ka nipatagitawugen nenian, mama ki padiayen ta hawug ka aitan, ki atug, ki sato, ki apagan apa.

5.niv: So the Pharisees and teachers of the law asked Jesus, “Why donʼt your disciples live according to the tradition of the elders instead of eating their food with defiled hands?”
5.cmn: 法利賽人和文士問他說：「你的門徒為甚麼不照古人的遺傳，用俗手吃飯呢？」
5.sry: Anata nitmalig tenian ta Farizeen ki makusasulat apa, 'Kaumang ka asi mawag ta patatawtawugan oho tu na pahatatunun ki mamumu, ra kman ki paul ki rima ka asi nipadinaw?'

6.niv: He replied, “Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you hypocrites; as it is written: “ ‘These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.
6.cmn: 耶穌說：「以賽亞指着你們假冒為善之人所說的預言是不錯的。如經上說： 這百姓用嘴唇尊敬我， 心卻遠離我。
6.sry: Ra teni ta nimatagivli kuma nenian, "Mising ta nipatagitanangen ti Esayas imumian ka paninien ki rig ki su kamu, mama ki nisulaten da, 'tau ta ata ka lmulug yawan ki bibig nein, ra tintin nein ta itutawag yawan.

7.niv: They worship me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules.’
7.cmn: 他們將人的吩咐當作道理教導人， 所以拜我也是枉然。
7.sry: Ra sawkinanino tmamud yawan, du matawtawug ki patagitawugan ka na sikakidi ki kagulung.'

8.niv: You have let go of the commands of God and are holding on to human traditions.”
8.cmn: 你們是離棄上帝的誡命，拘守人的遺傳」；
8.sry: Ka du asia kamu ki nipakusuan ki Alid, itukakwa kamu ki na pahatatunun ki kagulung, mama ki padipaten ki sato ki hawug apa: ka madag apa ki mamang ka kumahina ta pamuten umi."

9.niv: And he continued, “You have a fine way of setting aside the commands of God in order to observe your own traditions!
9.cmn: 又說：「你們誠然是廢棄上帝的誡命，要守自己的遺傳。
9.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Mamsing kamu makuduma ki pakusuan ki Alid, aley ki itukwaey umi ki na pahatatunun umi."

10.niv: For Moses said, ‘Honor your father and mother,’ and, ‘Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death.’
10.cmn: 摩西說：『當孝敬父母』；又說：『咒罵父母的，必治死他。』
10.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Moses, 'Miliga kaw ti Ama uhuan ti Ina uhuan: ka, Timamang ta makuavavag ki raraman ki rarenan tin pakapatayey ta teni.

11.niv: But you say that if anyone declares that what might have been used to help their father or mother is Corban (that is, devoted to God)—
11.cmn: 你們倒說：『人若對父母說：我所當奉給你的，已經作了各耳板』（各耳板就是供獻的意思），
11.sry: Ra kuma kamu ta imumi, 'Timamang ta kumaa hina ki su ti ama tinan, ti ina tinan lava: papapa ta ana, [Korban, ta papapa aley ki Alid] kamamang ka paputhaney maw kaw, nda paitukwaa ta teni ki raraman tin lava ki rarenan tin lava.'

12.niv: then you no longer let them do anything for their father or mother.
12.cmn: 以後你們就不容他再奉養父母。
12.sry: Anata asi mumi hahayen ta teni ka meyringey ki mamang ki raraman tin lava ki rarenan tin da.

13.niv: Thus you nullify the word of God by your tradition that you have handed down. And you do many things like that.”
13.cmn: 這就是你們承接遺傳，廢了上帝的道。你們還做許多這樣的事。」
13.sry: Nda pakahahanino kamu ki su ki Alid ki na pahatatunun umi, ka ana lapa ta nipahatatununan umi da: ka madag ki mamang ka kumahina ta pamut umi."

14.niv: Again Jesus called the crowd to him and said, “Listen to me, everyone, and understand this.
14.cmn: 耶穌又叫眾人來，對他們說：「你們都要聽我的話，也要明白。
14.sry: Iru ka nitataamen tin paukwa tenian ta makuilalalaw, nikuma nenian, "Ilingigaw kamu milingig, umhaaw apa.

15.niv: Nothing outside a person can defile them by going into them. Rather, it is what comes out of a person that defiles them.”
15.cmn: 從外面進去的不能污穢人，惟有從裏面出來的乃能污穢人。」
15.sry: Ausi ta mamang ka tu halap ki kagulung, ka du murbo tenian, asi pakavusuk ato tenian, ra kamamang ka sapapanag tenian, ana ta pakavusuk ato ki kagulung.

16.sry: Hairu timamang ta aku tangira ki ailingilingig, hmilingiga ato."

17.niv: After he had left the crowd and entered the house, his disciples asked him about this parable.
17.cmn: 耶穌離開眾人，進了屋子，門徒就問他這比喻的意思。
17.sry: Iru ka nimurbo ta teni tu talag maka makuilalawlaw, nitmalig tenian ta patatawtawugan tin aley ki pamikawlawan ka ana.

18.niv: “Are you so dull?” he asked. “Donʼt you see that nothing that enters a person from the outside can defile them?
18.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「你們也是這樣不明白嗎？豈不曉得凡從外面進入的，不能污穢人，
18.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Mauru apa kamu kawa ta imumi? Asi umi kawa umhaen, ka kamamang ka tu halap murbo ki kagulung, asi hmahay pakavusuk tenian?

19.niv: For it doesnʼt go into their heart but into their stomach, and then out of the body.” (In saying this, Jesus declared all foods clean.)
19.cmn: 因為不是入他的心，乃是入他的肚腹，又落到茅廁裏（ 這是說，各樣的食物都是潔淨的）」；
19.sry: Aley ka asi sararbo tu tintin tin, ra tu awvavawungen apa ta ana, upanagen tu vual ta ana ka pakakuptig imid ki kakanen.

20.niv: He went on: “What comes out of a person is what defiles them.
20.cmn: 又說：「從人裏面出來的，那才能污穢人；
20.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni, "Ka sapapanag tu kagulung, ana ta pakavusuk mahid ki kagulung.

21.niv: For it is from within, out of a personʼs heart, that evil thoughts come—sexual immorality, theft, murder,
21.cmn: 因為從裏面，就是從人心裏，發出惡念、苟合、
21.sry: Ka maka rbo, maka tintin ki kagulung, mupanag ta na darimdim ka asi mariyang, ki nimakakitil, ki asi nimakakitil, ki lalpulpug

22.niv: adultery, greed, malice, deceit, lewdness, envy, slander, arrogance and folly.
22.cmn: 偷盜、凶殺、姦淫、貪婪、邪惡、詭詐、淫蕩、嫉妒、謗讟、驕傲、狂妄。
22.sry: ki hauzungey, ki hauzungen, ki mate, ki paturahay, ki haway ki maveyung, ki mata ka asi mariyang, ki barugan, ki haway ki rmapurapu.

23.niv: All these evils come from inside and defile a person.”
23.cmn: 這一切的惡都是從裏面出來，且能污穢人。」 一個婦人的信心 （太15‧21－28）
23.sry: Nda imid ki rig ka ata mupanag maka rbo, ka pakavusuk mahid ki kagulung."

24.niv: Jesus left that place and went to the vicinity of Tyre. He entered a house and did not want anyone to know it; yet he could not keep his presence secret.
24.cmn: 耶穌從那裏起身，往泰爾、西頓的境內去，進了一家，不願意人知道，卻隱藏不住。
24.sry: Iru ka nitawhabul ta teni hina nidmarang mukwa tu upanian ki nay ki Tayrus ki Sidon, ka nisararbo tu talag, ka inang ta timamang ka umhaey ato: ka asi nihmahay itudungaw ta teni.

25.niv: In fact, as soon as she heard about him, a woman whose little daughter was possessed by an impure spirit came and fell at his feet.
25.cmn: 當下，有一個婦人，她的小女兒被污鬼附着，聽見耶穌的事，就來俯伏在他腳前。
25.sry: Ka du milingig matagimimia tenian ta saat ka ina ka aku alak tin ka ina ka aku yupan ka asi matikanag, niirua matagiduma tu rapal tin.

26.niv: The woman was a Greek, born in Syrian Phoenicia. She begged Jesus to drive the demon out of her daughter.
26.cmn: 這婦人是希臘人，屬敘利腓尼基族。她求耶穌趕出那鬼離開她的女兒。
26.sry: Ka Grieken ta ina ka ana, ka na Surofoinikissa ki purug: ka nitmumimia tenian ki padarangaw tin ta litu ki alak tin ka ina.

27.niv: “First let the children eat all they want,” he told her, “for it is not right to take the childrenʼs bread and toss it to the dogs.”
27.cmn: 耶穌對她說：「讓兒女們先吃飽，不好拿兒女的餅丟給狗吃。」
27.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, "Siuroa pakavangtawaw ta alalak, ka asi mariyang ka haawmiey ta paul ki alalak, aringaney piga ki ata tu asuasuan ka pupu."

28.niv: “Lord,” she replied, “even the dogs under the table eat the childrenʼs crumbs.”
28.cmn: 婦人回答說：「主啊，不錯；但是狗在桌子底下也吃孩子們的碎渣兒。」
28.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta teni kuma tenian, "Hahay Meyrang: ka kman apa ta asu ka tu rarim ki avokan ka na alalak."

29.niv: Then he told her, “For such a reply, you may go; the demon has left your daughter.”
29.cmn: 耶穌對她說：「因這句話，你回去吧；鬼已經離開你的女兒了。」
29.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni tenian, "Aley ki su ka ata, ukwaaw, nidmarang ta litu ki alakina oho."

30.niv: She went home and found her child lying on the bed, and the demon gone.
30.cmn: 她就回家去，見小孩子躺在床上，鬼已經出去了。 耶穌治好耳聾舌結的人
30.sry: Ka ru dmarang ta teni mupanag, nikabaley tin ki alakina ka malaliko tu apagan, ka nidmarang ta litu.

31.niv: Then Jesus left the vicinity of Tyre and went through Sidon, down to the Sea of Galilee and into the region of the Decapolis.
31.cmn: 耶穌又離了泰爾的境界，經過西頓，就從低加坡里境內來到加利利海。
31.sry: Ka du mila dmarang ki lbag ki nay ki Tayrus ki Sidon, niirua tu vaung ki Galilaya, tawkwa tu tukad ki lbag ki purug ki Dekapolis.

32.niv: There some people brought to him a man who was deaf and could hardly talk, and they begged Jesus to place his hand on him.
32.cmn: 有人帶着一個耳聾舌結的人來見耶穌，求他按手在他身上。
32.sry: Ka niad paukwa tenian ta vual ka mavuta ka mangupo ki su, ka nitmumimia tenian ka atahalapey tin ta rima tenian.

33.niv: After he took him aside, away from the crowd, Jesus put his fingers into the manʼs ears. Then he spit and touched the manʼs tongue.
33.cmn: 耶穌領他離開眾人，到一邊去，就用指頭探他的耳朵，吐唾沫抹他的舌頭，
33.sry: Iru ka nipatulam tenian paukwa ki makuilalawlaw, nipakavung ki kagamus tin tu tangira tin, ka ru nimadipag, nismukla ki litu tin.

34.niv: He looked up to heaven and with a deep sigh said to him, “Ephphatha!” (which means “Be opened!”).
34.cmn: 望天歎息，對他說：「以法大！」就是說：「開了吧！」
34.sry: Ka ru niinag tin papasuvavulum, nimahug, ka nikuma tenian, "Efata", ka inaakwaaney, aawlubey.

35.niv: At this, the manʼs ears were opened, his tongue was loosened and he began to speak plainly.
35.cmn: 他的耳朵就開了，舌結也解了，說話也清楚了。
35.sry: Ka madis niparukilat ta tangira tin, ka nimatanino ki dadila tin, ka nimasusu kmiim ki su.

36.niv: Jesus commanded them not to tell anyone. But the more he did so, the more they kept talking about it.
36.cmn: 耶穌囑咐他們不要告訴人；但他越發囑咐，他們越發傳揚開了。
36.sry: Ka nisingig mavag nenian, ka asi banavanaey timamangan: ra du masaun mavag nenian, masaun pakaamaga ta neni ki ata.

37.niv: People were overwhelmed with amazement. “He has done everything well,” they said. “He even makes the deaf hear and the mute speak.”
37.cmn: 眾人分外希奇，說：「他所做的事都好，他連聾子也叫他們聽見，啞巴也叫他們說話。」
37.sry: Ka uhang nimukiap ta neni, kun, Peyringey tin ta mamang ki mamang: peyringey tin ta nimatawle, peyringey tin ta mangupo.

1.niv: During those days another large crowd gathered. Since they had nothing to eat, Jesus called his disciples to him and said,
1.cmn: 那時，又有許多人聚集，並沒有甚麼吃的。耶穌叫門徒來，說：
1.sry: Tu wagi ka ana, iru apa mabatung ta makuilalawlaw, ka ausi ki mamang ka kanaw nein, ka nitataam ti Yesus ta patawtawugan tin tenian, kuma nenian.

2.niv: “I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat.
2.cmn: 「我憐憫這眾人；因為他們同我在這裏已經三天，也沒有吃的了。
2.sry: "Mararig ko maharafhaf ki kaharuman ki makuilalawlaw, aley ka maka turu ki wagi itulam yawan, ka ausi ki mamang ka kanaw nein.

3.niv: If I send them home hungry, they will collapse on the way, because some of them have come a long distance.”
3.cmn: 我若打發他們餓着回家，就必在路上困乏，因為其中有從遠處來的。」
3.sry: Ka ru padarangen aw ta neni padarangen nein ka asi apa mavok, matub tu darang ta neni, ka niirua ta raruma nenian makadalia."

4.niv: His disciples answered, “But where in this remote place can anyone get enough bread to feed them?”
4.cmn: 門徒回答說：「在這野地，從哪裏能得餅，叫這些人吃飽呢？」
4.sry: Ka nimatagivli tenian ta patawtawugan tin, 'Kaumang ka pakamamsinga ki paul ta timamang hiya tu pulag ki tau ka ata?'

5.niv: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied.
5.cmn: 耶穌問他們說：「你們有多少餅？」他們說：「七個。」
5.sry: Ka nitmalig ta teni nenian, "Pipina ato ta paul imumian?" Ka nikuma ta neni, 'Pipitu.'

6.niv: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground. When he had taken the seven loaves and given thanks, he broke them and gave them to his disciples to distribute to the people, and they did so.
6.cmn: 他吩咐眾人坐在地上，就拿着這七個餅祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒，叫他們擺開，門徒就擺在眾人面前。
6.sry: Ka nipairungen tin tu nay ta makuilalawlaw, ka niara tin ta pipitu ki paul, nipatagivli tin ki lalululug, nipipi, ka nipigaan tin ki patawtawugan tin, aley ka siatatagen nein ta neni, ka nipaatunun nein ta ana ki makuilalawlaw.

7.niv: They had a few small fish as well; he gave thanks for them also and told the disciples to distribute them.
7.cmn: 又有幾條小魚；耶穌祝了福，就吩咐也擺在眾人面前。
7.sry: Ka akumeya apa ta neni ki tging ka using: ka ru nimakuvli makualilid, nipakusuen tin ka pahatununaney apa ta ana nenian.

8.niv: The people ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
8.cmn: 眾人都吃，並且吃飽了，收拾剩下的零碎，有七筐子。
8.sry: Ka nimiimid mavok, ka mibangtaw lato, ka niara nein ilud ki nikda ki na pipi pitu ka lagian.

9.niv: About four thousand were present. After he had sent them away,
9.cmn: 人數約有四千。耶穌打發他們走了，
9.sry: Neni ka nikman, na apat ato katununan lava ta neni: ka nipadarangen tin ta neni.

10.niv: he got into the boat with his disciples and went to the region of Dalmanutha.
10.cmn: 隨即同門徒上船，來到大瑪努他境內。 求主顯個神蹟 （太16‧1－4）
10.sry: Ka madis nimuavang lam ki patawtawugan tin, ka niirua tu paaputan ki Dalmanuta.

11.niv: The Pharisees came and began to question Jesus. To test him, they asked him for a sign from heaven.
11.cmn: 法利賽人出來盤問耶穌，求他從天上顯個神蹟給他們看，想要試探他。
11.sry: Iru ka nimupanag ta Farizeen ka nimataginaunamu matagisal tenian, nitmumimia tenian ki pukidian ka maka vulum, tu repunga tenian.

12.niv: He sighed deeply and said, “Why does this generation ask for a sign? Truly I tell you, no sign will be given to it.”
12.cmn: 耶穌心裏深深地歎息，說：「這世代為甚麼求神蹟呢？我實在告訴你們，沒有神蹟給這世代看。」
12.sry: Ka ru nimaawsusu mavulas tu rig tin, nikuma, "Kaumang ka tmumimia ta kavuilan ka ata ki pukidian? Mising kun aw kamu, asi pigaaney ta pukidian ki kavuivuilan ka ata."

13.niv: Then he left them, got back into the boat and crossed to the other side.
13.cmn: 他就離開他們，又上船往海那邊去了。 防備法利賽人和希律的酵 （太16‧5－12）
13.sry: Ka ru nidarangen tin nenian, nimuavang mila, ka nidmarang muarug.

14.niv: The disciples had forgotten to bring bread, except for one loaf they had with them in the boat.
14.cmn: 門徒忘了帶餅；在船上除了一個餅，沒有別的食物。
14.sry: Ka nihuhingarupen ki patawtawugan keyul ki paul, ka ausi ta neni ki mamang tu avang dik sasat ki paul.

15.niv: “Be careful,” Jesus warned them. “Watch out for the yeast of the Pharisees and that of Herod.”
15.cmn: 耶穌囑咐他們說：「你們要謹慎，防備法利賽人的酵和希律的酵。」
15.sry: Ka nisikidien tin nenian, kun, "Kmita, saukaviera ki nipeyapingit ki Farizeen, ki nipeyapingit apa ti Herodes."

16.niv: They discussed this with one another and said, “It is because we have no bread.”
16.cmn: 他們彼此議論說：「這是因為我們沒有餅吧。」
16.sry: Neni ra nipagalaley pagdumdum pagmado nenian, kun, 'Aley ka asi kita akeyul ki paul ta ana.'

17.niv: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked them: “Why are you talking about having no bread? Do you still not see or understand? Are your hearts hardened?
17.cmn: 耶穌看出來，就說：「你們為甚麼因為沒有餅就議論呢？你們還不省悟，還不明白嗎？你們的心還是愚頑嗎？
17.sry: Ka ru umhaen ti Yesus ta ata nikun tin nenian, "Kamang ta paalaleyan umi, aley ka ausi kamu ki paul? Asi apa mumi kavanen, ka asi mumi umhaen, maatag ato kawa ta tintin umi?

18.niv: Do you have eyes but fail to see, and ears but fail to hear? And donʼt you remember?
18.cmn: 你們有眼睛，看不見嗎？有耳朵，聽不見嗎？也不記得嗎？
18.sry: Meyta ka aku mata, asi kamu kawa kmita? Meyta ka aku tangira, asi kamu kawa milingig? Ka asi kamu pahibaleyen?

19.niv: When I broke the five loaves for the five thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?” “Twelve,” they replied.
19.cmn: 我擘開那五個餅分給五千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少籃子呢？」他們說：「十二個。」
19.sry: Du nipipi aw ta ririma ki paul tu rima katununan ka tau, pipina ka lagian ta matmuy ki na pipi ka niara umi ilud?" Nikuma ta neni tenian, 'Sat kitian ab ki ruha.'

20.niv: “And when I broke the seven loaves for the four thousand, how many basketfuls of pieces did you pick up?” They answered, “Seven.”
20.cmn: 「又擘開那七個餅分給四千人，你們收拾的零碎裝滿了多少筐子呢？」他們說：「七個。」
20.sry: "Iru ka pipitu ka nipipi aw ta apat ki paul aley ki tatununan ki vual, pipina ka lagian ta matmuy ki na pipi ka niara umi ilud?" Ka nikuma ta neni, 'Pipitu.'

21.niv: He said to them, “Do you still not understand?”
21.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們還是不明白嗎？」 治好伯賽大的瞎子
21.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Kamang ka asi apa mumi umhaen?"

22.niv: They came to Bethsaida, and some people brought a blind man and begged Jesus to touch him.
22.cmn: 他們來到伯賽大，有人帶一個瞎子來，求耶穌摸他。
22.sry: Ka niirua ta teni tu Bethsaida, ka niad nein tenian ta vual ka mavuta, ka nitmumimia tenian ka smukla tenian.

23.niv: He took the blind man by the hand and led him outside the village. When he had spit on the manʼs eyes and put his hands on him, Jesus asked, “Do you see anything?”
23.cmn: 耶穌拉着瞎子的手，領他到村外，就吐唾沫在他眼睛上，按手在他身上，問他說：「你看見甚麼了？」
23.sry: Ka ru niaraw ki rima ki mavuta, niad tin tenian paumala ki awma, ka ru nimadipag tu mata tin, niatakwa ki rima tenian, nitmalig tenian, malava ka kmita ato ta teni ki mamang.

24.niv: He looked up and said, “I see people; they look like trees walking around.”
24.cmn: 他就抬頭一看，說：「我看見人了；他們好像樹木，並且行走。」
24.sry: Ka nimararaw ta teni peyhalap, ka nikuma, 'Kmita ko ki kagulung, ka mama ki paranag ka munonang ta neni.'

25.niv: Once more Jesus put his hands on the manʼs eyes. Then his eyes were opened, his sight was restored, and he saw everything clearly.
25.cmn: 隨後又按手在他眼睛上，他定睛一看，就復了原，樣樣都看得清楚了。
25.sry: Siawug ki ana niatahalapen tin ta rima tu mata tin, ka nipaararaw, ka nipadarikagen ato, ka nimatikanag ato kmita ta teni ki imid ki mamang.

26.niv: Jesus sent him home, saying, “Donʼt even go into the village.”
26.cmn: 耶穌打發他回家，說：「連這村子你也不要進去。」 彼得認耶穌為基督 （太16‧13－20；路9‧18－21）
26.sry: Ka nipadarangen tin paukwa tenian, kun, "Ina murboa tu awma, ina banavana timamangan tu awma ka ana."

27.niv: Jesus and his disciples went on to the villages around Caesarea Philippi. On the way he asked them, “Who do people say I am?”
27.cmn: 耶穌和門徒出去，往凱撒利亞‧腓立比村莊去；在路上問門徒說：「人說我是誰？」
27.sry: Ka nidmarang ta ti Yesus, ki patatawtawugan apa tin mukwa tu awmaawma ki Sesarea ka ti Filipus: ka tu darang nitmalig ki patatawtawugan tin, kuma nenian, "Timang kuma ta tau yawan da?"

28.niv: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, one of the prophets.”
28.cmn: 他們說：「有人說是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；又有人說是先知裏的一位。」
28.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta neni, 'Ti Yoanes ka tamaawlug, ta raruma, ti Eliyas, ta raruma apa, ki saat ki na tamamatagitan.'

29.niv: “But what about you?” he asked. “Who do you say I am?” Peter answered, “You are the Messiah.”
29.cmn: 又問他們說：「你們說我是誰？」彼得回答說：「你是基督。」
29.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Imumi ra, timang kuma kamu yawan?" Ka nimatagivli ta ti Petrus, kuma tenian, 'Ti Kristus kaw.'

30.niv: Jesus warned them not to tell anyone about him.
30.cmn: 耶穌就禁戒他們，不要告訴人。 耶穌預言受難和復活 （太16‧21－28；路9‧22－27）
30.sry: Ka nisingig mavag nenian, ka asi banavanaa timamangan tenian.

31.niv: He then began to teach them that the Son of Man must suffer many things and be rejected by the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and after three days rise again.
31.cmn: 從此，他教訓他們說：「人子必須受許多的苦，被長老、祭司長，和文士棄絕，並且被殺，過三天復活。」
31.sry: Ka nimanaunamu matawtawug nenian, ka kidi ato ka tubha ki madag ta Alak ki kagulung, ka rmawa ki mamumu, ki tamapigik ka sibavaw, ki makusasulat, ka pakapatayaw, ka gapita siawug ki tuturu ki wagi.

32.niv: He spoke plainly about this, and Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him.
32.cmn: 耶穌明明地說這話，彼得就拉着他，勸他。
32.sry: Ka nipasusuen tin ta su ka ata matagiamag. Ka ru nipatulam tenian ta ti Petrus, nimataginaunamu matimha tenian.

33.niv: But when Jesus turned and looked at his disciples, he rebuked Peter. “Get behind me, Satan!” he said. “You do not have in mind the concerns of God, but merely human concerns.”
33.cmn: 耶穌轉過來，看着門徒，就責備彼得說：「撒但，退我後邊去吧！因為你不體貼上帝的意思，只體貼人的意思。」
33.sry: Ra teni ru nimaawduma mararaw ki patatawtawugan tin, nimatimha ti Petrusan, kun, "Dmaranga Satan yawan, ka asi kaw pagarupit pagdumdum ka a'tu Alid: dik ka a'tu kagulung da."

34.niv: Then he called the crowd to him along with his disciples and said: “Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.
34.cmn: 於是叫眾人和門徒來，對他們說：「若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，背起他的十字架來跟從我。
34.sry: Ka ru nitataam tin paukwa tenian ta makuilalawlaw lam ki patawtawugan tin, nikuma nenian, "Timamang ta mamuy maawug mukwa yawan da, rmawa mado tenian, maraa ka navavarag tin, ka smaladiluga yawan.

35.niv: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me and for the gospel will save it.
35.cmn: 因為，凡要救自己生命的，必喪掉生命；凡為我和福音喪掉生命的，必救了生命。
35.sry: Ka timamang ta mamuy hmamia ki kawagan tin, patarumaa ki ana: ra timamang ta patarumaa ato ki kawagan tin aley yawan ki hagnaw apa, pakariyanga ki ana.

36.niv: What good is it for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul?
36.cmn: 人就是賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？
36.sry: Ka aku tan ki mang ta kagulung, ka paputanen tin tenian ta imid ki nay, ru mahavung ki kawagan tin?

37.niv: Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?
37.cmn: 人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
37.sry: Kamanga lato ta pigaey ki kagulung, ka paviriey ki vati tin?

38.niv: If anyone is ashamed of me and my words in this adulterous and sinful generation, the Son of Man will be ashamed of them when he comes in his Fatherʼs glory with the holy angels.”
38.cmn: 凡在這淫亂罪惡的世代，把我和我的道當作可恥的，人子在他父的榮耀裏，同聖天使降臨的時候，也要把那人當作可恥的。」
38.sry: Nda timamang ta mangala yawan ki na su aw tu kavuytan ka ata ka tamararburbo ka tamakavaraw, mangala apa tenian ta Alak ki kagulung, du irua ato tu kairangan ki kidi ki Rama tin lam ki tamagnaw ka dilig matiktik."

1.niv: And he said to them, “Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see that the kingdom of God has come with power.”
1.cmn: 耶穌又對他們說：「我實在告訴你們，站在這裏的，有人在沒嘗死味以前，必要看見上帝的國大有能力臨到。」 耶穌改變形像 （太17‧1－13；路9‧28－36）
1.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Mising kun aw kamu, ka akumeya ta raruma ki mituko hiya, ka asi kdimana ki kapatayan, tu kidi apa ka ana ka kitaey ato nein ta peysasuan ki Alid irua tu kailgan".

2.niv: After six days Jesus took Peter, James and John with him and led them up a high mountain, where they were all alone. There he was transfigured before them.
2.cmn: 過了六天，耶穌帶着彼得、雅各、約翰暗暗地上了高山，就在他們面前變了形像，
2.sry: Ka tu awug ki anim ki wagi nipatulam ta ti Yesus tenian ti Petrusan, ti Yakobusan, ti Yoanesan apa, ka nidilug tin punini nenian tu vukin ka mahandag: ka nisilala ta haway tin tu amag nenian.

3.niv: His clothes became dazzling white, whiter than anyone in the world could bleach them.
3.cmn: 衣服放光，極其潔白，地上漂布的，沒有一個能漂得那樣白。
3.sry: Ka nimatikanag ta pamian tin, mapule mama ki uging ka maparukapok, kumahina ka asi palpug papuley ta timamang tu nay.

4.niv: And there appeared before them Elijah and Moses, who were talking with Jesus.
4.cmn: 忽然，有以利亞同摩西向他們顯現，並且和耶穌說話。
4.sry: Ka nikitaan nein ta ti Eliyas lam ti Mosesan, ka matagitavag ti Yesusan.

5.niv: Peter said to Jesus, “Rabbi, it is good for us to be here. Let us put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah.”
5.cmn: 彼得對耶穌說：「拉比，我們在這裏真好！可以搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。」
5.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Petrus kuma ti Yesusan, 'Rabi, mariyang ta ayakwaan eta hiya, nda meyringey eta tuturu ki rata, a'muhoa ta sasat, a'Mosesa ta sasat, a'Eliyasa ta sasat.'

6.niv: (He did not know what to say, they were so frightened.)
6.cmn: 彼得不知道說甚麼才好，因為他們甚是懼怕。
6.sry: Ka asi mumha ta su ka pasusuey tin, aley ka uhang ta neni matakut.

7.niv: Then a cloud appeared and covered them, and a voice came from the cloud: “This is my Son, whom I love. Listen to him!”
7.cmn: 有一朵雲彩來遮蓋他們；也有聲音從雲彩裏出來，說：「這是我的愛子，你們要聽他。」
7.sry: Ka niirua ta purarey ka nitmamurap nenian, ka niirua ta ingaw maka purarey, kun, 'Ti ata ta Alak aw ka kavagangoen, milingiga tenian.'

8.niv: Suddenly, when they looked around, they no longer saw anyone with them except Jesus.
8.cmn: 門徒忽然周圍一看，不再見一人，只見耶穌同他們在那裏。
8.sry: Ka madis du ararawen nein maawvering, asi nein nikitaan ta sasasat ka timamang, dik ti Yesusan ka itusat nenian.

9.niv: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus gave them orders not to tell anyone what they had seen until the Son of Man had risen from the dead.
9.cmn: 下山的時候，耶穌囑咐他們說：「人子還沒有從死裏復活，你們不要將所看見的告訴人。」
9.sry: Iru ka tawdarim ta neni tu vukin, nisikidi nenian ka asi banavanaa timamangan ki nikitaan nein, tu kidi apa ka gapita ato ta Alak ki kagulung ki nikapatayan tin

10.niv: They kept the matter to themselves, discussing what “rising from the dead” meant.
10.cmn: 門徒將這話存記在心，彼此議論「從死裏復活」是甚麼意思。
10.sry: Ka niatakwaan nein paukwa ki su ka ata, mataginaunado matagitavag ki su, mang ta likugey gapit ki nikapatayan.

11.niv: And they asked him, “Why do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?”
11.cmn: 他們就問耶穌說：「文士為甚麼說以利亞必須先來？」
11.sry: Ka nitmalig tenian ta neni, kuma, 'Mang kun ki makusasulat, ka kidi ato ka siuroa irua ta ti Eliyas?'

12.niv: Jesus replied, “To be sure, Elijah does come first, and restores all things. Why then is it written that the Son of Man must suffer much and be rejected?
12.cmn: 耶穌說：「以利亞固然先來復興萬事；經上不是指着人子說，他要受許多的苦被人輕慢呢？
12.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta teni kuma nenian: "Siuroa irua ta ti Eliyas, ka palikuga pagapit ki mamang, ka mama ki mang ta nisulaten ato matagimimia ki Alak ki kagulung, ka kidi ato ka tubha ki madag tenian, ka pukidiey lato ta neni.

13.niv: But I tell you, Elijah has come, and they have done to him everything they wished, just as it is written about him.”
13.cmn: 我告訴你們，以利亞已經來了，他們也任意待他，正如經上所指着他的話。」 治好被污鬼附身的孩子 （太17‧14－21；路9‧37－43）
13.sry: Ra pasusuen aw kamu, ka makaha ato irua ta ti Eliyas, ka nipamuten nein tenian ta mamang ka nikamuyen nein, mama ki nisulaten ato tenian."

14.niv: When they came to the other disciples, they saw a large crowd around them and the teachers of the law arguing with them.
14.cmn: 耶穌到了門徒那裏，看見有許多人圍着他們，又有文士和他們辯論。
14.sry: Ka ru irua ato ki patatawtawugan tin, nikitaan tin ta makuilalawlaw ka mabatung tu ritung nenian, ki makusasulat apa ka patagisal nenian.

15.niv: As soon as all the people saw Jesus, they were overwhelmed with wonder and ran to greet him.
15.cmn: 眾人一見耶穌，都甚希奇，就跑上去問他的安。
15.sry: Ka madis du nikmita tenian ta makuilalawlaw, nimukiap ato ki rig, ka sium pukwa tenian ka nitmabe ta neni tenian.

16.niv: “What are you arguing with them about?” he asked.
16.cmn: 耶穌問他們說：「你們和他們辯論的是甚麼？」
16.sry: Ka nitmalig ta teni ki makusasulat, "Mang ta patigtilan umi nenian?"

17.niv: A man in the crowd answered, “Teacher, I brought you my son, who is possessed by a spirit that has robbed him of speech.
17.cmn: 眾人中間有一個人回答說：「夫子，我帶了我的兒子到你這裏來，他被啞巴鬼附着。
17.sry: Ka saat ka vual tu makuilalawlaw ta nimatagivli tenian, kuma, 'Tamamatawtawug, niad aw imhuan ta alak aw ka parag ka aku yupan ki mangupo.

18.niv: Whenever it seizes him, it throws him to the ground. He foams at the mouth, gnashes his teeth and becomes rigid. I asked your disciples to drive out the spirit, but they could not.”
18.cmn: 無論在哪裏，鬼捉弄他，把他摔倒，他就口中流沫，咬牙切齒，身體枯乾。我請過你的門徒把鬼趕出去，他們卻是不能。」
18.sry: Ka tumamang ka mara tenian, aringen tin ta teni tu nay, ka mangarey ta mutus, ka muragit ki walig, ka milalap ato. Ka nipasusuen aw ki patawtawugan oho ka padarang ta yupan ki mangupo, ka asi nein palpugen.'

19.niv: “You unbelieving generation,” Jesus replied, “how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy to me.”
19.cmn: 耶穌說：「噯！不信的世代啊，我在你們這裏要到幾時呢？我忍耐你們要到幾時呢？把他帶到我這裏來吧。」
19.sry: Ka matagivli ta ti Yesus, nikun tin nenian, "Kavavualan ka asi tnamising, maka manga ko ki dalia ka tulama ko imumian? Maka manga ki dalia ka tububuganey maw kamu? Ad ato hiya ta teni paukwa yawan."

20.niv: So they brought him. When the spirit saw Jesus, it immediately threw the boy into a convulsion. He fell to the ground and rolled around, foaming at the mouth.
20.cmn: 他們就帶了他來。他一見耶穌，鬼便叫他重重地抽瘋，倒在地上，翻來覆去，口中流沫。
20.sry: Ka niad nein tenian paukwa tenian. Ka ru kitaan tin ta teni, madis nisikidi tenian ta yupan. Ka nitawkwa tu nay, ka lboar apa, ngangarey ta mutus.

21.niv: Jesus asked the boyʼs father, “How long has he been like this?” “From childhood,” he answered.
21.cmn: 耶穌問他父親說：「他得這病有多少日子呢？」回答說：「從小的時候。
21.sry: Ka nitmalig ta teni ki raraman tin, "Maka mang maka dalia ki nipamuten tenian ta ata?" Ka nikuma ta teni, "na maka raraway ra.

22.niv: “It has often thrown him into fire or water to kill him. But if you can do anything, take pity on us and help us.”
22.cmn: 鬼屢次把他扔在火裏、水裏，要滅他。你若能做甚麼，求你憐憫我們，幫助我們。」
22.sry: Ka vunavunaen smakikwa tenian tu apuy tu ralum apa, aley ki parumarumaa tenian. Ra ru pailpug kaw pamut ki mamang, maharum ato hmamia imianan.''

23.niv: “ ‘If you can’?” said Jesus. “Everything is possible for one who believes.”
23.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「你若能信，在信的人，凡事都能。」
23.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, "Hairu tnamising kaw, peylpugen imid ki mamang tenian ka tnamising."

24.niv: Immediately the boyʼs father exclaimed, “I do believe; help me overcome my unbelief!”
24.cmn: 孩子的父親立時喊着說：「我信！但我信不足，求主幫助。」
24.sry: Ka madis nimakulangag ta raraman ki raway kuma, "tnamising ko, Meyrang. Sagkuey ko tu asi tnamisingan aw."

25.niv: When Jesus saw that a crowd was running to the scene, he rebuked the impure spirit. “You deaf and mute spirit,” he said, “I command you, come out of him and never enter him again.”
25.cmn: 耶穌看見眾人都跑上來， 就斥責那污鬼，說：「你這聾啞的鬼，我吩咐你從他裏頭出來，再不要進去！」
25.sry: Iru ka nikmita ta ti Yesus ka sium mawisal mukwa ta makuilalawlaw, nimatimha ki yupan ka asi matikanag, kuma tenian, "yupan ka mangupo, pakusuen aw kaw, mupanag tenian, ka asia lato murbo tenian."

26.niv: The spirit shrieked, convulsed him violently and came out. The boy looked so much like a corpse that many said, “Heʼs dead.”
26.cmn: 那鬼喊叫，使孩子大大地抽了一陣瘋，就出來了。孩子好像死了一般，以致眾人多半說：「他是死了。」
26.sry: Anata nimakulangag ta yupan, ka nisidadaw tenian, nidmarang tenian, ka mama ki patay ta teni, kuma apa hina ka mabatung ta nikuma, "Nimapatay ta teni."

27.niv: But Jesus took him by the hand and lifted him to his feet, and he stood up.
27.cmn: 但耶穌拉着他的手，扶他起來，他就站起來了。
27.sry: Ra ti Yesus ta nipeykwaan ki rima tin, nipagapit tenian, ka nimituko ta teni.

28.niv: After Jesus had gone indoors, his disciples asked him privately, “Why couldnʼt we drive it out?”
28.cmn: 耶穌進了屋子，門徒就暗暗地問他說：「我們為甚麼不能趕出他去呢？」
28.sry: Iru ka nimurbo ki talag, nitmawkila ta teni tmalig tenian ta patawtawugan tin, "Kamang ka asi kame ta imian nismakilpug smakipapanag ki ana?"

29.niv: He replied, “This kind can come out only by prayer. ”
29.cmn: 耶穌說：「非用禱告，這一類的鬼總不能出來。」 耶穌第二次預言受難和復活 （太17‧22－23；路9‧43－45）
29.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Asi padarangen ta nanang ka ata ki mamang, dik ki pakualiliden ki irikuten apa."

30.niv: They left that place and passed through Galilee. Jesus did not want anyone to know where they were,
30.cmn: 他們離開那地方，經過加利利；耶穌不願意人知道。
30.sry: Ka dmarang hina, nimalidawa tu Galilaya, ka niinang kamuyen tin ka umhaey timamang ru tumang ta neni.

31.niv: because he was teaching his disciples. He said to them, “The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men. They will kill him, and after three days he will rise.”
31.cmn: 於是教訓門徒，說：「人子將要被交在人手裏，他們要殺害他；被殺以後，過三天他要復活。」
31.sry: Ka nimatawtawug ta teni ki patawtawugan tin, kuma nenian, "Paatununey ta Alak ki kagulung tu rima ki kagulung, ka pakapataya tenian, ka ru pakapatayaw lato, matimawaga gapit ta teni tu ka taturu ki wagi."

32.niv: But they did not understand what he meant and were afraid to ask him about it.
32.cmn: 門徒卻不明白這話，又不敢問他。 誰最偉大 （太18‧1－5；路9‧46－48）
32.sry: Ra asi nein niumhaen ta su ka ata, ka nimatakut tmalig tenian.

33.niv: They came to Capernaum. When he was in the house, he asked them, “What were you arguing about on the road?”
33.cmn: 他們來到迦百農。耶穌在屋裏問門徒說：「你們在路上議論的是甚麼？」
33.sry: Ka niirua ta teni tu Kapernaum, ka ru ayakwa ato tu talag nitmalig nenian, "Mang ta nipatagirarig umi tu darang?"

34.niv: But they kept quiet because on the way they had argued about who was the greatest.
34.cmn: 門徒不作聲，因為他們在路上彼此爭論誰為大。
34.sry: Ra nimeypat ta neni, aley ka tu darang nipatagirarig ki su, timang lava ta siuro tu vavaw ki kidi.

35.niv: Sitting down, Jesus called the Twelve and said, “Anyone who wants to be first must be the very last, and the servant of all.”
35.cmn: 耶穌坐下，叫十二個門徒來，說：「若有人願意作首先的，他必作眾人末後的，作眾人的用人。」
35.sry: Ka ru mirung ta teni nitataam tin ta sasat kitian ab ki ruha, ka nikuma nenian, "Timamang ta mamuya siuro ta teni, kidi ato maawug ki imid, ki pairungaw apa ki imid."

36.niv: He took a little child whom he placed among them. Taking the child in his arms, he said to them,
36.cmn: 於是領過一個小孩子來，叫他站在門徒中間，又抱起他來，對他們說：
36.sry: Anata niawug tin ta using ka raway, nipatukakwa tenian paitutukad nenian, ka ru niaraen tin tu ayva tin, nikuma nenian.

37.niv: “Whoever welcomes one of these little children in my name welcomes me; and whoever welcomes me does not welcome me but the one who sent me.”
37.cmn: 「凡為我名接待一個像這小孩子的，就是接待我；凡接待我的，不是接待我，乃是接待那差我來的。」 不敵擋我們就是幫助我們 （路9‧49－50）
37.sry: "Timamang ta maawmitatalag ki raway ka kumahina tu nanang aw, teni ta maawmitatalag yawan; timamang apa ta maawmitatalag yawan, asi ti yaw ta maawmitatalag, ra teni apa ka nimadingi yawan."

38.niv: “Teacher,” said John, “we saw someone driving out demons in your name and we told him to stop, because he was not one of us.”
38.cmn: 約翰對耶穌說：「夫子，我們看見一個人奉你的名趕鬼，我們就禁止他，因為他不跟從我們。」
38.sry: Nda nimatagivli ta ti Yoanes tenian, kuma, "Tamamatawtawug, nikitaan yan saat ki vual ka padarang ki litu tu nanang oho, ka nimavag kame tenian, aley ka asi masawug ta teni imitan."

39.niv: “Do not stop him,” Jesus said. “For no one who does a miracle in my name can in the next moment say anything bad about me,
39.cmn: 耶穌說：「不要禁止他；因為沒有人奉我名行異能，反倒輕易毀謗我。
39.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Yesus, "Ina mavag tenian, ka ausi ta timamang ka pamutaw ki kailgan tu nanang aw, ka mawug matagiharang yawan.

40.niv: for whoever is not against us is for us.
40.cmn: 不敵擋我們的，就是幫助我們的。
40.sry: Ka timamang ta asi makuduma imitan, teni ta tulam imitan.

41.niv: Truly I tell you, anyone who gives you a cup of water in my name because you belong to the Messiah will certainly not lose their reward.
41.cmn: 凡因你們是屬基督，給你們一杯水喝的，我實在告訴你們，他不能不得賞賜。」 罪的誘惑 （太18‧6－9；路17‧1－2）
41.sry: Ka timamang ta paita imumian ki hawug ki ralum tu Nanang aw, aley ka ti Kristus kamu, dilig kun aw kamu ra, asi tawruma ki uvavarugan tin.

42.niv: “If anyone causes one of these little ones—those who believe in me—to stumble, it would be better for them if a large millstone were hung around their neck and they were thrown into the sea.
42.cmn: 「凡使這信我的一個小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在這人的頸項上，扔在海裏。
42.sry: Ra timamang ta pasaisalakuapa pakavaraw ki saaat ki using ka ata ka tnamising yawan, masaun mariyang tenian ka pukakudey ki vato ki papuhuden ta rig tin, ka aringaney tu vaung.

43.niv: If your hand causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life maimed than with two hands to go into hell, where the fire never goes out.
43.cmn: 倘若你一隻手叫你跌倒，就把它砍下來；
43.sry: Hairu ka pakavaraw imhuan ta rima oho, lukutaw ta ana: masaun mariyang imhuan murbo ki kawagan ru aku sat ki rima, ka ruruha kaw ki rima sakikwaaney tu kalawhawan, tu apuy ka asi hmahay pahiyupen.

44.cmn: 你缺了肢體進入永生，強如有兩隻手落到地獄，入那不滅的火裏去。
44.sry: Tu hina asi mapataya ta bawbawug nein, ka asi maawmia ta apuy da.

45.niv: And if your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off. It is better for you to enter life crippled than to have two feet and be thrown into hell.
45.cmn: 倘若你一隻腳叫你跌倒，就把它 砍下來；
45.sry: Hairu ka pakavaraw imhuan ta rapal oho, lukutaw ta ana: masaun mariyang imhuan murbo ka mapilay kaw tu kawagan, ka ruruha kaw ki rapal sakikwaaney tu kalawhawan, tu apuy ka asi hmahay pahiyupen.

46.cmn: 你瘸腿進入永生，強如有兩隻腳被丟在地獄裏。
46.sry: Tu hina asi mapataya ta bawbawug nein, ka asi maawmia ta apuy da.

47.niv: And if your eye causes you to stumble, pluck it out. It is better for you to enter the kingdom of God with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into hell,
47.cmn: 倘若你一隻眼叫你跌倒，就去掉它；你只有一隻眼進入上帝的國，強如有兩隻眼被丟在地獄裏。
47.sry: Hairu ka pakavaraw imhuan ta mata oho, kmada ki ana: masaun mariyang imhuan ka aku sat kaw ki mata murboa tu peysasuan ki Alid, ka ruruha kaw ki mata sakikwaaney tu apuy ki kalawhawan.

48.niv: where “ ‘the worms that eat them do not die, and the fire is not quenched.’
48.cmn: 在那裏，蟲是不死的，火是不滅的。
48.sry: Tu hina asi mapataya ta bawbawug nein, ka asi maawmia ta apuy da.

49.niv: Everyone will be salted with fire.
49.cmn: 因為必用火當鹽醃各人。
49.sry: Ka imid ki vual ta smakitawaga ki apuy: imid ki papigikan ta smakitawaga ki vaya.

50.niv: “Salt is good, but if it loses its saltiness, how can you make it salty again? Have salt among yourselves, and be at peace with each other.”
50.cmn: 鹽本是好的，若失了味，可用甚麼叫它再鹹呢？你們裏頭應當有鹽，彼此和睦。」
50.sry: Mariyang ta vaya; iru ra mitamsi ta vaya, pakahaaraw mumi ki mang? Akumeyaa lato ki vaya imumian, ka makuimid ki rig akumeyaa ki reya makunanado imumian.

1.niv: Jesus then left that place and went into the region of Judea and across the Jordan. Again crowds of people came to him, and as was his custom, he taught them.
1.cmn: 耶穌從那裏起身，來到猶太的境界並約旦河外。眾人又聚集到他那裏，他又照常教訓他們。
1.sry: Ka nidmarang hina ta teni, niirua tu paaputan ki Yudea tu arug ki Yordan. Ka nimila mukwa tenian ta makuilalawlaw, ka mama ki na kidi nimatawtawug ta teni mila nenian.

2.niv: Some Pharisees came and tested him by asking, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife?”
2.cmn: 有法利賽人來問他說：「人休妻可以不可以？」意思要試探他。
2.sry: Ka niirua tenian ta Farizeen ka nirepung tenian, tmalig, 'Hahayen kawa ta tau sawtawaga ki keyan tin?'

3.niv: “What did Moses command you?” he replied.
3.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「摩西吩咐你們的是甚麼？」
3.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta teni kuma nenian, "Kamang ta nipakusuen ti Moses imumian?"

4.niv: They said, “Moses permitted a man to write a certificate of divorce and send her away.”
4.cmn: 他們說：「摩西許人寫了休書便可以休妻。」
4.sry: Nikuma ta neni, 'Nihahayen ti Moses ta parag ka smulat ki sulat ki padadaradarang, ka padarangaw ta keyan tin.'

5.niv: “It was because your hearts were hard that Moses wrote you this law,” Jesus replied.
5.cmn: 耶穌說：「摩西因為你們的心硬，所以寫這條例給你們；
5.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian, "Aley ki tihag umi ki tintin nisulaten ti Moses ta pakusuen ka ata imumian.

6.niv: “But at the beginning of creation God ‘made them male and female.’
6.cmn: 但從起初創造的時候，上帝造人是造男造女。
6.sry: Ra tu naunamu ki peyringeyan, nipeyringey tin nenian ta parag, ta ina.

7.niv: ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife,
7.cmn: 因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。
7.sry: Aley ki ana dmaranga ta tau ki rama ki rena, ka sawlama ki keyan tin;

8.niv: and the two will become one flesh.’ So they are no longer two, but one flesh.
8.cmn: 既然如此，夫妻不再是兩個人，乃是一體的了。
8.sry: Ka raruha ka ana sasata ki vaat. Kumahina ka asi raruha ta neni, nda sasata lapa ki vaat.

9.niv: Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.”
9.cmn: 所以，上帝配合的，人不可分開。」
9.sry: Anata ka nipapasal ki Alid asi papagpiagaw ki kagulung."

10.niv: When they were in the house again, the disciples asked Jesus about this.
10.cmn: 到了屋裏，門徒就問他這事。
10.sry: Iru ka itukwa ato tu talag, nitmalig tenian ta patatawtawugan tin aley ki ata.

11.niv: He answered, “Anyone who divorces his wife and marries another woman commits adultery against her.
11.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「凡休妻另娶的，就是犯姦淫，辜負他的妻子；
11.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Timamang ta padarang ki keyan tin, ka maya ki pani, rburbo ato tenian ra.

12.niv: And if she divorces her husband and marries another man, she commits adultery.”
12.cmn: 妻子若離棄丈夫另嫁，也是犯姦淫了。」 耶穌為小孩祝福 （太19‧13－15；路18‧15－17）
12.sry: Ka ru padaranga ta ina ki tbung tin, ka maya ki pani, rburbo ato ra."

13.niv: People were bringing little children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them, but the disciples rebuked them.
13.cmn: 有人帶着小孩子來見耶穌，要耶穌摸他們，門徒便責備那些人。
13.sry: Ka niad paukwa tenian ta raraway ka smukla ki ana: nda nipatimhaen ki patawtawugan tin ta neni ka niad nenian.

14.niv: When Jesus saw this, he was indignant. He said to them, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of God belongs to such as these.
14.cmn: 耶穌看見就惱怒，對門徒說：「讓小孩子到我這裏來，不要禁止他們；因為在上帝國的，正是這樣的人。
14.sry: Iru ka kakitaan ti Yesus ta ata uhang nimaidingit ta teni, ka nikuma nenian, "Surunganey ta raraway paukwa yawan, ina mavag nenian: aley ka a'neni ta peysasuan ki Alid.

15.niv: Truly I tell you, anyone who will not receive the kingdom of God like a little child will never enter it.”
15.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，凡要承受上帝國的，若不像小孩子，斷不能進去。」
15.sry: Dilig kun aw kamu ra, timamang ta asi makutatalag ki peysasuan ki Alid mama ki raway, asi murboa hina ki ana."

16.niv: And he took the children in his arms, placed his hands on them and blessed them.
16.cmn: 於是抱着小孩子，給他們按手，為他們祝福。 財主尋求永生之道 （太19‧16－30；路18‧18－30）
16.sry: Ka nimara ta teni nenian tu ayva tin, niatahalapen tin ta rima nenian, nimakuriyang nenian.

17.niv: As Jesus started on his way, a man ran up to him and fell on his knees before him. “Good teacher,” he asked, “what must I do to inherit eternal life?”
17.cmn: 耶穌出來行路的時候，有一個人跑來，跪在他面前，問他說：「良善的夫子，我當做甚麼事才可以承受永生？」
17.sry: Ka ru samamala ta ti Yesus tu darang, niirua ta saat sium, ka ru matalikurug tu duma tenian, nitmalig tenian, "Tamamatawtawug ka mariyang, pamutaw maw ta mang tu tabliey maw ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug?"

18.niv: “Why do you call me good?” Jesus answered. “No one is good—except God alone.
18.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「你為甚麼稱我是良善的？除了上帝一位之外，再沒有良善的。
18.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, "Ka mang ta pananangen oho yawan ka mariyang? Ausi ta timamang ka mariyang, dik sasat ki Alid.

19.niv: You know the commandments: ‘You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony, you shall not defraud, honor your father and mother.’ ”
19.cmn: 誡命你是曉得的：不可殺人；不可姦淫；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；不可虧負人；當孝敬父母。」
19.sry: Kavanaen hu ta pakusuen ki su, Asi kaw muzuzunga ki nimakakitil, Asi kaw hauzunga, Asi kaw gmaila sihaharang, Asi kaw hmimida ki rig, Miliga kaw ti Amaan ti Inaan oho apa." '

20.niv: “Teacher,” he declared, “all these I have kept since I was a boy.”
20.cmn: 他對耶穌說：「夫子，這一切我從小都遵守了。」
20.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta teni kuma tenian, "Tamamatawtawug, kamamang ka ata nikwaen aw ki na kararaway aw."

21.niv: Jesus looked at him and loved him. “One thing you lack,” he said. “Go, sell everything you have and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”
21.cmn: 耶穌看着他，就愛他，對他說：「你還缺少一件：去變賣你所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。」
21.sry: Iru ka araraw ti Yesus tenian, nikavagangoen tin tenian, ka nikuma tenian, "Saasat ki mamang ta ausi apa imhuan: ukwa, pasaduma ki mamang oho, ka pigaey ato ki malimuk, ka akumeyaa kaw ki vangey tu tunun ki vulum. Nda mukwaa, araw ta na vavarag oho, ka smaladiluga yawan da."

22.niv: At this the manʼs face fell. He went away sad, because he had great wealth.
22.cmn: 他聽見這話，臉上就變了色，憂憂愁愁地走了，因為他的產業很多。
22.sry: Ka ru mavulas ta teni ki su ka ata, nidmarang ta teni mavulas, aley ka akumeya tenian ki madag ki hurup.

23.niv: Jesus looked around and said to his disciples, “How hard it is for the rich to enter the kingdom of God!”
23.cmn: 耶穌周圍一看，對門徒說：「有錢財的人進上帝的國是何等地難哪！」
23.sry: Iru ka ararawen ti Yesus tu tin, nikuma ki patatawtawugan tin, "Mahugfpit ta neni ka mavangey murbo tu peysasuan ki Alid."

24.niv: The disciples were amazed at his words. But Jesus said again, “Children, how hard it is to enter the kingdom of God!
24.cmn: 門徒希奇他的話。耶穌又對他們說：「小子，倚靠錢財的人進上帝的國是何等地難哪！
24.sry: Ka nimukiap ato ta patawtawugan ki su tin. Ra nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, kuma nenian, "Kaalalak, mahugfpit lava tu nenian ka tnamising ki vangey murbo tu peysasuan ki Alid.

25.niv: It is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God.”
25.cmn: 駱駝穿過針的眼，比財主進上帝的國還容易呢。」
25.sry: Ka siuro hmahay ta kemel tawkwa tu lbas ki simsim, ka murboa ta mavangey tu peysasuan ki Alid."

26.niv: The disciples were even more amazed, and said to each other, “Who then can be saved?”
26.cmn: 門徒就分外希奇，對他說：「這樣誰能得救呢？」
26.sry: Ka uhang nimukiap ta neni, ka nimatagitavatavag ta neni, "Timang ta pakalpugey ru ana pakariyang?"

27.niv: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but not with God; all things are possible with God.”
27.cmn: 耶穌看着他們，說：「在人是不能，在上帝卻不然，因為上帝凡事都能。」
27.sry: Ka du araraw ti Yesus nikuma nenian, "Asi peylpugen ta ata tu kagulungan, ra asi tu Alid; aley ka peylpugen imid ki mamang ki Alid."

28.niv: Then Peter spoke up, “We have left everything to follow you!”
28.cmn: 彼得就對他說：「看哪，我們已經撇下所有的跟從你了。」
28.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nimataginaunamu ta ti Petrus kuma tenian, "Kitaey, nisawimidan yan sawtawag ki mamang, ka nimuawug kame imhuan."

29.niv: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus replied, “no one who has left home or brothers or sisters or mother or father or children or fields for me and the gospel
29.cmn: 耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，人為我和福音撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姊妹、父母、兒女、田地，
29.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma, "Mising kun aw kamu, Ausi ta timamang ka nidmarang ki talag, ki tagiapaparag, ki niaha, ki rama, ki rena, ki keyan, ki alalak, ki umauma lava aley yawan ki hagnaw apa ki su ka ata

30.niv: will fail to receive a hundred times as much in this present age: homes, brothers, sisters, mothers, children and fields—along with persecutions—and in the age to come eternal life.
30.cmn: 沒有不在今世得百倍的，就是房屋、弟兄、姊妹、母親、兒女、田地，並且要受逼迫，在來世必得永生。
30.sry: ka asi mara ta ana sat kaatugan mama apa ki madadag tu kidi hinin, ki talag, ki tagiapaparag, ki niaha, ki alalak, ki uma, tu kudilugan apa, ka tu idarinugan ka irua du kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug.

31.niv: But many who are first will be last, and the last first.”
31.cmn: 然而，有許多在前的，將要在後，在後的，將要在前。」 耶穌第三次預言受難和復活 （太20‧17－19；路18‧31－34）
31.sry: Ra mabatung ki siurouro ta siaawuga ato, ka siaawug ta siurouroa ato.

32.niv: They were on their way up to Jerusalem, with Jesus leading the way, and the disciples were astonished, while those who followed were afraid. Again he took the Twelve aside and told them what was going to happen to him.
32.cmn: 他們行路上耶路撒冷去。耶穌在前頭走，門徒就希奇，跟從的人也害怕。耶穌又叫過十二個門徒來，把自己將要遭遇的事告訴他們說：
32.sry: Ka niirua ta neni sabavaw tu Yerusalem, ka ru madadilug ta ti Yesus nenian tu darang, nimukiap ta patatawtawugan, ka nimatakut ta neni ka nimaawug tenian. Iru ka nipatulam tin mila ta sat kitian ab ki ruha, nimataginaunamu nenian mang ta mamang ka pavutaw tenian.

33.niv: “We are going up to Jerusalem,” he said, “and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death and will hand him over to the Gentiles,
33.cmn: 「看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，人子將要被交給祭司長和文士，他們要定他死罪，交給外邦人。
33.sry: Kun, "Kitaey muvavaw kita muYerusalem, ka paatununaney ta Alak ki kagulung ki sibavaw ki tamapigik ki makusasulat apa, ka dmungdunga tenian ki pakapatayey, ka paatununaney tenian ki Heydang.

34.niv: who will mock him and spit on him, flog him and kill him. Three days later he will rise.”
34.cmn: 他們要戲弄他，吐唾沫在他臉上，鞭打他，殺害他。過了三天，他要復活。」 雅各和約翰的要求 （太20‧20－28）
34.sry: Ka bilavilaey nein ta teni, papavavulas tenian, smakikwa tenian, ka pakapataya tenian, ka tu ka taturu ki wagi likuga ta teni gapit."

35.niv: Then James and John, the sons of Zebedee, came to him. “Teacher,” they said, “we want you to do for us whatever we ask.”
35.cmn: 西庇太的兒子雅各、約翰進前來，對耶穌說：「夫子，我們無論求你甚麼，願你給我們做。」
35.sry: Ka nimukwa tenian ta ti Yakobus ti Yoanes apa, ka na alalak ti Zebedeus, ka nikun nein, "Tamamatawtawug kamuyen yan ka tmimiaw yan, ka pamutaw muho imianan."

36.niv: “What do you want me to do for you?” he asked.
36.cmn: 耶穌說：「要我給你們做甚麼？」
36.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Mang ta kamuyen umi ka peyringeyaney maw kamu?"

37.niv: They replied, “Let one of us sit at your right and the other at your left in your glory.”
37.cmn: 他們說：「賜我們在你的榮耀裏，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。」
37.sry: Nikuma ta neni tenian, "Pigaey kame ka mirunga kame, ka saata tu uwal oho, ka saata tu ugi oho tu kairangan ki kidi oho."

38.niv: “You donʼt know what you are asking,” Jesus said. “Can you drink the cup I drink or be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with?”
38.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們不知道所求的是甚麼。我所喝的杯，你們能喝嗎？我所受的洗，你們能受嗎？」
38.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, "Asi kamu mavana ka mang ta tmimian umi: Mulpug kamu kawa mit ki hawug ka itaw maw? Tagawlpugen kamu kawa mawlug ki awlugan ka awlugey ko?"

39.niv: “We can,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “You will drink the cup I drink and be baptized with the baptism I am baptized with,
39.cmn: 他們說：「我們能。」耶穌說：「我所喝的杯，你們也要喝；我所受的洗，你們也要受；
39.sry: Nikuma ta neni tenian, "Mulpug kame." Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, "Mit kamu ki hawug ka itaw maw, ka awlugey kamu ki awlugan ka awlugey ko, awlugey kamu ra.

40.niv: but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared.”
40.cmn: 只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是為誰預備的，就賜給誰。」
40.sry: Ra mirung ato tu uwal aw, tu ugi apa maw, asi a'yaw ta pigaey ato, ra pigaey ato nenian ka nipatagitan ato ra."

41.niv: When the ten heard about this, they became indignant with James and John.
41.cmn: 那十個門徒聽見，就惱怒雅各、約翰。
41.sry: Iru ka milingig ta sat kitian ka raruma ki ata nimahapang ta neni ti Yakobusan ti Yoanesan apa.

42.niv: Jesus called them together and said, “You know that those who are regarded as rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.
42.cmn: 耶穌叫他們來，對他們說：「你們知道，外邦人有尊為君王的，治理他們，有大臣操權管束他們。
42.sry: Ka ru nitmataam ta ti Yesus nenian paukwa tenian, nikuma nenian, "Kavanaan umi ka neni ka sibavaw meysasu ki Heydang, ka meyrang ta sikakwa nenian ki kailgan da.

43.niv: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
43.cmn: 只是在你們中間，不是這樣。你們中間，誰願為大，就必作你們的用人；
43.sry: Ra asi kumaa hina imumian: ra timamang imumian ta mamuya kawirangen ki kidi, teni ta pairungaw umi.

44.niv: and whoever wants to be first must be slave of all.
44.cmn: 在你們中間，誰願為首，就必作眾人的僕人。
44.sry: Ka timamang ta mamuya siuro imumian, teni ta kuncia ato ki imid.

45.niv: For even the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
45.cmn: 因為人子來，並不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命作多人的贖價。」 治好瞎子巴底買 （太20‧29－34；路18‧35－43）
45.sry: Ka asi irua ato ta Alak ki kagulung tu irungey tenian, ra tu sawmadoey tin mirung, ka pigaey apa ta vati tin tu tagilien mivli ki mabatung."

46.niv: Then they came to Jericho. As Jesus and his disciples, together with a large crowd, were leaving the city, a blind man, Bartimaeus (which means “son of Timaeus”), was sitting by the roadside begging.
46.cmn: 到了耶利哥；耶穌同門徒並許多人出耶利哥的時候，有一個討飯的瞎子，是底買的兒子巴底買，坐在路旁。
46.sry: Ka niirua ta neni tu Yeriko: ka ru tawpapanag ta teni tu Yeriko lam ki patatawtawugan tin, ki makuilalawlaw apa ka mabatung, ta mavuta ka ti Bartimeus ka alak ti Timeus, ta mirung tu said ki darang tmumimia ki atagey.

47.niv: When he heard that it was Jesus of Nazareth, he began to shout, “Jesus, Son of David, have mercy on me!”
47.cmn: 他聽見是拿撒勒的耶穌，就喊着說：「大衛的子孫耶穌啊！可憐我吧！」
47.sry: Iru ka milingig ta teni ka ti Yesus ka tagiNazareth ta ana, nimataginaunamu makulangag ta teni, matagikumahina, "Yesus ka na Alak ti David, maharum ato yawan."

48.niv: Many rebuked him and told him to be quiet, but he shouted all the more, “Son of David, have mercy on me!”
48.cmn: 有許多人責備他，不許他作聲。他卻越發大聲喊着說：「大衛的子孫哪，可憐我吧！」
48.sry: Ka mabatung ta nimatimha tenian, ka maipata ta teni: ra nimakusaun apa makutun makulangag ta teni, "Na Alak ti David kaharumaw ko."

49.niv: Jesus stopped and said, “Call him.” So they called to the blind man, “Cheer up! On your feet! Heʼs calling you.”
49.cmn: 耶穌就站住，說：「叫過他來。」他們就叫那瞎子，對他說：「放心，起來！他叫你啦。」
49.sry: Ka ru rikaw mituko ta ti Yesus, nimakusu tmataam tenian. Ka nitmataam ta neni ki mavuta, kun tenian, "Pasahuta timi, gapita, tmataam ta teni imhuan."

50.niv: Throwing his cloak aside, he jumped to his feet and came to Jesus.
50.cmn: 瞎子就丟下衣服，跳起來，走到耶穌那裏。
50.sry: Iru ka niaring tin ta kulamug tin, nigapit ka nimukwa ti Yesusan.

51.niv: “What do you want me to do for you?” Jesus asked him. The blind man said, “Rabbi, I want to see.”
51.cmn: 耶穌說：「要我為你做甚麼？」瞎子說：「拉波尼，我要能看見。」
51.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma tenian, "Mang ta kamuyen hu ka peyringeyaney maw kaw?" Nikuma ta mavuta tenian, "Meyrang, ka kmita ato ko."

52.niv: “Go,” said Jesus, “your faith has healed you.” Immediately he received his sight and followed Jesus along the road.
52.cmn: 耶穌說：「你去吧！你的信救了你了。」瞎子立刻看見了，就在路上跟隨耶穌。
52.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, "mukwaa, nipakadarikag imhuan ta tnamisingan oho." Ka madis nikmita ta teni, ka nimaawug ta teni ti Yesusan tu darang.

1.niv: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage and Bethany at the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two of his disciples,
1.cmn: 耶穌和門徒將近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其和伯大尼，在橄欖山那裏；耶穌就打發兩個門徒，
1.sry: Iru ka nimuhili ki Yerusalem ta neni, ki Bethfage ki Bethania apa, tu Vukin ki Elaya, nipadadingien tin ta raruha ki patawtawugan tin, ka nikuma nenian

2.niv: saying to them, “Go to the village ahead of you, and just as you enter it, you will find a colt tied there, which no one has ever ridden. Untie it and bring it here.
2.cmn: 對他們說：「你們往對面村子裏去，一進去的時候，必看見一匹驢駒拴在那裏，是從來沒有人騎過的，可以解開，牽來。
2.sry: "Ukwaaw tu awma ka ana ka maiduma imumian, ka madis du murbo kamu hina, makivaley umi ta patak ka ipu ka asi apa nihalapen timamang: aawkakirigey tenian mad yawan.

3.niv: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you doing this?’ say, ‘The Lord needs it and will send it back here shortly.’ ”
3.cmn: 若有人對你們說：『為甚麼做這事？』你們就說：『主要用牠。 』那人必立時讓你們牽來。」
3.sry: Ka ru matagikumaa hina lava ta timamang imumian, "Kamang ta pamut umi ka ana?" Kumaa kamu hina ra, "mayaapo ki ana ta Meyrang: ka patudisey tin madingi ta teni hiya."

4.niv: They went and found a colt outside in the street, tied at a doorway. As they untied it,
4.cmn: 他們去了，便看見一匹驢駒拴在門外街道上，就把牠解開。
4.sry: Iru ka dmarang ta neni, nikabaley nein ta patak ki luwang ka ipu ka kakirig tu ngataf tu halap ki darang, ka niaawmien nein ta ana.

5.niv: some people standing there asked, “What are you doing, untying that colt?”
5.cmn: 在那裏站着的人，有幾個說：「你們解驢駒做甚麼？」
5.sry: Ka raruma ka mituko hina nikuma nenian, 'Mang ta aawkakirigen umi ki patak?'

6.niv: They answered as Jesus had told them to, and the people let them go.
6.cmn: 門徒照着耶穌所說的回答，那些人就任憑他們牽去了。
6.sry: Ra nikuma ta neni nenian mama ki na sikakidi ti Yesus, ka nimus ato ta neni nenian.

7.niv: When they brought the colt to Jesus and threw their cloaks over it, he sat on it.
7.cmn: 他們把驢駒牽到耶穌那裏，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶穌就騎上。
7.sry: Iru ka niad nein ta patak ki luwang ka ipu ti Yesusan, niatahabilen nein ta kulamug nein tenian, ka nipahalaley nein tenian.

8.niv: Many people spread their cloaks on the road, while others spread branches they had cut in the fields.
8.cmn: 有許多人把衣服鋪在路上，也有人把田間的樹枝砍下來，鋪在路上。
8.sry: Ka mabatung ta makuilalawlaw nimapag ki kulamug nein tu darang, ka raruma ta nitmagta ki pehil ki paranag, ka nihavuluen nein ta ana tu darang.

9.niv: Those who went ahead and those who followed shouted, “Hosanna!” “Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!”
9.cmn: 前行後隨的人都喊着說： 和散那 ！ 奉主名來的是應當稱頌的！
9.sry: Ka neni ka siururo, neni apa ka siawawug ta nimakulangag, kumakwa, 'Hosana: pakuriyangaw lmulug ta teni ka ana ka irarurua tu nanang ki Meyrang.

10.niv: “Blessed is the coming kingdom of our father David!” “Hosanna in the highest heaven!”
10.cmn: 那將要來的我祖大衛之國是應當稱頌的！ 高高在上和散那！
10.sry: Pakariyangey lmulug ta peysasuan ki na Ramu yan ka ti David, ka irua lato tu Nanang ki Meyrang: Hosana tu situnun sibavaw ki vuluvulum.'

11.niv: Jesus entered Jerusalem and went into the temple courts. He looked around at everything, but since it was already late, he went out to Bethany with the Twelve.
11.cmn: 耶穌進了耶路撒冷，入了聖殿，周圍看了各樣物件。天色已晚，就和十二個門徒出城，往伯大尼去了。 咒詛無花果樹 （太21‧18－19）
11.sry: Ka nisararbo ta ti Yesus tu Yerusalem, ki Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid: ka ru nikitaan tin maawduma ta mamang da, iru ka madung ato, nitawpapanag mukwa tu Bethania lam ki sat kitian ab ki ruha.

12.niv: The next day as they were leaving Bethany, Jesus was hungry.
12.cmn: 第二天，他們從伯大尼出來，耶穌餓了。
12.sry: Ka tu sasat apa ki wagi ka tu awug, ru dmarang ta neni maka Bethania, nimagangey ta teni.

13.niv: Seeing in the distance a fig tree in leaf, he went to find out if it had any fruit. When he reached it, he found nothing but leaves, because it was not the season for figs.
13.cmn: 遠遠地看見一棵無花果樹，樹上有葉子，就往那裏去，或者在樹上可以找着甚麼。到了樹下，竟找不着甚麼，不過有葉子，因為不是收無花果的時候。
13.sry: Ka ru kitaan tin tu dalia sat ka ngaraan ka lakawungen ka aku hapa, nidmarang ta teni, du malava ka makivaleya ki mamang tu ngara ka ana: iru ka irua lato hina, asi nikabaley tin kamamang ki hapa, aley ka asi apa kidi tu tawil ki lakawungen.

14.niv: Then he said to the tree, “May no one ever eat fruit from you again.” And his disciples heard him say it.
14.cmn: 耶穌就對樹說：「從今以後，永沒有人吃你的果子。」他的門徒也聽見了。 潔淨聖殿 （太21‧12－17；路19‧45－48；約2‧13－22）
14.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, kuma ki ana, "Mikakwa asi kman ta timamang ki vua imhuan tu ikakwan midarinug." Ka niilingigen ta ana ki patawtawugan tin.

15.niv: On reaching Jerusalem, Jesus entered the temple courts and began driving out those who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves,
15.cmn: 他們來到耶路撒冷。耶穌進入聖殿，趕出殿裏做買賣的人，推倒兌換銀錢之人的桌子和賣鴿子之人的凳子；
15.sry: Ka irua lato ta neni tu Yerusalem, ka ru nimurbo ta ti Yesus ki kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, nimataginaunamu padarang nenian ka pasadarima ki peyla apa tu kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, ka nipapawtukag tin ta tamaviri ki malituk, ki taul apa ki tamapasadima ki padaug.

16.niv: and would not allow anyone to carry merchandise through the temple courts.
16.cmn: 也不許人拿着器具從殿裏經過；
16.sry: Ka asi hahayen tin ta timamang ka meykwa ki sato tu kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid.

17.niv: And as he taught them, he said, “Is it not written: ‘My house will be called a house of prayer for all nations’ ? But you have made it ‘a den of robbers.’ ”
17.cmn: 便教訓他們說：「經上不是記着說： 我的殿必稱為萬國禱告的殿嗎？ 你們倒使它 成為賊窩了。」
17.sry: Ka nimatawtawug ta teni, kuma nenian, "Asi kawa nisulaten da, 'Talag aw ta pananangey talag ki pakualiliden ki imid ki tautau?' Ra nipeyringey umi ta ata ki varinga ki tamalpug."

18.niv: The chief priests and the teachers of the law heard this and began looking for a way to kill him, for they feared him, because the whole crowd was amazed at his teaching.
18.cmn: 祭司長和文士聽見這話，就想法子要除滅耶穌，卻又怕他，因為眾人都希奇他的教訓。
18.sry: Ka nimilingig ki ata ta makusasulat ki sibavaw apa ka tamapigik, ka nikmiim ki su ka parumarumaa tenian; ka nimatakut tenian, aley ka niinag ta makuilalawlaw matagirarig ki nipatatawtawugen tin da.

19.niv: When evening came, Jesus and his disciples went out of the city.
19.cmn: 每天晚上，耶穌出城去。 從無花果樹得教訓 （太21‧20－22）
19.sry: Ka ru madung ato, nitawpapanag ta teni tu awma.

20.niv: In the morning, as they went along, they saw the fig tree withered from the roots.
20.cmn: 早晨，他們從那裏經過，看見無花果樹連根都枯乾了。
20.sry: Iru ka madama apa maliawrag ta neni, nikitaan nein ta lakawungen ka nimilaklak tu patar.

21.niv: Peter remembered and said to Jesus, “Rabbi, look! The fig tree you cursed has withered!”
21.cmn: 彼得想起耶穌的話來，就對他說：「拉比，請看！你所咒詛的無花果樹已經枯乾了。」
21.sry: Ka du nipagdimdim matuk ta ti Petrus, nikuma tenian, "Rabi, kitaey, nimilaklak ta lakawungen ka nipakuavavagen hu."

22.niv: “Have faith in God,” Jesus answered.
22.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「你們當信服上帝。
22.sry: Ka du matagivli ta ti Yesus nikuma nenian, "Aku tnamising ki Alid.

23.niv: “Truly I tell you, if anyone says to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and does not doubt in their heart but believes that what they say will happen, it will be done for them.
23.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，無論何人對這座山說：『你挪開此地，投在海裏！』他若心裏不疑惑，只信他所說的必成，就必給他成了。
23.sry: Ka dilig kun aw kamu ra, ka timamang ta kumaa hina ki su ki vukin ka ata, paleyaw ka aringaney tu vaung, ka asi padalag tu tintin tin, ra tnamisinga ka pavawutaw ta mamang ka pasusuen tin, kamamang ka pasusuen tin pamutaw tenian.

24.niv: Therefore I tell you, whatever you ask for in prayer, believe that you have received it, and it will be yours.
24.cmn: 所以我告訴你們，凡你們禱告祈求的，無論是甚麼，只要信是得着的，就必得着。
24.sry: Aley ki ana pasusuen aw kamu, kamamang ka tmimiaw umi tu pakualiliden, tnamisinga ka araaw umi ta ana, ka akumeyaa kamu ki ana.

25.niv: And when you stand praying, if you hold anything against anyone, forgive them, so that your Father in heaven may forgive you your sins.”
25.cmn: 你們站着禱告的時候，若想起有人得罪你們，就當饒恕他，好叫你們在天上的父也饒恕你們的過犯。
25.sry: Ka ru mituko kamu makualilid, ataral ato, hairu akumeya kamu ki mamang ki tau, aley ka ataral apa ta raraman umi ka tu tunun ki vuluvulum imumian ki nitawrahayen umi.

26.cmn: 你們若不饒恕人，你們在天上的父也不饒恕你們的過犯。 」 質問耶穌的權柄 （太21‧23－27；路20‧1－8）
26.sry: Nda iru ra asi kamu ataral, asi atarala lapa ta raraman umi ka tu tunun ki vuluvulum ki nitawrahayen umi."

27.niv: They arrived again in Jerusalem, and while Jesus was walking in the temple courts, the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders came to him.
27.cmn: 他們又來到耶路撒冷。耶穌在殿裏行走的時候，祭司長和文士並長老進前來，
27.sry: Ka nisalikug ta neni mukwa tu Yerusalem, ka du munonang ta teni tu Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, niirua tenian ta sibavaw ka tamapigik, ta makusasulat, ki mamumu apa.

28.niv: “By what authority are you doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave you authority to do this?”
28.cmn: 問他說：「你仗着甚麼權柄做這些事？給你這權柄的是誰呢？」
28.sry: Ka nikuma tenian, "Tu kairangan timang ta pamuten hu ta ata? Ka timang ta nipiga imhuan ki kairangan ka ata ki pamuten hu ta ata?"

29.niv: Jesus replied, “I will ask you one question. Answer me, and I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
29.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「我要問你們一句話，你們回答我，我就告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。
29.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian, "Talig apa maw kamu ki sasat ki su, ka du matagivlia kamu ki ata yawan, vanavanaa ko imumian tu kairangan timang ka pamuten aw ta ata.

30.niv: Johnʼs baptism—was it from heaven, or of human origin? Tell me!”
30.cmn: 約翰的洗禮是從天上來的？是從人間來的呢？你們可以回答我。」
30.sry: Nda na aawlug ti Yoanes, maka tunun ki vulum kawa ta ana, maka kagulung kawa? Matagivlia yawan da."

31.niv: They discussed it among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why didnʼt you believe him?’
31.cmn: 他們彼此商議說：「我們若說『從天上來』，他必說：『這樣，你們為甚麼不信他呢？』
31.sry: Neni ra nipagalaley pagdumdum pagmado nenian, kun, "Hairu maka tunun ki vulum ta su yan, matagikumaa ta teni, Kamang ka asi kamu nitnamising tenian?

32.niv: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’ …” (They feared the people, for everyone held that John really was a prophet.)
32.cmn: 若說『從人間來』，卻又怕百姓，因為眾人真以約翰為先知。」
32.sry: Iru ra maka kagulung kun yan, anata katakuten nein ta makuilalawlaw, aley ka tamamatagitan da imid nikwa nein ti Yoanesan."

33.niv: So they answered Jesus, “We donʼt know.” Jesus said, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.”
33.cmn: 於是回答耶穌說：「我們不知道。」耶穌說：「我也不告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。」
33.sry: Nimatagivli ta neni kuma ti Yesusan, "Akierey." Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian, "Ka asi ko vanavanaa imumian, tu kailgan timang ka pamuten aw ta ata."

1.niv: Jesus then began to speak to them in parables: “A man planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a pit for the winepress and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and moved to another place.
1.cmn: 耶穌就用比喻對他們說：「有人栽了一個葡萄園，周圍圈上籬笆，挖了一個壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給園戶，就往外國去了。
1.sry: Ka nimeynaunamu masusu ta teni nenian ki pamikawlawan ki su. "Saat ki vual ka nimadiri ki a'tu ka karawmatagan, ka nipuritungen tin ta tatavag, ka nikudauken tin ta dauk ka patukwaan ki nisiput ka hala ki karawmata, ka nipeyringey tin ta tarakal ka vato, ka nipaitukwa hina ki tamatagkul, ka nitawhabul apa mukwa tu pani ki purug.

2.niv: At harvest time he sent a servant to the tenants to collect from them some of the fruit of the vineyard.
2.cmn: 到了時候，打發一個僕人到園戶那裏，要從園戶收葡萄園的果子。
2.sry: Ka tu kidi ki kaayaman nimadingi ta teni ki kuncia tin paukwa ki tamatagkul ka ana, ka arawaw tin ki vua ki karawmatagan da.

3.niv: But they seized him, beat him and sent him away empty-handed.
3.cmn: 園戶拿住他，打了他，叫他空手回去。
3.sry: Ra tmurung ta neni tenian, nipatawbawrig smaplat tenian, ka nipadarangen nein makugko tenian.

4.niv: Then he sent another servant to them; they struck this man on the head and treated him shamefully.
4.cmn: 再打發一個僕人到他們那裏。他們打傷他的頭，並且凌辱他。
4.sry: Nimila madingi nenian ta pani ki kuncia, ra nicit nein ki na vato tu vungo, ka nivulasen nein madingi tenian.

5.niv: He sent still another, and that one they killed. He sent many others; some of them they beat, others they killed.
5.cmn: 又打發一個僕人去，他們就殺了他。後又打發好些僕人去，有被他們打的，有被他們殺的。
5.sry: Ka nimila madingi ki pani, ka nipakapatayan nein tenian, ki mabatung apa ka pani, ka nipatawbawrig ki pani, ka nipakapatay ki pani.

6.niv: “He had one left to send, a son, whom he loved. He sent him last of all, saying, ‘They will respect my son.’
6.cmn: 園主還有一位是他的愛子，末後又打發他去，意思說：『他們必尊敬我的兒子。』
6.sry: Nda ka akumeya ato ki saat ki alak tin ka kavagangoen, nipadingien tin tenian paukwa nenian, ka kuma, "Matakuta lava masawkulkul ki alak aw ra."

7.niv: “But the tenants said to one another, ‘This is the heir. Come, letʼs kill him, and the inheritance will be ours.’
7.cmn: 不料，那些園戶彼此說：『這是承受產業的。來吧，我們殺他，產業就歸我們了！』
7.sry: Iru ra nimatagisal matagitavatavag ta tamatagkul ka ana, "Teni ta tablia tamia, nda pakapatay eta tenian, tami eta ta tablien da."

8.niv: So they took him and killed him, and threw him out of the vineyard.
8.cmn: 於是拿住他，殺了他，把他丟在園外。
8.sry: Iru ka niaraw nein tmurung tenian, nipakapatay tenian, ka nimaring smakitawag tenian tu mala ki a'tu karawmatagan.

9.niv: “What then will the owner of the vineyard do? He will come and kill those tenants and give the vineyard to others.
9.cmn: 這樣，葡萄園的主人要怎麼辦呢？他要來除滅那些園戶，將葡萄園轉給別人。
9.sry: "Anata umanga lava ta meyrang ki a'tu karawmatagan? Irua ta teni, ka pakapatayey tin ta tamatagkul ka ana, ka pigaey tin ta a'tu kakarawmatagan ki pani ra.

10.niv: Havenʼt you read this passage of Scripture: “ ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone;
10.cmn: 經上寫着說： 匠人所棄的石頭 已作了房角的頭塊石頭。
10.sry: Asi kamu kawa nikting ta na Sasulat ka ata: 'Vato ka niaring ki tamameyringey ki talag, nikawvato tu pusul.'

11.niv: the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes’ ?”
11.cmn: 這是主所做的， 在我們眼中看為希奇。 這經你們沒有念過嗎？」
11.sry: Nipamuten ki Meyrang ta ata, ka uringawen ato tu mata eta?"

12.niv: Then the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders looked for a way to arrest him because they knew he had spoken the parable against them. But they were afraid of the crowd; so they left him and went away.
12.cmn: 他們看出這比喻是指着他們說的，就想要捉拿他，只是懼怕百姓，於是離開他走了。 納稅給凱撒的問題 （太22‧15－22；路20‧19－26）
12.sry: Ka nikmiim ta neni ki turungen tenian, ra nimatakut ki makuilalawlaw, ka umhaen nein ka nipasusuen tin nenian ta pamikawlawan ka ana. Ka ru paitukakwa tenian, nidmarang ta neni.

13.niv: Later they sent some of the Pharisees and Herodians to Jesus to catch him in his words.
13.cmn: 後來，他們打發幾個法利賽人和幾個希律黨的人到耶穌那裏，要就着他的話陷害他。
13.sry: Ka nipadingien nein paukwa tenian ta raruma ki Farizeen, ki Herodianen apa, aley ki tagiduka tigkla ki patagiruken ki su tin tenian.

14.niv: They came to him and said, “Teacher, we know that you are a man of integrity. You arenʼt swayed by others, because you pay no attention to who they are; but you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?
14.cmn: 他們來了，就對他說：「夫子，我們知道你是誠實的，甚麼人你都不徇情面；因為你不看人的外貌，乃是誠誠實實傳上帝的道。納稅給凱撒可以不可以？
14.sry: Ka ru irua ato ta neni, nikuma tenian, "Tamamatawtawug, kavanen yan ka matiktik kaw ki su, ka asi kaw masaun meykwa ki tau, ka asi kaw masaun meykwa ki vulung ki kagulung, ra nipatagitawugey muho ta darang ki Alid tu katiktikan. Hahayen kawa piga ki meysasu ka sibavaw ka Siatug Sibavaw ta imugan, asi lava hahayen?"

15.niv: Should we pay or shouldnʼt we?” But Jesus knew their hypocrisy. “Why are you trying to trap me?” he asked. “Bring me a denarius and let me look at it.”
15.cmn: 我們該納不該納？」耶穌知道他們的假意，就對他們說：「你們為甚麼試探我？拿一個銀錢來給我看！」
15.sry: "Pigaey yan kawa, asi lava pigaey yan?" Ra tu kalangen tin ta paninien ki rig nein, nikuma nenian, "Kaumang ka repunga kamu yawan? Ad ato ko ta denarium ka malituk ka kmitaa ko ki ana."

16.niv: They brought the coin, and he asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?” “Caesarʼs,” they replied.
16.cmn: 他們就拿了來。耶穌說：「這像和這號是誰的？」他們說：「是凱撒的。」
16.sry: Ka niaden nein ta ana, ka nikuma nenian, "A'timang ta pasutautauen ka ata? Na paahahalap apa ka patag?" Ka nikuma ta neni tenian, "Ki Siatug Sibavaw."

17.niv: Then Jesus said to them, “Give back to Caesar what is Caesarʼs and to God what is Godʼs.” And they were amazed at him.
17.cmn: 耶穌說：「凱撒的物當歸給凱撒，上帝的物當歸給上帝。」他們就很希奇他。 復活的問題 （太22‧23－33；路20‧27－40）
17.sry: Ka ru matagivli ta ti Yesus nikuma nenian, "Pigaey lato ki Siatug Sibavaw ka a'tu Siatug Sibavaw, ki Alid apa ka a'tu Alid ra." Ka nimukiap ta neni tenian.

18.niv: Then the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.
18.cmn: 撒都該人常說沒有復活的事。他們來問耶穌說：
18.sry: Tu kidi ka ana irua ato mukwa tenian ta Saduseen, ka kuma kakwa hina, ka ausia likugey gapit, ka nitmalig tenian, kuma.

19.niv: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses wrote for us that if a manʼs brother dies and leaves a wife but no children, the man must marry the widow and raise up offspring for his brother.
19.cmn: 「夫子，摩西為我們寫着說：『人若死了，撇下妻子，沒有孩子，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。』
