19.sry: "Tamamatawtawug, nisulaten ti Moses imianan, hairu mapatay ta tagiapaparag ki tau, ka paitukwaa ki keyan tin, ka ausi ki alalak, ka araw ki tagiapaparag tin ta keyan tin, ka papatimawagey ta gaap ki tagiapaparag tin.

20.niv: Now there were seven brothers. The first one married and died without leaving any children.
20.cmn: 有弟兄七人，第一個娶了妻，死了，沒有留下孩子。
20.sry: Nda na aku papitu ki tagiapaparag. Ka niputbung ta naunamu, ka nimapatay tu ausi ki alalak.

21.niv: The second one married the widow, but he also died, leaving no child. It was the same with the third.
21.cmn: 第二個娶了她，也死了，沒有留下孩子。第三個也是這樣。
21.sry: Ka niirua ta kararuha ki ina tin, ka nimapatay apa, ka asi nimadis malidawa ki gaap, kuma apa hina ta kataturu.

22.niv: In fact, none of the seven left any children. Last of all, the woman died too.
22.cmn: 那七個人都沒有留下孩子；末了，那婦人也死了。
22.sry: Ka pipitu ka ana ta nimara tenian, asi nimasilala ki alalak. Tu awug ki imid nenian nipiskwa apa mapatay ta ina.

23.niv: At the resurrection whose wife will she be, since the seven were married to her?”
23.cmn: 當復活的時候，她是哪一個的妻子呢？因為他們七個人都娶過她。」
23.sry: Anata tu likugey gapit, du likugey apa ta neni, a'timanga ta keyan nein? Du nipuimid meya tenian ta pipitu ka ana."

24.niv: Jesus replied, “Are you not in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God?
24.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們所以錯了，豈不是因為不明白聖經，不曉得上帝的大能嗎？
24.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, kuma hiya nenian, "Asi kamu kawa tawrumaa tu asi kavanaan ki na sasulat ki lig apa ki Alid?

25.niv: When the dead rise, they will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.
25.cmn: 人從死裏復活，也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一樣。
25.sry: Nda iru ka likuga ta neni gapit, asi putbunga, asi paputbunganey apa, ra mama ato ki tamagnaw ka tu tunun ki vulum.

26.niv: Now about the dead rising—have you not read in the Book of Moses, in the account of the burning bush, how God said to him, ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’ ?
26.cmn: 論到死人復活，你們沒有念過摩西的書荊棘篇上所載的嗎？上帝對摩西說：『我是亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝。』
26.sry: Ka ato likugey gapit, asi umi kawa nikting tu sulat ti Moses, tu ayhawan ka paranag ta Alid tenian, kun, "Ti yaw ta Alid ti Abraham, ta Alid ti Isaak, ta Alid apa ti Yakob?

27.niv: He is not the God of the dead, but of the living. You are badly mistaken!”
27.cmn: 上帝不是死人的上帝，乃是活人的上帝。你們是大錯了。」 最大的誡命 （太22‧34－40；路10‧25－28）
27.sry: Asi Alid ta teni ki patay, ra Alid apa ki mawag. Anata ta tawkwa kamu tu kairangan."

28.niv: One of the teachers of the law came and heard them debating. Noticing that Jesus had given them a good answer, he asked him, “Of all the commandments, which is the most important?”
28.cmn: 有一個文士來，聽見他們辯論，曉得耶穌回答的好，就問他說：「誡命中哪是第一要緊的呢？」
28.sry: Ka saat ki makusasulat ta niirua tenian, ka nimilingig ki su nein pagdumdum, ka ru kitaan tin ka nipatagivlien tin nenian, nitmalig tenian, "Mang ta su ka naunamu ki imid ki pakusuan?"

29.niv: “The most important one,” answered Jesus, “is this: ‘Hear, O Israel: The Lord our God, the Lord is one.
29.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「第一要緊的就是說：『以色列啊，你要聽，主－我們上帝是獨一的主。
29.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Yesus tenian, "Ata ta siuro ki kairangan ki su, Milingiga Israel: Meyrang ka Alid yan dik saasat ta Meyrang.

30.niv: Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind and with all your strength.’
30.cmn: 你要盡心、盡性、盡意、盡力愛主－你的上帝。』
30.sry: Ka mavagangoa kaw ki Meyrang ka Alid oho tu tintin oho ka mitatumuk, tu vati oho ka mitatumuk, tu umhaen oho pagdumdum, tu imid apa ki kailgan oho. Ata ta su ka naunamu ki pakusuan.

31.niv: The second is this: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’ There is no commandment greater than these.”
31.cmn: 其次就是說：『要愛人如己。 』再沒有比這兩條誡命更大的了。」
31.sry: Ra kararuha ta makawlawla ki ata: Mavagangoa kaw ki tau ka raruma mama mamado imhuan. Ausi ta pani ki pakusuan ka masaun irang ki ata."

32.niv: “Well said, teacher,” the man replied. “You are right in saying that God is one and there is no other but him.
32.cmn: 那文士對耶穌說：「夫子說，上帝是一位，實在不錯；除了他以外，再沒有別的上帝；
32.sry: Ka nikuma tenian ta makusasulat, "Mamsing Tamamatawtawug, matiktik ta su oho, ka saat ta Alid, ka ausi ta pani ki pani dik tenian.

33.niv: To love him with all your heart, with all your understanding and with all your strength, and to love your neighbor as yourself is more important than all burnt offerings and sacrifices.”
33.cmn: 並且盡心、盡智、盡力愛他，又愛人如己，就比一切燔祭和各樣祭祀好的多。」
33.sry: Ka kavagangoen ta teni ki tintin ka mitatumuk, ki umhaen ato, ki vati apa ka mitatumuk, ki pasikunung ato ki kailgan, ka kavagangoen apa ta tau ka raruma mama mamado tenian, ta masaun meyrang ki imid ki papakahahalapen ka papigikan ka nimilamag ki papigikan apa."

34.niv: When Jesus saw that he had answered wisely, he said to him, “You are not far from the kingdom of God.” And from then on no one dared ask him any more questions.
34.cmn: 耶穌見他回答的有智慧，就對他說：「你離上帝的國不遠了。」從此以後，沒有人敢再問他甚麼。 大衛子孫的問題 （太22‧41－46；路20‧41－44）
34.sry: Ka ru kitaan ti Yesus ka nimatagivli ta teni ki pakuzazingan, nikuma tenian, "Asi kaw madalia ki peysasuan ki Alid." Ka nimaneyaney ta timamang tmalig tenian ki mamang.

35.niv: While Jesus was teaching in the temple courts, he asked, “Why do the teachers of the law say that the Messiah is the son of David?
35.cmn: 耶穌在殿裏教訓人，就問他們說：「文士怎麼說基督是大衛的子孫呢？
35.sry: Ra du matagivli ta ti Yesus nikuma du matawtawug tu Kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, "Matagikumahina ki mang ta makusasulat, ka na alak ti David ta ti Kristus?

36.niv: David himself, speaking by the Holy Spirit, declared: “ ‘The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet.” ’
36.cmn: 大衛被聖靈感動，說： 主對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊， 等我使你仇敵作你的腳凳。
36.sry: Ka ti David ta nimatagikumahina ki YUPAN, 'Nimasusu ta Meyrang ki Meyrang aw, mirunga tu uwal aw tu kidi ka paitukwaaw lato maw ta sivawawvawug imhuan tu kakakwaan ki rapal oho.

37.niv: David himself calls him ‘Lord.’ How then can he be his son?” The large crowd listened to him with delight.
37.cmn: 大衛既自己稱他為主，他怎麼又是大衛的子孫呢？」眾人都喜歡聽他。 譴責文士 （太23‧1－36；路20‧45－47）
37.sry: Anata mananang ta ti David tenian, "Meyrang". Anata mamamang ka na alak tin ta teni? Ka makuilalawlaw ka ana ta nimilingig tenian ka aku kahaylan."

38.niv: As he taught, Jesus said, “Watch out for the teachers of the law. They like to walk around in flowing robes and be greeted with respect in the marketplaces,
38.cmn: 耶穌在教訓之間，說：「你們要防備文士；他們好穿長衣遊行，喜愛人在街市上問他們的安，
38.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian tu patatawtawugan tin, "Ra saukaviera ki makusasulat ka mamuy munonang tu pakahandag ki kulamug, ki pasirariuen apa tu panag ka pakuisal nein.

39.niv: and have the most important seats in the synagogues and the places of honor at banquets.
39.cmn: 又喜愛會堂裏的高位，筵席上的首座。
39.sry: Ka kamawen nein ta irarungan ki itu uroen tu Pakuisasalan, ki uroen apa tu pileyligen.

40.niv: They devour widowsʼ houses and for a show make lengthy prayers. These men will be punished most severely.”
40.cmn: 他們侵吞寡婦的家產，假意作很長的禱告。這些人要受更重的刑罰！」 寡婦的奉獻 （路21‧1－4）
40.sry: Ka kanen nein ta talatalag ki inaina ka nikapatayan tbung, tu hawaten ki haway ki pakudaliadalien makualilid. Neni ka ata pakivaleyey ki siuro makdung ka dungdungen."

41.niv: Jesus sat down opposite the place where the offerings were put and watched the crowd putting their money into the temple treasury. Many rich people threw in large amounts.
41.cmn: 耶穌對銀庫坐着，看眾人怎樣投錢入庫。有好些財主往裏投了若干的錢。
41.sry: Ka du mirung ta ti Yesus tu duma vatolang ki atahaan ki vangey, nikitaan tin mama ki mang ta makuilalawlaw ka smakikwa ki malituk tu vatolang ka ana. Ka mabatung ta mavangey ka nismakikwa ki madag.

42.niv: But a poor widow came and put in two very small copper coins, worth only a few cents.
42.cmn: 有一個窮寡婦來，往裏投了兩個小錢，就是一個大錢。
42.sry: Ka niirua ta saat ka ina, ka nismakikwa ki ruruha ki malituk, nda dik ki lumari ka saasat.

43.niv: Calling his disciples to him, Jesus said, “Truly I tell you, this poor widow has put more into the treasury than all the others.
43.cmn: 耶穌叫門徒來，說：「我實在告訴你們，這窮寡婦投入庫裏的，比眾人所投的更多。
43.sry: Iru ka nitataam tin paukwa tenian ta patawtawugan tin, nikuma nenian, "Mising kun aw kamu ra, ka masaun mabatung ta ina ka nikapatayan ki tbung ka ata tu vavaw ki imid nenian ka masaun tu pukakwaan ki vangey.

44.niv: They all gave out of their wealth; but she, out of her poverty, put in everything—all she had to live on.”
44.cmn: 因為，他們都是自己有餘，拿出來投在裏頭；但這寡婦是自己不足，把她一切養生的都投上了。」
44.sry: Ka nipuimid nein ta neni pakakwa ki kahuvaran nein, ra teni ki kahuvaran tin nipuimid tin ta imid ka akumeya tin, ta imid apa ki kawagan tin.

1.niv: As Jesus was leaving the temple, one of his disciples said to him, “Look, Teacher! What massive stones! What magnificent buildings!”
1.cmn: 耶穌從殿裏出來的時候，有一個門徒對他說：「夫子，請看，這是何等的石頭！何等的殿宇！」
1.sry: Nda du samamala ta ti Yesus ki kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, nikuma ta saat ki patatawtawugan tin tenian, "Tamamatawtawug, kitaey, kamang ka vato ka kumahina irang, mang apa ki tarakal da."

2.niv: “Do you see all these great buildings?” replied Jesus. “Not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
2.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「你看見這大殿宇嗎？將來在這裏沒有一塊石頭留在石頭上，不被拆毀了。」 災難的起頭 （太24‧3－14；路21‧7－19）
2.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma tenian, "Kitaan hu kawa ta tarakal ka irang ka ata? Asi paitukwaey hiya ta sasasat ka vato paituhalap ki vato ka ruma, ka asi taktakaw."

3.niv: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives opposite the temple, Peter, James, John and Andrew asked him privately,
3.cmn: 耶穌在橄欖山上對聖殿而坐。彼得、雅各、約翰，和安得烈暗暗地問他說：
3.sry: Iru ka mirung ta teni tu Vukin ki Elaya, tu duma ki kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, nimusinag tmalig tenian ta ti Petrus, ti Yakobus, ti Yoanes, ti Andreas.

4.niv: “Tell us, when will these things happen? And what will be the sign that they are all about to be fulfilled?”
4.cmn: 「請告訴我們，甚麼時候有這些事呢？這一切事將成的時候有甚麼預兆呢？」
4.sry: 'Vanavanaey kame, manoa lato ta mamang ka ata? Ka kamanga lato ta pukidian, ka pamutaw lato ta mamang ka ata?'

5.niv: Jesus said to them: “Watch out that no one deceives you.
5.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們要謹慎，免得有人迷惑你們。
5.sry: Iru ka matagivli ta ti Yesus nimataginaunamu nenian, "Kitaey, ka asi paturahaya ta timamang imumian.

6.niv: Many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am he,’ and will deceive many.
6.cmn: 將來有好些人冒我的名來，說：『我是基督』，並且要迷惑許多人。
6.sry: Ka mabatung ta iruaa tu nanang aw, ka kumaa, Ti yaw ta ti Kristus, ka paturahayaw nein ta tau ka madag.

7.niv: When you hear of wars and rumors of wars, do not be alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.
7.cmn: 你們聽見打仗和打仗的風聲，不要驚慌。這些事是必須有的，只是末期還沒有到。
7.sry: Ka ru ilingigaw umi ta pasacitan, ki ikalawakawen apa ki pasacitan, ina miringaw ki rig, ka kidi ato ka pavutaw ta mamang ka ata, ra ausi apa ki limulimu.

8.niv: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be earthquakes in various places, and famines. These are the beginning of birth pains.
8.cmn: 民要攻打民，國要攻打國；多處必有地震、饑荒。這都是災難的起頭。
8.sry: Ka gapita ta tautau muduma ki tautau, ta peysasuan apa makuduma ki peysasuan: ka iruaa ki ninug tu manini ki itukwaan, ka iruaa ki kahangeyan, ki sasamukan da: kamamang ka ata dik ka naunamu ki pahialalamen.

9.niv: “You must be on your guard. You will be handed over to the local councils and flogged in the synagogues. On account of me you will stand before governors and kings as witnesses to them.
9.cmn: 但你們要謹慎；因為人要把你們交給公會， 並且你們在會堂裏要受鞭打，又為我的緣故站在諸侯與君王面前，對他們作見證。
9.sry: Ra, saukaviera kamu, aley ka paatununa imumian ki pakuisalan, ka patawbawriga imumian tu Pakuisasalan, ka paukwaey kamu tu duma ki Tagisu ki Meysasu apa aley yawan, tu patagihailan nenian.

10.niv: And the gospel must first be preached to all nations.
10.cmn: 然而，福音必須先傳給萬民。
10.sry: Ka kidi ato ka patasasuey siuro ta hagnaw ka mariyang tu imid ki tautau ka Heydang.

11.niv: Whenever you are arrested and brought to trial, do not worry beforehand about what to say. Just say whatever is given you at the time, for it is not you speaking, but the Holy Spirit.
11.cmn: 人把你們拉去交官的時候，不要預先思慮說甚麼；到那時候，賜給你們甚麼話，你們就說甚麼；因為說話的不是你們，乃是聖靈。
11.sry: Iru ra tmurunga ta neni imumian ka paatununa lapa imumian, ina mavuskar ki rig, mamang lava ta pasusuey mumi, ka asi kamu pagkubu ki rig: ra kamamang ka pigaaney imumian tu kidi ki tagley ka ana, pasusuey ato. Ka asi ta imumi ka masusu, ra YUPAN apa ta ana.

12.niv: “Brother will betray brother to death, and a father his child. Children will rebel against their parents and have them put to death.
12.cmn: 弟兄要把弟兄，父親要把兒子，送到死地；兒女要起來與父母為敵，害死他們；
12.sry: Ka paatununa ta tagiaparag ki tagiaparag tin tu kapatayan, ta raraman ki alak tin, ka makudumaa ta alalak ki tagilalalak nenian, ka lpuga nenian.

13.niv: Everyone will hate you because of me, but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.
13.cmn: 並且你們要為我的名被眾人恨惡。惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。」 大災難 （太24‧15－28；路21‧20－24）
13.sry: Ka kavahiraney kamu ki imid ki tau aley yawan, ra teni ka pahalimug tu ilalimugan ta pakariyangey da.

14.niv: “When you see ‘the abomination that causes desolation’ standing where it does not belong—let the reader understand—then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
14.cmn: 「你們看見那行毀壞可憎的，站在不當站的地方（讀這經的人須要會意）。那時，在猶太的，應當逃到山上；
14.sry: Iru ka kitaey umi ta kakariskausen ki ubulbulan ka nipasusuen ti Daniel ka na tamamatagitan, ka itukwa tu asi na kidi - nda umhaey ato ki tamakting - ana ta na mamang tu Yudea, da iliputa pubavukin.

15.niv: Let no one on the housetop go down or enter the house to take anything out.
15.cmn: 在房上的，不要下來，也不要進去拿家裏的東西；
15.sry: Na mamang ta ayaapang, ka asi murarim, ka asi murboa tu araey tin ki mamang tu talag tin.

16.niv: Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.
16.cmn: 在田裏的，也不要回去取衣裳。
16.sry: Ka timamang ta ayauma, asi maawmuveyringa mara ki kulamug tin.

17.niv: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!
17.cmn: 當那些日子，懷孕的和奶孩子的有禍了！
17.sry: Anay ta imumi ka inaina ka mavuy ka pauho tu wagi ka ana.

18.niv: Pray that this will not take place in winter,
18.cmn: 你們應當祈求，叫這些事不在冬天臨到。
18.sry: Nda makualilida ka asi pavutaw ta iliputey umi tu amigan,

19.niv: because those will be days of distress unequaled from the beginning, when God created the world, until now—and never to be equaled again.
19.cmn: 因為在那些日子必有災難，自從上帝創造萬物直到如今，並沒有這樣的災難，後來也必沒有。
19.sry: aley ka iruaa tu wagi ka ana ta sasamukan ki bulbulun, ka niausi ki kumahina siawug ki kidi ki naunamu ki nipeyringey ki Alid tu kidi apa hinin, ka ausia apa du rumang.

20.niv: “If the Lord had not cut short those days, no one would survive. But for the sake of the elect, whom he has chosen, he has shortened them.
20.cmn: 若不是主減少那日子，凡有血氣的，總沒有一個得救的；只是為主的選民，他將那日子減少了。
20.sry: Ka ru ina papakipoen ki Meyrang ta kidi ki wagi, asi pakariyangaw ta kamamang ka vaat; ra aley ki sakuperien, ka niperi tin, papakipoen tin ta wagi.

21.niv: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘Look, there he is!’ do not believe it.
21.cmn: 那時若有人對你們說：『看哪，基督在這裏』，或說：『基督在那裏』，你們不要信！
21.sry: Tu kidi ka ana ru matagikumaa hina lava ta timamang ki su imumian, 'Kitaey, tu hiya ta ti Kristus, tu hina lava', ina tnamising da.

22.niv: For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.
22.cmn: 因為假基督、假先知將要起來，顯神蹟奇事，倘若能行，就把選民迷惑了。
22.sry: Ka gapita ta mabatung ka sukristus, ka sutamamatagitan, ka pamuta ki pukakidian ki na ringey apa ki uringawen, aley ki paturahayaw nein ru ilpugen ta sakuperien da.

23.niv: So be on your guard; I have told you everything ahead of time.
23.cmn: 你們要謹慎。看哪，凡事我都預先告訴你們了。」 人子的降臨 （太24‧29－31；路21‧25－28）
23.sry: Ra, saukaviera, nipatasasuen aw kamu pasiuro ki imid ki mamang.

24.niv: “But in those days, following that distress, “ ‘the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light;
24.cmn: 「在那些日子，那災難以後， 日頭要變黑了， 月亮也不放光，
24.sry: Ra tu wawagi ka ana, siawug ki sasamuken ka ana, karumdumey ta wagi, ka asi matikanaga ta vural.

25.niv: the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’
25.cmn: 眾星要從天上墜落， 天勢都要震動。
25.sry: Ka muaring ta atatalingey ki vulum, ka pakilikalikaey ta kailgan ka tu tunun ki vuluvulum.

26.niv: “At that time people will see the Son of Man coming in clouds with great power and glory.
26.cmn: 那時，他們要看見人子有大能力、大榮耀，駕雲降臨。
26.sry: Ka tu kidi ka ana kmita ta neni ki Alak ki kagulung, ka irua tu purararey ki kailgan ki kairangan ki kidi.

27.niv: And he will send his angels and gather his elect from the four winds, from the ends of the earth to the ends of the heavens.
27.cmn: 他要差遣天使，把他的選民，從四方，從地極直到天邊，都招聚了來。」 從無花果樹學個比方 （太24‧32－35；路21‧29－33）
27.sry: Ka tu kidi ka ana padingiey tin ta tamagnaw tin, ka papakuilalawa ki niperi tin, ki pagapat ki nipakakwaan ki varevare, na kidi ki nay tu kidi apa ki vuluvulum.

28.niv: “Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.
28.cmn: 「你們可以從無花果樹學個比方：當樹枝發嫩長葉的時候，你們就知道夏天近了。
28.sry: Nda madaama mumha ki paranag ka lakawungen ki pamikawlawlaan: iru ka maawkuna ta pehil tin, ka musurag ta hapa tin, kalangen umi ka ayahili ta dagulang.

29.niv: Even so, when you see these things happening, you know that it is near, right at the door.
29.cmn: 這樣，你們幾時看見這些事成就，也該知道人子近了，正在門口了。
29.sry: Kuma apa kamu hina, ru kitaey umi ka pavutaw ta mamang ka ata, umhaaw ka tu tamang ta ana, tu ngataf apa.

30.niv: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.
30.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，這世代還沒有過去，這些事都要成就。
30.sry: Mising kun aw kamu, asi maliawraga ta kavuilan ka ata, ka pagkahan ato pamut imidey ta kamamang ka ana.

31.niv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
31.cmn: 天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。」 那日那時沒有人知道 （太24‧36－44）
31.sry: Maliawraga ta vulum ki nay, ra asi maliawraga ta kasuan aw.

32.niv: “But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
32.cmn: 「但那日子，那時辰，沒有人知道，連天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟有父知道。
32.sry: Ra kidi ki wagi ki tagley apa ka ana asi mumha ta timamang, asi apa ta tamagnaw ka tu tunun ki vulum, asi apa ta Alak, dik ki Rama.

33.niv: Be on guard! Be alert ! You do not know when that time will come.
33.cmn: 你們要謹慎，警醒祈禱，因為你們不曉得那日期幾時來到。
33.sry: Pulilita, mahamawaa, makualilida: ka asi umi umhaen ka mano ta kidi ra.

34.niv: Itʼs like a man going away: He leaves his house and puts his servants in charge, each with their assigned task, and tells the one at the door to keep watch.
34.cmn: 這事正如一個人離開本家，寄居外邦，把權柄交給僕人，分派各人當做的工，又吩咐看門的警醒。
34.sry: Ka mama ka ana ki kagulung, ka du tawhabula mukwa tu pani ki purug, ka nidmarang ki talag tin, ka nipaatunun tu kuncia ki kailgan tin, ki meybuavual ki peyringeyen tin, ka nipakusuen tin ki suayam tu ngataf.

35.niv: “Therefore keep watch because you do not know when the owner of the house will come back—whether in the evening, or at midnight, or when the rooster crows, or at dawn.
35.cmn: 所以，你們要警醒；因為你們不知道家主甚麼時候來，或晚上，或半夜，或雞叫，或早晨；
35.sry: Anata mahamawaa, aley ka asi umi umhaen ka mano ka irua ato ta Meyrang ki talag, du madung lava, du tukad lava muni ta tafuka, du madama lava.

36.niv: If he comes suddenly, do not let him find you sleeping.
36.cmn: 恐怕他忽然來到，看見你們睡着了。
36.sry: Aley ka ru irua lato ta teni, asi kumabaley imumian ka mirip.

37.niv: What I say to you, I say to everyone: ‘Watch!’ ”
37.cmn: 我對你們所說的話，也是對眾人說：要警醒！」
37.sry: Ka mamang ka ata ka pasusuen aw imumian, pasusuen aw ki imid, nda mahamawaa."

1.niv: Now the Passover and the Festival of Unleavened Bread were only two days away, and the chief priests and the teachers of the law were scheming to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.
1.cmn: 過兩天是逾越節，又是除酵節，祭司長和文士想法子怎麼用詭計捉拿耶穌，殺他。
1.sry: Ka ruruha ki wagi ru asi apa niakwa ta Uvavatugan ki Halidawan ki paul ka asi nipeyapingit, ka kmikiim ta tamapigik ka sibavaw ki makusasulat apa ki su, mamamang ka turungaw nein tenian ki sivanavanaan, ka pakapatayaw apa ta teni.

2.niv: “But not during the festival,” they said, “or the people may riot.”
2.cmn: 只是說：「當節的日子不可，恐怕百姓生亂。」 在伯大尼受膏 （太26‧6－13；約12‧1－8）
2.sry: Ka nikuma ta neni, "Asi tu uvavatugan, aley ka ausia ki kavarutivutan ki tau."

3.niv: While he was in Bethany, reclining at the table in the home of Simon the Leper, a woman came with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, made of pure nard. She broke the jar and poured the perfume on his head.
3.cmn: 耶穌在伯大尼長大痲瘋的西門家裏坐席的時候，有一個女人拿着一玉瓶至貴的真哪噠香膏來，打破玉瓶，把膏澆在耶穌的頭上。
3.sry: Ka ru ayakwa tu Bethania tu talag ti Simon ka utaumen ato ki Lepros, iru ka mirung ta teni tu avokan, niirua ta ina ka meykwa ki vato ka pule ka rukul, ka aku rapul ka Nardus ka mangal, ka asi nihurad ki angal. Ka ru nipuvavag tin ta rukul, niududoen tin ta ana masihalap ki vungo tin.

4.niv: Some of those present were saying indignantly to one another, “Why this waste of perfume?
4.cmn: 有幾個人心中很不喜悅，說：「何用這樣枉費香膏呢？
4.sry: Ka niakumeya ta raruma ki uhang nimaidingit, kuma, "Kaumang ta ataninoan ka ata ki rapul?"

5.niv: It could have been sold for more than a yearʼs wages and the money given to the poor.” And they rebuked her harshly.
5.cmn: 這香膏可以賣三十多兩銀子賙濟窮人。」他們就向那女人生氣。
5.sry: Ka patuilpug ru papeyla ta rapul ka ata ki turu kaatugan ki malituk ka nipigen ki ana ta malimuk. Ka nimaawrmur ato tenian.

6.niv: “Leave her alone,” said Jesus. “Why are you bothering her? She has done a beautiful thing to me.
6.cmn: 耶穌說：「由她吧！為甚麼難為她呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。
6.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Yesus, "Pasikunungaw ta teni, kaumang ka pakahimko umi tenian? Mariyang ta na ringey tin yawan da.

7.niv: The poor you will always have with you, and you can help them any time you want. But you will not always have me.
7.cmn: 因為常有窮人和你們同在，要向他們行善隨時都可以；只是你們不常有我。
7.sry: Ka mikakwa akumeyaa kamu ki malimuk ayakwa imumian, ka ru mamuy kamu, kmiim kamu mariyang nenian, ra ausia kamu mikakwa yawan.

8.niv: She did what she could. She poured perfume on my body beforehand to prepare for my burial.
8.cmn: 她所做的，是盡她所能的；她是為我安葬的事把香膏預先澆在我身上。
8.sry: Nimamut ta teni ki tnalpug tnaringey tin. Nirudo tin ta rapul masihalap ki vual aw tu ravakey.

9.niv: Truly I tell you, wherever the gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her.”
9.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，普天之下，無論在甚麼地方傳這福音，也要述說這女人所做的，以為記念。」 猶大出賣耶穌 （太26‧14－16；路22‧3－6）
9.sry: Mising kun aw kamu, tumang ka patasasuey ta hagnaw ka ata ka mariyang tu imid ki nay, pasusuey apa ta mamang ka na ringey tin tu hibavaleyan tenian."

10.niv: Then Judas Iscariot, one of the Twelve, went to the chief priests to betray Jesus to them.
10.cmn: 十二門徒之中，有一個加略人猶大去見祭司長，要把耶穌交給他們。
10.sry: Ka saat ki sat kitian ab ki ruha ka ti Yudas, nimukwa ki sibavaw ka tamapigik, aley ki paatununaney tin ti Yesusan nenian.

11.niv: They were delighted to hear this and promised to give him money. So he watched for an opportunity to hand him over.
11.cmn: 他們聽見就歡喜，又應許給他銀子；他就尋思如何得便把耶穌交給他們。 和門徒同度逾越節 （太26‧17－25；路22‧7－13，21－23；約13‧21－30）
11.sry: Iru ka milingig ta neni ki ata, nimaray ta neni, ka nipatumisingey nein piga ki malituk tenian. Ka nikmiim ta teni ki kidi ka mariyang, ka paatununaney tin tenian.

12.niv: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, when it was customary to sacrifice the Passover lamb, Jesusʼ disciples asked him, “Where do you want us to go and make preparations for you to eat the Passover?”
12.cmn: 除酵節的第一天，就是宰逾越羊羔的那一天，門徒對耶穌說：「你吃逾越節的筵席要我們往哪裏去預備呢？」
12.sry: Ka tu naunamu ki wagi ka asi nipeyapingit ta paul ka papigikey ta yuko ki halidawan, nikuma ta patawtawugan tin tenian, "Tumang ta kamuyen oho ka ukwaey yan tmanang imhuan pakan ki yuko ki halidawan?"

13.niv: So he sent two of his disciples, telling them, “Go into the city, and a man carrying a jar of water will meet you. Follow him.
13.cmn: 耶穌就打發兩個門徒，對他們說：「你們進城去，必有人拿着一瓶水迎面而來，你們就跟着他。
13.sry: Ka nipadadingien tin ta raruha ki patatawtawugan tin, kuma nenian, "Ukwaaw tu awma, ka awklaey mumi ta tau ka mad ki rukul ki ralum, maawuga tenian.

14.niv: Say to the owner of the house he enters, ‘The Teacher asks: Where is my guest room, where I may eat the Passover with my disciples?’
14.cmn: 他進哪家去，你們就對那家的主人說：『夫子說：客房在哪裏？我與門徒好在那裏吃逾越節的筵席。』
14.sry: Ka vanavana ki tagitalag, na su ki Tamamatawtawug, "Tumang ta glaf aley yawan ka mavoka ko lam ki patawtawugan aw tu na vatugan ki halidawan?"

15.niv: He will show you a large room upstairs, furnished and ready. Make preparations for us there.”
15.cmn: 他必指給你們擺設整齊的一間大樓，你們就在那裏為我們預備。」
15.sry: Ka pakitaey tin ta teni imumian ki glaf ka irang tu vavaw ka niputanang ki mamang. Tu hina tmanang ato imianan."

16.niv: The disciples left, went into the city and found things just as Jesus had told them. So they prepared the Passover.
16.cmn: 門徒出去，進了城，所遇見的正如耶穌所說的。他們就預備了逾越節的筵席。
16.sry: Iru ka nitawpapanag ta patawtawugan tin, niirua tu awma, ka nikabaley nein mama ki nipasusuen tin nenian: ka nitanangen nein ta yuko ki halidawan.

17.niv: When evening came, Jesus arrived with the Twelve.
17.cmn: 到了晚上，耶穌和十二個門徒都來了。
17.sry: Iru ka madung ato niirua ta teni lam ki sat kitian ab ki ruha.

18.niv: While they were reclining at the table eating, he said, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me—one who is eating with me.”
18.cmn: 他們坐席正吃的時候，耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，你們中間有一個與我同吃的人要賣我了。」
18.sry: Iru ka mirung ta neni ka nimavok, nikuma ta ti Yesus, "Mising kun aw kamu, saasat imumian ka misal yawan mavok, teni ta sivanavanaa yawan."

19.niv: They were saddened, and one by one they said to him, “Surely you donʼt mean me?”
19.cmn: 他們就憂愁起來，一個一個地問他說：「是我嗎？」
19.sry: Ka nimanaunamu ta neni mivavulas, ka nimataginaunamu ki su tenian ta meybuavual, "Ti yaw kawa?" Ka pani apa nikuma, "Ti yaw kawa."

20.niv: “It is one of the Twelve,” he replied, “one who dips bread into the bowl with me.
20.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「是十二個門徒中同我蘸手在盤子裏的那個人。
20.sry: Nda nimatagivli ta teni kuma nenian, "Saat ta teni ki sat kitian ab ki ruha ka ana, ka smilam yawan dmauk tu tangya.

21.niv: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
21.cmn: 人子必要去世，正如經上指着他所寫的；但賣人子的人有禍了！那人不生在世上倒好。」 設立主的晚餐 （太26‧26－30；路22‧14－20；林前11‧23－25）
21.sry: Kuma ato ka dmarang ta Alak ki kagulung mama ki nisulaten ato tenian, ra anay ki tau ka ana sivanavanaa ki Alak ki kagulung. Ka mariyang tenian ru asi nipeyalaken ta kagulung ka ana."

22.niv: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, “Take it; this is my body.”
22.cmn: 他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝了福，就擘開，遞給他們，說：「你們拿着吃，這是我的身體」；
22.sry: Iru ka meykakan ta neni, nimara ta ti Yesus ki paul, ka ru nimakuvli makualilid, nipipi tin, ka nipigaan tin nenian, ka nikuma, "Araw, kanaw, ata ta vual aw."

23.niv: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, and they all drank from it.
23.cmn: 又拿起杯來，祝謝了，遞給他們；他們都喝了。
23.sry: Ka ru niara tin ta hawug ka aitan, ka ru nipakuvli tin makualilid, nipigaen tin nenian ta ata, ka niitan nein mit ki ana.

24.niv: “This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many,” he said to them.
24.cmn: 耶穌說：「這是我立約的血，為多人流出來的。
24.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, ata ta gamag aw ki sikavagen ka vahaw, ka tiriaw aley ki mabatung.

25.niv: “Truly I tell you, I will not drink again from the fruit of the vine until that day when I drink it new in the kingdom of God.”
25.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直到我在上帝的國裏喝新的那日子。」
25.sry: Dilig kun aw kamu ra, asi ko mila mita ki na vua ki ngara ki karawmata tu kidi apa ki wagi ka ana ka mit ko ki na vahaw tu peysasuan ki Alid.

26.niv: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
26.cmn: 他們唱了詩，就出來，往橄欖山去。 預言彼得不認主 （太26‧31－35；路22‧31－34；約13‧36－38）
26.sry: Iru ka takakahan nein ta takalulugan, nitawpapanag ta neni mukwa tu Vukin ki Elaya.

27.niv: “You will all fall away,” Jesus told them, “for it is written: “ ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep will be scattered.’
27.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「你們都要跌倒了，因為經上記着說： 我要擊打牧人， 羊就分散了。
27.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, "Pakaimidaw kamu pakavaraw ki awvan ka ata: Aley ka nisasulaten, "Apidaw maw ta suayam, ka papagiavuakaw ta yuko."

28.niv: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
28.cmn: 但我復活以後，要在你們以先往加利利去。」
28.sry: Iru ka hakahaa lato ko gapit, tawururua ko imumian mukwa tu Galilaya."

29.niv: Peter declared, “Even if all fall away, I will not.”
29.cmn: 彼得說：「眾人雖然跌倒，我總不能。」
29.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Petrus tenian, "Meyta ru pakaimidaw ta neni pakavaraw, asi ko kumaa hina."

30.niv: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “today—yes, tonight—before the rooster crows twice you yourself will disown me three times.”
30.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「我實在告訴你，就在今天夜裏，雞叫兩遍以先，你要三次不認我。」
30.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, "Mising kun aw kaw, ka tu wagi ka ata, tu awvan ka ata du asi apa raruhaley muni ta tafuka, ka taturuley muho rmaw yawan."

31.niv: But Peter insisted emphatically, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you.” And all the others said the same.
31.cmn: 彼得卻極力地說：「我就是必須和你同死，也總不能不認你。」眾門徒都是這樣說。 在客西馬尼禱告 （太26‧36－46；路22‧39－46）
31.sry: Ka nimasusu ta ti Petrus masaun malig, "Meyta ru pislalam apa maw kaw mapatay, asi ko rmawa imhuan." Ka kuma apa hina ki su ta neni ka imid.

32.niv: They went to a place called Gethsemane, and Jesus said to his disciples, “Sit here while I pray.”
32.cmn: 他們來到一個地方，名叫客西馬尼。耶穌對門徒說：「你們坐在這裏，等我禱告。」
32.sry: Ka niirua ta neni tu itukakwaan ka pananangen Getsemani, ka nikuma ki patawtawugan tin, "Mirunga hiya tu kidi ru makualilida ko."

33.niv: He took Peter, James and John along with him, and he began to be deeply distressed and troubled.
33.cmn: 於是帶着彼得、雅各、約翰同去，就驚恐起來，極其難過，
33.sry: Ka ru patupara tenian ti Petrusan, ti Yakobusan, ti Yoanesan, nimanaunamu mavulas, mahimko apa ta teni.

34.niv: “My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death,” he said to them. “Stay here and keep watch.”
34.cmn: 對他們說：「我心裏甚是憂傷，幾乎要死；你們在這裏等候，警醒。」
34.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Matarawug mavulas ta vati aw tu kidi ki kapatayan; itukwa hiya mahamawaga."

35.niv: Going a little farther, he fell to the ground and prayed that if possible the hour might pass from him.
35.cmn: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，禱告說：「倘若可行，便叫那時候過去。」
35.sry: Ka ru nimaawro matiting, nidmangus tu nay, makualilid ka hairu peylpugen, ka maliawraga tenian ta kidi ki tagley ka ana.

36.niv: “ Abba, Father,” he said, “everything is possible for you. Take this cup from me. Yet not what I will, but what you will.”
36.cmn: 他說：「阿爸！父啊！在你凡事都能；求你將這杯撤去。然而，不要從我的意思，只要從你的意思。」
36.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni, "Aba, Rama, peylpugen imhuan imid ki mamang, hamiaw yawan ta hawug ka ata. Ra asi kumahina ka kamuyen aw, kuma apa hina ka kamuyen hu."

37.niv: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. “Simon,” he said to Peter, “are you asleep? Couldnʼt you keep watch for one hour?
37.cmn: 耶穌回來，見他們睡着了，就對彼得說：「西門，你睡覺嗎？不能警醒片時嗎？
37.sry: Ka du mukwa ta teni, nikabaley tin ta patawtawugan ka mirip, ka nikuma ti Petrusan, "Simon mirip kaw kawa? Asi kaw kawa palpug mahamawaga tu saat ki tagley?

38.niv: Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
38.cmn: 總要警醒禱告，免得入了迷惑。你們心靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。」
38.sry: Nda mahamawaga makualilida, ka asi umi ukwaey tu repungan. Masurol ta yupan, ra masakit ta vaat."

39.niv: Once more he went away and prayed the same thing.
39.cmn: 耶穌又去禱告，說的話還是與先前一樣，
39.sry: Ka du mila nimukwa ta teni, nimakualilid, ka matagila ki su ra.

40.niv: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy. They did not know what to say to him.
40.cmn: 又來見他們睡着了，因為他們的眼睛甚是困倦；他們也不知道怎麼回答。
40.sry: Ka du mukwa ta teni, mila kumabaley nenian ka mirip, aley ka uhang marisig ta mata nein ka asi nein umhaen kamang ka matagivlia tenian.

41.niv: Returning the third time, he said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Enough! The hour has come. Look, the Son of Man is delivered into the hands of sinners.
41.cmn: 第三次來，對他們說：「現在你們仍然睡覺安歇吧！夠了，時候到了。看哪，人子被賣在罪人手裏了。
41.sry: Iru ka irua ato ta teni tu ka taturu ki kidi, nikuma nenian, "Smasinipa smakilikug ki mangahar peyhababa? Mamsinga ato! Irua lato ta kidi ki tagley. Kitaey, paatununaw ta Alak ki kagulung tu rima ki tamakavaraw.

42.niv: Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”
42.cmn: 起來！我們走吧。看哪，那賣我的人近了！ 」 耶穌被捕 （太26‧47－56；路22‧47－53；約18‧3－12）
42.sry: Matimawaga gapit, ukwaey mita. Kitaey, mutuk ato ta simhamha yawan."

43.niv: Just as he was speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, appeared. With him was a crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests, the teachers of the law, and the elders.
43.cmn: 說話之間，忽然那十二個門徒裏的猶大來了，並有許多人帶着刀棒，從祭司長和文士並長老那裏與他同來。
43.sry: Ka madis du masusu apa ta teni, niirua ta ti Yudas ka saat ki sat kitian ab ki ruha, ka tulam tenian ta kalawaan ka irang ka meykwa ki tiraw ki vavuvukbuk, ka nipadingien ki tamapigik ka sibavaw, ki makusasulat, ki mamumu.

44.niv: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The one I kiss is the man; arrest him and lead him away under guard.”
44.cmn: 賣耶穌的人曾給他們一個暗號，說：「我與誰親嘴，誰就是他。你們把他拿住，牢牢靠靠地帶去。」
44.sry: Ka teni ka sivanavana tenian, nipukidi nenian, kuma, "Teni ka baigaw maw, teni ta ti ana, tmurunga tenian, patagipanag hmamia kading tenian."

45.niv: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, “Rabbi!” and kissed him.
45.cmn: 猶大來了，隨即到耶穌跟前，說：「拉比」，便與他親嘴。
45.sry: Ka ru irua ato madis mukwa tenian, nikun tin, "Rabi," ka nibaig tenian.

46.niv: The men seized Jesus and arrested him.
46.cmn: 他們就下手拿住他。
46.sry: Anata niatahalapen nein ta rima tenian, ka nitmurung apa tenian.

47.niv: Then one of those standing near drew his sword and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
47.cmn: 旁邊站着的人，有一個拔出刀來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他一個耳朵。
47.sry: Ka saat nenian ka mituko hina, ta nilmugut ki tiraw, ka nimapihit ki kuncia ki dadilug, tubo ki tangira tin.

48.niv: “Am I leading a rebellion,” said Jesus, “that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me?
48.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「你們帶着刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜嗎？
48.sry: Ka ru matagivli ta ti Yesus, nikuma nenian, "Nitawpapanag kamu mama ki mukwaa ki tamalpug, ki tiraw ki vavuvukbuk, aley ki turungaw umi yawan?

49.niv: Every day I was with you, teaching in the temple courts, and you did not arrest me. But the Scriptures must be fulfilled.”
49.cmn: 我天天教訓人，同你們在殿裏，你們並沒有拿我。但這事成就，為要應驗經上的話。」
49.sry: Wagiwagi nimakuisal ko imumian matawtawug tu kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, ka asi kamu nitmurung yawan. Ra kumahina ka pavawutaw ta na Sasulat."

50.niv: Then everyone deserted him and fled.
50.cmn: 門徒都離開他，逃走了。 逃走的少年人
50.sry: Ka du paikakwa tenian ta neni, niilput ta neni.

51.niv: A young man, wearing nothing but a linen garment, was following Jesus. When they seized him,
51.cmn: 有一個少年人，赤身披着一塊麻布，跟隨耶穌，眾人就捉拿他。
51.sry: Ka nismaladilug tenian ta sasat ka kawparag ki ayt ka ripirip ki vual tin ka manana. Ka ru nitmurung tenian ta kawpaparag,

52.niv: he fled naked, leaving his garment behind.
52.sry: ka du paitukakwa ki atakwaan ki ayt ka ripirip, niilput ta teni nenian.

53.niv: They took Jesus to the high priest, and all the chief priests, the elders and the teachers of the law came together.
53.cmn: 他們把耶穌帶到大祭司那裏，又有眾祭司長和長老並文士都來和大祭司一同聚集。
53.sry: Ka niaden nein ta ti Yesus paukwa tenian ki dadilug ka sibavaw, ka nimawisal ato tenian ta imid ki tamapigik ka sibavaw, ki mamumu, ki makusasulat apa.

54.niv: Peter followed him at a distance, right into the courtyard of the high priest. There he sat with the guards and warmed himself at the fire.
54.cmn: 彼得遠遠地跟着耶穌，一直進入大祭司的院裏，和差役一同坐在火光裏烤火。
54.sry: Ka niitudalia ituawug tenian ta ti Petrus, tu kidi apa ki glaf ki dadilug. Ka nimilam mirung ki makwa, pakalado tenian ki apuy.

55.niv: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death, but they did not find any.
55.cmn: 祭司長和全公會尋找見證控告耶穌，要治死他，卻尋不着。
55.sry: Ka tamapigik ka sibavaw ki na pakuisalan apa ta nikmiim ki su ka patagihailen sihaharang tu duma ti Yesusan, aley ki pakapatayaw nein tenian, ra asi nein pakivaleyen.

56.niv: Many testified falsely against him, but their statements did not agree.
56.cmn: 因為有好些人作假見證告他，只是他們的見證各不相合。
56.sry: Ka mabatung ta nimatagihail matagiduma tenian, ka asi maawakla ta patagihailen nein.

57.niv: Then some stood up and gave this false testimony against him:
57.cmn: 又有幾個人站起來作假見證告他，說：
57.sry: Ka ru nigapit ta raruma, nimatagihail matagiduma tenian, kuma,

58.niv: “We heard him say, ‘I will destroy this temple made with human hands and in three days will build another, not made with hands.’ ”
58.cmn: 「我們聽見他說：『我要拆毀這人手所造的殿，三日內就另造一座不是人手所造的。』」
58.sry: "Nimilingig kame tenian ka pasusuen tin," "Kutagaw maw ta Kuva ka ata ka nipeyringey ki rima ki tau, ka tu tuturu ki wagi peylikugaw maw ta pani ka asi nipeyringey ki rima."

59.niv: Yet even then their testimony did not agree.
59.cmn: 他們就是這麼作見證，也是各不相合。
59.sry: Ka asi apa maawakla ta patagihailan nein ki su.

60.niv: Then the high priest stood up before them and asked Jesus, “Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?”
60.cmn: 大祭司起來站在中間，問耶穌說：「你甚麼都不回答嗎？這些人作見證告你的是甚麼呢？」
60.sry: Ka nimituko ta Dadilug ka Sibavaw tu tukad nein, ka nitmalig ti Yesusan, kuma, "Ausi kaw ki matagivli ki su? Kamang ta patagihailen nein matagiduma imhuan?"

61.niv: But Jesus remained silent and gave no answer. Again the high priest asked him, “Are you the Messiah, the Son of the Blessed One?”
61.cmn: 耶穌卻不言語，一句也不回答。大祭司又問他說：「你是那當稱頌者的兒子基督不是？」
61.sry: Ra teni ta nimeypat, ka asi nimatagivli ki mamang. Nitmawkila tmalig tenian ta Dadilug ka Sibavaw, kuma tenian, "Ti Kristus kaw kawa, ka Alak ki Alid ka pakariyangey?"

62.niv: “I am,” said Jesus. “And you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.”
62.cmn: 耶穌說：「我是。你們必看見人子坐在那權能者的右邊，駕着天上的雲降臨。」
62.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus, "Ti yaw ka ata, ka kmitaa kamu ki Alak ki kagulung tu irungey tin tu uwal ki kailgan ki Alid ru iruaa tu purarey ki vulum."

63.niv: The high priest tore his clothes. “Why do we need any more witnesses?” he asked.
63.cmn: 大祭司就撕開衣服，說：「我們何必再用見證人呢？
63.sry: Anata nikhit ta dadilug ki kuvar tin, ka nikuma, "Mang ta mayaapo kita ki patagihailen?

64.niv: “You have heard the blasphemy. What do you think?” They all condemned him as worthy of death.
64.cmn: 你們已經聽見他這僭妄的話了。你們的意見如何？」他們都定他該死的罪。
64.sry: Niilingigen umi ta barugan: kamang ta purarig umi?" Ka nidmungdung ta neni tenian ki pakapapatapatay.

65.niv: Then some began to spit at him; they blindfolded him, struck him with their fists, and said, “Prophesy!” And the guards took him and beat him.
65.cmn: 就有人吐唾沫在他臉上，又蒙着他的臉，用拳頭打他，對他說：「你說預言吧！」差役接過他來，用手掌打他。 彼得三次不認主 （太26‧69－75；路22‧56－62；約18‧15－18，25－27）
65.sry: Ka nimataginaunamu ta raruma madipag tenian, ka nipakahalap ki vulung tin, ka nibukbuken nein ki na kumud tenian, kuma tenian, "Matagitan ato." Ka mad ta kmakading tenian ka bukbuken nein tenian.

66.niv: While Peter was below in the courtyard, one of the servant girls of the high priest came by.
66.cmn: 彼得在下邊院子裏；來了大祭司的一個使女，
66.sry: Ka tu urarboen ta ti Petrus ki tatalagan, niirua ta saat ka ina ka pairungen ki Dadilug ka Sibavaw.

67.niv: When she saw Peter warming himself, she looked closely at him. “You also were with that Nazarene, Jesus,” she said.
67.cmn: 見彼得烤火，就看着他，說：「你素來也是同拿撒勒人耶穌一夥的。」
67.sry: Ka ru kitaan tin ti Petrusan, ka mihalap mararaw tenian, nimasatatimi tenian, ka nikuma, "Nimakuilam apa kaw ta imhu ti Yesusan ka tagiNazareth."

68.niv: But he denied it. “I donʼt know or understand what youʼre talking about,” he said, and went out into the entryway.
68.cmn: 彼得卻不承認，說：「我不知道，也不明白你說的是甚麼。」於是出來，到了前院， 雞就叫了。
68.sry: Ra nilala ta teni, kuma, "Asi maw kalangen, asi maw umhaen mang ta su oho." Ka ru nitawpapanag tu ngataf ki glaf da, ka nimuni ta tafuka.

69.niv: When the servant girl saw him there, she said again to those standing around, “This fellow is one of them.”
69.cmn: 那使女看見他，又對旁邊站着的人說：「這也是他們一黨的。」
69.sry: Ka du ararawen tenian ta ina ka pairungen, nimataginaunamu kuma nenian ka mituko hina, "Ti ata ta na lam tin."

70.niv: Again he denied it. After a little while, those standing near said to Peter, “Surely you are one of them, for you are a Galilean.”
70.cmn: 彼得又不承認。過了不多的時候，旁邊站着的人又對彼得說：「你真是他們一黨的！因為你是加利利人。」
70.sry: Ka nimila rmaw ta teni. Ka madalia ki ana, neni ka mituko hina ta nimatagila kuma ti Petrusan, "Mising imhu ta na lam apa nein, ka maka Galilaya kaw, ka pakalang ato ki ingaw oho."

71.niv: He began to call down curses, and he swore to them, “I donʼt know this man youʼre talking about.”
71.cmn: 彼得就發咒起誓地說：「我不認得你們說的這個人。」
71.sry: Anata nimanaunamu makuavavag tenian pakariherihe apa ki su, "Asi maw kalangen ta tau ka ana ka pasusuen umi."

72.niv: Immediately the rooster crowed the second time. Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken to him: “Before the rooster crows twice you will disown me three times.” And he broke down and wept.
72.cmn: 立時雞叫了第二遍。彼得想起耶穌對他所說的話：「雞叫兩遍以先，你要三次不認我。」思想起來，就哭了。
72.sry: Ka tu kararuha nimuni ta tafuka. Ka nihmibaley ta ti Petrus ki na su ka nipasusuen ti Yesus tenian, "Tuturu ki uniey ki tafuka, sawturula kaw dmaw yawan." Ka ru pagdumdum ki ata, nivavulas ki rig tin nitmangitangi.

1.niv: Very early in the morning, the chief priests, with the elders, the teachers of the law and the whole Sanhedrin, made their plans. So they bound Jesus, led him away and handed him over to Pilate.
1.cmn: 一到早晨，祭司長和長老、文士、全公會的人大家商議，就把耶穌捆綁，解去交給彼拉多。
1.sry: Iru ka madama ato du matakung, nimatagisaal matagikipu ki su ta tamapigik ka sibavaw ki mamumu, ki makusasulat, imid apa ki pakuisalan. Ka nibawut ti Yesusan, niaden nein padarang ka nipaatunun tenian ti Pilatusan.

2.niv: “Are you the king of the Jews?” asked Pilate. “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
2.cmn: 彼拉多問他說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」耶穌回答說：「你說的是。」
2.sry: Ka nitmalig tenian ta ti Pilatus, "Meysasu kaw kawa ka Sibavaw ki Yoden?" Ka nimatagivli ta teni kuma tenian, "Matagimising kaw."

3.niv: The chief priests accused him of many things.
3.cmn: 祭司長告他許多的事。
3.sry: Ka nipatbarawen ta madag ki mamang ki Tamapigik ka Sibavaw tenian: ra asi tin patagivlien ta mamang.

4.niv: So again Pilate asked him, “Arenʼt you going to answer? See how many things they are accusing you of.”
4.cmn: 彼拉多又問他說：「你看，他們告你這麼多的事，你甚麼都不回答嗎？」
4.sry: Ka nitmawkila ta ti Pilatus tmalig tenian, kuma, "Asi kaw kawa patagivlien ki su? Kitaey papina ta patagihail nein sadaduma imhuan."

5.niv: But Jesus still made no reply, and Pilate was amazed.
5.cmn: 耶穌仍不回答，以致彼拉多覺得希奇。 耶穌被判死刑 （太27‧ 15－26；路23‧13－25；約18‧39－19‧16）
5.sry: Ra asi nimatagivli ta ti Yesus ki mamang, kumahina ka nimuringaw ta ti Pilatus.

6.niv: Now it was the custom at the festival to release a prisoner whom the people requested.
6.cmn: 每逢這節期，巡撫照眾人所求的，釋放一個囚犯給他們。
6.sry: Ka na kidi ki kadagamen tu uvavatugan ka ana maawmia ki tagisu ta niusangat nenian, timamang lava ka kamuyen nein da.

7.niv: A man called Barabbas was in prison with the insurrectionists who had committed murder in the uprising.
7.cmn: 有一個人名叫巴拉巴，和作亂的人一同捆綁。他們作亂的時候，曾殺過人。
7.sry: Ka niakumeya hina ta saat ka nanang tin ka ti Barabas, ka niatalagan lam nenian ka nitulam tenian tu karakarakan, ka nipakapatay tu karakarakan da.

8.niv: The crowd came up and asked Pilate to do for them what he usually did.
8.cmn: 眾人上去求巡撫，照常例給他們辦。
8.sry: Ka ru makulig ki ingaw ta makuilalawlaw nimataginaunamu tmumimia tenian pamut ki na ringey tin nenian.

9.niv: “Do you want me to release to you the king of the Jews?” asked Pilate,
9.cmn: 彼拉多說：「你們要我釋放猶太人的王給你們嗎？」
9.sry: Ra nimatagivli nenian ta ti Pilatus, kuma, "Mamuy kamu kawa ka awmiaw maw kamu ta Meysasu ka Sibavaw ki Yoden?"

10.niv: knowing it was out of self-interest that the chief priests had handed Jesus over to him.
10.cmn: 他原曉得，祭司長是因為嫉妒才把耶穌解了來。
10.sry: Ra kavanen tin ka nipaatununen ta teni ki Tamapigik ka Sibavaw aley ki gaasan tenian.

11.niv: But the chief priests stirred up the crowd to have Pilate release Barabbas instead.
11.cmn: 只是祭司長挑唆眾人，寧可釋放巴拉巴給他們。
11.sry: Ra nipatumumha ta tamapigik ka sibavaw ki makuilalawlaw, ka awmiaw nein sivanavanaa nenian ta ti Barabas.

12.niv: “What shall I do, then, with the one you call the king of the Jews?” Pilate asked them.
12.cmn: 彼拉多又說：「那麼樣，你們所稱為猶太人的王，我怎麼辦他呢？」
12.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Pilatus mila, kuma nenian, "Mang ta kamuyen umi ka pamutaw maw tenian ka pananangen umi ka Meysasu ka Sibavaw ki Yoden?"

13.niv: “Crucify him!” they shouted.
13.cmn: 他們又喊着說：「把他釘十字架！」
13.sry: Ka nimakulig ta neni mila makuimid, "Punavavaraga tenian."

14.niv: “Why? What crime has he committed?” asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify him!”
14.cmn: 彼拉多說：「為甚麼呢？他做了甚麼惡事呢？」他們便極力地喊着說：「把他釘十字架！」
14.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Pilatus nenian, "Kamang ta na varaw tin?" Ka pakusaten nein makutun, "punavavaraga tenian!"

15.niv: Wanting to satisfy the crowd, Pilate released Barabbas to them. He had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.
15.cmn: 彼拉多要叫眾人喜悅，就釋放巴拉巴給他們，將耶穌鞭打了，交給人釘十字架。 兵丁戲弄耶穌 （太27‧27－31；約19‧2－3）
15.sry: Iru ka mamuy kmiim ki makuilalawlaw ta ti Pilatus, niataral nenian ta ti Barabas, ra nipaatununen ti Yesusan, du nipatawbawrig smaplat tenian, tu punavavaragey tenian.

16.niv: The soldiers led Jesus away into the palace (that is, the Praetorium) and called together the whole company of soldiers.
16.cmn: 兵丁把耶穌帶進衙門院裏，叫齊了全營的兵。
16.sry: Ka nimad tenian ta tamamacit paukwa tu papamamagan ki talag ki kairangan, ka tmaam ta neni papaisal ta makuitatumuk ki tamamacit makuimid da.

17.niv: They put a purple robe on him, then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on him.
17.cmn: 他們給他穿上紫袍，又用荊棘編做冠冕給他戴上，
17.sry: Ka nipapakulamug tenian ki na patag ki kulamug ka mameyapuy, ka niritungen ta sakiru ki na adum, nipakaatahalapen nein tu vungo tin.

18.niv: And they began to call out to him, “Hail, king of the Jews!”
18.cmn: 就慶賀他說：「恭喜，猶太人的王啊！」
18.sry: Ka nimanaunamu makualilid tenian, "Tabe, Meysasu ka Sibavaw ki Yoden."

19.niv: Again and again they struck him on the head with a staff and spit on him. Falling on their knees, they paid homage to him.
19.cmn: 又拿一根葦子打他的頭，吐唾沫在他臉上，屈膝拜他。
19.sry: Ka nivulat tu vungo tin ki angto, ka nimadipag tenian, ka ru matalikurug, nireip tenian.

20.niv: And when they had mocked him, they took off the purple robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him out to crucify him.
20.cmn: 戲弄完了，就給他脫了紫袍，仍穿上他自己的衣服，帶他出去，要釘十字架。 耶穌被釘十字架 （太27‧32－44；路23‧26－43；約19‧17－27）
20.sry: Iru ka nibilavila tenian, niawmien nein ta kulamug ki na patag ka mameyapuy, ka nipapagkulamug nein ki nipamamien tin, ka niad nein tu punavavaragey tenian.

21.niv: A certain man from Cyrene, Simon, the father of Alexander and Rufus, was passing by on his way in from the country, and they forced him to carry the cross.
21.cmn: 有一個古利奈人西門，就是亞歷山大和魯孚的父親，從鄉下來，經過那地方，他們就勉強他同去，好背着耶穌的十字架。
21.sry: Ka niigareyen nein paaval ki vual ka ti Simon ka maka Kurenay, ka ukwa halidaw hina maka purug, ka raraman ti Alexander ti Rufus apa, ka paaval ki navavarag tin.

22.niv: They brought Jesus to the place called Golgotha (which means “the place of the skull”).
22.cmn: 他們帶耶穌到了各各他地方（各各他翻出來就是髑髏地），
22.sry: Iru ka ana nimad tenian paukwa tu itukwaan ka Golgota, ka siuwa itukwaan ki toktok.

23.niv: Then they offered him wine mixed with myrrh, but he did not take it.
23.cmn: 拿沒藥調和的酒給耶穌，他卻不受。
23.sry: Ka nipait tenian ki hala ki karawmata ka na hurad ki Mirhe, ra niinang mit.

24.niv: And they crucified him. Dividing up his clothes, they cast lots to see what each would get.
24.cmn: 於是將他釘在十字架上，拈鬮分他的衣服，看是誰得甚麼。
24.sry: Iru ka nipunavavarag tenian, nipatatag nein ta kulamug tin ki na pakyaw ka kamang ato ta araey timamang.

25.niv: It was nine in the morning when they crucified him.
25.cmn: 釘他在十字架上是巳初的時候。
25.sry: Ka kidi ato ki kataturu ki tagley, ka nipunavavarag nein tenian.

26.niv: The written notice of the charge against him read: The King of the Jews.
26.cmn: 在上面有他的罪狀，寫的是：「猶太人的王。」
26.sry: Ka nisulaten tin ta na paahahalap ki nialeyen patbaraw tenian, 'Ta Meysasu ka Sibavaw ki Yoden.'

27.niv: They crucified two rebels with him, one on his right and one on his left.
27.cmn: 他們又把兩個強盜和他同釘十字架，一個在右邊，一個在左邊。
27.sry: Ka nipunavavarag tenian punavavarag ta raruha ki tamalpug, tu uwal ta sasat, tu ugi ta sasat.

28.sry: Ka nipavutaw ta na Sasulat, ka kuma, "Ka nipatumumhaen pamut ki tamalpug."

29.niv: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads and saying, “So! You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days,
29.cmn: 從那裏經過的人辱罵他，搖着頭說：「咳！你這拆毀聖殿、三日又建造起來的，
29.sry: Ka neni ka hmarivat, nimakuavavag tenian bikbik ki vungo nein, kuma, "Aley imhu ka kuta kaw ki kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, ka meylikug meyringey ki ana tu tuturu ki wagi:

30.niv: come down from the cross and save yourself!”
30.cmn: 可以救自己，從十字架上下來吧！」
30.sry: Nda hamiaw imhuan, ka murarima ki na vavarag."

31.niv: In the same way the chief priests and the teachers of the law mocked him among themselves. “He saved others,” they said, “but he canʼt save himself!
31.cmn: 祭司長和文士也是這樣戲弄他，彼此說：「他救了別人，不能救自己。
31.sry: Makawlawla kumahina ta tamapigik ka sibavaw ki su ki makusasulat matagisal matagitavatavag, "Nihamien tin ta raruma, ka asi maawlpug maawmado hmamia tenian mamado.

32.niv: Let this Messiah, this king of Israel, come down now from the cross, that we may see and believe.” Those crucified with him also heaped insults on him.
32.cmn: 以色列的王基督，現在可以從十字架上下來，叫我們看見，就信了。」那和他同釘的人也是譏誚他。 耶穌的死 （太27‧45－56；路23‧44－49；約19‧28－30）
32.sry: Nda murarima hinin ta ti Kristus ka Meysasu ka Sibavaw ki Israel ki na vavarag, aley ka kmita kame ka tnamisinga kame." Ka neni ka nipulam tenian punavavarag, nimakuavavag tenian.

33.niv: At noon, darkness came over the whole land until three in the afternoon.
33.cmn: 從午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。
33.sry: Iru ka irua ato ta ka anim ki tagley, niaku karumduman ka mitatumuk tu imid ki purug tu kidi apa ki kamamatuda ki tagley.

34.niv: And at three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eloi, Eloi, lema sabachthani?” (which means “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”).
34.cmn: 申初的時候，耶穌大聲喊着說：「以羅伊！以羅伊！拉馬撒巴各大尼？」（翻出來就是：我的上帝！我的上帝！為甚麼離棄我？）
34.sry: Ka mahivat ato ki kamamatuda ki tagley, nimakulangag ta ti Yesus ki ingaw ka irang, kuma, "Eli, Eli, Lama Sabagtani," ka inaakwaaney,"Alid aw, Alid aw, kaumang ka nidmarang kaw paitusat yawan?"

35.niv: When some of those standing near heard this, they said, “Listen, heʼs calling Elijah.”
35.cmn: 旁邊站着的人，有的聽見就說：「看哪，他叫以利亞呢！」
35.sry: Ka raruma ka mituko hina, ru ilingigen nein ta ata, ta nikuma, 'Kitaey, tmataam ti Eliyasan ta teni.'

36.niv: Someone ran, filled a sponge with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink. “Now leave him alone. Letʼs see if Elijah comes to take him down,” he said.
36.cmn: 有一個人跑去，把海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在葦子上，送給他喝，說：「且等着，看以利亞來不來把他取下。」
36.sry: Ka sasat ta nisium, ka nimatmuy ki purut ki hala ka mapingit, ka ru nihma tu angto, nipaiten tin tenian, kuma, "Pasikunungaw, kitaey mita, malava ka iruaa ta ti Eliyas hmamia tenian."

37.niv: With a loud cry, Jesus breathed his last.
37.cmn: 耶穌大聲喊叫，氣就斷了。
37.sry: Ka du makulangag ki ingaw ka irang ta ti Yesus, nimitaraug ki hinawa.

38.niv: The curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom.
38.cmn: 殿裏的幔子從上到下裂為兩半。
38.sry: Ka nipapuduha ta varit ka kuvar ki kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, makavavaw tu kidi apa ka tu rarim.

39.niv: And when the centurion, who stood there in front of Jesus, saw how he died, he said, “Surely this man was the Son of God!”
39.cmn: 對面站着的百夫長看見耶穌這樣喊叫斷氣，就說：「這人真是上帝的兒子！」
39.sry: Nda iru ka nikitaan ki meysasu ki sat kaatugan ki vual ka mituko itu duma tenian ka makulangag kumahina ta teni, mupanag ki hinawa, nikuma, "Mising Alak ki Alid ta ti ata."

40.niv: Some women were watching from a distance. Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James the younger and of Joseph, and Salome.
40.cmn: 還有些婦女遠遠地觀看；內中有抹大拉的馬利亞，又有小雅各和約西的母親馬利亞，並有撒羅米，
40.sry: Ka niayakwa hina ta inaina ka matawtawag mararaw, ka ayatamawug nenian ta ti Maria Magdalene, ta ti Maria ka ti Yakobus ka usising, ti Yoses apa, ti Salome apa,

41.niv: In Galilee these women had followed him and cared for his needs. Many other women who had come up with him to Jerusalem were also there.
41.cmn: 就是耶穌在加利利的時候，跟隨他、服事他的那些人，還有同耶穌上耶路撒冷的好些婦女在那裏觀看。 耶穌的安葬 （太27‧57－61；路23‧50－56；約19‧38－42）
41.sry: ka nismaladilug ta inaina ka ata nisikwaen nein tenian, du ayakwa apa tenian tu Galilaya, ki mabatung apa ka inaina ka pani ka nisabavaw lam tenian mukwa tu Yerusalem.

42.niv: It was Preparation Day (that is, the day before the Sabbath). So as evening approached,
42.cmn: 到了晚上，因為這是預備日，就是安息日的前一日，
42.sry: Ka ru madung ato, aley ka sitatanangen ta ana, ka tu wagi ka uru ki pahihababan,

43.niv: Joseph of Arimathea, a prominent member of the Council, who was himself waiting for the kingdom of God, went boldly to Pilate and asked for Jesusʼ body.
43.cmn: 有亞利馬太的約瑟前來，他是尊貴的議士，也是等候上帝國的。他放膽進去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體；
43.sry: Niirua ta ti Yoses ka maka Arimatea, ka Meysasu ka sibavaw ki kidi, ka kmita apa ta teni ki Peysasuan ki Alid, ka nimurbo mukwa ti Pilatusan, ka nitmimien tin ta vual ti Yesus.

44.niv: Pilate was surprised to hear that he was already dead. Summoning the centurion, he asked him if Jesus had already died.
44.cmn: 彼拉多詫異耶穌已經死了，便叫百夫長來，問他耶穌死了久不久。
44.sry: Ka nimukiap ta ti Pilatus, ka nimapatay ato ta teni; ka ru nitataam ki meysasu ki sat kaatugan ki vual nitmalig tenian, malava ka nimapatay ato ta teni.

45.niv: When he learned from the centurion that it was so, he gave the body to Joseph.
45.cmn: 既從百夫長得知實情，就把耶穌的屍首賜給約瑟。
45.sry: Iru ka nimumha ato ki na meysasu ki sat kaatugan, nipahatunun tin ti Yosesan ta vual.

46.niv: So Joseph bought some linen cloth, took down the body, wrapped it in the linen, and placed it in a tomb cut out of rock. Then he rolled a stone against the entrance of the tomb.
46.cmn: 約瑟買了細麻布，把耶穌取下來，用細麻布裹好，安放在磐石中鑿出來的墳墓裏，又滾過一塊石頭來擋住墓門。
46.sry: Ka nipeyla ta ti Yoses ki ayt ka maganig, niara tin pukwa tu rarim tenian, ka nitmupu ki ayt ka ana, ka niatakwaen tin tenian tu ravak ka nikutaen tu vato, ka nirikilen tin ta vato tu ngataf ki ravak.

47.niv: Mary Magdalene and Mary the mother of Joseph saw where he was laid.
47.cmn: 抹大拉的馬利亞和約西的母親馬利亞都看見安放他的地方。
47.sry: Ka nikitaan ti Maria Magdalene, ti Maria apa ka ti ina ti Yoses ta niatakwaan tenian.

1.niv: When the Sabbath was over, Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James, and Salome bought spices so that they might go to anoint Jesusʼ body.
1.cmn: 過了安息日，抹大拉的馬利亞和雅各的母親馬利亞並撒羅米，買了香膏要去膏耶穌的身體。
1.sry: Iru ka nitawkwa ato ta wagi ki pahihababan, ti Maria Magdalene, ti Maria ka rarenan ti Yakobus, ti Salome apa ta nipeyla ki uru ka mavangug, aley ka mukwaa ta neni tigbulu tenian.

2.niv: Very early on the first day of the week, just after sunrise, they were on their way to the tomb
2.cmn: 七日的第一日清早，出太陽的時候，她們來到墳墓那裏，
2.sry: Ka madama apa du matakung tu wagi ka naunamu ki kupta, niirua ta neni tu ravak ru nimutiag ta wagi.

3.niv: and they asked each other, “Who will roll the stone away from the entrance of the tomb?”
3.cmn: 彼此說：「誰給我們把石頭從墓門滾開呢？」
3.sry: Ka nimatagitavatavag ta neni ki su, "Timang ta irua lato imianan ka rikiley ta vato tu ngataf ki ravak?"

4.niv: But when they looked up, they saw that the stone, which was very large, had been rolled away.
4.cmn: 那石頭原來很大，她們抬頭一看，卻見石頭已經滾開了。
4.sry: Iru ka mararawa ta neni, nikitaan nein ka nirikilen ato ta vato, ka uhang irang ta ana.

5.niv: As they entered the tomb, they saw a young man dressed in a white robe sitting on the right side, and they were alarmed.
5.cmn: 她們進了墳墓，看見一個少年人坐在右邊，穿着白袍，就甚驚恐。
5.sry: Iru ka sararbo ki ravak, nikitaan nein ta kawpaparag ka mirung tu uwal ki kidi, ka mamia lato ki kuvar ka mapule, ka nimatakut ta neni.

6.niv: “Donʼt be alarmed,” he said. “You are looking for Jesus the Nazarene, who was crucified. He has risen! He is not here. See the place where they laid him.
6.cmn: 那少年人對她們說：「不要驚恐！你們尋找那釘十字架的拿撒勒人耶穌，他已經復活了，不在這裏。請看安放他的地方。
6.sry: Ra nikuma ta teni nenian, "ina matakut, kmiim kamu ti Yesusan ka maka Nazareth ka nipunavavaragen. Nipatimawagen ta teni, ausi ta teni hiya. Kitaey ta itukwaan ka niatakwaan nein tenian.

7.niv: But go, tell his disciples and Peter, ‘He is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him, just as he told you.’ ”
7.cmn: 你們可以去告訴他的門徒和彼得，說：『他在你們以先往加利利去。在那裏你們要見他，正如他從前所告訴你們的。』」
7.sry: Ra ukwaaw, vanavanaey ki patatawtawugan tin, ti Petrusan apa, ka siururo ta teni imumian mukwa tu Galilaya, tu hina kitaey umi ta teni, mama ki nipasusuen tin imumian."

8.niv: Trembling and bewildered, the women went out and fled from the tomb. They said nothing to anyone, because they were afraid.
8.cmn: 她們就出來，從墳墓那裏逃跑，又發抖又驚奇，甚麼也不告訴人，因為她們害怕。 向抹大拉的馬利亞顯現 （太28‧9－10；約20‧11－18）
8.sry: Ka madis nimupanag ta neni, niilput ta neni tu ravak, aley ka uhang ta neni ki uringawen. Ka asi nein nipasusuen ta mamang ki timamang, aley ka nimatakut ta neni.

9.niv: When Jesus rose early on the first day of the week, he appeared first to Mary Magdalene, out of whom he had driven seven demons.
9.cmn: 在七日的第一日清早，耶穌復活了，就先向抹大拉的馬利亞顯現（耶穌從她身上曾趕出七個鬼）。
9.sry: Iru ka nipatimawagen ta ti Yesus pagapit du madama apa tu wagi ka naunamu ki kupta, nimupanag siuro ti Maria Magdalene, ka nipadarangen tin ta pitu ki litu.

10.niv: She went and told those who had been with him and who were mourning and weeping.
10.cmn: 她去告訴那向來跟隨耶穌的人；那時他們正哀慟哭泣。
10.sry: Ka nimukwa ta teni ka banavana nenian ka nimakakwa tenian ka nimavulas tmangitangi apa ta neni.

11.niv: When they heard that Jesus was alive and that she had seen him, they did not believe it.
11.cmn: 他們聽見耶穌活了，被馬利亞看見，卻是不信。 向兩個門徒顯現 （路24‧13－35）
11.sry: Ru ilingigen nein ka mawag ta ti Yesus, ka nikitaan tin ta teni, asi nitnamising ta neni.

12.niv: Afterward Jesus appeared in a different form to two of them while they were walking in the country.
12.cmn: 這事以後，門徒中間有兩個人往鄉下去。走路的時候，耶穌變了形像，向他們顯現。
12.sry: Siawug ki ana nipakita ta ti Yesus tu pani ki haway ki raruha nenian ru nimunonang ta neni ka nimukwa tu purug.

13.niv: These returned and reported it to the rest; but they did not believe them either.
13.cmn: 他們就去告訴其餘的門徒；其餘的門徒也是不信。 門徒奉差遣 （太28‧16－20；路24‧36－49；約20‧19－23；徒1‧6－8）
13.sry: Ka nimukwa ta neni, ka gnawen nein ta ata ki raruma, ra asi nitnamising ta neni nenian.

14.niv: Later Jesus appeared to the Eleven as they were eating; he rebuked them for their lack of faith and their stubborn refusal to believe those who had seen him after he had risen.
14.cmn: 後來，十一個門徒坐席的時候，耶穌向他們顯現，責備他們不信，心裏剛硬，因為他們不信那些在他復活以後看見他的人。
14.sry: Siawug ki ana nimupanag ta teni ki sat kitian ab ki sat du mirung ta neni mavok, ka nisingig nenian ki asi tnamisingan nein ki tihag ki tintin, aley ka asi nein nitnamising ta neni ka nikmita tenian tu siawug ki ana ka nigapit ato ta teni.

15.niv: He said to them, “Go into all the world and preach the gospel to all creation.
15.cmn: 他又對他們說：「你們往普天下去，傳福音給萬民聽。
15.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, "Ukwaaw tu imid ki nay, matasasu ki hagnaw ka mariyang tu imid ki nipeyringey da.

16.niv: Whoever believes and is baptized will be saved, but whoever does not believe will be condemned.
16.cmn: 信而受洗的，必然得救；不信的，必被定罪。
16.sry: Timamang ta tnamising ka awlugey, pakariyangaw ta teni; ra timamang ta asi tnamising, dungdungaw ta teni.

17.niv: And these signs will accompany those who believe: In my name they will drive out demons; they will speak in new tongues;
17.cmn: 信的人必有神蹟隨着他們，就是奉我的名趕鬼；說新方言；
17.sry: Ka siawug ta pukidian ka ata mukwa nenian ka tnamising: Tu nanang aw padarangen nein ta litu, pasusuen nein ta susu ka vahaw.

18.niv: they will pick up snakes with their hands; and when they drink deadly poison, it will not hurt them at all; they will place their hands on sick people, and they will get well.”
18.cmn: 手能拿蛇；若喝了甚麼毒物，也必不受害；手按病人，病人就必好了。」 耶穌升天 （路24‧50－53；徒1‧9－11）
18.sry: Hmaa lato ta neni ki vuyley, ka ru mit lava ki mamang ka pakapatay, asi hmahay pakaalam nenian ta ana: paitukwaa nein ta rima ki maalam, ka madarikaga ta neni.

19.niv: After the Lord Jesus had spoken to them, he was taken up into heaven and he sat at the right hand of God.
19.cmn: 主耶穌和他們說完了話，後來被接到天上，坐在上帝的右邊。
19.sry: Anata iru ka nimatagikaha ta Meyrang ka ti Yesus nenian, niara ta teni paukwa tu tunun ki vulum, ka nimirung tu uwal ki Alid.

20.niv: Then the disciples went out and preached everywhere, and the Lord worked with them and confirmed his word by the signs that accompanied it.
20.cmn: 門徒出去，到處宣傳福音。主和他們同工，用神蹟隨着，證實所傳的道。阿們！
20.sry: Nda nitawpapanag ta patawtawugan matagihail matasasu tu imid ki itukwaan, ka mapungas ta Meyrang nenian, ka patagihailen tin ta su ki pukidian ka ayalam maawug ki ana. Amen.

1.niv: This is the genealogy of Jesus the Messiah the son of David, the son of Abraham:
1.cmn: 亞伯拉罕的後裔，大衛的子孫，耶穌基督的家譜：
1.sry: Sulat ki kavuilan ti Yesus Kristus, ka na alak ti David, ka na alak ti Abraham.

2.niv: Abraham was the father of Isaac, Isaac the father of Jacob, Jacob the father of Judah and his brothers,
2.cmn: 亞伯拉罕生以撒；以撒生雅各；雅各生猶大和他的弟兄；
2.sry: Ti Abraham ta nipualak ti Isaakan. Ti Isaak ta nipualak ti Yakoban. Ti Yakob ta nipualak ti Yudaan, ki tagiapaparag apa tin da.

3.niv: Judah the father of Perez and Zerah, whose mother was Tamar, Perez the father of Hezron, Hezron the father of Ram,
3.cmn: 猶大從她瑪氏生法勒斯和謝拉；法勒斯生希斯崙；希斯崙生亞蘭；
3.sry: Ti Yudas ta nipualak na Faresan na Zaraan apa pukwa ti Tamaran. Ti Fares ta nipualak ti Esroman. Ti Esrom ta nipualak ti Araman.

4.niv: Ram the father of Amminadab, Amminadab the father of Nahshon, Nahshon the father of Salmon,
4.cmn: 亞蘭生亞米拿達；亞米拿達生拿順；拿順生撒門；
4.sry: Ti Aram ta nipualak ti Aminadaban. Ti Aminadab ta nipualak ti Naasonan. Ti Naason ta nipualak ti Salmonan.

5.niv: Salmon the father of Boaz, whose mother was Rahab, Boaz the father of Obed, whose mother was Ruth, Obed the father of Jesse,
5.cmn: 撒門從喇合氏生波阿斯；波阿斯從路得氏生俄備得；俄備得生耶西；
5.sry: Ti Salmon ta nipualak na Boosan pukwa ti Rahaban. Ti Boos ta nipualak na Obedan pukwa ti Rutan. Ti Obed ta nipualak ti Yesean.

6.niv: and Jesse the father of King David. David was the father of Solomon, whose mother had been Uriahʼs wife,
6.cmn: 耶西生大衛王。 大衛從烏利亞的妻子生所羅門；
6.sry: Ti Yese ta nipualak ti Davidan ka na meysasu ka sibavaw. Ti David ka na meysasu ta nipualak ti Salomonan pukwa tenian ka nikeya ti Uriyas.

7.niv: Solomon the father of Rehoboam, Rehoboam the father of Abijah, Abijah the father of Asa,
7.cmn: 所羅門生羅波安；羅波安生亞比雅；亞比雅生亞撒；
7.sry: Ti Salomon ta nipualak ti Roboaman. Ti Roboam ta nipualak ti Abiyaan. Ti Abiya ta nipualak ti Asaan.

8.niv: Asa the father of Jehoshaphat, Jehoshaphat the father of Jehoram, Jehoram the father of Uzziah,
8.cmn: 亞撒生約沙法；約沙法生約蘭；約蘭生烏西雅；
8.sry: Ti Asa ta nipualak ti Yosafatan. Ti Yosafat ta nipualak ti Yoraman. Ti Yoram ta nipualak ti Oziyasan.

9.niv: Uzziah the father of Jotham, Jotham the father of Ahaz, Ahaz the father of Hezekiah,
9.cmn: 烏西雅生約坦；約坦生亞哈斯；亞哈斯生希西家；
9.sry: Ti Oziyas ta nipualak ti Yoataman. Ti Yoatam ta nipualak ti Ahazan. Ti Ahaz ta nipualak ti Ezekiyasan.

10.niv: Hezekiah the father of Manasseh, Manasseh the father of Amon, Amon the father of Josiah,
10.cmn: 希西家生瑪拿西；瑪拿西生亞們；亞們生約西亞；
10.sry: patahabuneinTi Ezekiyas ta nipualak ti Manasesan. Ti Manases ta nipualak ti Amonan. Ti Amon ta nipualak ti Yosiyasan.

11.niv: and Josiah the father of Jeconiah and his brothers at the time of the exile to Babylon.
11.cmn: 百姓被遷到巴比倫的時候，約西亞生耶哥尼雅和他的弟兄。
11.sry: Ti Yosiyas ta nipualak ti Yekoniyasan, ki tagiapaparag apa tin tu tamang ki kidi ki takalaey pukwa tu Babilon.

12.niv: After the exile to Babylon: Jeconiah was the father of Shealtiel, Shealtiel the father of Zerubbabel,
12.cmn: 遷到巴比倫之後，耶哥尼雅生撒拉鐵；撒拉鐵生所羅巴伯；
12.sry: Tu awug apa ki nitakalan tu Babilon nipualak ta ti Yekoniyas ti Salatielan. Ti Salatiel ta nipualak ti Zorobabelan.

13.niv: Zerubbabel the father of Abihud, Abihud the father of Eliakim, Eliakim the father of Azor,
13.cmn: 所羅巴伯生亞比玉；亞比玉生以利亞敬；以利亞敬生亞所；
13.sry: Ti Zorobabel ta nipualak ti Abiyudan. Ti Abiyud ta nipualak ti Eliyakiman. Ti Eliyakim ta nipualak ti Azoran.

14.niv: Azor the father of Zadok, Zadok the father of Akim, Akim the father of Elihud,
14.cmn: 亞所生撒督；撒督生亞金；亞金生以律；
14.sry: Ti Azor ta nipualak ti Sadokan. Ti Sadok ta nipualak ti Akinan. Ti Akin ta nipualak ti Eliyudan.

15.niv: Elihud the father of Eleazar, Eleazar the father of Matthan, Matthan the father of Jacob,
15.cmn: 以律生以利亞撒；以利亞撒生馬但；馬但生雅各；
15.sry: Ti Eliyud ta nipualak ti Eleyazaran. Ti Eleyazar ta nipualak ti Matanan. Ti Matan ta nipualak ti Yakoban.

16.niv: and Jacob the father of Joseph, the husband of Mary, and Mary was the mother of Jesus who is called the Messiah.
16.cmn: 雅各生約瑟，就是馬利亞的丈夫。那稱為基督的耶穌是從馬利亞生的。
16.sry: Ti Yakob ta nipualak ti Yosefan, ka mukukwaa ti Mariaan, ka nipeyalak tin ta ti Yesus, ka pananangen ki siuwa ti Kristus.

17.niv: Thus there were fourteen generations in all from Abraham to David, fourteen from David to the exile to Babylon, and fourteen from the exile to the Messiah.
17.cmn: 這樣，從亞伯拉罕到大衛共有十四代；從大衛到遷至巴比倫的時候也有十四代；從遷至巴比倫的時候到基督又有十四代。 耶穌基督降生 （路2‧1－7）
17.sry: Anata imid ki kavuivuilan na Abraham tu kidi ti David, saat ato kitian ab ki pat ki kavuivuilan. Ka na David tu kidi ki takalaey pukwa tu Babilon saat ato kitian ab ki pat ki kavuivuilan da. Ka na takalan tu Babilon tu kidi ti Kristus, saat ato kitian ab ki pat ki kavuivuilan da.

18.niv: This is how the birth of Jesus the Messiah came about: His mother Mary was pledged to be married to Joseph, but before they came together, she was found to be pregnant through the Holy Spirit.
18.cmn: 耶穌基督降生的事記在下面：他母親馬利亞已經許配了約瑟，還沒有迎娶，馬利亞就從聖靈懷了孕。
18.sry: Ka nipeyalaken ti Yesus Kristusan ta na kuma ato hina; Iru ka nimaamamado masasahut ta ti Yosef ka pakakitiley ti Maria ka Rena tin ka asi apa nitayalam, niayavavaley ka aku kavuyen ta teni ki na Yupan ka Dilig Matiktik.

19.niv: Because Joseph her husband was faithful to the law, and yet did not want to expose her to public disgrace, he had in mind to divorce her quietly.
19.cmn: 她丈夫約瑟是個義人，不願意明明地羞辱她，想要暗暗地把她休了。
19.sry: Nda ti Yosef ka ukukwaaw tin, aley ka na matiktik ta teni, ka niinangen tin pakaamag pakangala tenian, nipurarig ki sawuzungen sawtauwag tenian.

20.niv: But after he had considered this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, “Joseph son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary home as your wife, because what is conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.
20.cmn: 正思念這事的時候，有主的使者向他夢中顯現，說：「大衛的子孫約瑟，不要怕！只管娶過你的妻子馬利亞來，因她所懷的孕是從聖靈來的。
20.sry: Hairu ka pagdimdimen tin ta ata; kitaey Tamagnaw ki Meyrang ta nimupanag tenian tu maling, ka nikuma; Yosef ka na alak ti David, ina matakut maya pukwa imhuan ti Mariaan ka tagawpawpawey moho: ka ata ka nikavuy tin, na Yupan ta ana ka Dilig Matiktik.

21.niv: She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins.”
21.cmn: 她將要生一個兒子，你要給他起名叫耶穌，因他要將自己的百姓從罪惡裏救出來。」
21.sry: Ka meyalaka ki alak ka parag, ka sakinanangey moho ta nananga tin Yesus, aley ka tamapakariyanga ki tau tin ki varaw nein.

22.niv: All this took place to fulfill what the Lord had said through the prophet:
22.cmn: 這一切的事成就是要應驗主藉先知所說的話，
22.sry: Ka nimamut ato ta mamang ka ata aley ka pavutaw ta na su ki Meyrang papatagitunun ki tamamatagitan, ka nikuma

23.niv: “The virgin will conceive and give birth to a son, and they will call him Immanuel” (which means “God with us”).
23.cmn: 說： 必有童女懷孕生子； 人要稱他的名為以馬內利。 （以馬內利翻出來就是「上帝與我們同在」。）
23.sry: Kitaey, akumeyaa ki kavuyen ta Tamatul ka asi uparagen, ka meyalaka ki alak ka parag, ka smakinananga kaw ki nanang tin, Emanuel, teni ki su du pahavirivirien tu lam imitan ta Alid.

24.niv: When Joseph woke up, he did what the angel of the Lord had commanded him and took Mary home as his wife.
24.cmn: 約瑟醒了，起來，就遵着主使者的吩咐把妻子娶過來；
24.sry: Iru ka nipatimawagen ta ti Yosef ki niiripen tin, niakwa tin mama ki na sikakidi ki Tamagnaw ki Meyrang tenian, ka nipaukwa tenian ki ukukwaaw tin.

25.niv: But he did not consummate their marriage until she gave birth to a son. And he gave him the name Jesus.
25.cmn: 只是沒有和她同房，等她生了兒子，就給他起名叫耶穌。
25.sry: Ka asi tin kalangen ta teni, tu kidi ki nipeykahaan tin meyalak ta alak tin ka singada, ka nismakinanang tenian ki nanang ka Yesus.

1.niv: After Jesus was born in Bethlehem in Judea, during the time of King Herod, Magi from the east came to Jerusalem
1.cmn: 當希律王的時候，耶穌生在猶太的伯利恆。有幾個博士從東方來到耶路撒冷，說：
1.sry: Nda hairu ka nipeyalak ta ti Yesus tu Bethlehem ka itu Yudea, tu wagi ki Meysasu ka Sibavaw ka ti Herodes; Kitaey nilumad ta Makuzazing pulilit ka nimakareya mukwa tu Yerusalem:

2.niv: and asked, “Where is the one who has been born king of the Jews? We saw his star when it rose and have come to worship him.”
2.cmn: 「那生下來作猶太人之王的在哪裏？我們在東方看見他的星，特來拜他。」
2.sry: Kun Tumang ta nipeyalak ka Sibavaw ka Meysasu ki Yoden? Ka nikitaan yan tagareya ta atatalingey tin, ka nilumad kame tu deipey tenian.

3.niv: When King Herod heard this he was disturbed, and all Jerusalem with him.
3.cmn: 希律王聽見了，就心裏不安；耶路撒冷合城的人也都不安。
3.sry: Iru ka niilingig ta ata ki Meysasu ka Sibavaw ka ti Herodes, miharafhaf ato ta teni ki sat kaumang apa ki Yerusalem tulam tenian.

4.niv: When he had called together all the peopleʼs chief priests and teachers of the law, he asked them where the Messiah was to be born.
4.cmn: 他就召齊了祭司長和民間的文士，問他們說：「基督當生在何處？」
4.sry: Ka ru nipapakuil tin imid ta Tamapigik ka Sibavaw ki makusasulat apa ki tau, nitmalig nenian, peyalakaw lava tumang ta ti Kristus?

5.niv: “In Bethlehem in Judea,” they replied, “for this is what the prophet has written:
5.cmn: 他們回答說：「在猶太的伯利恆。因為有先知記着，說：
5.sry: Ka nikuma ta neni tenian; tu Bethlehem, ka itu Yudea; ka niaya kumaan hina smulat ki matagitan

6.niv: “ ‘But you, Bethlehem, in the land of Judah, are by no means least among the rulers of Judah; for out of you will come a ruler who will shepherd my people Israel.’”
6.cmn: 猶大地的伯利恆啊， 你在猶大諸城中並不是最小的； 因為將來有一位君王要從你那裏出來， 牧養我以色列民。」
6.sry: Ka imhu Bethlehem ta purug ki Yuda, madagawa asi ausiausing kaw ki sibavaw dmilug Meysasu ki Yuda; Aley ka makakwaa imhuan mupanag ta tamadilug, ka kmadinga ki tautau ka Israel.

7.niv: Then Herod called the Magi secretly and found out from them the exact time the star had appeared.
7.cmn: 當下，希律暗暗地召了博士來，細問那星是甚麼時候出現的，
7.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nimakuuzung tmataam ki makusazing pulilit ka ana ta ti Herodes, nimungara nenian ki kidi ki niupanagen ki atatalingey nenian?

8.niv: He sent them to Bethlehem and said, “Go and search carefully for the child. As soon as you find him, report to me, so that I too may go and worship him.”
8.cmn: 就差他們往伯利恆去，說：「你們去仔細尋訪那小孩子，尋到了就來報信，我也好去拜他。」
8.sry: Ka ru madingidingi nenian tu Bethlehem, nikuma, udadarangaw makipungas kmiim aley ki raway, ka ru pakivaleyen umi ta teni, lmikuga hagnaw yawan, aley ka irua apa ko deip tenian.

9.niv: After they had heard the king, they went on their way, and the star they had seen when it rose went ahead of them until it stopped over the place where the child was.
9.cmn: 他們聽見王的話就去了。在東方所看見的那星忽然在他們前頭行，直行到小孩子的地方，就在上頭停住了。
9.sry: Neini ka ana du nitnakaha ato milingig ki Meysasu ka Sibavaw, nidmarang ato ra, Ka kitaey, ta atatalingey ka niararaw nein, tagareya, nitururu tawkwa nenian tu kidi apa ka ana, ka nitawkwa rikaw tu vavau ki itukwaan ki raway ra.

10.niv: When they saw the star, they were overjoyed.
10.cmn: 他們看見那星，就大大地歡喜；
10.sry: Iru ka kitaan nein ta atatalingey nda, nimaray ta neni ki karayen ka uhang irang.

11.niv: On coming to the house, they saw the child with his mother Mary, and they bowed down and worshiped him. Then they opened their treasures and presented him with gifts of gold, frankincense and myrrh.
11.cmn: 進了房子，看見小孩子和他母親馬利亞，就俯伏拜那小孩子，揭開寶盒，拿黃金、乳香、沒藥為禮物獻給他。
11.sry: Ka tu urarboen nein ki talag, nipakivaley nein ta raway lam ki rarenan tin ka ti Maria: ka tu padukluen nein, nireip tenian. Hairu ka niaawluben ta vangey nein, niad nein tenian ta hahoriuriu ka kim, litaw ka pa ato, litaw apa ka Mirha.

12.niv: And having been warned in a dream not to go back to Herod, they returned to their country by another route.
12.cmn: 博士因為在夢中被主指示不要回去見希律，就從別的路回本地去了。 逃往埃及
12.sry: Iru ka nipakusuen tu maling ka asi maawmuveyringa salikug ti Heroesan, nitawkwa tu pani ki darang mukua tu purug nein ra.

13.niv: When they had gone, an angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. “Get up,” he said, “take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt. Stay there until I tell you, for Herod is going to search for the child to kill him.”
13.cmn: 他們去後，有主的使者向約瑟夢中顯現，說：「起來！帶着小孩子同他母親逃往埃及，住在那裏，等我吩咐你；因為希律必尋找小孩子，要除滅他。」
13.sry: Iru ka nitawkwakaha dmarang ta neni, kitaey ta TamaGnaw ki Meyrang mupanag tu maling ti Yosefan, matagikumahina: Gapit tawkwaaw ta raway patugparaaw ta ti ina tin, iluputa mukwa tu Ehipten, ka itukwa apa hina ka vanavanaey maw kaw: ka kumaa lato hina ka kmiima ta ti Herodes ki raway, ki pakapatay tenian

14.niv: So he got up, took the child and his mother during the night and left for Egypt,
14.cmn: 約瑟就起來，夜間帶着小孩子和他母親往埃及去，
14.sry: Anata teni ru nipapatimawagen nimumara ki raway lam ki rarenan tin ka awvanan, ka nidmarang sakakwa Ehipten.

15.niv: where he stayed until the death of Herod. And so was fulfilled what the Lord had said through the prophet: “Out of Egypt I called my son.”
15.cmn: 住在那裏，直到希律死了。這是要應驗主藉先知所說的話，說：「我從埃及召出我的兒子來。」 屠殺男孩
15.sry: Ka niitukwa hina tu nik apatayen ti Herodes: aley ka pavawutaw ta na su ki Meyrang papatagitunun ki Matagitan, kun, nitmam aw ta alak aw tu Egypten.

16.niv: When Herod realized that he had been outwitted by the Magi, he was furious, and he gave orders to kill all the boys in Bethlehem and its vicinity who were two years old and under, in accordance with the time he had learned from the Magi.
16.cmn: 希律見自己被博士愚弄，就大大發怒，差人將伯利恆城裏並四境所有的男孩，照着他向博士仔細查問的時候，凡兩歲以裏的，都殺盡了。
16.sry: Iru ka kitaey ti Herodes, ka nisimhamha tenian ta makusazing pulilit, dumiaka uhang madadingit ta teni, ka ru nimadingidingi, nilpug ki imid ki raraway ka tu Bethlehem, tu imid apa ki karivirivil tin, ka maka ruha ki tawil ka makwa apa, na akakwan ki kidi ka nitmawkilimug ki makusazing puarara ka ana

17.niv: Then what was said through the prophet Jeremiah was fulfilled:
17.cmn: 這就應了先知耶利米的話，說：
17.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nipavutaw ta su ka na patagisasu ki Tamamatagitan ka ti Yeremiyas kun

18.niv: “A voice is heard in Ramah, weeping and great mourning, Rachel weeping for her children and refusing to be comforted, because they are no more.”
18.cmn: 在拉瑪聽見號咷大哭的聲音， 是拉結哭她兒女， 不肯受安慰， 因為他們都不在了。 從埃及回來
18.sry: Niilingigen tu Rama ta na rarungorungo, ta na tatangitangi ki na rareyreying apa ka madag; ti Rachel ta nitmangitangi matagivulavulas ki alalak tin, ka inang ki pakahaniapen, aley ka awlug ato.

19.niv: After Herod died, an angel of the Lord appeared in a dream to Joseph in Egypt
19.cmn: 希律死了以後，有主的使者在埃及向約瑟夢中顯現，說：
19.sry: Iru ka nimakidi ki ikakagulungan ta ti Herodes; kitaey ta Tamagnaw ki Meyrang mauamah ti Yosefan tu maling tin tu Ehipten:

20.niv: and said, “Get up, take the child and his mother and go to the land of Israel, for those who were trying to take the childʼs life are dead.”
20.cmn: 「起來！帶着小孩子和他母親往以色列地去，因為要害小孩子性命的人已經死了。」
20.sry: Kun, matimawaga gapit, araaw ta raway alam aw ti ina tin, ka tawhabula mukwa tu purug ki Israel, ka nimapatay ta neni ka nikiikiim nein ta vati ki raway.

21.niv: So he got up, took the child and his mother and went to the land of Israel.
21.cmn: 約瑟就起來，把小孩子和他母親帶到以色列地去；
21.sry: Anata, iru ka nimatimawag ta teni, nimara ki raway ki rarenan apa tin, ka nilumad tu purug ka Israel.

22.niv: But when he heard that Archelaus was reigning in Judea in place of his father Herod, he was afraid to go there. Having been warned in a dream, he withdrew to the district of Galilee,
22.cmn: 只因聽見亞基老接着他父親希律作了猶太王，就怕往那裏去，又在夢中被主指示，便往加利利境內去了，
22.sry: Nda iru ra ilingigen tin ka Meysasu ka Sibavaw ta ti Archelaus tu Yudea mivariu ki raraman tin ka ti Herodes, nimatakut sakakwa hina ta teni: Ra du nipakusuan tu maling, nitawhabul tu lbalbag ki Galilaya.

23.niv: and he went and lived in a town called Nazareth. So was fulfilled what was said through the prophets, that he would be called a Nazarene.
23.cmn: 到了一座城，名叫拿撒勒，就住在那裏。這是要應驗先知所說，他將稱為拿撒勒人的話了。
23.sry: Iru ka lmalmad irua hina, nimurila tu awma ka pananangen Nazareth: aley ka pavawutaw ta na su ki tamamatagitan, ka pananangey ta teni ka Nazarenus.

1.niv: In those days John the Baptist came, preaching in the wilderness of Judea
1.cmn: 那時，有施洗的約翰出來，在猶太的曠野傳道，說：
1.sry: Ka tu wagi ka ana niirua ta ti Yoanes ka Tamaawlug matasasu tu pawlapawlag ki Yudea,

2.niv: and saying, “Repent, for the kingdom of heaven has come near.”
2.cmn: 「天國近了，你們應當悔改！」
2.sry: Kun, Silala pasalikuga ki vana umi ki rig ka nimutuk ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum

3.niv: This is he who was spoken of through the prophet Isaiah: “A voice of one calling in the wilderness, ‘Prepare the way for the Lord, make straight paths for him.’ ”
3.cmn: 這人就是先知以賽亞所說的。他說：「在曠野有人聲喊着說： 預備主的道， 修直他的路！」
3.sry: Ka teni ta ti ata ka nipasusuen ki matagitan ka ti Esayas, kun; Ingaw ki makulangag tu pawlapawlag, Sidadaranga pakaparilpil ki darang ki Meyrang, peytiktikaw ta pukakun tin.

4.niv: Johnʼs clothes were made of camelʼs hair, and he had a leather belt around his waist. His food was locusts and wild honey.
4.cmn: 這約翰身穿駱駝毛的衣服，腰束皮帶，吃的是蝗蟲、野蜜。
4.sry: Teni ta ti Yoanes ka niakumeya ki pamamian tin ka na riving ki luwang, ka aku tuuk [ka kemel kumakwa] ki ayt apa ka na kuraaw, ka nimaid ki valut tin, ka kanen tin idahi na huwalu apa ta ana.

5.niv: People went out to him from Jerusalem and all Judea and the whole region of the Jordan.
5.cmn: 那時，耶路撒冷和猶太全地，並約旦河一帶地方的人，都出去到約翰那裏，
5.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nitawpapanag mukwa tenian ta Yerusalem, imideyaw apa ta Yudea, imid apa ki sat ka da pudapan ka tu hivat ki Yordan.

6.niv: Confessing their sins, they were baptized by him in the Jordan River.
6.cmn: 承認他們的罪，在約旦河裏受他的洗。
6.sry: Ka niawlugan tin ta neni tu Yordan, tu pupapanagen ki varaw nein ra.

7.niv: But when he saw many of the Pharisees and Sadducees coming to where he was baptizing, he said to them: “You brood of vipers! Who warned you to flee from the coming wrath?
7.cmn: 約翰看見許多法利賽人和撒都該人也來受洗，就對他們說：「毒蛇的種類！誰指示你們逃避將來的忿怒呢？
7.sry: Teni ra, du ararawen tin ta hmabatung ki Farizeen ki Saduseen tu awlungan tin, nikuma nenian; Na kakubkub ki tpung, timang ta nimaduk imumian pailput ki ngale ka ru rumanga.

8.niv: Produce fruit in keeping with repentance.
8.cmn: 你們要結出果子來，與悔改的心相稱。
8.sry: Anata makavua ki vua ka na kaangalen pasalikugen umi silala.

9.niv: And do not think you can say to yourselves, ‘We have Abraham as our father.’ I tell you that out of these stones God can raise up children for Abraham.
9.cmn: 不要自己心裏說：『有亞伯拉罕為我們的祖宗。』我告訴你們，上帝能從這些石頭中給亞伯拉罕興起子孫來。
9.sry: Ina pukidi imumian pagdumdum pagmado pagkumahina; Aku na raramaan kame ti Abrahaman. Ka pasusuenaw kamu ra, ka pailpug ta Alid pagapit ki vato ka ana ki alalak ti Abrahaman.

10.niv: The ax is already at the root of the trees, and every tree that does not produce good fruit will be cut down and thrown into the fire.
10.cmn: 現在斧子已經放在樹根上，凡不結好果子的樹就砍下來，丟在火裏。
10.sry: Hinin da niatakwaan ta vuthaw tu patar ki paranaranag; imid ki paranag ka asi makavua ki vua ka mariyang, tagtaaw lato maring tu apuy.

11.niv: “I baptize you with water for repentance. But after me comes one who is more powerful than I, whose sandals I am not worthy to carry. He will baptize you with the Holy Spirit and fire.
11.cmn: 我是用水給你們施洗，叫你們悔改。但那在我以後來的，能力比我更大，我就是給他提鞋也不配。他要用聖靈與火給你們施洗。
11.sry: Ti yaw ta mawlug imumian ki ralum tu silalaan; Ra teni ka siawug yawan mukwa ta mararey malig yawan, ka asi ko tu keyrangan meykwa ki tatapil tin da; Teni ta mawluga imumian ki Yupan ka Dilig Matiktik, ki apuy apa ra.

12.niv: His winnowing fork is in his hand, and he will clear his threshing floor, gathering his wheat into the barn and burning up the chaff with unquenchable fire.”
12.cmn: 他手裏拿着簸箕，要揚淨他的場，把麥子收在倉裏，把糠用不滅的火燒盡了。」 耶穌受洗 （可1‧9－11；路3‧21－22）
12.sry: Ka varaku tin peykwaan ki rima tin, ka pakakuptiga ki dadadaen tin, ka palilidaw tin ta irung tu kuvaw; Hudag da pailamagaw tin tu apuy ka asi hmahay pahiyupen.

13.niv: Then Jesus came from Galilee to the Jordan to be baptized by John.
13.cmn: 當下，耶穌從加利利來到約旦河，見了約翰，要受他的洗。
13.sry: Tu kidi ka ana niirua ta ti Yesus maka Galilaya tu Yordan ti Yoanesan, aley ka paawlugey tin tenian
