13.niv: For all the Prophets and the Law prophesied until John.
13.cmn: 因為眾先知和律法說預言，到約翰為止。
13.sry: Ka imid ki na tamamatagitan, ki tatuko apa, nimatagitan tu kidi ti Yoanesan.

14.niv: And if you are willing to accept it, he is the Elijah who was to come.
14.cmn: 你們若肯領受，這人就是那應當來的以利亞。
14.sry: Ka ru mamuy kamu lawung [ki su ka ata] teni ta ti Eliyas ka pairuaw.

15.niv: Whoever has ears, let them hear.
15.cmn: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！
15.sry: Timamang ka aku tangira ki ailingilingig, hmilingiga ato.

16.niv: “To what can I compare this generation? They are like children sitting in the marketplaces and calling out to others:
16.cmn: 我可用甚麼比這世代呢？好像孩童坐在街市上招呼同伴，說：
16.sry: Ka pakalawlawen maw timamangan ta kavuivuilan ka ata? Makalaw lato ki raraway ka mirarung tu kairagan, ka tmataam ki lam nein.

17.niv: “ ‘We played the pipe for you, and you did not dance; we sang a dirge, and you did not mourn.’
17.cmn: 我們向你們吹笛， 你們不跳舞； 我們向你們舉哀， 你們不捶胸。
17.sry: Matagikumahina ki su, Nipariringiden yan kamu, ka asi kamu nirmangtultul. Nitakatangitangi kame tmatay, ka asi kamu nitmangitangi.

18.niv: For John came neither eating nor drinking, and they say, ‘He has a demon.’
18.cmn: 約翰來了，也不吃也不喝，人就說他是被鬼附着的；
18.sry: Ka niirua ta ti Yoanes, asi kman, asi mit, ka aku litu, kun nein.

19.niv: The Son of Man came eating and drinking, and they say, ‘Here is a glutton and a drunkard, a friend of tax collectors and sinners.’ But wisdom is proved right by her deeds.”
19.cmn: 人子來了，也吃也喝，人又說他是貪食好酒的人，是稅吏和罪人的朋友。但智慧之子總以智慧為是 。」 耶穌責備不悔改的城 （路10‧13－15）
19.sry: Irua ato ta Alak ki kagulung, ka kman ka mit, ka kun nein da, Kitaey ta kagulung ka mawrur, ka tamadihu, riu ki tamaimug ki tamakavaraw apa. Ra niputiktiken ta pakuzazingan ki alalak nein.

20.niv: Then Jesus began to denounce the towns in which most of his miracles had been performed, because they did not repent.
20.cmn: 耶穌在諸城中行了許多異能，那些城的人終不悔改，就在那時候責備他們，說：
20.sry: Anata nimeynaunamu meyrararey ki awmaawma ka nipafute hina ta madag ki kailgan tin ka uringawen, ka asi matamha silala ta neni.

21.niv: “Woe to you, Chorazin! Woe to you, Bethsaida! For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Tyre and Sidon, they would have repented long ago in sackcloth and ashes.
21.cmn: 「哥拉汛哪，你有禍了！伯賽大啊，你有禍了！因為在你們中間所行的異能，若行在泰爾、西頓，他們早已披麻蒙灰悔改了。
21.sry: Aley imhu ki Korazin, aley imhu ki Bethzaida: ka ru nipafute tu Tayrus lava tu Sidon lava ta malig ka na ringey ka nipafute imhuan, ina matamha silala kalhay tu nimana, lmawa tu avo apa ta teni.

22.niv: But I tell you, it will be more bearable for Tyre and Sidon on the day of judgment than for you.
22.cmn: 但我告訴你們，當審判的日子，泰爾、西頓所受的，比你們還容易受呢！
22.sry: Anata pasusuen aw kamu ra, Ka sauney lmawa ki pahahavuhavung ta Tayrus, ki Sidon apa imumian, tu wagi ki papamamagen da.

23.niv: And you, Capernaum, will you be lifted to the heavens? No, you will go down to Hades. For if the miracles that were performed in you had been performed in Sodom, it would have remained to this day.
23.cmn: 迦百農啊，你已經升到天上，將來必墜落陰間；因為在你那裏所行的異能，若行在所多瑪，它還可以存到今日。
23.sry: Ka imhu ki Kapernaum, ka nipuvavawen ki kidi puvavulum, muhulaney kaw tu kalawhawan. Aley ka ru nipafute tu Sodoma ta malig ka na ringey ka ana ka nipafute imhuan, ina itukakwa tu kidi ki wagi ka ata ta neni.

24.niv: But I tell you that it will be more bearable for Sodom on the day of judgment than for you.”
24.cmn: 但我告訴你們，當審判的日子，所多瑪所受的，比你還容易受呢！」 到我這裏來 （路10‧21－22）
24.sry: Ra ka pasusuen aw kamu, Ka sauney lumawa ta pahahavuhavung ki purug ki Sodoma imhuan, tu wagi ki pamamagen da.

25.niv: At that time Jesus said, “I praise you, Father, Lord of heaven and earth, because you have hidden these things from the wise and learned, and revealed them to little children.
25.cmn: 那時，耶穌說：「父啊，天地的主，我感謝你！因為你將這些事向聰明通達人就藏起來，向嬰孩就顯出來。
25.sry: Dilig tu kidi ka ana nimatagivli ta ti Yesus ka nikuma, Pakululugen aw kaw Rama, Meyrang ki tunun ki vulum ki nay, ka nihaohu ta mamang ka ata ki makusazing ki ta mawmha, ka awtataawfen hu ta ata pupanag ki alalak.

26.niv: Yes, Father, for this is what you were pleased to do.
26.cmn: 父啊，是的，因為你的美意本是如此。
26.sry: Hahay Rama, ka na kumahina ta kamawen hu tu amag oho.

27.niv: “All things have been committed to me by my Father. No one knows the Son except the Father, and no one knows the Father except the Son and those to whom the Son chooses to reveal him.
27.cmn: 一切所有的，都是我父交付我的；除了父，沒有人知道子；除了子和子所願意指示的，沒有人知道父。
27.sry: Imid ki mamang nipaatunun yawan ki Rama aw; ka asi kumalang ta timamang ki Alak dik ki Raraman, asi kumalang ta timamang ki Raraman dik ki Alak, teni apa ka kamuyey ki Alak maawtatawuf pupanag [ki ata.]

28.niv: “Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest.
28.cmn: 凡勞苦擔重擔的人可以到我這裏來，我就使你們得安息。
28.sry: Muimida mukwa yawan ta imumi ka siba ka banunug, ka pauliaw maw kamu;

29.niv: Take my yoke upon you and learn from me, for I am gentle and humble in heart, and you will find rest for your souls.
29.cmn: 我心裏柔和謙卑，你們當負我的軛，學我的樣式；這樣，你們心裏就必得享安息。
29.sry: Araw pakahalap imumian ta paden aw, [mawtawawuga yawan] ka patagitawaney yawan, ka mahapug ko ki rig, ka nitdarimen apa ki tintin; ka makivaleya kamu ki paulian tu vati umi.

30.niv: For my yoke is easy and my burden is light.”
30.cmn: 因為我的軛是容易的，我的擔子是輕省的。」
30.sry: Ka mahapug ta paden aw, ka mahaal ta pabanunugen aw.

1.niv: At that time Jesus went through the grainfields on the Sabbath. His disciples were hungry and began to pick some heads of grain and eat them.
1.cmn: 那時，耶穌在安息日從麥地經過。他的門徒餓了，就掐起麥穗來吃。
1.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nitawkwa ta ti Yesus ki na dadiri tu wagi ki pahihababan, ka magangey ta patatawutawugan tin, madis mutut apa ki nanag.

2.niv: When the Pharisees saw this, they said to him, “Look! Your disciples are doing what is unlawful on the Sabbath.”
2.cmn: 法利賽人看見，就對耶穌說：「看哪，你的門徒做安息日不可做的事了！」
2.sry: Ka ru kitaan [ta ata] ki Farizeen nikuma tenian, kitaey pamut ta patatawutawugan oho ki asi hahayen pamut tu wagi ki pahihababan.

3.niv: He answered, “Havenʼt you read what David did when he and his companions were hungry?
3.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「經上記着大衛和跟從他的人飢餓之時所做的事，你們沒有念過嗎？
3.sry: Ra nikuma ta teni nenian, Asi kamu kawa nikting kamang ta niringeyen ti David, du magangey, neni apa ka na lam tin?

4.niv: He entered the house of God, and he and his companions ate the consecrated bread—which was not lawful for them to do, but only for the priests.
4.cmn: 他怎麼進了上帝的殿，吃了陳設餅，這餅不是他和跟從他的人可以吃得，惟獨祭司才可以吃。
4.sry: Mama ki mang ka nimurbo tu talag ki Alid, ka nikman ki paul ki puamagen, ka asi hahayen pakan tenian ki lam apa tin da; ra dik ki dadilug?

5.niv: Or havenʼt you read in the Law that the priests on Sabbath duty in the temple desecrate the Sabbath and yet are innocent?
5.cmn: 再者，律法上所記的，當安息日，祭司在殿裏犯了安息日還是沒有罪，你們沒有念過嗎？
5.sry: Asi kamu lava nikmutkut tu tatuko ka nipasasaramsam ta dadilug ki wagi ki pahihababan, tu nipasanien ka kuva ru na wagi ki pahihababan, ka asi nimavaraw ta neni?

6.niv: I tell you that something greater than the temple is here.
6.cmn: 但我告訴你們，在這裏有一人比殿更大。
6.sry: Ka pasusuen aw kamu, ka tataun ta masaun meyrang ki kidi kuva.

7.niv: If you had known what these words mean, ‘I desire mercy, not sacrifice,’ you would not have condemned the innocent.
7.cmn: 『我喜愛憐恤，不喜愛祭祀。』你們若明白這話的意思，就不將無罪的當作有罪的了。
7.sry: Iru ra umhaen umi lava, kamang ka ana, kamuyen aw ta kaharuman asi ki papigikan, ina kamu asi nidumungdung kuma kahier ki asi nimavaraw.

8.niv: For the Son of Man is Lord of the Sabbath.”
8.cmn: 因為人子是安息日的主。」 治好枯乾了一隻手的人 （可3‧1－6；路6‧6－11）
8.sry: Ka Meyrang apa ki wagi ki pahihababan ta Alak ki kagulung.

9.niv: Going on from that place, he went into their synagogue,
9.cmn: 耶穌離開那地方，進了一個會堂。
9.sry: Ka ru malidawa hina, niirua tu pakuisalan.

10.niv: and a man with a shriveled hand was there. Looking for a reason to bring charges against Jesus, they asked him, “Is it lawful to heal on the Sabbath?”
10.cmn: 那裏有一個人枯乾了一隻手。有人問耶穌說：「安息日治病可以不可以？」意思是要控告他。
10.sry: Ka kitaey niaku kagulung ka niilaklaken ki rima, ka nitmalig ta neni tenian, kuma, Hahayen kawa pakadarikag tu wagi ki pahihababan? (aley ka pakavavarawa tenian.)

11.niv: He said to them, “If any of you has a sheep and it falls into a pit on the Sabbath, will you not take hold of it and lift it out?
11.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們中間誰有一隻羊，當安息日掉在坑裏，不把牠抓住、拉上來呢？
11.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, Tumang ta kagulung imumian, ka aku sasat ki yuko, ka ru muputo lava ta ana tu wagi ki pahihababan, ka asi mawuga puvavaw ki ana?

12.niv: How much more valuable is a person than a sheep! Therefore it is lawful to do good on the Sabbath.”
12.cmn: 人比羊何等貴重呢！所以，在安息日做善事是可以的。」
12.sry: Sipinanan ki masaun sibavaw ta kagulung ki yuko? Anata hahayen apa pamut ki mariyang tu wagi ki pahihababan. Sipinanan ki masaun sibavaw ta kagulung ki yuko? Anata hahayen apa pamut ki mariyang tu wagi ki pahihababan.

13.niv: Then he said to the man, “Stretch out your hand.” So he stretched it out and it was completely restored, just as sound as the other.
13.cmn: 於是對那人說：「伸出手來！」他把手一伸，手就復了原，和那隻手一樣。
13.sry: Anata nikuma ki vual ka ana, Siksikaw ta rima oho; ka nisiken tin, ka nikawlikug kawriyang mama ki kidi [tin].

14.niv: But the Pharisees went out and plotted how they might kill Jesus.
14.cmn: 法利賽人出去，商議怎樣可以除滅耶穌。 上帝所揀選的僕人
14.sry: Iru ka nimumala ta Farizeen, nimakisal ki su makiduma tenian, mamamang ka parumarumaa tenian

15.niv: Aware of this, Jesus withdrew from that place. A large crowd followed him, and he healed all who were ill.
15.cmn: 耶穌知道了，就離開那裏，有許多人跟着他。他把其中有病的人都治好了；
15.sry: Ra tu umhaen ti Yesus [ta ata] nidmarang hina, ka mararap ta makuilalawlaw ka nimuawug tenian, ka nipakaimiden tin pakadarikag nenian.

16.niv: He warned them not to tell others about him.
16.cmn: 又囑咐他們，不要給他傳名。
16.sry: Ka nisingig mavag nenian, ka asi pakaamaga tenian.

17.niv: This was to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet Isaiah:
17.cmn: 這是要應驗先知以賽亞的話，說：
17.sry: Aley ka pauftaw lato ta na su ki na tamatagitan ka ti Esayas, kun,

18.niv: “Here is my servant whom I have chosen, the one I love, in whom I delight; I will put my Spirit on him, and he will proclaim justice to the nations.
18.cmn: 看哪！我的僕人， 我所揀選、所親愛、心裏所喜悅的， 我要將我的靈賜給他； 他必將公理傳給外邦。
18.sry: Kitaey ta rarawayaw, ka niperi aw, ka kavagangoen aw, ka kamawen ki vati aw. Puhal apaw maw tenian ta Yupan aw, ka gnawey tin ta dungdungan ki Heydang.

19.niv: He will not quarrel or cry out; no one will hear his voice in the streets.
19.cmn: 他不爭競，不喧嚷； 街上也沒有人聽見他的聲音。
19.sry: Asi marangirangila, asi hmuwawawa, asi milingiga ta timamang tu daradarang ki ingaw tin.

20.niv: A bruised reed he will not break, and a smoldering wick he will not snuff out, till he has brought justice through to victory.
20.cmn: 壓傷的蘆葦，他不折斷； 將殘的燈火，他不吹滅； 等他施行公理，叫公理得勝。
20.sry: Asi paungitawag ki htig ka nimuputo, asi paiupaw tin ta purut ka ma ato, tu kidi apa ka pudawaa pupanag ki dindingan tu tatununan.

21.niv: In his name the nations will put their hope.”
21.cmn: 外邦人都要仰望他的名。 耶穌和別西卜 （可3‧20－30；路11‧14－23）
21.sry: Ka mitadunga ta Heydang tu nanang tin.

22.niv: Then they brought him a demon-possessed man who was blind and mute, and Jesus healed him, so that he could both talk and see.
22.cmn: 當下，有人將一個被鬼附着、又瞎又啞的人帶到耶穌那裏，耶穌就醫治他，甚至那啞巴又能說話，又能看見。
22.sry: Tu kidi ka ana niadan paukwa tenian ta saat ka niulitu, ka mavuta, ka mangupu, ka nipakadarikagen tin tenian, tu kidi ka kumahina ka masusu ato kmita ta nimavuta ka ana nimangupu apa.

23.niv: All the people were astonished and said, “Could this be the Son of David?”
23.cmn: 眾人都驚奇，說：「這不是大衛的子孫嗎？」
23.sry: Ka nienag ta imid ki makuilalawlaw, ka nikuma, asi kawa na alak ti David ta ti ata?

24.niv: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “It is only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, that this fellow drives out demons.”
24.cmn: 但法利賽人聽見，就說：「這個人趕鬼，無非是靠着鬼王別西卜啊。」
24.sry: Ka ru ilingigen [ta ata] ki Farizeen, nikuma, asi padarang ta ti ata ki litu, dik ki Beelzebul, ka sibavaw ki litulitu.

25.niv: Jesus knew their thoughts and said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be ruined, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
25.cmn: 耶穌知道他們的意念，就對他們說：「凡一國自相紛爭，就成為荒場；一城一家自相紛爭，必站立不住；
25.sry: Iru ka mumha ta ti Yesus ki nadudarumdum nein, nimasusu nenian, imid ki peysasuan ka peypapurupurug nenian mamado, pakapapawlagaw pakasupok; imid apa ki awma ki talag lava ka pakaawmaawma, paka atalatalag nenian mama da, asi itukakwaa ta ana ra.

26.niv: If Satan drives out Satan, he is divided against himself. How then can his kingdom stand?
26.cmn: 若撒但趕逐撒但，就是自相紛爭，他的國怎能站得住呢？
26.sry: Ka ru padarang ta litu ki lituan, papapiagaw tenian mamado; ka itukakwaa mama kimang ta peysasuan tin?

27.niv: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your people drive them out? So then, they will be your judges.
27.cmn: 我若靠着別西卜趕鬼，你們的子弟趕鬼又靠着誰呢？這樣，他們就要斷定你們的是非。
27.sry: Iru ka padarangenaw ta litu ki Beelzebul, padarangen ta neni timangan ki alalak umi? Aley ki ana tamadumungdunga ta neni imumian.

28.niv: But if it is by the Spirit of God that I drive out demons, then the kingdom of God has come upon you.
28.cmn: 我若靠着上帝的靈趕鬼，這就是上帝的國臨到你們了。
28.sry: Iru ra padarangenaw ta litu ki Yupan ki Alid, ana ta irua ato imumian ta peysasuan ki Alid.

29.niv: “Or again, how can anyone enter a strong manʼs house and carry off his possessions unless he first ties up the strong man? Then he can plunder his house.
29.cmn: 人怎能進壯士家裏，搶奪他的家具呢？除非先捆住那壯士，才可以搶奪他的家財。
29.sry: Ka mulpuga mama ki mang murbo ta timamang ki talag ki siuro malig pasawa ra ki sato tin, ru asi tin aliuroen bawut ta siuro malig, ana ta pasawaraa ki talag tin?

30.niv: “Whoever is not with me is against me, and whoever does not gather with me scatters.
30.cmn: 不與我相合的，就是敵我的；不同我收聚的，就是分散的。」
30.sry: Timamang ta asi tulam yawan, teni ta makuduma yawan; timamang apa ta asi papakipu papagisal tulam yawan, papapiag ta teni.

31.niv: And so I tell you, every kind of sin and slander can be forgiven, but blasphemy against the Spirit will not be forgiven.
31.cmn: 所以我告訴你們：「人一切的罪和褻瀆的話都可得赦免，惟獨褻瀆聖靈，總不得赦免。
31.sry: Aley ki ata pasusuen aw kamu, imid ki varaw ki barugan apa makutalum ataraley ki kagulung; ra barugan makutalum ka makuduma ki Yupan, asi ataraley ki kagulung.

32.niv: Anyone who speaks a word against the Son of Man will be forgiven, but anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit will not be forgiven, either in this age or in the age to come.
32.cmn: 凡說話干犯人子的，還可得赦免；惟獨說話干犯聖靈的，今世來世總不得赦免。」 樹和果子 （路6‧43－45）
32.sry: Ka timamang ta masusua ato ki mamang ka su matagiduma ki Alak ki kagulung, ataraley tenian [ta ata]; ra timamang ta matagidumadumaa lato ki Yupan ka Dilig Matiktik, asi ataraley tenian ta ata, asi tu idarinugan ka ata ka hinin, asi tu ata apa ka iruaa du ruman.

33.niv: “Make a tree good and its fruit will be good, or make a tree bad and its fruit will be bad, for a tree is recognized by its fruit.
33.cmn: 「你們或以為樹好，果子也好；樹壞，果子也壞；因為看果子就可以知道樹。
33.sry: Da pukidia matarig, ka mariyang lava ta paranag, mariyang apa ta vua tin; ka asi mariyang lava ta paranag, ki vua apa tin. Ka kalangen ki vua ta paranag.

34.niv: You brood of vipers, how can you who are evil say anything good? For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of.
34.cmn: 毒蛇的種類！你們既是惡人，怎能說出好話來呢？因為心裏所充滿的，口裏就說出來。
34.sry: Na kubkub ki tupung, pulpug kamu mama ki mang pusu ki mariyang ru mate kamu ra, ka tu patagiluafen ki tintin masusu ta mutus.

35.niv: A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in him, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in him.
35.cmn: 善人從他心裏所存的善就發出善來；惡人從他心裏所存的惡就發出惡來。
35.sry: Tau ka mariyang pupanag ki mariyang ki kavangeyan ka mariyang ki tintin, tau apa ka mate pupanag ki asi mariyang ki kavangeyan ka mate.

36.niv: But I tell you that everyone will have to give account on the day of judgment for every empty word they have spoken.
36.cmn: 我又告訴你們，凡人所說的閒話，當審判的日子，必要句句供出來；
36.sry: Ra pasusuen aw kamu ka na sasasat ki nino ka su ka pasusuey ato ki kagulung, ka meyvlia ta neni kting ki ana tu wagi ki papamamagan.

37.niv: For by your words you will be acquitted, and by your words you will be condemned.”
37.cmn: 因為要憑你的話定你為義，也要憑你的話定你有罪。」 要求神蹟 （可8‧11－12；路11‧29－32）
37.sry: Ka putiktikey kamu ki na su umi, ka dungdungey kamu ki na su umi.

38.niv: Then some of the Pharisees and teachers of the law said to him, “Teacher, we want to see a sign from you.”
38.cmn: 當時，有幾個文士和法利賽人對耶穌說：「夫子，我們願意你顯個神蹟給我們看。」
38.sry: Anata nimatagivli ta raruma ki makusasulat ki Farizeen apa ka nikuma, Matawtawug kamuyen yan kmita ka paamutey imhu ta pukidian.

39.niv: He answered, “A wicked and adulterous generation asks for a sign! But none will be given it except the sign of the prophet Jonah.
39.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「一個邪惡淫亂的世代求看神蹟，除了先知約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他們看。
39.sry: Ra teni ta matagivli nikuma nenian, Kavuytan ka mate ka rarburbo tmumimia ki pukidian, ka asi pigaaney ato nenian, dik ki na pukakidi ki na tamatagitan ka ti Yonas.

40.niv: For as Jonah was three days and three nights in the belly of a huge fish, so the Son of Man will be three days and three nights in the heart of the earth.
40.cmn: 約拿三日三夜在大魚肚腹中，人子也要這樣三日三夜在地裏頭。
40.sry: Ka mama ka nimakaturu ki wagi, maka turu apa ki awvan ta ti Yonas tu vual ki mawaw, kumahina ki wagi ki awvan ta Alak ki kagulung tu tintin [ka rarun] ki nay ra.

41.niv: The men of Nineveh will stand up at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for they repented at the preaching of Jonah, and now something greater than Jonah is here.
41.cmn: 當審判的時候，尼尼微人要起來定這世代的罪，因為尼尼微人聽了約拿所傳的就悔改了。看哪，在這裏有一人比約拿更大！
41.sry: Gapita ta papara ka maka Ninive tu papamamagen lam ki kavavuilan ka ata dmungdung nenian; ka nisilala nipasalikug ki vana nein ki rig tu nipatagisasuan ti Yonas. Ka kitaey masaun tu vavaw ki kidi ti Yonasan, ataun hiya.

42.niv: The Queen of the South will rise at the judgment with this generation and condemn it; for she came from the ends of the earth to listen to Solomonʼs wisdom, and now something greater than Solomon is here.
42.cmn: 當審判的時候，南方的女王要起來定這世代的罪； 因為她從地極而來，要聽所羅門的智慧話。看哪，在這裏有一人比所羅門更大！」 污鬼回來 （路11‧24－26）
42.sry: Gapita ta sibavaw ka meysasu ka ina ka maka timug tu papamamagan lam ki kavuytan ka ata, dmungdung nenian; aley ka niirua maka kidi ki nay milingig ki na kakakusasing ti Salomon. Ka kitaey, masaun tu vavaw ki kidi ti Salomonan, ataen hiya.

43.niv: “When an impure spirit comes out of a person, it goes through arid places seeking rest and does not find it.
43.cmn: 「污鬼離了人身，就在無水之地過來過去，尋求安歇之處，卻尋不着。
43.sry: Ka ru dmaranga ato maka rbo ki kagulung ta yupan ka asi matikanag, dumiaka sakakwan tin munonang tu itukwan ka markag kmakiim ki pahihababaney tin, ra asi tin pakivaleyen.

44.niv: Then it says, ‘I will return to the house I left.’ When it arrives, it finds the house unoccupied, swept clean and put in order.
44.cmn: 於是說：『我要回到我所出來的屋裏去。』到了，就看見裏面空閒，打掃乾淨，修飾好了，
44.sry: Anata pasusuen tin, salikuga ko mukwa tu talag aw, ka nidarangen aw; ka ru irua, pakivaleyen tin ka kuko ka niuw apan ki uwap tmura paka atabung ta ana.

45.niv: Then it goes and takes with it seven other spirits more wicked than itself, and they go in and live there. And the final condition of that person is worse than the first. That is how it will be with this wicked generation.”
45.cmn: 便去另帶了七個比自己更惡的鬼來，都進去住在那裏。那人末後的景況比先前更不好了。這邪惡的世代也要如此。」 耶穌的母親和兄弟們 （可3‧31－35；路8‧19－21）
45.sry: Anata ukun tin mara patulam tenian pipitu ki yupan ka pani ka masaun mate tenian mamado, ka ru nisararbo itukwa ta neni hina, ka aawug ki kagulung ka ana pakasaunein pakate ki na uro tin. Kuma apa hina ki kavuytan ka ata ka mate.

46.niv: While Jesus was still talking to the crowd, his mother and brothers stood outside, wanting to speak to him.
46.cmn: 耶穌還對眾人說話的時候，不料他母親和他弟兄站在外邊，要與他說話。
46.sry: Ka ru pasusuen apa tin ki makuilalawlaw, kitaey ta ti rena ki tagiapaparag apa tin ta nimituko itu mala, kmiim ki pasusuey nein tenian.

47.niv: Someone told him, “Your mother and brothers are standing outside, wanting to speak to you.”
47.cmn: 有人告訴他說：「看哪，你母親和你弟兄站在外邊，要與你說話。」
47.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti ano tenian, Kitaey, itu mala hina mituko ta ti rena ki tagiapaparag apa oho, kmim ki pasusuey nein imhuan.

48.niv: He replied to him, “Who is my mother, and who are my brothers?”
48.cmn: 他卻回答那人說：「誰是我的母親？誰是我的弟兄？」
48.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta teni kuma tenian ka bana [ki ata], Timang ta rarenan aw? Timang ta tagiapaparag aw?

49.niv: Pointing to his disciples, he said, “Here are my mother and my brothers.
49.cmn: 就伸手指着門徒，說：「看哪，我的母親，我的弟兄。
49.sry: Ka ru sikiskig ki rima tin meyvavaw ki patatawutawugan tin, nikuma, kitaey ta rarenan aw, ki tagiapaparag apa maw.

50.niv: For whoever does the will of my Father in heaven is my brother and sister and mother.”
50.cmn: 凡遵行我天父旨意的人，就是我的弟兄姊妹和母親了。」
50.sry: Ka timamang ta paamuta ato ki kamuyen ki Rama aw ka tu tunun ki vuluvulum, teni ta tagiapaparag aw, ki niaha, ki rena apa maw.

1.niv: That same day Jesus went out of the house and sat by the lake.
1.cmn: 當那一天，耶穌從房子裏出來，坐在海邊。
1.sry: Ka tu wagi ka ana ru nimumala ta ti Yesus ki talag, nimirung tu tamang ki vaung.

2.niv: Such large crowds gathered around him that he got into a boat and sat in it, while all the people stood on the shore.
2.cmn: 有許多人到他那裏聚集，他只得上船坐下，眾人都站在岸上。
2.sry: Ka mabatung ta makuilalawlaw ka nimawawakla tenian, kumahina ka nimuavang mirung ta teni, ka imid ki makuilalawlaw ta niitukwa tu said.

3.niv: Then he told them many things in parables, saying: “A farmer went out to sow his seed.
3.cmn: 他用比喻對他們講許多道理，說：「有一個撒種的出去撒種；
3.sry: Ka nipasusuen tin ta madadag [ki mamang] ki pamikawlawan; kun, Kitaey nitawpapanag [muawma] aley ki dirien ta tamadiri;

4.niv: As he was scattering the seed, some fell along the path, and the birds came and ate it up.
4.cmn: 撒的時候，有落在路旁的，飛鳥來吃盡了；
4.sry: Ka tu dadirien tin, nitawkwa ta ruma [ki gaap] tu vidag ki darang; ka niirua ta ayayam ka subug, ka ni[rmuruk] kman ki ana.

5.niv: Some fell on rocky places, where it did not have much soil. It sprang up quickly, because the soil was shallow.
5.cmn: 有落在土淺石頭地上的，土既不深，發苗最快，
5.sry: Ka nitawkwa ta ruma tu vatugtugan ka mausing malii, ka nikawraliban [ta ana] tuul, aley ka ausi ki malawhaw ka nay ra.

6.niv: But when the sun came up, the plants were scorched, and they withered because they had no root.
6.cmn: 日頭出來一曬，因為沒有根，就枯乾了；
6.sry: Iru ra nimutiag ta wagi, dmiaka nipatihuwilen, ka aley ka ausi ki patar, nimilaklak da.

7.niv: Other seed fell among thorns, which grew up and choked the plants.
7.cmn: 有落在荊棘裏的，荊棘長起來，把它擠住了；
7.sry: Ka nitawkwa ta ruma tu adadauman; ka nikumaralib ta adum, ka nipaipatay ki ana.

8.niv: Still other seed fell on good soil, where it produced a crop—a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown.
8.cmn: 又有落在好土裏的，就結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。
8.sry: Ka nitawkwa ta ruma tu nay ka mariyang, ka nimakavua ki vua, sat kaatugan ta sasat, ninum kitian ta pani, ka turu kitian ta ruma [ki viturug.]

9.niv: Whoever has ears, let them hear.”
9.cmn: 有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」 用比喻的目的 （可4‧10－12；路8‧9－10）
9.sry: Timamang ta aku tangira ki [m]aililingig, da milingiga ato.

10.niv: The disciples came to him and asked, “Why do you speak to the people in parables?”
10.cmn: 門徒進前來，問耶穌說：「對眾人講話，為甚麼用比喻呢？」
10.sry: Iru ka irua tenian ta patatawutawugan [tin] nikuma tenian, Kamang ka masusu kaw nenian ki pamikawlawan?

11.niv: He replied, “Because the knowledge of the secrets of the kingdom of heaven has been given to you, but not to them.
11.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「因為天國的奧祕只叫你們知道，不叫他們知道。
11.sry: Teni ra nimatagivli kuma nenian, Aley ka nipigaan imumian mumha ki kalawhawan ki peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum, ra asi nipigaan ato ta neni ka ana.

12.niv: Whoever has will be given more, and they will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.
12.cmn: 凡有的，還要加給他，叫他有餘；凡沒有的，連他所有的，也要奪去。
12.sry: Ka timamang ta akumeya, teni apa ta pigaey, ka akumeyaa ta teni ki kahuvaran; ra timamang ta awlug, haawmiey apa tenian ta akumeya tin.

13.niv: This is why I speak to them in parables: “Though seeing, they do not see; though hearing, they do not hear or understand.
13.cmn: 所以我用比喻對他們講，是因他們看也看不見，聽也聽不見，也不明白。
13.sry: Aley ki ata pasusuenau nenian ki pamikawlawan ki su, aley ka tu kakitaan nein asi kmitaa, ka tu [m]ailingigen nein asi milingiga, ka asi mumhaa ta neni.

14.niv: In them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah: “ ‘You will be ever hearing but never understanding; you will be ever seeing but never perceiving.
14.cmn: 在他們身上，正應了以賽亞的預言，說： 你們聽是要聽見，卻不明白； 看是要看見，卻不曉得；
14.sry: Ka pavawuten nenian ta nipatagitan ti Esayas ka kuma, Ilingigey mumi ki [m]ailingigen, ra asi kamu mumhaa; ka kakitaey mumi ki kakitaan, ka asi kamu kmitaa pulilit.

15.niv: For this peopleʼs heart has become calloused; they hardly hear with their ears, and they have closed their eyes. Otherwise they might see with their eyes, hear with their ears, understand with their hearts and turn, and I would heal them.’
15.cmn: 因為這百姓油蒙了心， 耳朵發沉， 眼睛閉着， 恐怕眼睛看見， 耳朵聽見， 心裏明白，回轉過來， 我就醫治他們。
15.sry: Ka kawkunumato ta tintin ki tau ka ata, ka nimahugfpit milingig ta tangira nein; ka niitub ta mata nein ki asi nein kitaey du rumang ki mata, ki asi nein umhey ki tintin, ki asi silalaey, ki pakadarikagaw maw nenian.

16.niv: But blessed are your eyes because they see, and your ears because they hear.
16.cmn: 「但你們的眼睛是有福的，因為看見了；你們的耳朵也是有福的，因為聽見了。
16.sry: Ra aku riyang ta mata umi, aley ka kmita ato, ki tangira apa mumi, aley ka milingigatura.

17.niv: For truly I tell you, many prophets and righteous people longed to see what you see but did not see it, and to hear what you hear but did not hear it.
17.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，從前有許多先知和義人要看你們所看的，卻沒有看見，要聽你們所聽的，卻沒有聽見。」 解明撒種的比喻 （可4‧13－20；路8‧11－15）
17.sry: Ka dilig kun aw kamu ra, Ka mabatung ki na tamamatagitan ki na matiktik apa ta nimamuy kmita ka kitaen umi, ra asi nein nikitaan; milingig apa ka ilingigan umi, ra asi nein niilingigen.

18.niv: “Listen then to what the parable of the sower means:
18.cmn: 「所以，你們當聽這撒種的比喻。
18.sry: Anata milingiga ta imumi ki pamikawlawan ki tamadiri.

19.niv: When anyone hears the message about the kingdom and does not understand it, the evil one comes and snatches away what was sown in their heart. This is the seed sown along the path.
19.cmn: 凡聽見天國道理不明白的，那惡者就來，把所撒在他心裏的奪了去；這就是撒在路旁的了。
19.sry: Iru milingig ta timamang ki su ki peysasuan tu asi tin umhaen, dumiaka irua ta ti tatapin [ka litu] ka sumimurang mara ki nidiri tu tintin tin. Teni ta ti ano, ka nidiri tu vidag ki darang.

20.niv: The seed falling on rocky ground refers to someone who hears the word and at once receives it with joy.
20.cmn: 撒在石頭地上的，就是人聽了道，當下歡喜領受，
20.sry: Teni ka nidiri tu vatugtugan ka mahurat ki nay, teni ta ti ana ka milingig ki su, ka matadis mataray ki ana matarig

21.niv: But since they have no root, they last only a short time. When trouble or persecution comes because of the word, they quickly fall away.
21.cmn: 只因心裏沒有根，不過是暫時的，及至為道遭了患難，或是受了逼迫，立刻就跌倒了。
21.sry: Ra ausi ki patar tu mamado tenian, ka tnadis tnakaha ta teni: ka ru irua ta samukan ki kudilugan lava aley ki su, madis pakavarawen ato. Ra ausi ki patar tu mamado tenian, ka tnadis tnakaha ta teni; ka ru irua ta samukan ki kudilugan lava aley ki su, madis pakavarawen ato

22.niv: The seed falling among the thorns refers to someone who hears the word, but the worries of this life and the deceitfulness of wealth choke the word, making it unfruitful.
22.cmn: 撒在荊棘裏的，就是人聽了道，後來有世上的思慮、錢財的迷惑把道擠住了，不能結實。
22.sry: Teni ra ka nidiri tu adaduman, teni ta ti ata ka milingig ki su, ra pakuboen pagdimdim ki idarinugan ka ata ki simhamhan apa ki vangey ta kmaralib ki su, ka maka pawupag ta ana. Teni ra ka nidiri tu adaduman, teni ta ti ata ka milingig ki su, ra pagkuboen pagdumdum ki idarinugan ka ata ki simhamhan apa ki vangey ta kmaralib ki su, ka makapawpag ta ana.

23.niv: But the seed falling on good soil refers to someone who hears the word and understands it. This is the one who produces a crop, yielding a hundred, sixty or thirty times what was sown.”
23.cmn: 撒在好地上的，就是人聽道明白了，後來結實，有一百倍的，有六十倍的，有三十倍的。」 稗子的比喻
23.sry: Teni ka nidiri tu nay ka mariyang, teni ta ti ata ka du milingig ki su ka mumha ki ata, ka makavua apa pupanag sat kaatugan ta sasat, anim kitian ta pani, ka turu kitian ta ruma ra.

24.niv: Jesus told them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a man who sowed good seed in his field.
24.cmn: 耶穌又設個比喻對他們說：「天國好像人撒好種在田裏，
24.sry: Nipupanag nenian ki pani ki pamikawlawan, kun, Pamikawlawan ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum, ki tau ka nidmadiri ki gaap ka mariyang tu uma tin.

25.niv: But while everyone was sleeping, his enemy came and sowed weeds among the wheat, and went away.
25.cmn: 及至人睡覺的時候，有仇敵來，將稗子撒在麥子裏就走了。
25.sry: Ka tu iripen ki tau, niirua ta vawawug tin, ka nidmiri ki uro ka asi mariyang kmita mawg ki sivag, ka nidmarangatora.

26.niv: When the wheat sprouted and formed heads, then the weeds also appeared.
26.cmn: 到長苗吐穗的時候，稗子也顯出來。
26.sry: Iru ka nitibig kawngara, makavua, nimupanag apa ta uro ka asi mariyang.

27.niv: “The ownerʼs servants came to him and said, ‘Sir, didnʼt you sow good seed in your field? Where then did the weeds come from?’
27.cmn: 田主的僕人來告訴他說：『主啊，你不是撒好種在田裏嗎？從哪裏來的稗子呢？』
27.sry: Ka du mukwa ta kuncia ki tagitalag, nikuma tenian: Meyrang, asi kawa mariyang ta gaap ka nidirien hu tu uma hu? maka kuna ka aku uru ka asi mariyang?

28.niv: “ ‘An enemy did this,’ he replied. “The servants asked him, ‘Do you want us to go and pull them up?’
28.cmn: 主人說：『這是仇敵做的。』僕人說：『你要我們去薅出來嗎？』
28.sry: Teni ra nikuma nenian, Nipamuten ka ana ki tau ka mavawug. Ka nikuma ta kuncia tenian, Kamuyen hu kawa ka ukwaey yan malilud ki ana?

29.niv: “ ‘No,’ he answered, ‘because while you are pulling the weeds, you may uproot the wheat with them.
29.cmn: 主人說：『不必，恐怕薅稗子，連麥子也拔出來。
29.sry: Ra nikuma ta teni, Asi, aley ka ru malilud kamu ki uru ka asi mariyang, asia kamu lava pi apara putul ki sivag.

30.niv: Let both grow together until the harvest. At that time I will tell the harvesters: First collect the weeds and tie them in bundles to be burned; then gather the wheat and bring it into my barn.’ ”
30.cmn: 容這兩樣一齊長，等着收割。當收割的時候，我要對收割的人說，先將稗子薅出來，捆成捆，留着燒；惟有麥子要收在倉裏。』」 芥菜種和麵酵的比喻 （可4‧30－32；路13‧18－21）
30.sry: Pakawsalaw patul tu kaayamey, ka tu kidi ki kaayaman pasusuey maw ki tau ka mayama, siurua ilud ki uru ka asi mariyang, ka ibenaw ta ana tu iban, aley ka papilamagaw, ra iludaw ta sivag tu kuvaw aw.

31.niv: He told them another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like a mustard seed, which a man took and planted in his field.
31.cmn: 他又設個比喻對他們說：「天國好像一粒芥菜種，有人拿去種在田裏。
31.sry: Pani apa ki pamikawlawan ka nipupanagen tin nenian, kun, Mama ki tugto ki suhay [ka kailwa] ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum, ka niara ki tau, ka na dadiri tin tu uma tin.

32.niv: Though it is the smallest of all seeds, yet when it grows, it is the largest of garden plants and becomes a tree, so that the birds come and perch in its branches.”
32.cmn: 這原是百種裏最小的，等到長起來，卻比各樣的菜都大，且成了樹，天上的飛鳥來宿在它的枝上。」
32.sry: Ka siuro utikiling [ta ana] ki imid ki tugto; irura nikawumhaa to, siuro ato irang ki imid ki uruuru; ka kawparanag ato, kuma apa hina ka irua ta ayayam ka subug silawlaw tu pehil tin da.

33.niv: He told them still another parable: “The kingdom of heaven is like yeast that a woman took and mixed into about sixty pounds of flour until it worked all through the dough.”
33.cmn: 他又對他們講個比喻說：「天國好像麵酵，有婦人拿來，藏在三斗麵裏，直等全團都發起來。」 用比喻的原因 （可4‧33－34）
33.sry: Ka nipasusuen tin ki pamikawlawan ka pani, Mama ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum ki nipeyapingit, ka niara ki ina ka nihma tu tuturu ki sawrarepungan ki muy, tu kidi apa ka ana ka maimid ato mapingit.

34.niv: Jesus spoke all these things to the crowd in parables; he did not say anything to them without using a parable.
34.cmn: 這都是耶穌用比喻對眾人說的話；若不用比喻，就不對他們說甚麼。
34.sry: Kamamang ka ata nimasusu ta ti Yesus ki makuilalawlaw tu pamikawlawan; ka asi nipasusuen ki mamang tu ausi ki pamikawlawan.

35.niv: So was fulfilled what was spoken through the prophet: “I will open my mouth in parables, I will utter things hidden since the creation of the world.”
35.cmn: 這是要應驗先知的話，說： 我要開口用比喻， 把創世以來所隱藏的事發明出來。 解明稗子的比喻
35.sry: Aley ka pavawutaw lato ta na su ki tamamatagitan, kun, Lutuafey maw ta mutus au tu pamikawlawan; Pupanagey maw ta niha na kidi ki nipaitu samdingen ta darun ki imid ki nay

36.niv: Then he left the crowd and went into the house. His disciples came to him and said, “Explain to us the parable of the weeds in the field.”
36.cmn: 當下，耶穌離開眾人，進了房子。他的門徒進前來，說：「請把田間稗子的比喻講給我們聽。」
36.sry: Iru ka nipadarang ki makuilalawlaw, nimutalag ta ti Yesus. Ka niirua tenian ta patawutawugan tin, kun, patagimisingey kame ki pamikawlawan ki ururu ka asi mariyang tu uma.

37.niv: He answered, “The one who sowed the good seed is the Son of Man.
37.cmn: 他回答說：「那撒好種的就是人子；
37.sry: Teni ta nimatagivli masusu nenian, Teni ka dmadiri ki gaap ka mariyang, teni ta Alak ki kagulung.

38.niv: The field is the world, and the good seed stands for the people of the kingdom. The weeds are the people of the evil one,
38.cmn: 田地就是世界；好種就是天國之子；稗子就是那惡者之子；
38.sry: Ka uma ta imid ka nay; gaap ka mariyangda ta alalak ki peysasuan; ra uru ka asi mariyang ta alalak ki tam apakate [ka litu.]

39.niv: and the enemy who sows them is the devil. The harvest is the end of the age, and the harvesters are angels.
39.cmn: 撒稗子的仇敵就是魔鬼；收割的時候就是世界的末了；收割的人就是天使。
39.sry: Ra vawaw ka nidmiri ki ana, teni ta litu; ka kaayaman ta kawkahan kawlimulimu ki idarinugan; ra tau ka maayam tamagnaw ta neni.

40.niv: “As the weeds are pulled up and burned in the fire, so it will be at the end of the age.
40.cmn: 將稗子薅出來用火焚燒，世界的末了也要如此。
40.sry: Anata mama ka paliluden ta uru ka asi mariyang, ka papilalamagen ki apuy, kumaa apahina tu kawkahan kawlimulimu ki idarinugan

41.niv: The Son of Man will send out his angels, and they will weed out of his kingdom everything that causes sin and all who do evil.
41.cmn: 人子要差遣使者，把一切叫人跌倒的和作惡的，從他國裏挑出來，
41.sry: Ka madingia ta Alak ki kagulung ki tamagnaw tin, ka papapiluda tu peysasuan tin imid ki pakavarawen kumaweyraw, ki pamut apa ki katukulan.

42.niv: They will throw them into the blazing furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
42.cmn: 丟在火爐裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。
42.sry: Ka aringaney nein sumakikwa nenian tu tatuloan ki apuy; tu hinawa ato ta tangitangien ki patitingen apa ki walig.

43.niv: Then the righteous will shine like the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Whoever has ears, let them hear.
43.cmn: 那時，義人在他們父的國裏，要發出光來，像太陽一樣。有耳可聽的，就應當聽！」 藏寶、尋珠、撒網的比喻
43.sry: Tu kidi ka ana matikanaga ta matiktik mama ki wagi tu peysasuan ki rama nein. Timamang ta aku tangira tu ilingigan, ilingigawra.

44.niv: “The kingdom of heaven is like treasure hidden in a field. When a man found it, he hid it again, and then in his joy went and sold all he had and bought that field.
44.cmn: 「天國好像寶貝藏在地裏，人遇見了就把它藏起來，歡歡喜喜地去變賣一切所有的，買這塊地。
44.sry: Mila, mama ki kavangeyan ka niha tu uma ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum, ka ru pakivaleyen ki tau, hain tin ta ana, ka aley ki karayen ki rig ukwaan tin pasadima ki mamang tin, ka peyla ki uma ka ana.

45.niv: “Again, the kingdom of heaven is like a merchant looking for fine pearls.
45.cmn: 天國又好像買賣人尋找好珠子，
45.sry: Mila, mama ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum ki tamapeyla, ka kmiim ki vato ka maganig ka tagikwa tu kudo.

46.niv: When he found one of great value, he went away and sold everything he had and bought it.
46.cmn: 遇見一顆重價的珠子，就去變賣他一切所有的，買了這顆珠子。
46.sry: Ka ru nipakivaley tin ta sasat ki vato ka mangal, ukwaan tin paimid pasadima ki mamang tin, ka peylaen tin ta ana.

47.niv: “Once again, the kingdom of heaven is like a net that was let down into the lake and caught all kinds of fish.
47.cmn: 天國又好像網撒在海裏，聚攏各樣水族，
47.sry: Mila apa, mama ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum ki kakawaur ka nipuvaungen, ka ulud ki imid ki nanang ki tuhing;

48.niv: When it was full, the fishermen pulled it up on the shore. Then they sat down and collected the good fish in baskets, but threw the bad away.
48.cmn: 網既滿了，人就拉上岸來，坐下，揀好的收在器具裏，將不好的丟棄了。
48.sry: Ka ru utumuyin ta ata, hipapurugin [ki tamapudulum] tu tagitag [ki ralum], ka ru mirung, sakuperien nein ki mariyang pukwa tu sato, ra ka aring nein ta asi mariyang.

49.niv: This is how it will be at the end of the age. The angels will come and separate the wicked from the righteous
49.cmn: 世界的末了也要這樣。天使要出來，從義人中把惡人分別出來，
49.sry: Kuma lato hina tu kawkahan kawlimulimu ki idarinugan; s apanaga ta tamagnaw, ka papiapiaga ki asi mariyang na tu tamawug ki matiktik;

50.niv: and throw them into the blazing furnace, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
50.cmn: 丟在火爐裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。」 新舊的東西
50.sry: Ka aringey nein sumakikwa nenian tu tatuloan ki apuy; tu hinawa lato ta tangitangien ki patitingen apa ki walig.

51.niv: “Have you understood all these things?” Jesus asked. “Yes,” they replied.
51.cmn: 耶穌說：「這一切的話你們都明白了嗎？」他們說：「我們明白了。」
51.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Muimid kamu kawa mumha ki ata? Nikuma [ta neni] tenian, Hahay Meyrang.

52.niv: He said to them, “Therefore every teacher of the law who has become a disciple in the kingdom of heaven is like the owner of a house who brings out of his storeroom new treasures as well as old.”
52.cmn: 他說：「凡文士受教作天國的門徒，就像一個家主從他庫裏拿出新舊的東西來。」 拿撒勒人厭棄耶穌 （可6‧1－6；路4‧16－30）
52.sry: Teni ra nikuma nenian: Anata imid ki makusasulat ka nipatagiutawugen tu peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum, mama ta teni ki tagitalag ka pupanag ki vangey tin ki vahaw ki rie apa.

53.niv: When Jesus had finished these parables, he moved on from there.
53.cmn: 耶穌說完了這些比喻，就離開那裏，
53.sry: Ka nikumahina, ru nimatagikaha ta ti Yesus ki pamikawlawhan ka ana, ka nidmarang hina.

54.niv: Coming to his hometown, he began teaching the people in their synagogue, and they were amazed. “Where did this man get this wisdom and these miraculous powers?” they asked.
54.cmn: 來到自己的家鄉，在會堂裏教訓人，甚至他們都希奇，說：「這人從哪裏有這等智慧和異能呢？
54.sry: Ka ru irua ato tu purug ki rama tin nimatawtawug nenian tu pakuisalan nein, kumahina ka nimukiap ta neni matagikumahina, Makakuna tenian ta kakusacingan ka ata ki kailgan apa?

55.niv: “Isnʼt this the carpenterʼs son? Isnʼt his motherʼs name Mary, and arenʼt his brothers James, Joseph, Simon and Judas?
55.cmn: 這不是木匠的兒子嗎？他母親不是叫馬利亞嗎？他弟兄們不是叫雅各、約西、 西門、猶大嗎？
55.sry: Asi kawa alak ta ti ata ki suyhu? asi kawa pananangen ta ti ina tin ti Maria? ki tagiapaparag tin ta ti Yakobus, ti Yoses, ti Simon, ti Yudas?

56.niv: Arenʼt all his sisters with us? Where then did this man get all these things?”
56.cmn: 他妹妹們不是都在我們這裏嗎？這人從哪裏有這一切的事呢？」
56.sry: Ki niaha tin, asi kawa ayaimid ayalam imitan? Makakuna tenian ta imid ki mamang ka ata?

57.niv: And they took offense at him. But Jesus said to them, “A prophet is not without honor except in his own town and in his own home.”
57.cmn: 他們就厭棄他。耶穌對他們說：「大凡先知，除了本地本家之外，沒有不被人尊敬的。」
57.sry: Ka nisaisalakuap tenian [pakate nenian mamado]. Ra nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Ausi ki rikurin lmulug ta tamamatagitan, dik tu purug tin, tu talag apa tin.

58.niv: And he did not do many miracles there because of their lack of faith.
58.cmn: 耶穌因為他們不信，就在那裏不多行異能了。
58.sry: Ka asi tin nipafutaw madag ki malig ka ringey tu hina, aley ki kauruan nein tnamising.

1.niv: At that time Herod the tetrarch heard the reports about Jesus,
1.cmn: 那時，分封的王希律聽見耶穌的名聲，
1.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nimilingig ta ti Herodes ka sat ki vual ki pagpat ki meysasu ki purug ki kakalawakaw ti Yesus.

2.niv: and he said to his attendants, “This is John the Baptist; he has risen from the dead! That is why miraculous powers are at work in him.”
2.cmn: 就對臣僕說：「這是施洗的約翰從死裏復活，所以這些異能從他裏面發出來。」
2.sry: Ka nikuma ki raraway tin, Ti Yoanes ka tamaawlug ta ti ata, Nipaapiten ta teni ki kapatayan, ka aley ki ata peyraringeyan tenian ta kailgan ka ringey.

3.niv: Now Herod had arrested John and bound him and put him in prison because of Herodias, his brother Philipʼs wife,
3.cmn: 起先，希律為他兄弟腓力的妻子希羅底的緣故，把約翰拿住，鎖在監裏。
3.sry: Ka nipatagi ta ti Herodes ti Yoanesan, nipavaut papusangat tenian aley ti Herodiasan ka key'an ki tagiapaparag tin ka ti Filipus.

4.niv: for John had been saying to him: “It is not lawful for you to have her.”
4.cmn: 因為約翰曾對他說：「你娶這婦人是不合理的。」
4.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yoanes tenian, Asi kaw hahayen meya tenian.

5.niv: Herod wanted to kill John, but he was afraid of the people, because they considered John a prophet.
5.cmn: 希律就想要殺他，只是怕百姓，因為他們以約翰為先知。
5.sry: Ka ru nikamuyen tin pakapatay tenian nimatakut ki tau, aley ka tamamatagitan ta teni nikuma ta rig nein.

6.niv: On Herodʼs birthday the daughter of Herodias danced for the guests and pleased Herod so much
6.cmn: 到了希律的生日，希羅底的女兒在眾人面前跳舞，使希律歡喜。
6.sry: Ka tu wagi ki uvavatugan ki nipeyalak ta ti Herodes, nirmangtultul ta tatimian ti Herodias tu tukad [nenian] ka nikiheylan ti Herodes.

7.niv: that he promised with an oath to give her whatever she asked.
7.cmn: 希律就起誓，應許隨她所求的給她。
7.sry: Ka nipatumising sawlalukut tenian piga ki mamang ki tmumiaw tin.

8.niv: Prompted by her mother, she said, “Give me here on a platter the head of John the Baptist.”
8.cmn: 女兒被母親所使，就說：「請把施洗約翰的頭放在盤子裏，拿來給我。」
8.sry: Teni ra du nipakuroen matawtawug ti ina tin, piganey yawan, kun tin, tu tangya ta vungo ti Yoanes ka tamaawlug.

9.niv: The king was distressed, but because of his oaths and his dinner guests, he ordered that her request be granted
9.cmn: 王便憂愁，但因他所起的誓，又因同席的人，就吩咐給她；
9.sry: Ka kawbulas ta sibavaw ka meysasu, ra aley ki nisawlukutan, aley apa nenian ka misal [tenian] mavok, nipakusuen tin ka pigaaney.

10.niv: and had John beheaded in the prison.
10.cmn: 於是打發人去，在監裏斬了約翰，
10.sry: Ka nimadingi patibu ki vungo ti Yoanes tu sangat.

11.niv: His head was brought in on a platter and given to the girl, who carried it to her mother.
11.cmn: 把頭放在盤子裏，拿來給了女子；女子拿去給她母親。
11.sry: Ka niad ta vungo tin tu tangya, ka nipigaan tatamien, ka nimad pukwa ti ina tinein.

12.niv: Johnʼs disciples came and took his body and buried it. Then they went and told Jesus.
12.cmn: 約翰的門徒來，把屍首領去埋葬了，就去告訴耶穌。 耶穌給五千人吃飽 （可6‧30－44；路9‧10－17；約6‧1－14）
12.sry: Ka niirua ta patawutawugan tin, ka niara nein ta vual tin, ka niravak nein ta ana; ka nimukwa banavana ti Yesusan.

13.niv: When Jesus heard what had happened, he withdrew by boat privately to a solitary place. Hearing of this, the crowds followed him on foot from the towns.
13.cmn: 耶穌聽見了，就上船從那裏獨自退到野地裏去。眾人聽見，就從各城裏步行跟隨他。
13.sry: Ka ru ilingigen ti Yesus [ta ana] nitawavang dmarang hina musinag tu pulag tu itu nien; iru ka ilingigen ki makuilalawlaw [ta ata] nitawpurug ta neni tu awmaawma smaladilug tenian.

14.niv: When Jesus landed and saw a large crowd, he had compassion on them and healed their sick.
14.cmn: 耶穌出來，見有許多的人，就憐憫他們，治好了他們的病人。
14.sry: Iru ka tawpapanag ta ti Yesus nikitaan tin ta makuilalawlaw ka mabatung, ka nimararig maharum nenian, ka nipadarikagen tin ta maalam nein.

15.niv: As evening approached, the disciples came to him and said, “This is a remote place, and itʼs already getting late. Send the crowds away, so they can go to the villages and buy themselves some food.”
15.cmn: 天將晚的時候，門徒進前來，說：「這是野地，時候已經過了，請叫眾人散開，他們好往村子裏去，自己買吃的。」
15.sry: Iru ka madung ato, niirua ta patawutawugan tin tenian, kun, Mapawlapawlag ta itukwaan, ka malikaha ato malidawa ta kidi; padarang ato imhuan ta makuilalawlaw, aley ka mukwaa tu awmaawma peyla ki kanaw nein.

16.niv: Jesus replied, “They do not need to go away. You give them something to eat.”
16.cmn: 耶穌說：「不用他們去，你們給他們吃吧！」
16.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Asi peyaapoen ka dmaranga ta neni; pigaey ato ki kakanaw nein ta imumi.

17.niv: “We have here only five loaves of bread and two fish,” they answered.
17.cmn: 門徒說：「我們這裏只有五個餅，兩條魚。」
17.sry: Neni ra nikuma tenian, Ausi kame hiya ki mamang, dik ririma ki paul, duruha apa ki tging.

18.niv: “Bring them here to me,” he said.
18.cmn: 耶穌說：「拿過來給我。」
18.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni, Adey ko ki ana pukwa hiya.

19.niv: And he directed the people to sit down on the grass. Taking the five loaves and the two fish and looking up to heaven, he gave thanks and broke the loaves. Then he gave them to the disciples, and the disciples gave them to the people.
19.cmn: 於是吩咐眾人坐在草地上，就拿着這五個餅，兩條魚，望着天祝福，擘開餅，遞給門徒，門徒又遞給眾人。
19.sry: Ka nipairungen tin ta makuilalawlaw tu kuvul, ka ru niara ta ririma ki paul duruha apa ki tging, tu nipasawvavulumen nipakariyang, ki su; ka ru nipipi tin, nipigaen tin ta paul ki patawutawugan, ka patawutawugan tin [ta nipahatunun] ki makuilalawlaw.

20.niv: They all ate and were satisfied, and the disciples picked up twelve basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
20.cmn: 他們都吃，並且吃飽了，把剩下的零碎收拾起來，裝滿了十二個籃子。
20.sry: Ka nikuimid kman ka mibangtaw ta neni, ka niara nein ki na pipi ka nikda kman, sat kitian ab ki ruha ka lagian ta matmuy.

21.niv: The number of those who ate was about five thousand men, besides women and children.
21.cmn: 吃的人，除了婦女孩子，約有五千。 耶穌在海面上行走 （可6‧45－52；約6‧15－21）
21.sry: Neni ka nikman, na rima katununan lava ta papara, du asi eykun ta inaina ki alalak apa.

22.niv: Immediately Jesus made the disciples get into the boat and go on ahead of him to the other side, while he dismissed the crowd.
22.cmn: 耶穌隨即催門徒上船，先渡到那邊去，等他叫眾人散開。
22.sry: Ka madis nimigarey ta ti Yesus pauavang ki patawutawugan tin pasiuro nenian puarug, du padarangaw tin ta makuilalawlaw.

23.niv: After he had dismissed them, he went up on a mountainside by himself to pray. Later that night, he was there alone,
23.cmn: 散了眾人以後，他就獨自上山去禱告。到了晚上，只有他一人在那裏。
23.sry: Ka ru nipadarangen tin ta makuilalawlaw, nimagdaken muvukin tu saat makualilid. Iru ka madung ato, nimakuisaat tu hynna. Ka ru nipadarangen tin ta makuilalawlaw, nimagdaken muvukin tu saat makualilid. Iru ka madung ato, nimakuisaat tu hina.

24.niv: and the boat was already a considerable distance from land, buffeted by the waves because the wind was against it.
24.cmn: 那時船在海中，因風不順，被浪搖撼。
24.sry: Ka ayatukad ki vaung ta avang, ka niparakuraku ki rungwal; aley ka hmaduma ta vare.

25.niv: Shortly before dawn Jesus went out to them, walking on the lake.
25.cmn: 夜裏四更天，耶穌在海面上走，往門徒那裏去。
25.sry: Ra tu ka apat ki suayam du awvanan, nitudarim mukwa ta ti Yesus munonang hmihalap ki [ralum ka tu] vaung

26.niv: When the disciples saw him walking on the lake, they were terrified. “Itʼs a ghost,” they said, and cried out in fear.
26.cmn: 門徒看見他在海面上走，就驚慌了，說：「是個鬼怪！」便害怕，喊叫起來。
26.sry: Iru ka kmita ta patawutawugan tin ka unonangen tin hmihalap ki vaung, nimiharafhaf ki rig, kun nein, Tubul lava ka ana; ka nihmuhuwahuwaw aley ki takut ta teni.

27.niv: But Jesus immediately said to them: “Take courage! It is I. Donʼt be afraid.”
27.cmn: 耶穌連忙對他們說：「你們放心，是我，不要怕！」
27.sry: Ra madis masusu nenian ta ti Yesus, ka kun tin, Pashuta ki rih, ti yaw ka ata, ynna matakut. Ra madis masusu nenian ta ti Yesus, ka kun tin, Pagshuta ki rig, ti yaw ka ata, ina matakut.

28.niv: “Lord, if itʼs you,” Peter replied, “tell me to come to you on the water.”
28.cmn: 彼得說：「主，如果是你，請叫我從水面上走到你那裏去。」
28.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Petrus kuma tenian, Meyrang, hairu imhu ka ata, dumiaka paukwaey ko imhuan pauhalap ki ralum.

29.niv: “Come,” he said. Then Peter got down out of the boat, walked on the water and came toward Jesus.
29.cmn: 耶穌說：「你來吧。」彼得就從船上下去，在水面上走，要到耶穌那裏去；
29.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni, Ukwaau; ka ru nimurarim ki avang ta ti Petrus, nimunonang hmihalap ki ralum aley ki ukwaey tin ti Yesusan.

30.niv: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid and, beginning to sink, cried out, “Lord, save me!”
30.cmn: 只因見風甚大，就害怕，將要沉下去，便喊着說：「主啊，救我！」
30.sry: Iru ka kitaan tin ta vare ka malig da, matakut ato, ka ru meynaunamu murub, nihmuhuwahuwaw, kuma, Meyrang, kadingu ko.

31.niv: Immediately Jesus reached out his hand and caught him. “You of little faith,” he said, “why did you doubt?”
31.cmn: 耶穌趕緊伸手拉住他，說：「你這小信的人哪，為甚麼疑惑呢？」
31.sry: Iru ka madis sikiskig ta ti rima nihipit tenian, ka nikuma tenian, Using kaw ki tnamisingan, kamang ka nipakaralag kaw ki rig?

32.niv: And when they climbed into the boat, the wind died down.
32.cmn: 他們上了船，風就住了。
32.sry: Ka ru nimagdaken muavang ta neni, palungpung ato ta vare.

33.niv: Then those who were in the boat worshiped him, saying, “Truly you are the Son of God.”
33.cmn: 在船上的人都拜他，說：「你真是上帝的兒子了。」 治好革尼撒勒的病人 （可6‧53－56）
33.sry: Neni ra ka ayaavang nimukwa tmamud tenian, kun, Mising Alak kaw ki Alid.

34.niv: When they had crossed over, they landed at Gennesaret.
34.cmn: 他們過了海，來到革尼撒勒地方。
34.sry: Ka ru tawavang muarug, niirua tu purug ka Genesaret.

35.niv: And when the men of that place recognized Jesus, they sent word to all the surrounding country. People brought all their sick to him
35.cmn: 那裏的人一認出是耶穌，就打發人到周圍地方去，把所有的病人帶到他那裏，
35.sry: Ka ru kalangen ta teni ki papara ki itukwan ka ana, nimadingi tu ritung ki imid ki purug ka tu tamang hina, ka niad nein paukwa tenian ta imid ka maalam.

36.niv: and begged him to let the sick just touch the edge of his cloak, and all who touched it were healed.
36.cmn: 只求耶穌准他們摸他的衣裳繸子；摸着的人就都好了。
36.sry: Ka nitmumimia tenian ka smudika smukla ki na papidpid ki kulamug tin; ka timamang ta nismukla, nipadarikagen.

1.niv: Then some Pharisees and teachers of the law came to Jesus from Jerusalem and asked,
1.cmn: 那時，有法利賽人和文士從耶路撒冷來見耶穌，說：
1.sry: Tu kidi ka ana niirua ti Yesus ta makusasulat ki Farizeen apa ka nimaka Yerusalem, ka kuma,

2.niv: “Why do your disciples break the tradition of the elders? They donʼt wash their hands before they eat!”
2.cmn: 「你的門徒為甚麼犯古人的遺傳呢？因為吃飯的時候，他們不洗手。」
2.sry: Kamang ka kmaarug ta patawutawugan oho ki na pahatatunun ki mamumu, ka asi madinaw ki rima nein, du kmana ki paul?

3.niv: Jesus replied, “And why do you break the command of God for the sake of your tradition?
3.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「你們為甚麼因着你們的遺傳犯上帝的誡命呢？
3.sry: Ra teni ta nimatagivli kuma nenian, Kamang ka kmaarug apa kamu ki pakusuan ki Alid ki na pahatatunun umi?

4.niv: For God said, ‘Honor your father and mother’ and ‘Anyone who curses their father or mother is to be put to death.’
4.cmn: 上帝說：『當孝敬父母』；又說：『咒罵父母的，必治死他。』
4.sry: Ka nimakusu ta Alid, kuma, Miliga kaw ti Amahuen ti Inauhuen: ka, Timamang ta makuavavag ki raraman ki [tin] pakapatayey ta teni.

5.niv: But you say that if anyone declares that what might have been used to help their father or mother is ‘devoted to God,’
5.cmn: 你們倒說：『無論何人對父母說：我所當奉給你的已經作了供獻，
5.sry: Ra kuma kamu ta imumi, Timamang ta kumaa hina ki su ti ama [tinan] ti ina [tinan lava] papapa [ta ana] kamamang ka paputhaney maw kaw, ka asi miliga ki raraman tin lava ki rarenan tin lava, [teni ta mising milig.]

6.niv: they are not to ‘honor their father or mother’ with it. Thus you nullify the word of God for the sake of your tradition.
6.cmn: 他就可以不孝敬父母。』這就是你們藉着遺傳，廢了上帝的誡命。
6.sry: Ka nipahahanino kamu [kumahina ki su] ki nipakusuan ki Alid ki na pahatatunun umi.

7.niv: You hypocrites! Isaiah was right when he prophesied about you:
7.cmn: 假冒為善的人哪，以賽亞指着你們說的預言是不錯的。他說：
7.sry: Imumi ka paninien ki rig ki su, mariyang ta nipatagitanangen ti Esayas imumian, ru kun tin

8.niv: “ ‘These people honor me with their lips, but their hearts are far from me.
8.cmn: 這百姓用嘴唇尊敬我， 心卻遠離我；
8.sry: Muhili yawan ta tau ka ata ki mutus nein, ka lmulug yawan ki bibig nein, ra tintin nein ta itutawag yawan.

9.niv: They worship me in vain; their teachings are merely human rules.’ ”
9.cmn: 他們將人的吩咐當作道理教導人， 所以拜我也是枉然。」
9.sry: Ra sawkinanino tmamud yawan, du matawtawug ki patagitawugan ka na sikakidi ki kagulung.

10.niv: Jesus called the crowd to him and said, “Listen and understand.
10.cmn: 耶穌就叫了眾人來，對他們說：「你們要聽，也要明白。
10.sry: Iru ka nitataamen tin paukwa tenian ta makuilalalaw, nikuma nenian, ilingigaw, umhaaw apa.

11.niv: What goes into someoneʼs mouth does not defile them, but what comes out of their mouth, that is what defiles them.”
11.cmn: 入口的不能污穢人，出口的乃能污穢人。」
11.sry: Ka sararbo ki mutus, asi pakavusuk mahid ki kagulung, ra dik ta ata ka sapapanag tu mutus, ana ta pakavusuk mahid ki kagulung.

12.niv: Then the disciples came to him and asked, “Do you know that the Pharisees were offended when they heard this?”
12.cmn: 當時，門徒進前來對他說：「法利賽人聽見這話，不服，你知道嗎？」
12.sry: Tu kidi ka ana niirua tenian ta patawutawugan tin, ka nikuma tenian, Umhaen hu kawa, ka ru milingig ta Farizeen ki su ka ana, ka nisaisalakuap ta neni pakate nenian?

13.niv: He replied, “Every plant that my heavenly Father has not planted will be pulled up by the roots.
13.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「凡栽種的物，若不是我天父栽種的，必要拔出來。
13.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta teni, kuma, Imid ki na talutalum ka asi nitalum ki Rama aw ka tu vulum, putulaw lato ta ana.

14.niv: Leave them; they are blind guides. If the blind lead the blind, both will fall into a pit.”
14.cmn: 任憑他們吧！他們是瞎眼領路的；若是瞎子領瞎子，兩個人都要掉在坑裏。」
14.sry: Nda amumuaw, tamadilug ka mavuta ta neni ki tau ka mavuta. Hairu madadilug ta mavuta ki mavuta, tu duruhaa muaring tu putu ra.

15.niv: Peter said, “Explain the parable to us.”
15.cmn: 彼得對耶穌說：「請將這比喻講給我們聽。」
15.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Petrus kuma tenian, Patagi misingey kame ki pamikawlaulan ka ana.

16.niv: “Are you still so dull?” Jesus asked them.
16.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們到如今還不明白嗎？
16.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Yesus, Mauru apa kamu kawa ta imumi?

17.niv: “Donʼt you see that whatever enters the mouth goes into the stomach and then out of the body?
17.cmn: 豈不知凡入口的，是運到肚子裏，又落在茅廁裏嗎？
17.sry: Asi apa mumi umhaen, kamamang ka mumutus, ka muvual ka aring tu awvavawungen [ta ana?]

18.niv: But the things that come out of a personʼs mouth come from the heart, and these defile them.
18.cmn: 惟獨出口的，是從心裏發出來的，這才污穢人。
18.sry: Ra kamamang ka maka mutus, sapapanag maka tintin, ka ana apa ta pakavusuk mahid ki kagulung.

19.niv: For out of the heart come evil thoughts—murder, adultery, sexual immorality, theft, false testimony, slander.
19.cmn: 因為從心裏發出來的，有惡念、凶殺、姦淫、苟合、偷盜、妄證、謗讟。
19.sry: Ka maka tintin mupanag ta ndarimdim ka asi mariyang, lalpulpug, uzuzung ki nimakakitil, ki asi nimakakitil, hahailhail, sihaharang, ki vavarbarug apa.

20.niv: These are what defile a person; but eating with unwashed hands does not defile them.”
20.cmn: 這都是污穢人的；至於不洗手吃飯，那卻不污穢人。」 迦南婦人的信心 （可7‧24－30）
20.sry: Ana apa pakavusuk mahid ki kagulung: ra ta avovok ki rima ka asi nipadinaw, asi pakavusuk mahid ki kagulung.

21.niv: Leaving that place, Jesus withdrew to the region of Tyre and Sidon.
21.cmn: 耶穌離開那裏，退到泰爾、西頓的境內去。
21.sry: Iru ka dmarang hina ta ti Yesus nisagkakwa tu upanian ki lbag ki nay ki Tayrus ki Sidon.

22.niv: A Canaanite woman from that vicinity came to him, crying out, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on me! My daughter is demon-possessed and suffering terribly.”
22.cmn: 有一個迦南婦人，從那地方出來，喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我！我女兒被鬼附得甚苦。」
22.sry: Ka kitaey sat ki ina ka tawawma tu Kanaan ta nitmataam makulangag tenian, kuma, Meyrang ka na Alak ti David, kaharumu ko: uluaf ato mulitu ta alak aw ka ina.

23.niv: Jesus did not answer a word. So his disciples came to him and urged him, “Send her away, for she keeps crying out after us.”
23.cmn: 耶穌卻一言不答。門徒進前來，求他說：「這婦人在我們後頭喊叫，請打發她走吧。」
23.sry: Teni ra asi nimatagivli tenian ki sasasat ka su. Ka ru irua ato tenian ta patawutawugan tin, nitmumimia tenian, kun, Padarangaw ta teni, ka makudilug tmataam imitan.

24.niv: He answered, “I was sent only to the lost sheep of Israel.”
24.cmn: 耶穌說：「我奉差遣不過是到以色列家迷失的羊那裏去。」
24.sry: Ra teni ta nimatagivli kuma, Asi ko nipadadingien, dik ka yuko ka ana ka paturumaan ki talag ki Israel.

25.niv: The woman came and knelt before him. “Lord, help me!” she said.
25.cmn: 那婦人來拜他，說：「主啊，幫助我！」
25.sry: Ka nimukwa ta teni tmamud tenian, kuma, Meyrang, Sagkuey ko.

26.niv: He replied, “It is not right to take the childrenʼs bread and toss it to the dogs.”
26.cmn: 他回答說：「不好拿兒女的餅丟給狗吃。」
26.sry: Ka nimatagivli [ta teni] nikuma, Asi mariyang ka haawmiey ta paul ki alalak, aringaney piga ki ata tu asuasuan ka pupu.

27.niv: “Yes it is, Lord,” she said. “Even the dogs eat the crumbs that fall from their masterʼs table.”
27.cmn: 婦人說：「主啊，不錯；但是狗也吃牠主人桌子上掉下來的碎渣兒。」
27.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni, Hahay Meyrang: ka kman apa ta asu na pakuypak ka muaring tu avokan ki Meyreyrang nein.

28.niv: Then Jesus said to her, “Woman, you have great faith! Your request is granted.” And her daughter was healed at that moment.
28.cmn: 耶穌說：「婦人，你的信心是大的！照你所要的，給你成全了吧。」從那時候，她女兒就好了。 治好許多病人
28.sry: Anata nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, kuma tenian, Ano ina, irang ta tnamisingan oho, pavutaw imhuan mama kamuyen hu. Ka nikawdarikag ta alak tin ka ina tu kidi ki tagley ka ana.

29.niv: Jesus left there and went along the Sea of Galilee. Then he went up on a mountainside and sat down.
29.cmn: 耶穌離開那地方，來到靠近加利利的海邊，就上山坐下。
29.sry: Iru ka nimalidawa hina ta ti Yesus, niirua tu tamang ki vaung ki Galilaya, ka ru nimagdaken muvukin, mirung ato hina.

30.niv: Great crowds came to him, bringing the lame, the blind, the crippled, the mute and many others, and laid them at his feet; and he healed them.
30.cmn: 有許多人到他那裏，帶着瘸子、瞎子、啞巴、有殘疾的，和好些別的病人，都放在他腳前；他就治好了他們。
30.sry: Ka mabatung ta makuilalawlaw ka niirua tenian, ka nipatulam nenian ki mapilay, ki mavuta, ki mangupu, ki mapika, ki pani apa ka mararap [ki vual,] ka nisumaki kwa nenian matagiduma tu rapal ti Yesus, ka nipadarikagen ta neni.

31.niv: The people were amazed when they saw the mute speaking, the crippled made well, the lame walking and the blind seeing. And they praised the God of Israel.
31.cmn: 甚至眾人都希奇；因為看見啞巴說話，殘疾的痊癒，瘸子行走，瞎子看見，他們就歸榮耀給以色列的上帝。 耶穌給四千人吃飽 （可8‧1－10）
31.sry: Kuma apa hina, ka nimukiap ta makuilalawlaw du kakitaan nein, ka masusu ta mangupu, ka madarikag ta mapika, ka munonang ta mapilay, ka kmita ta mavuta, ka nipuvavaw ta neni pukeyrangen ki kidi ki Alid ki Israel.

32.niv: Jesus called his disciples to him and said, “I have compassion for these people; they have already been with me three days and have nothing to eat. I do not want to send them away hungry, or they may collapse on the way.”
32.cmn: 耶穌叫門徒來，說：「我憐憫這眾人；因為他們同我在這裏已經三天，也沒有吃的了。我不願意叫他們餓着回去，恐怕在路上困乏。」
32.sry: Iru ka nitataam ti Yesus ta patawutawugan tin, nikuma, Mararig ko maharafhaf ki kaharuman ki makuilalawlaw, aley ka maka turu ki wagi itulam yawan, ka ausi ki mamang ka kanaw nein: ka inang ko padarang nenian ka asi apa mavok, ka asia du matub tu darang da.

33.niv: His disciples answered, “Where could we get enough bread in this remote place to feed such a crowd?”
33.cmn: 門徒說：「我們在這野地，哪裏有這麼多的餅叫這許多人吃飽呢？」
33.sry: Ka nikuma ta patawutawugan tin tenian, Tumang ta kumahina ki dag ki paul tu pulag tu pakavangtawaw mita ta makuilalawlaw ka kumahina ki vatong?

34.niv: “How many loaves do you have?” Jesus asked. “Seven,” they replied, “and a few small fish.”
34.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們有多少餅？」他們說：「有七個，還有幾條小魚。」
34.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Pipina ato ta paul imumian? Ka nikuma ta neni, Pipitu, matiting apa ki tging ka usising.

35.niv: He told the crowd to sit down on the ground.
35.cmn: 他就吩咐眾人坐在地上，
35.sry: Ka nipairungen tin tu nay ta makuilalawlaw.

36.niv: Then he took the seven loaves and the fish, and when he had given thanks, he broke them and gave them to the disciples, and they in turn to the people.
36.cmn: 拿着這七個餅和幾條魚，祝謝了，擘開，遞給門徒；門徒又遞給眾人。
36.sry: Ka ru niara tin ta pipitu ki paul ki tging apa, ka ru nipatubuli tin ki lalululug, nipipi, ka nipigaen tin ki patawutawugan, ra neni apa ka patawutawugan [nipaatunun] ki makuilalawlaw.

37.niv: They all ate and were satisfied. Afterward the disciples picked up seven basketfuls of broken pieces that were left over.
37.cmn: 眾人都吃，並且吃飽了，收拾剩下的零碎，裝滿了七個筐子。
37.sry: Ka nimiimid mavok, ka mibangtaw lato, ka niara nein ilud ki nikda ki na pipi pitu ka lagian ka matmuy ra.

38.niv: The number of those who ate was four thousand men, besides women and children.
38.cmn: 吃的人，除了婦女孩子，共有四千。
38.sry: Ka neni ka nimavok na apat ato katununan ki papara, du asi eykakun ta inaina ki alalak apa.

39.niv: After Jesus had sent the crowd away, he got into the boat and went to the vicinity of Magadan.
39.cmn: 耶穌叫眾人散去，就上船，來到馬加丹的境界。
39.sry: Ka ru nipadarangen tin ta makuilalawlaw, nimagdaken muavang ta teni, ka niirua tu paaputan ki purug ki Magdala.

1.niv: The Pharisees and Sadducees came to Jesus and tested him by asking him to show them a sign from heaven.
1.cmn: 法利賽人和撒都該人來試探耶穌，請他從天上顯個神蹟給他們看。
1.sry: Iru ka irua ato tenian ta Farizeen lam ki Saduseen repung, nitumumimia tenian ka pakitaa nenian ki pukidian ka maka vulum.

2.niv: He replied, “When evening comes, you say, ‘It will be fair weather, for the sky is red,’
2.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「晚上天發紅，你們就說：『天必要晴。』
2.sry: Ra teni ta nimatagivli kuma nenian, Iru ka madung kuma kamu ki su nda, matikanaga lato, aley ka meypuhang ta vulum.

3.niv: and in the morning, ‘Today it will be stormy, for the sky is red and overcast.’ You know how to interpret the appearance of the sky, but you cannot interpret the signs of the times.
3.cmn: 早晨天發紅，又發黑，你們就說：『今日必有風雨。』你們知道分辨天上的氣色，倒不能分辨這時候的神蹟。
3.sry: Du madama, bagyuga, aley ka maipang kivulasun ta vulum. Imumi ka paninien ki rig ki su, umha umi mupiri ki haway ki vulum, ka asi mumi umhaen [mupiri] ki pukidian ki kidi [ki tawil?]

4.niv: A wicked and adulterous generation looks for a sign, but none will be given it except the sign of Jonah.” Jesus then left them and went away.
4.cmn: 一個邪惡淫亂的世代求神蹟，除了約拿的神蹟以外，再沒有神蹟給他看。」耶穌就離開他們去了。 防備法利賽人和撒都該人的酵 （可8‧14－21）
4.sry: Kavuivuilan ka mate ka tamararburbo, tmumimia ki pukidian: ka asi pigaaney nenian ta pukidian dik ki na pukakidi ki tamamatagitan ka ti Yonas. Iru ka ka paitukakwa nenian, nidarangen tin ra.

5.niv: When they went across the lake, the disciples forgot to take bread.
5.cmn: 門徒渡到那邊去，忘了帶餅。
5.sry: Iru ka irua ato ta patawutawugan tin tu said ka tu arug, nihuhingnarupen nein keyul ki paul.

6.niv: “Be careful,” Jesus said to them. “Be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
6.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「你們要謹慎，防備法利賽人和撒都該人的酵。」
6.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, kmita, saukavier ra ki nipeyapingit ki Farizeen ki Saduseen apa.

7.niv: They discussed this among themselves and said, “It is because we didnʼt bring any bread.”
7.cmn: 門徒彼此議論說：「這是因為我們沒有帶餅吧。」
7.sry: Neni ra nipagalaley pagdumdum pagmado nenian, kun, Aley ka asi kita akeyul ki paul [ta ana.]

8.niv: Aware of their discussion, Jesus asked, “You of little faith, why are you talking among yourselves about having no bread?
8.cmn: 耶穌看出來，就說：「你們這小信的人，為甚麼因為沒有餅彼此議論呢？
8.sry: Ka ru umhaen ti Yesus [ta ata] nikun tin nenian, Kamang ta paalaleyan umi pararig, imumi ka using ki tnamisingan, ka asi mumi akeyul ta paul?

9.niv: Do you still not understand? Donʼt you remember the five loaves for the five thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
9.cmn: 你們還不明白嗎？不記得那五個餅分給五千人、又收拾了多少籃子的零碎嗎？
9.sry: Asi apa mumi umhaen, asi mumi pahibaleyen pagdumdum ta ririma ki paul, ki rima katununan [ka papara] ka pipina ka lagian ka nialikugen umi ilud?

10.niv: Or the seven loaves for the four thousand, and how many basketfuls you gathered?
10.cmn: 也不記得那七個餅分給四千人、又收拾了多少筐子的零碎嗎？
10.sry: Ta pipitu apa ki paul, ki apat tatununan [ki papara], ka pipina ka lagian ta nialikugen umi ilud?

11.niv: How is it you donʼt understand that I was not talking to you about bread? But be on your guard against the yeast of the Pharisees and Sadducees.”
11.cmn: 我對你們說：『要防備法利賽人和撒都該人的酵』，這話不是指着餅說的，你們怎麼不明白呢？」
11.sry: Mamamang ka asi mumi umhaen, ka asi maw kamu nipasusuun ki paul, [ru nikwaau kamu] ka saukaviera kamu ki nipeyapingit ki Farizeen ki Saduseen apa?

12.niv: Then they understood that he was not telling them to guard against the yeast used in bread, but against the teaching of the Pharisees and Sadducees.
12.cmn: 門徒這才曉得他說的不是叫他們防備餅的酵，乃是防備法利賽人和撒都該人的教訓。 彼得認耶穌為基督 （可8‧27－30；路9‧18－21）
12.sry: Anata umhaen nein, ka asi nikuma, ka saukaviera ki nipeyapingit ki paulra, ki patawutawugan apa ki Farizeen ki Saduseen.

13.niv: When Jesus came to the region of Caesarea Philippi, he asked his disciples, “Who do people say the Son of Man is?”
13.cmn: 耶穌到了凱撒利亞‧腓立比的境內，就問門徒說：「人說我－－人子是誰？」
13.sry: Ka du iruaan ti Yesus tu kidi ki purug ki Sesareya ka na ti Filipus, nitumalig ki patawutawugan tin, kun, Timang kuma yawan ta tau, ka Alak ko ki kagulung ti yaw

14.niv: They replied, “Some say John the Baptist; others say Elijah; and still others, Jeremiah or one of the prophets.”
14.cmn: 他們說：「有人說是施洗的約翰；有人說是以利亞；又有人說是耶利米或是先知裏的一位。」
14.sry: Ka nikuma ta neni, Ta ruma, ka ti Yoanes [kaw] ka na tamaawlug, ta ruma, ka ti Eliyas [kaw], ta rumara ka ti Yeremiyas [kaw], ki saat lava ki na tamamatagitan.

15.niv: “But what about you?” he asked. “Who do you say I am?”
15.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們說我是誰？」
15.sry: Nikuma nenian, Imumi ra, timang kuma kamu yawan

16.niv: Simon Peter answered, “You are the Messiah, the Son of the living God.”
16.cmn: 西門‧彼得回答說：「你是基督，是永生上帝的兒子。」
16.sry: Nimatagivlien ti Simon Petrus, ka kuma, Ti Kristus kaw, ka Alak ki Alid ka mawag.

17.niv: Jesus replied, “Blessed are you, Simon son of Jonah, for this was not revealed to you by flesh and blood, but by my Father in heaven.
17.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「西門‧巴‧約拿，你是有福的！因為這不是屬血肉的指示你的，乃是我在天上的父指示的。
17.sry: Ka ru matagivli ta ti Yesus nikuma tenian, tamatagiriyang kaw Simon Bar Yona: aley ka asi paumha ato ki ata imhuan ta vaat ki gamag, ra Raman apa maw ka itutunun ki vuluvulum.

18.niv: And I tell you that you are Peter, and on this rock I will build my church, and the gates of Hades will not overcome it.
18.cmn: 我還告訴你，你是彼得，我要把我的教會建造在這磐石上；陰間的權柄不能勝過他。
18.sry: Ka kun apa kaw ka ti Petrus kaw, ka tu halap ki Petra ka ata peyshutey maw meyringey pakuisalan aw, ka asi tumununa ki ata ta ngataf ki kalawhawan.

19.niv: I will give you the keys of the kingdom of heaven; whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.”
19.cmn: 我要把天國的鑰匙給你，凡你在地上所捆綁的，在天上也要捆綁；凡你在地上所釋放的，在天上也要釋放。」
19.sry: Ka piganey maw kaw ta agawalilib ki Peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum: ka kamamang ka vawutaw imhu tu nay, vawutaney ato tu tunun ki vuluvulum. Ra kamamang ka aawvavawutey imhu tu nay, aawvavawutey tu tunun ki vuluvulum.

20.niv: Then he ordered his disciples not to tell anyone that he was the Messiah.
20.cmn: 當下，耶穌囑咐門徒，不可對人說他是基督。 耶穌預言受難和復活 （可8‧31－9‧1；路9‧22－27）
20.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nimavag ki patawutawugan tin, ka asi banavanaa timamangan ka ti Yesus ta teni ka ti Kristus

21.niv: From that time on Jesus began to explain to his disciples that he must go to Jerusalem and suffer many things at the hands of the elders, the chief priests and the teachers of the law, and that he must be killed and on the third day be raised to life.
21.cmn: 從此，耶穌才指示門徒，他必須上耶路撒冷去，受長老、祭司長、文士許多的苦，並且被殺，第三日復活。
21.sry: Tu kidi apa ka ana nimeynaunamu ta ti Yesus vanavana ki patatawutawugan tin, ka kidi ato ki darangey tin mukwa tu Yerusalem, ka tubha ki madag nenian ka mamumu [ki tau,] ka sibavaw ka tamapigik, ka makusasulat, ka pakapatayaw, ka patimawagey apa tu ka taturu ki wagi.

22.niv: Peter took him aside and began to rebuke him. “Never, Lord!” he said. “This shall never happen to you!”
22.cmn: 彼得就拉着他，勸他說：「主啊，萬不可如此！這事必不臨到你身上。」
22.sry: Iru ka nipatulam tenian ta ti Petrus, nikuma naunamu matimha tenian, kun, Meyrang maharuma imhuan, asi pavawutaw ta ata imhuan.

23.niv: Jesus turned and said to Peter, “Get behind me, Satan! You are a stumbling block to me; you do not have in mind the concerns of God, but merely human concerns.”
23.cmn: 耶穌轉過來，對彼得說：「撒但，退我後邊去吧！你是絆我腳的；因為你不體貼上帝的意思，只體貼人的意思。」
23.sry: Ra teni ru nimaawduma tenian, nikuma ti Petrusan, Dmaranga tamamakuduma murikur yawan, ka parawraw kaw yawan: ka asi kaw pagarupit pagdumdum ka a'tu Alid: dik ka a'tu kagulung da

24.niv: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “Whoever wants to be my disciple must deny themselves and take up their cross and follow me.
24.cmn: 於是耶穌對門徒說：「若有人要跟從我，就當捨己，背起他的十字架來跟從我。
24.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nikuma ta ti Yesus ki patawutawugan tin, Timamang ta mamuy maawug mukwa yawan da, rmawa mado tenian, maraa ka navavarag tin, ka smaladiluga yawan.

25.niv: For whoever wants to save their life will lose it, but whoever loses their life for me will find it.
25.cmn: 因為，凡要救自己生命的，必喪掉生命；凡為我喪掉生命的，必得着生命。
25.sry: Ka timamang ta mamuy hmamia ki kawagan tin, patarumaa ki ana: ra timamang ta patarumaa ato ki kawagan tin aley yawan, smuvaleya ki ana.

26.niv: What good will it be for someone to gain the whole world, yet forfeit their soul? Or what can anyone give in exchange for their soul?
26.cmn: 人若賺得全世界，賠上自己的生命，有甚麼益處呢？人還能拿甚麼換生命呢？
26.sry: Ka aku tan ki mang ta kagulung, ka paputanen tin tenian ta imid ki nay, ru mahavung ki vati tin? Kamanga lato lava ta papapa ki tau, ka paviriey ki vati tin?

27.niv: For the Son of Man is going to come in his Fatherʼs glory with his angels, and then he will reward each person according to what they have done.
27.cmn: 人子要在他父的榮耀裏，同着眾使者降臨；那時候，他要照各人的行為報應各人。
27.sry: Ka kumaa ato hina ka iruaa ta Alak ki kagulung tu keyrangan ki kidi ki ki Rama tin lam ki tamagnaw tin, ka tu kidi ka ana pahavlia ki maybuvual ki na pungas tin.

28.niv: “Truly I tell you, some who are standing here will not taste death before they see the Son of Man coming in his kingdom.”
28.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，站在這裏的，有人在沒嘗死味以前必看見人子降臨在他的國裏。」
28.sry: Dilig kun aw kamu ra, akumeya ta raruma ki mituko hiya, ka asi kdimana ki kapatayan, tu kidi apa ka ana ka kitaey ato nein ta Alak ki kagulung irua tu peysasuan tin.

1.niv: After six days Jesus took with him Peter, James and John the brother of James, and led them up a high mountain by themselves.
1.cmn: 過了六天，耶穌帶着彼得、雅各，和雅各的兄弟約翰，暗暗地上了高山，
1.sry: Ka tu awug ki anim ki wagi nipatulam ta ti Yesus tenian ti Petrusan, ti Yakobusan, ti Yoanesan apa, ka nidilug tin puni nenian tu vukin ka mahandag.

2.niv: There he was transfigured before them. His face shone like the sun, and his clothes became as white as the light.
2.cmn: 就在他們面前變了形像，臉面明亮如日頭，衣裳潔白如光。
2.sry: Ka nisilala ta haway tin tu amag nenian: ka nimatikanag ta vlung tin mama ki wagi, ka nimipule ta pamian tin mama ramag.

3.niv: Just then there appeared before them Moses and Elijah, talking with Jesus.
3.cmn: 忽然，有摩西、以利亞向他們顯現，同耶穌說話。
3.sry: Ka kitaey, ka nikitaan nein ta ti Moses, ti Eliyas apa matagitavag tenian.

4.niv: Peter said to Jesus, “Lord, it is good for us to be here. If you wish, I will put up three shelters—one for you, one for Moses and one for Elijah.”
4.cmn: 彼得對耶穌說：「主啊，我們在這裏真好！你若願意，我就在這裏搭三座棚，一座為你，一座為摩西，一座為以利亞。」
4.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Petrus kuma ti Yesusan, Meyrang, mariyang ta ayakwaan eta, hiya Hairu mamuy kaw, nda meyringey eta hiya tuturu ki rata, a'muhoa ta sasat, a'Mosesa ta sasat, a'Eliyasa ta sasat.

5.niv: While he was still speaking, a bright cloud covered them, and a voice from the cloud said, “This is my Son, whom I love; with him I am well pleased. Listen to him!”
5.cmn: 說話之間，忽然有一朵光明的雲彩遮蓋他們，且有聲音從雲彩裏出來，說：「這是我的愛子，我所喜悅的。你們要聽他！」
5.sry: Tu pasusuen apa tin, kitaey, ta purarey ka maramag ka nitmamurap nenian. Ka kitaey ta ingaw ka maka purarey, kun, Ti ata ta Alak aw ka kavagangen aw ka kamawen aw ta teni, milingiga tenian.

6.niv: When the disciples heard this, they fell facedown to the ground, terrified.
6.cmn: 門徒聽見，就俯伏在地，極其害怕。
6.sry: Ka ru ilingigen [ta ata] ki patawutawugan, nidmangus ki vulung nein, ka uhang ta neni ki takut.

7.niv: But Jesus came and touched them. “Get up,” he said. “Donʼt be afraid.”
7.cmn: 耶穌進前來，摸他們，說：「起來，不要害怕！」
7.sry: Iru ka irua ato ta ti Yesus, nismukla nenian, kun, gapita, ina matakut.

8.niv: When they looked up, they saw no one except Jesus.
8.cmn: 他們舉目不見一人，只見耶穌在那裏。
8.sry: Iru ka nipapasawvavaw ki mata nein, asi nein nikitaan ta sasasat ka timamang, dik ti Yesusan ka itusat.

9.niv: As they were coming down the mountain, Jesus instructed them, “Donʼt tell anyone what you have seen, until the Son of Man has been raised from the dead.”
9.cmn: 下山的時候，耶穌吩咐他們說：「人子還沒有從死裏復活，你們不要將所看見的告訴人。」
9.sry: Iru ka tdarim ta neni tu vukin, nisikidi nenian ta ti Yesus, kun, Ina banavana ki saat ki vual ki kihaweyan [ka ata,] tu kidi apa ka gapita ato ta Alak ki kagulung ki nikapatayan tin

10.niv: The disciples asked him, “Why then do the teachers of the law say that Elijah must come first?”
10.cmn: 門徒問耶穌說：「文士為甚麼說以利亞必須先來？」
10.sry: Ka nitmalig tenian ta patawutawugan tin, kuma, Mang kun ki makusasulat, ka kidi ato ka siuroa irua ta ti Eliyas?

11.niv: Jesus replied, “To be sure, Elijah comes and will restore all things.
11.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「以利亞固然先來，並要復興萬事；
11.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian: Siuroa irua ta ti Eliyas, ka palikuga pagapit ki mamang.

12.niv: But I tell you, Elijah has already come, and they did not recognize him, but have done to him everything they wished. In the same way the Son of Man is going to suffer at their hands.”
12.cmn: 只是我告訴你們，以利亞已經來了，人卻不認識他，竟任意待他。人子也將要這樣受他們的害。」
12.sry: Ra pasusuen aw kamu, ka makaha ato irua ta ti Eliyas, ka asi nein nikalangen tenian: ra nipamuten nein tenian ta mamang ka nikamuyen nein. Kuma apa hina papahialalamey nein ta Alak ki kagulung.

13.niv: Then the disciples understood that he was talking to them about John the Baptist.
13.cmn: 門徒這才明白耶穌所說的是指着施洗的約翰。 治好被鬼附身的孩子 （可9‧14－29；路9‧37－43）
13.sry: Anata niumhaen ki patawutawugan ka nimatagimimia nenian ti Yoanesan ka na tamaawlug.

14.niv: When they came to the crowd, a man approached Jesus and knelt before him.
14.cmn: 耶穌和門徒到了眾人那裏，有一個人來見耶穌，跪下，
14.sry: Ka tu ukakun nein tu makuilalawlaw, niirua tenian ta sat ki vual, ka matalikurug tu duma tenian, nikuma.

15.niv: “Lord, have mercy on my son,” he said. “He has seizures and is suffering greatly. He often falls into the fire or into the water.
15.cmn: 說：「主啊，憐憫我的兒子！他害癲癇的病很苦，屢次跌在火裏，屢次跌在水裏。
15.sry: Meyrang, Kaharumaw ta alak aw, ka pisburavural piskupang mapatay, ka pagilaluaf pagialalam: ka vunavuney muaring tu apuy, vunavuney apa tu ralum.

16.niv: I brought him to your disciples, but they could not heal him.”
16.cmn: 我帶他到你門徒那裏，他們卻不能醫治他。」
16.sry: Ka niadaw ta teni paukwa tu patawutawugan hu, ka asi nein palpugen tenian padarikag.

17.niv: “You unbelieving and perverse generation,” Jesus replied, “how long shall I stay with you? How long shall I put up with you? Bring the boy here to me.”
17.cmn: 耶穌說：「噯！這又不信又悖謬的世代啊，我在你們這裏要到幾時呢？我忍耐你們要到幾時呢？把他帶到我這裏來吧！」
17.sry: Ka ru matagivli ta ti Yesus, nikun tin, Aleya ki kavavualan ka asi tnamising ka m aparit, maka manga ko ki dalia ka tulama ko imumian? Makamanga ki dalia ka tububuganey maw kamu? Ad ato hiya ta teni paukwa yawan.

18.niv: Jesus rebuked the demon, and it came out of the boy, and he was healed at that moment.
18.cmn: 耶穌斥責那鬼，鬼就出來；從此孩子就痊癒了。
18.sry: Ka nimatimha tenian ta ti Yesus, ka nidmarang ta litu tenian, ka padarikag ato, ta raway tu patukidian ka ana ki tagley.

19.niv: Then the disciples came to Jesus in private and asked, “Why couldnʼt we drive it out?”
19.cmn: 門徒暗暗地到耶穌跟前，說：「我們為甚麼不能趕出那鬼呢？」
19.sry: Tu kidi ka ana ru nihmani irua ti Yesusan ta patawutawugan, ka nikun nein, Kamang ka asi kame ta imian nismakilpug smakipapanag tenian?

20.niv: He replied, “Because you have so little faith. Truly I tell you, if you have faith as small as a mustard seed, you can say to this mountain, ‘Move from here to there,’ and it will move. Nothing will be impossible for you.”
20.cmn: 耶穌說：「是因你們的信心小。我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心，像一粒芥菜種，就是對這座山說：『你從這邊挪到那邊』，它也必挪去；並且你們沒有一件不能做的事了。
20.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Aley ki kawruan umi tnamising: dilig kun aw kamu ra, iru na hay mamama ki tugtu ki suhay ta tnamisingan umi, ina kamu banavana ki vukin ka ata, dmaranga hiya mukwa hina, ka dmaranga mukwa: ka ausia ato ki mamang ka asi mumi inanangey meylpug.

21.cmn: 至於這一類的鬼，若不禱告、禁食，他就不出來 。」 耶穌第二次預言受難和復活 （可9‧30－32；路9‧43－45）
21.sry: Ra kidi ki nanang ka ata asi padarangen, dik ki pakualiliden ki irikuten apa.

22.niv: When they came together in Galilee, he said to them, “The Son of Man is going to be delivered into the hands of men.
22.cmn: 他們還住在加利利的時候，耶穌對門徒說：「人子將要被交在人手裏。
22.sry: Tu hikakuan nein [munonang] tu Galilaya, nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, paatununey ta Alak ki kagulung tu rima ki kagulung.

23.niv: They will kill him, and on the third day he will be raised to life.” And the disciples were filled with grief.
23.cmn: 他們要殺害他，第三日他要復活。」門徒就大大地憂愁。 繳納殿稅
23.sry: Ka pakapatayatenian, ka papatimawagaw tu kataturu ki wagi. Ka uhang mivulas ta nein.

24.niv: After Jesus and his disciples arrived in Capernaum, the collectors of the two-drachma temple tax came to Peter and asked, “Doesnʼt your teacher pay the temple tax?”
24.cmn: 到了迦百農，有收丁稅的人來見彼得，說：「你們的先生不納丁稅嗎？」
24.sry: Ka tu ukakun nein tu Kapernaum, nimukwa ti Petrusan ta tamaimug ki didragma, ka nikuma, Asi kawa pudaaw ki didragma ta tamamatawtawug imumian?

25.niv: “Yes, he does,” he replied. When Peter came into the house, Jesus was the first to speak. “What do you think, Simon?” he asked. “From whom do the kings of the earth collect duty and taxes—from their own children or from others?”
25.cmn: 彼得說：「納。」他進了屋子，耶穌先向他說：「西門，你的意思如何？世上的君王向誰征收關稅、丁稅？是向自己的兒子呢？是向外人呢？」
25.sry: Nikun tin, Hahay. Ka ru nimurbo tu talag, nimaawro masusu tenian ta ti Yesus, ka nikun tin, Pagmang kaw pagdumdum Simon? Mara na mangan ta sibavaw meysasu ki nay ki putanagen pudawag ki aimugan lava? Ki alak nein kawa? ki raruma kawa?

26.niv: “From others,” Peter answered. “Then the children are exempt,” Jesus said to him.
26.cmn: 彼得說：「是向外人。」耶穌說：「既然如此，兒子就可以免稅了。
26.sry: Nikuma ta ti Petrus tenian, Ki raruma. Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Anata taganino ta alak asi pudawag.

27.niv: “But so that we may not cause offense, go to the lake and throw out your line. Take the first fish you catch; open its mouth and you will find a four-drachma coin. Take it and give it to them for my tax and yours.”
27.cmn: 但恐怕觸犯他們，你且往海邊去釣魚，把先釣上來的魚拿起來，開了牠的口，必得一塊錢，可以拿去給他們，作你我的稅銀。」
27.sry: Ra aley ka asi mita pasaisalakuap ta neni, muvaunga, paheyriringaney ta heyring, ka araw ta tging kamu uro muvavaw, ka ru tiafaw ta mutus tin, kabaleyaw muho ta Stater [ka malituk:] araw ta ana, ka pigaaney ato nenian aley yawan, aley apa imhuan.

1.niv: At that time the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Who, then, is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven?”
1.cmn: 當時，門徒進前來，問耶穌說：「天國裏誰是最大的？」
1.sry: Tu kidi ki tagley ka ana nimukwa ta patawutawugan ti Yesusan, kuma, Timang ta siuro tu vavaw ki kidi tu peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum?

2.niv: He called a little child to him, and placed the child among them.
2.cmn: 耶穌便叫一個小孩子來，使他站在他們當中，
2.sry: Ka ru nitataam ti Yesus ta using ka raway paukwa tenian, nipaitukwa tenian paitutukad nenian.

3.niv: And he said: “Truly I tell you, unless you change and become like little children, you will never enter the kingdom of heaven.
3.cmn: 說：「我實在告訴你們，你們若不回轉，變成小孩子的樣式，斷不得進天國。
3.sry: Ka nikuma, Dilig kun aw kamu, hairu asi kamu silala mamikawlawla ki raraway, madaawa asi kamu murboa tu peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum.

4.niv: Therefore, whoever takes the lowly position of this child is the greatest in the kingdom of heaven.
4.cmn: 所以，凡自己謙卑像這小孩子的，他在天國裏就是最大的。
4.sry: Timamang ta pumadoa purarim tenian ki kidi mama ki raway ka ata, teni ta tu vavaw ki keyrangan tu peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum.

5.niv: And whoever welcomes one such child in my name welcomes me.
5.cmn: 凡為我的名接待一個像這小孩子的，就是接待我。」 罪的誘惑 （可9‧42－48；路17‧1－2）
5.sry: Timamang apa ta maawmitatalag ki raway ka kumahina tu nanang aw, teni ta maawmitatalag yawan.

6.niv: “If anyone causes one of these little ones—those who believe in me—to stumble, it would be better for them to have a large millstone hung around their neck and to be drowned in the depths of the sea.
6.cmn: 「凡使這信我的一個小子跌倒的，倒不如把大磨石拴在這人的頸項上，沉在深海裏。
6.sry: Ra timamang ta pasaisalakuapa [pakavaraw] ki saaat ki using ka ata ka tnamising yawan, masaun mariyang tenian ka pukakudey ki vato ki papuhuden ta rig tin, ka paurukidaw tu kalawhawan ki vaung.

7.niv: Woe to the world because of the things that cause people to stumble! Such things must come, but woe to the person through whom they come!
7.cmn: 這世界有禍了，因為將人絆倒；絆倒人的事是免不了的，但那絆倒人的有禍了！
7.sry: Alay ki nay alay ki pasaisalakuapen pakavaraw: ra kidi ato ka iruaa ta pasaisalakuapen pakavaraw: Ra alay ki tau ka pairua ki pasaisalakuapen pakavaraw.

8.niv: If your hand or your foot causes you to stumble, cut it off and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life maimed or crippled than to have two hands or two feet and be thrown into eternal fire.
8.cmn: 倘若你一隻手，或是一隻腳，叫你跌倒，就砍下來丟掉。你缺一隻手，或是一隻腳，進入永生，強如有兩手兩腳被丟在永火裏。
8.sry: Hairu ka pakavaraw imhuan ta rima oho lava, ki rapal apa muho lava, lukutaw, aringaney smakitawag imhuan. Masaun mariyang imhuan murbo ki kawagan ru mapilay kaw lava, ru mapika kaw lava, ra ka ruruha kaw ki rima lava, ruruha ki rapal lava, aringaney ato smakikwa tu apuy ka mikakwa midarinug.
