9.niv: And if your eye causes you to stumble, gouge it out and throw it away. It is better for you to enter life with one eye than to have two eyes and be thrown into the fire of hell.
9.cmn: 倘若你一隻眼叫你跌倒，就把它剜出來丟掉。你只有一隻眼進入永生，強如有兩隻眼被丟在地獄的火裏。」 迷羊的比喻 （路15‧3－7）
9.sry: Hairu ka pakavaraw imhuan ta mata oho, kuma da, aringaney imhuan. Masaun mariyang imhuan ka idi kaw ki mata murboa tu kawagan, ka ruruha kaw ki mata sakikwaaney tu apuy ki kalawhawan.

10.niv: “See that you do not despise one of these little ones. For I tell you that their angels in heaven always see the face of my Father in heaven.
10.cmn: 「你們要小心，不可輕看這小子裏的一個；我告訴你們，他們的使者在天上，常見我天父的面。
10.sry: Kitaey ka asi kamu murunga ki saaat ki using ka ana: ka pasusuenaw kamu, ka mikakwa mararaw ta tamagnaw nein ki vulung ki rama aw, ka tu tunun ki vuluvulum.

11.sry: Ka irua ato ta Alak ki kagulung tu pakariyangey ki ata ka nitawruma ato.

12.niv: “What do you think? If a man owns a hundred sheep, and one of them wanders away, will he not leave the ninety-nine on the hills and go to look for the one that wandered off?
12.cmn: 一個人若有一百隻羊，一隻走迷了路，你們的意思如何？他豈不撇下這九十九隻，往山裏去找那隻迷路的羊嗎？
12.sry: Pagmang kamu pagdumdum, hairu akumeya ta timamang ki tau sat kaatugan ki yuko, ka ru miaruma ato lava ki sasat ki ata, asi kawa paitukakwaey tin ta matuda kitian ab ki matuda, ka ru muvukivukin, asi kawa kmiima ki miaruma ato ka ana?

13.niv: And if he finds it, truly I tell you, he is happier about that one sheep than about the ninety-nine that did not wander off.
13.cmn: 若是找着了，我實在告訴你們，他為這一隻羊歡喜，比為那沒有迷路的九十九隻歡喜還大呢！
13.sry: Ka ru kuma ato hina ka pakivaleyen tin ta ata: Dilig kun aw kamu ra, ka masaun maray aley ki ana, ki matuda kitian ab ki matuda, ka asi nimiaruma.

14.niv: In the same way your Father in heaven is not willing that any of these little ones should perish.
14.cmn: 你們在天上的父也是這樣，不願意這小子裏失喪一個。」 如何對待犯過錯的弟兄
14.sry: Kuma apa hina asi kamuyen ki Raraman umi ka tu tunun ki vuluvulum, ka tawrumaa ta saaat ki using ka ata.

15.niv: “If your brother or sister sins, go and point out their fault, just between the two of you. If they listen to you, you have won them over.
15.cmn: 「倘若你的弟兄得罪你，你就去，趁着只有他和你在一處的時候，指出他的錯來。他若聽你，你便得了你的弟兄；
15.sry: Ka ru nimavaraw lava imhuan ta tagiapaparag oho, ukwa matimha makutavag tenian tu sinag tu saat imumian: Hairu milingig ta teni imhuan, dumiaka niputanen hu ta tagiapaparag oho.

16.niv: But if they will not listen, take one or two others along, so that ‘every matter may be established by the testimony of two or three witnesses.’
16.cmn: 他若不聽，你就另外帶一兩個人同去，要憑兩三個人的口作見證，句句都可定準。
16.sry: Iru ra asi milingig ta teni imhuan, dumiaka patupara imhuan ki saat lava ki ruruha lava ki vual, aley ka itushuta ato itukwa ta imid ki su tu mutus ki raruha ki taturu lava ki tamahail.

17.niv: If they still refuse to listen, tell it to the church; and if they refuse to listen even to the church, treat them as you would a pagan or a tax collector.
17.cmn: 若是不聽他們，就告訴教會；若是不聽教會，就看他像外邦人和稅吏一樣。
17.sry: Ka ru asi milingiga nenian, ana ta banavana ato ki pakuisalan: ka ru asi apa milingiga ki pakuisalan, ana ta mameya lato ta teni imhuan mama ki Heydang ki tamaimug.

18.niv: “Truly I tell you, whatever you bind on earth will be bound in heaven, and whatever you loose on earth will be loosed in heaven.
18.cmn: 「我實在告訴你們，凡你們在地上所捆綁的，在天上也要捆綁；凡你們在地上所釋放的，在天上也要釋放。
18.sry: Dilig kun aw kamu ra: Kamamang ka vawutaw umi tu nay, vawutey ta ana tu tunun ki vulum: kamamang apa ka aawvavawutey umi tu nay, aawvavawutey ta ana tu tunun ki vulum.

19.niv: “Again, truly I tell you that if two of you on earth agree about anything they ask for, it will be done for them by my Father in heaven.
19.cmn: 我又告訴你們，若是你們中間有兩個人在地上同心合意地求甚麼事，我在天上的父必為他們成全。
19.sry: Mila pasusuen aw kamu, Hairu maawakla ki rig ta ruruha ki vual imumian tu nay, aley ki mamang ka tmimiaw nein, hahayey nenian ki Raraman aw ka tu tunun ki vuluvulum.

20.niv: For where two or three gather in my name, there am I with them.”
20.cmn: 因為無論在哪裏，有兩三個人奉我的名聚會，那裏就有我在他們中間。」 不饒恕人的惡僕
20.sry: Ka tumamang ta mawisal ato raruha lava taturu lava ki vual tu Nanang aw, ayatukad ko hina nenian.

21.niv: Then Peter came to Jesus and asked, “Lord, how many times shall I forgive my brother or sister who sins against me? Up to seven times?”
21.cmn: 那時，彼得進前來，對耶穌說：「主啊，我弟兄得罪我，我當饒恕他幾次呢？到七次可以嗎？」
21.sry: Tu kidi ka ana irua ato tenian ta ti Petrus, ka nikuma, Meyrang, mapinana mavaraw yawan ta tagiapaparag aw, ki ataraley maw tenian? Matagi pitu kawa?

22.niv: Jesus answered, “I tell you, not seven times, but seventy-seven times.
22.cmn: 耶穌說：「我對你說，不是到七次，乃是到七十個七次。
22.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian Asiko matagipitu kuma imhuan, ra saupitu apa kitian saupitu.

23.niv: “Therefore, the kingdom of heaven is like a king who wanted to settle accounts with his servants.
23.cmn: 天國好像一個王要和他僕人算帳。
23.sry: Aley ki ata, ka papamikawlawlaan ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum ki sibavaw ka meysasu, ka mamuy meysal kting ki kuncia tenian.

24.niv: As he began the settlement, a man who owed him ten thousand bags of gold was brought to him.
24.cmn: 才算的時候，有人帶了一個欠一千萬銀子的來。
24.sry: Iru ka maynaunamu kutung ta teni, niaden tenian saat ki vual ka kawitingen sat kitian katununan ki Talenten.

25.niv: Since he was not able to pay, the master ordered that he and his wife and his children and all that he had be sold to repay the debt.
25.cmn: 因為他沒有甚麼償還之物，主人吩咐把他和他妻子兒女，並一切所有的都賣了償還。
25.sry: Iru ka ausi ki pudadaaw ta teni, nimadingi ta Meyrang ka papeylaaney ta teni, ta keyan tin, ta alalak tin, ki mamang apa ka a'teni, tu pahavlien pahamising pudaaw [ki kawitingen ka ana.]

26.niv: “At this the servant fell on his knees before him. ‘Be patient with me,’ he begged, ‘and I will pay back everything.’
26.cmn: 那僕人就俯伏拜他，說：『主啊，寬容我，將來我都要還清。』
26.sry: Ka ru mahakub ta kuncia, nireip tenian, kun, Meyrang mayamila apa yawan, pahaimidey maw kaw pudaaw.

27.niv: The servantʼs master took pity on him, canceled the debt and let him go.
27.cmn: 那僕人的主人就動了慈心，把他釋放了，並且免了他的債。
27.sry: Iru ka mararig ato maharum ta meyrang ki kuncia ka ana, niataral tenian mataginino ki kawitingen.

28.niv: “But when that servant went out, he found one of his fellow servants who owed him a hundred silver coins. He grabbed him and began to choke him. ‘Pay back what you owe me!’ he demanded.
28.cmn: 「那僕人出來，遇見他的一個同伴欠他十兩銀子，便揪着他，掐住他的喉嚨，說：『你把所欠的還我！』
28.sry: Iru ra tawpapanag ta kuncia ka ana, nikabaley tin ta saat ki kuncia ka na lam tin, ka kawitingen tin sat kaatugan ki malituk, ka ru mihakub, nimeyseyud ki rig tenian, kun, Pudaawa yawan ki kawiting aw imhuan

29.niv: “His fellow servant fell to his knees and begged him, ‘Be patient with me, and I will pay it back.’
29.cmn: 他的同伴就俯伏央求他，說：『寬容我吧，將來我必還清。』
29.sry: Anata ru mahakub ta na lam tin ka kuncia tu rapal tin, nitmumimia tenian, kun, Mayamila apa yawan, ka pahaimidey maw kaw pudaaw.

30.niv: “But he refused. Instead, he went off and had the man thrown into prison until he could pay the debt.
30.cmn: 他不肯，竟去把他下在監裏，等他還了所欠的債。
30.sry: Ra niinang ta teni: ka ru dmarang nipukwa tenian tu sangat, tu kidi apa ka ana ka pudaawaney tin ta kawitingan.

31.niv: When the other servants saw what had happened, they were outraged and went and told their master everything that had happened.
31.cmn: 眾同伴看見他所做的事就甚憂愁，去把這事都告訴了主人。
31.sry: Du kakitaan ki kuncia ka lalam tin ki nipamuten, uhang nimivulas ta nein, ka ru irua, nivanavana ki meyrang nein ki mamang nipamuten ato ra.

32.niv: “Then the master called the servant in. ‘You wicked servant,’ he said, ‘I canceled all that debt of yours because you begged me to.
32.cmn: 於是主人叫了他來，對他說：『你這惡奴才！你央求我，我就把你所欠的都免了，
32.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nitataam ta teni paukwa tenian ki meyrang tin, ka nikuma tenian, Kuncia ka mate, niataninoen aw kaw ataral imid ki nikawitingen aw ka ana, aley ka nitmumimia kaw yawan.

33.niv: Shouldnʼt you have had mercy on your fellow servant just as I had on you?’
33.cmn: 你不應當憐恤你的同伴，像我憐恤你嗎？』
33.sry: Ina muho kawa kaharuma ta kuncia ka na lam oho, mama ki kaharumen aw imhuan?

34.niv: In anger his master handed him over to the jailers to be tortured, until he should pay back all he owed.
34.cmn: 主人就大怒，把他交給掌刑的，等他還清了所欠的債。
34.sry: Ka ru mangale ta meyrang tin, nipaatununun tin tenian ki tamakahawut, tu kidi lapa ka ana ka pudaawaney tin ta imid ki mamang ka kawitingen tin tenian.

35.niv: “This is how my heavenly Father will treat each of you unless you forgive your brother or sister from your heart.”
35.cmn: 你們各人若不從心裏饒恕你的弟兄，我天父也要這樣待你們了。」
35.sry: Hmey kuma lapa hina imumian ta Raraman aw ka ayatunun ki vulum, ru asi kamu matararig ta maybuvual ataral ki tagiapaparag umi ki varaw nein.

1.niv: When Jesus had finished saying these things, he left Galilee and went into the region of Judea to the other side of the Jordan.
1.cmn: 耶穌說完了這些話，就離開加利利，來到猶太的境界約旦河外。
1.sry: Ka nikuma ato hina, ru nimatagikaha matagilimulimu ki su ka ata ta ti Yesus, ka nidmarang tawhabul tu Galilaya, ka niirua muarug ki Yordan tu paaputan ki Yudea.

2.niv: Large crowds followed him, and he healed them there.
2.cmn: 有許多人跟着他，他就在那裏把他們的病人治好了。
2.sry: Ka nimaawug tenian ta mabatung ki makuilalawlaw, ka nipadarikag tin nenian tu hina.

3.niv: Some Pharisees came to him to test him. They asked, “Is it lawful for a man to divorce his wife for any and every reason?”
3.cmn: 有法利賽人來試探耶穌，說：「人無論甚麼緣故都可以休妻嗎？」
3.sry: Ka niirua tenian ta Farizeen ki repunga tenian, kuma, Hahayen kawa ta tau padarangen ki keyan tin aley ki mamang?

4.niv: “Havenʼt you read,” he replied, “that at the beginning the Creator ‘made them male and female,’
4.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「那起初造人的，是造男造女，
4.sry: Nda nimatagivli ta teni kuma nenian, Asi mumi lava nikting, ka teni ka nimeyringey [ki kagulung], ka nipeyringey tin nenian ta parag ta ina?

5.niv: and said, ‘For this reason a man will leave his father and mother and be united to his wife, and the two will become one flesh’ ?
5.cmn: 並且說：『因此，人要離開父母，與妻子連合，二人成為一體。』這經你們沒有念過嗎？
5.sry: Ka nikuma apa, Aley ki ana dmaranga ta tau ki rama ki rena, ka sawlama ki keyan tin, ka raruha ka ana sasata ki vaat.

6.niv: So they are no longer two, but one flesh. Therefore what God has joined together, let no one separate.”
6.cmn: 既然如此，夫妻不再是兩個人，乃是一體的了。所以，上帝配合的，人不可分開。」
6.sry: Kuma hina ka asi raruha ta neni, nda dik sasat ki vaat. Ana ka nipapasal ki Alid asi papagpiagaw ki kagulung.

7.niv: “Why then,” they asked, “did Moses command that a man give his wife a certificate of divorce and send her away?”
7.cmn: 法利賽人說：「這樣，摩西為甚麼吩咐給妻子休書，就可以休她呢？」
7.sry: Nikuma [ta neni] tenian, Kamang ka nipakusuen ti Moses ka pigaaney ta sulat ki padadaradarang, ka padarangaw ta teni [ka keyan ki parag?]

8.niv: Jesus replied, “Moses permitted you to divorce your wives because your hearts were hard. But it was not this way from the beginning.
8.cmn: 耶穌說：「摩西因為你們的心硬，所以許你們休妻，但起初並不是這樣。
8.sry: Nikuma [ta teni] nenian, Nihahayen kamu ti Moses aley ki tihag umi ki tintin ka padaranga kamu ki keyan umi: Ra asi nikumahina tu naunamu.

9.niv: I tell you that anyone who divorces his wife, except for sexual immorality, and marries another woman commits adultery.”
9.cmn: 我告訴你們，凡休妻另娶的，若不是為淫亂的緣故，就是犯姦淫了；有人娶那被休的婦人，也是犯姦淫了。」
9.sry: Ra kun aw kamu, timamang ta padarang ki keyan tin, du asi aley ki kaveyungan, ka maya ki pani, rburbo ato ra, ka timamang ta maya ki nipadarang, rburbo[ apa ra.]

10.niv: The disciples said to him, “If this is the situation between a husband and wife, it is better not to marry.”
10.cmn: 門徒對耶穌說：「人和妻子既是這樣，倒不如不娶。」
10.sry: Nikuma tenian ta patawutawugan tin, Hairu kumahina ta kidi ki kagulung ki keyan tin, asi mariyang ka mayaa.

11.niv: Jesus replied, “Not everyone can accept this word, but only those to whom it has been given.
11.cmn: 耶穌說：「這話不是人都能領受的，惟獨賜給誰，誰才能領受。
11.sry: Teni ra nikuma nenian, Asi pahimid pahibaley ki su ka ata, dik nenian ka nipigaan ato.

12.niv: For there are eunuchs who were born that way, and there are eunuchs who have been made eunuchs by others—and there are those who choose to live like eunuchs for the sake of the kingdom of heaven. The one who can accept this should accept it.”
12.cmn: 因為有生來是閹人，也有被人閹的，並有為天國的緣故自閹的。這話誰能領受就可以領受。」 耶穌為小孩祝福 （可10‧13－16；路18‧15－17）
12.sry: Ka akumeya ato ki niahap, ka nipeyalaken kumahina ki vuil ki rena [nein]: ka akumeya niahap ka niahap ki kagulung: ka akumeya apa ki nimahap nenian tagimado aley ki peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum. Timamang ta pahilpug pahibaley [ki ata] pahibaley ato.

13.niv: Then people brought little children to Jesus for him to place his hands on them and pray for them. But the disciples rebuked them.
13.cmn: 那時，有人帶着小孩子來見耶穌，要耶穌給他們按手禱告，門徒就責備那些人。
13.sry: Tu kidi ka ana niad paukwa tenian ta raraway ka atahalapey tin ta rima nenian, tu pakualiliden: nda nipatimhaen ta neni ki patawutawugan.

14.niv: Jesus said, “Let the little children come to me, and do not hinder them, for the kingdom of heaven belongs to such as these.”
14.cmn: 耶穌說：「讓小孩子到我這裏來，不要禁止他們；因為在天國的，正是這樣的人。」
14.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Yesus, Surunganey ta raraway, ina mavag nenian paukwa yawan: aley ka a'neni ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum.

15.niv: When he had placed his hands on them, he went on from there.
15.cmn: 耶穌給他們按手，就離開那地方去了。 少年財主 （可10‧17－31；路18‧18－30）
15.sry: Iru ka niatahalapen tin ta rima nenian, nitawhabul ta teni dmarang hina.

16.niv: Just then a man came up to Jesus and asked, “Teacher, what good thing must I do to get eternal life?”
16.cmn: 有一個人來見耶穌，說：「夫子，我該做甚麼善事才能得永生？」
16.sry: Ka kitaey, ka saat [ki vual] ta nimukwa ka nikuma tenian, Tamamatawtawug ka mariyang, pamutaw maw ta riyang ki mang, tu akumeyaey maw ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug?

17.niv: “Why do you ask me about what is good?” Jesus replied. “There is only One who is good. If you want to enter life, keep the commandments.”
17.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「你為甚麼以善事問我呢？只有一位是善的。你若要進入永生，就當遵守誡命。」
17.sry: Nikuma ta teni tenian, Ka mang ta pananangen oho yawan ka mariyang? Ausi ta timamang ka mariyang, dik sasat ki Alid. Hairu mamuy kaw murbo tu kawagan, nda akwaaw ta na su ki nipakusuen [tu tatuko.]

18.niv: “Which ones?” he inquired. Jesus replied, “ ‘You shall not murder, you shall not commit adultery, you shall not steal, you shall not give false testimony,
18.cmn: 他說：「甚麼誡命？」耶穌說：「就是不可殺人；不可姦淫；不可偷盜；不可作假見證；
18.sry: Nikuma ta teni tenian, Su ka mang? Nda nikuma ta ti Yesus [Ata:] Asi kaw lpuga: Asi kaw muzuzunga ki nimakakitil: Asi kaw hauzunga: Asi kaw gmaila sihaharang.

19.niv: honor your father and mother,’ and ‘love your neighbor as yourself.’ ”
19.cmn: 當孝敬父母；又當愛人如己。」
19.sry: Milingiga kaw ti amawhuen ti inahuen: ka mavagangoa kaw ki tau ka raruma mama mamado imhuan.

20.niv: “All these I have kept,” the young man said. “What do I still lack?”
20.cmn: 那少年人說：「這一切我都遵守了，還缺少甚麼呢？」
20.sry: Nikuma tenian ta kawpapara, Imidenaw milingig ta mamang ka ata ki na kararaway aw: Ka mang ta ausi apa yawan?

21.niv: Jesus answered, “If you want to be perfect, go, sell your possessions and give to the poor, and you will have treasure in heaven. Then come, follow me.”
21.cmn: 耶穌說：「你若願意作完全人，可去變賣你所有的，分給窮人，就必有財寶在天上；你還要來跟從我。」
21.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Iru mamuy kaw mananag, ukwaa, pasaduma ki mamang oho, ka pigaey ato ki malimuk, ka akumeyaa kaw ki vangey tu tunun ki vulum: ka mukwaa hiya, maawug yawan da.

22.niv: When the young man heard this, he went away sad, because he had great wealth.
22.cmn: 那少年人聽見這話，就憂憂愁愁地走了，因為他的產業很多。
22.sry: Iru ka milingig ki su ka ata ta kawpapara, nidmarang ta teni mavulas, aley ka akumeya tenian ki madag ki hurup.

23.niv: Then Jesus said to his disciples, “Truly I tell you, it is hard for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of heaven.
23.cmn: 耶穌對門徒說：「我實在告訴你們，財主進天國是難的。
23.sry: Nda nikuma ta ti Yesus ki patawutawugan tin, Mising kun aw kamu ra, ka mahugfpit ta mavangey murbo tu peysasuan ki tunun ki vulum.

24.niv: Again I tell you, it is easier for a camel to go through the eye of a needle than for someone who is rich to enter the kingdom of God.”
24.cmn: 我又告訴你們，駱駝穿過針的眼，比財主進上帝的國還容易呢！」
24.sry: Ka hilaen aw kamu masusu, Ka siuro hmahay ta luwang ka makgun ki rikur tawkwa tu lbas ki simsim, ka murboa ta mavangey tu peysasuan ki Alid.

25.niv: When the disciples heard this, they were greatly astonished and asked, “Who then can be saved?”
25.cmn: 門徒聽見這話，就希奇得很，說：「這樣誰能得救呢？」
25.sry: Tu ilingigen [ki ata] ki patawutawugan tin, uhang nimukiap ta neni, ka nikuma, Timang ta pakalpugey ru ana pakariyang?

26.niv: Jesus looked at them and said, “With man this is impossible, but with God all things are possible.”
26.cmn: 耶穌看着他們，說：「在人這是不能的，在上帝凡事都能。」
26.sry: Ka du araraw ti Yesus nikuma nenian, Asi peylpugen ta ata tu kagulungan, ra peylpugen imid ki mamang ki Alid.

27.niv: Peter answered him, “We have left everything to follow you! What then will there be for us?”
27.cmn: 彼得就對他說：「看哪，我們已經撇下所有的跟從你，將來我們要得甚麼呢？」
27.sry: Tu kidi ka ana du matagivli ta ti Petrus nikuma tenian, Kitaey, nisawimidan yan sawtawag ki mamang, ka nimuawug kame imhuan: mamanga ato imianan?

28.niv: Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, at the renewal of all things, when the Son of Man sits on his glorious throne, you who have followed me will also sit on twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Israel.
28.cmn: 耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，你們這跟從我的人，到復興的時候，人子坐在他榮耀的寶座上，你們也要坐在十二個寶座上，審判以色列十二個支派。
28.sry: Nda nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Mising kun aw kamu ra, ka imumi ka nimuawug yawan tu peylikug meyalak, ru mirunga ato ta Alak ki kagulung tu irarungan ki tunun ki kararamagan ki kidi tin, ka mirunga apa kamu tu sat kitian ab ki ruha ki irarungan ka tunun pamamag ki sat kitian ab ki ruha ki kavuivuilan ti Israel.

29.niv: And everyone who has left houses or brothers or sisters or father or mother or wife or children or fields for my sake will receive a hundred times as much and will inherit eternal life.
29.cmn: 凡為我的名撇下房屋，或是弟兄、姊妹、父親、母親、兒女、田地的，必要得着百倍，並且承受永生。
29.sry: Ka timamang ta sawtawaga ato ki talag, ki tagiapaparag, ki niaha, ki rama, ki rena, ki keyan, ki alalak, ki umauma lava aley ki nanang aw, teni ta abulia mara ki sat kaatugan, ka tablia apa ki kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug.

30.niv: But many who are first will be last, and many who are last will be first.
30.cmn: 然而，有許多在前的，將要在後；在後的，將要在前。」
30.sry: Ra mabatung ki siurouro ta siaawuga ato, ka mabatung ki siaawug ta siurouroa ato.

1.niv: “For the kingdom of heaven is like a landowner who went out early in the morning to hire workers for his vineyard.
1.cmn: 「因為天國好像家主清早去雇人進他的葡萄園做工，
1.sry: Ka makawla ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum ki meyrang ki satkatalagan, ka nitawpapanag du madama ki papakalalamey tin pauvavaraug tu a'tu ka karawmatagan tin.

2.niv: He agreed to pay them a denarius for the day and sent them into his vineyard.
2.cmn: 和工人講定一天一錢銀子，就打發他們進葡萄園去。
2.sry: Iru ka nimaawmising maawakla ta su tin ki su ki makalama du sasat ki wagi nda, sasata ki malituk, nipaukwa ta teni nenian tu a'tu ka karawmatagan tin.

3.niv: “About nine in the morning he went out and saw others standing in the marketplace doing nothing.
3.cmn: 約在巳初出去，看見市上還有閒站的人，
3.sry: Iru ka nitpananag tu hivat ki kidi ki ka taturu ki tagley, nikitaan tin ta pani ki vual ka mihaung mituko tu panag.

4.niv: He told them, ‘You also go and work in my vineyard, and I will pay you whatever is right.’
4.cmn: 就對他們說：『你們也進葡萄園去，所當給的，我必給你們。』他們也進去了。
4.sry: Ka nikuma nenian, Nda ukwaaw apa imumi tu a'tu ka karawmatagan: ra kamamang ki patagitiktikey, pigaey maw kamu ra. Ka nimukwa ta neni.

5.niv: So they went. “He went out again about noon and about three in the afternoon and did the same thing.
5.cmn: 約在午正和申初又出去，也是這樣行。
5.sry: Iru ka nimila tpapanang tu hivat ki kaanim ki kamamatuda apa ki tagley, makawla nipaukwa tin

6.niv: About five in the afternoon he went out and found still others standing around. He asked them, ‘Why have you been standing here all day long doing nothing?’
6.cmn: 約在酉初出去，看見還有人站在那裏，就問他們說：『你們為甚麼整天在這裏閒站呢？』
6.sry: Iru ra nitawpapanag tu hivat ki kasasatkitian ab ki sat ki tagley, nikabaley tin ta raruma ka pani ka mihaung mituko, ka nikuma nenian, Kamang ta mihaung kamu mituko hiya maka sat ki wagi?

7.niv: “ ‘Because no one has hired us,’ they answered. “He said to them, ‘You also go and work in my vineyard.’
7.cmn: 他們說：『因為沒有人雇我們。』他說：『你們也進葡萄園去。』
7.sry: Nikuma tenian, Aley ka asi kame niudan ki saaat. Nikuma ta teni nenian, Ukwaaw apa imumi tu a'tu ka karawmatagan, kamamang ka patagitiktikey, araw umi ra

8.niv: “When evening came, the owner of the vineyard said to his foreman, ‘Call the workers and pay them their wages, beginning with the last ones hired and going on to the first.’
8.cmn: 到了晚上，園主對管事的說：『叫工人都來，給他們工錢，從後來的起，到先來的為止。』
8.sry: Iru ka madung ato, nikuma ta meyrang ki a'tu ka karawmatagan ki sikwa tin pudaaw, Tataamaw ki makalalam, nda pigaey ato ki tanan nein ki niuvaraugan, pahauro nenian ka nisiawug pahakidi apa ki nisiuro.

9.niv: “The workers who were hired about five in the afternoon came and each received a denarius.
9.cmn: 約在酉初雇的人來了，各人得了一錢銀子。
9.sry: Nda iru ka nimukwa ta nipapakalalam pauvaraug tu hivat ki ka sasat kitian ab sat ki tagley, niasasat mara ki malituk ta saaat ki vual.

10.niv: So when those came who were hired first, they expected to receive more. But each one of them also received a denarius.
10.cmn: 及至那先雇的來了，他們以為必要多得；誰知也是各得一錢。
10.sry: Iru ka mukwa ta nisiuro, nipurig ki asauney nein mara, ka neni apa ta saaat nimara ki sasat ki malituk.

11.niv: When they received it, they began to grumble against the landowner.
11.cmn: 他們得了，就埋怨家主說：
11.sry: Ka ru akaha mara [ki ana,] nimaawrmur ato ki tagitalag.

12.niv: ‘These who were hired last worked only one hour,’ they said, ‘and you have made them equal to us who have borne the burden of the work and the heat of the day.’
12.cmn: 『我們整天勞苦受熱，那後來的只做了一小時，你竟叫他們和我們一樣嗎？』
12.sry: Kun, Nisiawug ka ata nimudik muvaraug ki saat ki tagley, ka nipapamikawlawlawen hu ta neni imianan ka nitbugan yan ta mahimko ki maalting ka wagi.

13.niv: “But he answered one of them, ‘I am not being unfair to you, friend. Didnʼt you agree to work for a denarius?
13.cmn: 家主回答其中的一人說：『朋友，我不虧負你，你與我講定的不是一錢銀子嗎？
13.sry: Teni ra nimatagivli kuma ki saat nenian, Diu, asi ko paatukol imhuan. nimaawakla kaw yawan ki su ki sasat ki malituk?

14.niv: Take your pay and go. I want to give the one who was hired last the same as I gave you.
14.cmn: 拿你的走吧！我給那後來的和給你一樣，這是我願意的。
14.sry: Araaw ta aimhua, nda dmarang ato. Mamuy ko ki nisiawug ka ata pahamakawlawla piga imhuan.

15.niv: Donʼt I have the right to do what I want with my own money? Or are you envious because I am generous?’
15.cmn: 我的東西難道不可隨我的意思用嗎？因為我作好人，你就紅了眼嗎？』
15.sry: Asi ko kawa hahayen ka sikununga ko ki a'yaw? Asi lava mariyang ta mata hu aley ka mariyang ko?

16.niv: “So the last will be first, and the first will be last.”
16.cmn: 這樣，那在後的，將要在前；在前的，將要在後了。 」 耶穌第三次預言受難和復活 （可10‧32－34；路18‧31－34）
16.sry: Kuma hina siuroa ta siawug, ka siawuga ta siuro. Ka madag ta nitataam, ra matiting ta niperi.

17.niv: Now Jesus was going up to Jerusalem. On the way, he took the Twelve aside and said to them,
17.cmn: 耶穌上耶路撒冷去的時候，在路上把十二個門徒帶到一邊，對他們說：
17.sry: Ka ru nivavaw ta ti Yesus muYerusalem, nipatulalam tin sat kitian ab ki duha ki patawutawugan tin patusinag tu darang, ka nikuma nenian,

18.niv: “We are going up to Jerusalem, and the Son of Man will be delivered over to the chief priests and the teachers of the law. They will condemn him to death
18.cmn: 「看哪，我們上耶路撒冷去，人子要被交給祭司長和文士。他們要定他死罪，
18.sry: Kitaey muvavaw kita muYerusalem, ka paatununaney ta Alak ki kagulung ki sibavaw ki tamapigik ki makusasulat apa, ka dmungdunga tenian ki pakapatayey.

19.niv: and will hand him over to the Gentiles to be mocked and flogged and crucified. On the third day he will be raised to life!”
19.cmn: 又交給外邦人，將他戲弄，鞭打，釘在十字架上；第三日他要復活。」 母親的請求 （可10‧35－45）
19.sry: Ka paatununa tenian ki Heydang tu urungey, tu angatey, tu punavavaragey da, tu ka taturu ki wagi likuga ta teni gapit.

20.niv: Then the mother of Zebedeeʼs sons came to Jesus with her sons and, kneeling down, asked a favor of him.
20.cmn: 那時，西庇太兒子的母親同她兩個兒子上前來拜耶穌，求他一件事。
20.sry: Tu kidi ka ana irua ato tenian ta rarenan ki alalak ti Zebedeyus lam ki alalak tin, tu pakualiliden tu tmimien apa ki mamang tenian.

21.niv: “What is it you want?” he asked. She said, “Grant that one of these two sons of mine may sit at your right and the other at your left in your kingdom.”
21.cmn: 耶穌說：「你要甚麼呢？」她說：「願你叫我這兩個兒子在你國裏，一個坐在你右邊，一個坐在你左邊。」
21.sry: Teni ra nikuma tenian, mang ta kamuyen hu? Nikuma tenian, Pasusuey ka mirunga ta raruha ka alalak aw ka ata, ka saata tu uwal oho, ka saata tu ugi oho tu peysasuan oho.

22.niv: “You donʼt know what you are asking,” Jesus said to them. “Can you drink the cup I am going to drink?” “We can,” they answered.
22.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「你們不知道所求的是甚麼；我將要喝的杯，你們能喝嗎？」他們說：「我們能。」
22.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, nikuma, Asi kamu mavana ka mang ta tmimian umi: Mulpug kamu kawa mit ki hawug ka itaw maw? tagawlpugen kamu kawa mawlug ki awlugan ka awlugey ko? Nikuma tenian, Mulpug kame, tagawlpugen kame.

23.niv: Jesus said to them, “You will indeed drink from my cup, but to sit at my right or left is not for me to grant. These places belong to those for whom they have been prepared by my Father.”
23.cmn: 耶穌說：「我所喝的杯，你們必要喝；只是坐在我的左右，不是我可以賜的，乃是我父為誰預備的，就賜給誰。」
23.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, Ndaha mita kamu ki hawug aw, awlugey kamu ki awlugan ka awlugey ko, ra pairungen tu uwal aw tu ugi apa maw asi maw sikakwan ta pigaan, ra [pigaey] nenian ka nisitanun ti Rama aw.

24.niv: When the ten heard about this, they were indignant with the two brothers.
24.cmn: 那十個門徒聽見，就惱怒他們弟兄二人。
24.sry: Iru ka milingig ta sat kitian [ka raruma ki ata] uhang nitnavaingbing ki raruha ka matatagiapaparag.

25.niv: Jesus called them together and said, “You know that the rulers of the Gentiles lord it over them, and their high officials exercise authority over them.
25.cmn: 耶穌叫了他們來，說：「你們知道外邦人有君王為主治理他們，有大臣操權管束他們。
25.sry: Ka ru nitmataam ta ti Yesus nenian paukwa tenian, nikuma, Kavanaan umi ka sibavaw ki tautau ta meysasu nenian, ka meyreyrang ta sikakwa ki kailgan nenian.

26.niv: Not so with you. Instead, whoever wants to become great among you must be your servant,
26.cmn: 只是在你們中間，不可這樣；你們中間誰願為大，就必作你們的用人；
26.sry: Ra asi kumaa hina imumian: ra timamang imumian ta mamuya kawirangen ki kidi, teni ta pairungaw umi.

27.niv: and whoever wants to be first must be your slave—
27.cmn: 誰願為首，就必作你們的僕人。
27.sry: Ka timamang ta mamuya siuro imumian, teni ta kuncia ato umi ra

28.niv: just as the Son of Man did not come to be served, but to serve, and to give his life as a ransom for many.”
28.cmn: 正如人子來，不是要受人的服事，乃是要服事人，並且要捨命，作多人的贖價。」 治好兩個瞎子 （可10‧46－52；路18‧35－43）
28.sry: Mama ka asi irua ato ta Alak ki kagulung tu irungey tenian, ra tu sawmadoey tin mirung, ka pigaey apa ta vati tin tu tagilien mivli ki mabatung.

29.niv: As Jesus and his disciples were leaving Jericho, a large crowd followed him.
29.cmn: 他們出耶利哥的時候，有極多的人跟隨他。
29.sry: Nda iru ka tawpapanag ta neni tu Yeriko, nimaawug tenian ta makuilalawlaw ka mabatung.

30.niv: Two blind men were sitting by the roadside, and when they heard that Jesus was going by, they shouted, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
30.cmn: 有兩個瞎子坐在路旁，聽說是耶穌經過，就喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」
30.sry: Ka kitaey ta raruha ki mavuta ka mirung tu said ki darang, iru ka milingig ka hmarivat ta ti Yesus, nimakulangag tmataam kumakwa, Meyrang ka na Alak ti David, maharum ato imianan.

31.niv: The crowd rebuked them and told them to be quiet, but they shouted all the louder, “Lord, Son of David, have mercy on us!”
31.cmn: 眾人責備他們，不許他們作聲；他們卻越發喊着說：「主啊，大衛的子孫，可憐我們吧！」
31.sry: Ra nimatimha ta makuilalawlaw nenian, ka maipata ta neni, ra nimakusaun apa makutun makulangag ta neni, matagikumahina, Maharuma imianan, Meyrang ka na Alak ti David.

32.niv: Jesus stopped and called them. “What do you want me to do for you?” he asked.
32.cmn: 耶穌就站住，叫他們來，說：「要我為你們做甚麼？」
32.sry: Ka ru rikaw mituko ta ti Yesus, nitmataam nenian, kuma, Mang ta kamuyen umi ka peyringeyaney maw kamu?

33.niv: “Lord,” they answered, “we want our sight.”
33.cmn: 他們說：「主啊，要我們的眼睛能看見！」
33.sry: Nikuma ta neni tenian, Meyrang, ka parkilataw ta mata yan

34.niv: Jesus had compassion on them and touched their eyes. Immediately they received their sight and followed him.
34.cmn: 耶穌就動了慈心，把他們的眼睛一摸，他們立刻看見，就跟從了耶穌。
34.sry: Iru ka maimid maharafhaf ki na mavavohak ta ti Yesus [aley ki kaharuman,] nismukla ki mata nein, ka madis nikmita ta mata nein, ka nimaawug ta neni tenian.

1.niv: As they approached Jerusalem and came to Bethphage on the Mount of Olives, Jesus sent two disciples,
1.cmn: 耶穌和門徒將近耶路撒冷，到了伯法其，在橄欖山那裏。
1.sry: Iru ka nimuhili ki Yerusalem ta neni, niirua ki Bethfage, tu vukin ka makavavua ki imag, ana ta nipadadingien ti Yesus ta raruha ki patawutawugan tin, ka nikuma nenian

2.niv: saying to them, “Go to the village ahead of you, and at once you will find a donkey tied there, with her colt by her. Untie them and bring them to me.
2.cmn: 耶穌就打發兩個門徒，對他們說：「你們往對面村子裏去，必看見一匹驢拴在那裏，還有驢駒同在一處；你們解開，牽到我這裏來。
2.sry: Ukwaaw ta awma ka ana ka maiduma imumian, ra pakidisey umi makivaley ta luwang ka haava ka ipu ka na kakirig, ka aku lam ki patak: aawkakirigey mad yawan.

3.niv: If anyone says anything to you, say that the Lord needs them, and he will send them right away.”
3.cmn: 若有人對你們說甚麼，你們就說：『主要用牠。』那人必立時讓你們牽來。
3.sry: Nda iru ka aku su ta timamang imumian, kumaa kamu hina ra, mayaapa ki ana ta Meyrang: ka patudisey tin madingi ta ana.

4.niv: This took place to fulfill what was spoken through the prophet:
4.cmn: 這事成就是要應驗先知的話，說：
4.sry: Nipaimiden pavutaw ta mamang ka ata, aley ka pavawutaw ta na su ki tamamatagitan, ka kuma,

5.niv: “Say to Daughter Zion, ‘See, your king comes to you, gentle and riding on a donkey, and on a colt, the foal of a donkey.’ ”
5.cmn: 要對錫安的居民說： 看哪，你的王來到你這裏， 是溫柔的，又騎着驢， 就是騎着驢駒子。」
5.sry: Vanavanaey ta tatatimian ki Sion: kitaey, iraruruwa ta Meysasu ka Sibavaw mukwa imhuan, mahapug ki rig, ka pahaavaan ki luwang ka ipu, ki patak ki ipu ka aku paden.

6.niv: The disciples went and did as Jesus had instructed them.
6.cmn: 門徒就照耶穌所吩咐的去行，
6.sry: Iru ka dmarang ta patawutawugan da, nipamuten nein mama ki na sikakidi ti Yesus nenian.

7.niv: They brought the donkey and the colt and placed their cloaks on them for Jesus to sit on.
7.cmn: 牽了驢和驢駒來，把自己的衣服搭在上面，耶穌就騎上。
7.sry: Niad nein ta luwang ka ipu lam ki patak tin, ka niatahabilen ki ana ta kulamug nein, ka nipagialaley nein tenian ana.

8.niv: A very large crowd spread their cloaks on the road, while others cut branches from the trees and spread them on the road.
8.cmn: 眾人多半把衣服鋪在路上；還有人砍下樹枝來鋪在路上。
8.sry: Ka uhang ki batung ta makuilalawlaw nimapag ki kulamug nein tu darang, ka raruma ta nitmagta ki pehil ki paranag, ka nihavuluen nein ta ana tu darang.

9.niv: The crowds that went ahead of him and those that followed shouted, “Hosanna to the Son of David!” “Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord!” “Hosanna in the highest heaven!”
9.cmn: 前行後隨的眾人喊着說： 和散那歸於大衛的子孫！ 奉主名來的是應當稱頌的！ 高高在上和散那！
9.sry: Ka makuilalawlaw ka ana ka siururo ka siaawawug ta nimakulangag, kumakwa, Hosana ki Alak ti David: pakuriyangaw lmulug ta irarurua tu Nanang ti YEHOVA: Hosana tu situnun sibavaw ki vuluvulum.

10.niv: When Jesus entered Jerusalem, the whole city was stirred and asked, “Who is this?”
10.cmn: 耶穌既進了耶路撒冷，合城都驚動了，說：「這是誰？」
10.sry: Iru ka sararbo ta teni tu Yerusalem, nirumumang ta sat kaawmaan, ka nikuma, Timang ta ti ata?

11.niv: The crowds answered, “This is Jesus, the prophet from Nazareth in Galilee.”
11.cmn: 眾人說：「這是加利利拿撒勒的先知耶穌。」 潔淨聖殿 （可11‧15－19；路19‧45－48；約2‧13－22）
11.sry: Ka nikuma ta makuilalawlaw, Ti ata ta ti Yesus, ka tamamatagitan ka maka Nazareth ka tu Galilaya.

12.niv: Jesus entered the temple courts and drove out all who were buying and selling there. He overturned the tables of the money changers and the benches of those selling doves.
12.cmn: 耶穌進了上帝的殿，趕出殿裏一切做買賣的人，推倒兌換銀錢之人的桌子，和賣鴿子之人的凳子，
12.sry: Ka nimukuva tu kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid ta ti Yesus, ka aimid tin matuntun ta papeyla ki peyla apa tu kuva ki tatamudan, ka nipapaawtukagen tin ta tupal ki tamamaviri ki malituk, ki taul apa ki tam apapeyla ki padaug.

13.niv: “It is written,” he said to them, “ ‘My house will be called a house of prayer,’ but you are making it ‘a den of robbers.’ ”
13.cmn: 對他們說：「經上記着說： 我的殿必稱為禱告的殿， 你們倒使它成為賊窩了。」
13.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni nenian, nisulaten ato: Talag aw ta pananangey talag ki pakualiliden, ra nipeyringey umi ta ata ki varinga ki tamalpug.

14.niv: The blind and the lame came to him at the temple, and he healed them.
14.cmn: 在殿裏有瞎子、瘸子到耶穌跟前，他就治好了他們。
14.sry: Ka niirua tenian mukuva tu kuva ki tatamudan ta mavuta ki mapilay apa, ka nipadarikag tin nenian.

15.niv: But when the chief priests and the teachers of the law saw the wonderful things he did and the children shouting in the temple courts, “Hosanna to the Son of David,” they were indignant.
15.cmn: 祭司長和文士看見耶穌所行的奇事，又見小孩子在殿裏喊着說：「和散那歸於大衛的子孫！」就甚惱怒，
15.sry: Nda iru ka kmita ta tamapigik ka sibavaw ki makusasulat apa ki nipauringaw ka ringey tin, ki raraway apa ka makulangag tmataam tu kuva ki tatamudan, ka kuma, Hosana ki Alak ti David, uhang tnagpang ato.

16.niv: “Do you hear what these children are saying?” they asked him. “Yes,” replied Jesus, “have you never read, “ ‘From the lips of children and infants you, Lord, have called forth your praise’ ?”
16.cmn: 對他說：「這些人所說的，你聽見了嗎？」耶穌說：「是的。經上說『你從嬰孩和吃奶的口中完全了讚美』的話，你們沒有念過嗎？」
16.sry: Ka nikuma tenian, Ilingigen hu kawa magkuma su ta neni? Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Hahay ra. Asi umi lava nimikakwaan kting, tu mutus ki vahaw ka raway ki mauho apa nisitanang oho ta lulugan?

17.niv: And he left them and went out of the city to Bethany, where he spent the night.
17.cmn: 於是離開他們，出城到伯大尼去，在那裏住宿。 咒詛無花果樹 （可11‧12－14，20－24）
17.sry: Ka ru paitukakwa nenian, nidmarang tu awma mukwa tu Bethania, ka nimiuley hina ra.

18.niv: Early in the morning, as Jesus was on his way back to the city, he was hungry.
18.cmn: 早晨回城的時候，他餓了，
18.sry: Ka madama apa du salikug muawma, nimagangey ta teni.

19.niv: Seeing a fig tree by the road, he went up to it but found nothing on it except leaves. Then he said to it, “May you never bear fruit again!” Immediately the tree withered.
19.cmn: 看見路旁有一棵無花果樹，就走到跟前，在樹上找不着甚麼，不過有葉子，就對樹說：「從今以後，你永不結果子。」那無花果樹就立刻枯乾了。
19.sry: Nda iru ka kitaan tin sat ka ngaraan ka lakawungen tu said ki darang, nimukwa ta teni hina, ka asi nikabaley tin tu [ngara] ka ana dik ka hapa. Ka nikuma ki ana, Mikakwaa kaw asi makavua tu idarinugan. Ka nimadis milaklak ta lakawungen.

20.niv: When the disciples saw this, they were amazed. “How did the fig tree wither so quickly?” they asked.
20.cmn: 門徒看見了，便希奇說：「無花果樹怎麼立刻枯乾了呢？」
20.sry: Iru ka kitaan [ta ana] ki patawutawugan nimukiapato ra, ka nikun nein, Nismum ato mamamang milaklak ta lakawungen?

21.niv: Jesus replied, “Truly I tell you, if you have faith and do not doubt, not only can you do what was done to the fig tree, but also you can say to this mountain, ‘Go, throw yourself into the sea,’ and it will be done.
21.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「我實在告訴你們，你們若有信心，不疑惑，不但能行無花果樹上所行的事，就是對這座山說：『你挪開此地，投在海裏！』也必成就。
21.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian, Mising kun aw kamu ra, Iru akumeya kamu ki tnamisingan da tu asi pagdalagen ki rig, ina kamu asi dik pamuta ka nipamut ki lakawungen, nda hairu pasusuey umi ki vukin ka ata, paleyaw ka aringaney tu vaung, pamutaw lato ka ana.

22.niv: If you believe, you will receive whatever you ask for in prayer.”
22.cmn: 你們禱告，無論求甚麼，只要信，就必得着。」 質問耶穌的權柄 （可11‧27－33；路20‧1－8）
22.sry: Nda imid ki mamang ka tmumiaw umi tu pakualiliden, ru tnamising kamu, arawaw umi ta ana.

23.niv: Jesus entered the temple courts, and, while he was teaching, the chief priests and the elders of the people came to him. “By what authority are you doing these things?” they asked. “And who gave you this authority?”
23.cmn: 耶穌進了殿，正教訓人的時候，祭司長和民間的長老來問他說：「你仗着甚麼權柄做這些事？給你這權柄的是誰呢？」
23.sry: Nda du ukuvaen tin ki kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, niirua tenian, du mapungas matawtawug ki tamapigik ka sibavaw lam ki mamumu ka meyreyrang ki tau, ka kuma, Tu keyrangan timang ta pamuten hu ta ata? Ka timang ta nipiga imhuan ki keyrangan ka ana ki kidi?

24.niv: Jesus replied, “I will also ask you one question. If you answer me, I will tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
24.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「我也要問你們一句話，你們若告訴我，我就告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。
24.sry: Nimatagivli ta ti Yesus kuma nenian, Talig apa maw kamu ki sasat ki su, hairu vanavanaa kamu ki ata yawan nda, vanavanaa ko imumian tu keyrangan timang ka pamuten aw ta ata.

25.niv: Johnʼs baptism—where did it come from? Was it from heaven, or of human origin?” They discussed it among themselves and said, “If we say, ‘From heaven,’ he will ask, ‘Then why didnʼt you believe him?’
25.cmn: 約翰的洗禮是從哪裏來的？是從天上來的？是從人間來的呢？」他們彼此商議說：「我們若說『從天上來』，他必對我們說：『這樣，你們為甚麼不信他呢？』
25.sry: Nda na aawlug ti Yoanes maka kuna ka ana? Maka tunun kawa? Maka nay kawa? Nda nipagdmir pagalaley pagrarig, Hairu maka tunun kuma ta su yan, matagikumaa hina imianan, Kamang ka asi kamu nitnamising tenian?

26.niv: But if we say, ‘Of human origin’—we are afraid of the people, for they all hold that John was a prophet.”
26.cmn: 若說『從人間來』，我們又怕百姓，因為他們都以約翰為先知。」
26.sry: Iru ra maka kagulung kun yan, Anata katakuten yan ta makuilalawlaw: aley ka tamamatagitan da imid nikwa nein ti Yoanesan.

27.niv: So they answered Jesus, “We donʼt know.” Then he said, “Neither will I tell you by what authority I am doing these things.
27.cmn: 於是回答耶穌說：「我們不知道。」耶穌說：「我也不告訴你們我仗着甚麼權柄做這些事。」 兩個兒子的比喻
27.sry: Nimatagivli ta neni kuma ti Yesusan, Akierey. Nikuma apa ta teni nenian, Ka asi ko vanavanaa imumian, tu kailgan timang ka pamuten aw ta ata.

28.niv: “What do you think? There was a man who had two sons. He went to the first and said, ‘Son, go and work today in the vineyard.’
28.cmn: 又說：「一個人有兩個兒子。他來對大兒子說：『我兒，你今天到葡萄園裏去做工。』
28.sry: Ka pagmang umi pagdumdum? Saat ki vual ka aku alak ki duruha, ka ru ukwaan tin ki naunamu, nikuma, Alak ukwaaw, meyringeya hinin ki wagi ka ata tu a'tu ka karawmatagan aw.

29.niv: “ ‘I will not,’ he answered, but later he changed his mind and went.
29.cmn: 他回答說：『我不去』，以後自己懊悔，就去了。
29.sry: Ra nipatagivlien tin kuma, Inang ko: siawug ki ata du mavulas, nimukwa ato ra.

30.niv: “Then the father went to the other son and said the same thing. He answered, ‘I will, sir,’ but he did not go.
30.cmn: 又來對小兒子也是這樣說。他回答說：『父啊，我去』，他卻不去。
30.sry: Iru ka ukwaen tin kararuha, nipamikawlawla ki su tenian. Ka ru patagivlien tin nikuma, Nda mukwaa ko, ra asi tin vuten mukwa.

31.niv: “Which of the two did what his father wanted?” “The first,” they answered. Jesus said to them, “Truly I tell you, the tax collectors and the prostitutes are entering the kingdom of God ahead of you.
31.cmn: 你們想，這兩個兒子是哪一個遵行父命呢？」他們說：「大兒子。」耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，稅吏和娼妓倒比你們先進上帝的國。
31.sry: Timang ki daruha ka ata ta nipamut ki kamuyen ki rama? Nikuma ta neni tenian, Ti naunamu. Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Mising kun aw kamu ra, ka tamaimug ki inaina apa ka maveyung muuroa mukwa imumian tu peysasuan ki Alid.

32.niv: For John came to you to show you the way of righteousness, and you did not believe him, but the tax collectors and the prostitutes did. And even after you saw this, you did not repent and believe him.
32.cmn: 因為約翰遵着義路到你們這裏來，你們卻不信他；稅吏和娼妓倒信他。你們看見了，後來還是不懊悔去信他。」 凶惡園戶的比喻 （可12‧1－12；路20‧9－19）
32.sry: Ka niirua ta ti Yoanes imumian tu darang ki katiktikan, ra asi kamu nitnamising tenian: ra nitnamising tenian ta tamaimug ki inaina apa ka maveyung. Imumi ra du nikitaan umi [ta ana] asi kamu nimalilug mavulas tu awug aley ki tnamisingey umi tenian.

33.niv: “Listen to another parable: There was a landowner who planted a vineyard. He put a wall around it, dug a winepress in it and built a watchtower. Then he rented the vineyard to some farmers and moved to another place.
33.cmn: 「你們再聽一個比喻：有個家主栽了一個葡萄園，周圍圈上籬笆，裏面挖了一個壓酒池，蓋了一座樓，租給園戶，就往外國去了。
33.sry: Milingiga ki pani ki pamikawlawlaan. Niakumeya sat ki tau ka meysasu ki sat ka atalagan, ka nitalumen tin ta a'tu ka karawmatagan, ka nipuritungen tin ta tatavag, ka nikudauken tin ta dauk ka patukwaan ki nisiput ka hala ki karawmata, ka nipeyringey tin ta tarakal ka vato, ka nipaitukwa hina ki tamatagkul, ka nitawhabul apa mukwa tu pani ki purug.

34.niv: When the harvest time approached, he sent his servants to the tenants to collect his fruit.
34.cmn: 收果子的時候近了，就打發僕人到園戶那裏去收果子。
34.sry: Iru ka iruarua ta kidi ki pakavuaan, nipadingiun tin ta kuncia tin paukwa ki tamatagkul ka ana, ka arawaw nein ta vua tin da.

35.niv: “The tenants seized his servants; they beat one, killed another, and stoned a third.
35.cmn: 園戶拿住僕人，打了一個，殺了一個，用石頭打死一個。
35.sry: Iru ka mingid ta tamatagkul ki kuncia tin, nipasingsangsagen nein ta saat, nilpugen pani [ki vual,] ka nicit nein ki vato ta ti ka taturu.

36.niv: Then he sent other servants to them, more than the first time, and the tenants treated them the same way.
36.cmn: 主人又打發別的僕人去，比先前更多；園戶還是照樣待他們。
36.sry: Nimila madingi ki pani ki kuncia ka sasaun mabatung ki tu uro ka ana, ka nipapagkawlawla ta neni nenian da.

37.niv: Last of all, he sent his son to them. ‘They will respect my son,’ he said.
37.cmn: 後來打發他的兒子到他們那裏去，意思說：『他們必尊敬我的兒子。』
37.sry: Nda tu awug nipadingien tin paukwa nenian ta alak tin [ka parag] ka kuma, Matakuta lava ki alak aw ra.

38.niv: “But when the tenants saw the son, they said to each other, ‘This is the heir. Come, letʼs kill him and take his inheritance.’
38.cmn: 不料，園戶看見他兒子，就彼此說：『這是承受產業的。來吧，我們殺他，佔他的產業！』
38.sry: Iru ka kmita ki alak [ki parag] ta tamatagkul, nimatagisal matagitavatag, Teni ta tablia tamia, nda pakapatay eta tenian, tami eta ki tablien tin da.

39.niv: So they took him and threw him out of the vineyard and killed him.
39.cmn: 他們就拿住他，推出葡萄園外，殺了。
39.sry: Iru ka niaraw nein tmurung tenian, nimaring smakitawag ki a'tu ka karawmatagan ka nipakapatay tenian.

40.niv: “Therefore, when the owner of the vineyard comes, what will he do to those tenants?”
40.cmn: 園主來的時候要怎樣處治這些園戶呢？」
40.sry: Iru ra irua ato ta meyrang ki a'tu ka karawmatagan, umanga lava ki tamatagkul ka ana?

41.niv: “He will bring those wretches to a wretched end,” they replied, “and he will rent the vineyard to other tenants, who will give him his share of the crop at harvest time.”
41.cmn: 他們說：「要下毒手除滅那些惡人，將葡萄園另租給那按着時候交果子的園戶。」
41.sry: Nikuma tenian, Pakapatayey tin ta asi mariyang ka ana ki kapatayan ka mate, ka paitukwaa ki a'tu ka karawmatagan ki pani ki vual ka tmagkul, ka piga tenian ki vua tu kidi nein ti tawil.

42.niv: Jesus said to them, “Have you never read in the Scriptures: “ ‘The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes’ ?
42.cmn: 耶穌說：「經上寫着： 匠人所棄的石頭 已作了房角的頭塊石頭。 這是主所做的， 在我們眼中看為希奇。 這經你們沒有念過嗎？
42.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Mikakwa kawa asi umi nikting tu na sasulat, Vato ka niaring ki tamameyringey ki talag, nikawvato tu pusul: Nipamuten ti Yehova ta ata, ka uringawen ato tu mata eta.

43.niv: “Therefore I tell you that the kingdom of God will be taken away from you and given to a people who will produce its fruit.
43.cmn: 所以我告訴你們，上帝的國必從你們奪去，賜給那能結果子的百姓。
43.sry: Aley ki ana pasusuen aw kamu, ka haumiey imumian ta peysasuan ki Alid, ka pagakwaey paatunun ki tau ka makavavua.

44.niv: Anyone who falls on this stone will be broken to pieces; anyone on whom it falls will be crushed.”
44.cmn: 誰掉在這石頭上，必要跌碎；這石頭掉在誰的身上，就要把誰砸得稀爛。」
44.sry: Ka timamang ta muaring muhalap ki vato ka ana, pawtawitawey ta teni: ka timamang ta tawkwaey ki ana, pakaparupua tenian.

45.niv: When the chief priests and the Pharisees heard Jesusʼ parables, they knew he was talking about them.
45.cmn: 祭司長和法利賽人聽見他的比喻，就看出他是指着他們說的。
45.sry: Iru ka milingig ta tamapigik ka sibavaw ki Farizeen apa ki pamikawlawlaan tin ka ata, niumhaen nein ka patagimimian tin nenian.

46.niv: They looked for a way to arrest him, but they were afraid of the crowd because the people held that he was a prophet.
46.cmn: 他們想要捉拿他，只是怕眾人，因為眾人以他為先知。
46.sry: Ka ru kmiim ki turungen tenian, nimatakut ki makuilalawlaw, aley ka tamamatagitan ta teni nikuma ta rig nein.

1.niv: Jesus spoke to them again in parables, saying:
1.cmn: 耶穌又用比喻對他們說：
1.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta ti Yesus matagila nenian ki pamikawlawlaan, ka kuma,

2.niv: “The kingdom of heaven is like a king who prepared a wedding banquet for his son.
2.cmn: 「天國好比一個王為他兒子擺設娶親的筵席，
2.sry: Mamikawlawla ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vulum ki vual ka sibavaw meysasu, ka nipapahatatanang ki alak tin [ka parag] ki vatugan ki pakakitilan.

3.niv: He sent his servants to those who had been invited to the banquet to tell them to come, but they refused to come.
3.cmn: 就打發僕人去，請那些被召的人來赴席，他們卻不肯來。
3.sry: Ka nimadingi ki kuncia tin patataam ki niaitanen bana tu uvavatongey ki pakakitilan, ra niinang mukwa.

4.niv: “Then he sent some more servants and said, ‘Tell those who have been invited that I have prepared my dinner: My oxen and fattened cattle have been butchered, and everything is ready. Come to the wedding banquet.’
4.cmn: 王又打發別的僕人，說：『你們告訴那被召的人，我的筵席已經預備好了，牛和肥畜已經宰了，各樣都齊備，請你們來赴席。』
4.sry: Nipatulaan tin madingi ta pani ki kuncia, ka nikuma, vanavanaey ta aitanen bana, Kitaey nitanangaw ta idangarangaaw maw, nilpug ta luwang aw ka niahap, ki nituftuf apa [ka lawlung] ka nisiimid sikaha sitan, nda ukwaaw tu uvavatugan ki pakakitilan.

5.niv: “But they paid no attention and went off—one to his field, another to his business.
5.cmn: 那些人不理就走了；一個到自己田裏去；一個做買賣去；
5.sry: Ra du asi nein niilig, nidmarang mukwa teni ka ata tu uma tin, teni ka ana tu pagiasaan tin.

6.niv: The rest seized his servants, mistreated them and killed them.
6.cmn: 其餘的拿住僕人，凌辱他們，把他們殺了。
6.sry: Ra neni ka raruma du nitmurung ki kuncia tin, nisumamuk pakapatayey nenian.

7.niv: The king was enraged. He sent his army and destroyed those murderers and burned their city.
7.cmn: 王就大怒，發兵除滅那些兇手，燒毀他們的城。
7.sry: Iru ka milingig [ki ata] ta meysasu ka sibavaw, ni'ahagnangaidingdingit ta teni, ka ru nipadadingien tin ta kabatungan ki tau ka macit, nisidada tin ta tamalpug ka ana, ka na paaidig tin ki apuy ta awma nein.

8.niv: “Then he said to his servants, ‘The wedding banquet is ready, but those I invited did not deserve to come.
8.cmn: 於是對僕人說：『喜筵已經齊備，只是所召的人不配。
8.sry: Anata nikun tin ki kuncia tinda, Peykahan ato meytanan ta vatug ki pakakitilan, ra neni ka niaytanun bana, asi mamsing irang ki kidi.

9.niv: So go to the street corners and invite to the banquet anyone you find.’
9.cmn: 所以你們要往岔路口上去，凡遇見的，都召來赴席。』
9.sry: Aley ka ana upanaaw tu puta ki darang, ka paninapina ki vual ka kabaleyawumi, tidaw lato paukwa tu uvavatongey ki pakakitilan.

10.niv: So the servants went out into the streets and gathered all the people they could find, the bad as well as the good, and the wedding hall was filled with guests.
10.cmn: 那些僕人就出去，到大路上，凡遇見的，不論善惡都召聚了來，筵席上就坐滿了客。
10.sry: Ka ru tawpapanag ta kuncia ka ana tu daradarang, nipapakuilau imid ka nikabaley nein, ka mate mariyang apa, ka nimatmoy ta vatug ki ayarung.

11.niv: “But when the king came in to see the guests, he noticed a man there who was not wearing wedding clothes.
11.cmn: 王進來觀看賓客，見那裏有一個沒有穿禮服的，
11.sry: Iru ka nimurbo ta meysasu ka sibavaw tu himataey tin ta ayarung, nikitaan tin ta tau ka asi makulamug tu uvavatugan ki pakakitilan da.

12.niv: He asked, ‘How did you get in here without wedding clothes, friend?’ The man was speechless.
12.cmn: 就對他說：『朋友，你到這裏來怎麼不穿禮服呢？』那人無言可答。
12.sry: Ka nikuma tenian, Diu, mamang ta niurubunuhu hiya ru asikaw makulamug ki uvavatovatug? Ka makdig ki marat ta teni.

13.niv: “Then the king told the attendants, ‘Tie him hand and foot, and throw him outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
13.cmn: 於是王對使喚的人說：『捆起他的手腳來，把他丟在外邊的黑暗裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。』
13.sry: Anata nikuma ta meysasu ka sibavaw ki paairungan tin, halirimaey, halirapaley, araw, aringaney tenian tu karumduman ka siuro itutawag: Tu hinawa lato ta tangitangien ki patitingen apa ki walig.

14.niv: “For many are invited, but few are chosen.”
14.cmn: 因為被召的人多，選上的人少。」 納稅給凱撒的問題 （可12‧13－17；路20‧19－26）
14.sry: Ka mabatung ta nitataam, ra matiting ta niperi.

15.niv: Then the Pharisees went out and laid plans to trap him in his words.
15.cmn: 當時，法利賽人出去商議，怎樣就着耶穌的話陷害他，
15.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nidmarang ti Farizeen ka nimatagisal ki su, aley ka tagiduka tigkla ki patagiruken ki su nein tenian.

16.niv: They sent their disciples to him along with the Herodians. “Teacher,” they said, “we know that you are a man of integrity and that you teach the way of God in accordance with the truth. You arenʼt swayed by others, because you pay no attention to who they are.
16.cmn: 就打發他們的門徒同希律黨的人去見耶穌，說：「夫子，我們知道你是誠實人，並且誠誠實實傳上帝的道，甚麼人你都不徇情面，因為你不看人的外貌。
16.sry: Ka nipadingien nein paukwa tenian ta patawutawugan nein lam ki Herodianen, kumakwa, Tamamatawutawug, kavanaan yan ka matiktik kaw ki su, ka matawtawug kaw ki darang ki Alid tu katiktikan, ka mangaw muho ta timamang ka tau: ka asi kaw masawkulkul ki vulung ki tau.

17.niv: Tell us then, what is your opinion? Is it right to pay the imperial tax to Caesar or not?”
17.cmn: 請告訴我們，你的意見如何？納稅給凱撒可以不可以？」
17.sry: Anata vanavanaey kame, Mamang ta rig oho? Hahayen kawa piga ki meysasu ka sibavaw ka Siatug Sibavaw ta imugan, asi lava hahayen?

18.niv: But Jesus, knowing their evil intent, said, “You hypocrites, why are you trying to trap me?
18.cmn: 耶穌看出他們的惡意，就說：「假冒為善的人哪，為甚麼試探我？
18.sry: Ra tu kalangen Yesus ta sasamuken ki rig nein, nikuma nenian,

19.niv: Show me the coin used for paying the tax.” They brought him a denarius,
19.cmn: 拿一個上稅的錢給我看！」他們就拿一個銀錢來給他。
19.sry: Imumi ka paninien ki rig ki su, ka mang ta rarepung umi yawan? Pakitaaw ko ta malituk ka paimugan. Ka niad nein tenian ta denarium [ka malituk ka nipatagen.]

20.niv: and he asked them, “Whose image is this? And whose inscription?”
20.cmn: 耶穌說：「這像和這號是誰的？」
20.sry: Ka nikuma nenian, Atimang ta pasutautauen ka ata? Na paahahalap apa ka patag?

21.niv: “Caesarʼs,” they replied. Then he said to them, “So give back to Caesar what is Caesarʼs, and to God what is Godʼs.”
21.cmn: 他們說：「是凱撒的。」耶穌說：「這樣，凱撒的物當歸給凱撒；上帝的物當歸給上帝。」
21.sry: Nikuma tenian, Atu Siatug Sibavaw. Anata nikuma nenian, Pigaey ato ki Siatug Sibavaw ka a'tu Siatug Sibavaw, ki Alid apa ka a'tu Alid ra.

22.niv: When they heard this, they were amazed. So they left him and went away.
22.cmn: 他們聽見就希奇，離開他走了。 復活的問題 （可12‧18－27；路20‧27－40）
22.sry: Iru ka milingig ta neni ki ata, nimukiap ato: ka ru paikakwa tenian, nidmarang ta neni.

23.niv: That same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to him with a question.
23.cmn: 撒都該人常說沒有復活的事。那天，他們來問耶穌說：
23.sry: Tu wagi ka ana irua ato mukwa tenian ta Saduseen, ka kuma kakwa hina, ka ausia likugey gapit, ka nitmalig tenian,

24.niv: “Teacher,” they said, “Moses told us that if a man dies without having children, his brother must marry the widow and raise up offspring for him.
24.cmn: 「夫子，摩西說：『人若死了，沒有孩子，他兄弟當娶他的妻，為哥哥生子立後。』
24.sry: Kuma, Tamamatawutawug nikuma ta ti Moses, Hairu mapatay ta timamang ka ausi ki alalak, ana ta putbunga ta tagiapaparag tin ki nikeyan tin, ka pagapita ki gaap ki tagiapaparag tin.

25.niv: Now there were seven brothers among us. The first one married and died, and since he had no children, he left his wife to his brother.
25.cmn: 從前，在我們這裏有弟兄七人，第一個娶了妻，死了，沒有孩子，撇下妻子給兄弟。
25.sry: Nda na aku papitu ki matagiapaparag imianan, ka naunamu ka niputbung ta nimapatay ato, ka aley ka ausi ki alalak, nipatubli ki nikeyan tin ki tagiapaparag tin.

26.niv: The same thing happened to the second and third brother, right on down to the seventh.
26.cmn: 第二、第三，直到第七個，都是如此。
26.sry: Nimakawlawla kumahina ta ti kararuha, ta ti kataturu, makidi apa ki kapapitu.

27.niv: Finally, the woman died.
27.cmn: 末後，婦人也死了。
27.sry: Tu awug ki imid nenian nipiskwa apa mapatay ta ina.

28.niv: Now then, at the resurrection, whose wife will she be of the seven, since all of them were married to her?”
28.cmn: 這樣，當復活的時候，她是七個人中哪一個的妻子呢？因為他們都娶過她。」
28.sry: Anata tu likugey gapit, a'timanga ta keyan ki papitu ka ana? du nipuimid nein putubung tenian.

29.niv: Jesus replied, “You are in error because you do not know the Scriptures or the power of God.
29.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「你們錯了；因為不明白聖經，也不曉得上帝的大能。
29.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta ti Yesus, kuma hiya nenian, Tawrahay kamu tu asi kavanaan ki na sasulat ki lig apa ki Alid.

30.niv: At the resurrection people will neither marry nor be given in marriage; they will be like the angels in heaven.
30.cmn: 當復活的時候，人也不娶也不嫁，乃像天上的使者一樣。
30.sry: Nda tu likugey gapit asi putbunga, asi paputbunganey apa: ra mama ato ki tamagnaw ki Alid tu tunun ki vulum.

31.niv: But about the resurrection of the dead—have you not read what God said to you,
31.cmn: 論到死人復活，上帝在經上向你們所說的，你們沒有念過嗎？
31.sry: Ka ato likugey gapit, asi umi kawa nikting ta nipasusuen ki Alid imumian, ka kuma.

32.niv: ‘I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob’ ? He is not the God of the dead but of the living.”
32.cmn: 他說：『我是亞伯拉罕的上帝，以撒的上帝，雅各的上帝。』上帝不是死人的上帝，乃是活人的上帝。」
32.sry: Ti yaw ta Alid ti Abraham, ta Alid ti Isaak, ta Alid apa ti Yakob? Alid ta asi Alid ki patay, ra ki mawag.

33.niv: When the crowds heard this, they were astonished at his teaching.
33.cmn: 眾人聽見這話，就希奇他的教訓。 最大的誡命 （可12‧28－34；路10‧25－28）
33.sry: Iru ka milingig [ki ata] ta makuilalawlaw nimukiap ato ki na patawutawugan tin.

34.niv: Hearing that Jesus had silenced the Sadducees, the Pharisees got together.
34.cmn: 法利賽人聽見耶穌堵住了撒都該人的口，他們就聚集。
34.sry: Ra tu ilingigen ki Farizeen ka nitukid tin ta mutus ki Saduseen, nimawisal muakla ta neni.

35.niv: One of them, an expert in the law, tested him with this question:
35.cmn: 內中有一個人是律法師，要試探耶穌，就問他說：
35.sry: Ka saat nenian ka magtautauug ki tatuko ta nirepung tmalig tenian, kuma.

36.niv: “Teacher, which is the greatest commandment in the Law?”
36.cmn: 「夫子，律法上的誡命，哪一條是最大的呢？」
36.sry: Tamamamagtautauug, kamang ta su ka pagkusasusu ki keyrangan tu tatuko?

37.niv: Jesus replied: “ ‘Love the Lord your God with all your heart and with all your soul and with all your mind.’
37.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「你要盡心、盡性、盡意愛主－你的上帝。
37.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Mavagangoa kaw ki Meyrang ka Alid oho tu tintin oho ka mitatumuk, tu vati oho ka mitatumuk, tu imid apa ki umhaen oho pagdumdum.

38.niv: This is the first and greatest commandment.
38.cmn: 這是誡命中的第一，且是最大的。
38.sry: Ata ta su ka pakusasusu ka naunamu ki keyrangan.

39.niv: And the second is like it: ‘Love your neighbor as yourself.’
39.cmn: 其次也相倣，就是要愛人如己。
39.sry: Ra kararuha ta makawlawla ki ata: Mavagangoa kaw ki tau ka raruma mama mamado imhuan.

40.niv: All the Law and the Prophets hang on these two commandments.”
40.cmn: 這兩條誡命是律法和先知一切道理的總綱。」 大衛子孫的問題 （可12‧35－37；路20‧41－44）
40.sry: Tu ruruha ki pagkusasusu ka ata awlen ta imid ki tatuko ki na tamamatagitan apa.

41.niv: While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,
41.cmn: 法利賽人聚集的時候，耶穌問他們說：
41.sry: Iru ka makuisal ato ta Farizeen, nitmalig nenian ta ti Yesus,

42.niv: “What do you think about the Messiah? Whose son is he?” “The son of David,” they replied.
42.cmn: 「論到基督，你們的意見如何？他是誰的子孫呢？」他們回答說：「是大衛的子孫。」
42.sry: Ka kuma, pamang umi ta ti Kristus? Alak ti mang ta teni? Nikuma ta neni tenian, na alak ti David.

43.niv: He said to them, “How is it then that David, speaking by the Spirit, calls him ‘Lord’? For he says,
43.cmn: 耶穌說：「這樣，大衛被聖靈感動，怎麼還稱他為主，說：
43.sry: Nikuma nenian mamamang ka mananang tenian ta ti David ki Yupan, ki Meyrang tin, du kuma,

44.niv: “ ‘The Lord said to my Lord: “Sit at my right hand until I put your enemies under your feet.” ’
44.cmn: 主對我主說： 你坐在我的右邊， 等我把你仇敵放在你的腳下。
44.sry: Nimasusu ta Meyrang ki Meyrang aw, mirunga tu uwal aw tu kidi ka paitukwaaw lato maw ta sivawawvawug imhuan tu kakakwaan ki rapal oho?

45.niv: If then David calls him ‘Lord,’ how can he be his son?”
45.cmn: 大衛既稱他為主，他怎麼又是大衛的子孫呢？」
45.sry: Hairu mananang ta ti David tenian, Meyrang, mamamang ka na alak tin ta [teni?]

46.niv: No one could say a word in reply, and from that day on no one dared to ask him any more questions.
46.cmn: 他們沒有一個人能回答一言。從那日以後，也沒有人敢再問他甚麼。
46.sry: Ka asi matagilpug ta timamang matagivli tenian ki sasasat ki su: ka nimaneyaney ta timamang siawug ki kidi ki wagi ka ana tmawkilala tenian.

1.niv: Then Jesus said to the crowds and to his disciples:
1.cmn: 那時，耶穌對眾人和門徒講論，
1.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nimasusu ta ti Yesus ki makuilalawlaw ki patawutawugan apa tin,

2.niv: “The teachers of the law and the Pharisees sit in Mosesʼ seat.
2.cmn: 說：「文士和法利賽人坐在摩西的位上，
2.sry: Kuma, Tu niirarungen ti Moses, da mirung ato ta makusasulat ki Farizeen apa:

3.niv: So you must be careful to do everything they tell you. But do not do what they do, for they do not practice what they preach.
3.cmn: 凡他們所吩咐你們的，你們都要謹守遵行。但不要效法他們的行為；因為他們能說，不能行。
3.sry: Anata kamamang ka pasusuey nein paakwa imumian, akwaaw umi ra, pamutaw apa ta ana, ra na ringey nein asi akwaaw: aley ka pasusuen nein ra asi nein pamuten [ka ana.]

4.niv: They tie up heavy, cumbersome loads and put them on other peopleʼs shoulders, but they themselves are not willing to lift a finger to move them.
4.cmn: 他們把難擔的重擔捆起來，擱在人的肩上，但自己一個指頭也不肯動。
4.sry: Aley ka awfuten nein ta ul ka makdung, ka asi alpugen maval, ka paka atagen ki kagulung, ra inang pakilikalika ta neni ki kaamos nein.

5.niv: “Everything they do is done for people to see: They make their phylacteries wide and the tassels on their garments long;
5.cmn: 他們一切所做的事都是要叫人看見，所以將佩戴的經文做寬了，衣裳的繸子做長了，
5.sry: Ka pamuten nein ta imid ki na ringaringey nein ka ararawey ki kagulung. Ka pakairang ki lici ki pahibaleyen, ka pahuirang nein pahupat ta na papitpit ki kulamug nein.

6.niv: they love the place of honor at banquets and the most important seats in the synagogues;
6.cmn: 喜愛筵席上的首座，會堂裏的高位，
6.sry: Ka kamawen nein ta itugan da mirung tu pileyligen, ki taul apa ki itu uroen tu pakuisalan.

7.niv: they love to be greeted with respect in the marketplaces and to be called ‘Rabbi’ by others.
7.cmn: 又喜愛人在街市上問他安，稱呼他拉比 。
7.sry: Ta pasirariuen apa tu panag ka pakuisal tin, ta pananangen apa ki kagulung, Rabi, Rabi.

8.niv: “But you are not to be called ‘Rabbi,’ for you have one Teacher, and you are all brothers.
8.cmn: 但你們不要受拉比的稱呼，因為只有一位是你們的夫子；你們都是弟兄。
8.sry: Imumi ra ina pananangey Rabi, ra saat ta tamamatawtawug imumian, ka ti Kristus: ka imidey aw kamu tagiapaparag ta imumi.

9.niv: And do not call anyone on earth ‘father,’ for you have one Father, and he is in heaven.
9.cmn: 也不要稱呼地上的人為父，因為只有一位是你們的父，就是在天上的父。
9.sry: Ka asi umi raramaaw ta timamang tu nay, aley ka saat ta raraman umi ka ayatunun ki vulum.

10.niv: Nor are you to be called instructors, for you have one Instructor, the Messiah.
10.cmn: 也不要受師尊的稱呼，因為只有一位是你們的師尊，就是基督。
10.sry: Ka asi kamu pananagey tamamatawtawug: aley ka saat ta tamamatawtawug imumian ka ti Kristus:

11.niv: The greatest among you will be your servant.
11.cmn: 你們中間誰為大，誰就要作你們的用人。
11.sry: Ra timamang ta siuro tu keyrangan ki kidi imumian, teni ta pairungaw umi.

12.niv: For those who exalt themselves will be humbled, and those who humble themselves will be exalted.
12.cmn: 凡自高的，必降為卑；自卑的，必升為高。
12.sry: Ka timamang ta pumado pukeyrangen ki kidi tenian, ana ta purarimey da: timamang ta purarima ki kidi tenian pumado, ana ta pukeyrangey da.

13.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You shut the door of the kingdom of heaven in peopleʼs faces. You yourselves do not enter, nor will you let those enter who are trying to.
13.cmn: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們正當人前，把天國的門關了，自己不進去，正要進去的人，你們也不容他們進去。
13.sry: Ra anay imumi ka makusasulat ki Farizeen apa, ka paninien ki rig [ki su:] Iluban umi ki kagulung ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vulum, aley ka asi kamu murbo, timamang apa ka ina urbo, asi umi hahayen paurbo ta neni.

14.sry: Anay imumi ka makusasulat ki Farizeen apa, ka paninien ki rig [ki su:] Aley ka kanen umi ta tatalag ki inaina ka nikapatayan tbung, tu hawaten ki haway ki pakudaliadalien makualilid. Aley ki ana pakivaleyey umi ta siuro makdung ka dungdungen.

15.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You travel over land and sea to win a single convert, and when you have succeeded, you make them twice as much a child of hell as you are.
15.cmn: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們走遍洋海陸地，勾引一個人入教，既入了教，卻使他作地獄之子，比你們還加倍。
15.sry: Anay imumi ka makusasulat ki Farizeen apa, ka paninien ki rig [ki su:] Ka tawritung kamu ki vaung ki purupurug putawug ki vahaw ka Yoden: ka ru putawugen, pualak kamu tenian ki alak ki kalawugan pupuhal pusaun imumian.

16.niv: “Woe to you, blind guides! You say, ‘If anyone swears by the temple, it means nothing; but anyone who swears by the gold of the temple is bound by that oath.’
16.cmn: 「你們這瞎眼領路的有禍了！你們說：『凡指着殿起誓的，這算不得甚麼；只是凡指着殿中金子起誓的，他就該謹守。』
16.sry: Anay imumi ka tamadilug ka mavuta, ka kuma, du timamang ta sawlikuda ato ki su sawkuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, ka nino ta ana: ra timamang ta sawlikuda ato sawkim ka tu kuva ki ta tatamudan ki Alid, nda kawitingey ta ti ana.

17.niv: You blind fools! Which is greater: the gold, or the temple that makes the gold sacred?
17.cmn: 你們這無知瞎眼的人哪，甚麼是大的？是金子呢？還是叫金子成聖的殿呢？
17.sry: Imumi ka maringaw ka mavuta: kamang ta masaun mangal ki kidi, kim kawa, kuva kawa ka papani ki kim tu tatamuden ki Alid?

18.niv: You also say, ‘If anyone swears by the altar, it means nothing; but anyone who swears by the gift on the altar is bound by that oath.’
18.cmn: 你們又說：『凡指着壇起誓的，這算不得甚麼；只是凡指着壇上禮物起誓的，他就該謹守。』
18.sry: Ka ru sawlikuda ato ki su ta timamang ki itukwaan ki pigikan, ka nino ta ana: ra timamang ta sawlukuta ato ki na papa ka nipuhalapen, ka kawitingey ta teni.

19.niv: You blind men! Which is greater: the gift, or the altar that makes the gift sacred?
19.cmn: 你們這瞎眼的人哪，甚麼是大的？是禮物呢？還是叫禮物成聖的壇呢？
19.sry: Imumi ka maringaw ka mavuta: nda kamang masaun na keyrangan ki kidi, na papa kawa, itukwaan kawa ki papigikan ka papani ki na papa tu tatamuden ki Alid?

20.niv: Therefore, anyone who swears by the altar swears by it and by everything on it.
20.cmn: 所以，人指着壇起誓，就是指着壇和壇上一切所有的起誓；
20.sry: Anata timamang ta sawlikud ki su ki itukwaan ki papigikan sawlikuden tin ti ana, kamamang apa ka atahalapen ato hina.

21.niv: And anyone who swears by the temple swears by it and by the one who dwells in it.
21.cmn: 人指着殿起誓，就是指着殿和那住在殿裏的起誓；
21.sry: Ka timamang ta sawlikud ki su sawkuva ki tatamuden ki Alid, sawlikuden tin ki ana, tenian apa ka itukakwa hina.

22.niv: And anyone who swears by heaven swears by Godʼs throne and by the one who sits on it.
22.cmn: 人指着天起誓，就是指着上帝的寶座和那坐在上面的起誓。
22.sry: Ka timamang ta sawlikud ki tunun ki vulum, sawlikuduen tin ki irarungan ki Alid, tenian apa ka tagaraung hina.

23.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You give a tenth of your spices—mint, dill and cumin. But you have neglected the more important matters of the law—justice, mercy and faithfulness. You should have practiced the latter, without neglecting the former.
23.cmn: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們將薄荷、茴香、芹菜獻上十分之一，那律法上更重的事，就是公義、憐憫、信實，反倒不行了。這更重的是你們當行的；那也是不可不行的。
23.sry: Anay imumi ka makusasulat ki Farizeen apa, ka paninien ki rig ki su, piga kamu ki atag ka sat kitian ki Munte ki dile, ki kumin apa, ka asi umi pamuten ta siuro irang tu tatuko, [ata] ta dungdungan, kaharuman ki kashutan [ki nipatumisingen.] Nda kidi ka pamutaw ta ata, ka asi inangey ta ana.

24.niv: You blind guides! You strain out a gnat but swallow a camel.
24.cmn: 你們這瞎眼領路的，蠓蟲你們就濾出來，駱駝你們倒吞下去。
24.sry: Tamadilug ka mavuta, pasasakuden umi ta rikug, ka rihalen umi ta luwang ka kemel.

25.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You clean the outside of the cup and dish, but inside they are full of greed and self-indulgence.
25.cmn: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們洗淨杯盤的外面，裏面卻盛滿了勒索和放蕩。
25.sry: Anay imumi ka makusasulat ki Faiseen apa, ka paninien ki rig ki su: pakakuptigen umi ta hawug ka aitan ki tangya apa tu halap, ra tu rbo matmuy ta ana ki turinugan ki asi katiktikan ki rig.

26.niv: Blind Pharisee! First clean the inside of the cup and dish, and then the outside also will be clean.
26.cmn: 你這瞎眼的法利賽人，先洗淨杯盤的裏面，好叫外面也乾淨了。
26.sry: Farizeen ka mavuta kaw, pasiuroaw pakakuptig ta aturbo ki hawug ka aitan ki tangya apa, aley ka pakakuptigey apa ta atuhalap

27.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You are like whitewashed tombs, which look beautiful on the outside but on the inside are full of the bones of the dead and everything unclean.
27.cmn: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們好像粉飾的墳墓，外面好看，裏面卻裝滿了死人的骨頭和一切的污穢。
27.sry: Anay imumi ka makusasulat ki Farizeen apa, ka paninien ki rig ki su: ka papamag kawlawlaen kamu ki ravaravak ka tagapugen, ka mahaway matabung tu halap, ra matmuy turbo ki tural ki patay ki kamamang ki kavusuken.

28.niv: In the same way, on the outside you appear to people as righteous but on the inside you are full of hypocrisy and wickedness.
28.cmn: 你們也是如此，在人前，外面顯出公義來，裏面卻裝滿了假善和不法的事。
28.sry: Kuma kamu hina mahaway matiktik ki kagulung tu halap, ra matmuy kamu tu rbo ki pukakeyhalapen ki katukulan.

29.niv: “Woe to you, teachers of the law and Pharisees, you hypocrites! You build tombs for the prophets and decorate the graves of the righteous.
29.cmn: 「你們這假冒為善的文士和法利賽人有禍了！因為你們建造先知的墳，修飾義人的墓，說：
29.sry: Anay imumi ka makusasulat ki Farizeen apa, ka paninien ki rig ki su: ka peyringey umi ta ravaravak ki na tamamatagitan, ka peytabung umi ta tigalungan ki pahibaleyen ki tau ka na matiktik.

30.niv: And you say, ‘If we had lived in the days of our ancestors, we would not have taken part with them in shedding the blood of the prophets.’
30.cmn: 『若是我們在我們祖宗的時候，必不和他們同流先知的血。』
30.sry: Ka kuma kamu hina, hairu ina kame akumeya ato tu kidi ki wagi ki Ramu yan, ina kame akusi ato ki sawsalan tu gamag ki na tamamatagitan.

31.niv: So you testify against yourselves that you are the descendants of those who murdered the prophets.
31.cmn: 這就是你們自己證明是殺害先知者的子孫了。
31.sry: Kuma hina hmail kamu matagiduma imumian mamado, ka na alalak kamu nein ka nipakapatay ki na tamamatagitan.

32.niv: Go ahead, then, and complete what your ancestors started!
32.cmn: 你們去充滿你們祖宗的惡貫吧！
32.sry: Imumi ta putmuy ki rarepungan ki na mamumuan umi.

33.niv: “You snakes! You brood of vipers! How will you escape being condemned to hell?
33.cmn: 你們這些蛇類、毒蛇之種啊，怎能逃脫地獄的刑罰呢？
33.sry: Imumi ka vuyley ka nikubkub ki tpung, iliputa kamu mama ki mang ki pakuavavagan ki kalawhawan?

34.niv: Therefore I am sending you prophets and sages and teachers. Some of them you will kill and crucify; others you will flog in your synagogues and pursue from town to town.
34.cmn: 所以我差遣先知和智慧人並文士到你們這裏來，有的你們要殺害，要釘十字架；有的你們要在會堂裏鞭打，從這城追逼到那城，
34.sry: Aley ki ana, kitaey, padadingien aw kamu ta tamamatagitan, ta makusazing, ki makusasulat apa, ka pakapataya kamu ki raruma punavavarag apa nenian, ka patawbawriga kamu smaplat ki raruma tu pakuisalan umi, ka kmudiluga kamu [nenian] tu awmaawma.

35.niv: And so upon you will come all the righteous blood that has been shed on earth, from the blood of righteous Abel to the blood of Zechariah son of Berekiah, whom you murdered between the temple and the altar.
35.cmn: 叫世上所流義人的血都歸到你們身上，從義人亞伯的血起，直到你們在殿和壇中間所殺的巴拉加的兒子撒迦利亞的血為止。
35.sry: Aley ka muhalapa imumian ta imid ki na gamag ka matiktik, ka niududoen tu nay, na gamag ti Abel ka na matiktik tu kidi apa ki na gamag ti Zakariyas ka na alak ti Barakiyas, ka nilpug umi tu tukad ki kuva ki tatamuden ki itukwaan ki papigikan.

36.niv: Truly I tell you, all this will come on this generation.
36.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，這一切的罪都要歸到這世代了。」 為耶路撒冷哀哭 （路13‧34－35）
36.sry: Mising kun aw kamu, ka iruaa ta mamang ka ata muhalap ki kavuivuilan ka ana.

37.niv: “Jerusalem, Jerusalem, you who kill the prophets and stone those sent to you, how often I have longed to gather your children together, as a hen gathers her chicks under her wings, and you were not willing.
37.cmn: 「耶路撒冷啊，耶路撒冷啊，你常殺害先知，又用石頭打死那奉差遣到你這裏來的人。我多次願意聚集你的兒女，好像母雞把小雞聚集在翅膀底下，只是你們不願意。
37.sry: Yerusalem, Yerusalem, ka lpug kaw ki tamamatagitan, ka takacicit kaw ki na vato ki padadingien paukwa imhuan: muapina ta nikamuyen aw papaawlulud ki alalak oho mama ki tafuka ka papaawlud ki pipiu tin tu paparil [tin,] ra asi kamu nihmahay ato.

38.niv: Look, your house is left to you desolate.
38.cmn: 看哪，你們的家成為荒場留給你們。
38.sry: Kitaey paitukwaaw imumian ta talag umi ka niubulbulen.

39.niv: For I tell you, you will not see me again until you say, ‘Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord.’ ”
39.cmn: 我告訴你們，從今以後，你們不得再見我，直等到你們說：『奉主名來的是應當稱頌的。』」
39.sry: Ka pasusuen aw kamu, Asi kamu kmitaa yawan siawug ki kidi hinin, tu kidi apa ka ana ka pasusuey umi, Pakariyangey lmulug ta teni ka ana ka irarurua tu nanang ki Meyrang.

1.niv: Jesus left the temple and was walking away when his disciples came up to him to call his attention to its buildings.
1.cmn: 耶穌出了聖殿，正走的時候，門徒進前來，把殿宇指給他看。
1.sry: Ka ru samamala ta ti Yesus, nidmarang ki kuva ki tatamuden ki Alid, ka niirua tenian ta patawutawugan tin, tu pakitaey ki nipaitalag ki kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid.

2.niv: “Do you see all these things?” he asked. “Truly I tell you, not one stone here will be left on another; every one will be thrown down.”
2.cmn: 耶穌對他們說：「你們不是看見這殿宇嗎？我實在告訴你們，將來在這裏沒有一塊石頭留在石頭上，不被拆毀了。」 災難的起頭 （可13‧3－13；路21‧7－19）
2.sry: Ka nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Asi umi kawa ararawun ta mamang ka ata? Mising kun aw kamu, asi paitukwaey hiya ta [sasasat ka] vato paituhalap ki vato [ka ruma,] ka asi taktakaw.

3.niv: As Jesus was sitting on the Mount of Olives, the disciples came to him privately. “Tell us,” they said, “when will this happen, and what will be the sign of your coming and of the end of the age?”
3.cmn: 耶穌在橄欖山上坐着，門徒暗暗地來說：「請告訴我們，甚麼時候有這些事？你降臨和世界的末了有甚麼預兆呢？」
3.sry: Iru ka mirung ta teni tu vukin ka makavavua ki imag, nimukwa tu sinag tenian ta patawutawugan, ka nikuma, Vanavanaey kame, manoa lato ki kidi ta mamang ka ata? ka kamanga lato ta pukidian ki kaananung oho, ki sakahaan salimulimu apa ki idarinugan?

4.niv: Jesus answered: “Watch out that no one deceives you.
4.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「你們要謹慎，免得有人迷惑你們。
4.sry: Iru ka matagivli ta ti Yesus nikuma nenian, Kitaey, ka asi paturahaya ta timamang imumian.

5.niv: For many will come in my name, claiming, ‘I am the Messiah,’ and will deceive many.
5.cmn: 因為將來有好些人冒我的名來，說：『我是基督』，並且要迷惑許多人。
5.sry: Ka mabatung ta iruaa tu nanang aw, ka kumaa, Ti yaw ta ti Kristus, ka paturahayaw nein ta tau ka madag.

6.niv: You will hear of wars and rumors of wars, but see to it that you are not alarmed. Such things must happen, but the end is still to come.
6.cmn: 你們也要聽見打仗和打仗的風聲，總不要驚慌；因為這些事是必須有的，只是末期還沒有到。
6.sry: Ka ilingigaw umi ta pasacitan, ki ikalawakawen apa ki pasacitan. kmita, ka asia kamu ru paukiapen, ka kidi ato ka pavutaw ta mamang ka ata, ra ausi apa ki limulimu.

7.niv: Nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom. There will be famines and earthquakes in various places.
7.cmn: 民要攻打民，國要攻打國；多處必有饑荒、地震。
7.sry: Ka gapita ta tau muduma ki tau, ta peysasuan apa makuduma ki peysasuan: ka iruaa ki kahangeyan, ki pismamurangen, ki ninug tu manini ki itukwaan.

8.niv: All these are the beginning of birth pains.
8.cmn: 這都是災難的起頭。
8.sry: Nda kamamang ka ata dik ka naunamu ki pahialalamen.

9.niv: “Then you will be handed over to be persecuted and put to death, and you will be hated by all nations because of me.
9.cmn: 那時，人要把你們陷在患難裏，也要殺害你們；你們又要為我的名被萬民恨惡。
9.sry: Tu kidi ka ana paatununa imumian tu sasamukan, ka pakapatayaimumian, ka gaasaw kamu ki imid ki tautau aley ki nanang aw.

10.niv: At that time many will turn away from the faith and will betray and hate each other,
10.cmn: 那時，必有許多人跌倒，也要彼此陷害，彼此恨惡；
10.sry: Ka tu kidi ka ana pakavarawaw ta madadag [ki vual,] ka mapagavlivlia mapagamado mapagatununtunun, ka makavlivlia maka mado maka vahihir nenian.

11.niv: and many false prophets will appear and deceive many people.
11.cmn: 且有好些假先知起來，迷惑多人。
11.sry: Ka gapita ta mabatung ka asi dilig ka tamamatagitan, ka paturahayaw nein ta madadag ki tau.

12.niv: Because of the increase of wickedness, the love of most will grow cold,
12.cmn: 只因不法的事增多，許多人的愛心才漸漸冷淡了。
12.sry: Ka aley apa ki pakawtapangaw ta katukulan, ka hiyupey ki vagango ki madadag ki tau.

13.niv: but the one who stands firm to the end will be saved.
13.cmn: 惟有忍耐到底的，必然得救。
13.sry: Ka timamang ta itutarawag tu limu apa, pakariyangaw ta kumahina.

14.niv: And this gospel of the kingdom will be preached in the whole world as a testimony to all nations, and then the end will come.
14.cmn: 這天國的福音要傳遍天下，對萬民作見證，然後末期才來到。」 大災難 （可13‧14－23；路21‧20－24）
14.sry: Ka patasasuey ta hagnaw ka mariyang ka ana ki peysasuan tu imid ki itukakwaan ki nay, tu patagihailen ki imid ki tautau ka Heydang: ana ta iruaa ta limulimu.

15.niv: “So when you see standing in the holy place ‘the abomination that causes desolation,’ spoken of through the prophet Daniel—let the reader understand—
15.cmn: 「你們看見先知但以理所說的『那行毀壞可憎的』站在聖地（讀這經的人須要會意）。
15.sry: Iru ka kitaey umi ta kakariskausen ki ubulbulan ka nipasusuen ti Daniel ka na tamamatagitan, tu itukwaan ka nipeni tu tatamudan ki Alid (nda umhaey ato ki tamakting.)

16.niv: then let those who are in Judea flee to the mountains.
16.cmn: 那時，在猶太的，應當逃到山上；
16.sry: Tu kidi ka ana na mamang ta tu Yudea, da iliputa pubavukin.

17.niv: Let no one on the housetop go down to take anything out of the house.
17.cmn: 在房上的，不要下來拿家裏的東西；
17.sry: Na mamang ta ayaapang, ka asi murarim ki araey tin ki mamang tu talag tin.

18.niv: Let no one in the field go back to get their cloak.
18.cmn: 在田裏的，也不要回去取衣裳。
18.sry: Ka ayaawma apa, nda asi salikuga ki araey tin ki kulamug.

19.niv: How dreadful it will be in those days for pregnant women and nursing mothers!
19.cmn: 當那些日子，懷孕的和奶孩子的有禍了。
19.sry: Anay imumi [ka inaina] ka mavuy ka pauho tu wagi ka ana.

20.niv: Pray that your flight will not take place in winter or on the Sabbath.
20.cmn: 你們應當祈求，叫你們逃走的時候，不遇見冬天或是安息日。
20.sry: Nda makualilida ka asi pavutaw ta iliputey umi ru amigan, ru wagi lava ka pahihababan.

21.niv: For then there will be great distress, unequaled from the beginning of the world until now—and never to be equaled again.
21.cmn: 因為那時必有大災難，從世界的起頭直到如今，沒有這樣的災難，後來也必沒有。
21.sry: Ka iruaa du ana ta sasamukan ki bulbulun ka maluaf irang, ka niausi ki kumahina siawug ki kidi ki naunamu ki nay tu kidi apa hinin, ka ausia apa du rumang.

22.niv: “If those days had not been cut short, no one would survive, but for the sake of the elect those days will be shortened.
22.cmn: 若不減少那日子，凡有血氣的總沒有一個得救的；只是為選民，那日子必減少了。
22.sry: Ka ru ina papakipoen ta kidi ki wagi, asi pakariyangaw ta kamamang ka vaat: ra aley ki niperi papakipoey ta wagi ka ana.

23.niv: At that time if anyone says to you, ‘Look, here is the Messiah!’ or, ‘There he is!’ do not believe it.
23.cmn: 那時，若有人對你們說：『基督在這裏』，或說：『基督在那裏』，你們不要信！
23.sry: Tu kidi ka ana ru matagikumaa hina lava ta timamang ki su imumian, Kitaey, tu hiya ta ti Kristus, tu hina lava, ina tnamising da.

24.niv: For false messiahs and false prophets will appear and perform great signs and wonders to deceive, if possible, even the elect.
24.cmn: 因為假基督、假先知將要起來，顯大神蹟、大奇事，倘若能行，連選民也就迷惑了。
24.sry: Ka gapita ta mabatung ka sukristus, ka su ta tamamatagitan, ka pamuta ki pukakidian ka irang, ki na ringey apa ki uringawen, kuma apa hina ka paturahayaw nein (ru ilpugen) ta niperi da.

25.niv: See, I have told you ahead of time.
25.cmn: 看哪，我預先告訴你們了。
25.sry: Kitaey, nipatagitanen aw kamu ra.

26.niv: “So if anyone tells you, ‘There he is, out in the wilderness,’ do not go out; or, ‘Here he is, in the inner rooms,’ do not believe it.
26.cmn: 若有人對你們說：『看哪，基督在曠野裏』，你們不要出去！或說：『看哪，基督在內屋中』，你們不要信！
26.sry: Ka tu patagikumahinaey nein ki su imumian, Kitaey, ayapulag ta teni, ina tawpapanag: Kitaey, ayalaf ta teni tu rbo, ina tnamising.

27.niv: For as lightning that comes from the east is visible even in the west, so will be the coming of the Son of Man.
27.cmn: 閃電從東邊發出，直照到西邊。人子降臨也要這樣。
27.sry: Nda mama ka maka reya ta rikat ka maramag tu kidi apa ki taga raur da, kumaa apa hina ta iruaey ki Alak ki kagulung.

28.niv: Wherever there is a carcass, there the vultures will gather.
28.cmn: 屍首在哪裏，鷹也必聚在那裏。」 人子的降臨 （可13‧24－27；路21‧25－28）
28.sry: Ka tumamang ta na kulaw, pawaklaklaey tu hina ta akey.

29.niv: “Immediately after the distress of those days “ ‘the sun will be darkened, and the moon will not give its light; the stars will fall from the sky, and the heavenly bodies will be shaken.’
29.cmn: 「那些日子的災難一過去， 日頭就變黑了， 月亮也不放光， 眾星要從天上墜落， 天勢都要震動。
29.sry: Ka madis siawug ki sasamuken ki ubulbulen ki wagi ka ana, karumdumey ta wagi, ka asi matikanaga ta vural, ka muaringa maka vulum ta atatalingey, ka pakilikalikaey ta kailgan ki tunun ki vuluvulum.

30.niv: “Then will appear the sign of the Son of Man in heaven. And then all the peoples of the earth will mourn when they see the Son of Man coming on the clouds of heaven, with power and great glory.
30.cmn: 那時，人子的兆頭要顯在天上，地上的萬族都要哀哭。他們要看見人子，有能力，有大榮耀，駕着天上的雲降臨。
30.sry: Ka tu kidi ki ana mupanaga ta pukidian ki Alak ki kagulung tu vulum: ka tumangitangia du ana ta imidey aw ki kavuivuilan ki nay, ka kmitaa ki Alak ki kagulung, du irua tu purararey ki vulum tu kailgan ki keyrangan ki kidi ka maluaf.

31.niv: And he will send his angels with a loud trumpet call, and they will gather his elect from the four winds, from one end of the heavens to the other.
31.cmn: 他要差遣使者，用號筒的大聲，將他的選民，從四方，從天這邊到天那邊，都招聚了來。」 從無花果樹學個比方 （可13‧28－31；路21‧29－33）
31.sry: Ka padingiey tin ta tamagnaw tin ki yup ki oni apa ka irang, ka papakuilalawa ki niperi tin, ki pagapat ki nipakakwaan ki varevare, na suytunun ki vuluvulum tu kidi apa ki limulimu ki ana.

32.niv: “Now learn this lesson from the fig tree: As soon as its twigs get tender and its leaves come out, you know that summer is near.
32.cmn: 「你們可以從無花果樹學個比方：當樹枝發嫩長葉的時候，你們就知道夏天近了。
32.sry: Ka madaama mumha ki paranag ka lakawungen ki pamikawlawlaan: iru ka maawkuna ta pehil tin, ka musurag ta hapa tin, kalangen umi ka ayahili ta dagulang.

33.niv: Even so, when you see all these things, you know that it is near, right at the door.
33.cmn: 這樣，你們看見這一切的事，也該知道人子近了，正在門口了。
33.sry: Kuma apahina ta imumi, iru kitaey umi ta mamang ka ata, kalangaw umi ka ayatuk ayangataf ta ana.

34.niv: Truly I tell you, this generation will certainly not pass away until all these things have happened.
34.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，這世代還沒有過去，這些事都要成就。
34.sry: Mising kun aw kamu, asi maliawraga ta kavuilan ka ata, ka pagkahan ato pamut imidey aw kamamang ka ana.

35.niv: Heaven and earth will pass away, but my words will never pass away.
35.cmn: 天地要廢去，我的話卻不能廢去。」 那日那時沒有人知道 （可13‧32－37；路17‧26－30，34－36）
35.sry: Maliawraga ta vulum ki nay, ra asi maliawraga ta kasuan aw.

36.niv: “But about that day or hour no one knows, not even the angels in heaven, nor the Son, but only the Father.
36.cmn: 「但那日子，那時辰，沒有人知道，連天上的使者也不知道，子也不知道，惟獨父知道。
36.sry: Ra kidi ki wagi ki tagley apa ka ana asi mumha ta timamang, asi apa ta tamagnaw ka tu tunun ki vulum, dik ka Raraman aw tu saat.

37.niv: As it was in the days of Noah, so it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.
37.cmn: 挪亞的日子怎樣，人子降臨也要怎樣。
37.sry: Ka mama ki na wagi ti Nowe, kuma apa hina ta iruey ki Alak ki kagulung.

38.niv: For in the days before the flood, people were eating and drinking, marrying and giving in marriage, up to the day Noah entered the ark;
38.cmn: 當洪水以前的日子，人照常吃喝嫁娶，直到挪亞進方舟的那日；
38.sry: Nda mama ka kumahina ki kidi du ausi apa ta vaha ka irang, ka nimavok, nimit, niputbung, nipaputbung ta neni, tu kidi apa ki wagi ka ana ka niurbo ti Nowe tu sato [ka nipeyavang]

39.niv: and they knew nothing about what would happen until the flood came and took them all away. That is how it will be at the coming of the Son of Man.
39.cmn: 不知不覺洪水來了，把他們全都沖去。人子降臨也要這樣。
39.sry: Ka asi nein nikalang tu kidi apa ka ana ka irua ta vaha ka irang, ka maawimid maawmia nenian: kuma lapa hina ta iruaey ki kagulung.

40.niv: Two men will be in the field; one will be taken and the other left.
40.cmn: 那時，兩個人在田裏，取去一個，撇下一個。
40.sry: Tu kidi ka ana ayaumaa ta raruha ki vual, ka araaw ta saat, ka paitukwaaw ta saat.

41.niv: Two women will be grinding with a hand mill; one will be taken and the other left.
41.cmn: 兩個女人推磨，取去一個，撇下一個。
41.sry: Raruha ka inaina ka mahaltinga tu kahaltingan, saat ta araaw, saat ta paitukakwaaw.

42.niv: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know on what day your Lord will come.
42.cmn: 所以，你們要警醒，因為不知道你們的主是哪一天來到。
