42.sry: Anata mahamaa aley ka asi umi umhaen ta tagley ka mano ka iruaey ki Meyrang umi.

43.niv: But understand this: If the owner of the house had known at what time of night the thief was coming, he would have kept watch and would not have let his house be broken into.
43.cmn: 家主若知道幾更天有賊來，就必警醒，不容人挖透房屋；這是你們所知道的。
43.sry: Nda umhaaw ta ana, iru niumhaen ki tagitalag tu suayamen ka papina ta iruaa ta matalyaw, ina tin mawaa, ina tin asi pakarianey ta talag tin.

44.niv: So you also must be ready, because the Son of Man will come at an hour when you do not expect him.
44.cmn: 所以，你們也要預備，因為你們想不到的時候，人子就來了。」 忠心和不忠心的僕人 （路12‧41－48）
44.sry: Aley ki ata, nda tmado apa tmanang ta imumi, aley ka tu kidi ki tagley ka asi umi habawaten, iruaa ta Alak ki kagulung.

45.niv: “Who then is the faithful and wise servant, whom the master has put in charge of the servants in his household to give them their food at the proper time?
45.cmn: 「誰是忠心有見識的僕人，為主人所派，管理家裏的人，按時分糧給他們呢？
45.sry: Anata timang ta kuncia ka mashut ka matalagkaw, ka nipasibavawen ki Meyrang tin sat ka atalagan tin, aley ki pigaaney nenian ki kanaw tu kidi ka mariyang.

46.niv: It will be good for that servant whose master finds him doing so when he returns.
46.cmn: 主人來到，看見他這樣行，那僕人就有福了。
46.sry: Tamamatagiriyang ta kuncia ka ana, ka kabaleyaw ki Meyrang tin, du irua, ta meykumahina.

47.niv: Truly I tell you, he will put him in charge of all his possessions.
47.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，主人要派他管理一切所有的。
47.sry: Mising kun aw kamu ka pasibavawa tenian ki imid ki hurup tin.

48.niv: But suppose that servant is wicked and says to himself, ‘My master is staying away a long time,’
48.cmn: 倘若那惡僕心裏說：『我的主人必來得遲』，
48.sry: Hairu ra matagirmura tu tintin tin ta kuncia ka masamuk, Malanga irua ta Meyrang aw:

49.niv: and he then begins to beat his fellow servants and to eat and drink with drunkards.
49.cmn: 就動手打他的同伴，又和酒醉的人一同吃喝。
49.sry: Ka du maka naunamu bukbuk ki kuncia ka tagilalam tin, ka misala mavok, musala mit ki tamait.

50.niv: The master of that servant will come on a day when he does not expect him and at an hour he is not aware of.
50.cmn: 在想不到的日子，不知道的時辰，那僕人的主人要來，
50.sry: Anata iruaa ta Meyrang ka tamia ki kuncia ka ana tu wagi ki asi tin amamaten, tu kidi apa ki tagley ka asi tin umhaen.

51.niv: He will cut him to pieces and assign him a place with the hypocrites, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.
51.cmn: 重重地處治他，定他和假冒為善的人同罪；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。」
51.sry: Ka pasapiaga tenian, ka paitusala ki atag tin ki paninien ki rig ki su. Tu hinawa lato ta tangitangien ki patitingen ki walig.

1.niv: “At that time the kingdom of heaven will be like ten virgins who took their lamps and went out to meet the bridegroom.
1.cmn: 「那時，天國好比十個童女拿着燈出去迎接新郎。
1.sry: Tu kidi ka ana mamaa ta peysasuan ki tunun ki vuluvulum ki sat kitian ki kawinaina, ka ru niara nein ta puauging nein, nitawpapanag dumumaduma ki parag ka vahaw.

2.niv: Five of them were foolish and five were wise.
2.cmn: 其中有五個是愚拙的，五個是聰明的。
2.sry: Ka rarima ta neni ka matalagkaw, rarima apa ta maringaw.

3.niv: The foolish ones took their lamps but did not take any oil with them.
3.cmn: 愚拙的拿着燈，卻不預備油；
3.sry: Neni ka maringaw du niara nein ki puauging nein, asi nein niapara ki imag.

4.niv: The wise ones, however, took oil in jars along with their lamps.
4.cmn: 聰明的拿着燈，又預備油在器皿裏。
4.sry: Ra neni ka matalagkaw ta nimara ki imag tu sato nein apara ki puaugingan nein.

5.niv: The bridegroom was a long time in coming, and they all became drowsy and fell asleep.
5.cmn: 新郎遲延的時候，她們都打盹，睡着了。
5.sry: Iru ka malanga ta parag ka vahaw, nimiimid misurog, ka mirip ato

6.niv: “At midnight the cry rang out: ‘Hereʼs the bridegroom! Come out to meet him!’
6.cmn: 半夜有人喊着說：『新郎來了，你們出來迎接他！』
6.sry: Iru ka tukad ta awvan nipakulangagen, Kitaey, irarurua ta parag ka vahaw, tawpapanagey, dumadumaaw tenian.

7.niv: “Then all the virgins woke up and trimmed their lamps.
7.cmn: 那些童女就都起來收拾燈。
7.sry: Anata nigapit ta imid ki kawinaina ka ana, ka nisiriyang simimia ka puaugingan nein.

8.niv: The foolish ones said to the wise, ‘Give us some of your oil; our lamps are going out.’
8.cmn: 愚拙的對聰明的說：『請分點油給我們， 因為我們的燈要滅了。』
8.sry: Ka maringaw ta nikuma ki matalagkaw, Pigaey kame ki imag umi, ka miyup ta pataugingan yan.

9.niv: “ ‘No,’ they replied, ‘there may not be enough for both us and you. Instead, go to those who sell oil and buy some for yourselves.’
9.cmn: 聰明的回答說：『恐怕不夠你我用的；不如你們自己到賣油的那裏去買吧。』
9.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta matalagkaw, kuma, [Asi,] aley lava ka asi mamsinga imianan, imumian apa ta ruma: muuroa mukwa tu papeylan, ka peyla ato ki amumia.

10.niv: “But while they were on their way to buy the oil, the bridegroom arrived. The virgins who were ready went in with him to the wedding banquet. And the door was shut.
10.cmn: 她們去買的時候，新郎到了。那預備好了的，同他進去坐席，門就關了。
10.sry: Iru ka darangen nein peyla, niirua ta parag ka vahaw, ka neni ka nipatagitan, nitulam tenian murbo tu ibavavatugan mavok, ka niiluben ta ngataf.

11.niv: “Later the others also came. ‘Lord, Lord,’ they said, ‘open the door for us!’
11.cmn: 其餘的童女隨後也來了，說：『主啊，主啊，給我們開門！』
11.sry: Siawug niirua apa ta kawinaina ka raruma, kuma, Meyrang, meyrang, aawlubey kame.

12.niv: “But he replied, ‘Truly I tell you, I donʼt know you.’
12.cmn: 他卻回答說：『我實在告訴你們，我不認識你們。』
12.sry: Ka du matagivli ta teni nikuma, Mising kun aw kamu ra, asi ko kmalang imumian.

13.niv: “Therefore keep watch, because you do not know the day or the hour.
13.cmn: 所以，你們要警醒；因為那日子，那時辰，你們不知道。」 按才幹接受託付的比喻 （路19‧11－27）
13.sry: Anata mahamawaa, ka asi umi umhaen ta wagi ki kidi apa ki tagley ka iruaa ta Alak ki kagulung.

14.niv: “Again, it will be like a man going on a journey, who called his servants and entrusted his wealth to them.
14.cmn: 「天國又好比一個人要往外國去，就叫了僕人來，把他的家業交給他們，
14.sry: Ra mama [ka ana] ki kagulung, ka du tawhabula mukwa tu pani ki purug, nitmataam ki kuncia tin, ka nipaatununun tin nenian ki hurup tin.

15.niv: To one he gave five bags of gold, to another two bags, and to another one bag, each according to his ability. Then he went on his journey.
15.cmn: 按着各人的才幹給他們銀子：一個給了五千，一個給了二千，一個給了一千，就往外國去了。
15.sry: Ka nipiga rimaen tin ki talenten ki naunamu, nipiga ruhaen tin ta kararuha, nipiga saten tin ta kataturu, ta meybuavual na kidi ki pasiriyangey tin pasipipiyu, ka nimadis tawhabul.

16.niv: The man who had received five bags of gold went at once and put his money to work and gained five bags more.
16.cmn: 那領五千的隨即拿去做買賣，另外賺了五千。
16.sry: Ka teni ka niarima ki talenten, nidmarang pagiasa ki ana, ka niputan ki ririma ka pani.

17.niv: So also, the one with two bags of gold gained two more.
17.cmn: 那領二千的也照樣另賺了二千。
17.sry: Kuma apa hina ta teni ka niaruha, niputan ki ruruha ka pani.

18.niv: But the man who had received one bag went off, dug a hole in the ground and hid his masterʼs money.
18.cmn: 但那領一千的去掘開地，把主人的銀子埋藏了。
18.sry: Ra teni ka niasat mara, nidmarang kmari tu nay, ka niha tin ta malituk tin.

19.niv: “After a long time the master of those servants returned and settled accounts with them.
19.cmn: 過了許久，那些僕人的主人來了，和他們算帳。
19.sry: Ka siawug ki madalia ki kidi, niirua ta Meyrang ki kuncia ka ana, ka nikting tin meysal nenian.

20.niv: The man who had received five bags of gold brought the other five. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with five bags of gold. See, I have gained five more.’
20.cmn: 那領五千銀子的又帶着那另外的五千來，說：『主啊，你交給我五千銀子。請看，我又賺了五千。』
20.sry: Ka teni ka niarima ki talenten, nimukwa maad ki ririma apa ka pani ki talenten, ka nikun tin Meyrang ririma ki talenten ka nipigaen oho yawan, kitaey, ririma apa ka pani ki talenten, ka nipusaen ko putan ki ana.

21.niv: “His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your masterʼs happiness!’
21.cmn: 主人說：『好，你這又良善又忠心的僕人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把許多事派你管理；可以進來享受你主人的快樂。』
21.sry: Ka nikuma tenian ta Meyrang tin, Mamsing, kuncia ka mariyang ka makidkid, nimakidkid kaw tu katitingan, ka pasibavawaw maw kaw ki madag: Murboa tu karayan ki Meyrang oho.

22.niv: “The man with two bags of gold also came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘you entrusted me with two bags of gold; see, I have gained two more.’
22.cmn: 那領二千的也來，說：『主啊，你交給我二千銀子。請看，我又賺了二千。』
22.sry: Ka du mukwa ta teni, ka niaruha ki talenten, nikun tin, Meyrang, ruruha ki talenten ta nipigaen oho yawan, kitaey, ruruha apa ki pani ki talenten ka nipusaen ko putan.

23.niv: “His master replied, ‘Well done, good and faithful servant! You have been faithful with a few things; I will put you in charge of many things. Come and share your masterʼs happiness!’
23.cmn: 主人說：『好，你這又良善又忠心的僕人，你在不多的事上有忠心，我要把許多事派你管理；可以進來享受你主人的快樂。』
23.sry: Ka nikuma tenian ta Meyrang tin, Mamsing kuncia ka mariyang ka makidkid, Nimakidkid kaw katitingan, pasibavawaw maw kaw ki madag: Murboa tu karayan ki Meyrang oho.

24.niv: “Then the man who had received one bag of gold came. ‘Master,’ he said, ‘I knew that you are a hard man, harvesting where you have not sown and gathering where you have not scattered seed.
24.cmn: 那領一千的也來，說：『主啊，我知道你是忍心的人，沒有種的地方要收割，沒有散的地方要聚斂，
24.sry: Ka du mukwa ta teni ka niasat ki talen, nikun tin, Meyrang, kalangen aw kaw ka kagulung kaw ka maplag, ka mayam kaw ki asi muho na dadiri, ka palud kaw ki asi muho na sasasbug.

25.niv: So I was afraid and went out and hid your gold in the ground. See, here is what belongs to you.’
25.cmn: 我就害怕，去把你的一千銀子埋藏在地裏。請看，你的原銀子在這裏。』
25.sry: Ka aley ki takut aw nidmarang ko hmaa ki talen oho turbo ki nay: kitaey, akumeya kaw ki a'muho.

26.niv: “His master replied, ‘You wicked, lazy servant! So you knew that I harvest where I have not sown and gather where I have not scattered seed?
26.cmn: 主人回答說：『你這又惡又懶的僕人，你既知道我沒有種的地方要收割，沒有散的地方要聚斂，
26.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta Meyrang tin, kuma tenian, Kuncia ka mate, ka mangad, kavanaen hu, ka mayam ko tu asi maw na dadiri, ka palud ko ki asi maw na sasasbug.

27.niv: Well then, you should have put my money on deposit with the bankers, so that when I returned I would have received it back with interest.
27.cmn: 就當把我的銀子放給兌換銀錢的人，到我來的時候，可以連本帶利收回。
27.sry: Anata ina muho pigaey ta malituk aw ki tamaviri, ka du irua ato ko, nialikug ta a'yaw lam ki tan.

28.niv: “ ‘So take the bag of gold from him and give it to the one who has ten bags.
28.cmn: 奪過他這一千來，給那有一萬的。
28.sry: Anata hamiaw ta talent ka ana, ka pigaaney ato tenian ka akumeya ki sat kitian ki talenten.

29.niv: For whoever has will be given more, and they will have an abundance. Whoever does not have, even what they have will be taken from them.
29.cmn: 因為凡有的，還要加給他，叫他有餘；沒有的，連他所有的也要奪過來。
29.sry: Ka veyag ka akumeya, teni ta pigaey, ka pudimey apa; ra teni ka ausi, araey apa ta akumeya tenian.

30.niv: And throw that worthless servant outside, into the darkness, where there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.’
30.cmn: 把這無用的僕人丟在外面黑暗裏；在那裏必要哀哭切齒了。』」 萬民受審判
30.sry: Ka aringaney ta kuncia ka ana ka saramsam smakitawag tenian tu siuro itutawag ka karumduman, tu hinawa lato ta tangitangian ki patitingen apa ki walig.

31.niv: “When the Son of Man comes in his glory, and all the angels with him, he will sit on his glorious throne.
31.cmn: 「當人子在他榮耀裏、同着眾天使降臨的時候，要坐在他榮耀的寶座上。
31.sry: Ka ru iruaa ato ta Alak ki kagulung tu keyrangan ki kidi tin, imid apa ki tamagnaw ka dilig matiktik tulam tenian, ana ta irungey tin tu irarungan ki keyrangan ki kidi tin.

32.niv: All the nations will be gathered before him, and he will separate the people one from another as a shepherd separates the sheep from the goats.
32.cmn: 萬民都要聚集在他面前。他要把他們分別出來，好像牧羊的分別綿羊山羊一般，
32.sry: Ka papasaley tu amag tenian ta imid ki tautau, ka papagpiagey tin ta neni ka ana maito tavatavag mama ki suayam ka papagpiag ki yuko ki yu.

33.niv: He will put the sheep on his right and the goats on his left.
33.cmn: 把綿羊安置在右邊，山羊在左邊。
33.sry: Ka paitu uwaley tin ta yuko, ra paitu ugiey tin ta yu.

34.niv: “Then the King will say to those on his right, ‘Come, you who are blessed by my Father; take your inheritance, the kingdom prepared for you since the creation of the world.
34.cmn: 於是王要向那右邊的說：『你們這蒙我父賜福的，可來承受那創世以來為你們所預備的國；
34.sry: Anata matagikumaa apa hina ki su ta Meysasu ka Sibavaw nenian ka itukwa tu uwal tin, Mukwa hiya ta imumi ka nipakariyangen kamu ki su ki Rama aw, tabli ato ki Peysasuan ka nitanangen imumian na kidi ki nipaitu samdingen ta rarun ki nay.

35.niv: For I was hungry and you gave me something to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me something to drink, I was a stranger and you invited me in,
35.cmn: 因為我餓了，你們給我吃，渴了，你們給我喝；我作客旅，你們留我住；
35.sry: Ka nimagangey ko, ka nipakan umi yawan; Nimaito ko, ka nipait umi yawan; Nitagakwaen ato maw, ka nipeytatalag umi yawan.

36.niv: I needed clothes and you clothed me, I was sick and you looked after me, I was in prison and you came to visit me.’
36.cmn: 我赤身露體，你們給我穿；我病了，你們看顧我；我在監裏，你們來看我。』
36.sry: Nimanana, ka nipapakulamug kamu yawan: Nimalam ko, ka niduoy kamu yawan; Niayakwaen aw tu sangat, ka nimukwa kamu yawan.

37.niv: “Then the righteous will answer him, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry and feed you, or thirsty and give you something to drink?
37.cmn: 義人就回答說：『主啊，我們甚麼時候見你餓了，給你吃，渴了，給你喝？
37.sry: Anata matagivlia tenian ta matiktik, ka kumaa, Meyrang, nikitaan yan ka mano imhuan ka magangey kaw, ka nipakan yan? ka maito kaw, ka nipaiten yan imhuan?

38.niv: When did we see you a stranger and invite you in, or needing clothes and clothe you?
38.cmn: 甚麼時候見你作客旅，留你住，或是赤身露體，給你穿？
38.sry: Ka nikitaan yan ka mano imhuan ka tagakwa kaw, ka paitalagen yan imhuan? ka manana kaw, ka nipapakulamugen yan imhuan?

39.niv: When did we see you sick or in prison and go to visit you?’
39.cmn: 又甚麼時候見你病了，或是在監裏，來看你呢？』
39.sry: Nikitaan yan ka mano, ka maalam kaw, ka tu sangat, ka niukwaen yan imhuan?

40.niv: “The King will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did for one of the least of these brothers and sisters of mine, you did for me.’
40.cmn: 王要回答說：『我實在告訴你們，這些事你們既做在我這弟兄中一個最小的身上，就是做在我身上了。』
40.sry: Ka matagivlia ta Meysasu ka Sibavaw, matagikumahina nenian, Mising kun aw kamu, papinaan umi pamut [ta ata] ki saat ki tagiapaparag aw ka ata ka usising, nipamuten umi [ta ana] yawan.

41.niv: “Then he will say to those on his left, ‘Depart from me, you who are cursed, into the eternal fire prepared for the devil and his angels.
41.cmn: 王又要向那左邊的說：『你們這被咒詛的人，離開我！進入那為魔鬼和他的使者所預備的永火裏去！
41.sry: Anata matagikumaa apa hina ki su nenian ka itu ugi, Dmaranga yawan imumi ka nipakuavavagen mukwa tu apuy ka mikakwa midarinug, ka tanangen ka ato Litua ki tamagnaw apa tin.

42.niv: For I was hungry and you gave me nothing to eat, I was thirsty and you gave me nothing to drink,
42.cmn: 因為我餓了，你們不給我吃，渴了，你們不給我喝；
42.sry: Ka nikagangeyen aw, ka asi umi nipakan yawan; Niitoen aw, ka asi umi nipait yawan.

43.niv: I was a stranger and you did not invite me in, I needed clothes and you did not clothe me, I was sick and in prison and you did not look after me.’
43.cmn: 我作客旅，你們不留我住；我赤身露體，你們不給我穿；我病了，我在監裏，你們不來看顧我。』
43.sry: Nitagakwaen aw, ka asi umi nipaitalag yawan: Nipananagen aw, ka asi umi nipapakulamug yawan; Nikaalamen aw, ka niitukwaen aw tu sangat, ka as iumi nikitaan yawan.

44.niv: “They also will answer, ‘Lord, when did we see you hungry or thirsty or a stranger or needing clothes or sick or in prison, and did not help you?’
44.cmn: 他們也要回答說：『主啊，我們甚麼時候見你餓了，或渴了，或作客旅，或赤身露體，或病了，或在監裏，不伺候你呢？』
44.sry: Anata matagivlia ta neni tenian matagikumahina, Meyrang, mano ka nikitaan yan imhuan, ka maito, ka tagakwa, ka manana, ka maalam, ka tu sangat lava, ka asi yan niilingigen peylilig imhuan?

45.niv: “He will reply, ‘Truly I tell you, whatever you did not do for one of the least of these, you did not do for me.’
45.cmn: 王要回答說：『我實在告訴你們，這些事你們既不做在我這弟兄中一個最小的身上，就是不做在我身上了。』
45.sry: Anata matagivlia ta teni ki su nenian, Mising kun aw kamu ra: Papinaan umi asi pamut [ta ana] ki saat ki usising ka ata, asi apa umi nipamuten ta ata yawan.

46.niv: “Then they will go away to eternal punishment, but the righteous to eternal life.”
46.cmn: 這些人要往永刑裏去；那些義人要往永生裏去。」
46.sry: Ka mukwaa ta neni ka ata tu pagialalaman ka mikakwa midarinug; ra neni ka matiktik, tu kawagan ka mikakwa midarinug.

1.niv: When Jesus had finished saying all these things, he said to his disciples,
1.cmn: 耶穌說完了這一切的話，就對門徒說：
1.sry: Ka nipamting, du nipatagikahan ti Yesus matagilimulimu ki su ka ata, ka nikuma ki patawutawugan tin,

2.niv: “As you know, the Passover is two days away—and the Son of Man will be handed over to be crucified.”
2.cmn: 「你們知道，過兩天是逾越節，人子將要被交給人，釘在十字架上。」
2.sry: Kavana umi ka ruruha apa ki wagi muvatuga ki halidawan, ka paatununey ta Alak ki kagulung tu punavavaragey tenian.

3.niv: Then the chief priests and the elders of the people assembled in the palace of the high priest, whose name was Caiaphas,
3.cmn: 那時，祭司長和民間的長老聚集在大祭司稱為該亞法的院裏。
3.sry: Anata nimawisal ta sibavaw ka tamapigik, ta makusasulat, ki mamumu apa ki tau, tu glaf ki dadilug ka sibavaw, ka ti Kayafas ta nanang tin.

4.niv: and they schemed to arrest Jesus secretly and kill him.
4.cmn: 大家商議要用詭計拿住耶穌，殺他，
4.sry: Ka nikmiim ki su, ka turungaw nein ki sivanavanaan ta ti Yesus, ka pakapatayaw apa ta teni.

5.niv: “But not during the festival,” they said, “or there may be a riot among the people.”
5.cmn: 只是說：「當節的日子不可，恐怕民間生亂。」 在伯大尼受膏 （可14‧3－9；約12‧1－8）
5.sry: Ka nikuma ta neni: Asi tu uvavatugan, aley ka ausia ki kavarutivutan ki tau.

6.niv: While Jesus was in Bethany in the home of Simon the Leper,
6.cmn: 耶穌在伯大尼長大痲瘋的西門家裏，
6.sry: Ka ru ayakwa ta ti Yesus tu Bethania tu talag ti Simon ka utaumen ato [ki Leproos;]

7.niv: a woman came to him with an alabaster jar of very expensive perfume, which she poured on his head as he was reclining at the table.
7.cmn: 有一個女人拿着一玉瓶極貴的香膏來，趁耶穌坐席的時候，澆在他的頭上。
7.sry: Niirua tenian ta ina ka meykwa ki vato ka pule ka rukul, ka aku rapul ka uhang ki angal, ka nirudo tin ta ana masihalap ki vungo tin tu irarungan tin tu avokan.

8.niv: When the disciples saw this, they were indignant. “Why this waste?” they asked.
8.cmn: 門徒看見就很不喜悅，說：「何用這樣的枉費呢！
8.sry: Iru ka kakitaan ta ana ki patawutawugan tin, uhang nimaidingit ta neni, kun, Kaumang ta ataninoan ka ata?

9.niv: “This perfume could have been sold at a high price and the money given to the poor.”
9.cmn: 這香膏可以賣許多錢，賙濟窮人。」
9.sry: Ka ina patuilpug papeyla tu uhang ki angal ta rapul ka ata, papigaaney ta than tin ki tau ka malimuk.

10.niv: Aware of this, Jesus said to them, “Why are you bothering this woman? She has done a beautiful thing to me.
10.cmn: 耶穌看出他們的意思，就說：「為甚麼難為這女人呢？她在我身上做的是一件美事。
10.sry: Ra tu umhaen ti Yesus [ta ata] nikuma nenian, Kaumang ka pakahimko umi ta ina ka ata? Ka mariyang ta na ringey tin yawan da.

11.niv: The poor you will always have with you, but you will not always have me.
11.cmn: 因為常有窮人和你們同在；只是你們不常有我。
11.sry: Ka mikakwa akumeyaa kamu ki malimuk ayakwa imumian, ra ausia kamu mikakwa yawan.

12.niv: When she poured this perfume on my body, she did it to prepare me for burial.
12.cmn: 她將這香膏澆在我身上是為我安葬做的。
12.sry: Nda iru ka nirudo tin ta rapul ka ata tu vual aw, nipamuten ta ana [tu sitanen] ki ravakey yawan.

13.niv: Truly I tell you, wherever this gospel is preached throughout the world, what she has done will also be told, in memory of her.”
13.cmn: 我實在告訴你們，普天之下，無論在甚麼地方傳這福音，也要述說這女人所行的，作個紀念。」 猶大出賣耶穌 （可14‧10－11；路22‧3－6）
13.sry: Mising kun aw kamu, tumang ka patasasuey ta hagnaw ka ata ka mariyang tu imid ki nay, pasusuey apa hina ta mamang ka na ringey tin tu hibavaleyan tenian.

14.niv: Then one of the Twelve—the one called Judas Iscariot—went to the chief priests
14.cmn: 當下，十二門徒裏有一個稱為加略人猶大的，去見祭司長，
14.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nidmarang ta saat ki sat kitian ab ki ruha ka ana, ka ti Yudas Iskariyut ta nanang tin, ka nimukwa ki sibavaw ka tamapigik,

15.niv: and asked, “What are you willing to give me if I deliver him over to you?” So they counted out for him thirty pieces of silver.
15.cmn: 說： 「我把他交給你們，你們願意給我多少錢？」他們就給了他三十塊錢。
15.sry: Kuma, Mang ta pigaeyaney umi yawan, ka paatununey maw tenian imumian? Ka nisikidien nein tenian turu kitian ki malituk.

16.niv: From then on Judas watched for an opportunity to hand him over.
16.cmn: 從那時候，他就找機會要把耶穌交給他們。 和門徒同度逾越節 （可14‧12－21；路22‧7－14，21－23；約13‧21－30）
16.sry: Ka na kidi ka ana nihawaten tin ta kidi ka mariyang, ka manono ka paatununaney tin tenian.

17.niv: On the first day of the Festival of Unleavened Bread, the disciples came to Jesus and asked, “Where do you want us to make preparations for you to eat the Passover?”
17.cmn: 除酵節的第一天，門徒來問耶穌說：「你吃逾越節的筵席，要我們在哪裏給你預備？」
17.sry: Ka tu naunamu ki wagi ka asi nipeyapingit [ta paul] niirua ta patawutawugan ti Yesus, ka nikun nein tenian, Tumang ta kamuyen oho ka tanangaw yan imhuan pakan ki yuko ki halidaw?

18.niv: He replied, “Go into the city to a certain man and tell him, ‘The Teacher says: My appointed time is near. I am going to celebrate the Passover with my disciples at your house.’ ”
18.cmn: 耶穌說：「你們進城去，到某人那裏，對他說：『夫子說：我的時候快到了，我與門徒要在你家裏守逾越節。』」
18.sry: Ka nikuma ta teni, ukwaaw tu awma ka ana ti anoan, ka bana tenian, Na su ki Matatawutawug, tu tuk ta kidi aw, kukwaa ko kman imhuan [ki yuko] ki halidawan lam ki patawutawugan aw.

19.niv: So the disciples did as Jesus had directed them and prepared the Passover.
19.cmn: 門徒遵着耶穌所吩咐的就去預備了逾越節的筵席。
19.sry: Ka nimeyamut ta patawutawugan, mama ki na siatawtawug ti Yesus nenian, ka nipatagitan nein [ta yuko] ki halidawan.

20.niv: When evening came, Jesus was reclining at the table with the Twelve.
20.cmn: 到了晚上，耶穌和十二個門徒坐席。
20.sry: Iru ka madung ato nikulam mirung ki sat kitian ab ki ruha.

21.niv: And while they were eating, he said, “Truly I tell you, one of you will betray me.”
21.cmn: 正吃的時候，耶穌說：「我實在告訴你們，你們中間有一個人要賣我了。」
21.sry: Iru ka kanun nein, ana ta nikuma ta teni, Mising kun aw kamu, ka saat imumian ta sivanavanaa yawan.

22.niv: They were very sad and began to say to him one after the other, “Surely you donʼt mean me, Lord?”
22.cmn: 他們就甚憂愁，一個一個地問他說：「主，是我嗎？」
22.sry: Ka ru uhang ta neni mivavulas, nimataginaunamu ta meybuavual nenian matagikumahina tenian, Ti yaw kawa Meyrang?

23.niv: Jesus replied, “The one who has dipped his hand into the bowl with me will betray me.
23.cmn: 耶穌回答說：「同我蘸手在盤子裏的，就是他要賣我。
23.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta teni, kuma, Teni ka sumilam yawan du mawk ki rima tin tu tangya, teni ta sivanavanaa yawan.

24.niv: The Son of Man will go just as it is written about him. But woe to that man who betrays the Son of Man! It would be better for him if he had not been born.”
24.cmn: 人子必要去世，正如經上指着他所寫的；但賣人子的人有禍了！那人不生在世上倒好。」
24.sry: Uma ato ka dmarang ta Alak ki kagulung mama ki nisulaten ato tenian, ra anay ki tau ka ana sivanavanaa ki Alak ki kagulung, ina mariyang tenian, ru asi nipeyalaken ta kagulung ka ana.

25.niv: Then Judas, the one who would betray him, said, “Surely you donʼt mean me, Rabbi?” Jesus answered, “You have said so.”
25.cmn: 賣耶穌的猶大問他說：「拉比，是我嗎？」耶穌說：「你說的是。」 設立主的晚餐 （可14‧22－26；路22‧15－20；林前11‧23－25）
25.sry: Ka ti Yudas ka sivanavana tenian ta nimatagivli, kuma, Ti yaw kawa Rabi? Nikuma ta teni tenian, Patagiruken ato muho.

26.niv: While they were eating, Jesus took bread, and when he had given thanks, he broke it and gave it to his disciples, saying, “Take and eat; this is my body.”
26.cmn: 他們吃的時候，耶穌拿起餅來，祝福，就擘開，遞給門徒，說：「你們拿着吃，這是我的身體」；
26.sry: Iru ka meykakan ta neni, nimumawug ta ti Yesus ki paul, ka ru nimakuvli makualilid, nipipi tin, ka nipigaan tin ki patawutawugan tin ta ata, ka nikuma, Araw, kanaw, ata ta vual aw.

27.niv: Then he took a cup, and when he had given thanks, he gave it to them, saying, “Drink from it, all of you.
27.cmn: 又拿起杯來，祝謝了，遞給他們，說：「你們都喝這個；
27.sry: Ka ru niawug tin ta hawug ka aitan, ka ru nipakuvli tin makualilid, nipigaen tin nenian ta ata, kuma, Hutumukaw umi tu [hawug ki] ata.

28.niv: This is my blood of the covenant, which is poured out for many for the forgiveness of sins.
28.cmn: 因為這是我立約的血，為多人流出來，使罪得赦。
28.sry: Ka ata ta gamag aw, [ta gamag] ki sikavagen ka vahaw, ka tiriaw aley ki mabatung tu atanino ki varaw.

29.niv: I tell you, I will not drink from this fruit of the vine from now on until that day when I drink it new with you in my Fatherʼs kingdom.”
29.cmn: 但我告訴你們，從今以後，我不再喝這葡萄汁，直到我在我父的國裏同你們喝新的那日子。」
29.sry: Ka pasusuen aw kamu, ka asi maw itaw na kidi hinin ki na vua ka ata ki ngara ki karawmatag, tu kidi apa ki wagi ka ana, ru hubahawaw maw mit ta ata hmulam imumian tu peysasuan ki raraman aw.

30.niv: When they had sung a hymn, they went out to the Mount of Olives.
30.cmn: 他們唱了詩，就出來往橄欖山去。 預言彼得不認主 （可14‧27－31；路22‧31－34；約13‧36－38）
30.sry: Iru ka takakahan nein ta takalulugan, nitawpapanag ta neni mukwa tu vukin ka makavavua ki aku imag.

31.niv: Then Jesus told them, “This very night you will all fall away on account of me, for it is written: “ ‘I will strike the shepherd, and the sheep of the flock will be scattered.’
31.cmn: 那時，耶穌對他們說：「今夜，你們為我的緣故都要跌倒。因為經上記着說： 我要擊打牧人， 羊就分散了。
31.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Pakaimidaw kamu pakavaraw ki awvan ka ata: Aley ka nisasulaten, Apidaw maw ta suayam, ka papagiavuakaw ta yuko ki yuag.

32.niv: But after I have risen, I will go ahead of you into Galilee.”
32.cmn: 但我復活以後，要在你們以先往加利利去。」
32.sry: Iru ka hakahaa lato ko gapit, tawururua ko imumian mukwa tu Galilayan.

33.niv: Peter replied, “Even if all fall away on account of you, I never will.”
33.cmn: 彼得說：「眾人雖然為你的緣故跌倒，我卻永不跌倒。」
33.sry: Ra nimatagivli ta ti Petrus kuma tenian, Meyta ru pakaimidaw ta neni pakavaraw aley imhuan, mikakwa ko asi pakavarawaw ta ti yaw.

34.niv: “Truly I tell you,” Jesus answered, “this very night, before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.”
34.cmn: 耶穌說：「我實在告訴你，今夜雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」
34.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Mising kun aw kaw, ka tu awvan ka ata du asi apa muni ta tafuka, ka taturuley muho rmaw yawan.

35.niv: But Peter declared, “Even if I have to die with you, I will never disown you.” And all the other disciples said the same.
35.cmn: 彼得說：「我就是必須和你同死，也總不能不認你。」眾門徒都是這樣說。 在客西馬尼禱告 （可14‧32－42；路22‧39－46）
35.sry: Nikuma ta ti Petrus tenian, Meyta ru pislalam apa maw kaw mapatay, asi ko rmawa imhuan. Ka kuma apa hina ki su ta imid ki patawutawugan.

36.niv: Then Jesus went with his disciples to a place called Gethsemane, and he said to them, “Sit here while I go over there and pray.”
36.cmn: 耶穌同門徒來到一個地方，名叫客西馬尼，就對他們說：「你們坐在這裏，等我到那邊去禱告。」
36.sry: Anata nitulam nenian ta ti Yesus mukwa tu itukakwaan ka pananangen Getsemani, ka nikuma ki patawutawugan, Mirunga hiya tu kidi ki ukwaey maw hina makualilid.

37.niv: He took Peter and the two sons of Zebedee along with him, and he began to be sorrowful and troubled.
37.cmn: 於是帶着彼得和西庇太的兩個兒子同去，就憂愁起來，極其難過，
37.sry: Iru ka patupara tenian ti Petrusan, ki raruha apa ka na alalak ti Zebedeyus, nimanaunamu mavulas maluaf apa mahimko ta teni.

38.niv: Then he said to them, “My soul is overwhelmed with sorrow to the point of death. Stay here and keep watch with me.”
38.cmn: 便對他們說：「我心裏甚是憂傷，幾乎要死；你們在這裏等候，和我一同警醒。」
38.sry: Anata nikuma ta teni nenian, Matarawug mavulas ta vati aw tu kidi ki kapatayan; itukwa hiya mahamawaa itulam yawan.

39.niv: Going a little farther, he fell with his face to the ground and prayed, “My Father, if it is possible, may this cup be taken from me. Yet not as I will, but as you will.”
39.cmn: 他就稍往前走，俯伏在地，禱告說：「我父啊，倘若可行，求你叫這杯離開我。然而，不要照我的意思，只要照你的意思。」
39.sry: Iru ka niukakukwa tin, nimagakub ki vulung tin, ka nimakualilid, kuma, Rama aw, hairu ka ilpugen, pahaliawraga yawan ki hawug ka ata ka aitan: Nda asi mama ki kamuyen aw, ra mama apa ki kamuyen hu.

40.niv: Then he returned to his disciples and found them sleeping. “Couldnʼt you men keep watch with me for one hour?” he asked Peter.
40.cmn: 來到門徒那裏，見他們睡着了，就對彼得說：「怎麼樣？你們不能同我警醒片時嗎？
40.sry: Ka nimukwa ta teni ki patatawutawugan, ka nikumabaley nenian ka mirip, ka nikuma ti Petrusan, Mauru kamu kawa mahamawaga tulam yawan sasat ki tagley?

41.niv: “Watch and pray so that you will not fall into temptation. The spirit is willing, but the flesh is weak.”
41.cmn: 總要警醒禱告，免得入了迷惑。你們心靈固然願意，肉體卻軟弱了。」
41.sry: Nda mahamawaga makualilida, ka asi umi ukwaey tu repungan: Masurol ta yupan, ra asi masakit ta vaat.

42.niv: He went away a second time and prayed, “My Father, if it is not possible for this cup to be taken away unless I drink it, may your will be done.”
42.cmn: 第二次又去禱告說：「我父啊，這杯若不能離開我，必要我喝，就願你的意旨成全。」
42.sry: Mila tu kararuha du ukwa tin, nimakualilid, kuma, Rama aw, hairu asi maliphug maliawrag yawan ta hawug ka ata ka aitan, du asi maw huuroen mit, nda pamut ato ta kamuyen hu.

43.niv: When he came back, he again found them sleeping, because their eyes were heavy.
43.cmn: 又來，見他們睡着了，因為他們的眼睛困倦。
43.sry: Ka du mukwa ta teni, mila kumabaley nenian ka mirip; aley ka uhang marisig ta mata nein.

44.niv: So he left them and went away once more and prayed the third time, saying the same thing.
44.cmn: 耶穌又離開他們去了。第三次禱告，說的話還是與先前一樣。
44.sry: Ka du paikakwa nenian, niukwa tin mila, ka nimakualilid tu ka taturu, matagila teni ki sura.

45.niv: Then he returned to the disciples and said to them, “Are you still sleeping and resting? Look, the hour has come, and the Son of Man is delivered into the hands of sinners.
45.cmn: 於是來到門徒那裏，對他們說：「現在你們仍然睡覺安歇吧！時候到了，人子被賣在罪人手裏了。
45.sry: Anata nimukwa ta teni ki patawutawugan tin, kuma nenian, Smasinipa smakilikug ki mangahar peyhababa: Kitaey matuk ato ta kidi ki tagley, ka paatununaw ta Alak ki kagulung tu rima ki tamakavaraw.

46.niv: Rise! Let us go! Here comes my betrayer!”
46.sry: Matimawaga gapit, ukwaey mita, kitaey, mutuk ato ta simhamha yawan.

47.niv: While he was still speaking, Judas, one of the Twelve, arrived. With him was a large crowd armed with swords and clubs, sent from the chief priests and the elders of the people.
47.cmn: 說話之間，那十二個門徒裏的猶大來了，並有許多人帶着刀棒，從祭司長和民間的長老那裏與他同來。
47.sry: Iru ka masusu apa ta teni, kitaey, Niirua ta ti Yudas ka saat kitian ab ki ruha, ka tulam tenian ta kalawaan ka irang ka meykwa ki tiraw ki vavuvukbuk, ka nipadingien ki tamapigik ka sibavaw, ki mamumu apa ki tau.

48.niv: Now the betrayer had arranged a signal with them: “The one I kiss is the man; arrest him.”
48.cmn: 那賣耶穌的給了他們一個暗號，說：「我與誰親嘴，誰就是他。你們可以拿住他。」
48.sry: Ka teni ka sivanavana tenian, nipukidi nenian, kuma, Teni ka baigaw maw, teni ta ti ana, tmurunga tenian.

49.niv: Going at once to Jesus, Judas said, “Greetings, Rabbi!” and kissed him.
49.cmn: 猶大隨即到耶穌跟前，說：「請拉比安」，就與他親嘴。
49.sry: Ka madis du mukwa ti Yesusan, nikun tin, Tabe Rabi, ka nibaig tenian.

50.niv: Jesus replied, “Do what you came for, friend.” Then the men stepped forward, seized Jesus and arrested him.
50.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「朋友，你來要做的事，就做吧。」於是那些人上前，下手拿住耶穌。
50.sry: Ra nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Diu, Umang kaw hiya? Anata du nimutuk ta neni, nipatukwa ki rima ti Yesusan, ka nitmurung apa tenian.

51.niv: With that, one of Jesusʼ companions reached for his sword, drew it out and struck the servant of the high priest, cutting off his ear.
51.cmn: 有跟隨耶穌的一個人伸手拔出刀來，將大祭司的僕人砍了一刀，削掉了他一個耳朵。
51.sry: Ka kitaey, sasat nenian ka tulam ti Yesusan, du sikig ki rima, nilmugut ki tiraw tin, ka nirumad ki kuncia ki dadilug, tubo ki tangira tin.

52.niv: “Put your sword back in its place,” Jesus said to him, “for all who draw the sword will die by the sword.
52.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「收刀入鞘吧！凡動刀的，必死在刀下。
52.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Pulikugaw pukarulung ta tiraw oho; aley ka na mamang ta mara ki tiraw, sidadaw pakapatay ta neni ti tiraw.

53.niv: Do you think I cannot call on my Father, and he will at once put at my disposal more than twelve legions of angels?
53.cmn: 你想，我不能求我父現在為我差遣十二營多天使來嗎？
53.sry: Pagdumdumen hu lava, ka asi ko makulpug makualilid hinin ki Raraman aw, ka patulama ta teni yawan masaun madag ki sat kitian ab ki ruha ki Legionen, ki tamagnaw.

54.niv: But how then would the Scriptures be fulfilled that say it must happen in this way?”
54.cmn: 若是這樣，經上所說，事情必須如此的話怎麼應驗呢？」
54.sry: Nda pavutaw mama ki mang ta sasulat, [ka kuma] ka pamutaney kumahina ta mamang ka ata.

55.niv: In that hour Jesus said to the crowd, “Am I leading a rebellion, that you have come out with swords and clubs to capture me? Every day I sat in the temple courts teaching, and you did not arrest me.
55.cmn: 當時，耶穌對眾人說：「你們帶着刀棒出來拿我，如同拿強盜嗎？我天天坐在殿裏教訓人，你們並沒有拿我。
55.sry: Tu kidi ki tagley ka ata nikuma ta ti Yesus ki kalawan, Nitawpapanag kamu mama ki mukwaa ki tamalpug, ki tiraw ki vavuvukbuk, aley ki turungaw umi yawan; wagiwagi nimisal ko mirung imumian matatawutawug tu kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, ka asi kamu nitmurung yawan

56.niv: But this has all taken place that the writings of the prophets might be fulfilled.” Then all the disciples deserted him and fled.
56.cmn: 但這一切的事成就了，為要應驗先知書上的話。」當下，門徒都離開他，逃走了。 耶穌在公會裏受審 （可14‧53－65；路22‧54－55，63－71；約18‧13－14，19－24）
56.sry: Ra nipamuten ta mamang ka ata aley ka pavutaw lato ta na sasulat ki matamatagitan da. Tu kidi ka ana nipuimid ilput ta patawutawugan tin, paitukwa tenian.

57.niv: Those who had arrested Jesus took him to Caiaphas the high priest, where the teachers of the law and the elders had assembled.
57.cmn: 拿耶穌的人把他帶到大祭司該亞法那裏去；文士和長老已經在那裏聚會。
57.sry: Neni ka nitmurung ti Yesusan, nimad [tenian] paukwa ti Kayfasan ka dadilug ka sibavaw, nimawisal hina ta makusasulat ki mamumu apa.

58.niv: But Peter followed him at a distance, right up to the courtyard of the high priest. He entered and sat down with the guards to see the outcome.
58.cmn: 彼得遠遠地跟着耶穌，直到大祭司的院子，進到裏面，就和差役同坐，要看這事到底怎樣。
58.sry: Ka niitudalia itu awug tenian ta ti Petrus tu kidi apa ki glaf ki dadilug, ka ru murbo ato, nimilam mirung ki makwa, ka kakitaaw tin ta limulimu.

59.niv: The chief priests and the whole Sanhedrin were looking for false evidence against Jesus so that they could put him to death.
59.cmn: 祭司長和全公會尋找假見證控告耶穌，要治死他。
59.sry: Ra tamapigik ka sibavaw mamumu, ki na pakuisalan apa ta nikmiim ki su ka patagihailen sihaharang tu duma ti Yesusan, aley ki pakapatayaw nein tenian, ka asi nein nipakivaleyen da.

60.niv: But they did not find any, though many false witnesses came forward. Finally two came forward
60.cmn: 雖有好些人來作假見證，總得不着實據。末後有兩個人前來，說：
60.sry: Mukuna ka mabatung ta hmail ka sihaharang ka irua hina, asi nein nipakivaleyen ki mamang.

61.niv: and declared, “This fellow said, ‘I am able to destroy the temple of God and rebuild it in three days.’ ”
61.cmn: 「這個人曾說：『我能拆毀上帝的殿，三日內又建造起來。』」
61.sry: Tu awugda niirua ta raruha ki hmail ka sihaharang, ka nikuma, Teni ka ata ta nikumakuma, Kulpugen aw kuta ta kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, ka meylikug meyringey ki ana tu tuturu ki wagi.

62.niv: Then the high priest stood up and said to Jesus, “Are you not going to answer? What is this testimony that these men are bringing against you?”
62.cmn: 大祭司就站起來，對耶穌說：「你甚麼都不回答嗎？這些人作見證告你的是甚麼呢？」
62.sry: Iru ka gapit ta dadilug, nikuma tenian, Asi ko matagivli ki mamang? Mang ta hailen nein matagiduma imhuan?

63.niv: But Jesus remained silent. The high priest said to him, “I charge you under oath by the living God: Tell us if you are the Messiah, the Son of God.”
63.cmn: 耶穌卻不言語。大祭司對他說：「我指着永生上帝叫你起誓告訴我們，你是上帝的兒子基督不是？」
63.sry: Ra ti Yesus ta nimeypat, ka matagivli ta dadilug nikuma tenian, Pakariherihe ko [mata su] imhuan ki Alid ka mawag, ka banaa kaw imumian, malava ka ti Kristus kaw, ka Alak ki Alid?

64.niv: “You have said so,” Jesus replied. “But I say to all of you: From now on you will see the Son of Man sitting at the right hand of the Mighty One and coming on the clouds of heaven.”
64.cmn: 耶穌對他說：「你說的是。然而，我告訴你們，後來你們要看見人子坐在那權能者的右邊，駕着天上的雲降臨。」
64.sry: Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Nimatagiruk kaw. Ra kuma ko imumian, na hininan ka ata kitaey umi ta Alak ki kagulung tu irungey tin tu uwal ki kailgan [ki Alid] ru iruaa tu purarey ki vulum.

65.niv: Then the high priest tore his clothes and said, “He has spoken blasphemy! Why do we need any more witnesses? Look, now you have heard the blasphemy.
65.cmn: 大祭司就撕開衣服，說：「他說了僭妄的話，我們何必再用見證人呢？這僭妄的話，現在你們都聽見了。
65.sry: Anata nikiit ta dadilug ki pamamian tin, kuma, Nibarug ta teni makutalum [ki Alid,] mangaw yan ta matagihail ka ruma? Kitaey, niilingigen umi hinin ta bavarug tin [ki Alid].

66.niv: What do you think?” “He is worthy of death,” they answered.
66.cmn: 你們的意見如何？」他們回答說：「他是該死的。」
66.sry: Pamang ta rig umi? Ra neni ta nimatagivli kuma, [Oohoh] mamsing ki pakapapatapatay.

67.niv: Then they spit in his face and struck him with their fists. Others slapped him
67.cmn: 他們就吐唾沫在他臉上，用拳頭打他，也有用手掌打他的，說：
67.sry: Anata nipadipagan nein tu vulung tin, ka nibukbuken nein ki na kumud tenian.

68.niv: and said, “Prophesy to us, Messiah. Who hit you?”
68.cmn: 「基督啊！你是先知，告訴我們打你的是誰？」 彼得三次不認主 （可14‧66－72；路22‧56－62；約18‧15－18，25－27）
68.sry: Ka pani ki vual ta nitumaplag tenian tu timi, kuma, Keydmiru kame kmeytan Kristus, ti taplag kaw ti mang?

69.niv: Now Peter was sitting out in the courtyard, and a servant girl came to him. “You also were with Jesus of Galilee,” she said.
69.cmn: 彼得在外面院子裏坐着，有一個使女前來，說：「你素來也是同那加利利人耶穌一夥的。」
69.sry: Ka nimimala miraung ta ti Petrus tu tatalagan, ka saat ka kawina ka pairungen ta niirua tenian, kuma, Nimakuilam apa kaw ta imhu ti Yesusan ka maka Galilaya.

70.niv: But he denied it before them all. “I donʼt know what youʼre talking about,” he said.
70.cmn: 彼得在眾人面前卻不承認，說：「我不知道你說的是甚麼！」
70.sry: Ra amag dmaw ki tau ka imid, kuma, Asi maw umhaen kamang ta su oho. Ra amag dmaw ki tau ka imid, Asi maw umhaen kamang ta su oho.

71.niv: Then he went out to the gateway, where another servant girl saw him and said to the people there, “This fellow was with Jesus of Nazareth.”
71.cmn: 既出去，到了門口，又有一個使女看見他，就對那裏的人說：「這個人也是同拿撒勒人耶穌一夥的。」
71.sry: Iru ka mumala ta teni tu tangag, nikmita apa tenian ta pani [ka ina ka pairungen] ka kuma nenian ka ayakwa hina, Teni apa ta na lam ti Yesus ka tagiNazareth.

72.niv: He denied it again, with an oath: “I donʼt know the man!”
72.cmn: 彼得又不承認，並且起誓說：「我不認得那個人。」
72.sry: Ka nilala dmaw ki su ka na papakakariherihe, Asi maw kalangen ta tau.

73.niv: After a little while, those standing there went up to Peter and said, “Surely you are one of them; your accent gives you away.”
73.cmn: 過了不多的時候，旁邊站着的人前來，對彼得說：「你真是他們一黨的，你的口音把你露出來了。」
73.sry: Nda matuk ki kidi ka ana, nimukwa ta miruko hina, ka nikuma ti Petrusan, Mising imhu ta na lam apa nein, nda pakalang kaw ki ingaw oho.

74.niv: Then he began to call down curses, and he swore to them, “I donʼt know the man!” Immediately a rooster crowed.
74.cmn: 彼得就發咒起誓地說：「我不認得那個人。」立時，雞就叫了。
74.sry: Anata nimanaunamu makuavavag tenian pakariherihe apa ki su, Asi maw kalangen ta tau.

75.niv: Then Peter remembered the word Jesus had spoken: “Before the rooster crows, you will disown me three times.” And he went outside and wept bitterly.
75.cmn: 彼得想起耶穌所說的話：「雞叫以先，你要三次不認我。」他就出去痛哭。
75.sry: Ka nitmatuk muni ta tafuka; ka nihmibaley ta ti Petrus ki na su ti Yesus ka nikuma tenian, Tuturu ki uniey ki tafuka, sawturula kaw dmaw yawan. Ka ru nisamamala, niganum [ki rig tin] nitmangitangi.

1.niv: Early in the morning, all the chief priests and the elders of the people made their plans how to have Jesus executed.
1.cmn: 到了早晨，眾祭司長和民間的長老大家商議要治死耶穌，
1.sry: Iru ka madama ato, nikumiin ki su ta tamapigik ki mamumu apa ki tau sadaduma ti Yesusan tu pakapatayaney tenian.

2.niv: So they bound him, led him away and handed him over to Pilate the governor.
2.cmn: 就把他捆綁，解去，交給巡撫彼拉多。 猶大的死 （徒1‧18－19）
2.sry: Ka ru nibawut tenian, niaden nein padarang ka nipaatunun tenian ti Pontius Pilitus ka tagisu ki purug.

3.niv: When Judas, who had betrayed him, saw that Jesus was condemned, he was seized with remorse and returned the thirty pieces of silver to the chief priests and the elders.
3.cmn: 這時候，賣耶穌的猶大看見耶穌已經定了罪，就後悔，把那三十塊錢拿回來給祭司長和長老，說：
3.sry: Anata nikavulasen ti Yudas ka nisivanavana ato tenian, ru kitaan tin ka dungdungen ato ta teni, nialikug tin mad ki tuturu kitian ki malituk ki sibavaw ka tamapigik ki mamumu apara.

4.niv: “I have sinned,” he said, “for I have betrayed innocent blood.” “What is that to us?” they replied. “Thatʼs your responsibility.”
4.cmn: 「我賣了無辜之人的血是有罪了。」他們說：「那與我們有甚麼相干？你自己承當吧！」
4.sry: Kuma, Nimavaraw ko, ki sivanavanaan ta gamag ka matiktik. Ra nikuma ta neni, Mangaw yan? Imhu ta kmitaa.

5.niv: So Judas threw the money into the temple and left. Then he went away and hanged himself.
5.cmn: 猶大就把那銀錢丟在殿裏，出去吊死了。
5.sry: Iru ka niaring tin ta malituk smakikwa tu kuva ki tatamudan ki Alid, nidmarang ato ra, iru ka ukwa, nimawsaid.

6.niv: The chief priests picked up the coins and said, “It is against the law to put this into the treasury, since it is blood money.”
6.cmn: 祭司長拾起銀錢來，說：「這是血價，不可放在庫裏。」
6.sry: Iru ka awgen ki sibavaw ka tamapigik ta malituk, nikun nein, Asi hahayen ka sacitey ta ana tu pukakwaan ki nipapigikan, aley ka na kidi ki asa ki gamag ta ana ra.

7.niv: So they decided to use the money to buy the potterʼs field as a burial place for foreigners.
7.cmn: 他們商議，就用那銀錢買了窯戶的一塊田，為要埋葬外鄉人。
7.sry: Iru ka makikaha kmiim ki su, nipeyla nein ki ana ta uma ki tamatulu ki rangi, tu raravakey ki tagakwa [nenian]

8.niv: That is why it has been called the Field of Blood to this day.
8.cmn: 所以那塊田直到今日還叫做「血田」。
8.sry: Ka aley ki ana na pananangen ta uma ka ana, uma ki gamag, tu kidi apa ki wagi hinin.

9.niv: Then what was spoken by Jeremiah the prophet was fulfilled: “They took the thirty pieces of silver, the price set on him by the people of Israel,
9.cmn: 這就應了先知耶利米的話，說：「他們用那三十塊錢，就是被估定之人的價錢，是以色列人中所估定的，
9.sry: Anata nipafute ta na susu ki tamamatagitan ka ti Yeremiyas, ka nikun tin, Ka niawug nein turu kitian ki malituk, ta angal ka kidi ki na alalak ti Israel, ki nisikidien nein.

10.niv: and they used them to buy the potterʼs field, as the Lord commanded me.”
10.cmn: 買了窯戶的一塊田；這是照着主所吩咐我的。」 耶穌在彼拉多面前受審 （可15‧2－5；路23‧3－5；約18‧33－38）
10.sry: Ka nipigaan nein ta ana aley ki uma ki tamatulu ki rangi, tu akwaan ki nisikidiun ti YEHOVA yawan.

11.niv: Meanwhile Jesus stood before the governor, and the governor asked him, “Are you the king of the Jews?” “You have said so,” Jesus replied.
11.cmn: 耶穌站在巡撫面前；巡撫問他說：「你是猶太人的王嗎？」耶穌說：「你說的是。」
11.sry: Ka niituduma mituko ta ti Yesus ki tagisu ki purug, ka nitmalig ta tagisu, kuma, Meysasu kaw kawa ka sibavaw ki Joden? Nikuma ta ti Yesus tenian, Patagiruken hu.

12.niv: When he was accused by the chief priests and the elders, he gave no answer.
12.cmn: 他被祭司長和長老控告的時候，甚麼都不回答。
12.sry: Ka tu patbarawen tenian ki sibavaw ka tamapigik ki mamumu apa, asi tin patagivlien ta mamang.

13.niv: Then Pilate asked him, “Donʼt you hear the testimony they are bringing against you?”
13.cmn: 彼拉多就對他說：「他們作見證告你這麼多的事，你沒有聽見嗎？」
13.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Pilatus tenian, Asi kaw milingig papina ta patagihail nein sadaduma imhuan?

14.niv: But Jesus made no reply, not even to a single charge—to the great amazement of the governor.
14.cmn: 耶穌仍不回答，連一句話也不說，以致巡撫甚覺希奇。 耶穌被判死刑 （可15‧6－15；路23‧13－25；約18‧39－19‧16）
14.sry: Ra asi nipatagivlien tin ki sasasat ki su tenian, kumahina ka uhang nimuringaw ta tagisu.

15.niv: Now it was the governorʼs custom at the festival to release a prisoner chosen by the crowd.
15.cmn: 巡撫有一個常例，每逢這節期，隨眾人所要的釋放一個囚犯給他們。
15.sry: Ka na kidi ki kadagamen tu uvavatugan ka asatey maawmia ki tagisu ta niusangat ki makuilalawlaw, timamang lava ka kamuyen nein da.

16.niv: At that time they had a well-known prisoner whose name was Jesus Barabbas.
16.cmn: 當時有一個出名的囚犯叫巴拉巴。
16.sry: Ka niakumeya nein tu kidi ka ana saat ki vawuten ato ka mamag ki varaw, ka nisakinanangen ti Barabbas.

17.niv: So when the crowd had gathered, Pilate asked them, “Which one do you want me to release to you: Jesus Barabbas, or Jesus who is called the Messiah?”
17.cmn: 眾人聚集的時候，彼拉多就對他們說：「你們要我釋放哪一個給你們？是巴拉巴呢？是稱為基督的耶穌呢？」
17.sry: Iru ka nip apakuil ta neni, nikuma ta ti Pilatus nenian, Timang ta kamuy umi ka awmiaw maw kamu, ti Barabbas kawa? ti Yesus kawa, ka siuwa Kristus?

18.niv: For he knew it was out of self-interest that they had handed Jesus over to him.
18.cmn: 巡撫原知道他們是因為嫉妒才把他解了來。
18.sry: Ra kavanaan tin ka nipaatunun ta neni tenian aley ki gaasan tenian.

19.niv: While Pilate was sitting on the judgeʼs seat, his wife sent him this message: “Donʼt have anything to do with that innocent man, for I have suffered a great deal today in a dream because of him.”
19.cmn: 正坐堂的時候，他的夫人打發人來說：「這義人的事，你一點不可管，因為我今天在夢中為他受了許多的苦。」
19.sry: Iru ka mirung ta teni tu irarungan ki awpapanagan, nimadingi ta keyan tin pakavana tenian, ka kumakwa, Ina umamang ki matiktik ka ana; nda madag ta nitububugaen aw hinin ki awvan ka ata tu maling aley tenian.

20.niv: But the chief priests and the elders persuaded the crowd to ask for Barabbas and to have Jesus executed.
20.cmn: 祭司長和長老挑唆眾人，求釋放巴拉巴，除滅耶穌。
20.sry: Ra nipatumumha ta sibavaw ka tamapigik ki mamumu apa ki makuilalawlaw, ka tmimiaw nein ta ti Barabas, papakapatay ti Yesusan.

21.niv: “Which of the two do you want me to release to you?” asked the governor. “Barabbas,” they answered.
21.cmn: 巡撫對眾人說：「這兩個人，你們要我釋放哪一個給你們呢？」他們說：「巴拉巴。」
21.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta tagisu ki purug, kuma nenian, Timang ki raruha ka ata ta kamuy umi ka awmi aw maw kamu? Ka nikuma ta neni, Ti Barabas.

22.niv: “What shall I do, then, with Jesus who is called the Messiah?” Pilate asked. They all answered, “Crucify him!”
22.cmn: 彼拉多說：「這樣，那稱為基督的耶穌我怎麼辦他呢？」他們都說：「把他釘十字架！」
22.sry: Nikuma ta ti Pilatus nenian, Mangaw lato maw ta ti Yesus, ka siuwa ti Kristus? Nikumaibeyaveyag tenian, Nda punavavaragaw.

23.niv: “Why? What crime has he committed?” asked Pilate. But they shouted all the louder, “Crucify him!”
23.cmn: 巡撫說：「為甚麼呢？他做了甚麼惡事呢？」他們便極力地喊着說：「把他釘十字架！」
23.sry: Ra nikuma ta tagisu ki purug, Kamang ta na varaw tin? Ka pakusaen nein makutun, kuma papunavavaragaw.

24.niv: When Pilate saw that he was getting nowhere, but that instead an uproar was starting, he took water and washed his hands in front of the crowd. “I am innocent of this manʼs blood,” he said. “It is your responsibility!”
24.cmn: 彼拉多見說也無濟於事，反要生亂，就拿水在眾人面前洗手，說：「流這義人的血，罪不在我，你們承當吧。」
24.sry: Iru ka hmawat ta ti Pilatus, ka asi tin pakasaunen milig, ra nipakasaunen apa ta karakarakan, niawug tin ta ralum, ka madina ki rima tu amag ki makuisasal, ka nikun tin, Ausi ko ki varaw ki paputatirien ki gamag ki matiktik ka ata: Hmawata ta imumi ra

25.niv: All the people answered, “His blood is on us and on our children!”
25.cmn: 眾人都回答說：「他的血歸到我們和我們的子孫身上。」
25.sry: Ka nimatagivli ta makuitatumuk ka tau, Gamag tin ta muhalapa imianan ki alalak apa yan.

26.niv: Then he released Barabbas to them. But he had Jesus flogged, and handed him over to be crucified.
26.cmn: 於是彼拉多釋放巴拉巴給他們，把耶穌鞭打了，交給人釘十字架。 兵丁戲弄耶穌 （可15‧16－20；約19‧2－3）
26.sry: Anata niawmien tin paakwa nenian ta ti Barabas, iru ka nismaplat ti Yesusan, nipaatunun tu punavavaragey tenian.

27.niv: Then the governorʼs soldiers took Jesus into the Praetorium and gathered the whole company of soldiers around him.
27.cmn: 巡撫的兵就把耶穌帶進衙門，叫全營的兵都聚集在他那裏。
27.sry: Anata nipatulam ta tamamacit ki tagisu ki purug ti Yesusan, paukwa tenian tu keyrangan ki papamamagan, ka nipapaitumuk nein papaisal tenian ta makuitatumuk ki sat kaililan.

28.niv: They stripped him and put a scarlet robe on him,
28.cmn: 他們給他脫了衣服，穿上一件朱紅色袍子，
28.sry: Iru ka niawmien nein ta pamian tin, nipapahakuvar ta neni tenian ki kuvar ka mama ki apuy [ka patag.]

29.niv: and then twisted together a crown of thorns and set it on his head. They put a staff in his right hand. Then they knelt in front of him and mocked him. “Hail, king of the Jews!” they said.
29.cmn: 用荊棘編做冠冕，戴在他頭上，拿一根葦子放在他右手裏，跪在他面前，戲弄他，說：「恭喜，猶太人的王啊！」
29.sry: Iru ka nitinun nein ta sakiru ka na adum, nipakabungen nein tenian ta ata, pukwa ki angto apa tu rima ka uwal tin, ka ru matalikurug tu duma tenian, nibilavila tenian, kuma, Tabe meysasu ka sibavaw ki Yoden.

30.niv: They spit on him, and took the staff and struck him on the head again and again.
30.cmn: 又吐唾沫在他臉上，拿葦子打他的頭。
30.sry: Ka ru nimadipag tenian, niara nein ta angto, ka nivulat tu vungo tin.

31.niv: After they had mocked him, they took off the robe and put his own clothes on him. Then they led him away to crucify him.
31.cmn: 戲弄完了，就給他脫了袍子，仍穿上他自己的衣服，帶他出去，要釘十字架。 耶穌被釘十字架 （可15‧21－32；路23‧26－43；約19‧17－27）
31.sry: Iru ka nibilavila tenian, niawmien nein ta kuvar, ka nipapagkulamug nein ki nipamamien tin, ka niad nein tu punavavaragey tenian.

32.niv: As they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross.
32.cmn: 他們出來的時候，遇見一個古利奈人，名叫西門，就勉強他同去，好背着耶穌的十字架。
32.sry: Iru ka tawpapanag nikabaley nein ta vual ka maka Sirenen, ka ti Simon ki nanang; ka niigareyen nein paaval ki navavarag tin.

33.niv: They came to a place called Golgotha (which means “the place of the skull”).
33.cmn: 到了一個地方名叫各各他，意思就是「髑髏地」。
33.sry: Iru ka irua ato tu itukwaan, ka pananange nato Golgota, ka siuwa itukwaan ki toktok.

34.niv: There they offered Jesus wine to drink, mixed with gall; but after tasting it, he refused to drink it.
34.cmn: 兵丁拿苦膽調和的酒給耶穌喝；他嘗了，就不肯喝。
34.sry: Nipait tenian ki mapingit ka na hurad ki parno; iru ka nikudimanen tin, niinang mit.

35.niv: When they had crucified him, they divided up his clothes by casting lots.
35.cmn: 他們既將他釘在十字架上，就拈鬮分他的衣服，
35.sry: Iru ka nipunavavarag tenian, nipatatag nein ta nipamamien ki na pakyaw; aley ka pavutaw ta na su ki tamamatagitan, Nimaysal matatag ta neni ki pamamien aw, ka nipakyaw aley ki kulamug aw.

36.niv: And sitting down, they kept watch over him there.
36.cmn: 又坐在那裏看守他。
36.sry: Ka du mirung, nikmading tu hina tenian.

37.niv: Above his head they placed the written charge against him: This is Jesus, the King of the Jews.
37.cmn: 在他頭以上安一個牌子，寫着他的罪狀，說：「這是猶太人的王耶穌。」
37.sry: Ka nipukwaan nein puvavaw ki vungo tin ta na sasulat ki nialeyen patbaraw tenian, Ti ata ta Yesus ka Meysasu ka Sibavaw ki Yoden.

38.niv: Two rebels were crucified with him, one on his right and one on his left.
38.cmn: 當時，有兩個強盜和他同釘十字架，一個在右邊，一個在左邊。
38.sry: Tu kidi ka ana nipulamen tenian punavavarag ta raruha ki tamalpug, tu uwal ta sasat, tu ugi ta sasat.

39.niv: Those who passed by hurled insults at him, shaking their heads
39.cmn: 從那裏經過的人譏誚他，搖着頭，說：
39.sry: Ra neni ka hmarivat, nimakuavavag tenian bikbik ki vungo nein,

40.niv: and saying, “You who are going to destroy the temple and build it in three days, save yourself! Come down from the cross, if you are the Son of God!”
40.cmn: 「你這拆毀聖殿、三日又建造起來的，可以救自己吧！你如果是上帝的兒子，就從十字架上下來吧！」
40.sry: Kuma, Imhu ka kutakaw ki kuva ki tatamuden ki Alid, ka meyringey ki ana [meylikug] tu tuturu ki wagi, nda maawmado hmamia imhuan. Hairu Alak kaw ki Alid, murarima ki navavarag.

41.niv: In the same way the chief priests, the teachers of the law and the elders mocked him.
41.cmn: 祭司長和文士並長老也是這樣戲弄他，說：
41.sry: Makawlawla kumahina ta sibavaw ka tamapigik ki makusasulat, ki mamumu, ki Farizeen apa, du bilavila, nikuma ta neni,

42.niv: “He saved others,” they said, “but he canʼt save himself! Heʼs the king of Israel! Let him come down now from the cross, and we will believe in him.
42.cmn: 「他救了別人，不能救自己。他是以色列的王，現在可以從十字架上下來，我們就信他。
42.sry: Pani ki vual ta nihmamiaan tinra asi maawlpug maawmado hmamia tenian. Hairu meysasu ka sibavaw ta teni ki Israel, nda murarima hinin ta teni ki navavarag, ka tnamisinga kame tenian.

43.niv: He trusts in God. Let God rescue him now if he wants him, for he said, ‘I am the Son of God.’ ”
43.cmn: 他倚靠上帝，上帝若喜悅他，現在可以救他；因為他曾說：『我是上帝的兒子。』」
43.sry: Nimasuhut ki rig ki Alid; nda hamiaw tin hinin tenian, hairu aku muy tenian ta teni. Ka nikuma ta teni, Alak ko ki Alid ti yaw.

44.niv: In the same way the rebels who were crucified with him also heaped insults on him.
44.cmn: 那和他同釘的強盜也是這樣地譏誚他。 耶穌的死 （可15‧33－41；路23‧44－49；約19‧28－30）
44.sry: Ka teni ki ata nipaunanay tenian ta tamalpug, ka nipulaen ato punavavarag tenian.

45.niv: From noon until three in the afternoon darkness came over all the land.
45.cmn: 從午正到申初，遍地都黑暗了。
45.sry: Ka na kidi ki kaanim ki tagley niirua ta karumduman tu mitatumuk ki nay, tu kidi apa ki kamamatuda ki tagley.

46.niv: About three in the afternoon Jesus cried out in a loud voice, “Eli, Eli, lema sabachthani?” (which means “My God, my God, why have you forsaken me?”).
46.cmn: 約在申初，耶穌大聲喊着說：「以利！以利！拉馬撒巴各大尼？」就是說：「我的上帝！我的上帝！為甚麼離棄我？」
46.sry: Ka mahivat ato ki kamamatuda ki tagley, nimakulangag ta ti Yesus ki ingaw ka irang, kuma, Eli, Eli, Lama Sabagtani, ka inaakwaaney, Alid aw, Alid aw, kaumang ka nidmarang kaw paitusat?

47.niv: When some of those standing there heard this, they said, “Heʼs calling Elijah.”
47.cmn: 站在那裏的人，有的聽見就說：「這個人呼叫以利亞呢！」
47.sry: Ka raruma ka mituko hina, ru ilingigen nein [ta ata,] ta nikuma, Tmataam ti Eliyasan ta ti ata.

48.niv: Immediately one of them ran and got a sponge. He filled it with wine vinegar, put it on a staff, and offered it to Jesus to drink.
48.cmn: 內中有一個人趕緊跑去，拿海絨蘸滿了醋，綁在葦子上，送給他喝。
48.sry: Ka madis saat nenian ta nisium mara ki na vadiu, ka mama ki purut, ka ru niputumuyen tin ki mapingit, nimaliritung malivit ki na angto, ka nipait tenian.

49.niv: The rest said, “Now leave him alone. Letʼs see if Elijah comes to save him.”
49.cmn: 其餘的人說：「且等着，看以利亞來救他不來。」
49.sry: Ra nikuma ta raruma Usey ato, kitaey mita, malava ka iruaa ta ti Eliyas hmamia tenian.

50.niv: And when Jesus had cried out again in a loud voice, he gave up his spirit.
50.cmn: 耶穌又大聲喊叫，氣就斷了。
50.sry: Ka du mila makulig ki ingaw ka irang ta ti Yesus, nimitaraug ki hinawa.

51.niv: At that moment the curtain of the temple was torn in two from top to bottom. The earth shook, the rocks split
51.cmn: 忽然，殿裏的幔子從上到下裂為兩半，地也震動，磐石也崩裂，
51.sry: Ka kitaey, nipapuduha ta varit ka kuvar ki kuva ki tatamuden ki Alid, maka vavaw tu kidi apa ka tu rarim; ka nininug ta nay, ka nimuasas ta vato.

52.niv: and the tombs broke open. The bodies of many holy people who had died were raised to life.
52.cmn: 墳墓也開了，已睡聖徒的身體多有起來的。
52.sry: Ka nimutulag ta ravaravak, ka madag ki vual ki madilig matiktik, ka nimirip, ta nipagapiten ato.

53.niv: They came out of the tombs after Jesusʼ resurrection and went into the holy city and appeared to many people.
53.cmn: 到耶穌復活以後，他們從墳墓裏出來，進了聖城，向許多人顯現。
53.sry: Ka ru nitawpapanagen nein maka rbo ki ravaravak siawug ki nipatimawagan [pagapit] tenian, niirua ta neni tu awma ka paituni tu tatamudan ki Alid, ka nimupanag tu ki mabatung [ki vual.]

54.niv: When the centurion and those with him who were guarding Jesus saw the earthquake and all that had happened, they were terrified, and exclaimed, “Surely he was the Son of God!”
54.cmn: 百夫長和一同看守耶穌的人看見地震並所經歷的事，就極其害怕，說：「這真是上帝的兒子了！」
54.sry: Ra meysasu ki sat kaatugan, neni apa ka kumasal tenian kmading ti Yesusan, ru kitaan nein ta ninug, kamamang apa ka nipamuten, uhang nimatakut, kuma, Mising Alak ki Alid ta ti ana.

55.niv: Many women were there, watching from a distance. They had followed Jesus from Galilee to care for his needs.
55.cmn: 有好些婦女在那裏，遠遠地觀看；她們是從加利利跟隨耶穌來服事他的。
55.sry: Ka niayakwa hina ta inaina ka mabatung, matawtawag mararaw, ka nisiawug ti Yesusan maka Galilaya, aley ka pileyligey nein tenian.

56.niv: Among them were Mary Magdalene, Mary the mother of James and Joseph, and the mother of Zebedeeʼs sons.
56.cmn: 內中有抹大拉的馬利亞，又有雅各和約西的母親馬利亞，並有西庇太兩個兒子的母親。 耶穌的安葬 （可15‧42－47；路23‧50－56；約19‧38－42）
56.sry: Ka ayatamawug nenian ta ti Maria Magdalena, ta ti Maria ka ti Yakobus, ti Yoses apa, ki rarenan apa ki alalak ka papara ti Zebedeyus.

57.niv: As evening approached, there came a rich man from Arimathea, named Joseph, who had himself become a disciple of Jesus.
57.cmn: 到了晚上，有一個財主，名叫約瑟，是亞利馬太來的，他也是耶穌的門徒。
57.sry: Iru ka madung ato niirua ta vual ka mavangey ka maka Arimateya, ka ti Yosef ki nanang, ka patawutawugan apa ti Yesus.

58.niv: Going to Pilate, he asked for Jesusʼ body, and Pilate ordered that it be given to him.
58.cmn: 這人去見彼拉多，求耶穌的身體；彼拉多就吩咐給他。
58.sry: Teni ta nimukwa ti Pilatusan, ka nitmimien tin ta vual ti Yesus. Anata nimadingi ta ti Pilatus ka pahalikugey ta vual.

59.niv: Joseph took the body, wrapped it in a clean linen cloth,
59.cmn: 約瑟取了身體，用乾淨細麻布裹好，
59.sry: Iru ka araen ti Josef ta vual, nitupu tin ta ana ki ayt ka makuptig ka paligpig.

60.niv: and placed it in his own new tomb that he had cut out of the rock. He rolled a big stone in front of the entrance to the tomb and went away.
60.cmn: 安放在自己的新墳墓裏，就是他鑿在磐石裏的。他又把大石頭滾到墓門口，就去了。
60.sry: Ka niatakwaan tin ta ana tu ravak tin ka vahaw, ka nikutaen tin tu vato; iru ka nirikilen tin ta vato ka irang tu ngataf ki ravak, nidmarang ta teni.

61.niv: Mary Magdalene and the other Mary were sitting there opposite the tomb.
61.cmn: 有抹大拉的馬利亞和那個馬利亞在那裏，對着墳墓坐着。 封石妥守
61.sry: Ka niayakwa hina ta ti Maria Magdalena, ti Maria apa ka saat, ka mirung ta neni tu duma ki ravak.

62.niv: The next day, the one after Preparation Day, the chief priests and the Pharisees went to Pilate.
62.cmn: 次日，就是預備日的第二天，祭司長和法利賽人聚集來見彼拉多，說：
62.sry: Ra tu sasat apa ki wagi, ka siawug ki sitatanangen, nimawisal ta sibavaw ka tamapigik ki Farizeen apa ti Pilatusan

63.niv: “Sir,” they said, “we remember that while he was still alive that deceiver said, ‘After three days I will rise again.’
63.cmn: 「大人，我們記得那誘惑人的還活着的時候曾說：『三日後我要復活。』
63.sry: Kuma, Meyrang, hibaleyen yan ka nimatagikumahina ki su ta tamapatagirahay ki ana ka mawag apa ta teni, gapitaw maw siawug ki tuturu ki wagi.

64.niv: So give the order for the tomb to be made secure until the third day. Otherwise, his disciples may come and steal the body and tell the people that he has been raised from the dead. This last deception will be worse than the first.”
64.cmn: 因此，請吩咐人將墳墓把守妥當，直到第三日，恐怕他的門徒來，把他偷了去，就告訴百姓說：『他從死裏復活了。』這樣，那後來的迷惑比先前的更利害了！」
64.sry: Padingiaw hinin papaawsaun kmading ta ravak tu kidi ki kataturu ki wagi, aley ka asi lava iruaa ta patawutawugan tin du awvanan hauzung tenian, ka matagikumaa hina ki tau, nipatimawagen [pagapit] ki nikapatayan; ka kumahina masauna lato mate ta tauraheyen ka siawug ki nisiuro ato.

65.niv: “Take a guard,” Pilate answered. “Go, make the tomb as secure as you know how.”
65.cmn: 彼拉多說：「你們有看守的兵，去吧！盡你們所能的把守妥當。」
65.sry: Ra nikuma nenian ta ti Pilatus, Akumeya kamu ki kmakading, ukwaaw, papaawsaun ato ki ana mama ki kavana umi.

66.niv: So they went and made the tomb secure by putting a seal on the stone and posting the guard.
66.cmn: 他們就帶着看守的兵同去，封了石頭，將墳墓把守妥當。
66.sry: Iru ka dmarang ta neni, nipapaawsaunen nein ki kmakading ta ravak, ru nipukahan nein putapuyaw pukidi ta vato.

1.niv: After the Sabbath, at dawn on the first day of the week, Mary Magdalene and the other Mary went to look at the tomb.
1.cmn: 安息日將盡，七日的頭一日，天快亮的時候，抹大拉的馬利亞和那個馬利亞來看墳墓。
1.sry: Ka tu lalat siawug ki wagi ki pahihababan ru minaunamu bavarag, du naunamua ato [ta wagi] ki kupta, niirua ta ti Maria Magdalena, ti Maria apa ka saat tu ararawey nein ta ravak.

2.niv: There was a violent earthquake, for an angel of the Lord came down from heaven and, going to the tomb, rolled back the stone and sat on it.
2.cmn: 忽然，地大震動；因為有主的使者從天上下來，把石頭滾開，坐在上面。
2.sry: Ka kitaey, niirua ta ninug ka irang: da tamagnaw ki Meyrang kamurarim maka tunun, ta niirua, ka nirikilen tin ta vato putawag ki ngataf, ka nimirung ta teni mihalap ki ana.

3.niv: His appearance was like lightning, and his clothes were white as snow.
3.cmn: 他的相貌如同閃電，衣服潔白如雪。
3.sry: Ka haway tin ta mak ugla ki rikat, ka pamamien tin ta mapule mama ki ugla ka m aparukapok.

4.niv: The guards were so afraid of him that they shook and became like dead men.
4.cmn: 看守的人就因他嚇得渾身亂戰，甚至和死人一樣。
4.sry: Ka aley ki takut tenian, nimuavauvaug ta kmakading, ka mama ki patay ta neni.

5.niv: The angel said to the women, “Do not be afraid, for I know that you are looking for Jesus, who was crucified.
5.cmn: 天使對婦女說：「不要害怕！我知道你們是尋找那釘十字架的耶穌。
5.sry: Ra du matagivli ta tamagnaw nikuma ki inaina, ina matakut ta imumi, ka kavanaen aw ka kmiim kamu ti Yesusan ka nipunavavaragen ato.

6.niv: He is not here; he has risen, just as he said. Come and see the place where he lay.
6.cmn: 他不在這裏，照他所說的，已經復活了。你們來看安放主的地方。
6.sry: Ausi ta teni hiya; nipatimawagen ta teni [pagapit] mama ki na su tin. Mukwa hiya, kitaey ta itukwaan ki nikalalikuen ki Meyrang.

7.niv: Then go quickly and tell his disciples: ‘He has risen from the dead and is going ahead of you into Galilee. There you will see him.’ Now I have told you.”
7.cmn: 快去告訴他的門徒，說他從死裏復活了，並且在你們以先往加利利去，在那裏你們要見他。看哪，我已經告訴你們了。」
7.sry: Ka ukwa madis vanavana ki patawutawugan tin, ka nipatimawagen pagapit ki nikapatayan; ka kitaey, siururo ta teni imumian mukwa tu Galilaya, tu hina kitaey umi ta teni, Kitaey, patagikahaan ato maw imumian.

8.niv: So the women hurried away from the tomb, afraid yet filled with joy, and ran to tell his disciples.
8.cmn: 婦女們就急忙離開墳墓，又害怕，又大大地歡喜，跑去要報給他的門徒。
8.sry: Iru ka madis tawpapanagen nein ki ravak tu katakutan ki karayen apa ka irang, nisium ta neni aley ki gnawen [ki ata] ki patawutawugan tin.

9.niv: Suddenly Jesus met them. “Greetings,” he said. They came to him, clasped his feet and worshiped him.
9.cmn: 忽然，耶穌遇見她們，說：「願你們平安！」她們就上前抱住他的腳拜他。
9.sry: Iru ka dmarang ta neni aley ki gnawen ki patawutawugan tin, kitaey nimuakla nenian ta ti Yesus, kuma, Tabe [maray ato:] iru ka mukwa ta neni, nipeykwaan nein ta rapal tin, makualilid tenian.

10.niv: Then Jesus said to them, “Do not be afraid. Go and tell my brothers to go to Galilee; there they will see me.”
10.cmn: 耶穌對她們說：「不要害怕！你們去告訴我的弟兄，叫他們往加利利去，在那裏必見我。」 看守的兵報告祭司長
10.sry: Anata nikuma ta ti Yesus nenian, Ina matakut, ukwa ato hunaw ki tagiapaparag aw ka sakakwaey nein mukwa Galilaya, ka tu hina kmitaa neni yawan.

11.niv: While the women were on their way, some of the guards went into the city and reported to the chief priests everything that had happened.
11.cmn: 她們去的時候，看守的兵有幾個進城去，將所經歷的事都報給祭司長。
11.sry: Iru ka dmarang ta neni, kitaey ta ruma ki kmakading nimuawma ta neni, ka niimiden nein gnaw ki tamapigik ka sibavaw ta kamamang ka nipamuten ato ra.

12.niv: When the chief priests had met with the elders and devised a plan, they gave the soldiers a large sum of money,
12.cmn: 祭司長和長老聚集商議，就拿許多銀錢給兵丁，說：
12.sry: Iru ka mawisal ato ki mamumu, ka nikiimen nein ta su, nipahatapangen nein ta malituk ki vual ka tamamacit.

13.niv: telling them, “You are to say, ‘His disciples came during the night and stole him away while we were asleep.’
13.cmn: 「你們要這樣說：『夜間我們睡覺的時候，他的門徒來，把他偷去了。』
13.sry: Kuma, Matagi kumahina ki su ta imumi, ka niirua ka awvanan ta patawutawugan tin, ka nihauzung tenian tu iripaan.

14.niv: If this report gets to the governor, we will satisfy him and keep you out of trouble.”
14.cmn: 倘若這話被巡撫聽見，有我們勸他，保你們無事。」
14.sry: Hairu ka ilingey ki Tagisu ki purug ta ana, dmawdaloa kame tenian, ka ausia kamu ki himko ta imumi. Hairu ka ilingigey ki tagisu ki purug ta ana, dumawdaloa kame tenian, ka ausia kamu ki himko ta imumi.

15.niv: So the soldiers took the money and did as they were instructed. And this story has been widely circulated among the Jews to this very day.
15.cmn: 兵丁受了銀錢，就照所囑咐他們的去行。這話就傳說在猶太人中間，直到今日。 門徒奉差遣 （可16‧14－18；路24‧36－49；約20‧19－23；徒1‧6－8）
15.sry: Iru ka niara nein ta malituk, nipamut mama ki nipatagiutawugen nenian. Ka nihmaveya ta su ka ana tu ta mawug ki Yoden tu kidi apa ki wagi ka ata hinin.

16.niv: Then the eleven disciples went to Galilee, to the mountain where Jesus had told them to go.
16.cmn: 十一個門徒往加利利去，到了耶穌約定的山上。
16.sry: Ra sat kitian ab ki sat patawutawugan nitawhabul mukwa tu Galilaya, tu vukin ka nisikidien ti Yesus nenian.

17.niv: When they saw him, they worshiped him; but some doubted.
17.cmn: 他們見了耶穌就拜他，然而還有人疑惑。
17.sry: Iru ka kmita tenian, nimakualilid tenian ta neni, ra nipadalag apa ki rig ta ruma ra.

18.niv: Then Jesus came to them and said, “All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.
18.cmn: 耶穌進前來，對他們說：「天上地下所有的權柄都賜給我了。
18.sry: Iru ka mukwa muhili ta ti Yesus, nipasusuen tin nenian, kuma, Nipigaan ko imid ki kailgan tu tunun ki vulum ki nay.

19.niv: Therefore go and make disciples of all nations, baptizing them in the name of the Father and of the Son and of the Holy Spirit,
19.cmn: 所以，你們要去，使萬民作我的門徒，奉父、子、聖靈的名給他們施洗 。
19.sry: Anata mukwaa, makuveyaga matawutawug ki tautau, mawlug nenian tu nanang ki Rama, ki Alak, ki YUPAN; patagitawugey umi pailig nenian imid ki mamang ka nipakusuen aw imumian.

20.niv: and teaching them to obey everything I have commanded you. And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.”
20.cmn: 凡我所吩咐你們的，都教訓他們遵守，我就常與你們同在，直到世界的末了。」
20.sry: Ka kitaey, ayalam ko imumian tu imid ki wagi, tu kidi ki limulimu ki idarinugan. Amen.
